book.title: Tanakh
book.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
book.license: Hebrew: Miqra according to the Masorah via Sefaria, CC BY-SA. English: JPS 1917, public domain.
book.notes: Torah, Nevi’im and Ketuvim in the Hebrew order. Hebrew verse numbering is retained; a few books (e.g. Joel) differ from Christian numbering.

verses.original: לְאָדָ֥ם מַעַרְכֵי־לֵ֑ב וּ֝מֵיְהֹוָ֗ה מַעֲנֵ֥ה לָשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.translit: l'dm m'rkhylb vmyhvh m'nh lshvn
verses.translation: The preparations of the heart are man’s, But the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּֽל־דַּרְכֵי־אִ֭ישׁ זַ֣ךְ בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְתֹכֵ֖ן רוּח֣וֹת יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khldrkhy'ysh zkh b'ynyv vtkhn rvchvt yhvh
verses.translation: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; But the LORD weigheth the spirits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֹּ֣ל אֶל־יְהֹוָ֣ה מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וְ֝יִכֹּ֗נוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: gl 'lyhvh m'shykh vykhnv mchshbtykh
verses.translation: Commit thy works unto the LORD, And thy thoughts shall be established.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ל פָּעַ֣ל יְ֭הֹוָה לַֽמַּעֲנֵ֑הוּ וְגַם־רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לְי֣וֹם רָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: khl p'l yhvh lm'nhv vgmrsh' lyvm r'h
verses.translation: The LORD hath made every things for His own purpose, Yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה כׇּל־גְּבַהּ־לֵ֑ב יָ֥ד לְ֝יָ֗ד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃
verses.translit: tv'bt yhvh khlgbhlb yd lyd l' ynqh
verses.translation: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; My hand upon it! he shall not be unpunished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּחֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭אֱמֶת יְכֻפַּ֣ר עָוֺ֑ן וּבְיִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה ס֣וּר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.translit: bchsd v'mt ykhpr 'vn vbyr't yhvh svr mr'
verses.translation: By mercy and truth iniquity is expiated; And by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּרְצ֣וֹת יְ֭הֹוָה דַּרְכֵי־אִ֑ישׁ גַּם־א֝וֹיְבָ֗יו יַשְׁלִ֥ם אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: brtsvt yhvh drkhy'ysh gm'vybyv yshlm 'tv
verses.translation: When a man’s ways please the LORD, He maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טוֹב־מְ֭עַט בִּצְדָקָ֑ה מֵרֹ֥ב תְּ֝בוּא֗וֹת בְּלֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: tvbm't btsdqh mrb tbv'vt bl' mshpt
verses.translation: Better is a little with righteousness Than great revenues with injustice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֣ב אָ֭דָם יְחַשֵּׁ֣ב דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וַ֝יהֹוָ֗ה יָכִ֥ין צַעֲדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: lb 'dm ychshb drkhv vyhvh ykhyn ts'dv
verses.translation: A man’s heart deviseth his way; But the LORD directeth his steps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֶ֤סֶם  עַֽל־שִׂפְתֵי־מֶ֑לֶךְ בְּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט לֹ֣א יִמְעַל־פִּֽיו׃
verses.translit: qsm  'lshptymlkh bmshpt l' ym'lpyv
verses.translation: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king; His mouth trespasseth not in judgment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּ֤לֶס  וּמֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭שְׁפָּט לַיהֹוָ֑ה מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ כׇּל־אַבְנֵי־כִֽיס׃
verses.translit: pls  vm'zny mshpt lyhvh m'shhv khl'bnykhys
verses.translation: A just balance and scales are the LORD’S; All the weights of the bag are His work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת מְ֭לָכִים עֲשׂ֣וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע כִּ֥י בִ֝צְדָקָ֗ה יִכּ֥וֹן כִּסֵּֽא׃
verses.translit: tv'bt mlkhym 'shvt rsh' khy btsdqh ykhvn khs'
verses.translation: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness; For the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְצ֣וֹן מְ֭לָכִים שִׂפְתֵי־צֶ֑דֶק וְדֹבֵ֖ר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יֶאֱהָֽב׃
verses.translit: rtsvn mlkhym shptytsdq vdbr yshrym y'hb
verses.translation: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; And they love him that speaketh right.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲמַת־מֶ֥לֶךְ מַלְאֲכֵי־מָ֑וֶת וְאִ֖ישׁ חָכָ֣ם יְכַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: chmtmlkh ml'khymvt v'ysh chkhm ykhprnh
verses.translation: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death; But a wise man will pacify it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאוֹר־פְּנֵי־מֶ֥לֶךְ חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝רְצוֹנ֗וֹ כְּעָ֣ב מַלְקֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: b'vrpnymlkh chyym vrtsvnv kh'b mlqvsh
verses.translation: In the light of the king’s countenance is life; And his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קְֽנֹה־חׇכְמָ֗ה מַה־טּ֥וֹב מֵחָר֑וּץ וּקְנ֥וֹת בִּ֝ינָ֗ה נִבְחָ֥ר מִכָּֽסֶף׃
verses.translit: qnhchkhmh mhtvb mchrvts vqnvt bynh nbchr mkhsf
verses.translation: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! Yea, to get understanding is rather to be chosen than silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְסִלַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים ס֣וּר מֵרָ֑ע שֹׁמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ נֹצֵ֥ר דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mslt yshrym svr mr' shmr npshv ntsr drkhv
verses.translation: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil; He that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִפְנֵי־שֶׁ֥בֶר גָּא֑וֹן וְלִפְנֵ֥י כִ֝שָּׁל֗וֹן גֹּ֣בַהּ רֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: lpnyshbr g'vn vlpny khshlvn gbh rvch
verses.translation: Pride goeth before destruction, And a haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֣וֹב שְׁפַל־ר֭וּחַ אֶת־[עֲנָוִ֑ים] (עניים) מֵחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁ֝לָ֗ל אֶת־גֵּאִֽים׃
verses.translit: tvb shplrvch 't['nvym] ('nyym) mchlq shll 'tg'ym
verses.translation: Better it is to be of a lowly spirit with the humble, Than to divide the spoil with the proud.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל עַל־דָּ֭בָר יִמְצָא־ט֑וֹב וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּיהֹוָ֣ה אַשְׁרָֽיו׃
verses.translit: mshkhyl 'ldbr ymts'tvb vbvtch byhvh 'shryv
verses.translation: He that giveth heed unto the word shall find good; And whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַֽחֲכַם־לֵ֭ב יִקָּרֵ֣א נָב֑וֹן וּמֶ֥תֶק שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח׃
verses.translit: lchkhmlb yqr' nbvn vmtq shptym ysyf lqch
verses.translation: The wise in heart is called a man of discernment; And the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים שֵׂ֣כֶל בְּעָלָ֑יו וּמוּסַ֖ר אֱוִלִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.translit: mqvr chyym shkhl b'lyv vmvsr 'vlym 'vlt
verses.translation: Understanding is a fountain of life unto him that hath it; But folly is the chastisement of fools.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֣ב חָ֭כָם יַשְׂכִּ֣יל פִּ֑יהוּ וְעַל־שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח׃
verses.translit: lb chkhm yshkhyl pyhv v'lshptyv ysyf lqch
verses.translation: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, And addeth learning to his lips.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צוּף־דְּ֭בַשׁ אִמְרֵי־נֹ֑עַם מָת֥וֹק לַ֝נֶּ֗פֶשׁ וּמַרְפֵּ֥א לָעָֽצֶם׃
verses.translit: tsvfdbsh 'mryn'm mtvq lnpsh vmrp' l'tsm
verses.translation: Pleasant words are as a honeycomb, Sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֤שׁ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יָ֭שָׁר לִפְנֵי־אִ֑ישׁ וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ דַּרְכֵי־מָֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: ysh drkh yshr lpny'ysh v'chryth drkhymvt
verses.translation: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, But the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֶ֣פֶשׁ עָ֭מֵל עָ֣מְלָה לּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־אָכַ֖ף עָלָ֣יו פִּֽיהוּ׃
verses.translit: npsh 'ml 'mlh lv khy'khf 'lyv pyhv
verses.translation: The hunger of the labouring man laboureth for him; For his mouth compelleth him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ בְּ֭לִיַּעַל כֹּרֶ֣ה רָעָ֑ה וְעַל־[שְׂ֝פָת֗וֹ] (שפתיו) כְּאֵ֣שׁ צָרָֽבֶת׃
verses.translit: 'ysh bly'l khrh r'h v'l[shptv] (shptyv) kh'sh tsrbt
verses.translation: An ungodly man diggeth up evil, And in his lips there is as a burning fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ תַּ֭הְפֻּכוֹת יְשַׁלַּ֣ח מָד֑וֹן וְ֝נִרְגָּ֗ן מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף׃
verses.translit: 'ysh thpkhvt yshlch mdvn vnrgn mpryd 'lvf
verses.translation: A froward man soweth strife; And a whisperer separateth familiar friends.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ חָ֭מָס יְפַתֶּ֣ה רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝הוֹלִיכ֗וֹ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ לֹא־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: 'ysh chms ypth r'hv vhvlykhv bdrkh l'tvb
verses.translation: A man of violence enticeth his neighbour, And leadeth him into a way that is not good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹצֶ֣ה עֵ֭ינָיו לַחְשֹׁ֣ב תַּהְפֻּכ֑וֹת קֹרֵ֥ץ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו כִּלָּ֥ה רָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'tsh 'ynyv lchshb thpkhvt qrts shptyv khlh r'h
verses.translation: He shutteth his eyes, it is to devise froward things; He that biteth his lips bringeth evil to pass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲטֶ֣רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת שֵׂיבָ֑ה בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה תִּמָּצֵֽא׃
verses.translit: 'trt tp'rt shybh bdrkh tsdqh tmts'
verses.translation: The hoary head is a crown of glory, It is found in the way of righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֤וֹב אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם מִגִּבּ֑וֹר וּמֹשֵׁ֥ל בְּ֝רוּח֗וֹ מִלֹּכֵ֥ד עִֽיר׃
verses.translit: tvb 'rkh 'pym mgbvr vmshl brvchv mlkhd 'yr
verses.translation: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; And he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּ֭חֵיק יוּטַ֣ל אֶת־הַגּוֹרָ֑ל וּ֝מֵיְהֹוָ֗ה כׇּל־מִשְׁפָּטֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: bchyq yvtl 'thgvrl vmyhvh khlmshptv
verses.translation: The lot is cast into the lap; But the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֤וֹב פַּ֣ת חֲ֭רֵבָה וְשַׁלְוָה־בָ֑הּ מִ֝בַּ֗יִת מָלֵ֥א זִבְחֵי־רִֽיב׃
verses.translit: tvb pt chrbh vshlvhbh mbyt ml' zbchyryb
verses.translation: Better is a dry morsel and quietness therewith, Than a house full of feasting with strife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶֽבֶד־מַשְׂכִּ֗יל יִ֭מְשֹׁל בְּבֵ֣ן מֵבִ֑ישׁ וּבְת֥וֹךְ אַ֝חִ֗ים יַחֲלֹ֥ק נַחֲלָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'bdmshkhyl ymshl bbn mbysh vbtvkh 'chym ychlq nchlh
verses.translation: A servant that dealeth wisely shall have rule over a son that dealeth shamefully, And shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַצְרֵ֣ף לַ֭כֶּסֶף וְכ֣וּר לַזָּהָ֑ב וּבֹחֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: mtsrf lkhsf vkhvr lzhb vbchn lbvt yhvh
verses.translation: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold; But the LORD trieth the hearts. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵ֭רַע מַקְשִׁ֣יב עַל־שְׂפַת־אָ֑וֶן שֶׁ֥קֶר מֵ֝זִ֗ין עַל־לְשׁ֥וֹן הַוֺּֽת׃
verses.translit: mr' mqshyb 'lshpt'vn shqr mzyn 'llshvn hvt
verses.translation: A evil-doer giveth heed to wicked lips; And a liar giveth ear to a mischievous tongue.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹעֵ֣ג לָ֭רָשׁ חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ שָׂמֵ֥חַ לְ֝אֵ֗יד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃
verses.translit: l'g lrsh chrf 'shhv shmch l'yd l' ynqh
verses.translation: Whoso mocketh the poor blasphemeth his Maker; And he that is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲטֶ֣רֶת זְ֭קֵנִים בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים וְתִפְאֶ֖רֶת בָּנִ֣ים אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'trt zqnym bny bnym vtp'rt bnym 'bvtm
verses.translation: Children’s children are the crown of old men; And the glory of children are their fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־נָאוָ֣ה לְנָבָ֣ל שְׂפַת־יֶ֑תֶר אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־לְנָדִ֥יב שְׂפַת־שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.translit: l'n'vh lnbl shptytr 'f khylndyb shptshqr
verses.translation: Overbearing speech becometh not a churl; Much less do lying lips a prince.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶבֶן־חֵ֣ן הַ֭שֹּׁחַד בְּעֵינֵ֣י בְעָלָ֑יו אֶֽל־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִפְנֶ֣ה יַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: 'bnchn hshchd b'yny b'lyv 'lkhl'shr ypnh yshkhyl
verses.translation: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it; Whithersoever he turneth, he prospereth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְֽכַסֶּה־פֶּ֭שַׁע מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אַהֲבָ֑ה וְשֹׁנֶ֥ה בְ֝דָבָ֗ר מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף׃
verses.translit: mkhshpsh' mbqsh 'hbh vshnh bdbr mpryd 'lvf
verses.translation: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; But he that harpeth on a matter estrangeth a familiar friend.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תֵּ֣חַת גְּעָרָ֣ה בְמֵבִ֑ין מֵהַכּ֖וֹת כְּסִ֣יל מֵאָֽה׃
verses.translit: tcht g'rh bmbyn mhkhvt khsyl m'h
verses.translation: A rebuke entereth deeper into a man of understanding Than a hundred stripes into a fool.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־מְרִ֥י יְבַקֶּשׁ־רָ֑ע וּמַלְאָ֥ךְ אַ֝כְזָרִ֗י יְשֻׁלַּח־בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'khmry ybqshr' vml'kh 'khzry yshlchbv
verses.translation: A rebellious man seeketh only evil; Therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּג֬וֹשׁ דֹּ֣ב שַׁכּ֣וּל בְּאִ֑ישׁ וְאַל־כְּ֝סִ֗יל בְּאִוַּלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: pgvsh db shkhvl b'ysh v'lkhsyl b'vltv
verses.translation: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, Rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵשִׁ֣יב רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה לֹא־[תָמ֥וּשׁ] (תמיש) רָ֝עָ֗ה מִבֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mshyb r'h tcht tvbh l'[tmvsh] (tmysh) r'h mbytv
verses.translation: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, Evil shall not depart from his house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פּ֣וֹטֵֽר מַ֭יִם רֵאשִׁ֣ית מָד֑וֹן וְלִפְנֵ֥י הִ֝תְגַּלַּ֗ע הָרִ֥יב נְטֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: pvtr mym r'shyt mdvn vlpny htgl' hryb ntvsh
verses.translation: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water; Therefore leave off contention, before the quarrel break out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַצְדִּ֣יק רָ֭שָׁע וּמַרְשִׁ֣יעַ צַדִּ֑יק תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: mtsdyq rsh' vmrshy' tsdyq tv'bt yhvh gmshnyhm
verses.translation: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the righteous, Even they both are an abomination to the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָמָּה־זֶּ֣ה מְחִ֣יר בְּיַד־כְּסִ֑יל לִקְנ֖וֹת חׇכְמָ֣ה וְלֶב־אָֽיִן׃
verses.translit: lmhzh mchyr bydkhsyl lqnvt chkhmh vlb'yn
verses.translation: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool To buy wisdom, seeing he hath no understanding?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּכׇל־עֵ֭ת אֹהֵ֣ב הָרֵ֑עַ וְאָ֥ח לְ֝צָרָ֗ה יִוָּלֵֽד׃
verses.translit: bkhl't 'hb hr' v'ch ltsrh yvld
verses.translation: A friend loveth at all times, And a brother is born for adversity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָדָ֣ם חֲסַר־לֵ֭ב תּוֹקֵ֣עַ כָּ֑ף עֹרֵ֥ב עֲ֝רֻבָּ֗ה לִפְנֵ֥י רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: 'dm chsrlb tvq' khf 'rb 'rbh lpny r'hv
verses.translation: A man void of understanding is he that striketh hands, And becometh surety in the presence of his neighbour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֣הֵֽב פֶּ֭שַׁע אֹהֵ֣ב מַצָּ֑ה מַגְבִּ֥יהַּ פִּ֝תְח֗וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־שָֽׁבֶר׃
verses.translit: 'hb psh' 'hb mtsh mgbyh ptchv mbqshshbr
verses.translation: He loveth transgression that loveth strife; He that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִקֶּשׁ־לֵ֭ב לֹ֣א יִמְצָא־ט֑וֹב וְנֶהְפָּ֥ךְ בִּ֝לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ יִפּ֥וֹל בְּרָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'qshlb l' ymts'tvb vnhpkh blshvnv ypvl br'h
verses.translation: He that hath a forward heart findeth no good; And he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֹלֵ֣ד כְּ֭סִיל לְת֣וּגָה ל֑וֹ וְלֹא־יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח אֲבִ֣י נָבָֽל׃
verses.translit: yld khsyl ltvgh lv vl'yshmch 'by nbl
verses.translation: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow; And the father of a churl hath no joy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֣ב שָׂ֭מֵחַ יֵיטִ֣יב גֵּהָ֑ה וְר֥וּחַ נְ֝כֵאָ֗ה תְּיַבֶּשׁ־גָּֽרֶם׃
verses.translit: lb shmch yytyb ghh vrvch nkh'h tybshgrm
verses.translation: A merry heart is a good medicine; But a broken spirit drieth the bones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֹׁ֣חַד מֵ֭חֵק רָשָׁ֣ע יִקָּ֑ח לְ֝הַטּ֗וֹת אׇרְח֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: shchd mchq rsh' yqch lhtvt 'rchvt mshpt
verses.translation: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom, To pervert the ways of justice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י מֵבִ֣ין חׇכְמָ֑ה וְעֵינֵ֥י כְ֝סִ֗יל בִּקְצֵה־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: 'tpny mbyn chkhmh v'yny khsyl bqtsh'rts
verses.translation: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; But the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּ֣עַס לְ֭אָבִיו בֵּ֣ן כְּסִ֑יל וּ֝מֶ֗מֶר לְיֽוֹלַדְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: kh's l'byv bn khsyl vmmr lyvldtv
verses.translation: A foolish son is vexation to his father, And bitterness to her that bore him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֤ם עֲנ֣וֹשׁ לַצַּדִּ֣יק לֹא־ט֑וֹב לְהַכּ֖וֹת נְדִיבִ֣ים עַל־יֹֽשֶׁר׃
verses.translit: gm 'nvsh ltsdyq l'tvb lhkhvt ndybym 'lyshr
verses.translation: To punish also the righteous is not good, Nor to strike the noble for their uprightness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חוֹשֵׂ֣ךְ אֲ֭מָרָיו יוֹדֵ֣עַ דָּ֑עַת (וקר) [יְקַר־]ר֝֗וּחַ אִ֣ישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.translit: chvshkh 'mryv yvd' d't (vqr) [yqr]rvch 'ysh tbvnh
verses.translation: He that spareth his words hath knowledge; And he that husbandeth his spirit is a man of discernment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֤ם אֱוִ֣יל מַ֭חֲרִישׁ חָכָ֣ם יֵחָשֵׁ֑ב אֹטֵ֖ם שְׂפָתָ֣יו נָבֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: gm 'vyl mchrysh chkhm ychshb 'tm shptyv nbvn
verses.translation: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise; And he that shutteth his lips is esteemed as a man of understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְֽ֭תַאֲוָה יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ נִפְרָ֑ד בְּכׇל־תּ֝וּשִׁיָּ֗ה יִתְגַּלָּֽע׃
verses.translit: lt'vh ybqsh nprd bkhltvshyh ytgl'
verses.translation: He that separateth himself seeketh his own desire, And snarlest against all sound wisdom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יַחְפֹּ֣ץ כְּ֭סִיל בִּתְבוּנָ֑ה כִּ֝֗י אִֽם־בְּהִתְגַּלּ֥וֹת לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: l'ychpts khsyl btbvnh khy 'mbhtglvt lbv
verses.translation: A fool hath no delight in understanding, But only that his heart may lay itself bare.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּֽבוֹא־רָ֭שָׁע בָּ֣א גַם־בּ֑וּז וְֽעִם־קָל֥וֹן חֶרְפָּֽה׃
verses.translit: bbv'rsh' b' gmbvz v'mqlvn chrph
verses.translation: When the wicked cometh, there cometh also contempt, And with ignominy reproach.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַ֣יִם עֲ֭מֻקִּים דִּבְרֵ֣י פִי־אִ֑ישׁ נַ֥חַל נֹ֝בֵ֗עַ מְק֣וֹר חׇכְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: mym 'mqym dbry py'ysh nchl nb' mqvr chkhmh
verses.translation: The words of a man’s mouth are as deep waters; A flowing brook, a fountain of wisdom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂאֵ֣ת פְּנֵי־רָשָׁ֣ע לֹא־ט֑וֹב לְהַטּ֥וֹת צַ֝דִּ֗יק בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: sh't pnyrsh' l'tvb lhtvt tsdyq bmshpt
verses.translation: It is not good to respect the person of the wicked, So as to turn aside the righteous in judgment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂפְתֵ֣י כְ֭סִיל יָבֹ֣אוּ בְרִ֑יב וּ֝פִ֗יו לְֽמַהֲלֻמ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽא׃
verses.translit: shpty khsyl yb'v bryb vpyv lmhlmvt yqr'
verses.translation: A fool’s lips enter into contention, And his mouth calleth for strokes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּֽי־כְ֭סִיל מְחִתָּה־ל֑וֹ וּ֝שְׂפָתָ֗יו מוֹקֵ֥שׁ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: pykhsyl mchthlv vshptyv mvqsh npshv
verses.translation: A fool’s mouth is his ruin, And his lips are the snare of his soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י נִ֭רְגָּן כְּמִֽתְלַהֲמִ֑ים וְ֝הֵ֗ם יָרְד֥וּ חַדְרֵי־בָֽטֶן׃
verses.translit: dbry nrgn khmtlhmym vhm yrdv chdrybtn
verses.translation: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, And they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֭ם מִתְרַפֶּ֣ה בִמְלַאכְתּ֑וֹ אָ֥ח ה֝֗וּא לְבַ֣עַל מַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.translit: gm mtrph bml'khtv 'ch hv' lb'l mshchyt
verses.translation: Even one that is slack in his work Is brother to him that is a destroyer. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִגְדַּל־עֹ֭ז שֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה בּֽוֹ־יָר֖וּץ צַדִּ֣יק וְנִשְׂגָּֽב׃
verses.translit: mgdl'z shm yhvh bvyrvts tsdyq vnshgb
verses.translation: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: The righteous runneth into it, and is set up on high.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֣וֹן עָ֭שִׁיר קִרְיַ֣ת עֻזּ֑וֹ וּכְחוֹמָ֥ה נִ֝שְׂגָּבָ֗ה בְּמַשְׂכִּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hvn 'shyr qryt 'zv vkhchvmh nshgbh bmshkhtv
verses.translation: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, And as a high wall in his own conceit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִפְנֵי־שֶׁ֭בֶר יִגְבַּ֣הּ לֶב־אִ֑ישׁ וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָב֣וֹד עֲנָוָֽה׃
verses.translit: lpnyshbr ygbh lb'ysh vlpny khbvd 'nvh
verses.translation: Before destruction the heart of a man is haughty, And before honour goeth humility.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵשִׁ֣יב דָּ֭בָר בְּטֶ֣רֶם יִשְׁמָ֑ע אִוֶּ֥לֶת הִיא־ל֝֗וֹ וּכְלִמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: mshyb dbr btrm yshm' 'vlt hy'lv vkhlmh
verses.translation: He that giveth answer before he heareth, It is folly and confusion unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֽוּחַ־אִ֭ישׁ יְכַלְכֵּ֣ל מַחֲלֵ֑הוּ וְר֥וּחַ נְ֝כֵאָ֗ה מִ֣י יִשָּׂאֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: rvch'ysh ykhlkhl mchlhv vrvch nkh'h my ysh'nh
verses.translation: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; But a broken spirit who can bear?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן יִקְנֶה־דָּ֑עַת וְאֹ֥זֶן חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים תְּבַקֶּשׁ־דָּֽעַת׃
verses.translit: lb nbvn yqnhd't v'zn chkhmym tbqshd't
verses.translation: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; And the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַתָּ֣ן אָ֭דָם יַרְחִ֣יב ל֑וֹ וְלִפְנֵ֖י גְדֹלִ֣ים יַנְחֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: mtn 'dm yrchyb lv vlpny gdlym ynchnv
verses.translation: A man’s gift maketh room for him, And bringeth him before great men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַדִּ֣יק הָרִאשׁ֣וֹן בְּרִיב֑וֹ (יבא) [וּבָֽא־]רֵ֝עֵ֗הוּ וַחֲקָרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: tsdyq hr'shvn brybv (yb') [vb']r'hv vchqrv
verses.translation: He that pleadeth his cause first seemeth just; But his neighbour cometh and searcheth him out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭דְיָנִים יַשְׁבִּ֣ית הַגּוֹרָ֑ל וּבֵ֖ין עֲצוּמִ֣ים יַפְרִֽיד׃
verses.translit: mdynym yshbyt hgvrl vbyn 'tsvmym ypryd
verses.translation: The lot causeth strife to cease, And parteth asunder the contentious.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֗ח נִפְשָׁ֥ע מִקִּרְיַת־עֹ֑ז (ומדונים) [וּ֝מִדְיָנִ֗ים] כִּבְרִ֥יחַ אַרְמֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: 'ch npsh' mqryt'z (vmdvnym) [vmdynym] khbrych 'rmvn
verses.translation: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city; And their contentions are like the bars of a castle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִפְּרִ֣י פִי־אִ֭ישׁ תִּשְׂבַּ֣ע בִּטְנ֑וֹ תְּבוּאַ֖ת שְׂפָתָ֣יו יִשְׂבָּֽע׃
verses.translit: mpry py'ysh tshb' btnv tbv't shptyv yshb'
verses.translation: A man’s belly shall be filled with the fruit of his mouth; With the increase of his lips shall he be satisfied.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָ֣וֶת וְ֭חַיִּים בְּיַד־לָשׁ֑וֹן וְ֝אֹהֲבֶ֗יהָ יֹאכַ֥ל פִּרְיָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: mvt vchyym bydlshvn v'hbyh y'khl pryh
verses.translation: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; And they that indulge it shall eat the fruit thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָצָ֣א אִ֭שָּׁה מָ֣צָא ט֑וֹב וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: mts' 'shh mts' tvb vypq rtsvn myhvh
verses.translation: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a great good, And obtaineth favour of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּחֲנוּנִ֥ים יְדַבֶּר־רָ֑שׁ וְ֝עָשִׁ֗יר יַעֲנֶ֥ה עַזּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: tchnvnym ydbrrsh v'shyr y'nh 'zvt
verses.translation: The poor useth entreaties; But the rich answereth impudently.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ רֵ֭עִים לְהִתְרֹעֵ֑עַ וְיֵ֥שׁ אֹ֝הֵ֗ב דָּבֵ֥ק מֵאָֽח׃
verses.translit: 'ysh r'ym lhtr'' vysh 'hb dbq m'ch
verses.translation: There are friends that one hath to his own hurt; But there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טֽוֹב־רָ֭שׁ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֑וֹ מֵעִקֵּ֥שׁ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו וְה֣וּא כְסִֽיל׃
verses.translit: tvbrsh hvlkh btmv m'qsh shptyv vhv' khsyl
verses.translation: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity Than he that is perverse in his lips and a fool at the same time.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֤ם בְּלֹא־דַ֣עַת נֶ֣פֶשׁ לֹא־ט֑וֹב וְאָ֖ץ בְּרַגְלַ֣יִם חוֹטֵֽא׃
verses.translit: gm bl'd't npsh l'tvb v'ts brglym chvt'
verses.translation: Also, that the soul be without knowledge is not good; And he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִוֶּ֣לֶת אָ֭דָם תְּסַלֵּ֣ף דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְעַל־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה יִזְעַ֥ף לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'vlt 'dm tslf drkhv v'lyhvh yz'f lbv
verses.translation: The foolishness of man perverteth his way; And his heart fretteth against the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֗וֹן יֹ֭סִיף רֵעִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝דָ֗ל מֵרֵעֵ֥הוּ יִפָּרֵֽד׃
verses.translit: hvn ysyf r'ym rbym vdl mr'hv yprd
verses.translation: Wealth addeth many friends; But as for the poor, his friend separateth himself from him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֣ד שְׁ֭קָרִים לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְיָפִ֥יחַ כְּ֝זָבִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִמָּלֵֽט׃
verses.translit: 'd shqrym l' ynqh vypych khzbym l' ymlt
verses.translation: A false witness shall not be unpunished; And he that breatheth forth lies shall not escape.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֭בִּים יְחַלּ֣וּ פְנֵֽי־נָדִ֑יב וְכׇל־הָ֝רֵ֗עַ לְאִ֣ישׁ מַתָּֽן׃
verses.translit: rbym ychlv pnyndyb vkhlhr' l'ysh mtn
verses.translation: Many will entreat the favour of the liberal man; And every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּ֥ל־אֲחֵי־רָ֨שׁ  שְֽׂנֵאֻ֗הוּ אַ֤ף כִּ֣י מְ֭רֵעֵהוּ רָחֲק֣וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ מְרַדֵּ֖ף אֲמָרִ֣ים (לא) [לוֹ־]הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: khl'chyrsh  shn'hv 'f khy mr'hv rchqv mmnv mrdf 'mrym (l') [lv]hmh
verses.translation: All the brethren of the poor do hate him; How much more do his friends go far from him! He that pursueth words, they turn against him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֹֽנֶה־לֵּ֭ב אֹהֵ֣ב נַפְשׁ֑וֹ שֹׁמֵ֥ר תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה לִמְצֹא־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: qnhlb 'hb npshv shmr tbvnh lmts'tvb
verses.translation: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul; He that keepeth understanding shall find good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֣ד שְׁ֭קָרִים לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְיָפִ֖יחַ כְּזָבִ֣ים יֹאבֵֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'd shqrym l' ynqh vypych khzbym y'bd {p}
verses.translation: A false witness shall not be unpunished; And he that breatheth forth lies shall perish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־נָאוֶ֣ה לִכְסִ֣יל תַּעֲנ֑וּג אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־לְעֶ֤בֶד  מְשֹׁ֬ל בְּשָׂרִֽים׃
verses.translit: l'n'vh lkhsyl t'nvg 'f khyl'bd  mshl bshrym
verses.translation: Luxury is not seemly for a fool; Much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֵׂ֣כֶל אָ֭דָם הֶאֱרִ֣יךְ אַפּ֑וֹ וְ֝תִפְאַרְתּ֗וֹ עֲבֹ֣ר עַל־פָּֽשַׁע׃
verses.translit: shkhl 'dm h'rykh 'pv vtp'rtv 'br 'lpsh'
verses.translation: It is the discretion of a man to be slow to anger, And it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַ֣הַם כַּ֭כְּפִיר זַ֣עַף מֶ֑לֶךְ וּכְטַ֖ל עַל־עֵ֣שֶׂב רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: nhm khkhpyr z'f mlkh vkhtl 'l'shb rtsvnv
verses.translation: The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; But his favour is as dew upon the grass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַוֺּ֣ת לְ֭אָבִיו בֵּ֣ן כְּסִ֑יל וְדֶ֥לֶף טֹ֝רֵ֗ד מִדְיְנֵ֥י אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: hvt l'byv bn khsyl vdlf trd mdyny 'shh
verses.translation: A foolish son is the calamity of his father; And the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּ֣יִת וָ֭הוֹן נַחֲלַ֣ת אָב֑וֹת וּ֝מֵיְהֹוָ֗ה אִשָּׁ֥ה מַשְׂכָּֽלֶת׃
verses.translit: byt vhvn nchlt 'bvt vmyhvh 'shh mshkhlt
verses.translation: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers; But a prudent wife is from the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֭צְלָה תַּפִּ֣יל תַּרְדֵּמָ֑ה וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ רְמִיָּ֣ה תִרְעָֽב׃
verses.translit: 'tslh tpyl trdmh vnpsh rmyh tr'b
verses.translation: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; And the idle soul shall suffer hunger.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֣ר מִ֭צְוָה שֹׁמֵ֣ר נַפְשׁ֑וֹ בּוֹזֵ֖ה דְרָכָ֣יו (יומת) [יָמֽוּת]׃
verses.translit: shmr mtsvh shmr npshv bvzh drkhyv (yvmt) [ymvt]
verses.translation: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his soul; But he that despiseth His ways shall die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַלְוֵ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה ח֣וֹנֵֽן דָּ֑ל וּ֝גְמֻל֗וֹ יְשַׁלֶּם־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mlvh yhvh chvnn dl vgmlv yshlmlv
verses.translation: He that is gracious unto the poor lendeth unto the LORD; And his good deed will He repay unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְךָ כִּֽי־יֵ֣שׁ תִּקְוָ֑ה וְאֶל־הֲ֝מִית֗וֹ אַל־תִּשָּׂ֥א נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.translit: ysr bnkh khyysh tqvh v'lhmytv 'ltsh' npshkh
verses.translation: Chasten thy son, for there is hope; But set not thy heart on his destruction. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (גרל) [גְּֽדׇל־]חֵ֭מָה נֹ֣שֵׂא עֹ֑נֶשׁ כִּ֥י אִם־תַּ֝צִּ֗יל וְע֣וֹד תּוֹסִֽף׃
verses.translit: (grl) [gdl]chmh nsh' 'nsh khy 'mttsyl v'vd tvsf
verses.translation: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment; For if thou interpose, thou wilt add thereto.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע עֵ֭צָה וְקַבֵּ֣ל מוּסָ֑ר לְ֝מַ֗עַן תֶּחְכַּ֥ם בְּאַחֲרִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: shm' 'tsh vqbl mvsr lm'n tchkhm b'chrytkh
verses.translation: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, That thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַבּ֣וֹת מַחֲשָׁב֣וֹת בְּלֶב־אִ֑ישׁ וַעֲצַ֥ת יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תָקֽוּם׃
verses.translit: rbvt mchshbvt blb'ysh v'tst yhvh hy' tqvm
verses.translation: There are many devices in a man’s heart; But the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּאֲוַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְטֽוֹב־רָ֝֗שׁ מֵאִ֥ישׁ כָּזָֽב׃
verses.translit: t'vt 'dm chsdv vtvbrsh m'ysh khzb
verses.translation: The lust of a man is his shame; And a poor man is better than a liar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֣ה לְחַיִּ֑ים וְשָׂבֵ֥עַ יָ֝לִ֗ין בַּל־יִפָּ֥קֶד רָֽע׃
verses.translit: yr't yhvh lchyym vshb' ylyn blypqd r'
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life; And he that hath it shall abide satisfied, He shall not be visited with evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טָ֘מַ֤ן עָצֵ֣ל יָ֭דוֹ בַּצַּלָּ֑חַת גַּם־אֶל־פִּ֝֗יהוּ לֹ֣א יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: tmn 'tsl ydv btslcht gm'lpyhv l' yshybnh
verses.translation: The sluggard burieth his hand in the dish, And will not so much as bring it back to his mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֣ץ תַּ֭כֶּה וּפֶ֣תִי יַעְרִ֑ם וְהוֹכִ֥יחַ לְ֝נָב֗וֹן יָבִ֥ין דָּֽעַת׃
verses.translit: lts tkhh vpty y'rm vhvkhych lnbvn ybyn d't
verses.translation: When thou smitest a scorner, the simple will become prudent; And when one that hath understanding is reproved, he will understand knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְֽשַׁדֶּד־אָ֭ב יַבְרִ֣יחַ אֵ֑ם בֵּ֝֗ן מֵבִ֥ישׁ וּמַחְפִּֽיר׃
verses.translit: mshdd'b ybrych 'm bn mbysh vmchpyr
verses.translation: A son that dealeth shamefully and reproachfully Will despoil his father, and chase away his mother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲֽדַל־בְּ֭נִי לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ מוּסָ֑ר לִ֝שְׁג֗וֹת מֵאִמְרֵי־דָֽעַת׃
verses.translit: chdlbny lshm' mvsr lshgvt m'mryd't
verses.translation: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction That causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֣ד בְּ֭לִיַּעַל יָלִ֣יץ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְבַלַּע־אָֽוֶן׃
verses.translit: 'd bly'l ylyts mshpt vpy rsh'ym ybl''vn
verses.translation: An ungodly witness mocketh at right; And the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָכ֣וֹנוּ לַלֵּצִ֣ים שְׁפָטִ֑ים וּ֝מַהֲלֻמ֗וֹת לְגֵ֣ו כְּסִילִֽים׃
verses.translit: nkhvnv lltsym shptym vmhlmvt lgv khsylym
verses.translation: Judgments are prepared for scorners, And stripes for the back of fools.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֣ץ הַ֭יַּיִן הֹמֶ֣ה שֵׁכָ֑ר וְכׇל־שֹׁ֥גֶה בּ֝֗וֹ לֹ֣א יֶחְכָּֽם׃
verses.translit: lts hyyn hmh shkhr vkhlshgh bv l' ychkhm
verses.translation: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is riotous; and whosoever reeleth thereby is not wise.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַ֣הַם כַּ֭כְּפִיר אֵ֣ימַת מֶ֑לֶךְ מִ֝תְעַבְּר֗וֹ חוֹטֵ֥א נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: nhm khkhpyr 'ymt mlkh mt'brv chvt' npshv
verses.translation: The terror of a king is as the roaring of a lion: He that provoketh him to anger forfeiteth his life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּב֣וֹד לָ֭אִישׁ שֶׁ֣בֶת מֵרִ֑יב וְכׇל־אֱ֝וִ֗יל יִתְגַּלָּֽע׃
verses.translit: khbvd l'ysh shbt mryb vkhl'vyl ytgl'
verses.translation: It is an honour for a man to keep aloof from strife; but every fool will be snarling.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵ֭חֹרֶף עָצֵ֣ל לֹא־יַחֲרֹ֑שׁ (ישאל) [וְשָׁאַ֖ל] בַּקָּצִ֣יר וָאָֽיִן׃
verses.translit: mchrf 'tsl l'ychrsh (ysh'l) [vsh'l] bqtsyr v'yn
verses.translation: The sluggard will not plow when winter setteth in; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַ֣יִם עֲ֭מֻקִּים עֵצָ֣ה בְלֶב־אִ֑ישׁ וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּבוּנָ֣ה יִדְלֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: mym 'mqym 'tsh blb'ysh v'ysh tbvnh ydlnh
verses.translation: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רׇב־אָדָ֗ם יִ֭קְרָא אִ֣ישׁ חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ אֱ֝מוּנִ֗ים מִ֣י יִמְצָֽא׃
verses.translit: rb'dm yqr' 'ysh chsdv v'ysh 'mvnym my ymts'
verses.translation: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness; but a faithful man who can find?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֣וֹ צַדִּ֑יק אַשְׁרֵ֖י בָנָ֣יו אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.translit: mthlkh btmv tsdyq 'shry bnyv 'chryv
verses.translation: He that walketh in his integrity as a just man, happy are his children after him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֗לֶךְ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל־כִּסֵּא־דִ֑ין מְזָרֶ֖ה בְעֵינָ֣יו כׇּל־רָֽע׃
verses.translit: mlkh yvshb 'lkhs'dyn mzrh b'ynyv khlr'
verses.translation: A king that sitteth on the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־יֹ֭אמַר זִכִּ֣יתִי לִבִּ֑י טָ֝הַ֗רְתִּי מֵחַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.translit: myy'mr zkhyty lby thrty mcht'ty
verses.translation: Who can say: ‘I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin’?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֣בֶן וָ֭אֶבֶן אֵיפָ֣ה וְאֵיפָ֑ה תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'bn v'bn 'yph v'yph tv'bt yhvh gmshnyhm
verses.translation: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them alike are abomination to the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֣ם בְּ֭מַעֲלָלָיו יִתְנַכֶּר־נָ֑עַר אִם־זַ֖ךְ וְאִם־יָשָׁ֣ר פׇּעֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: gm bm'llyv ytnkhrn'r 'mzkh v'myshr p'lv
verses.translation: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֣זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַת וְעַ֣יִן רֹאָ֑ה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה גַם־שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'zn shm't v'yn r'h yhvh 'shh gmshnyhm
verses.translation: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD hath made even both of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תֶּאֱהַ֣ב שֵׁ֭נָה פֶּן־תִּוָּרֵ֑שׁ פְּקַ֖ח עֵינֶ֣יךָ שְֽׂבַֽע־לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translit: 'lt'hb shnh pntvrsh pqch 'ynykh shb'lchm
verses.translation: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt have bread in plenty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֣ע רַ֭ע יֹאמַ֣ר הַקּוֹנֶ֑ה וְאֹזֵ֥ל ל֝֗וֹ אָ֣ז יִתְהַלָּֽל׃
verses.translit: r' r' y'mr hqvnh v'zl lv 'z ythll
verses.translation: ’It is bad, it is bad’, saith the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ זָ֭הָב וְרׇב־פְּנִינִ֑ים וּכְלִ֥י יְ֝קָ֗ר שִׂפְתֵי־דָֽעַת׃
verses.translit: ysh zhb vrbpnynym vkhly yqr shptyd't
verses.translation: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies; but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְֽקַח־בִּ֭גְדוֹ כִּי־עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וּבְעַ֖ד (נכרים) [נׇכְרִיָּ֣ה] חַבְלֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: lqchbgdv khy'rb zr vb'd (nkhrym) [nkhryh] chblhv
verses.translation: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger; and hold him in pledge that is surety for an alien woman.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָרֵ֣ב לָ֭אִישׁ לֶ֣חֶם שָׁ֑קֶר וְ֝אַחַ֗ר יִמָּֽלֵא־פִ֥יהוּ חָצָֽץ׃
verses.translit: 'rb l'ysh lchm shqr v'chr yml'pyhv chtsts
verses.translation: Bread of falsehood is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת בְּעֵצָ֣ה תִכּ֑וֹן וּ֝בְתַחְבֻּל֗וֹת עֲשֵׂ֣ה מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: mchshbvt b'tsh tkhvn vbtchblvt 'shh mlchmh
verses.translation: Every purpose is established by counsel; and with good advice carry on war.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גּֽוֹלֶה־סּ֭וֹד הוֹלֵ֣ךְ רָכִ֑יל וּלְפֹתֶ֥ה שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִתְעָרָֽב׃
verses.translit: gvlhsvd hvlkh rkhyl vlpth shptyv l' tt'rb
verses.translation: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets; therefore meddle not with him that openeth wide his lips.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְ֭קַלֵּל אָבִ֣יו וְאִמּ֑וֹ יִֽדְעַ֥ךְ נֵ֝ר֗וֹ (באישון) [בֶּאֱשׁ֥וּן] חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.translit: mqll 'byv v'mv yd'kh nrv (b'yshvn) [b'shvn] chshkh
verses.translation: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in the blackest darkness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַ֭חֲלָה (מבחלת) [מְבֹהֶ֣לֶת] בָּרִאשׁוֹנָ֑ה וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ לֹ֣א תְבֹרָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: nchlh (mbchlt) [mbhlt] br'shvnh v'chryth l' tbrkh
verses.translation: An estate may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תֹּאמַ֥ר אֲשַׁלְּמָה־רָ֑ע קַוֵּ֥ה לַ֝יהֹוָ֗ה וְיֹ֣שַֽׁע לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'lt'mr 'shlmhr' qvh lyhvh vysh' lkh
verses.translation: Say not thou: ‘I will requite evil’; wait for the LORD, and He will save thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה אֶ֣בֶן וָאָ֑בֶן וּמֹאזְנֵ֖י מִרְמָ֣ה לֹא־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: tv'bt yhvh 'bn v'bn vm'zny mrmh l'tvb
verses.translation: Divers weights are an abomination to the LORD; and a false balance is not good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵיְהֹוָ֥ה מִצְעֲדֵי־גָ֑בֶר וְ֝אָדָ֗ם מַה־יָּבִ֥ין דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: myhvh mts'dygbr v'dm mhybyn drkhv
verses.translation: A man’s goings are of the LORD; how then can man look to his way?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מוֹקֵ֣שׁ אָ֭דָם יָ֣לַע קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְאַחַ֖ר נְדָרִ֣ים לְבַקֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: mvqsh 'dm yl' qdsh v'chr ndrym lbqr
verses.translation: It is a snare to a man rashly to say: ‘Holy’, and after vows to make inquiry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְזָרֶ֣ה רְ֭שָׁעִים מֶ֣לֶךְ חָכָ֑ם וַיָּ֖שֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם אוֹפָֽן׃
verses.translit: mzrh rsh'ym mlkh chkhm vyshb 'lyhm 'vpn
verses.translation: A wise king sifteth the wicked, and turneth the wheel over them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֵ֣ר יְ֭הֹוָה נִשְׁמַ֣ת אָדָ֑ם חֹ֝פֵ֗שׂ כׇּל־חַדְרֵי־בָֽטֶן׃
verses.translit: nr yhvh nshmt 'dm chpsh khlchdrybtn
verses.translation: The spirit of man is the lamp of the LORD, searching all the inward parts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭אֱמֶת יִצְּרוּ־מֶ֑לֶךְ וְסָעַ֖ד בַּחֶ֣סֶד כִּסְאֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: chsd v'mt ytsrvmlkh vs'd bchsd khs'v
verses.translation: Mercy and truth preserve the king; and his throne is upheld by mercy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת בַּחוּרִ֣ים כֹּחָ֑ם וַהֲדַ֖ר זְקֵנִ֣ים שֵׂיבָֽה׃
verses.translit: tp'rt bchvrym khchm vhdr zqnym shybh
verses.translation: The glory of young men is their strength; and the beauty of old men is the hoary head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַבֻּר֣וֹת פֶּ֭צַע (תמריק) [תַּמְר֣וּק] בְּרָ֑ע וּ֝מַכּ֗וֹת חַדְרֵי־בָֽטֶן׃
verses.translit: chbrvt pts' (tmryq) [tmrvq] br' vmkhvt chdrybtn
verses.translation: Sharp wounds cleanse away evil; So do stripes that reach the inward parts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּלְגֵי־מַ֣יִם לֶב־מֶ֭לֶךְ בְּיַד־יְהֹוָ֑ה עַֽל־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֖ר יַחְפֹּ֣ץ יַטֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: plgymym lbmlkh bydyhvh 'lkhl'shr ychpts ytnv
verses.translation: The king’s heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the watercourses: He turneth it whithersoever He will.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּֽל־דֶּרֶךְ־אִ֭ישׁ יָשָׁ֣ר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְתֹכֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khldrkh'ysh yshr b'ynyv vtkhn lbvt yhvh
verses.translation: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes; But the LORD weigheth the hearts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲ֭שֹׂה צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נִבְחָ֖ר לַיהֹוָ֣ה מִזָּֽבַח׃
verses.translit: 'shh tsdqh vmshpt nbchr lyhvh mzbch
verses.translation: To do righteousness and justice Is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רוּם־עֵ֭ינַיִם וּרְחַב־לֵ֑ב נִ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים חַטָּֽאת׃
verses.translit: rvm'ynym vrchblb nr rsh'ym cht't
verses.translation: A haughty look, and a proud heart— The tillage of the wicked is sin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת חָ֭רוּץ אַךְ־לְמוֹתָ֑ר וְכׇל־אָ֝֗ץ אַךְ־לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: mchshbvt chrvts 'khlmvtr vkhl'ts 'khlmchsvr
verses.translation: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; But every one that is hasty hasteth only to want.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֹּ֣עַל אֹ֭צָרוֹת בִּלְשׁ֣וֹן שָׁ֑קֶר הֶ֥בֶל נִ֝דָּ֗ף מְבַקְשֵׁי־מָֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: p'l 'tsrvt blshvn shqr hbl ndf mbqshymvt
verses.translation: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue Is a vapour driven to and fro; they [that seek them] seek death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֹׁד־רְשָׁעִ֥ים יְגוֹרֵ֑ם כִּ֥י מֵ֝אֲנ֗וּ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: shdrsh'ym ygvrm khy m'nv l'shvt mshpt
verses.translation: The violence of the wicked shall drag them away; Because they refuse to do justly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲפַכְפַּ֬ךְ דֶּ֣רֶךְ אִ֣ישׁ וָזָ֑ר וְ֝זַ֗ךְ יָשָׁ֥ר פׇּעֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hpkhpkh drkh 'ysh vzr vzkh yshr p'lv
verses.translation: The way of man is froward and strange; But as for the pure, his work is right.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֗וֹב לָשֶׁ֥בֶת עַל־פִּנַּת־גָּ֑ג מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים וּבֵ֥ית חָֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: tvb lshbt 'lpntgg m'sht mdynym vbyt chbr
verses.translation: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, Than in a house in common with a contentious woman.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֶ֣פֶשׁ רָ֭שָׁע אִוְּתָה־רָ֑ע לֹֽא־יֻחַ֖ן בְּעֵינָ֣יו רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: npsh rsh' 'vthr' l'ychn b'ynyv r'hv
verses.translation: The soul of the wicked desireth evil; His neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּֽעֲנׇשׁ־לֵ֭ץ יֶחְכַּם־פֶּ֑תִי וּבְהַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְ֝חָכָ֗ם יִקַּח־דָּֽעַת׃
verses.translit: b'nshlts ychkhmpty vbhshkhyl lchkhm yqchd't
verses.translation: When the scorner is punished, the thoughtless is made wise; And when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל צַ֭דִּיק לְבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע מְסַלֵּ֖ף רְשָׁעִ֣ים לָרָֽע׃
verses.translit: mshkhyl tsdyq lbyt rsh' mslf rsh'ym lr'
verses.translation: The Righteous One considereth the house of the wicked; Overthrowing the wicked to their ruin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹטֵ֣ם אׇ֭זְנוֹ מִזַּעֲקַת־דָּ֑ל גַּֽם־ה֥וּא יִ֝קְרָ֗א וְלֹ֣א יֵעָנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: 'tm 'znv mz'qtdl gmhv' yqr' vl' y'nh
verses.translation: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, He also shall cry himself, but shall not be answered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַתָּ֣ן בַּ֭סֵּתֶר יִכְפֶּה־אָ֑ף וְשֹׁ֥חַד בַּ֝חֵ֗ק חֵמָ֥ה עַזָּֽה׃
verses.translit: mtn bstr ykhph'f vshchd bchq chmh 'zh
verses.translation: A gift in secret pacifieth anger, And a present in the bosom strong wrath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַ֭צַּדִּיק עֲשׂ֣וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝מְחִתָּ֗ה לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.translit: shmchh ltsdyq 'shvt mshpt vmchth lp'ly 'vn
verses.translation: To do justly is joy to the righteous, But ruin to the workers of iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָדָ֗ם תּ֭וֹעֶה מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל בִּקְהַ֖ל רְפָאִ֣ים יָנֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: 'dm tv'h mdrkh hshkhl bqhl rp'ym ynvch
verses.translation: The man that strayeth out of the way of understanding Shall rest in the congregation of the shades.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ מַ֭חְסוֹר אֹהֵ֣ב שִׂמְחָ֑ה אֹהֵ֥ב יַֽיִן־וָ֝שֶׁ֗מֶן לֹ֣א יַעֲשִֽׁיר׃
verses.translit: 'ysh mchsvr 'hb shmchh 'hb yynvshmn l' y'shyr
verses.translation: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man; He that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣פֶר לַצַּדִּ֣יק רָשָׁ֑ע וְתַ֖חַת יְשָׁרִ֣ים בּוֹגֵֽד׃
verses.translit: khpr ltsdyq rsh' vtcht yshrym bvgd
verses.translation: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous; And the faithless cometh in the stead of the upright.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֗וֹב שֶׁ֥בֶת בְּאֶֽרֶץ־מִדְבָּ֑ר מֵאֵ֖שֶׁת (מדונים) [מִדְיָנִ֣ים] וָכָֽעַס׃
verses.translit: tvb shbt b'rtsmdbr m'sht (mdvnym) [mdynym] vkh's
verses.translation: It is better to dwell in a desert land, Than with a contentious and fretful woman.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹצָ֤ר  נֶחְמָ֣ד וָ֭שֶׁמֶן בִּנְוֵ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וּכְסִ֖יל אָדָ֣ם יְבַלְּעֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: 'vtsr  nchmd vshmn bnvh chkhm vkhsyl 'dm ybl'nv
verses.translation: There is desirable treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; But a foolish man swalloweth it up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֹ֭דֵף צְדָקָ֣ה וָחָ֑סֶד יִמְצָ֥א חַ֝יִּ֗ים צְדָקָ֥ה וְכָבֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: rdf tsdqh vchsd ymts' chyym tsdqh vkhbvd
verses.translation: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy Findeth life, prosperity, and honour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִ֣יר גִּ֭בֹּרִים עָלָ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וַ֝יֹּ֗רֶד עֹ֣ז מִבְטֶחָֽהֿ׃
verses.translit: 'yr gbrym 'lh chkhm vyrd 'z mbtchh
verses.translation: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, And bringeth down the stronghold wherein it trusteth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פִּ֭יו וּלְשׁוֹנ֑וֹ שֹׁמֵ֖ר מִצָּר֣וֹת נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: shmr pyv vlshvnv shmr mtsrvt npshv
verses.translation: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue Keepeth his soul from troubles.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֵ֣ד יָ֭הִיר לֵ֣ץ שְׁמ֑וֹ ע֝וֹשֶׂ֗ה בְּעֶבְרַ֥ת זָדֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: zd yhyr lts shmv 'vshh b'brt zdvn
verses.translation: A proud and haughty man, scorner is his name, Even he that dealeth in overbearing pride.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּאֲוַ֣ת עָצֵ֣ל תְּמִיתֶ֑נּוּ כִּֽי־מֵאֲנ֖וּ יָדָ֣יו לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.translit: t'vt 'tsl tmytnv khym'nv ydyv l'shvt
verses.translation: The desire of the slothful killeth him; For his hands refuse to labour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַ֭יּוֹם הִתְאַוָּ֣ה תַאֲוָ֑ה וְצַדִּ֥יק יִ֝תֵּ֗ן וְלֹ֣א יַחְשֹֽׂךְ׃
verses.translit: khlhyvm ht'vh t'vh vtsdyq ytn vl' ychshkh
verses.translation: There is that coveteth greedily all the day long; But the righteous giveth and spareth not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֵבָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־בְזִמָּ֥ה יְבִיאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: zbch rsh'ym tv'bh 'f khybzmh yby'nv
verses.translation: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination; How much more, when he bringeth it with the proceeds of wickedness?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵד־כְּזָבִ֥ים יֹאבֵ֑ד וְאִ֥ישׁ שׁ֝וֹמֵ֗עַ לָנֶ֥צַח יְדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: 'dkhzbym y'bd v'ysh shvm' lntsch ydbr
verses.translation: A false witness shall perish; But the man that obeyeth shall speak unchallenged.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵעֵ֬ז אִ֣ישׁ רָשָׁ֣ע בְּפָנָ֑יו וְ֝יָשָׁ֗ר ה֤וּא  (יכין דרכיו) [יָבִ֬ין דַּרְכּֽוֹ]׃
verses.translit: h'z 'ysh rsh' bpnyv vyshr hv'  (ykhyn drkhyv) [ybyn drkhv]
verses.translation: A wicked man hardeneth his face; But as for the upright, he looketh well to his way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣ין חׇ֭כְמָה וְאֵ֣ין תְּבוּנָ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין עֵ֝צָ֗ה לְנֶ֣גֶד יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'yn chkhmh v'yn tbvnh v'yn 'tsh lngd yhvh {p}
verses.translation: There is no wisdom nor understanding Nor counsel against the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ס֗וּס מ֭וּכָן לְי֣וֹם מִלְחָמָ֑ה וְ֝לַיהֹוָ֗ה הַתְּשׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.translit: svs mvkhn lyvm mlchmh vlyhvh htshv'h
verses.translation: The horse is prepared against the day of battle; But victory is of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִבְחָ֣ר שֵׁ֭ם מֵעֹ֣שֶׁר רָ֑ב מִכֶּ֥סֶף וּ֝מִזָּהָ֗ב חֵ֣ן טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: nbchr shm m'shr rb mkhsf vmzhb chn tvb
verses.translation: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, And loving favour rather than silver and gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָשִׁ֣יר וָרָ֣שׁ נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ עֹשֵׂ֖ה כֻלָּ֣ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'shyr vrsh npgshv 'shh khlm yhvh
verses.translation: The rich and the poor meet together— The LORD is the maker of them all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָר֤וּם  רָאָ֣ה רָעָ֣ה (ויסתר) [וְנִסְתָּ֑ר] וּ֝פְתָיִ֗ים עָבְר֥וּ וְֽנֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: 'rvm  r'h r'h (vystr) [vnstr] vptyym 'brv vn'nshv
verses.translation: A prudent man seeth the evil, and hideth himself; But the thoughtless pass on, and are punished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֣קֶב עֲ֭נָוָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֑ה עֹ֖שֶׁר וְכָב֣וֹד וְחַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: 'qb 'nvh yr't yhvh 'shr vkhbvd vchyym
verses.translation: The reward of humility is the fear of the LORD, Even riches, and honour, and life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צִנִּ֣ים פַּ֭חִים בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ עִקֵּ֑שׁ שׁוֹמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ יִרְחַ֥ק מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: tsnym pchym bdrkh 'qsh shvmr npshv yrchq mhm
verses.translation: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward; He that keepeth his soul holdeth himself far from them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲנֹ֣ךְ לַ֭נַּעַר עַל־פִּ֣י דַרְכּ֑וֹ גַּ֥ם כִּי־יַ֝זְקִ֗ין לֹא־יָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: chnkh ln'r 'lpy drkhv gm khyyzqyn l'ysvr mmnh
verses.translation: Train up a child in the way he should go, And even when he is old, he will not depart from it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָ֭שִׁיר בְּרָשִׁ֣ים יִמְשׁ֑וֹל וְעֶ֥בֶד לֹ֝וֶ֗ה לְאִ֣ישׁ מַלְוֶֽה׃
verses.translit: 'shyr brshym ymshvl v'bd lvh l'ysh mlvh
verses.translation: The rich ruleth over the poor, And the borrower is servant to the lender.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זוֹרֵ֣עַ עַ֭וְלָה (יקצור) [יִקְצׇר־]אָ֑וֶן וְשֵׁ֖בֶט עֶבְרָת֣וֹ יִכְלֶֽה׃
verses.translit: zvr' 'vlh (yqtsvr) [yqtsr]'vn vshbt 'brtv ykhlh
verses.translation: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity; And the rod of his wrath shall fail.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טֽוֹב־עַ֭יִן ה֣וּא יְבֹרָ֑ךְ כִּֽי־נָתַ֖ן מִלַּחְמ֣וֹ לַדָּֽל׃
verses.translit: tvb'yn hv' ybrkh khyntn mlchmv ldl
verses.translation: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; For he giveth of his bread to the poor.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גָּ֣רֵֽשׁ לֵ֭ץ וְיֵצֵ֣א מָד֑וֹן וְ֝יִשְׁבֹּ֗ת דִּ֣ין וְקָלֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: grsh lts vyts' mdvn vyshbt dyn vqlvn
verses.translation: Cast out the scorner, and contention will go out; Yea, strife and shame will cease.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹהֵ֥ב (טהור) [טְהׇר־]לֵ֑ב חֵ֥ן שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו רֵעֵ֥הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: 'hb (thvr) [thr]lb chn shptyv r'hv mlkh
verses.translation: He that loveth pureness of heart, That hath grace in his lips, the king shall be his friend.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הֹוָה נָ֣צְרוּ דָ֑עַת וַ֝יְסַלֵּ֗ף דִּבְרֵ֥י בֹגֵֽד׃
verses.translit: 'yny yhvh ntsrv d't vyslf dbry bgd
verses.translation: The eyes of the LORD preserve him that hath knowledge, But He overthroweth the words of the faithless man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר עָ֭צֵל אֲרִ֣י בַח֑וּץ בְּת֥וֹךְ רְ֝חֹב֗וֹת אֵרָצֵֽחַ׃
verses.translit: 'mr 'tsl 'ry bchvts btvkh rchbvt 'rtsch
verses.translation: The sluggard saith: ‘There is a lion without; I shall be slain in the streets.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁוּחָ֣ה עֲ֭מֻקָּה פִּ֣י זָר֑וֹת זְע֥וּם יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה (יפול) [יִפׇּל־]שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: shvchh 'mqh py zrvt z'vm yhvh (ypvl) [ypl]shm
verses.translation: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: He that is abhorred of the LORD shall fall therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֭וֶּלֶת קְשׁוּרָ֣ה בְלֶב־נָ֑עַר שֵׁ֥בֶט מ֝וּסָ֗ר יַרְחִיקֶ֥נָּה מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: 'vlt qshvrh blbn'r shbt mvsr yrchyqnh mmnv
verses.translation: Foolishness is bound up in the heart of a child; But the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹ֣שֵֽׁק דָּ֭ל לְהַרְבּ֣וֹת ל֑וֹ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ֝עָשִׁ֗יר אַךְ־לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: 'shq dl lhrbvt lv ntn l'shyr 'khlmchsvr
verses.translation: One may oppress the poor, yet will their gain increase; One may give to the rich, yet will want come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֥ט אׇזְנְךָ֗ וּ֭שְׁמַע דִּבְרֵ֣י חֲכָמִ֑ים וְ֝לִבְּךָ֗ תָּשִׁ֥ית לְדַעְתִּֽי׃
verses.translit: ht 'znkh vshm' dbry chkhmym vlbkh tshyt ld'ty
verses.translation: Incline thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, And apply thy heart unto my knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־נָ֭עִים כִּֽי־תִשְׁמְרֵ֣ם בְּבִטְנֶ֑ךָ יִכֹּ֥נוּ יַ֝חְדָּ֗ו עַל־שְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: khyn'ym khytshmrm bbtnkh ykhnv ychdv 'lshptykh
verses.translation: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; Let them be established altogether upon thy lips.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִֽהְי֣וֹת בַּ֭יהֹוָה מִבְטַחֶ֑ךָ הוֹדַעְתִּ֖יךָ הַיּ֣וֹם אַף־אָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: lhyvt byhvh mbtchkh hvd'tykh hyvm 'f'th
verses.translation: That thy trust may be in the LORD, I have made them known to thee this day, even to thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֤א כָתַ֣בְתִּֽי לְ֭ךָ (שלשום) [שָׁלִישִׁ֑ים] בְּמֹ֖עֵצ֣וֹת וָדָֽעַת׃
verses.translit: hl' khtbty lkh (shlshvm) [shlyshym] bm'tsvt vd't
verses.translation: Have not I written unto thee excellent things Of counsels and knowledge;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהֽוֹדִיעֲךָ֗ קֹ֭שְׁטְ אִמְרֵ֣י אֱמֶ֑ת לְהָשִׁ֥יב אֲמָרִ֥ים אֱ֝מֶ֗ת לְשֹׁלְחֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: lhvdy'kh qsht 'mry 'mt lhshyb 'mrym 'mt lshlchykh
verses.translation: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth, That thou mightest bring back words of truth to them that send thee?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַֽל־תִּגְזׇל־דָּ֭ל כִּ֣י דַל־ה֑וּא וְאַל־תְּדַכֵּ֖א עָנִ֣י בַשָּֽׁעַר׃
verses.translit: 'ltgzldl khy dlhv' v'ltdkh' 'ny bsh'r
verses.translation: Rob not the weak, because he is weak, Neither crush the poor in the gate;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יְ֭הֹוָה יָרִ֣יב רִיבָ֑ם וְקָבַ֖ע אֶת־קֹבְעֵיהֶ֣ם נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: khyyhvh yryb rybm vqb' 'tqb'yhm npsh
verses.translation: For the LORD will plead their cause, And despoil of life those that despoil them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּ֭תְרַע אֶת־בַּ֣עַל אָ֑ף וְאֶת־אִ֥ישׁ חֵ֝מ֗וֹת לֹ֣א תָבֽוֹא׃
verses.translit: 'lttr' 'tb'l 'f v't'ysh chmvt l' tbv'
verses.translation: Make no friendship with a man that is given to anger; And with a wrathful man thou shalt not go;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּן־תֶּאֱלַ֥ף אֹרְחֹתָ֑ו וְלָקַחְתָּ֖ מוֹקֵ֣שׁ לְנַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.translit: pnt'lf 'rchtv vlqcht mvqsh lnpshkh
verses.translation: Lest thou learn his ways, And get a snare to thy soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תְּהִ֥י בְתֹֽקְעֵי־כָ֑ף בַּ֝עֹרְבִ֗ים מַשָּׁאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'lthy btq'ykhf b'rbym msh'vt
verses.translation: Be thou not of them that strike hands, Or of them that are sureties for debts;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אֵֽין־לְךָ֥ לְשַׁלֵּ֑ם לָ֥מָּה יִקַּ֥ח מִ֝שְׁכָּבְךָ֗ מִתַּחְתֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'm'ynlkh lshlm lmh yqch mshkhbkh mtchtykh
verses.translation: If thou hast not wherewith to pay, Why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּ֭סֵּג גְּב֣וּל עוֹלָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשׂ֣וּ אֲבוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'ltsg gbvl 'vlm 'shr 'shv 'bvtykh
verses.translation: Remove not the ancient landmark, Which thy fathers have set.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָזִ֡יתָ אִ֤ישׁ  מָ֘הִ֤יר בִּמְלַאכְתּ֗וֹ לִֽפְנֵי־מְלָכִ֥ים יִתְיַצָּ֑ב בַּל־יִ֝תְיַצֵּ֗ב לִפְנֵ֥י חֲשֻׁכִּֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: chzyt 'ysh  mhyr bml'khtv lpnymlkhym ytytsb blytytsb lpny chshkhym {p}
verses.translation: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; He shall not stand before mean men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תֵ֭שֵׁב לִלְח֣וֹם אֶת־מוֹשֵׁ֑ל בִּ֥ין תָּ֝בִ֗ין אֶת־אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: khytshb llchvm 'tmvshl byn tbyn 't'shr lpnykh
verses.translation: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider well him that is before thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ שַׂכִּ֣ין בְּלֹעֶ֑ךָ אִם־בַּ֖עַל נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: vshmt shkhyn bl'kh 'mb'l npsh 'th
verses.translation: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּ֭תְאָו לְמַטְעַמּוֹתָ֑יו וְ֝ה֗וּא לֶ֣חֶם כְּזָבִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'ltt'v lmt'mvtyv vhv' lchm khzbym
verses.translation: Be not desirous of his dainties; seeing they are deceitful food.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּיגַ֥ע לְֽהַעֲשִׁ֑יר מִֽבִּינָתְךָ֥ חֲדָֽל׃
verses.translit: 'ltyg' lh'shyr mbyntkh chdl
verses.translation: Weary not thyself to be rich; Cease from thine own wisdom. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (התעוף) [הֲתָ֤עִיף]־עֵינֶ֥יךָ בּ֗וֹ וְֽאֵ֫ינֶ֥נּוּ כִּ֤י עָשֹׂ֣ה יַעֲשֶׂה־לּ֣וֹ כְנָפַ֑יִם כְּ֝נֶ֗שֶׁר (ועיף) [יָע֥וּף] הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: (ht'vf) [ht'yf]'ynykh bv v'ynnv khy 'shh y'shhlv khnpym khnshr (v'yf) [y'vf] hshmym {p}
verses.translation: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon it? it is gone; For riches certainly make themselves wings, Like an eagle that flieth toward heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּלְחַ֗ם אֶת־לֶ֭חֶם רַ֣ע עָ֑יִן וְאַל־תִּ֝תְאָ֗ו לְמַטְעַמֹּתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'ltlchm 'tlchm r' 'yn v'ltt'v lmt'mtyv
verses.translation: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, Neither desire thou his dainties;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י  כְּמ֥וֹ שָׁעַ֥ר בְּנַפְשׁ֗וֹ כֶּ֫ן־ה֥וּא אֱכ֣וֹל וּ֭שְׁתֵה יֹ֣אמַר לָ֑ךְ וְ֝לִבּ֗וֹ בַּל־עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khy  khmv sh'r bnpshv khnhv' 'khvl vshth y'mr lkh vlbv bl'mkh
verses.translation: For as one that hath reckoned within himself, so is he: ‘Eat and drink’, saith he to thee; But his heart is not with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּֽתְּךָ־אָכַ֥לְתָּ תְקִיאֶ֑נָּה וְ֝שִׁחַ֗תָּ דְּבָרֶ֥יךָ הַנְּעִימִֽים׃
verses.translit: ptkh'khlt tqy'nh vshcht dbrykh hn'ymym
verses.translation: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, And lose thy sweet words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאׇזְנֵ֣י כְ֭סִיל אַל־תְּדַבֵּ֑ר כִּי־יָ֝ב֗וּז לְשֵׂ֣כֶל מִלֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: b'zny khsyl 'ltdbr khyybvz lshkhl mlykh
verses.translation: Speak not in the ears of a fool; for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּ֭סֵּג גְּב֣וּל עוֹלָ֑ם וּבִשְׂדֵ֥י יְ֝תוֹמִ֗ים אַל־תָּבֹֽא׃
verses.translit: 'ltsg gbvl 'vlm vbshdy ytvmym 'ltb'
verses.translation: Remove not the ancient landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־גֹאֲלָ֥ם חָזָ֑ק הֽוּא־יָרִ֖יב אֶת־רִיבָ֣ם אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khyg'lm chzq hv'yryb 'trybm 'tkh
verses.translation: For their Redeemer is strong; He will plead their cause with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָבִ֣יאָה לַמּוּסָ֣ר לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝אׇזְנֶ֗ךָ לְאִמְרֵי־דָֽעַת׃
verses.translit: hby'h lmvsr lbkh v'znkh l'mryd't
verses.translation: Apply thy heart unto instruction, And thine ears to the words of knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּמְנַ֣ע מִנַּ֣עַר מוּסָ֑ר כִּֽי־תַכֶּ֥נּוּ בַ֝שֵּׁ֗בֶט לֹ֣א יָמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: 'ltmn' mn'r mvsr khytkhnv bshbt l' ymvt
verses.translation: Withhold not correction from the child; For though thou beat him with the rod, he will not die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭תָּה בַּשֵּׁ֣בֶט תַּכֶּ֑נּוּ וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ מִשְּׁא֥וֹל תַּצִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: 'th bshbt tkhnv vnpshv msh'vl ttsyl
verses.translation: Thou beatest him with the rod, And wilt deliver his soul from the nether-world.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭נִי אִם־חָכַ֣ם לִבֶּ֑ךָ יִשְׂמַ֖ח לִבִּ֣י גַם־אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: bny 'mchkhm lbkh yshmch lby gm'ny
verses.translation: My son, if thy heart be wise, My heart will be glad, even mine;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתַעְלֹ֥זְנָה כִלְיוֹתָ֑י בְּדַבֵּ֥ר שְׂ֝פָתֶ֗יךָ מֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vt'lznh khlyvty bdbr shptykh myshrym
verses.translation: Yea, my reins will rejoice, When thy lips speak right things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־יְקַנֵּ֣א לִ֭בְּךָ בַּחַטָּאִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם־בְּיִרְאַת־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: 'lyqn' lbkh bcht'ym khy 'mbyr'tyhvh khlhyvm
verses.translation: Let not thy heart envy sinners, But be in the fear of the LORD all the day;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֭י אִם־יֵ֣שׁ אַחֲרִ֑ית וְ֝תִקְוָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִכָּרֵֽת׃
verses.translit: khy 'mysh 'chryt vtqvtkh l' tkhrt
verses.translation: For surely there is a future; And thy hope shall not be cut off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמַע־אַתָּ֣ה בְנִ֣י וַחֲכָ֑ם וְאַשֵּׁ֖ר בַּדֶּ֣רֶךְ לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: shm''th bny vchkhm v'shr bdrkh lbkh
verses.translation: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, And guide thy heart in the way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תְּהִ֥י בְסֹֽבְאֵי־יָ֑יִן בְּזֹלְלֵ֖י בָשָׂ֣ר לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'lthy bsb'yyyn bzlly bshr lmv
verses.translation: Be not among winebibbers; Among gluttonous eaters of flesh;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־סֹבֵ֣א וְ֭זוֹלֵל יִוָּרֵ֑שׁ וּ֝קְרָעִ֗ים תַּלְבִּ֥ישׁ נוּמָֽה׃
verses.translit: khysb' vzvll yvrsh vqr'ym tlbysh nvmh
verses.translation: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty; And drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע לְ֭אָבִיךָ זֶ֣ה יְלָדֶ֑ךָ וְאַל־תָּ֝ב֗וּז כִּֽי־זָקְנָ֥ה אִמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: shm' l'bykh zh yldkh v'ltbvz khyzqnh 'mkh
verses.translation: Hearken unto thy father that begot thee, And despise not thy mother when she is old.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱמֶ֣ת קְ֭נֵה וְאַל־תִּמְכֹּ֑ר חׇכְמָ֖ה וּמוּסָ֣ר וּבִינָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'mt qnh v'ltmkhr chkhmh vmvsr vbynh
verses.translation: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (גול) [גִּ֣יל] יָ֭גִיל אֲבִ֣י צַדִּ֑יק (יולד) [וְיוֹלֵ֥ד] חָ֝כָ֗ם (וישמח) [יִשְׂמַח־]בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: (gvl) [gyl] ygyl 'by tsdyq (yvld) [vyvld] chkhm (vyshmch) [yshmch]bv
verses.translation: The father of the righteous will greatly rejoice; and he that begetteth a wise child will have joy of him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִֽשְׂמַח־אָבִ֥יךָ וְאִמֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝תָגֵ֗ל יוֹלַדְתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: yshmch'bykh v'mkh vtgl yvldtkh
verses.translation: Let thy father and thy mother be glad, and let her that bore thee rejoice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּנָה־בְנִ֣י לִבְּךָ֣ לִ֑י וְ֝עֵינֶ֗יךָ דְּרָכַ֥י (תרצנה) [תִּצֹּֽרְנָה]׃
verses.translit: tnhbny lbkh ly v'ynykh drkhy (trtsnh) [ttsrnh]
verses.translation: My son, give me thy heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־שׁוּחָ֣ה עֲמֻקָּ֣ה זוֹנָ֑ה וּבְאֵ֥ר צָ֝רָ֗ה נׇכְרִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: khyshvchh 'mqh zvnh vb'r tsrh nkhryh
verses.translation: For a harlot is a deep ditch; and an alien woman is a narrow pit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַף־הִ֭יא כְּחֶ֣תֶף תֶּאֱרֹ֑ב וּ֝בוֹגְדִ֗ים בְּאָדָ֥ם תּוֹסִֽף׃
verses.translit: 'fhy' khchtf t'rb vbvgdym b'dm tvsf
verses.translation: She also lieth in wait as a robber, and increaseth the faithless among men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמִ֨י א֥וֹי לְמִ֪י אֲב֡וֹי לְמִ֤י (מדונים) [מִדְיָנִ֨ים ] לְמִ֥י שִׂ֗יחַ לְ֭מִי פְּצָעִ֣ים חִנָּ֑ם לְ֝מִ֗י חַכְלִל֥וּת עֵינָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: lmy 'vy lmy 'bvy lmy (mdvnym) [mdynym ] lmy shych lmy pts'ym chnm lmy chkhllvt 'ynym
verses.translation: Who crieth: ‘Woe’? who: ‘Alas’? Who hath contentions? who hath raving? Who hath wounds without cause? Who hath redness of eyes?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַֽמְאַחֲרִ֥ים עַל־הַיָּ֑יִן לַ֝בָּאִ֗ים לַחְקֹ֥ר מִמְסָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: lm'chrym 'lhyyn lb'ym lchqr mmskh
verses.translation: They that tarry long at the wine; They that go to try mixed wine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תֵּ֥רֶא יַּיִן֮ כִּ֤י יִתְאַ֫דָּ֥ם כִּֽי־יִתֵּ֣ן (בכיס) [בַּכּ֣וֹס] עֵינ֑וֹ יִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בְּמֵֽישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'ltr' yyn khy yt'dm khyytn (bkhys) [bkhvs] 'ynv ythlkh bmyshrym
verses.translation: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth its colour in the cup, When it glideth down smoothly;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭חֲרִיתוֹ כְּנָחָ֣שׁ יִשָּׁ֑ךְ וּֽכְצִפְעֹנִ֥י יַפְרִֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'chrytv khnchsh yshkh vkhtsp'ny yprsh
verses.translation: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like a basilisk.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֭ינֶיךָ יִרְא֣וּ זָר֑וֹת וְ֝לִבְּךָ֗ יְדַבֵּ֥ר תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'ynykh yr'v zrvt vlbkh ydbr thpkhvt
verses.translation: Thine eyes shall behold strange things, and thy heart shall utter confused things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭הָיִיתָ כְּשֹׁכֵ֣ב בְּלֶב־יָ֑ם וּ֝כְשֹׁכֵ֗ב בְּרֹ֣אשׁ חִבֵּֽל׃
verses.translit: vhyyt khshkhb blbym vkhshkhb br'sh chbl
verses.translation: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִכּ֥וּנִי בַל־חָלִיתִי֮ הֲלָמ֗וּנִי בַּל־יָ֫דָ֥עְתִּי מָתַ֥י אָקִ֑יץ א֝וֹסִ֗יף אֲבַקְשֶׁ֥נּוּ עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: hkhvny blchlyty hlmvny blyd'ty mty 'qyts 'vsyf 'bqshnv 'vd
verses.translation: ’They have struck me, and I felt it not, they have beaten me, and I knew it not; when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תְּ֭קַנֵּא בְּאַנְשֵׁ֣י רָעָ֑ה וְאַל־תִּ֝תְאָ֗ו לִֽהְי֥וֹת אִתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'ltqn' b'nshy r'h v'ltt'v lhyvt 'tm
verses.translation: Be not thou envious of evil men, Neither desire to be with them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־שֹׁ֭ד יֶהְגֶּ֣ה לִבָּ֑ם וְ֝עָמָ֗ל שִׂפְתֵיהֶ֥ם תְּדַבֵּֽרְנָה׃
verses.translit: khyshd yhgh lbm v'ml shptyhm tdbrnh
verses.translation: For their heart studieth destruction, And their lips talk of mischief.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭חׇכְמָה יִבָּ֣נֶה בָּ֑יִת וּ֝בִתְבוּנָ֗ה יִתְכּוֹנָֽן׃
verses.translit: bchkhmh ybnh byt vbtbvnh ytkhvnn
verses.translation: Through wisdom is a house builded; And by understanding it is established;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֭בְדַעַת חֲדָרִ֣ים יִמָּלְא֑וּ כׇּל־ה֖וֹן יָקָ֣ר וְנָעִֽים׃
verses.translit: vbd't chdrym yml'v khlhvn yqr vn'ym
verses.translation: And by knowledge are the chambers filled With all precious and pleasant riches.
