verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֶּבֶר־חָכָ֥ם בַּע֑וֹז וְאִֽישׁ־דַּ֝֗עַת מְאַמֶּץ־כֹּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: gbrchkhm b'vz v'yshd't m'mtskhch
verses.translation: A wise man is strong; Yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְ֭תַחְבֻּלוֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ֣ מִלְחָמָ֑ה וּ֝תְשׁוּעָ֗ה בְּרֹ֣ב יוֹעֵֽץ׃
verses.translit: khy btchblvt t'shhlkh mlchmh vtshv'h brb yv'ts
verses.translation: For with wise advice thou shalt make thy war; And in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאמ֣וֹת לֶאֱוִ֣יל חׇכְמ֑וֹת בַּ֝שַּׁ֗עַר לֹ֣א יִפְתַּח־פִּֽיהוּ׃
verses.translit: r'mvt l'vyl chkhmvt bsh'r l' yptchpyhv
verses.translation: Wisdom is as unattainable to a fool as corals; He openeth not his mouth in the gate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְחַשֵּׁ֥ב לְהָרֵ֑עַ ל֝֗וֹ בַּעַל־מְזִמּ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: mchshb lhr' lv b'lmzmvt yqr'v
verses.translation: He that deviseth to do evil, Men shall call him a mischievous person.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זִמַּ֣ת אִוֶּ֣לֶת חַטָּ֑את וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת לְאָדָ֣ם לֵֽץ׃
verses.translit: zmt 'vlt cht't vtv'bt l'dm lts
verses.translation: The thought of foolishness is sin; And the scorner is an abomination to men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֭תְרַפִּיתָ בְּי֥וֹם צָרָ֗ה צַ֣ר כֹּחֶֽכָה׃
verses.translit: htrpyt byvm tsrh tsr khchkhh
verses.translation: If thou faint in the day of adversity, Thy strength is small indeed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭צֵּל לְקֻחִ֣ים לַמָּ֑וֶת וּמָטִ֥ים לַ֝הֶ֗רֶג אִם־תַּחְשֽׂוֹךְ׃
verses.translit: htsl lqchym lmvt vmtym lhrg 'mtchshvkh
verses.translation: Deliver them that are drawn unto death; And those that are ready to be slain wilt thou forbear to rescue?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תֹאמַ֗ר הֵן֮ לֹא־יָדַ֢עְנ֫וּ זֶ֥ה הֲֽלֹא־תֹ֘כֵ֤ן לִבּ֨וֹת  הֽוּא־יָבִ֗ין וְנֹצֵ֣ר נַ֭פְשְׁךָ ה֣וּא יֵדָ֑ע וְהֵשִׁ֖יב לְאָדָ֣ם כְּפׇעֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khyt'mr hn l'yd'nv zh hl'tkhn lbvt  hv'ybyn vntsr npshkh hv' yd' vhshyb l'dm khp'lv
verses.translation: If thou sayest: ‘Behold, we knew not this’, Doth not He that weigheth the hearts consider it? And He that keepeth thy soul, doth not He know it? And shall not He render to every man according to his works?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱכׇל־בְּנִ֣י דְבַ֣שׁ כִּי־ט֑וֹב וְנֹ֥פֶת מָ֝ת֗וֹק עַל־חִכֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'khlbny dbsh khytvb vnpt mtvq 'lchkhkh
verses.translation: My son, eat thou honey, for it is good, And the honeycomb is sweet to thy taste;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּ֤ן  דְּעֶ֥ה חׇכְמָ֗ה לְנַ֫פְשֶׁ֥ךָ אִם־מָ֭צָאתָ וְיֵ֣שׁ אַחֲרִ֑ית וְ֝תִקְוָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִכָּרֵֽת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khn  d'h chkhmh lnpshkh 'mmts't vysh 'chryt vtqvtkh l' tkhrt {p}
verses.translation: So know thou wisdom to be unto thy soul; If thou hast found it, then shall there be a future, And thy hope shall not be cut off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תֶּאֱרֹ֣ב רָ֭שָׁע לִנְוֵ֣ה צַדִּ֑יק אַֽל־תְּשַׁדֵּ֥ד רִבְצֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'lt'rb rsh' lnvh tsdyq 'ltshdd rbtsv
verses.translation: Lie not in wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous, Spoil not his resting-place;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י שֶׁ֨בַע  יִפּ֣וֹל צַדִּ֣יק וָקָ֑ם וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים יִכָּשְׁל֥וּ בְרָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy shb'  ypvl tsdyq vqm vrsh'ym ykhshlv br'h
verses.translation: For a righteous man falleth seven times, and riseth up again, But the wicked stumble under adversity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּנְפֹ֣ל (אויביך) [א֭וֹיִבְךָ] אַל־תִּשְׂמָ֑ח וּ֝בִכָּשְׁל֗וֹ אַל־יָגֵ֥ל לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: bnpl ('vybykh) ['vybkh] 'ltshmch vbkhshlv 'lygl lbkh
verses.translation: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, And let not thy heart be glad when he stumbleth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּן־יִרְאֶ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה וְרַ֣ע בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְהֵשִׁ֖יב מֵעָלָ֣יו אַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: pnyr'h yhvh vr' b'ynyv vhshyb m'lyv 'pv
verses.translation: Lest the LORD see it, and it displease Him, And He turn away His wrath from him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּתְחַ֥ר בַּמְּרֵעִ֑ים אַל־תְּ֝קַנֵּ֗א בָּֽרְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'lttchr bmr'ym 'ltqn' brsh'ym
verses.translation: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, Neither be thou envious at the wicked;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י  לֹא־תִהְיֶ֣ה אַחֲרִ֣ית לָרָ֑ע נֵ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khy  l'thyh 'chryt lr' nr rsh'ym yd'kh
verses.translation: For there will be no future to the evil man, The lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְרָא־אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּנִ֣י וָמֶ֑לֶךְ עִם־שׁ֝וֹנִ֗ים אַל־תִּתְעָרָֽב׃
verses.translit: yr''tyhvh bny vmlkh 'mshvnym 'ltt'rb
verses.translation: My son, fear thou the LORD and the king, And meddle not with them that are given to change;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־פִ֭תְאֹם יָק֣וּם אֵידָ֑ם וּפִ֥יד שְׁ֝נֵיהֶ֗ם מִ֣י יוֹדֵֽעַ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khypt'm yqvm 'ydm vpyd shnyhm my yvd' {p}
verses.translation: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; And who knoweth the ruin from them both?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־אֵ֥לֶּה לַחֲכָמִ֑ים הַֽכֵּר־פָּנִ֖ים בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט בַּל־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: gm'lh lchkhmym hkhrpnym bmshpt bltvb
verses.translation: These also are sayings of the wise. To have respect of persons in judgment is not good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֤מֵ֨ר  לְרָשָׁע֮ צַדִּ֢יק אָ֥֫תָּה יִקְּבֻ֥הוּ עַמִּ֑ים יִזְעָמ֥וּהוּ לְאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: 'mr  lrsh' tsdyq 'th yqbhv 'mym yz'mvhv l'mym
verses.translation: He that saith unto the wicked: ‘Thou art righteous’, Peoples shall curse him, nations shall execrate him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלַמּוֹכִיחִ֥ים יִנְעָ֑ם וַ֝עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם תָּב֥וֹא בִרְכַּת־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: vlmvkhychym yn'm v'lyhm tbv' brkhttvb
verses.translation: But to them that decide justly shall be delight, And a good blessing shall come upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂפָתַ֥יִם יִשָּׁ֑ק מֵ֝שִׁ֗יב דְּבָרִ֥ים נְכֹחִֽים׃
verses.translit: shptym yshq mshyb dbrym nkhchym
verses.translation: He kisseth the lips That giveth a right answer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָ֘כֵ֤ן בַּח֨וּץ  מְלַאכְתֶּ֗ךָ וְעַתְּדָ֣הּ בַּשָּׂדֶ֣ה לָ֑ךְ אַ֝חַ֗ר וּבָנִ֥יתָ בֵיתֶֽךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hkhn bchvts  ml'khtkh v'tdh bshdh lkh 'chr vbnyt bytkh {p}
verses.translation: Prepare thy work without, And make it fit for thyself in the field; And afterwards build thy house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תְּהִ֣י עֵד־חִנָּ֣ם בְּרֵעֶ֑ךָ וַ֝הֲפִתִּ֗יתָ בִּשְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'lthy 'dchnm br'kh vhptyt bshptykh
verses.translation: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; And deceive not with thy lips.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תֹּאמַ֗ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָֽשָׂה־לִ֭י כֵּ֤ן אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־לּ֑וֹ אָשִׁ֖יב לָאִ֣ישׁ כְּפׇעֳלֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lt'mr kh'shr 'shhly khn ''shhlv 'shyb l'ysh khp'lv {p}
verses.translation: Say not: ‘I will do so to him as he hath done to me; I will render to the man according to his work.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־שְׂדֵ֣ה אִישׁ־עָצֵ֣ל עָבַ֑רְתִּי וְעַל־כֶּ֝֗רֶם אָדָ֥ם חֲסַר־לֵֽב׃
verses.translit: 'lshdh 'ysh'tsl 'brty v'lkhrm 'dm chsrlb
verses.translation: I went by the field of the slothful, And by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה עָ֘לָ֤ה כֻלּ֨וֹ  קִמְּשֹׂנִ֗ים כׇּסּ֣וּ פָנָ֣יו חֲרֻלִּ֑ים וְגֶ֖דֶר אֲבָנָ֣יו נֶהֱרָֽסָה׃
verses.translit: vhnh 'lh khlv  qmshnym khsv pnyv chrlym vgdr 'bnyv nhrsh
verses.translation: And, lo, it was all grown over with thistles, The face thereof was covered with nettles, And the stone wall thereof was broken down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶחֱזֶ֣ה אָ֭נֹכִי אָשִׁ֣ית לִבִּ֑י רָ֝אִ֗יתִי לָקַ֥חְתִּי מוּסָֽר׃
verses.translit: v'chzh 'nkhy 'shyt lby r'yty lqchty mvsr
verses.translation: Then I beheld, and considered well; I saw, and received instruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְעַ֣ט שֵׁ֭נוֹת מְעַ֣ט תְּנוּמ֑וֹת מְעַ֓ט  חִבֻּ֖ק יָדַ֣יִם לִשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.translit: m't shnvt m't tnvmvt m't  chbq ydym lshkhb
verses.translation: ’Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to sleep’—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָֽא־מִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ רֵישֶׁ֑ךָ וּ֝מַחְסֹרֶ֗יךָ כְּאִ֣ישׁ מָגֵֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vb'mthlkh ryshkh vmchsrykh kh'ysh mgn {p}
verses.translation: So shall thy poverty come as a runner, And thy want as an armed man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־אֵ֭לֶּה מִשְׁלֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶ֝עְתִּ֗יקוּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י  חִזְקִיָּ֬ה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: gm'lh mshly shlmh 'shr h'tyqv 'nshy  chzqyh mlkhyhvdh
verses.translation: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּבֹ֣ד אֱ֭לֹהִים הַסְתֵּ֣ר דָּבָ֑ר וּכְבֹ֥ד מְ֝לָכִ֗ים חֲקֹ֣ר דָּבָֽר׃
verses.translit: khbd 'lhym hstr dbr vkhbd mlkhym chqr dbr
verses.translation: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing; but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣יִם לָ֭רוּם וָאָ֣רֶץ לָעֹ֑מֶק וְלֵ֥ב מְ֝לָכִ֗ים אֵ֣ין חֵֽקֶר׃
verses.translit: shmym lrvm v'rts l'mq vlb mlkhym 'yn chqr
verses.translation: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָג֣וֹ סִיגִ֣ים מִכָּ֑סֶף וַיֵּצֵ֖א לַצֹּרֵ֣ף כֶּֽלִי׃
verses.translit: hgv sygym mkhsf vyts' ltsrf khly
verses.translation: Take away the dross from the silver, and there cometh forth a vessel for the refiner;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָג֣וֹ רָ֭שָׁע לִפְנֵי־מֶ֑לֶךְ וְיִכּ֖וֹן בַּצֶּ֣דֶק כִּסְאֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hgv rsh' lpnymlkh vykhvn btsdq khs'v
verses.translation: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּתְהַדַּ֥ר לִפְנֵי־מֶ֑לֶךְ וּבִמְק֥וֹם גְּ֝דֹלִ֗ים אַֽל־תַּעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.translit: 'ltthdr lpnymlkh vbmqvm gdlym 'lt'md
verses.translation: Glorify not thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י ט֥וֹב אֲמׇר־לְךָ֗ עֲֽלֵ֫ה־הֵ֥נָּה מֵ֭הַשְׁפִּ֣ילְךָ לִפְנֵ֣י נָדִ֑יב אֲשֶׁ֖ר רָא֣וּ עֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: khy tvb 'mrlkh 'lhhnh mhshpylkh lpny ndyb 'shr r'v 'ynykh
verses.translation: For better is it that it be said unto thee: ‘Come up hither’, than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom thine eyes have seen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תֵּצֵ֥א לָרִ֗ב מַ֫הֵ֥ר פֶּ֣ן מַה־תַּ֭עֲשֶׂה בְּאַחֲרִיתָ֑הּ בְּהַכְלִ֖ים אֹתְךָ֣ רֵעֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'ltts' lrb mhr pn mht'shh b'chryth bhkhlym 'tkh r'kh
verses.translation: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רִ֭יבְךָ רִ֣יב אֶת־רֵעֶ֑ךָ וְס֖וֹד אַחֵ֣ר אַל־תְּגָֽל׃
verses.translit: rybkh ryb 'tr'kh vsvd 'chr 'ltgl
verses.translation: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour, but reveal not the secret of another;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּֽן־יְחַסֶּדְךָ֥ שֹׁמֵ֑עַ וְ֝דִבָּתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.translit: pnychsdkh shm' vdbtkh l' tshvb
verses.translation: Lest he that heareth it revile thee, and thine infamy turn not away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּפּוּחֵ֣י זָ֭הָב בְּמַשְׂכִּיּ֣וֹת כָּ֑סֶף דָּ֝בָ֗ר דָּבֻ֥ר עַל־אׇפְנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: tpvchy zhb bmshkhyvt khsf dbr dbr 'l'pnyv
verses.translation: A word fitly spoken Is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֶ֣זֶם זָ֭הָב וַחֲלִי־כָ֑תֶם מוֹכִ֥יחַ חָ֝כָ֗ם עַל־אֹ֥זֶן שֹׁמָֽעַת׃
verses.translit: nzm zhb vchlykhtm mvkhych chkhm 'l'zn shm't
verses.translation: As an ear-ring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, So is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּצִנַּת־שֶׁ֨לֶג  בְּי֬וֹם קָצִ֗יר צִ֣יר נֶ֭אֱמָן לְשֹׁלְחָ֑יו וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ אֲדֹנָ֣יו יָשִֽׁיב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khtsntshlg  byvm qtsyr tsyr n'mn lshlchyv vnpsh 'dnyv yshyb {p}
verses.translation: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, So is a faithful messenger to him that sendeth him; For he refresheth the soul of his master. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְשִׂיאִ֣ים וְ֭רוּחַ וְגֶ֣שֶׁם אָ֑יִן אִ֥ישׁ מִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ל בְּמַתַּת־שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.translit: nshy'ym vrvch vgshm 'yn 'ysh mthll bmttshqr
verses.translation: As vapours and wind without rain, So is he that boasteth himself of a false gift.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאֹ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם יְפֻתֶּ֣ה קָצִ֑ין וְלָשׁ֥וֹן רַ֝כָּ֗ה תִּשְׁבׇּר־גָּֽרֶם׃
verses.translit: b'rkh 'pym ypth qtsyn vlshvn rkhh tshbrgrm
verses.translation: By long forbearing is a ruler persuaded, And a soft tongue breaketh the bone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּבַ֣שׁ מָ֭צָאתָ אֱכֹ֣ל דַּיֶּ֑ךָּ פֶּן־תִּ֝שְׂבָּעֶ֗נּוּ וַהֲקֵאתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: dbsh mts't 'khl dykh pntshb'nv vhq'tv
verses.translation: Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, Lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֹקַ֣ר רַ֭גְלְךָ מִבֵּ֣ית רֵעֶ֑ךָ פֶּן־יִ֝שְׂבָּעֲךָ֗ וּשְׂנֵאֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: hqr rglkh mbyt r'kh pnyshb'kh vshn'kh
verses.translation: Let thy foot be seldom in thy neighbour’s house; Lest he be sated with thee, and hate thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵפִ֣יץ וְ֭חֶרֶב וְחֵ֣ץ שָׁנ֑וּן אִ֥ישׁ עֹנֶ֥ה בְ֝רֵעֵ֗הוּ עֵ֣ד שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.translit: mpyts vchrb vchts shnvn 'ysh 'nh br'hv 'd shqr
verses.translation: As a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow, So is a man that beareth false witness against his neighbour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֵׁ֣ן רֹ֭עָה וְרֶ֣גֶל מוּעָ֑דֶת מִבְטָ֥ח בּ֝וֹגֵ֗ד בְּי֣וֹם צָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: shn r'h vrgl mv'dt mbtch bvgd byvm tsrh
verses.translation: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble Is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַ֥עֲדֶה־בֶּ֨גֶד  בְּי֣וֹם קָ֭רָה חֹ֣מֶץ עַל־נָ֑תֶר וְשָׁ֥ר בַּ֝שִּׁרִ֗ים עַ֣ל לֶב־רָֽע׃ {פ}
verses.translit: m'dhbgd  byvm qrh chmts 'lntr vshr bshrym 'l lbr' {p}
verses.translation: As one that taketh off a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, So is he that singeth songs to a heavy heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־רָעֵ֣ב שֹׂ֭נַאֲךָ הַאֲכִלֵ֣הוּ לָ֑חֶם וְאִם־צָ֝מֵ֗א הַשְׁקֵ֥הוּ מָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: 'mr'b shn'kh h'khlhv lchm v'mtsm' hshqhv mym
verses.translation: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat, And if he be thirsty, give him water to drink;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י גֶחָלִ֗ים אַ֭תָּה חֹתֶ֣ה עַל־רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַ֝יהֹוָ֗ה יְשַׁלֶּם־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khy gchlym 'th chth 'lr'shv vyhvh yshlmlkh
verses.translation: For thou wilt heap coals of fire upon his head, And the LORD will reward thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ר֣וּחַ צָ֭פוֹן תְּח֣וֹלֵֽל גָּ֑שֶׁם וּפָנִ֥ים נִ֝זְעָמִ֗ים לְשׁ֣וֹן סָֽתֶר׃
verses.translit: rvch tspvn tchvll gshm vpnym nz'mym lshvn str
verses.translation: The north wind bringeth forth rain, And a backbiting tongue an angry countenance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֗וֹב שֶׁ֥בֶת עַל־פִּנַּת־גָּ֑ג מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת (מדונים) [מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים] וּבֵ֥ית חָֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: tvb shbt 'lpntgg m'sht (mdvnym) [mdynym] vbyt chbr
verses.translation: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, Than in a house in common with a contentious woman.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַ֣יִם קָ֭רִים עַל־נֶ֣פֶשׁ עֲיֵפָ֑ה וּשְׁמוּעָ֥ה ט֝וֹבָ֗ה מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מֶרְחָֽק׃
verses.translit: mym qrym 'lnpsh 'yph vshmv'h tvbh m'rts mrchq
verses.translation: As cold waters to a faint soul, So is good news from a far country.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַעְיָ֣ן נִ֭רְפָּשׂ וּמָק֣וֹר מׇשְׁחָ֑ת צַ֝דִּ֗יק מָ֣ט לִפְנֵֽי־רָשָֽׁע׃
verses.translit: m'yn nrpsh vmqvr mshcht tsdyq mt lpnyrsh'
verses.translation: As a troubled fountain, and a corrupted spring, So is a righteous man that giveth way before the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֘כֹ֤ל דְּבַ֣שׁ הַרְבּ֣וֹת לֹא־ט֑וֹב וְחֵ֖קֶר כְּבֹדָ֣ם כָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: 'khl dbsh hrbvt l'tvb vchqr khbdm khbvd
verses.translation: It is not good to eat much honey; So for men to search out their own glory is not glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִ֣יר פְּ֭רוּצָה אֵ֣ין חוֹמָ֑ה אִ֝֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵ֖ין מַעְצָ֣ר לְרוּחֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'yr prvtsh 'yn chvmh 'ysh 'shr 'yn m'tsr lrvchv
verses.translation: Like a city broken down and without a wall, So is he whose spirit is without restraint.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּשֶּׁ֤לֶג  בַּקַּ֗יִץ וְכַמָּטָ֥ר בַּקָּצִ֑יר כֵּ֤ן לֹֽא־נָאוֶ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל כָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: khshlg  bqyts vkhmtr bqtsyr khn l'n'vh lkhsyl khbvd
verses.translation: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, So honour is not seemly for a fool.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּצִּפּ֣וֹר לָ֭נוּד כַּדְּר֣וֹר לָע֑וּף כֵּ֥ן קִֽלְלַ֥ת חִ֝נָּ֗ם (לא) [ל֣וֹ] תָבֹֽא׃
verses.translit: khtspvr lnvd khdrvr l'vf khn qllt chnm (l') [lv] tb'
verses.translation: As the wandering sparrow, as the flying swallow, So the curse that is causeless shall come home. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁ֣וֹט לַ֭סּוּס מֶ֣תֶג לַחֲמ֑וֹר וְ֝שֵׁ֗בֶט לְגֵ֣ו כְּסִילִֽים׃
verses.translit: shvt lsvs mtg lchmvr vshbt lgv khsylym
verses.translation: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, And a rod for the back of fools.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּ֣עַן כְּ֭סִיל כְּאִוַּלְתּ֑וֹ פֶּֽן־תִּשְׁוֶה־לּ֥וֹ גַם־אָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: 'lt'n khsyl kh'vltv pntshvhlv gm'th
verses.translation: Answer not a fool according to his folly, Lest thou also be like unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲנֵ֣ה כְ֭סִיל כְּאִוַּלְתּ֑וֹ פֶּן־יִהְיֶ֖ה חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'nh khsyl kh'vltv pnyhyh chkhm b'ynyv
verses.translation: Answer a fool according to his folly, Lest he be wise in his own eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְקַצֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַיִם חָמָ֣ס שֹׁתֶ֑ה שֹׁלֵ֖חַ דְּבָרִ֣ים בְּיַד־כְּסִֽיל׃
verses.translit: mqtsh rglym chms shth shlch dbrym bydkhsyl
verses.translation: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool Cutteth off his own feet, and drinketh damage.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּלְי֣וּ שֹׁ֭קַיִם מִפִּסֵּ֑חַ וּ֝מָשָׁ֗ל בְּפִ֣י כְסִילִֽים׃
verses.translit: dlyv shqym mpsch vmshl bpy khsylym
verses.translation: The legs hang limp from the lame; So is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּצְר֣וֹר אֶ֭בֶן בְּמַרְגֵּמָ֑ה כֵּן־נוֹתֵ֖ן לִכְסִ֣יל כָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: khtsrvr 'bn bmrgmh khnnvtn lkhsyl khbvd
verses.translation: As a small stone in a heap of stones, So is he that giveth honour to a fool.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ח֭וֹחַ עָלָ֣ה בְיַד־שִׁכּ֑וֹר וּ֝מָשָׁ֗ל בְּפִ֣י כְסִילִֽים׃
verses.translit: chvch 'lh bydshkhvr vmshl bpy khsylym
verses.translation: As a thorn that cometh into the hand of a drunkard, So is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֥ב מְחוֹלֵֽל־כֹּ֑ל וְשֹׂכֵ֥ר כְּ֝סִ֗יל וְשֹׂכֵ֥ר עֹבְרִֽים׃
verses.translit: rb mchvllkhl vshkhr khsyl vshkhr 'brym
verses.translation: A master performeth all things; But he that stoppeth a fool is as one that stoppeth a flood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּ֭כֶלֶב שָׁ֣ב עַל־קֵא֑וֹ כְּ֝סִ֗יל שׁוֹנֶ֥ה בְאִוַּלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khkhlb shb 'lq'v khsyl shvnh b'vltv
verses.translation: As a dog that returneth to his vomit, So is a fool that repeateth his folly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאִ֗יתָ אִ֭ישׁ חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינָ֑יו תִּקְוָ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: r'yt 'ysh chkhm b'ynyv tqvh lkhsyl mmnv
verses.translation: Seest thou a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope of a fool than of him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר עָ֭צֵל שַׁ֣חַל בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ אֲ֝רִ֗י בֵּ֣ין הָרְחֹבֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'mr 'tsl shchl bdrkh 'ry byn hrchbvt
verses.translation: The sluggard saith: ‘There is a lion in the way; Yea, a lion is in the streets.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭דֶּלֶת תִּסּ֣וֹב עַל־צִירָ֑הּ וְ֝עָצֵ֗ל עַל־מִטָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hdlt tsvb 'ltsyrh v'tsl 'lmttv
verses.translation: The door is turning upon its hinges, And the sluggard is still upon his bed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טָ֘מַ֤ן עָצֵ֣ל יָ֭דוֹ בַּצַּלָּ֑חַת נִ֝לְאָ֗ה לַהֲשִׁיבָ֥הּ אֶל־פִּֽיו׃
verses.translit: tmn 'tsl ydv btslcht nl'h lhshybh 'lpyv
verses.translation: The sluggard burieth his hand in the dish; It wearieth him to bring it back to his mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָכָ֣ם עָצֵ֣ל בְּעֵינָ֑יו מִ֝שִּׁבְעָ֗ה מְשִׁ֣יבֵי טָֽעַם׃
verses.translit: chkhm 'tsl b'ynyv mshb'h mshyby t'm
verses.translation: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes Than seven men that give wise answer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַחֲזִ֥יק בְּאׇזְנֵי־כָ֑לֶב עֹבֵ֥ר מִ֝תְעַבֵּ֗ר עַל־רִ֥יב לֹּא־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mchzyq b'znykhlb 'br mt'br 'lryb l'lv
verses.translation: He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife not his own, Is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּֽ֭מִתְלַהְלֵהַּ הַיֹּרֶ֥ה זִקִּ֗ים חִצִּ֥ים וָמָֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: khmtlhlh hyrh zqym chtsym vmvt
verses.translation: As a madman who casteth firebrands, Arrows, and death;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּֽן־אִ֭ישׁ רִמָּ֣ה אֶת־רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝אָמַ֗ר הֲֽלֹא־מְשַׂחֵ֥ק אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: khn'ysh rmh 'tr'hv v'mr hl'mshchq 'ny
verses.translation: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, And saith: ‘Am not I in sport?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאֶ֣פֶס עֵ֭צִים תִּכְבֶּה־אֵ֑שׁ וּבְאֵ֥ין נִ֝רְגָּ֗ן יִשְׁתֹּ֥ק מָדֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: b'ps 'tsym tkhbh'sh vb'yn nrgn yshtq mdvn
verses.translation: Where no wood is, the fire goeth out; And where there is no whisperer, contention ceaseth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּחָ֣ם לְ֭גֶחָלִים וְעֵצִ֣ים לְאֵ֑שׁ וְאִ֥ישׁ (מדונים) [מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים] לְחַרְחַר־רִֽיב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: pchm lgchlym v'tsym l'sh v'ysh (mdvnym) [mdynym] lchrchrryb {p}
verses.translation: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; So is a contentious man to kindle strife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י נִ֭רְגָּן כְּמִֽתְלַהֲמִ֑ים וְ֝הֵ֗ם יָרְד֥וּ חַדְרֵי־בָֽטֶן׃
verses.translit: dbry nrgn khmtlhmym vhm yrdv chdrybtn
verses.translation: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, And they go down into the innermost parts of the body.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֶּ֣סֶף סִ֭יגִים מְצֻפֶּ֣ה עַל־חָ֑רֶשׂ שְׂפָתַ֖יִם דֹּלְקִ֣ים וְלֶב־רָֽע׃
verses.translit: khsf sygym mtsph 'lchrsh shptym dlqym vlbr'
verses.translation: Burning lips and a wicked heart Are like an earthen vessel overlaid with silver dross.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּ֭שְׂפָתָו יִנָּכֵ֣ר שׂוֹנֵ֑א וּ֝בְקִרְבּ֗וֹ יָשִׁ֥ית מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: bshptv ynkhr shvn' vbqrbv yshyt mrmh
verses.translation: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, But he layeth up deceit within him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יְחַנֵּ֣ן ק֭וֹלוֹ אַל־תַּאֲמֶן־בּ֑וֹ כִּ֤י שֶׁ֖בַע תּוֹעֵב֣וֹת בְּלִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khyychnn qvlv 'lt'mnbv khy shb' tv'bvt blbv
verses.translation: When he speaketh fair, Believe him not; For there are seven abominations in his heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּכַּסֶּ֣ה שִׂ֭נְאָה בְּמַשָּׁא֑וֹן תִּגָּלֶ֖ה רָעָת֣וֹ בְקָהָֽל׃
verses.translit: tkhsh shn'h bmsh'vn tglh r'tv bqhl
verses.translation: Though his hatred be concealed with deceit, His wickedness shall be revealed before the congregation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּֽרֶה־שַּׁ֭חַת בָּ֣הּ יִפּ֑וֹל וְג֥וֹלֵֽל אֶ֝֗בֶן אֵלָ֥יו תָּשֽׁוּב׃
verses.translit: khrhshcht bh ypvl vgvll 'bn 'lyv tshvb
verses.translation: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein; And he that rolleth a stone, it shall return upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְֽשׁוֹן־שֶׁ֭קֶר יִשְׂנָ֣א דַכָּ֑יו וּפֶ֥ה חָ֝לָ֗ק יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה מִדְחֶֽה׃
verses.translit: lshvnshqr yshn' dkhyv vph chlq y'shh mdchh
verses.translation: A lying tongue hateth those that are crushed by it; And a flattering mouth worketh ruin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַֽל־תִּ֭תְהַלֵּל בְּי֣וֹם מָחָ֑ר כִּ֤י לֹֽא־תֵ֝דַ֗ע מַה־יֵּ֥לֶד יֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: 'ltthll byvm mchr khy l'td' mhyld yvm
verses.translation: Boast not thyself of to- morrow; For thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהַלֶּלְךָ֣ זָ֣ר וְלֹא־פִ֑יךָ נׇ֝כְרִ֗י וְאַל־שְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: yhllkh zr vl'pykh nkhry v'lshptykh
verses.translation: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; A stranger, and not thine own lips.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּֽבֶד־אֶ֭בֶן וְנֵ֣טֶל הַח֑וֹל וְכַ֥עַס אֱ֝וִ֗יל כָּבֵ֥ד מִשְּׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khbd'bn vntl hchvl vkh's 'vyl khbd mshnyhm
verses.translation: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; But a fool’s vexation is heavier than they both.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַכְזְרִיּ֣וּת חֵ֭מָה וְשֶׁ֣טֶף אָ֑ף וּמִ֥י יַ֝עֲמֹ֗ד לִפְנֵ֥י קִנְאָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'khzryvt chmh vshtf 'f vmy y'md lpny qn'h
verses.translation: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; But who is able to stand before jealousy?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֭וֹבָה תּוֹכַ֣חַת מְגֻלָּ֑ה מֵאַהֲבָ֥ה מְסֻתָּֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: tvbh tvkhcht mglh m'hbh mstrt
verses.translation: Better is open rebuke Than love that is hidden.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֶ֭אֱמָנִים פִּצְעֵ֣י אוֹהֵ֑ב וְ֝נַעְתָּר֗וֹת נְשִׁיק֥וֹת שׂוֹנֵֽא׃
verses.translit: n'mnym pts'y 'vhb vn'trvt nshyqvt shvn'
verses.translation: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; But the kisses of an enemy are importunate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֶ֣פֶשׁ שְׂ֭בֵעָה תָּב֣וּס נֹ֑פֶת וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ רְ֝עֵבָ֗ה כׇּל־מַ֥ר מָתֽוֹק׃
verses.translit: npsh shb'h tbvs npt vnpsh r'bh khlmr mtvq
verses.translation: The full soul loatheth a honeycomb; But to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּ֭צִפּוֹר נוֹדֶ֣דֶת מִן־קִנָּ֑הּ כֵּֽן־אִ֝֗ישׁ נוֹדֵ֥ד מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khtspvr nvddt mnqnh khn'ysh nvdd mmqvmv
verses.translation: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, So is a man that wandereth from his place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁ֣מֶן וּ֭קְטֹרֶת יְשַׂמַּֽח־לֵ֑ב וּמֶ֥תֶק רֵ֝עֵ֗הוּ מֵעֲצַת־נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: shmn vqtrt yshmchlb vmtq r'hv m'tstnpsh
verses.translation: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart; So doth the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֵ֥עֲךָ֨ (ורעה) [וְרֵ֪עַ] אָבִ֡יךָ אַֽל־תַּעֲזֹ֗ב וּבֵ֥ית אָחִ֗יךָ אַל־תָּ֭בוֹא בְּי֣וֹם אֵידֶ֑ךָ ט֥וֹב שָׁכֵ֥ן קָ֝ר֗וֹב מֵאָ֥ח רָחֽוֹק׃
verses.translit: r'kh (vr'h) [vr'] 'bykh 'lt'zb vbyt 'chykh 'ltbv' byvm 'ydkh tvb shkhn qrvb m'ch rchvq
verses.translation: Thine own friend, and thy father’s friend, forsake not; Neither go into thy brother’s house in the day of thy calamity; Better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲכַ֣ם בְּ֭נִי וְשַׂמַּ֣ח לִבִּ֑י וְאָשִׁ֖יבָה חֹרְפִ֣י דָבָֽר׃
verses.translit: chkhm bny vshmch lby v'shybh chrpy dbr
verses.translation: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, That I may answer him that taunteth me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָר֤וּם  רָאָ֣ה רָעָ֣ה נִסְתָּ֑ר פְּ֝תָאיִ֗ם עָבְר֥וּ נֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: 'rvm  r'h r'h nstr pt'ym 'brv n'nshv
verses.translation: A prudent man seeth the evil, and hideth himself; But the thoughtless pass on, and are punished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קַח־בִּ֭גְדוֹ כִּי־עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וּבְעַ֖ד נׇכְרִיָּ֣ה חַבְלֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: qchbgdv khy'rb zr vb'd nkhryh chblhv
verses.translation: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger; And hold him in pledge that is surety for an alien woman.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְבָ֘רֵ֤ךְ רֵעֵ֨הוּ  בְּק֣וֹל גָּ֭דוֹל בַּבֹּ֣קֶר הַשְׁכֵּ֑ים קְ֝לָלָ֗ה תֵּחָ֥שֶׁב לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mbrkh r'hv  bqvl gdvl bbqr hshkhym qllh tchshb lv
verses.translation: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, It shall be counted a curse to him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דֶּ֣לֶף ט֭וֹרֵד בְּי֣וֹם סַגְרִ֑יר וְאֵ֥שֶׁת (מדונים) [מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים] נִשְׁתָּוָֽה׃
verses.translit: dlf tvrd byvm sgryr v'sht (mdvnym) [mdynym] nshtvh
verses.translation: A continual dropping in a very rainy day And a contentious woman are alike;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צֹפְנֶ֥יהָ צָפַן־ר֑וּחַ וְשֶׁ֖מֶן יְמִינ֣וֹ יִקְרָֽא׃
verses.translit: tspnyh tspnrvch vshmn ymynv yqr'
verses.translation: He that would hide her hideth the wind, And the ointment of his right hand betrayeth itself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּרְזֶ֣ל בְּבַרְזֶ֣ל יָ֑חַד וְ֝אִ֗ישׁ יַ֣חַד פְּנֵֽי־רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: brzl bbrzl ychd v'ysh ychd pnyr'hv
verses.translation: Iron sharpeneth iron; So a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֹצֵ֣ר תְּ֭אֵנָה יֹאכַ֣ל פִּרְיָ֑הּ וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣יו יְכֻבָּֽד׃
verses.translit: ntsr t'nh y'khl pryh vshmr 'dnyv ykhbd
verses.translation: Whoso keepeth the fig-tree shall eat the fruit thereof; And he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּ֭מַּיִם הַפָּנִ֣ים לַפָּנִ֑ים כֵּ֤ן לֵֽב־הָ֝אָדָ֗ם לָאָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: khmym hpnym lpnym khn lbh'dm l'dm
verses.translation: As in water face answereth to face, So the heart of man to man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁא֣וֹל וַ֭אֲבַדֹּה לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּ֑עְנָה וְעֵינֵ֥י הָ֝אָדָ֗ם לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּֽעְנָה׃
verses.translit: sh'vl v'bdh l' tshb'nh v'yny h'dm l' tshb'nh
verses.translation: The nether-world and Destruction are never satiated; So the eyes of man are never satiated.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַצְרֵ֣ף לַ֭כֶּסֶף וְכ֣וּר לַזָּהָ֑ב וְ֝אִ֗ישׁ לְפִ֣י מַהֲלָלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mtsrf lkhsf vkhvr lzhb v'ysh lpy mhllv
verses.translation: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, And a man is tried by his praise.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֥ם־תִּכְתּֽוֹשׁ־אֶת־הָאֱוִ֨יל  בַּ֥מַּכְתֵּ֡שׁ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָ֭רִיפוֹת בַּעֱלִ֑י לֹא־תָס֥וּר מֵ֝עָלָ֗יו אִוַּלְתּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'mtkhtvsh'th'vyl  bmkhtsh btvkh hrypvt b'ly l'tsvr m'lyv 'vltv {p}
verses.translation: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar with a pestle among groats, Yet will not his foolishness depart from him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָדֹ֣עַ תֵּ֭דַע פְּנֵ֣י צֹאנֶ֑ךָ שִׁ֥ית לִ֝בְּךָ֗ לַעֲדָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: yd' td' pny ts'nkh shyt lbkh l'drym
verses.translation: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, And look well to thy herds;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א לְעוֹלָ֣ם חֹ֑סֶן וְאִם־נֵ֝֗זֶר לְד֣וֹר (דור) [וָדֽוֹר]׃
verses.translit: khy l' l'vlm chsn v'mnzr ldvr (dvr) [vdvr]
verses.translation: For riches are not for ever; And doth the crown endure unto all generations?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גָּלָ֣ה חָ֭צִיר וְנִרְאָה־דֶ֑שֶׁא וְ֝נֶאֶסְפ֗וּ עִשְּׂב֥וֹת הָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: glh chtsyr vnr'hdsh' vn'spv 'shbvt hrym
verses.translation: When the hay is mown, and the tender grass showeth itself, And the herbs of the mountains are gathered in;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּבָשִׂ֥ים לִלְבוּשֶׁ֑ךָ וּמְחִ֥יר שָׂ֝דֶ֗ה עַתּוּדִֽים׃
verses.translit: khbshym llbvshkh vmchyr shdh 'tvdym
verses.translation: The lambs will be for thy clothing, And the goats the price for a field. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדֵ֤י  חֲלֵ֬ב עִזִּ֗ים לְֽ֭לַחְמְךָ לְלֶ֣חֶם בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וְ֝חַיִּ֗ים לְנַעֲרוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vdy  chlb 'zym llchmkh llchm bytkh vchyym ln'rvtykh
verses.translation: And there will be goats’milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household; And maintenance for thy maidens.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָ֣סוּ וְאֵין־רֹדֵ֣ף רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝צַדִּיקִ֗ים כִּכְפִ֥יר יִבְטָֽח׃
verses.translit: nsv v'ynrdf rsh' vtsdyqym khkhpyr ybtch
verses.translation: The wicked flee when no man pursueth; But the righteous are secure as a young lion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּפֶ֣שַֽׁע אֶ֭רֶץ רַבִּ֣ים שָׂרֶ֑יהָ וּבְאָדָ֥ם מֵבִ֥ין יֹ֝דֵ֗עַ כֵּ֣ן יַאֲרִֽיךְ׃
verses.translit: bpsh' 'rts rbym shryh vb'dm mbyn yd' khn y'rykh
verses.translation: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof; But by a man of understanding and knowledge established order shall long continue.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֶּֽבֶר־רָ֭שׁ וְעֹשֵׁ֣ק דַּלִּ֑ים מָטָ֥ר סֹ֝חֵ֗ף וְאֵ֣ין לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translit: gbrrsh v'shq dlym mtr schf v'yn lchm
verses.translation: A poor man that oppresseth the weak Is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹזְבֵ֣י ת֭וֹרָה יְהַלְל֣וּ רָשָׁ֑ע וְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י ת֝וֹרָ֗ה יִתְגָּ֥רוּ בָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'zby tvrh yhllv rsh' vshmry tvrh ytgrv bm {p}
verses.translation: They that forsake the law praise the wicked; But such as keep the law contend with them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁי־רָ֭ע לֹא־יָבִ֣ינוּ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּמְבַקְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה יָבִ֥ינוּ כֹֽל׃
verses.translit: 'nshyr' l'ybynv mshpt vmbqshy yhvh ybynv khl
verses.translation: Evil men understand not justice; But they that seek the LORD understand all things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טֽוֹב־רָ֭שׁ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֑וֹ מֵעִקֵּ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכַ֗יִם וְה֣וּא עָשִֽׁיר׃
verses.translit: tvbrsh hvlkh btmv m'qsh drkhym vhv' 'shyr
verses.translation: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, Than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נוֹצֵ֣ר תּ֭וֹרָה בֵּ֣ן מֵבִ֑ין וְרֹעֶ֥ה ז֝וֹלְלִ֗ים יַכְלִ֥ים אָבִֽיו׃
verses.translit: nvtsr tvrh bn mbyn vr'h zvllym ykhlym 'byv
verses.translation: A wise son observeth the teaching; But he that is a companion of gluttonous men shameth his father.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַרְבֶּ֣ה ה֭וֹנוֹ בְּנֶ֣שֶׁךְ (ובתרבית) [וְתַרְבִּ֑ית] לְחוֹנֵ֖ן דַּלִּ֣ים יִקְבְּצֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: mrbh hvnv bnshkh (vbtrbyt) [vtrbyt] lchvnn dlym yqbtsnv
verses.translation: He that augmenteth his substance by interest and increase, Gathereth it for him that is gracious to the poor.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵסִ֣יר אׇ֭זְנוֹ מִשְּׁמֹ֣עַ תּוֹרָ֑ה גַּ֥ם תְּ֝פִלָּת֗וֹ תּוֹעֵבָֽה׃
verses.translit: msyr 'znv mshm' tvrh gm tpltv tv'bh
verses.translation: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, Even his prayer is an abomination.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשְׁגֶּ֤ה יְשָׁרִ֨ים  בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ רָ֗ע בִּשְׁחוּת֥וֹ הֽוּא־יִפּ֑וֹל וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים יִנְחֲלוּ־טֽוֹב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: mshgh yshrym  bdrkh r' bshchvtv hv'ypvl vtmymym ynchlvtvb {p}
verses.translation: Whoso causeth the upright to go astray in an evil way, He shall fall himself into his own pit; But the whole-hearted shall inherit good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָכָ֣ם בְּ֭עֵינָיו אִ֣ישׁ עָשִׁ֑יר וְדַ֖ל מֵבִ֣ין יַחְקְרֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: chkhm b'ynyv 'ysh 'shyr vdl mbyn ychqrnv
verses.translation: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; But the poor that hath understanding searcheth him through.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּעֲלֹ֣ץ צַ֭דִּיקִים רַבָּ֣ה תִפְאָ֑רֶת וּבְק֥וּם רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְחֻפַּ֥שׂ אָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: b'lts tsdyqym rbh tp'rt vbqvm rsh'ym ychpsh 'dm
verses.translation: When the righteous exult, there is great glory; But when the wicked rise, men must be sought for.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְכַסֶּ֣ה פְ֭שָׁעָיו לֹ֣א יַצְלִ֑יחַ וּמוֹדֶ֖ה וְעֹזֵ֣ב יְרֻחָֽם׃
verses.translit: mkhsh psh'yv l' ytslych vmvdh v'zb yrchm
verses.translation: He that covereth his transgressions shall not prosper; But whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall obtain mercy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם מְפַחֵ֣ד תָּמִ֑יד וּמַקְשֶׁ֥ה לִ֝בּ֗וֹ יִפּ֥וֹל בְּרָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'shry 'dm mpchd tmyd vmqshh lbv ypvl br'h
verses.translation: Happy is the man that feareth alway; But he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲֽרִי־נֹ֭הֵם וְדֹ֣ב שׁוֹקֵ֑ק מוֹשֵׁ֥ל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע עַ֣ל עַם־דָּֽל׃
verses.translit: 'rynhm vdb shvqq mvshl rsh' 'l 'mdl
verses.translation: As a roaring lion, and a ravenous bear; So is a wicked ruler over a poor people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָגִ֗יד חֲסַ֣ר תְּ֭בוּנוֹת וְרַ֥ב מַעֲשַׁקּ֑וֹת (שנאי) [שֹׂ֥נֵא] בֶ֝֗צַע יַאֲרִ֥יךְ יָמִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: ngyd chsr tbvnvt vrb m'shqvt (shn'y) [shn'] bts' y'rykh ymym {p}
verses.translation: The prince that lacketh understanding is also a great oppressor; But he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֭דָם עָשֻׁ֣ק בְּדַם־נָ֑פֶשׁ עַד־בּ֥וֹר יָ֝נ֗וּס אַל־יִתְמְכוּ־בֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'dm 'shq bdmnpsh 'dbvr ynvs 'lytmkhvbv
verses.translation: A man that is laden with the blood of any person Shall hasten his steps unto the pit; none will support him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ תָּ֭מִים יִוָּשֵׁ֑עַ וְנֶעְקַ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכַ֗יִם יִפּ֥וֹל בְּאֶחָֽת׃
verses.translit: hvlkh tmym yvsh' vn'qsh drkhym ypvl b'cht
verses.translation: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved; But he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹבֵ֣ד אַ֭דְמָתוֹ יִֽשְׂבַּֽע־לָ֑חֶם וּמְרַדֵּ֥ף רֵ֝יקִ֗ים יִֽשְׂבַּֽע־רִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: 'bd 'dmtv yshb'lchm vmrdf ryqym yshb'rysh
verses.translation: He that tilleth his ground shall have plenty of bread; But he that followeth after vain things shall have poverty enough.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ אֱ֭מוּנוֹת רַב־בְּרָכ֑וֹת וְאָ֥ץ לְ֝הַעֲשִׁ֗יר לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃
verses.translit: 'ysh 'mvnvt rbbrkhvt v'ts lh'shyr l' ynqh
verses.translation: A faithful man shall abound with blessings; But he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be unpunished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽכֵּר־פָּנִ֥ים לֹא־ט֑וֹב וְעַל־פַּת־לֶ֝֗חֶם יִפְשַׁע־גָּֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: hkhrpnym l'tvb v'lptlchm ypsh'gbr
verses.translation: To have respect of persons is not good; For a man will transgress for a piece of bread.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִ֥בְהָֽל־לַה֗וֹן אִ֭ישׁ רַ֣ע עָ֑יִן וְלֹא־יֵ֝דַ֗ע כִּי־חֶ֥סֶר יְבֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: nbhllhvn 'ysh r' 'yn vl'yd' khychsr yb'nv
verses.translation: He that hath an evil eye hasteneth after riches, And knoweth not that want shall come upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מ֘וֹכִ֤יחַ אָדָ֣ם אַ֭חֲרַי חֵ֣ן יִמְצָ֑א מִֽמַּחֲלִ֥יק לָשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.translit: mvkhych 'dm 'chry chn ymts' mmchlyq lshvn
verses.translation: He that rebuketh a man shall in the end find more favour Than he that flattereth with the tongue.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גּוֹזֵ֤ל  אָ֘בִ֤יו וְאִמּ֗וֹ וְאֹמֵ֥ר אֵֽין־פָּ֑שַׁע חָבֵ֥ר ה֝֗וּא לְאִ֣ישׁ מַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.translit: gvzl  'byv v'mv v'mr 'ynpsh' chbr hv' l'ysh mshchyt
verses.translation: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith: ‘It is no transgression’, The same is the companion of a destroyer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְחַב־נֶ֭פֶשׁ יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וּבֹטֵ֖חַ עַל־יְהֹוָ֣ה יְדֻשָּֽׁן׃
verses.translit: rchbnpsh ygrh mdvn vbtch 'lyhvh ydshn
verses.translation: He that is of a greedy spirit stirreth up strife; But he that putteth his trust in the LORD shall be abundantly gratified.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בּוֹטֵ֣חַ בְּ֭לִבּוֹ ה֣וּא כְסִ֑יל וְהוֹלֵ֥ךְ בְּ֝חׇכְמָ֗ה ה֣וּא יִמָּלֵֽט׃
verses.translit: bvtch blbv hv' khsyl vhvlkh bchkhmh hv' ymlt
verses.translation: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool; But whoso walketh wisely, he shall escape.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נוֹתֵ֣ן לָ֭רָשׁ אֵ֣ין מַחְס֑וֹר וּמַעְלִ֥ים עֵ֝ינָ֗יו רַב־מְאֵרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: nvtn lrsh 'yn mchsvr vm'lym 'ynyv rbm'rvt
verses.translation: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack; But he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּק֣וּם רְ֭שָׁעִים יִסָּתֵ֣ר אָדָ֑ם וּ֝בְאׇבְדָ֗ם יִרְבּ֥וּ צַדִּיקִֽים׃
verses.translit: bqvm rsh'ym ystr 'dm vb'bdm yrbv tsdyqym
verses.translation: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; But when they perish, the righteous increase.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ תּ֭וֹכָחוֹת מַקְשֶׁה־עֹ֑רֶף פֶּ֥תַע יִ֝שָּׁבֵ֗ר וְאֵ֣ין מַרְפֵּֽא׃
verses.translit: 'ysh tvkhchvt mqshh'rf pt' yshbr v'yn mrp'
verses.translation: He that being often reproved hardeneth his neck Shall suddenly be broken, and that without remedy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּרְב֣וֹת צַ֭דִּיקִים יִשְׂמַ֣ח הָעָ֑ם וּבִמְשֹׁ֥ל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע יֵאָ֥נַֽח עָֽם׃
verses.translit: brbvt tsdyqym yshmch h'm vbmshl rsh' y'nch 'm
verses.translation: When the righteous are increased, the people rejoice; but when the wicked beareth rule, the people sigh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִישׁ־אֹהֵ֣ב חׇ֭כְמָה יְשַׂמַּ֣ח אָבִ֑יו וְרֹעֶ֥ה ז֝וֹנ֗וֹת יְאַבֶּד־הֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: 'ysh'hb chkhmh yshmch 'byv vr'h zvnvt y'bdhvn
verses.translation: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father; but he that keepeth company with harlots wasteth his substance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֗לֶךְ בְּ֭מִשְׁפָּט יַעֲמִ֣יד אָ֑רֶץ וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּרוּמ֣וֹת יֶהֶרְסֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: mlkh bmshpt y'myd 'rts v'ysh trvmvt yhrsnh
verses.translation: The king by justice establisheth the land; but he that exacteth gifts overthroweth it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֶּ֭בֶר מַחֲלִ֣יק עַל־רֵעֵ֑הוּ רֶ֝֗שֶׁת פּוֹרֵ֥שׂ עַל־פְּעָמָֽיו׃
verses.translit: gbr mchlyq 'lr'hv rsht pvrsh 'lp'myv
verses.translation: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his steps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּפֶ֤שַֽׁע אִ֣ישׁ רָ֣ע מוֹקֵ֑שׁ וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק יָר֥וּן וְשָׂמֵֽחַ׃
verses.translit: bpsh' 'ysh r' mvqsh vtsdyq yrvn vshmch
verses.translation: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare; but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֹדֵ֣עַ צַ֭דִּיק דִּ֣ין דַּלִּ֑ים רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לֹא־יָבִ֥ין דָּֽעַת׃
verses.translit: yd' tsdyq dyn dlym rsh' l'ybyn d't
verses.translation: The righteous taketh knowledge of the cause of the poor; the wicked understandeth not knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י לָ֭צוֹן יָפִ֣יחוּ קִרְיָ֑ה וַ֝חֲכָמִ֗ים יָשִׁ֥יבוּ אָֽף׃
verses.translit: 'nshy ltsvn ypychv qryh vchkhmym yshybv 'f
verses.translation: Scornful men set a city in a blaze; But wise men turn away wrath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִֽישׁ־חָכָ֗ם נִ֭שְׁפָּט אֶת־אִ֣ישׁ אֱוִ֑יל וְרָגַ֥ז וְ֝שָׂחַ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין נָֽחַת׃
verses.translit: 'yshchkhm nshpt 't'ysh 'vyl vrgz vshchq v'yn ncht
verses.translation: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, Whether he be angry or laugh, there will be no rest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י דָ֭מִים יִשְׂנְאוּ־תָ֑ם וִ֝ישָׁרִ֗ים יְבַקְשׁ֥וּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'nshy dmym yshn'vtm vyshrym ybqshv npshv
verses.translation: The men of blood hate him that is sincere; And as for the upright, they seek his life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־ר֭וּחוֹ יוֹצִ֣יא כְסִ֑יל וְ֝חָכָ֗ם בְּאָח֥וֹר יְשַׁבְּחֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: khlrvchv yvtsy' khsyl vchkhm b'chvr yshbchnh
verses.translation: A fool spendeth all his spirit; But a wise man stilleth it within him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֹ֭שֵׁל מַקְשִׁ֣יב עַל־דְּבַר־שָׁ֑קֶר כׇּֽל־מְשָׁרְתָ֥יו רְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.translit: mshl mqshyb 'ldbrshqr khlmshrtyv rsh'ym
verses.translation: If a ruler hearkeneth to falsehood, All his servants are wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָ֤שׁ וְאִ֣ישׁ תְּכָכִ֣ים נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ מֵ֤אִיר־עֵינֵ֖י שְׁנֵיהֶ֣ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: rsh v'ysh tkhkhym npgshv m'yr'yny shnyhm yhvh
verses.translation: The poor man and the oppressor meet together; The LORD giveth light to the eyes of them both.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ שׁוֹפֵ֣ט בֶּאֱמֶ֣ת דַּלִּ֑ים כִּ֝סְא֗וֹ לָעַ֥ד יִכּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: mlkh shvpt b'mt dlym khs'v l'd ykhvn
verses.translation: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, His throne shall be established for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֵׁ֣בֶט וְ֭תוֹכַחַת יִתֵּ֣ן חׇכְמָ֑ה וְנַ֥עַר מְ֝שֻׁלָּ֗ח מֵבִ֥ישׁ אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: shbt vtvkhcht ytn chkhmh vn'r mshlch mbysh 'mv
verses.translation: The rod and reproof give wisdom; But a child left to himself causeth shame to his mother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּרְב֣וֹת רְ֭שָׁעִים יִרְבֶּה־פָּ֑שַׁע וְ֝צַדִּיקִ֗ים בְּֽמַפַּלְתָּ֥ם יִרְאֽוּ׃
verses.translit: brbvt rsh'ym yrbhpsh' vtsdyqym bmpltm yr'v
verses.translation: When the wicked are increased, transgression increaseth; But the righteous shall gaze upon their fall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְךָ וִינִיחֶ֑ךָ וְיִתֵּ֖ן מַעֲדַנִּ֣ים לְנַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: ysr bnkh vynychkh vytn m'dnym lnpshkh {p}
verses.translation: Correct thy son, and he will give thee rest; Yea, he will give delight unto thy soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאֵ֣ין חָ֭זוֹן יִפָּ֣רַֽע עָ֑ם וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹרָ֣ה אַשְׁרֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: b'yn chzvn ypr' 'm vshmr tvrh 'shrhv
verses.translation: Where there is no vision, the people cast off restraint; But he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּ֭דְבָרִים לֹא־יִוָּ֣סֶר עָ֑בֶד כִּי־יָ֝בִ֗ין וְאֵ֣ין מַעֲנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: bdbrym l'yvsr 'bd khyybyn v'yn m'nh
verses.translation: A servant will not be corrected by words; For though he understand, there will be no response.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָזִ֗יתָ אִ֭ישׁ אָ֣ץ בִּדְבָרָ֑יו תִּקְוָ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: chzyt 'ysh 'ts bdbryv tqvh lkhsyl mmnv
verses.translation: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְפַנֵּ֣ק מִנֹּ֣עַר עַבְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝אַחֲרִית֗וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה מָנֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: mpnq mn'r 'bdv v'chrytv yhyh mnvn
verses.translation: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child Shall have him become master at the last.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִֽישׁ־אַ֭ף יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וּבַ֖עַל חֵמָ֣ה רַב־פָּֽשַׁע׃
verses.translit: 'ysh'f ygrh mdvn vb'l chmh rbpsh'
verses.translation: An angry man stirreth up strife, And a wrathful man aboundeth in transgression.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּאֲוַ֣ת אָ֭דָם תַּשְׁפִּילֶ֑נּוּ וּשְׁפַל־ר֝֗וּחַ יִתְמֹ֥ךְ כָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: g'vt 'dm tshpylnv vshplrvch ytmkh khbvd
verses.translation: A man’s pride shall bring him low; but he that is of a lowly spirit shall attain to honour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חוֹלֵ֣ק עִם־גַּ֭נָּב שׂוֹנֵ֣א נַפְשׁ֑וֹ אָלָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע וְלֹ֣א יַגִּֽיד׃
verses.translit: chvlq 'mgnb shvn' npshv 'lh yshm' vl' ygyd
verses.translation: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: He heareth the adjuration and uttereth nothing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶרְדַּ֣ת אָ֭דָם יִתֵּ֣ן מוֹקֵ֑שׁ וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּיהֹוָ֣ה יְשֻׂגָּֽב׃
verses.translit: chrdt 'dm ytn mvqsh vbvtch byhvh yshgb
verses.translation: The fear of man bringeth a snare; but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be set up on high.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֭בִּים מְבַקְשִׁ֣ים פְּנֵֽי־מוֹשֵׁ֑ל וּ֝מֵיְהֹוָ֗ה מִשְׁפַּט־אִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: rbym mbqshym pnymvshl vmyhvh mshpt'ysh
verses.translation: Many seek the ruler’s favour; but a man’s judgment cometh from the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת צַ֭דִּיקִים אִ֣ישׁ עָ֑וֶל וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע יְשַׁר־דָּֽרֶךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: tv'bt tsdyqym 'ysh 'vl vtv'bt rsh' yshrdrkh {p}
verses.translation: An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous; and he that is upright in the way is an abomination to the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֤י  אָג֥וּר בִּן־יָקֶ֗ה הַמַּ֫שָּׂ֥א נְאֻ֣ם הַ֭גֶּבֶר לְאִיתִיאֵ֑ל לְאִ֖יתִיאֵ֣ל וְאֻכָֽל׃
verses.translit: dbry  'gvr bnyqh hmsh' n'm hgbr l'yty'l l'yty'l v'khl
verses.translation: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh; the burden. The man saith unto Ithiel, unto Ithiel and Ucal:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י בַ֣עַר אָנֹכִ֣י מֵאִ֑ישׁ וְלֹֽא־בִינַ֖ת אָדָ֣ם לִֽי׃
verses.translit: khy b'r 'nkhy m'ysh vl'bynt 'dm ly
verses.translation: Surely I am brutish, unlike a man, And have not the understanding of a man;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־לָמַ֥דְתִּי חׇכְמָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת קְדֹשִׁ֣ים אֵדָֽע׃
verses.translit: vl'lmdty chkhmh vd't qdshym 'd'
verses.translation: And I have not learned wisdom, That I should have the knowledge of the Holy One.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֤י עָלָֽה־שָׁמַ֨יִם  וַיֵּרַ֡ד מִ֤י אָֽסַף־ר֨וּחַ  בְּחׇפְנָ֡יו מִ֤י צָֽרַר־מַ֨יִם  בַּשִּׂמְלָ֗ה מִ֭י הֵקִ֣ים כׇּל־אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ מַה־שְּׁמ֥וֹ וּמַֽה־שֶּׁם־בְּ֝נ֗וֹ כִּ֣י תֵדָֽע׃
verses.translit: my 'lhshmym  vyrd my 'sfrvch  bchpnyv my tsrrmym  bshmlh my hqym khl'psy'rts mhshmv vmhshmbnv khy td'
verses.translation: Who hath ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who hath gathered the wind in his fists? Who hath bound the waters in his garment? Who hath established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if thou knowest?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־אִמְרַ֣ת אֱל֣וֹהַּ צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khl'mrt 'lvh tsrvph mgn hv' lchsym bv
verses.translation: Every word of God is tried; He is a shield unto them that take refuge in Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תּ֥וֹסְףְּ עַל־דְּבָרָ֑יו פֶּן־יוֹכִ֖יחַ בְּךָ֣ וְנִכְזָֽבְתָּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'ltvsf 'ldbryv pnyvkhych bkh vnkhzbt {p}
verses.translation: Add thou not unto His words, Lest He reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁ֭תַּיִם שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵאִתָּ֑ךְ אַל־תִּמְנַ֥ע מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי בְּטֶ֣רֶם אָמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: shtym sh'lty m'tkh 'ltmn' mmny btrm 'mvt
verses.translation: Two things have I asked of Thee; Deny me them not before I die:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֤וְא  וּֽדְבַר־כָּזָ֡ב הַרְחֵ֬ק מִמֶּ֗נִּי רֵ֣אשׁ וָ֭עֹשֶׁר אַל־תִּֽתֶּן־לִ֑י הַ֝טְרִיפֵ֗נִי לֶ֣חֶם חֻקִּֽי׃
verses.translit: shv'  vdbrkhzb hrchq mmny r'sh v'shr 'lttnly htrypny lchm chqy
verses.translation: Remove far from me falsehood and lies; Give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with mine allotted bread;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּ֥ן־אֶשְׂבַּ֨ע  וְכִחַשְׁתִּי֮ וְאָמַ֗רְתִּי מִ֥י־יְ֫הֹוָ֥ה וּפֶֽן־אִוָּרֵ֥שׁ וְגָנַ֑בְתִּי וְ֝תָפַ֗שְׂתִּי שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהָֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: pn'shb'  vkhchshty v'mrty myyhvh vpn'vrsh vgnbty vtpshty shm 'lhy {p}
verses.translation: Lest I be full, and deny, and say: ‘Who is the LORD?’ Or lest I be poor, and steal, And profane the name of my God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּלְשֵׁ֣ן עֶ֭בֶד אֶל־אֲדֹנָ֑ו פֶּֽן־יְקַלֶּלְךָ֥ וְאָשָֽׁמְתָּ׃
verses.translit: 'ltlshn 'bd 'l'dnv pnyqllkh v'shmt
verses.translation: Slander not a servant unto his master, Lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דּ֭וֹר אָבִ֣יו יְקַלֵּ֑ל וְאֶת־אִ֝מּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְבָרֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: dvr 'byv yqll v't'mv l' ybrkh
verses.translation: There is a generation that curse their father, And do not bless their mother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דּ֭וֹר טָה֣וֹר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וּ֝מִצֹּאָת֗וֹ לֹ֣א רֻחָֽץ׃
verses.translit: dvr thvr b'ynyv vmts'tv l' rchts
verses.translation: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, And yet are not washed from their filthiness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דּ֭וֹר מָה־רָמ֣וּ עֵינָ֑יו וְ֝עַפְעַפָּ֗יו יִנָּשֵֽׂאוּ׃
verses.translit: dvr mhrmv 'ynyv v'p'pyv ynsh'v
verses.translation: There is a generation, Oh how lofty are their eyes! And their eyelids are lifted up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דּ֤וֹר  חֲרָב֣וֹת שִׁנָּיו֮ וּֽמַאֲכָל֢וֹת מְֽתַלְּעֹ֫תָ֥יו לֶאֱכֹ֣ל עֲנִיִּ֣ים מֵאֶ֑רֶץ וְ֝אֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים מֵאָדָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: dvr  chrbvt shnyv vm'khlvt mtl'tyv l'khl 'nyym m'rts v'byvnym m'dm {p}
verses.translation: There is a generation whose teeth are as swords, and their great teeth as knives, To devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַ֥עֲלוּקָ֨ה  שְׁתֵּ֥י בָנוֹת֮ הַ֤ב  הַ֥֫ב שָׁל֣וֹשׁ הֵ֭נָּה לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּ֑עְנָה אַ֝רְבַּ֗ע לֹא־אָ֥מְרוּ הֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: l'lvqh  shty bnvt hb  hb shlvsh hnh l' tshb'nh 'rb' l''mrv hvn
verses.translation: The horseleech hath two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ There are three things that are never satisfied, Yea, four that say not: ‘Enough’:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁאוֹל֮ וְעֹ֢צֶ֫ר רָ֥חַם אֶ֭רֶץ לֹא־שָׂ֣בְעָה מַּ֑יִם וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ לֹא־אָ֥מְרָה הֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: sh'vl v'tsr rchm 'rts l'shb'h mym v'sh l''mrh hvn
verses.translation: The grave; and the barren womb; The earth that is not satisfied with water; And the fire that saith not: ‘Enough.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֤יִן  תִּ֥לְעַ֣ג לְאָב֮ וְתָבֻ֢ז לִֽיקְּהַ֫ת־אֵ֥ם יִקְּר֥וּהָ עֹֽרְבֵי־נַ֑חַל וְֽיֹאכְל֥וּהָ בְנֵי־נָֽשֶׁר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'yn  tl'g l'b vtbz lyqht'm yqrvh 'rbynchl vy'khlvh bnynshr {p}
verses.translation: The eye that mocketh at his father, And despiseth to obey his mother, The ravens of the valley shall pick it out, And the young vultures shall eat it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה הֵ֭מָּה נִפְלְא֣וּ מִמֶּ֑נִּי (וארבע) [וְ֝אַרְבָּעָ֗ה] לֹ֣א יְדַעְתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: shlshh hmh npl'v mmny (v'rb') [v'rb'h] l' yd'tym
verses.translation: There are three things which are too wonderful for me, Yea, four which I know not:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַנֶּ֨שֶׁר  בַּשָּׁמַיִם֮ דֶּ֥רֶךְ נָחָ֗שׁ עֲלֵ֫י־צ֥וּר דֶּרֶךְ־אֳנִיָּ֥ה בְלֶב־יָ֑ם וְדֶ֖רֶךְ גֶּ֣בֶר בְּעַלְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: drkh hnshr  bshmym drkh nchsh 'lytsvr drkh'nyh blbym vdrkh gbr b'lmh
verses.translation: The way of an eagle in the air; The way of a serpent upon a rock; The way of a ship in the midst of the sea; And the way of a man with a young woman.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּ֤ן  דֶּ֥רֶךְ אִשָּׁ֗ה מְנָ֫אָ֥פֶת אָ֭כְלָה וּמָ֣חֲתָה פִ֑יהָ וְ֝אָמְרָ֗ה לֹא־פָעַ֥לְתִּי אָֽוֶן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khn  drkh 'shh mn'pt 'khlh vmchth pyh v'mrh l'p'lty 'vn {p}
verses.translation: So is the way of an adulterous woman; She eateth, and wipeth her mouth, And saith: ‘I have done no wickedness.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת שָׁ֭לוֹשׁ רָ֣גְזָה אֶ֑רֶץ וְתַ֥חַת אַ֝רְבַּ֗ע לֹא־תוּכַ֥ל שְׂאֵֽת׃
verses.translit: tcht shlvsh rgzh 'rts vtcht 'rb' l'tvkhl sh't
verses.translation: For three things the earth doth quake, And for four it cannot endure:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּֽחַת־עֶ֭בֶד כִּ֣י יִמְל֑וֹךְ וְ֝נָבָ֗ל כִּ֣י יִֽשְׂבַּֽע־לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translit: tcht'bd khy ymlvkh vnbl khy yshb'lchm
verses.translation: For a servant when he reigneth; And a churl when he is filled with food;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת שְׂ֭נוּאָה כִּ֣י תִבָּעֵ֑ל וְ֝שִׁפְחָ֗ה כִּֽי־תִירַ֥שׁ גְּבִרְתָּֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: tcht shnv'h khy tb'l vshpchh khytyrsh gbrth {p}
verses.translation: For an odious woman when she is married; And a handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַרְבָּ֣עָה הֵ֭ם קְטַנֵּי־אָ֑רֶץ וְ֝הֵ֗מָּה חֲכָמִ֥ים מְחֻכָּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'rb'h hm qtny'rts vhmh chkhmym mchkhmym
verses.translation: There are four things which are little upon the earth, But they are exceeding wise:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭נְּמָלִים עַ֣ם לֹא־עָ֑ז וַיָּכִ֖ינוּ בַקַּ֣יִץ לַחְמָֽם׃
verses.translit: hnmlym 'm l''z vykhynv bqyts lchmm
verses.translation: The ants are a people not strong, Yet they provide their food in the summer;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁ֭פַנִּים עַ֣ם לֹא־עָצ֑וּם וַיָּשִׂ֖ימוּ בַסֶּ֣לַע בֵּיתָֽם׃
verses.translit: shpnym 'm l''tsvm vyshymv bsl' bytm
verses.translation: The rock-badgers are but a feeble folk, Yet make they their houses in the crags;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֭לֶךְ אֵ֣ין לָאַרְבֶּ֑ה וַיֵּצֵ֖א חֹצֵ֣ץ כֻּלּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mlkh 'yn l'rbh vyts' chtsts khlv
verses.translation: The locusts have no king, Yet go they forth all of them by bands;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂ֭מָמִית בְּיָדַ֣יִם תְּתַפֵּ֑שׂ וְ֝הִ֗יא בְּהֵ֣יכְלֵי מֶֽלֶךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: shmmyt bydym ttpsh vhy' bhykhly mlkh {p}
verses.translation: The spider thou canst take with the hands, Yet is she in kings’palaces.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה הֵ֭מָּה מֵיטִ֣יבֵי צָ֑עַד וְ֝אַרְבָּעָ֗ה מֵיטִ֥בֵי לָֽכֶת׃
verses.translit: shlshh hmh mytyby ts'd v'rb'h mytby lkht
verses.translation: There are three things which are stately in their march, Yea, four which are stately in going:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַ֭יִשׁ גִּבּ֣וֹר בַּבְּהֵמָ֑ה וְלֹא־יָ֝שׁ֗וּב מִפְּנֵי־כֹֽל׃
verses.translit: lysh gbvr bbhmh vl'yshvb mpnykhl
verses.translation: The lion, which is mightiest among beasts, And turneth not away for any;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זַרְזִ֣יר מׇתְנַ֣יִם אוֹ־תָ֑יִשׁ וּ֝מֶ֗לֶךְ אַלְק֥וּם עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: zrzyr mtnym 'vtysh vmlkh 'lqvm 'mv
verses.translation: The greyhound; the he-goat also; And the king, against whom there is no rising up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־נָבַ֥לְתָּ בְהִתְנַשֵּׂ֑א וְאִם־זַ֝מּ֗וֹתָ יָ֣ד לְפֶֽה׃
verses.translit: 'mnblt bhtnsh' v'mzmvt yd lph
verses.translation: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, Or if thou hast planned devices, lay thy hand upon thy mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִ֪יץ חָלָ֡ב י֘וֹצִ֤יא חֶמְאָ֗ה וּֽמִיץ־אַ֭ף י֣וֹצִיא דָ֑ם וּמִ֥יץ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם י֣וֹצִיא רִֽיב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy myts chlb yvtsy' chm'h vmyts'f yvtsy' dm vmyts 'pym yvtsy' ryb {p}
verses.translation: For the churning of milk bringeth forth curd, And the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood; So the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּ֭בְרֵי לְמוּאֵ֣ל מֶ֑לֶךְ מַ֝שָּׂ֗א אֲֽשֶׁר־יִסְּרַ֥תּוּ אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: dbry lmv'l mlkh msh' 'shrysrtv 'mv
verses.translation: The words of king Lemuel; the burden wherewith his mother corrected him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־בְּ֭רִי וּמַֽה־בַּר־בִּטְנִ֑י וּ֝מֶ֗ה בַּר־נְדָרָֽי׃
verses.translit: mhbry vmhbrbtny vmh brndry
verses.translation: What, my son? and what, O son of my womb? And what, O son of my vows?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּתֵּ֣ן לַנָּשִׁ֣ים חֵילֶ֑ךָ וּ֝דְרָכֶ֗יךָ לַֽמְח֥וֹת מְלָכִֽין׃
verses.translit: 'lttn lnshym chylkh vdrkhykh lmchvt mlkhyn
verses.translation: Give not thy strength unto women, Nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֤ל לַֽמְלָכִ֨ים  לְֽמוֹאֵ֗ל אַ֣ל לַֽמְלָכִ֣ים שְׁתוֹ־יָ֑יִן וּ֝לְרוֹזְנִ֗ים (או) [אֵ֣י] שֵׁכָֽר׃
verses.translit: 'l lmlkhym  lmv'l 'l lmlkhym shtvyyn vlrvznym ('v) ['y] shkhr
verses.translation: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine: Nor for princes to say: ‘Where is strong drink?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּן־יִ֭שְׁתֶּה וְיִשְׁכַּ֣ח מְחֻקָּ֑ק וִ֝ישַׁנֶּ֗ה דִּ֣ין כׇּל־בְּנֵי־עֹֽנִי׃
verses.translit: pnyshth vyshkhch mchqq vyshnh dyn khlbny'ny
verses.translation: Lest they drink, and forget that which is decreed, And pervert the justice due to any that is afflicted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּנוּ־שֵׁכָ֥ר לְאוֹבֵ֑ד וְ֝יַ֗יִן לְמָ֣רֵי נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: tnvshkhr l'vbd vyyn lmry npsh
verses.translation: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, And wine unto the bitter in soul;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֭שְׁתֶּה וְיִשְׁכַּ֣ח רִישׁ֑וֹ וַ֝עֲמָל֗וֹ לֹ֣א יִזְכׇּר־עֽוֹד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yshth vyshkhch ryshv v'mlv l' yzkhr'vd {p}
verses.translation: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּתַח־פִּ֥יךָ לְאִלֵּ֑ם אֶל־דִּ֝֗ין כׇּל־בְּנֵ֥י חֲלֽוֹף׃
verses.translit: ptchpykh l'lm 'ldyn khlbny chlvf
verses.translation: Open thy mouth for the dumb, in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּתַח־פִּ֥יךָ שְׁפׇט־צֶ֑דֶק וְ֝דִ֗ין עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְיֽוֹן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: ptchpykh shpttsdq vdyn 'ny v'byvn {p}
verses.translation: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵֽשֶׁת־חַ֭יִל מִ֣י יִמְצָ֑א וְרָחֹ֖ק מִפְּנִינִ֣ים מִכְרָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: 'shtchyl my ymts' vrchq mpnynym mkhrh
verses.translation: A woman of valour who can find? For her price is far above rubies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּ֣טַח בָּ֭הּ לֵ֣ב בַּעְלָ֑הּ וְ֝שָׁלָ֗ל לֹ֣א יֶחְסָֽר׃
verses.translit: btch bh lb b'lh vshll l' ychsr
verses.translation: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, and he hath no lack of gain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גְּמָלַ֣תְהוּ ט֣וֹב וְלֹא־רָ֑ע כֹּ֝֗ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: gmlthv tvb vl'r' khl ymy chyyh
verses.translation: She doeth him good and not evil all the days of her life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דָּ֭רְשָׁה צֶ֣מֶר וּפִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ֝תַּ֗עַשׂ בְּחֵ֣פֶץ כַּפֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: drshh tsmr vpshtym vt'sh bchpts khpyh
verses.translation: She seeketh wool and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָ֭יְתָה כׇּאֳנִיּ֣וֹת סוֹחֵ֑ר מִ֝מֶּרְחָ֗ק תָּבִ֥יא לַחְמָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: hyth kh'nyvt svchr mmrchq tby' lchmh
verses.translation: She is like the merchant-ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּ֤קׇם  בְּע֬וֹד לַ֗יְלָה וַתִּתֵּ֣ן טֶ֣רֶף לְבֵיתָ֑הּ וְ֝חֹ֗ק לְנַעֲרֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vtqm  b'vd lylh vttn trf lbyth vchq ln'rtyh
verses.translation: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth food to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָמְמָ֣ה שָׂ֭דֶה וַתִּקָּחֵ֑הוּ מִפְּרִ֥י כַ֝פֶּ֗יהָ (נטע) [נָ֣טְעָה] כָּֽרֶם׃
verses.translit: zmmh shdh vtqchhv mpry khpyh (nt') [nt'h] khrm
verses.translation: She considereth a field, and buyeth it; with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָֽגְרָ֣ה בְע֣וֹז מׇתְנֶ֑יהָ וַ֝תְּאַמֵּ֗ץ זְרוֹעֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: chgrh b'vz mtnyh vt'mts zrv'tyh
verses.translation: She girdeth her loins with strength, And maketh strong her arms.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טָ֭עֲמָה כִּי־ט֣וֹב סַחְרָ֑הּ לֹא־יִכְבֶּ֖ה (בליל) [בַלַּ֣יְלָה] נֵרָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: t'mh khytvb schrh l'ykhbh (blyl) [blylh] nrh
verses.translation: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good; Her lamp goeth not out by night.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֭דֶיהָ שִׁלְּחָ֣ה בַכִּישׁ֑וֹר וְ֝כַפֶּ֗יהָ תָּ֣מְכוּ פָֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: ydyh shlchh bkhyshvr vkhpyh tmkhv plkh
verses.translation: She layeth her hands to the distaff, And her hands hold the spindle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּ֭פָּהּ פָּֽרְשָׂ֣ה לֶעָנִ֑י וְ֝יָדֶ֗יהָ שִׁלְּחָ֥ה לָאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: khph prshh l'ny vydyh shlchh l'byvn
verses.translation: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; Yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־תִירָ֣א לְבֵיתָ֣הּ מִשָּׁ֑לֶג כִּ֥י כׇל־בֵּ֝יתָ֗הּ לָבֻ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.translit: l'tyr' lbyth mshlg khy khlbyth lbsh shnym
verses.translation: She is not afraid of the snow for her household; For all her household are clothed with scarlet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַרְבַדִּ֥ים עָֽשְׂתָה־לָּ֑הּ שֵׁ֖שׁ וְאַרְגָּמָ֣ן לְבוּשָֽׁהּ׃
verses.translit: mrbdym 'shthlh shsh v'rgmn lbvshh
verses.translation: She maketh for herself coverlets; Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נוֹדָ֣ע בַּשְּׁעָרִ֣ים בַּעְלָ֑הּ בְּ֝שִׁבְתּ֗וֹ עִם־זִקְנֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: nvd' bsh'rym b'lh bshbtv 'mzqny'rts
verses.translation: Her husband is known in the gates, When he sitteth among the elders of the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סָדִ֣ין עָ֭שְׂתָה וַתִּמְכֹּ֑ר וַ֝חֲג֗וֹר נָתְנָ֥ה לַֽכְּנַעֲנִֽי׃
verses.translit: sdyn 'shth vtmkhr vchgvr ntnh lkhn'ny
verses.translation: She maketh linen garments and selleth them; And delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹז־וְהָדָ֥ר לְבוּשָׁ֑הּ וַ֝תִּשְׂחַ֗ק לְי֣וֹם אַחֲרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: 'zvhdr lbvshh vtshchq lyvm 'chrvn
verses.translation: Strength and dignity are her clothing; And she laugheth at the time to come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּ֭יהָ פָּתְחָ֣ה בְחׇכְמָ֑ה וְת֥וֹרַת חֶ֝֗סֶד עַל־לְשׁוֹנָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: pyh ptchh bchkhmh vtvrt chsd 'llshvnh
verses.translation: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; And the law of kindness is on her tongue.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צ֭וֹפִיָּה (הילכות) [הֲלִיכ֣וֹת] בֵּיתָ֑הּ וְלֶ֥חֶם עַ֝צְל֗וּת לֹ֣א תֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: tsvpyh (hylkhvt) [hlykhvt] byth vlchm 'tslvt l' t'khl
verses.translation: She looketh well to the ways of her household, And eateth not the bread of idleness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָ֣מוּ בָ֭נֶיהָ וַֽיְאַשְּׁר֑וּהָ בַּ֝עְלָ֗הּ וַֽיְהַלְלָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: qmv bnyh vy'shrvh b'lh vyhllh
verses.translation: Her children rise up, and call her blessed; Her husband also, and he praiseth her:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַבּ֣וֹת בָּ֭נוֹת עָ֣שׂוּ חָ֑יִל וְ֝אַ֗תְּ עָלִ֥ית עַל־כֻּלָּֽנָה׃
verses.translit: rbvt bnvt 'shv chyl v't 'lyt 'lkhlnh
verses.translation: ’Many daughters have done valiantly, But thou excellest them all.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭חֵן וְהֶ֣בֶל הַיֹּ֑פִי אִשָּׁ֥ה יִרְאַת־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תִתְהַלָּֽל׃
verses.translit: shqr hchn vhbl hypy 'shh yr'tyhvh hy' tthll
verses.translation: Grace is deceitful, and beauty is vain; But a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּנוּ־לָ֭הּ מִפְּרִ֣י יָדֶ֑יהָ וִיהַלְל֖וּהָ בַשְּׁעָרִ֣ים מַֽעֲשֶֽׂיהָ׃
verses.translit: tnvlh mpry ydyh vyhllvh bsh'rym m'shyh
verses.translation: Give her of the fruit of her hands; And let her works praise her in the gates.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֛ישׁ הָיָ֥ה בְאֶֽרֶץ־ע֖וּץ אִיּ֣וֹב שְׁמ֑וֹ וְהָיָ֣ה  הָאִ֣ישׁ הַה֗וּא תָּ֧ם וְיָשָׁ֛ר וִירֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְסָ֥ר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.translit: 'ysh hyh b'rts'vts 'yvb shmv vhyh  h'ysh hhv' tm vyshr vyr' 'lhym vsr mr'
verses.translation: THERE was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was whole-hearted and upright, and one that feared God, and shunned evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּוָּ֥לְדוּ ל֛וֹ שִׁבְעָ֥ה בָנִ֖ים וְשָׁל֥וֹשׁ בָּנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyvldv lv shb'h bnym vshlvsh bnvt
verses.translation: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י מִ֠קְנֵ֠הוּ שִֽׁבְעַ֨ת אַלְפֵי־צֹ֜אן וּשְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת אַלְפֵ֣י גְמַלִּ֗ים וַחֲמֵ֨שׁ מֵא֤וֹת צֶֽמֶד־בָּקָר֙ וַחֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֲתוֹנ֔וֹת וַעֲבֻדָּ֖ה רַבָּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וַֽיְהִי֙ הָאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא גָּד֖וֹל מִכׇּל־בְּנֵי־קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.translit: vyhy mqnhv shb't 'lpyts'n vshlsht 'lpy gmlym vchmsh m'vt tsmdbqr vchmsh m'vt 'tvnvt v'bdh rbh m'd vyhy h'ysh hhv' gdvl mkhlbnyqdm
verses.translation: His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she-asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָלְכ֤וּ בָנָיו֙ וְעָשׂ֣וּ מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה בֵּ֖ית אִ֣ישׁ יוֹמ֑וֹ וְשָׁלְח֗וּ וְקָֽרְאוּ֙ לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אַחְיֹתֵיהֶ֔ם לֶאֱכֹ֥ל וְלִשְׁתּ֖וֹת עִמָּהֶֽם׃
