verses.translit: vhlkhv bnyv v'shv mshth byt 'ysh yvmv vshlchv vqr'v lshlsht 'chytyhm l'khl vlshtvt 'mhm
verses.translation: And his sons used to go and hold a feast in the house of each one upon his day; and they would send and invite their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֡י כִּ֣י הִקִּ֩יפוּ֩ יְמֵ֨י הַמִּשְׁתֶּ֜ה וַיִּשְׁלַ֧ח אִיּ֣וֹב וַֽיְקַדְּשֵׁ֗ם וְהִשְׁכִּ֣ים בַּבֹּ֘קֶר֮ וְהֶעֱלָ֣ה עֹלוֹת֮ מִסְפַּ֣ר כֻּלָּם֒ כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר אִיּ֔וֹב אוּלַי֙ חָטְא֣וּ בָנַ֔י וּבֵרְכ֥וּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בִּלְבָבָ֑ם כָּ֛כָה יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אִיּ֖וֹב כׇּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhy khy hqypv ymy hmshth vyshlch 'yvb vyqdshm vhshkhym bbqr vh'lh 'lvt mspr khlm khy 'mr 'yvb 'vly cht'v bny vbrkhv 'lhym blbbm khkhh y'shh 'yvb khlhymym {p}
verses.translation: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt-offerings according to the number of them all; for Job said: ‘It may be that my sons have sinned, and blasphemed God in their hearts.’ Thus did Job continually.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל־יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיָּב֥וֹא גַֽם־הַשָּׂטָ֖ן בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyhy hyvm vyb'v bny h'lhym lhtytsb 'lyhvh vybv' gmhshtn btvkhm
verses.translation: Now it fell upon a day, that the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan came also among them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָ֖ן מֵאַ֣יִן תָּבֹ֑א וַיַּ֨עַן הַשָּׂטָ֤ן אֶת־יְהֹוָה֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר מִשּׁ֣וּט בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּמֵֽהִתְהַלֵּ֖ךְ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhshtn m'yn tb' vy'n hshtn 'tyhvh vy'mr mshvt b'rts vmhthlkh bh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Satan: ‘Whence comest thou?’ Then Satan answered the LORD, and said: ‘From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־הַשָּׂטָ֔ן הֲשַׂ֥מְתָּ לִבְּךָ֖ עַל־עַבְדִּ֣י אִיּ֑וֹב כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין כָּמֹ֙הוּ֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֧ם וְיָשָׁ֛ר יְרֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְסָ֥ר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhshtn hshmt lbkh 'l'bdy 'yvb khy 'yn khmhv b'rts 'ysh tm vyshr yr' 'lhym vsr mr'
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Satan: ‘Hast thou considered My servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a whole-hearted and an upright man, one that feareth God, and shunneth evil?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַן הַשָּׂטָ֛ן אֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הַֽחִנָּ֔ם יָרֵ֥א אִיּ֖וֹב אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'n hshtn 'tyhvh vy'mr hchnm yr' 'yvb 'lhym
verses.translation: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said: ‘Doth Job fear God for nought?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹֽא־[אַ֠תָּ֠ה] (את) שַׂ֣כְתָּ בַעֲד֧וֹ וּבְעַד־בֵּית֛וֹ וּבְעַ֥ד כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֖וֹ מִסָּבִ֑יב מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יָדָיו֙ בֵּרַ֔כְתָּ וּמִקְנֵ֖הוּ פָּרַ֥ץ בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: hl'['th] ('t) shkht b'dv vb'dbytv vb'd khl'shrlv msbyb m'shh ydyv brkht vmqnhv prts b'rts
verses.translation: Hast not Thou made a hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath, on every side? Thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his possessions are increased in the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאוּלָם֙ שְֽׁלַֽח־נָ֣א יָֽדְךָ֔ וְגַ֖ע בְּכׇל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֑וֹ אִם־לֹ֥א עַל־פָּנֶ֖יךָ יְבָרְכֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: v'vlm shlchn' ydkh vg' bkhl'shrlv 'ml' 'lpnykh ybrkhkh
verses.translation: But put forth Thy hand now, and touch all that he hath, surely he will blaspheme Thee to Thy face.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָ֗ן הִנֵּ֤ה כׇל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ֙ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ רַ֣ק אֵלָ֔יו אַל־תִּשְׁלַ֖ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וַיֵּצֵא֙ הַשָּׂטָ֔ן מֵעִ֖ם פְּנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhshtn hnh khl'shrlv bydkh rq 'lyv 'ltshlch ydkh vyts' hshtn m'm pny yhvh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Satan: ‘Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thy hand.’ So Satan went forth from the presence of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י הַיּ֑וֹם וּבָנָ֨יו וּבְנֹתָ֤יו אֹֽכְלִים֙ וְשֹׁתִ֣ים יַ֔יִן בְּבֵ֖ית אֲחִיהֶ֥ם הַבְּכֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vyhy hyvm vbnyv vbntyv 'khlym vshtym yyn bbyt 'chyhm hbkhvr
verses.translation: And it fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַלְאָ֛ךְ בָּ֥א אֶל־אִיּ֖וֹב וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הַבָּקָר֙ הָי֣וּ חֹֽרְשׁ֔וֹת וְהָאֲתֹנ֖וֹת רֹע֥וֹת עַל־יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vml'kh b' 'l'yvb vy'mr hbqr hyv chrshvt vh'tnvt r'vt 'lydyhm
verses.translation: that there came a messenger unto Job, and said: ‘The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּפֹּ֤ל שְׁבָא֙ וַתִּקָּחֵ֔ם וְאֶת־הַנְּעָרִ֖ים הִכּ֣וּ לְפִי־חָ֑רֶב וָאִמָּ֨לְטָ֧ה רַק־אֲנִ֛י לְבַדִּ֖י לְהַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vtpl shb' vtqchm v'thn'rym hkhv lpychrb v'mlth rq'ny lbdy lhgyd lkh
verses.translation: and the Sabeans made a raid, and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ע֣וֹד  זֶ֣ה מְדַבֵּ֗ר וְזֶה֮ בָּ֣א וַיֹּאמַר֒ אֵ֣שׁ אֱלֹהִ֗ים נָֽפְלָה֙ מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַתִּבְעַ֥ר בַּצֹּ֛אן וּבַנְּעָרִ֖ים וַתֹּֽאכְלֵ֑ם וָאִמָּ֨לְטָ֧ה רַק־אֲנִ֛י לְבַדִּ֖י לְהַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'vd  zh mdbr vzh b' vy'mr 'sh 'lhym nplh mnhshmym vtb'r bts'n vbn'rym vt'khlm v'mlth rq'ny lbdy lhgyd lkh
verses.translation: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said: ‘A fire of God is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ע֣וֹד  זֶ֣ה מְדַבֵּ֗ר וְזֶה֮ בָּ֣א וַיֹּאמַר֒ כַּשְׂדִּ֞ים שָׂ֣מוּ  שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה רָאשִׁ֗ים וַֽיִּפְשְׁט֤וּ עַל־הַגְּמַלִּים֙ וַיִּקָּח֔וּם וְאֶת־הַנְּעָרִ֖ים הִכּ֣וּ לְפִי־חָ֑רֶב וָאִמָּ֨לְטָ֧ה רַק־אֲנִ֛י לְבַדִּ֖י לְהַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'vd  zh mdbr vzh b' vy'mr khshdym shmv  shlshh r'shym vypshtv 'lhgmlym vyqchvm v'thn'rym hkhv lpychrb v'mlth rq'ny lbdy lhgyd lkh
verses.translation: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said: ‘The Chaldeans set themselves in three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have taken them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֚ד זֶ֣ה מְדַבֵּ֔ר וְזֶ֖ה בָּ֣א וַיֹּאמַ֑ר בָּנֶ֨יךָ וּבְנוֹתֶ֤יךָ אֹֽכְלִים֙ וְשֹׁתִ֣ים יַ֔יִן בְּבֵ֖ית אֲחִיהֶ֥ם הַבְּכֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: 'd zh mdbr vzh b' vy'mr bnykh vbnvtykh 'khlym vshtym yyn bbyt 'chyhm hbkhvr
verses.translation: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said: ‘Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֩ ר֨וּחַ גְּדוֹלָ֜ה בָּ֣אָה  מֵעֵ֣בֶר הַמִּדְבָּ֗ר וַיִּגַּע֙ בְּאַרְבַּע֙ פִּנּ֣וֹת הַבַּ֔יִת וַיִּפֹּ֥ל עַל־הַנְּעָרִ֖ים וַיָּמ֑וּתוּ וָאִמָּ֨לְטָ֧ה רַק־אֲנִ֛י לְבַדִּ֖י לְהַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vhnh rvch gdvlh b'h  m'br hmdbr vyg' b'rb' pnvt hbyt vypl 'lhn'rym vymvtv v'mlth rq'ny lbdy lhgyd lkh
verses.translation: And, behold, there came a great wind from across the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young people, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤קׇם אִיּוֹב֙ וַיִּקְרַ֣ע אֶת־מְעִל֔וֹ וַיָּ֖גׇז אֶת־רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיִּפֹּ֥ל אַ֖רְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ׃
verses.translit: vyqm 'yvb vyqr' 'tm'lv vygz 'tr'shv vypl 'rtsh vyshtchv
verses.translation: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ עָרֹ֨ם יָצָ֜תִי מִבֶּ֣טֶן אִמִּ֗י וְעָרֹם֙ אָשׁ֣וּב שָׁ֔מָּה יְהֹוָ֣ה נָתַ֔ן וַֽיהֹוָ֖ה לָקָ֑ח יְהִ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה מְבֹרָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'rm ytsty mbtn 'my v'rm 'shvb shmh yhvh ntn vyhvh lqch yhy shm yhvh mbrkh
verses.translation: And he said; Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, And naked shall I return thither; The LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; Blessed be the name of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּכׇל־זֹ֖את לֹא־חָטָ֣א אִיּ֑וֹב וְלֹא־נָתַ֥ן תִּפְלָ֖ה לֵאלֹהִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bkhlz't l'cht' 'yvb vl'ntn tplh l'lhym {p}
verses.translation: For all this Job sinned not, nor ascribed aught unseemly to God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל־יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיָּב֤וֹא גַֽם־הַשָּׂטָן֙ בְּתֹכָ֔ם לְהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy hyvm vyb'v bny h'lhym lhtytsb 'lyhvh vybv' gmhshtn btkhm lhtytsb 'lyhvh
verses.translation: Again it fell upon a day, that the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־הַשָּׂטָ֔ן אֵ֥י מִזֶּ֖ה תָּבֹ֑א וַיַּ֨עַן הַשָּׂטָ֤ן אֶת־יְהֹוָה֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר מִשֻּׁ֣ט בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּמֵֽהִתְהַלֵּ֖ךְ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhshtn 'y mzh tb' vy'n hshtn 'tyhvh vy'mr msht b'rts vmhthlkh bh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Satan: ‘From whence comest thou?’ And Satan answered the LORD, and said: ‘From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָ֗ן הֲשַׂ֣מְתָּ לִבְּךָ֮ אֶל־עַבְדִּ֣י אִיּוֹב֒ כִּי֩ אֵ֨ין כָּמֹ֜הוּ בָּאָ֗רֶץ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֧ם וְיָשָׁ֛ר יְרֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְסָ֣ר מֵרָ֑ע וְעֹדֶ֙נּוּ֙ מַחֲזִ֣יק בְּתֻמָּת֔וֹ וַתְּסִיתֵ֥נִי ב֖וֹ לְבַלְּע֥וֹ חִנָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhshtn hshmt lbkh 'l'bdy 'yvb khy 'yn khmhv b'rts 'ysh tm vyshr yr' 'lhym vsr mr' v'dnv mchzyq btmtv vtsytny bv lbl'v chnm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Satan: ‘Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a whole-hearted and an upright man, one that feareth God, and shunneth evil? and he still holdeth fast his integrity, although thou didst move Me against him, to destroy him without cause.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַן הַשָּׂטָ֛ן אֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר ע֣וֹר בְּעַד־ע֗וֹר וְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָאִ֔ישׁ יִתֵּ֖ן בְּעַ֥ד נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'n hshtn 'tyhvh vy'mr 'vr b'd'vr vkhl 'shr l'ysh ytn b'd npshv
verses.translation: And Satan answered the LORD, and said: ‘Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוּלָם֙ שְֽׁלַֽח־נָ֣א יָֽדְךָ֔ וְגַ֥ע אֶל־עַצְמ֖וֹ וְאֶל־בְּשָׂר֑וֹ אִם־לֹ֥א אֶל־פָּנֶ֖יךָ יְבָרְכֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: 'vlm shlchn' ydkh vg' 'l'tsmv v'lbshrv 'ml' 'lpnykh ybrkhkh
verses.translation: But put forth Thy hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, surely he will blaspheme Thee to Thy face.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָ֖ן הִנּ֣וֹ בְיָדֶ֑ךָ אַ֖ךְ אֶת־נַפְשׁ֥וֹ שְׁמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhshtn hnv bydkh 'kh 'tnpshv shmr
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Satan: ‘Behold, he is in thy hand; only spare his life.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ הַשָּׂטָ֔ן מֵאֵ֖ת פְּנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיַּ֤ךְ אֶת־אִיּוֹב֙ בִּשְׁחִ֣ין רָ֔ע מִכַּ֥ף רַגְל֖וֹ (עד) [וְעַ֥ד] קׇדְקֳדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyts' hshtn m't pny yhvh vykh 't'yvb bshchyn r' mkhf rglv ('d) [v'd] qdqdv
verses.translation: So Satan went forth from the presence of the LORD, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot even unto his crown.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ל֣וֹ חֶ֔רֶשׂ לְהִתְגָּרֵ֖ד בּ֑וֹ וְה֖וּא יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּתוֹךְ־הָאֵֽפֶר׃
verses.translit: vyqchlv chrsh lhtgrd bv vhv' yshb btvkhh'pr
verses.translation: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself therewith; and he sat among the ashes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ עֹדְךָ֖ מַחֲזִ֣יק בְּתֻמָּתֶ֑ךָ בָּרֵ֥ךְ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וָמֻֽת׃
verses.translit: vt'mr lv 'shtv 'dkh mchzyq btmtkh brkh 'lhym vmt
verses.translation: Then said his wife unto him: ‘Dost thou still hold fast thine integrity? blaspheme God, and die.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֗יהָ כְּדַבֵּ֞ר אַחַ֤ת הַנְּבָלוֹת֙ תְּדַבֵּ֔רִי גַּ֣ם אֶת־הַטּ֗וֹב נְקַבֵּל֙ מֵאֵ֣ת הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְאֶת־הָרָ֖ע לֹ֣א נְקַבֵּ֑ל בְּכׇל־זֹ֛את לֹא־חָטָ֥א אִיּ֖וֹב בִּשְׂפָתָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyh khdbr 'cht hnblvt tdbry gm 'thtvb nqbl m't h'lhym v'thr' l' nqbl bkhlz't l'cht' 'yvb bshptyv {p}
verses.translation: But he said unto her: ‘Thou speakest as one of the impious women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?’ For all this did not Job sin with his lips.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֞וּ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת  רֵעֵ֣י אִיּ֗וֹב אֵ֣ת כׇּל־הָרָעָ֣ה הַזֹּאת֮ הַבָּ֣אָה עָלָיו֒ וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִמְּקֹמ֔וֹ אֱלִיפַ֤ז הַתֵּֽימָנִי֙ וּבִלְדַּ֣ד הַשּׁוּחִ֔י וְצוֹפַ֖ר הַנַּֽעֲמָתִ֑י וַיִּוָּעֲד֣וּ יַחְדָּ֔ו לָב֥וֹא לָנֽוּד־ל֖וֹ וּֽלְנַחֲמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshm'v shlsht  r'y 'yvb 't khlhr'h hz't hb'h 'lyv vyb'v 'ysh mmqmv 'lypz htymny vbldd hshvchy vtsvpr hn'mty vyv'dv ychdv lbv' lnvdlv vlnchmv
verses.translation: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place, Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to bemoan him and to comfort him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂא֨וּ אֶת־עֵינֵיהֶ֤ם מֵֽרָחוֹק֙ וְלֹ֣א הִכִּירֻ֔הוּ וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ קוֹלָ֖ם וַיִּבְכּ֑וּ וַֽיִּקְרְעוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מְעִל֔וֹ וַיִּזְרְק֥וּ עָפָ֛ר עַל־רָאשֵׁיהֶ֖ם הַשָּׁמָֽיְמָה׃
verses.translit: vysh'v 't'ynyhm mrchvq vl' hkhyrhv vysh'v qvlm vybkhv vyqr'v 'ysh m'lv vyzrqv 'pr 'lr'shyhm hshmymh
verses.translation: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his mantle, and threw dust upon their heads toward heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּשְׁב֤וּ אִתּוֹ֙ לָאָ֔רֶץ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים וְשִׁבְעַ֣ת לֵיל֑וֹת וְאֵין־דֹּבֵ֤ר אֵלָיו֙ דָּבָ֔ר כִּ֣י רָא֔וּ כִּי־גָדַ֥ל הַכְּאֵ֖ב מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vyshbv 'tv l'rts shb't ymym vshb't lylvt v'yndbr 'lyv dbr khy r'v khygdl hkh'b m'd
verses.translation: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spoke a word unto him; for they saw that his grief was very great.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַֽחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן פָּתַ֤ח אִיּוֹב֙ אֶת־פִּ֔יהוּ וַיְקַלֵּ֖ל אֶת־יוֹמֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'chrykhn ptch 'yvb 'tpyhv vyqll 'tyvmv {p}
verses.translation: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: And Job spoke, and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֹ֣אבַד י֭וֹם אִוָּ֣לֶד בּ֑וֹ וְהַלַּ֥יְלָה אָ֝מַ֗ר הֹ֣רָה גָֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: y'bd yvm 'vld bv vhlylh 'mr hrh gbr
verses.translation: Let the day perish wherein I was born, And the night wherein it was said: ‘A man-child is brought forth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַיּ֥וֹם הַה֗וּא יְֽהִ֫י־חֹ֥שֶׁךְ אַֽל־יִדְרְשֵׁ֣הוּ אֱל֣וֹהַּ מִמַּ֑עַל וְאַל־תּוֹפַ֖ע עָלָ֣יו נְהָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: hyvm hhv' yhychshkh 'lydrshhv 'lvh mm'l v'ltvp' 'lyv nhrh
verses.translation: Let that day be darkness; Let not God inquire after it from above, Neither let the light shine upon it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִגְאָלֻ֡הוּ חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְ֭צַלְמָוֶת תִּשְׁכׇּן־עָלָ֣יו עֲנָנָ֑ה יְ֝בַעֲתֻ֗הוּ כִּֽמְרִ֥ירֵי יֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: yg'lhv chshkh vtslmvt tshkhn'lyv 'nnh yb'thv khmryry yvm
verses.translation: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own; Let a cloud dwell upon it; Let all that maketh black the day terrify it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַלַּ֥יְלָה הַהוּא֮ יִקָּחֵ֢ה֫וּ אֹ֥פֶל אַל־יִ֭חַדְּ בִּימֵ֣י שָׁנָ֑ה בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר יְ֝רָחִ֗ים אַל־יָבֹֽא׃
verses.translit: hlylh hhv' yqchhv 'pl 'lychd bymy shnh bmspr yrchym 'lyb'
verses.translation: As for that night, let thick darkness seize upon it; Let it not rejoice among the days of the year; Let it not come into the number of the months.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה הַלַּ֣יְלָה הַ֭הוּא יְהִ֣י גַלְמ֑וּד אַל־תָּב֖וֹא רְנָנָ֣ה בֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hnh hlylh hhv' yhy glmvd 'ltbv' rnnh bv
verses.translation: Lo, let that night be desolate; Let no joyful voice come therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִקְּבֻ֥הוּ אֹֽרְרֵי־י֑וֹם הָ֝עֲתִידִ֗ים עֹרֵ֥ר לִוְיָתָֽן׃
verses.translit: yqbhv 'rryyvm h'tydym 'rr lvytn
verses.translation: Let them curse it that curse the day, Who are ready to rouse up leviathan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֶחְשְׁכוּ֮ כּוֹכְבֵ֢י נִ֫שְׁפּ֥וֹ יְקַו־לְא֥וֹר וָאַ֑יִן וְאַל־יִ֝רְאֶ֗ה בְּעַפְעַפֵּי־שָֽׁחַר׃
verses.translit: ychshkhv khvkhby nshpv yqvl'vr v'yn v'lyr'h b'p'pyshchr
verses.translation: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; Let it look for light, but have none; Neither let it behold the eyelids of the morning;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א סָ֭גַר דַּלְתֵ֣י בִטְנִ֑י וַיַּסְתֵּ֥ר עָ֝מָ֗ל מֵעֵינָֽי׃
verses.translit: khy l' sgr dlty btny vystr 'ml m'yny
verses.translation: Because it shut not up the doors of my [mother’s] womb, Nor hid trouble from mine eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה לֹּ֣א מֵרֶ֣חֶם אָמ֑וּת מִבֶּ֖טֶן יָצָ֣אתִי וְאֶגְוָֽע׃
verses.translit: lmh l' mrchm 'mvt mbtn yts'ty v'gv'
verses.translation: Why died I not from the womb? Why did I not perish at birth?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַ֭דּוּעַ קִדְּמ֣וּנִי בִרְכָּ֑יִם וּמַה־שָּׁ֝דַ֗יִם כִּ֣י אִינָֽק׃
verses.translit: mdv' qdmvny brkhym vmhshdym khy 'ynq
verses.translation: Why did the knees receive me? And wherefore the breasts, that I should suck?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עַ֭תָּה שָׁכַ֣בְתִּי וְאֶשְׁק֑וֹט יָ֝שַׁ֗נְתִּי אָ֤ז  יָנ֬וּחַֽ לִֽי׃
verses.translit: khy'th shkhbty v'shqvt yshnty 'z  ynvch ly
verses.translation: For now should I have lain still and been quiet; I should have slept; then had I been at rest—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִם־מְ֭לָכִים וְיֹ֣עֲצֵי אָ֑רֶץ הַבֹּנִ֖ים חֳרָב֣וֹת לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'mmlkhym vy'tsy 'rts hbnym chrbvt lmv
verses.translation: With kings and counsellors of the earth, Who built up waste places for themselves;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֣וֹ עִם־שָׂ֭רִים זָהָ֣ב לָהֶ֑ם הַֽמְמַלְאִ֖ים בָּתֵּיהֶ֣ם כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.translit: 'v 'mshrym zhb lhm hmml'ym btyhm khsf
verses.translation: Or with princes that had gold, Who filled their houses with silver;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֤וֹ כְנֵ֣פֶל טָ֭מוּן לֹ֣א אֶהְיֶ֑ה כְּ֝עֹלְלִ֗ים לֹא־רָ֥אוּ אֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: 'v khnpl tmvn l' 'hyh kh'llym l'r'v 'vr
verses.translation: Or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been; As infants that never saw light.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֣ם רְ֭שָׁעִים חָ֣דְלוּ רֹ֑גֶז וְשָׁ֥ם יָ֝נ֗וּחוּ יְגִ֣יעֵי כֹֽחַ׃
verses.translit: shm rsh'ym chdlv rgz vshm ynvchv ygy'y khch
verses.translation: There the wicked cease from troubling; And there the weary are at rest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֭חַד אֲסִירִ֣ים שַׁאֲנָ֑נוּ לֹ֥א שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ ק֣וֹל נֹגֵֽשׂ׃
verses.translit: ychd 'syrym sh'nnv l' shm'v qvl ngsh
verses.translation: There the prisoners are at ease together; They hear not the voice of the taskmaster.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָטֹ֣ן וְ֭גָדוֹל שָׁ֣ם ה֑וּא וְ֝עֶ֗בֶד חׇפְשִׁ֥י מֵאֲדֹנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: qtn vgdvl shm hv' v'bd chpshy m'dnyv
verses.translation: The small and great are there alike; And the servant is free from his master.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה יִתֵּ֣ן לְעָמֵ֣ל א֑וֹר וְ֝חַיִּ֗ים לְמָ֣רֵי נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: lmh ytn l'ml 'vr vchyym lmry npsh
verses.translation: Wherewith is light given to him that is in misery, And life unto the bitter in soul—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽמְחַכִּ֣ים לַמָּ֣וֶת וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וַֽ֝יַּחְפְּרֻ֗הוּ מִמַּטְמוֹנִֽים׃
verses.translit: hmchkhym lmvt v'ynnv vychprhv mmtmvnym
verses.translation: Who long for death, but it cometh not; And dig for it more than for hid treasures;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשְּׂמֵחִ֥ים אֱלֵי־גִ֑יל יָ֝שִׂ֗ישׂוּ כִּ֣י יִמְצְאוּ־קָֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: hshmchym 'lygyl yshyshv khy ymts'vqbr
verses.translation: Who rejoice unto exultation, And are glad, when they can find the grave?—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭גֶבֶר אֲשֶׁר־דַּרְכּ֣וֹ נִסְתָּ֑רָה וַיָּ֖סֶךְ אֱל֣וֹהַּ בַּעֲדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: lgbr 'shrdrkhv nstrh vyskh 'lvh b'dv
verses.translation: To a man whose way is hid, And whom God hath hedged in?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־לִפְנֵ֣י לַ֭חְמִי אַנְחָתִ֣י תָבֹ֑א וַֽיִּתְּכ֥וּ כַ֝מַּ֗יִם שַׁאֲגֹתָֽי׃
verses.translit: khylpny lchmy 'nchty tb' vytkhv khmym sh'gty
verses.translation: For my sighing cometh instead of my food, And my roarings are poured out like water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י פַ֣חַד פָּ֭חַדְתִּי וַיֶּאֱתָיֵ֑נִי וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָ֝גֹ֗רְתִּי יָ֣בֹא לִֽי׃
verses.translit: khy pchd pchdty vy'tyny v'shr ygrty yb' ly
verses.translation: For the thing which I did fear is come upon me, And that which I was afraid of hath overtaken me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א שָׁלַ֨וְתִּי  וְלֹ֖א שָׁקַ֥טְתִּי וְֽלֹא־נָ֗חְתִּי וַיָּ֥בֹא רֹֽגֶז׃ {פ}
verses.translit: l' shlvty  vl' shqtty vl'nchty vyb' rgz {p}
verses.translation: I was not at ease, neither was I quiet, Neither had I rest; but trouble came.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּימָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'lypz htymny vy'mr
verses.translation: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲנִסָּ֬ה דָבָ֣ר אֵלֶ֣יךָ תִּלְאֶ֑ה וַעְצֹ֥ר בְּ֝מִלִּ֗ין מִ֣י יוּכָֽל׃
verses.translit: hnsh dbr 'lykh tl'h v'tsr bmlyn my yvkhl
verses.translation: If one venture a word unto thee, wilt thou be weary? But who can withhold himself from speaking?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֭נֵּה יִסַּ֣רְתָּ רַבִּ֑ים וְיָדַ֖יִם רָפ֣וֹת תְּחַזֵּֽק׃
verses.translit: hnh ysrt rbym vydym rpvt tchzq
verses.translation: Behold, thou hast instructed many, And thou hast strengthened the weak hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כּ֭וֹשֵׁל יְקִימ֣וּן מִלֶּ֑יךָ וּבִרְכַּ֖יִם כֹּרְע֣וֹת תְּאַמֵּֽץ׃
verses.translit: khvshl yqymvn mlykh vbrkhym khr'vt t'mts
verses.translation: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, And thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י עַתָּ֨ה  תָּב֣וֹא אֵלֶ֣יךָ וַתֵּ֑לֶא תִּגַּ֥ע עָ֝דֶ֗יךָ וַתִּבָּהֵֽל׃
verses.translit: khy 'th  tbv' 'lykh vtl' tg' 'dykh vtbhl
verses.translation: But now it is come upon thee, and thou art weary; It toucheth thee, and thou art affrighted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֣א יִ֭רְאָתְךָ כִּסְלָתֶ֑ךָ תִּ֝קְוָתְךָ֗ וְתֹ֣ם דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: hl' yr'tkh khsltkh tqvtkh vtm drkhykh
verses.translation: Is not thy fear of God thy confidence, And thy hope the integrity of thy ways?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכׇר־נָ֗א מִ֤י ה֣וּא נָקִ֣י אָבָ֑ד וְ֝אֵיפֹ֗ה יְשָׁרִ֥ים נִכְחָֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: zkhrn' my hv' nqy 'bd v'yph yshrym nkhchdv
verses.translation: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתִי חֹ֣רְשֵׁי אָ֑וֶן וְזֹרְעֵ֖י עָמָ֣ל יִקְצְרֻֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: kh'shr r'yty chrshy 'vn vzr'y 'ml yqtsrhv
verses.translation: According as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, And sow mischief, reap the same.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִנִּשְׁמַ֣ת אֱל֣וֹהַּ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וּמֵר֖וּחַ אַפּ֣וֹ יִכְלֽוּ׃
verses.translit: mnshmt 'lvh y'bdv vmrvch 'pv ykhlv
verses.translation: By the breath of God they perish, And by the blast of His anger are they consumed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁאֲגַ֣ת אַ֭רְיֵה וְק֣וֹל שָׁ֑חַל וְשִׁנֵּ֖י כְפִירִ֣ים נִתָּֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: sh'gt 'ryh vqvl shchl vshny khpyrym nt'v
verses.translation: The lion roareth, and the fierce lion howleth— Yet the teeth of the young lions are broken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַ֭יִשׁ אֹבֵ֣ד מִבְּלִי־טָ֑רֶף וּבְנֵ֥י לָ֝בִ֗יא יִתְפָּרָֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: lysh 'bd mblytrf vbny lby' ytprdv
verses.translation: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, And the whelps of the lioness are scattered abroad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭אֵלַי דָּבָ֣ר יְגֻנָּ֑ב וַתִּקַּ֥ח אׇ֝זְנִ֗י שֵׁ֣מֶץ מֶֽנְהֽוּ׃
verses.translit: v'ly dbr ygnb vtqch 'zny shmts mnhv
verses.translation: Now a word was secretly brought to me, And mine ear received a whisper thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּ֭שְׂעִפִּים מֵחֶזְיֹנ֣וֹת לָ֑יְלָה בִּנְפֹ֥ל תַּ֝רְדֵּמָ֗ה עַל־אֲנָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: bsh'pym mchzynvt lylh bnpl trdmh 'l'nshym
verses.translation: In thoughts from the visions of the night, When deep sleep falleth on men,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּ֣חַד קְ֭רָאַנִי וּרְעָדָ֑ה וְרֹ֖ב עַצְמוֹתַ֣י הִפְחִֽיד׃
verses.translit: pchd qr'ny vr'dh vrb 'tsmvty hpchyd
verses.translation: Fear came upon me, and trembling, And all my bones were made to shake. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭רוּחַ עַל־פָּנַ֣י יַחֲלֹ֑ף תְּ֝סַמֵּ֗ר שַׂעֲרַ֥ת בְּשָׂרִֽי׃
verses.translit: vrvch 'lpny ychlf tsmr sh'rt bshry
verses.translation: Then a spirit passed before my face, That made the hair of my flesh to stand up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַעֲמֹ֤ד  וְֽלֹא־אַכִּ֬יר מַרְאֵ֗הוּ תְּ֭מוּנָה לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑י דְּמָמָ֖ה וָק֣וֹל אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.translit: y'md  vl''khyr mr'hv tmvnh lngd 'yny dmmh vqvl 'shm'
verses.translation: It stood still, but I could not discern the appearance thereof; A form was before mine eyes; I heard a still voice:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭אֱנוֹשׁ מֵאֱל֣וֹהַּ יִצְדָּ֑ק אִ֥ם מֵ֝עֹשֵׂ֗הוּ יִטְהַר־גָּֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: h'nvsh m'lvh ytsdq 'm m'shhv ythrgbr
verses.translation: ’Shall mortal man be just before God? Shall a man be pure before his Maker?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֣ן בַּ֭עֲבָדָיו לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין וּ֝בְמַלְאָכָ֗יו יָשִׂ֥ים תׇּהֳלָֽה׃
verses.translit: hn b'bdyv l' y'myn vbml'khyv yshym thlh
verses.translation: Behold, He putteth no trust in His servants, And His angels He chargeth with folly;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֤ף  שֹׁכְנֵ֬י בָֽתֵּי־חֹ֗מֶר אֲשֶׁר־בֶּעָפָ֥ר יְסוֹדָ֑ם יְ֝דַכְּא֗וּם לִפְנֵי־עָֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'f  shkhny btychmr 'shrb'pr ysvdm ydkh'vm lpny'sh
verses.translation: How much more them that dwell in houses of clay, Whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבֹּ֣קֶר לָעֶ֣רֶב יֻכַּ֑תּוּ מִבְּלִ֥י מֵ֝שִׂ֗ים לָנֶ֥צַח יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: mbqr l'rb ykhtv mbly mshym lntsch y'bdv
verses.translation: Betwixt morning and evening they are shattered; They perish for ever without any regarding it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹא־נִסַּ֣ע יִתְרָ֣ם בָּ֑ם יָ֝מ֗וּתוּ וְלֹ֣א בְחׇכְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: hl'ns' ytrm bm ymvtv vl' bchkhmh
verses.translation: Is not their tent-cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קְֽרָא־נָ֭א הֲיֵ֣שׁ עוֹנֶ֑ךָּ וְאֶל־מִ֖י מִקְּדֹשִׁ֣ים תִּפְנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: qr'n' hysh 'vnkh v'lmy mqdshym tpnh
verses.translation: Call now; is there any that will answer thee? And to which of the holy ones wilt thou turn?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־לֶ֭אֱוִיל יַהֲרׇג־כָּ֑עַשׂ וּ֝פֹתֶ֗ה תָּמִ֥ית קִנְאָֽה׃
verses.translit: khyl'vyl yhrgkh'sh vpth tmyt qn'h
verses.translation: For anger killeth the foolish man, And envy slayeth the silly one.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲֽנִי־רָ֭אִיתִי אֱוִ֣יל מַשְׁרִ֑ישׁ וָאֶקּ֖וֹב נָוֵ֣הוּ פִתְאֹֽם׃
verses.translit: 'nyr'yty 'vyl mshrysh v'qvb nvhv pt'm
verses.translation: I have seen the foolish taking root; But suddenly I beheld his habitation cursed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְחֲק֣וּ בָנָ֣יו מִיֶּ֑שַׁע וְיִֽדַּכְּא֥וּ בַ֝שַּׁ֗עַר וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: yrchqv bnyv mysh' vydkh'v bsh'r v'yn mtsyl
verses.translation: His children are far from safety, And are crushed in the gate, with none to deliver them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר קְצִיר֨וֹ  רָ֘עֵ֤ב יֹאכֵ֗ל וְאֶֽל־מִצִּנִּ֥ים יִקָּחֵ֑הוּ וְשָׁאַ֖ף צַמִּ֣ים חֵילָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'shr qtsyrv  r'b y'khl v'lmtsnym yqchhv vsh'f tsmym chylm
verses.translation: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, And taketh it even out of the thorns, and the snare gapeth for their substance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י  לֹא־יֵצֵ֣א מֵעָפָ֣ר אָ֑וֶן וּ֝מֵאֲדָמָ֗ה לֹא־יִצְמַ֥ח עָמָֽל׃
verses.translit: khy  l'yts' m'pr 'vn vm'dmh l'ytsmch 'ml
verses.translation: For affliction cometh not forth from the dust, Neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אָ֭דָם לְעָמָ֣ל יוּלָּ֑ד וּבְנֵי־רֶ֝֗שֶׁף יַגְבִּ֥יהוּ עֽוּף׃
verses.translit: khy'dm l'ml yvld vbnyrshf ygbyhv 'vf
verses.translation: But man is born unto trouble, As the sparks fly upward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוּלָ֗ם אֲ֭נִי אֶדְרֹ֣שׁ אֶל־אֵ֑ל וְאֶל־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים אָשִׂ֥ים דִּבְרָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'vlm 'ny 'drsh 'l'l v'l'lhym 'shym dbrty
verses.translation: But as for me, I would seek unto God, And unto God would I commit my cause;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֣ה גְ֭דֹלוֹת וְאֵ֣ין חֵ֑קֶר נִ֝פְלָא֗וֹת עַד־אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.translit: 'shh gdlvt v'yn chqr npl'vt 'd'yn mspr
verses.translation: Who doeth great things and unsearchable, Marvellous things without number;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַנֹּתֵ֣ן מָ֭טָר עַל־פְּנֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְשֹׁ֥לֵֽחַ מַ֝֗יִם עַל־פְּנֵ֥י חוּצֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: hntn mtr 'lpny'rts vshlch mym 'lpny chvtsvt
verses.translation: Who giveth rain upon the earth, And sendeth waters upon the fields;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָשׂ֣וּם שְׁפָלִ֣ים לְמָר֑וֹם וְ֝קֹדְרִ֗ים שָׂ֣גְבוּ יֶֽשַׁע׃
verses.translit: lshvm shplym lmrvm vqdrym shgbv ysh'
verses.translation: So that He setteth up on high those that are low, And those that mourn are exalted to safety.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵ֭פֵר מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת עֲרוּמִ֑ים וְֽלֹא־תַעֲשֶׂ֥נָה יְ֝דֵיהֶ֗ם תֻּֽשִׁיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: mpr mchshbvt 'rvmym vl't'shnh ydyhm tshyh
verses.translation: He frustrateth the devices of the crafty, So that their hands can perform nothing substantial.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹכֵ֣ד חֲכָמִ֣ים בְּעׇרְמָ֑ם וַעֲצַ֖ת נִפְתָּלִ֣ים נִמְהָֽרָה׃
verses.translit: lkhd chkhmym b'rmm v'tst nptlym nmhrh
verses.translation: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness; And the counsel of the wily is carried headlong.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹמָ֥ם יְפַגְּשׁוּ־חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וְ֝כַלַּ֗יְלָה יְֽמַשְׁשׁ֥וּ בַֽצׇּהֳרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: yvmm ypgshvchshkh vkhlylh ymshshv btshrym
verses.translation: They meet with darkness in the day-time, And grope at noonday as in the night. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣שַׁע מֵ֭חֶרֶב מִפִּיהֶ֑ם וּמִיַּ֖ד חָזָ֣ק אֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vysh' mchrb mpyhm vmyd chzq 'byvn
verses.translation: But He saveth from the sword of their mouth, Even the needy from the hand of the mighty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֣י לַדַּ֣ל תִּקְוָ֑ה וְ֝עֹלָ֗תָה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vthy ldl tqvh v'lth qptsh pyh
verses.translation: So the poor hath hope, And iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה אַשְׁרֵ֣י אֱ֭נוֹשׁ יוֹכִחֶ֣נּוּ אֱל֑וֹהַּ וּמוּסַ֥ר שַׁ֝דַּ֗י אַל־תִּמְאָֽס׃
verses.translit: hnh 'shry 'nvsh yvkhchnv 'lvh vmvsr shdy 'ltm's
verses.translation: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth; Therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַכְאִ֣יב וְיֶחְבָּ֑שׁ יִ֝מְחַ֗ץ וְיָדָ֥ו תִּרְפֶּֽינָה׃
verses.translit: khy hv' ykh'yb vychbsh ymchts vydv trpynh
verses.translation: For He maketh sore, and bindeth up; He woundeth, and His hands make whole.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּשֵׁ֣שׁ צָ֭רוֹת יַצִּילֶ֑ךָּ וּבְשֶׁ֓בַע  לֹֽא־יִגַּ֖ע בְּךָ֣ רָֽע׃
verses.translit: bshsh tsrvt ytsylkh vbshb'  l'yg' bkh r'
verses.translation: He will deliver thee in six troubles; Yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּֽ֭רָעָב פָּדְךָ֣ מִמָּ֑וֶת וּ֝בְמִלְחָמָ֗ה מִ֣ידֵי חָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: br'b pdkh mmvt vbmlchmh mydy chrb
verses.translation: In famine He will redeem thee from death; And in war from the power of the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּשׁ֣וֹט לָ֭שׁוֹן תֵּחָבֵ֑א וְֽלֹא־תִירָ֥א מִ֝שֹּׁ֗ד כִּ֣י יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.translit: bshvt lshvn tchb' vl'tyr' mshd khy ybv'
verses.translation: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue; Neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְשֹׁ֣ד וּלְכָפָ֣ן תִּשְׂחָ֑ק וּֽמֵחַיַּ֥ת הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ אַל־תִּירָֽא׃
verses.translit: lshd vlkhpn tshchq vmchyt h'rts 'ltyr'
verses.translation: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh; Neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י עִם־אַבְנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֣ה בְרִיתֶ֑ךָ וְחַיַּ֥ת הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה הׇשְׁלְמָה־לָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khy 'm'bny hshdh brytkh vchyt hshdh hshlmhlkh
verses.translation: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field; And the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽ֭יָדַעְתָּ כִּֽי־שָׁל֣וֹם אׇהֳלֶ֑ךָ וּֽפָקַדְתָּ֥ נָ֝וְךָ֗ וְלֹ֣א תֶחֱטָֽא׃
verses.translit: vyd't khyshlvm 'hlkh vpqdt nvkh vl' tcht'
verses.translation: And thou shalt know that thy tent is in peace; And thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt miss nothing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽ֭יָדַעְתָּ כִּֽי־רַ֣ב זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וְ֝צֶאֱצָאֶ֗יךָ כְּעֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vyd't khyrb zr'kh vts'ts'ykh kh'shb h'rts
verses.translation: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, And thine offspring as the grass of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּב֣וֹא בְכֶ֣לַח אֱלֵי־קָ֑בֶר כַּעֲל֖וֹת גָּדִ֣ישׁ בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: tbv' bkhlch 'lyqbr kh'lvt gdysh b'tv
verses.translation: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a ripe age, Like as a shock of corn cometh in in its season.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה־זֹ֖את חֲקַרְנ֥וּהָ כֶּֽן־הִ֑יא שְׁ֝מָעֶ֗נָּה וְאַתָּ֥ה דַֽע־לָֽךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hnhz't chqrnvh khnhy' shm'nh v'th d'lkh {p}
verses.translation: Lo this, we have searched it, So it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Job answered and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ל֗וּ שָׁק֣וֹל יִשָּׁקֵ֣ל כַּעְשִׂ֑י (והיתי) [וְ֝הַוָּתִ֗י] בְּֽמֹאזְנַ֥יִם יִשְׂאוּ־יָֽחַד׃
verses.translit: lv shqvl yshql kh'shy (vhyty) [vhvty] bm'znym ysh'vychd
verses.translation: Oh that my vexation were but weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances altogether!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עַתָּ֗ה מֵח֣וֹל יַמִּ֣ים יִכְבָּ֑ד עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן דְּבָרַ֥י לָֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: khy'th mchvl ymym ykhbd 'lkhn dbry l'v
verses.translation: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas; therefore are my words broken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י חִצֵּ֪י שַׁדַּ֡י עִמָּדִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲ֭מָתָם שֹׁתָ֣ה רוּחִ֑י בִּעוּתֵ֖י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעַרְכֽוּנִי׃
verses.translit: khy chtsy shdy 'mdy 'shr chmtm shth rvchy b'vty 'lvh y'rkhvny
verses.translation: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof my spirit drinketh up; the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיִֽנְהַק־פֶּ֥רֶא עֲלֵי־דֶ֑שֶׁא אִ֥ם יִגְעֶה־שּׁ֝֗וֹר עַל־בְּלִילֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hynhqpr' 'lydsh' 'm yg'hshvr 'lblylv
verses.translation: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? Or loweth the ox over his fodder?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיֵאָכֵ֣ל תָּ֭פֵל מִבְּלִי־מֶ֑לַח אִם־יֶשׁ־טַ֝֗עַם בְּרִ֣יר חַלָּמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: hy'khl tpl mblymlch 'mysht'm bryr chlmvt
verses.translation: Can that which hath no savour be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the juice of mallows?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵאֲנָ֣ה לִנְגּ֣וֹעַ נַפְשִׁ֑י הֵ֝֗מָּה כִּדְוֵ֥י לַחְמִֽי׃
verses.translit: m'nh lngv' npshy hmh khdvy lchmy
verses.translation: My soul refuseth to touch them; they are as the sickness of my flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־יִ֭תֵּן תָּב֣וֹא שֶׁאֱלָתִ֑י וְ֝תִקְוָתִ֗י יִתֵּ֥ן אֱלֽוֹהַּ׃
verses.translit: myytn tbv' sh'lty vtqvty ytn 'lvh
verses.translation: Oh that I might have my request, and that God would grant me the thing that I long for! .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֹאֵ֣ל אֱ֭לוֹהַּ וִידַכְּאֵ֑נִי יַתֵּ֥ר יָ֝ד֗וֹ וִיבַצְּעֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vy'l 'lvh vydkh'ny ytr ydv vybts'ny
verses.translation: Even that it would please God to crush me; that He would let loose His hand, and cut me off!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֥תְהִי־ע֨וֹד  נֶ֘חָ֤מָתִ֗י וַאֲסַלְּדָ֣ה בְ֭חִילָה לֹ֣א יַחְמ֑וֹל כִּי־לֹ֥א כִ֝חַ֗דְתִּי אִמְרֵ֥י קָדֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: vthy'vd  nchmty v'sldh bchylh l' ychmvl khyl' khchdty 'mry qdvsh
verses.translation: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would exult in pain, though He spare not; For I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־כֹּחִ֥י כִֽי־אֲיַחֵ֑ל וּמַה־קִּ֝צִּ֗י כִּֽי־אַאֲרִ֥יךְ נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: mhkhchy khy'ychl vmhqtsy khy''rykh npshy
verses.translation: What is my strength, that I should wait? And what is mine end, that I should be patient?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־כֹּ֣חַ אֲבָנִ֣ים כֹּחִ֑י אִֽם־בְּשָׂרִ֥י נָחֽוּשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'mkhch 'bnym khchy 'mbshry nchvsh
verses.translation: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of brass?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַאִ֬ם אֵ֣ין עֶזְרָתִ֣י בִ֑י וְ֝תֻשִׁיָּ֗ה נִדְּחָ֥ה מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: h'm 'yn 'zrty by vtshyh ndchh mmny
verses.translation: Is it that I have no help in me, and that sound wisdom is driven quite from me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמָּ֣ס מֵרֵעֵ֣הוּ חָ֑סֶד וְיִרְאַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י יַעֲזֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: lms mr'hv chsd vyr't shdy y'zvb
verses.translation: To him that is ready to faint kindness is due from his friend, Even to him that forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭חַי בָּגְד֣וּ כְמוֹ־נָ֑חַל כַּאֲפִ֖יק נְחָלִ֣ים יַעֲבֹֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: 'chy bgdv khmvnchl kh'pyq nchlym y'brv
verses.translation: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, As the channel of brooks that overflow,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַקֹּדְרִ֥ים מִנִּי־קָ֑רַח עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ יִתְעַלֶּם־שָֽׁלֶג׃
verses.translit: hqdrym mnyqrch 'lymv yt'lmshlg
verses.translation: Which are black by reason of the ice, And wherein the snow hideth itself;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּעֵ֣ת יְזֹרְב֣וּ נִצְמָ֑תוּ בְּ֝חֻמּ֗וֹ נִדְעֲכ֥וּ מִמְּקוֹמָֽם׃
verses.translit: b't yzrbv ntsmtv bchmv nd'khv mmqvmm
verses.translation: What time they wax warm, they vanish, When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֭לָּ֣פְתוּ אׇרְח֣וֹת דַּרְכָּ֑ם יַעֲל֖וּ בַתֹּ֣הוּ וְיֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: ylptv 'rchvt drkhm y'lv bthv vy'bdv
verses.translation: The paths of their way do wind, They go up into the waste, and are lost.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֭בִּיטוּ אׇרְח֣וֹת תֵּמָ֑א הֲלִיכֹ֥ת שְׁ֝בָ֗א קִוּוּ־לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: hbytv 'rchvt tm' hlykht shb' qvvlmv
verses.translation: The caravans of Tema looked, The companies of Sheba waited for them—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֹּ֥שׁוּ כִֽי־בָטָ֑ח בָּ֥אוּ עָ֝דֶ֗יהָ וַיֶּחְפָּֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: bshv khybtch b'v 'dyh vychprv
verses.translation: They were ashamed because they had hoped; They came thither, and were confounded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עַ֭תָּה הֱיִ֣יתֶם לֹ֑א תִּֽרְא֥וּ חֲ֝תַ֗ת וַתִּירָֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: khy'th hyytm l' tr'v chtt vtyr'v
verses.translation: For now ye are become His; Ye see a terror, and are afraid.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲֽכִי־אָ֭מַרְתִּי הָ֣בוּ לִ֑י וּ֝מִכֹּחֲכֶ֗ם שִׁחֲד֥וּ בַעֲדִֽי׃
verses.translit: hkhy'mrty hbv ly vmkhchkhm shchdv b'dy
verses.translation: Did I say: ‘Give unto me’? Or: ‘Offer a present for me of your substance’?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַלְּט֥וּנִי מִיַּד־צָ֑ר וּמִיַּ֖ד עָרִיצִ֣ים תִּפְדּֽוּנִי׃
verses.translit: vmltvny mydtsr vmyd 'rytsym tpdvny
verses.translation: or: ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? Or: ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֭וֹרוּנִי וַאֲנִ֣י אַחֲרִ֑ישׁ וּמַה־שָּׁ֝גִ֗יתִי הָבִ֥ינוּ לִֽי׃
verses.translit: hvrvny v'ny 'chrysh vmhshgyty hbynv ly
verses.translation: Teach me, and I will hold my peace; And cause me to understand wherein I have erred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־נִּמְרְצ֥וּ אִמְרֵי־יֹ֑שֶׁר וּמַה־יּוֹכִ֖יחַ הוֹכֵ֣חַ מִכֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: mhnmrtsv 'mryyshr vmhyvkhych hvkhch mkhm
verses.translation: How forcible are words of uprightness! But what doth your arguing argue?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַלְהוֹכַ֣ח מִלִּ֣ים תַּחְשֹׁ֑בוּ וּ֝לְר֗וּחַ אִמְרֵ֥י נֹאָֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: hlhvkhch mlym tchshbv vlrvch 'mry n'sh
verses.translation: Do ye hold words to be an argument, But the speeches of one that is desperate to be wind?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַף־עַל־יָת֥וֹם תַּפִּ֑ילוּ וְ֝תִכְר֗וּ עַֽל־רֵיעֲכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'f'lytvm tpylv vtkhrv 'lry'khm
verses.translation: Yea, ye would cast lots upon the fatherless, And dig a pit for your friend.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭עַתָּה הוֹאִ֣ילוּ פְנוּ־בִ֑י וְעַל־פְּ֝נֵיכֶ֗ם אִם־אֲכַזֵּֽב׃
verses.translit: v'th hv'ylv pnvby v'lpnykhm 'm'khzb
verses.translation: Now therefore be pleased to look upon me; For surely I shall not lie to your face.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֽׁוּבוּ־נָ֭א אַל־תְּהִ֣י עַוְלָ֑ה (ושבי) [וְשׁ֥וּבוּ] ע֝֗וֹד צִדְקִי־בָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: shvbvn' 'lthy 'vlh (vshby) [vshvbv] 'vd tsdqybh
verses.translation: Return, I pray you, let there be no injustice; Yea, return again, my cause is righteous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיֵשׁ־בִּלְשׁוֹנִ֥י עַוְלָ֑ה אִם־חִ֝כִּ֗י לֹא־יָבִ֥ין הַוּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: hyshblshvny 'vlh 'mchkhy l'ybyn hvvt
verses.translation: Is there injustice on my tongue? Cannot my taste discern crafty devices?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹֽא־צָבָ֣א לֶֽאֱנ֣וֹשׁ (על) [עֲלֵי־]אָ֑רֶץ וְכִימֵ֖י שָׂכִ֣יר יָמָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hl'tsb' l'nvsh ('l) ['ly]'rts vkhymy shkhyr ymyv
verses.translation: Is there not a time of service to man upon earth? And are not his days like the days of a hireling?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּעֶ֥בֶד יִשְׁאַף־צֵ֑ל וּ֝כְשָׂכִ֗יר יְקַוֶּ֥ה פׇעֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: kh'bd ysh'ftsl vkhshkhyr yqvh p'lv
verses.translation: As a servant that eagerly longeth for the shadow, And as a hireling that looketh for his wages;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּ֤ן הׇנְחַ֣לְתִּי לִ֭י יַרְחֵי־שָׁ֑וְא וְלֵיל֥וֹת עָ֝מָ֗ל מִנּוּ־לִֽי׃
verses.translit: khn hnchlty ly yrchyshv' vlylvt 'ml mnvly
verses.translation: So am I made to possess—months of vanity, And wearisome nights are appointed to me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־שָׁכַ֗בְתִּי וְאָמַ֗רְתִּי מָתַ֣י אָ֭קוּם וּמִדַּד־עָ֑רֶב וְשָׂבַ֖עְתִּי נְדֻדִ֣ים עֲדֵי־נָֽשֶׁף׃
verses.translit: 'mshkhbty v'mrty mty 'qvm vmdd'rb vshb'ty nddym 'dynshf
verses.translation: When I lie down, I say: ‘When shall I arise?’ But the night is long, and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֘בַ֤שׁ בְּשָׂרִ֣י רִ֭מָּה (וגיש) [וְג֣וּשׁ] עָפָ֑ר עוֹרִ֥י רָ֝גַ֗ע וַיִּמָּאֵֽס׃
verses.translit: lbsh bshry rmh (vgysh) [vgvsh] 'pr 'vry rg' vym's
verses.translation: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; My skin closeth up and breaketh out afresh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָמַ֣י קַ֭לּוּ מִנִּי־אָ֑רֶג וַ֝יִּכְל֗וּ בְּאֶ֣פֶס תִּקְוָֽה׃
verses.translit: ymy qlv mny'rg vykhlv b'ps tqvh
verses.translation: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, And are spent without hope.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְ֭כֹר כִּי־ר֣וּחַ חַיָּ֑י לֹא־תָשׁ֥וּב עֵ֝ינִ֗י לִרְא֥וֹת טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: zkhr khyrvch chyy l'tshvb 'yny lr'vt tvb
verses.translation: O remember that my life is a breath; Mine eye shall no more see good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־תְ֭שׁוּרֵנִי עֵ֣ין רֹ֑אִי עֵינֶ֖יךָ בִּ֣י וְאֵינֶֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: l'tshvrny 'yn r'y 'ynykh by v'ynny
verses.translation: The eye of him that seeth me shall behold me no more; While Thine eyes are upon me, I am gone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּלָ֣ה עָ֭נָן וַיֵּלַ֑ךְ כֵּ֥ן יוֹרֵ֥ד שְׁ֝א֗וֹל לֹ֣א יַעֲלֶֽה׃
verses.translit: khlh 'nn vylkh khn yvrd sh'vl l' y'lh
verses.translation: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away, So he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יָשׁ֣וּב ע֣וֹד לְבֵית֑וֹ וְלֹא־יַכִּירֶ֖נּוּ ע֣וֹד מְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: l'yshvb 'vd lbytv vl'ykhyrnv 'vd mqmv
verses.translation: He shall return no more to his house, Neither shall his place know him any more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־אֲנִי֮ לֹ֤א אֶחֱשׇׂ֫ךְ־פִּ֥י אֲֽ֭דַבְּרָה בְּצַ֣ר רוּחִ֑י אָ֝שִׂ֗יחָה בְּמַ֣ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: gm'ny l' 'chshkhpy 'dbrh btsr rvchy 'shychh bmr npshy
verses.translation: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲֽיָם־אָ֭נִי אִם־תַּנִּ֑ין כִּֽי־תָשִׂ֖ים עָלַ֣י מִשְׁמָֽר׃
verses.translit: hym'ny 'mtnyn khytshym 'ly mshmr
verses.translation: Am I a sea, or a sea-monster, That Thou settest a watch over me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אָ֭מַרְתִּי תְּנַחֲמֵ֣נִי עַרְשִׂ֑י יִשָּׂ֥א בְ֝שִׂיחִ֗י מִשְׁכָּבִֽי׃
verses.translit: khy'mrty tnchmny 'rshy ysh' bshychy mshkhby
verses.translation: When I say: ‘My bed shall comfort me, My couch shall ease my complaint’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחִתַּתַּ֥נִי בַחֲלֹמ֑וֹת וּֽמֵחֶזְיֹנ֥וֹת תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: vchttny bchlmvt vmchzynvt tb'tny
verses.translation: Then Thou scarest me with dreams, And terrifiest me through visions;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּבְחַ֣ר מַחֲנָ֣ק נַפְשִׁ֑י מָ֝֗וֶת מֵעַצְמוֹתָֽי׃
verses.translit: vtbchr mchnq npshy mvt m'tsmvty
verses.translation: So that my soul chooseth strangling, And death rather than these my bones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָ֭אַסְתִּי לֹא־לְעֹלָ֣ם אֶחְיֶ֑ה חֲדַ֥ל מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי כִּי־הֶ֥בֶל יָמָֽי׃
verses.translit: m'sty l'l'lm 'chyh chdl mmny khyhbl ymy
verses.translation: I loathe it; I shall not live alway; Let me alone; for my days are vanity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָֽה־אֱ֭נוֹשׁ כִּ֣י תְגַדְּלֶ֑נּוּ וְכִֽי־תָשִׁ֖ית אֵלָ֣יו לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: mh'nvsh khy tgdlnv vkhytshyt 'lyv lbkh
verses.translation: What is man, that Thou shouldest magnify him, And that Thou shouldest set Thy heart upon him,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּפְקְדֶ֥נּוּ לִבְקָרִ֑ים לִ֝רְגָעִ֗ים תִּבְחָנֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: vtpqdnv lbqrym lrg'ym tbchnnv
verses.translation: And that Thou shouldest remember him every morning, And try him every moment?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּ֭מָּה לֹא־תִשְׁעֶ֣ה מִמֶּ֑נִּי לֹֽא־תַ֝רְפֵּ֗נִי עַד־בִּלְעִ֥י רֻקִּֽי׃
verses.translit: khmh l'tsh'h mmny l'trpny 'dbl'y rqy
verses.translation: How long wilt Thou not look away from me, Nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָטָ֡אתִי מָ֤ה אֶפְעַ֨ל  לָךְ֮ נֹצֵ֢ר הָ֫אָדָ֥ם לָ֤מָה שַׂמְתַּ֣נִי לְמִפְגָּ֣ע לָ֑ךְ וָאֶהְיֶ֖ה עָלַ֣י לְמַשָּֽׂא׃
verses.translit: cht'ty mh 'p'l  lkh ntsr h'dm lmh shmtny lmpg' lkh v'hyh 'ly lmsh'
verses.translation: If I have sinned, what do I unto Thee, O Thou watcher of men? Why hast Thou set me as a mark for Thee, So that I am a burden to myself?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֶ֤ה  לֹא־תִשָּׂ֣א פִשְׁעִי֮ וְתַעֲבִ֢יר אֶת־עֲוֺ֫נִ֥י כִּֽי־עַ֭תָּה לֶעָפָ֣ר אֶשְׁכָּ֑ב וְשִׁ֖חַרְתַּ֣נִי וְאֵינֶֽנִּי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vmh  l'tsh' psh'y vt'byr 't'vny khy'th l'pr 'shkhb vshchrtny v'ynny {p}
verses.translation: And why dost Thou not pardon my transgression, And take away mine iniquity? For now shall I lie down in the dust; And Thou wilt seek me, but I shall not be.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַשּׁוּחִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n bldd hshvchy vy'mr
verses.translation: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־אָ֥ן תְּמַלֶּל־אֵ֑לֶּה וְר֥וּחַ כַּ֝בִּ֗יר אִמְרֵי־פִֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'd'n tmll'lh vrvch khbyr 'mrypykh
verses.translation: How long wilt thou speak these things, Seeing that the words of thy mouth are as a mighty wind?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭אֵל יְעַוֵּ֣ת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְאִם־שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יְעַוֵּת־צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.translit: h'l y'vt mshpt v'mshdy y'vttsdq
verses.translation: Doth God pervert judgment? Or doth the Almighty pervert justice?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־בָּנֶ֥יךָ חָֽטְאוּ־ל֑וֹ וַֽ֝יְשַׁלְּחֵ֗ם בְּיַד־פִּשְׁעָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mbnykh cht'vlv vyshlchm bydpsh'm
verses.translation: If thy children sinned against Him, He delivered them into the hand of their transgression.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אַ֭תָּה תְּשַׁחֵ֣ר אֶל־אֵ֑ל וְאֶל־שַׁ֝דַּ֗י תִּתְחַנָּֽן׃
verses.translit: 'm'th tshchr 'l'l v'lshdy ttchnn
verses.translation: If thou wouldest seek earnestly unto God, And make thy supplication to the Almighty;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־זַ֥ךְ וְיָשָׁ֗ר אָ֥֫תָּה כִּֽי־עַ֭תָּה יָעִ֣יר עָלֶ֑יךָ וְ֝שִׁלַּ֗ם נְוַ֣ת צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'mzkh vyshr 'th khy'th y'yr 'lykh vshlm nvt tsdqkh
verses.translation: If thou wert pure and upright; Surely now He would awake for thee, And make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה רֵאשִׁיתְךָ֣ מִצְעָ֑ר וְ֝אַחֲרִֽיתְךָ֗ יִשְׂגֶּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vhyh r'shytkh mts'r v'chrytkh yshgh m'd
verses.translation: And though thy beginning was small, Yet thy end should greatly increase.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־שְׁאַל־נָ֭א לְדֹ֣ר רִישׁ֑וֹן וְ֝כוֹנֵ֗ן לְחֵ֣קֶר אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: khysh'ln' ldr ryshvn vkhvnn lchqr 'bvtm
verses.translation: For inquire, I pray thee, of the former generation, And apply thyself to that which their fathers have searched out—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תְמ֣וֹל אֲ֭נַחְנוּ וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע כִּ֤י צֵ֖ל יָמֵ֣ינוּ עֲלֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: khytmvl 'nchnv vl' nd' khy tsl ymynv 'ly'rts
verses.translation: For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, Because our days upon earth are a shadow—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹא־הֵ֣ם י֭וֹרוּךָ יֹ֣אמְרוּ לָ֑ךְ וּ֝מִלִּבָּ֗ם יוֹצִ֥אוּ מִלִּֽים׃
verses.translit: hl'hm yvrvkh y'mrv lkh vmlbm yvts'v mlym
verses.translation: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, And utter words out of their heart?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיִֽגְאֶה־גֹּ֭מֶא בְּלֹ֣א בִצָּ֑ה יִשְׂגֶּה־אָ֥חוּ בְלִי־מָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: hyg'hgm' bl' btsh yshgh'chv blymym
verses.translation: Can the rush shoot up without mire? Can the reed-grass grow without water?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹדֶ֣נּוּ בְ֭אִבּוֹ לֹ֣א יִקָּטֵ֑ף וְלִפְנֵ֖י כׇל־חָצִ֣יר יִיבָֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'dnv b'bv l' yqtf vlpny khlchtsyr yybsh
verses.translation: Whilst it is yet in its greenness, and not cut down, It withereth before any other herb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּ֗ן אׇ֭רְחוֹת כׇּל־שֹׁ֣כְחֵי אֵ֑ל וְתִקְוַ֖ת חָנֵ֣ף תֹּאבֵֽד׃
verses.translit: khn 'rchvt khlshkhchy 'l vtqvt chnf t'bd
verses.translation: So are the paths of all that forget God; And the hope of the godless man shall perish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־יָק֥וֹט כִּסְל֑וֹ וּבֵ֥ית עַ֝כָּבִ֗ישׁ מִבְטַחֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'shryqvt khslv vbyt 'khbysh mbtchv
verses.translation: Whose confidence is gossamer, And whose trust is a spider’s web.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשָּׁעֵ֣ן עַל־בֵּ֭יתוֹ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֑ד יַחֲזִ֥יק בּ֝֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א יָקֽוּם׃
verses.translit: ysh'n 'lbytv vl' y'md ychzyq bv vl' yqvm
verses.translation: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand; He shall hold fast thereby, but it shall not endure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָטֹ֣ב ה֭וּא לִפְנֵי־שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְעַ֥ל גַּ֝נָּת֗וֹ יֹנַקְתּ֥וֹ תֵצֵֽא׃
verses.translit: rtb hv' lpnyshmsh v'l gntv ynqtv tts'
verses.translation: He is green before the sun, And his shoots go forth over his garden.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־גַּ֭ל שׇׁרָשָׁ֣יו יְסֻבָּ֑כוּ בֵּ֖ית אֲבָנִ֣ים יֶחֱזֶֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lgl shrshyv ysbkhv byt 'bnym ychzh
verses.translation: His roots are wrapped about the heap, He beholdeth the place of stones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יְבַלְּעֶ֥נּוּ מִמְּקֹמ֑וֹ וְכִ֥חֶשׁ בּ֝֗וֹ לֹ֣א רְאִיתִֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'mybl'nv mmqmv vkhchsh bv l' r'ytykh
verses.translation: If he be destroyed from his place, Then it shall deny him: ‘I have not seen thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶן־ה֭וּא מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּ֝מֵעָפָ֗ר אַחֵ֥ר יִצְמָֽחוּ׃
verses.translit: hnhv' mshvsh drkhv vm'pr 'chr ytsmchv
verses.translation: Behold, this is the joy of his way, And out of the earth shall others spring.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶן־אֵ֭ל לֹ֣א יִמְאַס־תָּ֑ם וְלֹֽא־יַ֝חֲזִ֗יק בְּיַד־מְרֵעִֽים׃
verses.translit: hn'l l' ym'stm vl'ychzyq bydmr'ym
verses.translation: Behold, God will not cast away an innocent man, Neither will He uphold the evil-doers;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־יְמַלֵּ֣ה שְׂח֣וֹק פִּ֑יךָ וּשְׂפָתֶ֥יךָ תְרוּעָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'dymlh shchvq pykh vshptykh trv'h
verses.translation: Till He fill thy mouth with laughter, And thy lips with shouting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֹׂנְאֶ֥יךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ־בֹ֑שֶׁת וְאֹ֖הֶל רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֵינֶֽנּוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: shn'ykh ylbshvbsht v'hl rsh'ym 'ynnv {p}
verses.translation: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; And the tent of the wicked shall be no more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Job answered and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אׇ֭מְנָם יָדַ֣עְתִּי כִי־כֵ֑ן וּמַה־יִּצְדַּ֖ק אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עִם־אֵֽל׃
verses.translit: 'mnm yd'ty khykhn vmhytsdq 'nvsh 'm'l
verses.translation: Of a truth I know that it is so; And how can man be just with God?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יַ֭חְפֹּץ לָרִ֣יב עִמּ֑וֹ לֹֽא־יַ֝עֲנֶ֗נּוּ אַחַ֥ת מִנִּי־אָֽלֶף׃
verses.translit: 'mychpts lryb 'mv l'y'nnv 'cht mny'lf
verses.translation: If one should desire to contend with Him, He could not answer Him one of a thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲכַ֣ם לֵ֭בָב וְאַמִּ֣יץ כֹּ֑חַ מִֽי־הִקְשָׁ֥ה אֵ֝לָ֗יו וַיִּשְׁלָֽם׃
verses.translit: chkhm lbb v'myts khch myhqshh 'lyv vyshlm
verses.translation: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength; Who hath hardened himself against Him, and prospered?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמַּעְתִּ֣יק הָ֭רִים וְלֹ֣א יָדָ֑עוּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר הֲפָכָ֣ם בְּאַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hm'tyq hrym vl' yd'v 'shr hpkhm b'pv
verses.translation: Who removeth the mountains, and they know it not, When He overturneth them in His anger.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמַּרְגִּ֣יז אֶ֭רֶץ מִמְּקוֹמָ֑הּ וְ֝עַמּוּדֶ֗יהָ יִתְפַּלָּצֽוּן׃
verses.translit: hmrgyz 'rts mmqvmh v'mvdyh ytpltsvn
verses.translation: Who shaketh the earth out of her place, And the pillars thereof tremble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֹמֵ֣ר לַ֭חֶרֶס וְלֹ֣א יִזְרָ֑ח וּבְעַ֖ד כּוֹכָבִ֣ים יַחְתֹּֽם׃
verses.translit: h'mr lchrs vl' yzrch vb'd khvkhbym ychtm
verses.translation: Who commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; And sealeth up the stars.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֹטֶ֣ה שָׁמַ֣יִם לְבַדּ֑וֹ וְ֝דוֹרֵ֗ךְ עַל־בָּ֥מֳתֵי יָֽם׃
verses.translit: nth shmym lbdv vdvrkh 'lbmty ym
verses.translation: Who alone stretcheth out the heavens, And treadeth upon the waves of the sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹֽשֶׂה־עָ֭שׁ כְּסִ֥יל וְכִימָ֗ה וְחַדְרֵ֥י תֵמָֽן׃
verses.translit: 'shh'sh khsyl vkhymh vchdry tmn
verses.translation: Who maketh the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, And the chambers of the south.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֣ה גְ֭דֹלוֹת עַד־אֵ֣ין חֵ֑קֶר וְ֝נִפְלָא֗וֹת עַד־אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.translit: 'shh gdlvt 'd'yn chqr vnpl'vt 'd'yn mspr
verses.translation: Who doeth great things past finding out; Yea, marvellous things without number.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֤ן יַעֲבֹ֣ר עָ֭לַי וְלֹ֣א אֶרְאֶ֑ה וְ֝יַחֲלֹ֗ף וְֽלֹא־אָבִ֥ין לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hn y'br 'ly vl' 'r'h vychlf vl''byn lv
verses.translation: Lo, He goeth by me, and I see Him not. He passeth on also, but I perceive Him not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֣ן יַ֭חְתֹּף מִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ מִי־יֹאמַ֥ר אֵ֝לָ֗יו מַֽה־תַּעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: hn ychtf my yshybnv myy'mr 'lyv mht'shh
verses.translation: Behold, He snatcheth away, who can hinder Him? Who will say unto Him: ‘What doest Thou?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֭לוֹהַּ לֹא־יָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑וֹ תַּחְתָּ֥ו שָׁ֝חֲח֗וּ עֹ֣זְרֵי רָֽהַב׃
verses.translit: 'lvh l'yshyb 'pv tchtv shchchv 'zry rhb
verses.translation: God will not withdraw His anger; The helpers of Rahab did stoop under Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭ף כִּֽי־אָנֹכִ֣י אֶעֱנֶ֑נּוּ אֶבְחֲרָ֖ה דְבָרַ֣י עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'f khy'nkhy ''nnv 'bchrh dbry 'mv
verses.translation: How much less shall I answer Him, And choose out my arguments with Him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִם־צָ֭דַקְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶעֱנֶ֑ה לִ֝מְשֹׁפְטִ֗י אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃
verses.translit: 'shr 'mtsdqty l' ''nh lmshpty 'tchnn
verses.translation: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer; I would make supplication to Him that contendeth with me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־קָרָ֥אתִי וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֑נִי לֹֽא־אַ֝אֲמִ֗ין כִּֽי־יַאֲזִ֥ין קוֹלִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'mqr'ty vy'nny l'''myn khyy'zyn qvly
verses.translation: If I had called, and He had answered me; Yet would I not believe that He would hearken unto my voice—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־בִּשְׂעָרָ֥ה יְשׁוּפֵ֑נִי וְהִרְבָּ֖ה פְצָעַ֣י חִנָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'shrbsh'rh yshvpny vhrbh pts'y chnm
verses.translation: He that would break me with a tempest, And multiply my wounds without cause;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־יִ֭תְּנֵנִי הָשֵׁ֣ב רוּחִ֑י כִּ֥י יַ֝שְׂבִּעַ֗נִי מַמְּרֹרִֽים׃
verses.translit: l'ytnny hshb rvchy khy yshb'ny mmrrym
verses.translation: That would not suffer me to take my breath, But fill me with bitterness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־לְכֹ֣חַ אַמִּ֣יץ הִנֵּ֑ה וְאִם־לְ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מִ֣י יוֹעִידֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: 'mlkhch 'myts hnh v'mlmshpt my yv'ydny
verses.translation: If it be a matter of strength, lo, He is mighty! And if of justice, who will appoint me a time? .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אֶ֭צְדָּק פִּ֣י יַרְשִׁיעֵ֑נִי תׇּֽם־אָ֝֗נִי וַֽיַּעְקְשֵֽׁנִי׃
verses.translit: 'm'tsdq py yrshy'ny tm'ny vy'qshny
verses.translation: Though I be righteous, mine own mouth shall condemn me; Though I be innocent, He shall prove me perverse.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תׇּֽם־אָ֭נִי לֹֽא־אֵדַ֥ע נַפְשִׁ֗י אֶמְאַ֥ס חַיָּֽי׃
verses.translit: tm'ny l''d' npshy 'm's chyy
verses.translation: I am innocent—I regard not myself, I despise my life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחַ֗ת הִ֥֫יא עַל־כֵּ֥ן אָמַ֑רְתִּי תָּ֥ם וְ֝רָשָׁ֗ע ה֣וּא מְכַלֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'cht hy' 'lkhn 'mrty tm vrsh' hv' mkhlh
verses.translation: It is all one—therefore I say: He destroyeth the innocent and the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־שׁ֭וֹט יָמִ֣ית פִּתְאֹ֑ם לְמַסַּ֖ת נְקִיִּ֣ם יִלְעָֽג׃
verses.translit: 'mshvt ymyt pt'm lmst nqym yl'g
verses.translation: If the scourge slay suddenly, He will mock at the calamity of the guiltless.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֤רֶץ  נִתְּנָ֬ה בְֽיַד־רָשָׁ֗ע פְּנֵֽי־שֹׁפְטֶ֥יהָ יְכַסֶּ֑ה אִם־לֹ֖א אֵפ֣וֹא מִי־הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: 'rts  ntnh bydrsh' pnyshptyh ykhsh 'ml' 'pv' myhv'
verses.translation: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked; He covereth the faces of the judges thereof; If it be not He, who then is it?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָמַ֣י קַ֭לּוּ מִנִּי־רָ֑ץ בָּ֝רְח֗וּ לֹא־רָא֥וּ טוֹבָֽה׃
verses.translit: vymy qlv mnyrts brchv l'r'v tvbh
verses.translation: Now my days are swifter than a runner; They flee away, they see no good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָ֭לְפוּ עִם־אֳנִיּ֣וֹת אֵבֶ֑ה כְּ֝נֶ֗שֶׁר יָט֥וּשׂ עֲלֵי־אֹֽכֶל׃
verses.translit: chlpv 'm'nyvt 'bh khnshr ytvsh 'ly'khl
verses.translation: They are passed away as the swift ships; As the vulture that swoopeth on the prey.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אׇ֭מְרִי אֶשְׁכְּחָ֣ה שִׂיחִ֑י אֶעֶזְבָ֖ה פָנַ֣י וְאַבְלִֽיגָה׃
verses.translit: 'm'mry 'shkhchh shychy ''zbh pny v'blygh
verses.translation: If I say: ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad countenance, and be of good cheer’,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָגֹ֥רְתִּי כׇל־עַצְּבֹתָ֑י יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּי־לֹ֥א תְנַקֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: ygrty khl'tsbty yd'ty khyl' tnqny
verses.translation: I am afraid of all my pains, I know that Thou wilt not hold me guiltless.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֥י אֶרְשָׁ֑ע לָמָּה־זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל אִיגָֽע׃
verses.translit: 'nkhy 'rsh' lmhzh hbl 'yg'
verses.translation: I shall be condemned; Why then do I labour in vain?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־הִתְרָחַ֥צְתִּי (במו) [בְמֵי־]שָׁ֑לֶג וַ֝הֲזִכּ֗וֹתִי בְּבֹ֣ר כַּפָּֽי׃
verses.translit: 'mhtrchtsty (bmv) [bmy]shlg vhzkhvty bbr khpy
verses.translation: If I wash myself with snow water, And make my hands never so clean;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֭ז בַּשַּׁ֣חַת תִּטְבְּלֵ֑נִי וְ֝תִעֲב֗וּנִי שַׂלְמוֹתָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'z bshcht ttblny vt'bvny shlmvty
verses.translation: Yet wilt Thou plunge me in the ditch, And mine own clothes shall abhor me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־לֹא־אִ֣ישׁ כָּמ֣וֹנִי אֶעֱנֶ֑נּוּ נָב֥וֹא יַ֝חְדָּ֗ו בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: khyl''ysh khmvny ''nnv nbv' ychdv bmshpt
verses.translation: For He is not a man, as I am, that I should answer Him, That we should come together in judgment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א יֵשׁ־בֵּינֵ֣ינוּ מוֹכִ֑יחַ יָשֵׁ֖ת יָד֣וֹ עַל־שְׁנֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: l' yshbynynv mvkhych ysht ydv 'lshnynv
verses.translation: There is no arbiter betwixt us, That might lay his hand upon us both.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָסֵ֣ר מֵעָלַ֣י שִׁבְט֑וֹ וְ֝אֵמָת֗וֹ אַֽל־תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: ysr m'ly shbtv v'mtv 'ltb'tny
verses.translation: Let Him take His rod away from me, And let not His terror make me afraid;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲֽ֭דַבְּרָה וְלֹ֣א אִירָאֶ֑נּוּ כִּ֥י לֹא־כֵ֥ן אָ֝נֹכִ֗י עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'dbrh vl' 'yr'nv khy l'khn 'nkhy 'mdy
verses.translation: Then would I speak, and not fear Him; For I am not so with myself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָֽקְטָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֗י בְּחַ֫יָּ֥י אֶעֶזְבָ֣ה עָלַ֣י שִׂיחִ֑י אֲ֝דַבְּרָ֗ה בְּמַ֣ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: nqth npshy bchyy ''zbh 'ly shychy 'dbrh bmr npshy
verses.translation: My soul is weary of my life; I will give free course to my complaint; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹמַ֣ר אֶל־אֱ֭לוֹהַּ אַל־תַּרְשִׁיעֵ֑נִי ה֝וֹדִיעֵ֗נִי עַ֣ל מַה־תְּרִיבֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: 'mr 'l'lvh 'ltrshy'ny hvdy'ny 'l mhtrybny
verses.translation: I will say unto God: Do not condemn me; Make me know wherefore Thou contendest with me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲט֤וֹב לְךָ֨  כִּֽי־תַעֲשֹׁ֗ק כִּֽי־תִ֭מְאַס יְגִ֣יעַ כַּפֶּ֑יךָ וְעַל־עֲצַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים הוֹפָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.translit: htvb lkh  khyt'shq khytm's ygy' khpykh v'l'tst rsh'ym hvp't
verses.translation: Is it good unto Thee that Thou shouldest oppress, That Thou shouldest despise the work of Thy hands, And shine upon the counsel of the wicked?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַעֵינֵ֣י בָשָׂ֣ר לָ֑ךְ אִם־כִּרְא֖וֹת אֱנ֣וֹשׁ תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: h'yny bshr lkh 'mkhr'vt 'nvsh tr'h
verses.translation: Hast Thou eyes of flesh? Or seest Thou as man seeth?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲכִימֵ֣י אֱנ֣וֹשׁ יָמֶ֑יךָ אִם־שְׁ֝נוֹתֶ֗יךָ כִּ֣ימֵי גָֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: hkhymy 'nvsh ymykh 'mshnvtykh khymy gbr
verses.translation: Are Thy days as the days of man, Or Thy years as a man’s days,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תְבַקֵּ֥שׁ לַעֲוֺנִ֑י וּֽלְחַטָּאתִ֥י תִדְרֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: khytbqsh l'vny vlcht'ty tdrvsh
verses.translation: That Thou inquirest after mine iniquity, And searchest after my sin, .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַֽל־דַּ֭עְתְּךָ כִּֽי־לֹ֣א אֶרְשָׁ֑ע וְאֵ֖ין מִיָּדְךָ֣ מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: 'ld'tkh khyl' 'rsh' v'yn mydkh mtsyl
verses.translation: Although Thou knowest that I shall not be condemned; And there is none that can deliver out of Thy hand?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָדֶ֣יךָ עִ֭צְּבוּנִי וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֑וּנִי יַ֥חַד סָ֝בִ֗יב וַֽתְּבַלְּעֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: ydykh 'tsbvny vy'shvny ychd sbyb vtbl'ny
verses.translation: Thy hands have framed me and fashioned me Together round about; yet Thou dost destroy me!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכׇר־נָ֭א כִּי־כַחֹ֣מֶר עֲשִׂיתָ֑נִי וְֽאֶל־עָפָ֥ר תְּשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: zkhrn' khykhchmr 'shytny v'l'pr tshybny
verses.translation: Remember, I beseech Thee, that Thou hast fashioned me as clay; And wilt Thou bring me into dust again?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֣א כֶ֭חָלָב תַּתִּיכֵ֑נִי וְ֝כַגְּבִנָּ֗ה תַּקְפִּיאֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: hl' khchlb ttykhny vkhgbnh tqpy'ny
verses.translation: Hast Thou not poured me out as milk, And curdled me like cheese?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ע֣וֹר וּ֭בָשָׂר תַּלְבִּישֵׁ֑נִי וּֽבַעֲצָמ֥וֹת וְ֝גִידִ֗ים תְּשֹׂכְכֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: 'vr vbshr tlbyshny vb'tsmvt vgydym tshkhkhny
verses.translation: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, And knit me together with bones and sinews.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַיִּ֣ים וָ֭חֶסֶד עָשִׂ֣יתָ עִמָּדִ֑י וּ֝פְקֻדָּתְךָ֗ שָֽׁמְרָ֥ה רוּחִֽי׃
verses.translit: chyym vchsd 'shyt 'mdy vpqdtkh shmrh rvchy
verses.translation: Thou hast granted me life and favour, And Thy providence hath preserved my spirit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭אֵלֶּה צָפַ֣נְתָּ בִלְבָבֶ֑ךָ יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּי־זֹ֥את עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: v'lh tspnt blbbkh yd'ty khyz't 'mkh
verses.translation: Yet these things Thou didst hide in Thy heart; I know that this is with Thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־חָטָ֥אתִי וּשְׁמַרְתָּ֑נִי וּ֝מֵעֲוֺנִ֗י לֹ֣א תְנַקֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: 'mcht'ty vshmrtny vm'vny l' tnqny
verses.translation: If I sin, then Thou markest me, And Thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־רָשַׁ֡עְתִּי אַלְלַ֬י לִ֗י וְ֭צָדַקְתִּי לֹא־אֶשָּׂ֣א רֹאשִׁ֑י שְׂבַ֥ע קָ֝ל֗וֹן וּרְאֵ֥ה עׇנְיִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'mrsh'ty 'lly ly vtsdqty l''sh' r'shy shb' qlvn vr'h 'nyy
verses.translation: If I be wicked, woe unto me; And if I be righteous, yet shall I not lift up my head— Being filled with ignominy And looking upon mine affliction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭יִגְאֶה כַּשַּׁ֣חַל תְּצוּדֵ֑נִי וְ֝תָשֹׁ֗ב תִּתְפַּלָּא־בִֽי׃
