verses.translit: vyg'h khshchl ttsvdny vtshb ttpl'by
verses.translation: And if it exalt itself, Thou huntest me as a lion; And again Thou showest Thyself marvellous upon me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּחַדֵּ֬שׁ עֵדֶ֨יךָ  נֶגְדִּ֗י וְתֶ֣רֶב כַּ֭עַשְׂךָ עִמָּדִ֑י חֲלִיפ֖וֹת וְצָבָ֣א עִמִּֽי׃
verses.translit: tchdsh 'dykh  ngdy vtrb kh'shkh 'mdy chlypvt vtsb' 'my
verses.translation: Thou renewest Thy witnesses against me, And increasest Thine indignation upon me; Host succeeding host against me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָ֣מָּה מֵ֭רֶחֶם הֹצֵאתָ֑נִי אֶ֝גְוַ֗ע וְעַ֣יִן לֹֽא־תִרְאֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vlmh mrchm hts'tny 'gv' v'yn l'tr'ny
verses.translation: Wherefore then hast Thou brought me forth out of the womb? Would that I had perished, and no eye had seen me!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־הָיִ֣יתִי אֶהְיֶ֑ה מִ֝בֶּ֗טֶן לַקֶּ֥בֶר אוּבָֽל׃
verses.translit: kh'shr l'hyyty 'hyh mbtn lqbr 'vbl
verses.translation: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹֽא־מְעַ֣ט יָמַ֣י (יחדל) [וַחֲדָ֑ל] (ישית) [וְשִׁ֥ית] מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי וְאַבְלִ֥יגָה מְּעָֽט׃
verses.translit: hl'm't ymy (ychdl) [vchdl] (yshyt) [vshyt] mmny v'blygh m't
verses.translation: Are not my days few? Cease then, And let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּטֶ֣רֶם אֵ֭לֵךְ וְלֹ֣א אָשׁ֑וּב אֶל־אֶ֖רֶץ חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: btrm 'lkh vl' 'shvb 'l'rts chshkh vtslmvt
verses.translation: Before I go whence I shall not return, Even to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֤רֶץ עֵפָ֨תָה  כְּמ֥וֹ אֹ֗פֶל צַ֭לְמָוֶת וְלֹ֥א סְדָרִ֗ים וַתֹּ֥פַע כְּמוֹ־אֹֽפֶל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'rts 'pth  khmv 'pl tslmvt vl' sdrym vtp' khmv'pl {p}
verses.translation: A land of thick darkness, as darkness itself; A land of the shadow of death, without any order, And where the light is as darkness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יַּעַן צֹפַ֥ר הַֽנַּעֲמָתִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n tspr hn'mty vy'mr
verses.translation: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲרֹ֣ב דְּ֭בָרִים לֹ֣א יֵעָנֶ֑ה וְאִם־אִ֖ישׁ שְׂפָתַ֣יִם יִצְדָּֽק׃
verses.translit: hrb dbrym l' y'nh v'm'ysh shptym ytsdq
verses.translation: Should not the multitude of words be answered? And should a man full of talk be accounted right?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּ֭דֶּיךָ מְתִ֣ים יַחֲרִ֑ישׁוּ וַ֝תִּלְעַ֗ג וְאֵ֣ין מַכְלִֽם׃
verses.translit: bdykh mtym ychryshv vtl'g v'yn mkhlm
verses.translation: Thy boastings have made men hold their peace, And thou hast mocked, with none to make thee ashamed;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭תֹּאמֶר זַ֣ךְ לִקְחִ֑י וּ֝בַ֗ר הָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vt'mr zkh lqchy vbr hyyty b'ynykh
verses.translation: And thou hast said: ‘My doctrine is pure, And I am clean in Thine eyes.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם מִֽי־יִתֵּ֣ן אֱל֣וֹהַּ דַּבֵּ֑ר וְיִפְתַּ֖ח שְׂפָתָ֣יו עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: v'vlm myytn 'lvh dbr vyptch shptyv 'mkh
verses.translation: But oh that God would speak, And open His lips against thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיַגֶּד־לְךָ֨  תַּ֥עֲלֻמ֣וֹת חׇכְמָה֮ כִּֽי־כִפְלַ֢יִם לְֽת֫וּשִׁיָּ֥ה וְדַ֡ע כִּֽי־יַשֶּׁ֥ה לְךָ֥ אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ מֵעֲוֺנֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vygdlkh  t'lmvt chkhmh khykhplym ltvshyh vd' khyyshh lkh 'lvh m'vnkh
verses.translation: And that He would tell thee the secrets of wisdom, That sound wisdom is manifold! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַחֵ֣קֶר אֱל֣וֹהַּ תִּמְצָ֑א אִ֤ם עַד־תַּכְלִ֖ית שַׁדַּ֣י תִּמְצָֽא׃
verses.translit: hchqr 'lvh tmts' 'm 'dtkhlyt shdy tmts'
verses.translation: Canst thou find out the deep things of God? Canst thou attain unto the purpose of the Almighty?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גׇּבְהֵ֣י שָׁ֭מַיִם מַה־תִּפְעָ֑ל עֲמֻקָּ֥ה מִ֝שְּׁא֗וֹל מַה־תֵּדָֽע׃
verses.translit: gbhy shmym mhtp'l 'mqh msh'vl mhtd'
verses.translation: It is high as heaven; what canst thou do? Deeper than the nether-world; what canst thou know?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲרֻכָּ֣ה מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִדָּ֑הּ וּ֝רְחָבָ֗ה מִנִּי־יָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'rkhh m'rts mdh vrchbh mnyym
verses.translation: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יַחֲלֹ֥ף וְיַסְגִּ֑יר וְ֝יַקְהִ֗יל וּמִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: 'mychlf vysgyr vyqhyl vmy yshybnv
verses.translation: If He pass by, and shut up, Or gather in, then who can hinder Him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־ה֭וּא יָדַ֣ע מְתֵי־שָׁ֑וְא וַיַּרְא־אָ֝֗וֶן וְלֹ֣א יִתְבּוֹנָֽן׃
verses.translit: khyhv' yd' mtyshv' vyr''vn vl' ytbvnn
verses.translation: For He knoweth base men; and when He seeth iniquity, will He not then consider it?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֣ישׁ נָ֭בוּב יִלָּבֵ֑ב וְעַ֥יִר פֶּ֝֗רֶא אָדָ֥ם יִוָּלֵֽד׃
verses.translit: v'ysh nbvb ylbb v'yr pr' 'dm yvld
verses.translation: But an empty man will get understanding, when a wild ass’s colt is born a man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אַ֭תָּה הֲכִינ֣וֹתָ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וּפָרַשְׂתָּ֖ אֵלָ֣יו כַּפֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'm'th hkhynvt lbkh vprsht 'lyv khpykh
verses.translation: If thou set thy heart aright, and stretch out thy hands toward Him—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אָ֣וֶן בְּ֭יָדְךָ הַרְחִיקֵ֑הוּ וְאַל־תַּשְׁכֵּ֖ן בְּאֹהָלֶ֣יךָ עַוְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'm'vn bydkh hrchyqhv v'ltshkhn b'hlykh 'vlh
verses.translation: If iniquity be in thy hand, put it far away, and let not unrighteousness dwell in thy tents—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־אָ֤ז  תִּשָּׂ֣א פָנֶ֣יךָ מִמּ֑וּם וְהָיִ֥יתָ מֻ֝צָ֗ק וְלֹ֣א תִירָֽא׃
verses.translit: khy'z  tsh' pnykh mmvm vhyyt mtsq vl' tyr'
verses.translation: Surely then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; Yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה עָמָ֣ל תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח כְּמַ֖יִם עָבְר֣וּ תִזְכֹּֽר׃
verses.translit: khy'th 'ml tshkhch khmym 'brv tzkhr
verses.translation: For thou shalt forget thy misery; Thou shalt remember it as waters that are passed away;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽ֭מִצׇּהֳרַיִם יָק֣וּם חָ֑לֶד תָּ֝עֻ֗פָה כַּבֹּ֥קֶר תִּהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vmtshrym yqvm chld t'ph khbqr thyh
verses.translation: And thy life shall be clearer than the noonday; though there be darkness, it shall be as the morning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.translit: vbtcht khyysh tqvh vchprt lbtch tshkhb
verses.translation: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt look about thee, and shalt take thy rest in safety.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽ֭רָבַצְתָּ וְאֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד וְחִלּ֖וּ פָנֶ֣יךָ רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vrbtst v'yn mchryd vchlv pnykh rbym
verses.translation: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; Yea, many shall make suit unto thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֵינֵ֥י רְשָׁעִ֗ים תִּ֫כְלֶ֥ינָה וּ֭מָנוֹס אָבַ֣ד מִנְהֶ֑ם וְ֝תִקְוָתָ֗ם מַֽפַּֽח־נָֽפֶשׁ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'yny rsh'ym tkhlynh vmnvs 'bd mnhm vtqvtm mpchnpsh {p}
verses.translation: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, And they shall have no way to flee, And their hope shall be the drooping of the soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Job answered and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אׇ֭מְנָם כִּ֣י אַתֶּם־עָ֑ם וְ֝עִמָּכֶ֗ם תָּמ֥וּת חׇכְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'mnm khy 'tm'm v'mkhm tmvt chkhmh
verses.translation: No doubt but ye are the people, And wisdom shall die with you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־לִ֤י לֵבָ֨ב  כְּֽמוֹכֶ֗ם לֹא־נֹפֵ֣ל אָנֹכִ֣י מִכֶּ֑ם וְאֶת־מִי־אֵ֥ין כְּמוֹ־אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: gmly lbb  khmvkhm l'npl 'nkhy mkhm v'tmy'yn khmv'lh
verses.translation: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you; Yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂחֹ֤ק לְרֵעֵ֨הוּ  אֶהְיֶ֗ה קֹרֵ֣א לֶ֭אֱלוֹהַּ וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֑הוּ שְׂ֝ח֗וֹק צַדִּ֥יק תָּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: shchq lr'hv  'hyh qr' l'lvh vy'nhv shchvq tsdyq tmym
verses.translation: I am as one that is a laughing-stock to his neighbour, A man that called upon God, And He answered him; The just, the innocent man is a laughing-stock,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַפִּ֣יד בּ֭וּז לְעַשְׁתּ֣וּת שַׁאֲנָ֑ן נָ֝כ֗וֹן לְמ֣וֹעֲדֵי רָֽגֶל׃
verses.translit: lpyd bvz l'shtvt sh'nn nkhvn lmv'dy rgl
verses.translation: A contemptible brand in the thought of him that is at ease, A thing ready for them whose foot slippeth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׁלָ֤יוּ אֹהָלִ֨ים  לְשֹׁ֥דְדִ֗ים וּֽ֭בַטֻּחוֹת לְמַרְגִּ֣יזֵי אֵ֑ל לַאֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵבִ֖יא אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: yshlyv 'hlym  lshddym vbtchvt lmrgyzy 'l l'shr hby' 'lvh bydv
verses.translation: The tents of robbers prosper, And they that provoke God are secure, In whatsoever God bringeth into their hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם שְׁאַל־נָ֣א בְהֵמ֣וֹת וְתֹרֶ֑ךָּ וְע֥וֹף הַ֝שָּׁמַ֗יִם וְיַגֶּד־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: v'vlm sh'ln' bhmvt vtrkh v'vf hshmym vygdlkh
verses.translation: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; And the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֤וֹ שִׂ֣יחַ לָאָ֣רֶץ וְתֹרֶ֑ךָּ וִיסַפְּר֥וּ לְ֝ךָ֗ דְּגֵ֣י הַיָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'v shych l'rts vtrkh vysprv lkh dgy hym
verses.translation: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee; And the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭י לֹא־יָדַ֣ע בְּכׇל־אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֥י יַד־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה עָ֣שְׂתָה זֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: my l'yd' bkhl'lh khy ydyhvh 'shth z't
verses.translation: Who knoweth not among all these, That the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭יָדוֹ נֶ֣פֶשׁ כׇּל־חָ֑י וְ֝ר֗וּחַ כׇּל־בְּשַׂר־אִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: 'shr bydv npsh khlchy vrvch khlbshr'ysh
verses.translation: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, And the breath of all mankind.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹא־אֹ֭זֶן מִלִּ֣ין תִּבְחָ֑ן וְ֝חֵ֗ךְ אֹ֣כֶל יִטְעַם־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hl''zn mlyn tbchn vchkh 'khl yt'mlv
verses.translation: Doth not the ear try words, Even as the palate tasteth its food?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּישִׁישִׁ֥ים חׇכְמָ֑ה וְאֹ֖רֶךְ יָמִ֣ים תְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.translit: byshyshym chkhmh v'rkh ymym tbvnh
verses.translation: Is wisdom with aged men, And understanding in length of days?—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִ֭מּוֹ חׇכְמָ֣ה וּגְבוּרָ֑ה ל֝֗וֹ עֵצָ֥ה וּתְבוּנָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'mv chkhmh vgbvrh lv 'tsh vtbvnh
verses.translation: With Him is wisdom and might; He hath counsel and understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֣ן יַ֭הֲרוֹס וְלֹ֣א יִבָּנֶ֑ה יִסְגֹּ֥ר עַל־אִ֝֗ישׁ וְלֹ֣א יִפָּתֵֽחַ׃
verses.translit: hn yhrvs vl' ybnh ysgr 'l'ysh vl' yptch
verses.translation: Behold, He breaketh down, and it cannot be built again; He shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֤ן יַעְצֹ֣ר בַּמַּ֣יִם וְיִבָ֑שׁוּ וִ֝ישַׁלְּחֵ֗ם וְיַ֖הַפְכוּ־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: hn y'tsr bmym vybshv vyshlchm vyhpkhv'rts
verses.translation: Behold, He withholdeth the waters, and they dry up; Also He sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִ֭מּוֹ עֹ֣ז וְתוּשִׁיָּ֑ה ל֝֗וֹ שֹׁגֵ֥ג וּמַשְׁגֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'mv 'z vtvshyh lv shgg vmshgh
verses.translation: With Him is strength and sound wisdom; The deceived and the deceiver are His.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מוֹלִ֣יךְ יוֹעֲצִ֣ים שׁוֹלָ֑ל וְֽשֹׁפְטִ֥ים יְהוֹלֵֽל׃
verses.translit: mvlykh yv'tsym shvll vshptym yhvll
verses.translation: He leadeth counsellors away stripped, And judges maketh He fools.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מוּסַ֣ר מְלָכִ֣ים פִּתֵּ֑חַ וַיֶּאְסֹ֥ר אֵ֝ז֗וֹר בְּמׇתְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: mvsr mlkhym ptch vy'sr 'zvr bmtnyhm
verses.translation: He looseth the bond of kings, And bindeth their loins with a girdle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מוֹלִ֣יךְ כֹּהֲנִ֣ים שׁוֹלָ֑ל וְאֵ֖תָנִ֣ים יְסַלֵּֽף׃
verses.translit: mvlykh khhnym shvll v'tnym yslf
verses.translation: He leadeth priests away stripped, And overthroweth the mighty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵסִ֣יר שָׂ֭פָה לְנֶאֱמָנִ֑ים וְטַ֖עַם זְקֵנִ֣ים יִקָּֽח׃
verses.translit: msyr shph ln'mnym vt'm zqnym yqch
verses.translation: He removeth the speech of men of trust, And taketh away the sense of the elders.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁוֹפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל־נְדִיבִ֑ים וּמְזִ֖יחַ אֲפִיקִ֣ים רִפָּֽה׃
verses.translit: shvpkh bvz 'lndybym vmzych 'pyqym rph
verses.translation: He poureth contempt upon princes, And looseth the belt of the strong.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְגַלֶּ֣ה עֲ֭מֻקוֹת מִנִּי־חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וַיֹּצֵ֖א לָא֣וֹר צַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: mglh 'mqvt mnychshkh vyts' l'vr tslmvt
verses.translation: He uncovereth deep things out of darkness, And bringeth out to light the shadow of death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשְׂגִּ֣יא לַ֭גּוֹיִם וַֽיְאַבְּדֵ֑ם שֹׁטֵ֥חַ לַ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם וַיַּנְחֵֽם׃
verses.translit: mshgy' lgvym vy'bdm shtch lgvym vynchm
verses.translation: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them; He enlargeth the nations, and leadeth them away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵסִ֗יר לֵ֭ב רָאשֵׁ֣י עַם־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם בְּתֹ֣הוּ לֹא־דָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.translit: msyr lb r'shy 'mh'rts vyt'm bthv l'drkh
verses.translation: He taketh away the heart of the chiefs of the people of the land, And causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְמַֽשְׁשׁוּ־חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וְלֹא־א֑וֹר וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם כַּשִּׁכּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: ymshshvchshkh vl''vr vyt'm khshkhvr
verses.translation: They grope in the dark without light, And He maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶן־כֹּ֭ל רָאֲתָ֣ה עֵינִ֑י שָֽׁמְעָ֥ה אׇ֝זְנִ֗י וַתָּ֥בֶן לָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: hnkhl r'th 'yny shm'h 'zny vtbn lh
verses.translation: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, Mine ear hath heard and understood it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּֽ֭דַעְתְּכֶם יָדַ֣עְתִּי גַם־אָ֑נִי לֹֽא־נֹפֵ֖ל אָנֹכִ֣י מִכֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: khd'tkhm yd'ty gm'ny l'npl 'nkhy mkhm
verses.translation: What ye know, do I know also; I am not inferior unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוּלָ֗ם אֲ֭נִי אֶל־שַׁדַּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְהוֹכֵ֖חַ אֶל־אֵ֣ל אֶחְפָּֽץ׃
verses.translit: 'vlm 'ny 'lshdy 'dbr vhvkhch 'l'l 'chpts
verses.translation: Notwithstanding I would speak to the Almighty, And I desire to reason with God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם אַתֶּ֥ם טֹפְלֵי־שָׁ֑קֶר רֹפְאֵ֖י אֱלִ֣ל כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'vlm 'tm tplyshqr rp'y 'll khlkhm
verses.translation: But ye are plasterers of lies, Ye are all physicians of no value.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִי־יִ֭תֵּן הַחֲרֵ֣שׁ תַּחֲרִישׁ֑וּן וּתְהִ֖י לָכֶ֣ם לְחׇכְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: myytn hchrsh tchryshvn vthy lkhm lchkhmh
verses.translation: Oh that ye would altogether hold your peace! And it would be your wisdom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֥א תוֹכַחְתִּ֑י וְרִב֖וֹת שְׂפָתַ֣י הַקְשִֽׁיבוּ׃
verses.translit: shm'vn' tvkhchty vrbvt shpty hqshybv
verses.translation: Hear now my reasoning, And hearken to the pleadings of my lips.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭לְאֵל תְּדַבְּר֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה וְ֝ל֗וֹ תְּֽדַבְּר֥וּ רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: hl'l tdbrv 'vlh vlv tdbrv rmyh
verses.translation: Will ye speak unrighteously for God, And talk deceitfully for Him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲפָנָ֥יו תִּשָּׂא֑וּן אִם־לָאֵ֥ל תְּרִיבֽוּן׃
verses.translit: hpnyv tsh'vn 'ml'l trybvn
verses.translation: Will ye show Him favour? Will ye contend for God?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲ֭טוֹב כִּֽי־יַחְקֹ֣ר אֶתְכֶ֑ם אִם־כְּהָתֵ֥ל בֶּ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ תְּהָתֵ֥לּוּ בֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: htvb khyychqr 'tkhm 'mkhhtl b'nvsh thtlv bv
verses.translation: Would it be good that He should search you out? Or as one mocketh a man, will ye mock Him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹכֵ֣חַ יוֹכִ֣יחַ אֶתְכֶ֑ם אִם־בַּ֝סֵּ֗תֶר פָּנִ֥ים תִּשָּׂאֽוּן׃
verses.translit: hvkhch yvkhych 'tkhm 'mbstr pnym tsh'vn
verses.translation: He will surely reprove you, If ye do secretly show favour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֣א שְׂ֭אֵתוֹ תְּבַעֵ֣ת אֶתְכֶ֑ם וּ֝פַחְדּ֗וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: hl' sh'tv tb't 'tkhm vpchdv ypl 'lykhm
verses.translation: Shall not His majesty terrify you, And His dread fall upon you?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זִֽ֭כְרֹנֵיכֶם מִשְׁלֵי־אֵ֑פֶר לְגַבֵּי־חֹ֝֗מֶר גַּבֵּיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: zkhrnykhm mshly'pr lgbychmr gbykhm
verses.translation: Your memorials shall be like unto ashes, Your eminences to eminences of clay.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַחֲרִ֣ישׁוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי וַאֲדַבְּרָה־אָ֑נִי וְיַעֲבֹ֖ר עָלַ֣י מָֽה׃
verses.translit: hchryshv mmny v'dbrh'ny vy'br 'ly mh
verses.translation: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, And let come on me what will.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־מָ֤ה  אֶשָּׂ֣א בְשָׂרִ֣י בְשִׁנָּ֑י וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אָשִׂ֥ים בְּכַפִּֽי׃
verses.translit: 'lmh  'sh' bshry bshny vnpshy 'shym bkhpy
verses.translation: Wherefore? I will take my flesh in my teeth, And put my life in my hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֣ן יִ֭קְטְלֵנִי (לא) [ל֣וֹ] אֲיַחֵ֑ל אַךְ־דְּ֝רָכַ֗י אֶל־פָּנָ֥יו אוֹכִֽיחַ׃
verses.translit: hn yqtlny (l') [lv] 'ychl 'khdrkhy 'lpnyv 'vkhych
verses.translation: Though He slay me, yet will I trust in Him; But I will argue my ways before Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־הוּא־לִ֥י לִישׁוּעָ֑ה כִּי־לֹ֥א לְ֝פָנָ֗יו חָנֵ֥ף יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.translit: gmhv'ly lyshv'h khyl' lpnyv chnf ybv'
verses.translation: This also shall be my salvation, That a hypocrite cannot come before Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝אַחֲוָתִ֗י בְּאׇזְנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: shm'v shmv' mlty v'chvty b'znykhm
verses.translation: Hear diligently my speech, And let my declaration be in your ears.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה־נָ֭א עָרַ֣כְתִּי מִשְׁפָּ֑ט יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּי־אֲנִ֥י אֶצְדָּֽק׃
verses.translit: hnhn' 'rkhty mshpt yd'ty khy'ny 'tsdq
verses.translation: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִי־ה֭וּא יָרִ֣יב עִמָּדִ֑י כִּֽי־עַתָּ֖ה אַחֲרִ֣ישׁ וְאֶגְוָֽע׃
verses.translit: myhv' yryb 'mdy khy'th 'chrysh v'gv'
verses.translation: Who is he that will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־שְׁ֭תַּיִם אַל־תַּ֣עַשׂ עִמָּדִ֑י אָ֥ז מִ֝פָּנֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א אֶסָּתֵֽר׃
verses.translit: 'khshtym 'lt'sh 'mdy 'z mpnykh l' 'str
verses.translation: Only do not two things unto me, Then will I not hide myself from Thee:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּ֭פְּךָ מֵעָלַ֣י הַרְחַ֑ק וְ֝אֵ֥מָתְךָ֗ אַֽל־תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: khpkh m'ly hrchq v'mtkh 'ltb'tny
verses.translation: Withdraw Thy hand far from me; And let not Thy terror make me afraid.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֭קְרָא וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶעֱנֶ֑ה אֽוֹ־אֲ֝דַבֵּ֗ר וַהֲשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vqr' v'nkhy ''nh 'v'dbr vhshybny
verses.translation: Then call Thou, and I will answer; Or let me speak, and answer Thou me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּמָּ֣ה לִ֭י עֲוֺנ֣וֹת וְחַטָּא֑וֹת פִּֽשְׁעִ֥י וְ֝חַטָּאתִ֗י הֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: khmh ly 'vnvt vcht'vt psh'y vcht'ty hdy'ny
verses.translation: How many are mine iniquities and sins? Make me to know my transgression and my sin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָֽמָּה־פָנֶ֥יךָ תַסְתִּ֑יר וְתַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאוֹיֵ֣ב לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: lmhpnykh tstyr vtchshbny l'vyb lkh
verses.translation: Wherefore hidest Thou Thy face, And holdest me for Thine enemy?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶעָלֶ֣ה נִדָּ֣ף תַּעֲר֑וֹץ וְאֶת־קַ֖שׁ יָבֵ֣שׁ תִּרְדֹּֽף׃
verses.translit: h'lh ndf t'rvts v'tqsh ybsh trdf
verses.translation: Wilt Thou harass a driven leaf? And wilt Thou pursue the dry stubble?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תִכְתֹּ֣ב עָלַ֣י מְרֹר֑וֹת וְ֝תוֹרִישֵׁ֗נִי עֲוֺנ֥וֹת נְעוּרָֽי׃
verses.translit: khytkhtb 'ly mrrvt vtvryshny 'vnvt n'vry
verses.translation: That Thou shouldest write bitter things against me, And make me to inherit the iniquities of my youth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתָ֘שֵׂ֤ם בַּסַּ֨ד  רַגְלַ֗י וְתִשְׁמ֥וֹר כׇּל־אׇרְחוֹתָ֑י עַל־שׇׁרְשֵׁ֥י רַ֝גְלַ֗י תִּתְחַקֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vtshm bsd  rgly vtshmvr khl'rchvty 'lshrshy rgly ttchqh
verses.translation: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, And lookest narrowly unto all my paths; Thou drawest Thee a line about the soles of my feet;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭הוּא כְּרָקָ֣ב יִבְלֶ֑ה כְּ֝בֶ֗גֶד אֲכָ֣לוֹ עָֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vhv' khrqb yblh khbgd 'khlv 'sh
verses.translation: Though I am like a wine-skin that consumeth, Like a garment that is moth-eaten.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֭דָם יְל֣וּד אִשָּׁ֑ה קְצַ֥ר יָ֝מִ֗ים וּֽשְׂבַֽע־רֹֽגֶז׃
verses.translit: 'dm ylvd 'shh qtsr ymym vshb'rgz
verses.translation: Man that is born of a woman Is of few days, and full of trouble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּצִ֣יץ יָ֭צָא וַיִּמָּ֑ל וַיִּבְרַ֥ח כַּ֝צֵּ֗ל וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: khtsyts yts' vyml vybrch khtsl vl' y'mvd
verses.translation: He cometh forth like a flower, and withereth; He fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַף־עַל־זֶ֭ה פָּקַ֣חְתָּ עֵינֶ֑ךָ וְאֹ֘תִ֤י תָבִ֖יא בְמִשְׁפָּ֣ט עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'f'lzh pqcht 'ynkh v'ty tby' bmshpt 'mkh
verses.translation: And dost Thou open Thine eyes upon such a one, And bringest me into judgment with Thee?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־יִתֵּ֣ן טָ֭הוֹר מִטָּמֵ֗א לֹ֣א אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: myytn thvr mtm' l' 'chd
verses.translation: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֥ם־חֲרוּצִ֨ים  יָמָ֗יו מִֽסְפַּר־חֳדָשָׁ֥יו אִתָּ֑ךְ חֻקָּ֥ו עָ֝שִׂ֗יתָ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲבֹֽר׃
verses.translit: 'mchrvtsym  ymyv msprchdshyv 'tkh chqv 'shyt vl' y'br
verses.translation: Seeing his days are determined, The number of his months is with Thee, And Thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁעֵ֣ה מֵעָלָ֣יו וְיֶחְדָּ֑ל עַד־יִ֝רְצֶ֗ה כְּשָׂכִ֥יר יוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: sh'h m'lyv vychdl 'dyrtsh khshkhyr yvmv
verses.translation: Look away from him, that he may rest, Till he shall accomplish, as a hireling, his day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י יֵ֥שׁ לָעֵ֗ץ תִּ֫קְוָ֥ה אִֽם־יִ֭כָּרֵת וְע֣וֹד יַחֲלִ֑יף וְ֝יֹנַקְתּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א תֶחְדָּֽל׃
verses.translit: khy ysh l'ts tqvh 'mykhrt v'vd ychlyf vynqtv l' tchdl
verses.translation: For there is hope of a tree, If it be cut down, that it will sprout again, And that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יַזְקִ֣ין בָּאָ֣רֶץ שׇׁרְשׁ֑וֹ וּ֝בֶעָפָ֗ר יָמ֥וּת גִּזְעֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'myzqyn b'rts shrshv vb'pr ymvt gz'v
verses.translation: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, And the stock thereof die in the ground;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵרֵ֣יחַ מַ֣יִם יַפְרִ֑חַ וְעָשָׂ֖ה קָצִ֣יר כְּמוֹ־נָֽטַע׃
verses.translit: mrych mym yprch v'shh qtsyr khmvnt'
verses.translation: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, And put forth boughs like a plant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגֶ֣בֶר יָ֭מוּת וַֽיֶּחֱלָ֑שׁ וַיִּגְוַ֖ע אָדָ֣ם וְאַיּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vgbr ymvt vychlsh vygv' 'dm v'yv
verses.translation: But man dieth, and lieth low; Yea, man perisheth, and where is he?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָֽזְלוּ־מַ֭יִם מִנִּי־יָ֑ם וְ֝נָהָ֗ר יֶחֱרַ֥ב וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'zlvmym mnyym vnhr ychrb vybsh
verses.translation: As the waters fail from the sea, And the river is drained dry;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֥ישׁ שָׁכַ֗ב וְֽלֹא־יָ֫ק֥וּם עַד־בִּלְתִּ֣י שָׁ֭מַיִם לֹ֣א יָקִ֑יצוּ וְלֹֽא־יֵ֝עֹ֗רוּ מִשְּׁנָתָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'ysh shkhb vl'yqvm 'dblty shmym l' yqytsv vl'y'rv mshntm
verses.translation: So man lieth down and riseth not; Till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, Nor be roused out of their sleep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֤י יִתֵּ֨ן  בִּשְׁא֬וֹל תַּצְפִּנֵ֗נִי תַּ֭סְתִּירֵנִי עַד־שׁ֣וּב אַפֶּ֑ךָ תָּ֤שִֽׁית־לִ֖י חֹ֣ק וְתִזְכְּרֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: my ytn  bsh'vl ttspnny tstyrny 'dshvb 'pkh tshytly chq vtzkhrny
verses.translation: Oh that Thou wouldest hide me in the nether-world, That Thou wouldest keep me secret, until Thy wrath be past, That Thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יָמ֥וּת גֶּ֗בֶר הֲיִֽ֫חְיֶ֥ה כׇּל־יְמֵ֣י צְבָאִ֣י אֲיַחֵ֑ל עַד־בּ֝֗וֹא חֲלִיפָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'mymvt gbr hychyh khlymy tsb'y 'ychl 'dbv' chlypty
verses.translation: If a man die, may he live again? All the days of my service would I wait, till my relief should come—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּ֭קְרָא וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ לְֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ תִכְסֹֽף׃
verses.translit: tqr' v'nkhy ''nkh lm'shh ydykh tkhsf
verses.translation: Thou wouldest call, and I would answer Thee; Thou wouldest have a desire to the work of Thy hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עַ֭תָּה צְעָדַ֣י תִּסְפּ֑וֹר לֹֽא־תִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר עַל־חַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.translit: khy'th ts'dy tspvr l'tshmr 'lcht'ty
verses.translation: But now Thou numberest my steps, Thou dost not even wait for my sin;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָתֻ֣ם בִּצְר֣וֹר פִּשְׁעִ֑י וַ֝תִּטְפֹּ֗ל עַל־עֲוֺנִֽי׃
verses.translit: chtm btsrvr psh'y vttpl 'l'vny
verses.translation: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, And Thou heapest up mine iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭אוּלָם הַר־נוֹפֵ֣ל יִבּ֑וֹל וְ֝צ֗וּר יֶעְתַּ֥ק מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'vlm hrnvpl ybvl vtsvr y'tq mmqmv
verses.translation: And surely the mountain falling crumbleth away, And the rock is removed out of its place;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲבָנִ֤ים  שָׁ֥חֲקוּ מַ֗יִם תִּשְׁטֹֽף־סְפִיחֶ֥יהָ עֲפַר־אָ֑רֶץ וְתִקְוַ֖ת אֱנ֣וֹשׁ הֶאֱבַֽדְתָּ׃
verses.translit: 'bnym  shchqv mym tshtfspychyh 'pr'rts vtqvt 'nvsh h'bdt
verses.translation: The waters wear the stones; The overflowings thereof wash away the dust of the earth; So Thou destroyest the hope of man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּתְקְפֵ֣הוּ לָ֭נֶצַח וַֽיַּהֲלֹ֑ךְ מְשַׁנֶּ֥ה פָ֝נָ֗יו וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: ttqphv lntsch vyhlkh mshnh pnyv vtshlchhv
verses.translation: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth; Thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִכְבְּד֣וּ בָ֭נָיו וְלֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וְ֝יִצְעֲר֗וּ וְֽלֹא־יָבִ֥ין לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: ykhbdv bnyv vl' yd' vyts'rv vl'ybyn lmv
verses.translation: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; And they are brought low, but he regardeth them not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־בְּ֭שָׂרוֹ עָלָ֣יו יִכְאָ֑ב וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ עָלָ֥יו תֶּאֱבָֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'khbshrv 'lyv ykh'b vnpshv 'lyv t'bl {p}
verses.translation: But his flesh grieveth for him, And his soul mourneth over him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּימָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'lypz htymny vy'mr
verses.translation: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶחָכָ֗ם יַעֲנֶ֥ה דַעַת־ר֑וּחַ וִימַלֵּ֖א קָדִ֣ים בִּטְנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hchkhm y'nh d'trvch vyml' qdym btnv
verses.translation: Should a wise man make answer with windy knowledge, And fill his belly with the east wind?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹכֵ֣חַ בְּ֭דָבָר לֹ֣א יִסְכּ֑וֹן וּ֝מִלִּ֗ים לֹא־יוֹעִ֥יל בָּֽם׃
verses.translit: hvkhch bdbr l' yskhvn vmlym l'yv'yl bm
verses.translation: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, Or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַף־אַ֭תָּה תָּפֵ֣ר יִרְאָ֑ה וְתִגְרַ֥ע שִׂ֝יחָ֗ה לִפְנֵי־אֵֽל׃
verses.translit: 'f'th tpr yr'h vtgr' shychh lpny'l
verses.translation: Yea, thou doest away with fear, And impairest devotion before God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְאַלֵּ֣ף עֲוֺנְךָ֣ פִ֑יךָ וְ֝תִבְחַ֗ר לְשׁ֣וֹן עֲרוּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy y'lf 'vnkh pykh vtbchr lshvn 'rvmym
verses.translation: For thine iniquity teacheth thy mouth, And thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַרְשִׁיעֲךָ֣ פִ֣יךָ וְלֹא־אָ֑נִי וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ יַעֲנוּ־בָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: yrshy'kh pykh vl''ny vshptykh y'nvbkh
verses.translation: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I; Yea, thine own lips testify against thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲרִאישׁ֣וֹן אָ֭דָם תִּוָּלֵ֑ד וְלִפְנֵ֖י גְבָע֣וֹת חוֹלָֽלְתָּ׃
verses.translit: hr'yshvn 'dm tvld vlpny gb'vt chvllt
verses.translation: Art thou the first man that was born? Or wast thou brought forth before the hills?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַבְס֣וֹד אֱל֣וֹהַּ תִּשְׁמָ֑ע וְתִגְרַ֖ע אֵלֶ֣יךָ חׇכְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: hbsvd 'lvh tshm' vtgr' 'lykh chkhmh
verses.translation: Dost thou hearken in the council of God? And dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־יָּ֭דַעְתָּ וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע תָּ֝בִ֗ין וְֽלֹא־עִמָּ֥נוּ הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: mhyd't vl' nd' tbyn vl''mnv hv'
verses.translation: What knowest thou, that we know not? What understandest thou, which is not in us?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־שָׂ֣ב גַּם־יָשִׁ֣ישׁ בָּ֑נוּ כַּבִּ֖יר מֵאָבִ֣יךָ יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: gmshb gmyshysh bnv khbyr m'bykh ymym
verses.translation: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, Much older than thy father.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמְעַ֣ט מִ֭מְּךָ תַּנְחוּמ֣וֹת אֵ֑ל וְ֝דָבָ֗ר לָאַ֥ט עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: hm't mmkh tnchvmvt 'l vdbr l't 'mkh
verses.translation: Are the consolations of God too small for thee, And the word that dealeth gently with thee?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־יִּקָּחֲךָ֥ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וּֽמַה־יִּרְזְמ֥וּן עֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: mhyqchkh lbkh vmhyrzmvn 'ynykh
verses.translation: Why doth thy heart carry thee away? And why do thine eyes wink?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תָשִׁ֣יב אֶל־אֵ֣ל רוּחֶ֑ךָ וְהֹצֵ֖אתָ מִפִּ֣יךָ מִלִּֽין׃
verses.translit: khytshyb 'l'l rvchkh vhts't mpykh mlyn
verses.translation: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, And lettest such words go out of thy mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָה־אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי־יִזְכֶּ֑ה וְכִי־יִ֝צְדַּ֗ק יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: mh'nvsh khyyzkhh vkhyytsdq ylvd 'shh
verses.translation: What is man, that he should be clean? And he that is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֣ן בִּ֭קְדֹשָׁו לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין וְ֝שָׁמַ֗יִם לֹא־זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hn bqdshv l' y'myn vshmym l'zkhv b'ynyv
verses.translation: Behold, He putteth no trust in His holy ones; Yea, the heavens are not clean in His sight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭ף כִּי־נִתְעָ֥ב וְֽנֶאֱלָ֑ח אִישׁ־שֹׁתֶ֖ה כַמַּ֣יִם עַוְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'f khynt'b vn'lch 'yshshth khmym 'vlh
verses.translation: How much less one that is abominable and impure, Man who drinketh iniquity like water! .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲחַוְךָ֥ שְֽׁמַֽע־לִ֑י וְזֶֽה־חָ֝זִ֗יתִי וַאֲסַפֵּֽרָה׃
verses.translit: 'chvkh shm'ly vzhchzyty v'sprh
verses.translation: I will tell thee, hear thou me; And that which I have seen I will declare—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־חֲכָמִ֥ים יַגִּ֑ידוּ וְלֹ֥א כִ֝חֲד֗וּ מֵאֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'shrchkhmym ygydv vl' khchdv m'bvtm
verses.translation: Which wise men have told From their fathers, and have not hid it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָהֶ֣ם לְ֭בַדָּם נִתְּנָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְלֹא־עָ֖בַר זָ֣ר בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.translit: lhm lbdm ntnh h'rts vl''br zr btvkhm
verses.translation: Unto whom alone the land was given, And no stranger passed among them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־יְמֵ֣י רָ֭שָׁע ה֣וּא מִתְחוֹלֵ֑ל וּמִסְפַּ֥ר שָׁ֝נִ֗ים נִצְפְּנ֥וּ לֶעָרִֽיץ׃
verses.translit: khlymy rsh' hv' mtchvll vmspr shnym ntspnv l'ryts
verses.translation: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, Even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קוֹל־פְּחָדִ֥ים בְּאׇזְנָ֑יו בַּ֝שָּׁל֗וֹם שׁוֹדֵ֥ד יְבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: qvlpchdym b'znyv bshlvm shvdd ybv'nv
verses.translation: A sound of terrors is in his ears: In prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יַאֲמִ֣ין שׁ֭וּב מִנִּי־חֹ֑שֶׁךְ (וצפו) [וְצָפ֖וּי] ה֣וּא אֱלֵי־חָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: l'y'myn shvb mnychshkh (vtspv) [vtspvy] hv' 'lychrb
verses.translation: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, And he is waited for of the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֹ֘דֵ֤ד ה֣וּא לַלֶּ֣חֶם אַיֵּ֑ה יָדַ֓ע  כִּי־נָכ֖וֹן בְּיָד֣וֹ יֽוֹם־חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.translit: ndd hv' llchm 'yh yd'  khynkhvn bydv yvmchshkh
verses.translation: He wandereth abroad for bread: ‘Where is it?’ He knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽ֭בַעֲתֻהוּ צַ֣ר וּמְצוּקָ֑ה תִּ֝תְקְפֵ֗הוּ כְּמֶ֤לֶךְ  עָתִ֬יד לַכִּידֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: yb'thv tsr vmtsvqh ttqphv khmlkh  'tyd lkhydvr
verses.translation: Distress and anguish overwhelm him; They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־נָטָ֣ה אֶל־אֵ֣ל יָד֑וֹ וְאֶל־שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְגַּבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: khynth 'l'l ydv v'lshdy ytgbr
verses.translation: Because he hath stretched out his hand against God, And behaveth himself proudly against the Almighty;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָר֣וּץ אֵלָ֣יו בְּצַוָּ֑אר בַּ֝עֲבִ֗י גַּבֵּ֥י מָגִנָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: yrvts 'lyv btsv'r b'by gby mgnyv
verses.translation: He runneth upon him with a stiff neck, With the thick bosses of his bucklers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־כִסָּ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּחֶלְבּ֑וֹ וַיַּ֖עַשׂ פִּימָ֣ה עֲלֵי־כָֽסֶל׃
verses.translit: khykhsh pnyv bchlbv vy'sh pymh 'lykhsl
verses.translation: Because he hath covered his face with his fatness, And made collops of fat on his loins;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכּ֤וֹן  עָ֘רִ֤ים נִכְחָד֗וֹת בָּ֭תִּים לֹא־יֵ֣שְׁבוּ לָ֑מוֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר הִתְעַתְּד֣וּ לְגַלִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vyshkhvn  'rym nkhchdvt btym l'yshbv lmv 'shr ht'tdv lglym
verses.translation: And he hath dwelt in desolate cities, In houses which no man would inhabit, Which were ready to become heaps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־יֶ֭עְשַׁר וְלֹא־יָק֣וּם חֵיל֑וֹ וְלֹא־יִטֶּ֖ה לָאָ֣רֶץ מִנְלָֽם׃
verses.translit: l'y'shr vl'yqvm chylv vl'yth l'rts mnlm
verses.translation: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, Neither shall their produce bend to the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־יָס֨וּר  מִנִּי־חֹ֗שֶׁךְ יֹ֭נַקְתּוֹ תְּיַבֵּ֣שׁ שַׁלְהָ֑בֶת וְ֝יָס֗וּר בְּר֣וּחַ פִּֽיו׃
verses.translit: l'ysvr  mnychshkh ynqtv tybsh shlhbt vysvr brvch pyv
verses.translation: He shall not depart out of darkness; The flame shall dry up his branches, And by the breath of His mouth shall he go away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־יַאֲמֵ֣ן בַּשָּׁ֣ו נִתְעָ֑ה כִּי־שָׁ֝֗וְא תִּהְיֶ֥ה תְמוּרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'ly'mn bshv nt'h khyshv' thyh tmvrtv
verses.translation: Let him not trust in vanity, deceiving himself; For vanity shall be his recompense.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּֽלֹא־י֭וֹמוֹ תִּמָּלֵ֑א וְ֝כִפָּת֗וֹ לֹ֣א רַעֲנָֽנָה׃
verses.translit: bl'yvmv tml' vkhptv l' r'nnh
verses.translation: It shall be accomplished before his time, And his branch shall not be leafy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַחְמֹ֣ס כַּגֶּ֣פֶן בִּסְר֑וֹ וְיַשְׁלֵ֥ךְ כַּ֝זַּ֗יִת נִצָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: ychms khgpn bsrv vyshlkh khzyt ntstv
verses.translation: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, And shall cast off his flower as the olive.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עֲדַ֣ת חָנֵ֣ף גַּלְמ֑וּד וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ אָכְלָ֥ה אׇהֳלֵי־שֹֽׁחַד׃
verses.translit: khy'dt chnf glmvd v'sh 'khlh 'hlyshchd
verses.translation: For the company of the godless shall be desolate, And fire shall consume the tents of bribery.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָרֹ֣ה עָ֭מָל וְיָ֣לֹֽד אָ֑וֶן וּ֝בִטְנָ֗ם תָּכִ֥ין מִרְמָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hrh 'ml vyld 'vn vbtnm tkhyn mrmh {p}
verses.translation: They conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity, And their belly prepareth deceit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Job answered and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי כְאֵ֣לֶּה רַבּ֑וֹת מְנַחֲמֵ֖י עָמָ֣ל כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: shm'ty kh'lh rbvt mnchmy 'ml khlkhm
verses.translation: I have heard many such things; Sorry comforters are ye all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲקֵ֥ץ לְדִבְרֵי־ר֑וּחַ א֥וֹ מַה־יַּ֝מְרִֽיצְךָ֗ כִּ֣י תַֽעֲנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: hqts ldbryrvch 'v mhymrytskh khy t'nh
verses.translation: Shall windy words have an end? Or what provoketh thee that thou answerest?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֤ם  אָנֹכִי֮ כָּכֶ֢ם אֲדַ֫בֵּ֥רָה ל֤וּ יֵ֪שׁ נַפְשְׁכֶ֡ם תַּ֤חַת נַפְשִׁ֗י אַחְבִּ֣ירָה עֲלֵיכֶ֣ם בְּמִלִּ֑ים וְאָנִ֥יעָה עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם בְּמ֣וֹ רֹאשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: gm  'nkhy khkhm 'dbrh lv ysh npshkhm tcht npshy 'chbyrh 'lykhm bmlym v'ny'h 'lykhm bmv r'shy
verses.translation: I also could speak as ye do; If your soul were in my soul’s stead, I could join words together against you, And shake my head at you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲאַמִּצְכֶ֥ם בְּמוֹ־פִ֑י וְנִ֖יד שְׂפָתַ֣י יַחְשֹֽׂךְ׃
verses.translit: ''mtskhm bmvpy vnyd shpty ychshkh
verses.translation: I would strengthen you with my mouth, And the moving of my lips would assuage your grief.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִֽם־אֲ֭דַבְּרָה לֹא־יֵחָשֵׂ֣ךְ כְּאֵבִ֑י וְ֝אַחְדְּלָ֗ה מַה־מִּנִּ֥י יַהֲלֹֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'm'dbrh l'ychshkh kh'by v'chdlh mhmny yhlkh
verses.translation: Though I speak, my pain is not assuaged; And though I forbear, what am I eased?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־עַתָּ֥ה הֶלְאָ֑נִי הֲ֝שִׁמּ֗וֹתָ כׇּל־עֲדָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'kh'th hl'ny hshmvt khl'dty
verses.translation: But now He hath made me weary; Thou hast made desolate all my company.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽ֭תִּקְמְטֵנִי לְעֵ֣ד הָיָ֑ה וַיָּ֥קׇם בִּ֥י כַ֝חֲשִׁ֗י בְּפָנַ֥י יַעֲנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vtqmtny l'd hyh vyqm by khchshy bpny y'nh
verses.translation: And Thou hast shrivelled me up, which is a witness against me; And my leanness riseth up against me, it testifieth to my face.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַפּ֤וֹ טָרַ֨ף  וַֽיִּשְׂטְמֵ֗נִי חָרַ֣ק עָלַ֣י בְּשִׁנָּ֑יו צָרִ֓י  יִלְטֹ֖שׁ עֵינָ֣יו לִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'pv trf  vyshtmny chrq 'ly bshnyv tsry  yltsh 'ynyv ly
verses.translation: He hath torn me in His wrath, and hated me; He hath gnashed upon me with His teeth; Mine adversary sharpeneth his eyes upon me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּעֲר֬וּ עָלַ֨י  בְּפִיהֶ֗ם בְּ֭חֶרְפָּה הִכּ֣וּ לְחָיָ֑י יַ֝֗חַד עָלַ֥י יִתְמַלָּאֽוּן׃
verses.translit: p'rv 'ly  bpyhm bchrph hkhv lchyy ychd 'ly ytml'vn
verses.translation: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; They have smitten me upon the cheek scornfully; They gather themselves together against me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַסְגִּירֵ֣נִי אֵ֭ל אֶ֣ל עֲוִ֑יל וְעַל־יְדֵ֖י רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִרְטֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: ysgyrny 'l 'l 'vyl v'lydy rsh'ym yrtny
verses.translation: God delivereth me to the ungodly, And casteth me into the hands of the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֘לֵ֤ו הָיִ֨יתִי  וַֽיְפַרְפְּרֵ֗נִי וְאָחַ֣ז בְּ֭עׇרְפִּי וַֽיְפַצְפְּצֵ֑נִי וַיְקִימֵ֥נִי ל֝֗וֹ לְמַטָּרָֽה׃
verses.translit: shlv hyyty  vyprprny v'chz b'rpy vyptsptsny vyqymny lv lmtrh
verses.translation: I was at ease, and He broke me asunder; Yea, He hath taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces; He hath also set me up for His mark.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֘סֹ֤בּוּ עָלַ֨י  רַבָּ֗יו יְפַלַּ֣ח כִּ֭לְיוֹתַי וְלֹ֣א יַחְמֹ֑ל יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ לָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מְרֵרָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: ysbv 'ly  rbyv yplch khlyvty vl' ychml yshpkh l'rts mrrty
verses.translation: His archers compass me round about, He cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; He poureth out my gall upon the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִפְרְצֵ֣נִי פֶ֭רֶץ עַל־פְּנֵי־פָ֑רֶץ יָרֻ֖ץ עָלַ֣י כְּגִבּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: yprtsny prts 'lpnyprts yrts 'ly khgbvr
verses.translation: He breaketh me with breach upon breach; He runneth upon me like a giant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׂ֣ק תָּ֭פַרְתִּי עֲלֵ֣י גִלְדִּ֑י וְעֹלַ֖לְתִּי בֶעָפָ֣ר קַרְנִֽי׃
verses.translit: shq tprty 'ly gldy v'llty b'pr qrny
verses.translation: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, And have laid my horn in the dust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּנַ֣י (חמרמרה) [חֳ֭מַרְמְרוּ] מִנִּי־בֶ֑כִי וְעַ֖ל עַפְעַפַּ֣י צַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: pny (chmrmrh) [chmrmrv] mnybkhy v'l 'p'py tslmvt
verses.translation: My face is reddened with weeping, And on my eyelids is the shadow of death;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֭ל לֹא־חָמָ֣ס בְּכַפָּ֑י וּֽתְפִלָּתִ֥י זַכָּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'l l'chms bkhpy vtplty zkhh
verses.translation: Although there is no violence in my hands, And my prayer is pure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֭רֶץ אַל־תְּכַסִּ֣י דָמִ֑י וְֽאַל־יְהִ֥י מָ֝ק֗וֹם לְזַעֲקָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'rts 'ltkhsy dmy v'lyhy mqvm lz'qty
verses.translation: O earth, cover not thou my blood, And let my cry have no resting-place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־עַ֭תָּה הִנֵּה־בַשָּׁמַ֣יִם עֵדִ֑י וְ֝שָׂהֲדִ֗י בַּמְּרֹמִֽים׃
verses.translit: gm'th hnhbshmym 'dy vshhdy bmrmym
verses.translation: Even now, behold, my Witness is in heaven, And He that testifieth of me is on high.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְלִיצַ֥י רֵעָ֑י אֶל־אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ דָּלְפָ֥ה עֵינִֽי׃
verses.translit: mlytsy r'y 'l'lvh dlph 'yny
verses.translation: Mine inward thoughts are my intercessors, Mine eye poureth out tears unto God;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיוֹכַ֣ח לְגֶ֣בֶר עִם־אֱל֑וֹהַּ וּֽבֶן־אָדָ֥ם לְרֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vyvkhch lgbr 'm'lvh vbn'dm lr'hv
verses.translation: That He would set aright a man contending with God, As a son of man setteth aright his neighbour! .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־שְׁנ֣וֹת מִסְפָּ֣ר יֶאֱתָ֑יוּ וְאֹ֖רַח לֹא־אָשׁ֣וּב אֶהֱלֹֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khyshnvt mspr y'tyv v'rch l''shvb 'hlkh
verses.translation: For the years that are few are coming on, And I shall go the way whence I shall not return.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רוּחִ֣י חֻ֭בָּלָה יָמַ֥י נִזְעָ֗כוּ קְבָרִ֥ים לִֽי׃
verses.translit: rvchy chblh ymy nz'khv qbrym ly
verses.translation: My spirit consumed, my days are extinct, The grave is ready for me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־לֹ֣א הֲ֭תֻלִים עִמָּדִ֑י וּ֝בְהַמְּרוֹתָ֗ם תָּלַ֥ן עֵינִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'ml' htlym 'mdy vbhmrvtm tln 'yny
verses.translation: Surely there are mockers with me, And mine eye abideth in their provocation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִֽׂימָה־נָּ֭א עׇרְבֵ֣נִי עִמָּ֑ךְ מִ֥י ה֝֗וּא לְיָדִ֥י יִתָּקֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: shymhn' 'rbny 'mkh my hv' lydy ytq'
verses.translation: Give now a pledge, be surety for me with Thyself; Who else is there that will strike hands with me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־לִ֭בָּם צָפַ֣נְתָּ מִשָּׂ֑כֶל עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן לֹ֣א תְרֹמֵֽם׃
verses.translit: khylbm tspnt mshkhl 'lkhn l' trmm
verses.translation: For Thou hast hid their heart from understanding; Therefore shalt Thou not exalt them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭חֵלֶק יַגִּ֣יד רֵעִ֑ים וְעֵינֵ֖י בָנָ֣יו תִּכְלֶֽנָה׃
verses.translit: lchlq ygyd r'ym v'yny bnyv tkhlnh
verses.translation: He that denounceth his friends for the sake of flattery, Even the eyes of his children shall fail.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽ֭הִצִּיגַנִי לִמְשֹׁ֣ל עַמִּ֑ים וְתֹ֖פֶת לְפָנִ֣ים אֶהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vhtsygny lmshl 'mym vtpt lpnym 'hyh
verses.translation: He hath made me also a byword of the people; And I am become one in whose face they spit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֣כַהּ מִכַּ֣עַשׂ עֵינִ֑י וִיצֻרַ֖י כַּצֵּ֣ל כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vtkhh mkh'sh 'yny vytsry khtsl khlm
verses.translation: Mine eye also is dimmed by reason of vexation, And all my members are as a shadow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָשֹׁ֣מּוּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים עַל־זֹ֑את וְ֝נָקִ֗י עַל־חָנֵ֥ף יִתְעֹרָֽר׃
verses.translit: yshmv yshrym 'lz't vnqy 'lchnf yt'rr
verses.translation: Upright men are astonished at this, And the innocent stirreth up himself against the godless.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֹאחֵ֣ז צַדִּ֣יק דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּֽטְהׇר־יָ֝דַ֗יִם יֹסִ֥יף אֹֽמֶץ׃
verses.translit: vy'chz tsdyq drkhv vthrydym ysyf 'mts
verses.translation: Yet the righteous holdeth on his way, And he that hath clean hands waxeth stronger and stronger.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם כֻּלָּ֣ם תָּ֭שֻׁבוּ וּבֹ֣אוּ נָ֑א וְלֹֽא־אֶמְצָ֖א בָכֶ֣ם חָכָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'vlm khlm tshbv vb'v n' vl''mts' bkhm chkhm
verses.translation: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now; And I shall not find a wise man among you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָמַ֣י עָ֭בְרוּ זִמֹּתַ֣י נִתְּק֑וּ מ֖וֹרָשֵׁ֣י לְבָבִֽי׃
verses.translit: ymy 'brv zmty ntqv mvrshy lbby
verses.translation: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, Even the thoughts of my heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַ֭יְלָה לְי֣וֹם יָשִׂ֑ימוּ א֝֗וֹר קָר֥וֹב מִפְּנֵי־חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.translit: lylh lyvm yshymv 'vr qrvb mpnychshkh
verses.translation: They change the night into day; The light is short because of darkness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אֲ֭קַוֶּה שְׁא֣וֹל בֵּיתִ֑י בַּ֝חֹ֗שֶׁךְ רִפַּ֥דְתִּי יְצוּעָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'm'qvh sh'vl byty bchshkh rpdty ytsv'y
verses.translation: If I look for the nether-world as my house; If I have spread my couch in the darkness;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַשַּׁ֣חַת קָ֭רָאתִי אָ֣בִי אָ֑תָּה אִמִּ֥י וַ֝אֲחֹתִ֗י לָרִמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: lshcht qr'ty 'by 'th 'my v'chty lrmh
verses.translation: If I have said to corruption: ‘Thou art my father’, To the worm: ‘Thou art my mother, and my sister’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭אַיֵּה אֵפ֣וֹ תִקְוָתִ֑י וְ֝תִקְוָתִ֗י מִ֣י יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: v'yh 'pv tqvty vtqvty my yshvrnh
verses.translation: Where then is my hope? And as for my hope, who shall see it?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּדֵּ֣י שְׁאֹ֣ל תֵּרַ֑דְנָה אִם־יַ֖חַד עַל־עָפָ֣ר נָֽחַת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bdy sh'l trdnh 'mychd 'l'pr ncht {p}
verses.translation: They shall go down to the bars of the nether-world, When we are at rest together in the dust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַשֻּׁחִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n bldd hshchy vy'mr
verses.translation: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־אָ֤נָה  תְּשִׂימ֣וּן קִנְצֵ֣י לְמִלִּ֑ין תָּ֝בִ֗ינוּ וְאַחַ֥ר נְדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: 'd'nh  tshymvn qntsy lmlyn tbynv v'chr ndbr
verses.translation: How long will ye lay snares for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַ֭דּוּעַ נֶחְשַׁ֣בְנוּ כַבְּהֵמָ֑ה נִ֝טְמִ֗ינוּ בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: mdv' nchshbnv khbhmh ntmynv b'ynykhm
verses.translation: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, And reputed dull in your sight?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טֹרֵ֥ף נַפְשׁ֗וֹ בְּאַ֫פּ֥וֹ הַֽ֭לְמַעַנְךָ תֵּעָ֣זַב אָ֑רֶץ וְיֶעְתַּק־צ֝֗וּר מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: trf npshv b'pv hlm'nkh t'zb 'rts vy'tqtsvr mmqmv
verses.translation: Thou that tearest thyself in thine anger, Shall the earth be forsaken for thee? Or shall the rock be removed out of its place? .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֤ם א֣וֹר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָ֑ךְ וְלֹא־יִ֝גַּ֗הּ שְׁבִ֣יב אִשּֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: gm 'vr rsh'ym yd'kh vl'ygh shbyb 'shv
verses.translation: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, And the spark of his fire shall not shine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֭וֹר חָשַׁ֣ךְ בְּאׇהֳל֑וֹ וְ֝נֵר֗וֹ עָלָ֥יו יִדְעָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'vr chshkh b'hlv vnrv 'lyv yd'kh
verses.translation: The light shall be dark in his tent, And his lamp over him shall be put out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֭צְרוּ צַעֲדֵ֣י אוֹנ֑וֹ וְֽתַשְׁלִיכֵ֥הוּ עֲצָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: ytsrv ts'dy 'vnv vtshlykhhv 'tstv
verses.translation: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, And his own counsel shall cast him down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־שֻׁלַּ֣ח בְּרֶ֣שֶׁת בְּרַגְלָ֑יו וְעַל־שְׂ֝בָכָ֗ה יִתְהַלָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khyshlch brsht brglyv v'lshbkhh ythlkh
verses.translation: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, And he walketh upon the toils.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֹאחֵ֣ז בְּעָקֵ֣ב פָּ֑ח יַחֲזֵ֖ק עָלָ֣יו צַמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: y'chz b'qb pch ychzq 'lyv tsmym
verses.translation: A gin shall take him by the heel, And a snare shall lay hold on him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טָמ֣וּן בָּאָ֣רֶץ חַבְל֑וֹ וּ֝מַלְכֻּדְתּ֗וֹ עֲלֵ֣י נָתִֽיב׃
verses.translit: tmvn b'rts chblv vmlkhdtv 'ly ntyb
verses.translation: A noose is hid for him in the ground, And a trap for him in the way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סָ֭בִיב בִּעֲתֻ֣הוּ בַלָּה֑וֹת וֶהֱפִיצֻ֥הוּ לְרַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: sbyb b'thv blhvt vhpytshv lrglyv
verses.translation: Terrors shall overwhelm him on every side, And shall entrap him at his feet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהִי־רָעֵ֥ב אֹנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֵ֗יד נָכ֥וֹן לְצַלְעֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: yhyr'b 'nv v'yd nkhvn ltsl'v
verses.translation: His trouble shall be ravenous, And calamity shall be ready for his fall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֹ֭אכַל בַּדֵּ֣י עוֹר֑וֹ יֹאכַ֥ל בַּ֝דָּ֗יו בְּכ֣וֹר מָֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: y'khl bdy 'vrv y'khl bdyv bkhvr mvt
verses.translation: It shall devour the members of his body, Yea, the first-born of death shall devour his members.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִנָּתֵ֣ק מֵ֭אׇהֳלוֹ מִבְטַח֑וֹ וְ֝תַצְעִדֵ֗הוּ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בַּלָּהֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: yntq m'hlv mbtchv vtts'dhv lmlkh blhvt
verses.translation: That wherein he trusteth shall be plucked out of his tent; And he shall be brought to the king of terrors.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּשְׁכּ֣וֹן בְּ֭אׇהֳלוֹ מִבְּלִיל֑וֹ יְזֹרֶ֖ה עַל־נָוֵ֣הוּ גׇפְרִֽית׃
verses.translit: tshkhvn b'hlv mblylv yzrh 'lnvhv gpryt
verses.translation: There shall dwell in his tent that which is none of his; Brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭תַּחַת שׇׁרָשָׁ֣יו יִבָ֑שׁוּ וּ֝מִמַּ֗עַל יִמַּ֥ל קְצִירֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mtcht shrshyv ybshv vmm'l yml qtsyrv
verses.translation: His roots shall dry up beneath, And above shall his branch wither.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זִֽכְרוֹ־אָ֭בַד מִנִּי־אָ֑רֶץ וְלֹא־שֵׁ֥ם ל֝֗וֹ עַל־פְּנֵי־חֽוּץ׃
verses.translit: zkhrv'bd mny'rts vl'shm lv 'lpnychvts
verses.translation: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, And he shall have no name abroad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֶ֭הְדְּפֻהוּ מֵא֣וֹר אֶל־חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וּֽמִתֵּבֵ֥ל יְנִדֻּֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: yhdphv m'vr 'lchshkh vmtbl yndhv
verses.translation: He shall be driven from light into darkness, And chased out of the world.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֘א־נִ֤ין ל֣וֹ וְלֹא־נֶ֣כֶד בְּעַמּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֥ין שָׂ֝רִ֗יד בִּמְגוּרָֽיו׃
verses.translit: l'nyn lv vl'nkhd b'mv v'yn shryd bmgvryv
verses.translation: He shall have neither son nor son’s son among his people, Nor any remaining in his dwellings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־י֭וֹמוֹ נָשַׁ֣מּוּ אַחֲרֹנִ֑ים וְ֝קַדְמֹנִ֗ים אָ֣חֲזוּ שָֽׂעַר׃
verses.translit: 'lyvmv nshmv 'chrnym vqdmnym 'chzv sh'r
verses.translation: They that come after shall be astonished at his day, As they that went before are affrighted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־אֵ֭לֶּה מִשְׁכְּנ֣וֹת עַוָּ֑ל וְ֝זֶ֗ה מְק֣וֹם לֹֽא־יָדַֽע־אֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'kh'lh mshkhnvt 'vl vzh mqvm l'yd''l {p}
verses.translation: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, And this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Job answered and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־אָ֭נָה תּוֹגְי֣וּן נַפְשִׁ֑י וּֽתְדַכּאוּנַ֥נִי בְמִלִּֽים׃
verses.translit: 'd'nh tvgyvn npshy vtdkh'vnny bmlym
verses.translation: How long will ye vex my soul, And crush me with words?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֤ה עֶ֣שֶׂר פְּ֭עָמִים תַּכְלִימ֑וּנִי לֹֽא־תֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ תַּהְכְּרוּ־לִֽי׃
verses.translit: zh 'shr p'mym tkhlymvny l'tbshv thkhrvly
verses.translation: These ten times have ye reproached me; Ye are not ashamed that ye deal harshly with me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַף־אׇמְנָ֥ם שָׁגִ֑יתִי אִ֝תִּ֗י תָּלִ֥ין מְשׁוּגָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'f'mnm shgyty 'ty tlyn mshvgty
verses.translation: And be it indeed that I have erred, Mine error remaineth with myself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אׇ֭מְנָם עָלַ֣י תַּגְדִּ֑ילוּ וְתוֹכִ֥יחוּ עָ֝לַ֗י חֶרְפָּתִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'm'mnm 'ly tgdylv vtvkhychv 'ly chrpty
verses.translation: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, And plead against me my reproach;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּֽעוּ־אֵ֭פוֹ כִּֽי־אֱל֣וֹהַּ עִוְּתָ֑נִי וּ֝מְצוּד֗וֹ עָלַ֥י הִקִּֽיף׃
verses.translit: d'v'pv khy'lvh 'vtny vmtsvdv 'ly hqyf
verses.translation: Know now that God hath subverted my cause, And hath compassed me with His net.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֤ן אֶצְעַ֣ק חָ֭מָס וְלֹ֣א אֵעָנֶ֑ה אֲ֝שַׁוַּ֗ע וְאֵ֣ין מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: hn 'ts'q chms vl' ''nh 'shv' v'yn mshpt
verses.translation: Behold, I cry out: ‘Violence! ’ but I am not heard; I cry aloud, but there is no justice. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אׇרְחִ֣י גָ֭דַר וְלֹ֣א אֶעֱב֑וֹר וְעַ֥ל נְ֝תִיבוֹתַ֗י חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יָשִֽׂים׃
verses.translit: 'rchy gdr vl' ''bvr v'l ntybvty chshkh yshym
verses.translation: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, And hath set darkness in my paths.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּ֭בוֹדִי מֵעָלַ֣י הִפְשִׁ֑יט וַ֝יָּ֗סַר עֲטֶ֣רֶת רֹאשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: khbvdy m'ly hpshyt vysr 'trt r'shy
verses.translation: He hath stripped me of my glory, And taken the crown from my head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִתְּצֵ֣נִי סָ֭בִיב וָאֵלַ֑ךְ וַיַּסַּ֥ע כָּ֝עֵ֗ץ תִּקְוָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: yttsny sbyb v'lkh vys' kh'ts tqvty
verses.translation: He hath broken me down on every side, and I am gone; And my hope hath He plucked up like a tree.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣חַר עָלַ֣י אַפּ֑וֹ וַיַּחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי ל֣וֹ כְצָרָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vychr 'ly 'pv vychshbny lv khtsryv
verses.translation: He hath also kindled His wrath against me, And He counteth me unto Him as one of His adversaries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֤חַד  יָ֘בֹ֤אוּ גְדוּדָ֗יו וַיָּסֹ֣לּוּ עָלַ֣י דַּרְכָּ֑ם וַיַּחֲנ֖וּ סָבִ֣יב לְאׇהֳלִֽי׃
verses.translit: ychd  yb'v gdvdyv vyslv 'ly drkhm vychnv sbyb l'hly
verses.translation: His troops come on together, And cast up their way against me, And encamp round about my tent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭חַי מֵעָלַ֣י הִרְחִ֑יק וְ֝יֹדְעַ֗י אַךְ־זָ֥רוּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: 'chy m'ly hrchyq vyd'y 'khzrv mmny
verses.translation: He hath put my brethren far from me, And mine acquaintance are wholly estranged from me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָדְל֥וּ קְרוֹבָ֑י וּֽמְיֻדָּעַ֥י שְׁכֵחֽוּנִי׃
verses.translit: chdlv qrvby vmyd'y shkhchvny
verses.translation: My kinsfolk have failed, And my familiar friends have forgotten me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גָּ֘רֵ֤י בֵיתִ֣י וְ֭אַמְהֹתַי לְזָ֣ר תַּחְשְׁבֻ֑נִי נׇ֝כְרִ֗י הָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: gry byty v'mhty lzr tchshbny nkhry hyyty b'ynyhm
verses.translation: They that dwell in my house, and my maids, count me for a stranger; I am become an alien in their sight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְעַבְדִּ֣י קָ֭רָאתִי וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה בְּמוֹ־פִ֝֗י אֶתְחַנֶּן־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: l'bdy qr'ty vl' y'nh bmvpy 'tchnnlv
verses.translation: I call unto my servant, and he giveth me no answer, Though I entreat him with my mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ר֭וּחִי זָ֣רָה לְאִשְׁתִּ֑י וְ֝חַנֹּתִ֗י לִבְנֵ֥י בִטְנִֽי׃
verses.translit: rvchy zrh l'shty vchnty lbny btny
verses.translation: My breath is abhorred of my wife, And I am loathsome to the children of my tribe.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־עֲ֭וִילִים מָ֣אֲסוּ בִ֑י אָ֝ק֗וּמָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ־בִֽי׃
verses.translit: gm'vylym m'sv by 'qvmh vydbrvby
verses.translation: Even urchins despised me; If I arise, they speak against me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּ֭עֲבוּנִי כׇּל־מְתֵ֣י סוֹדִ֑י וְזֶה־אָ֝הַ֗בְתִּי נֶהְפְּכוּ־בִֽי׃
verses.translit: t'bvny khlmty svdy vzh'hbty nhpkhvby
verses.translation: All my intimate friends abhor me; And they whom I loved are turned against me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּעוֹרִ֣י וּ֭בִבְשָׂרִי דָּבְקָ֣ה עַצְמִ֑י וָ֝אֶתְמַלְּטָ֗ה בְּע֣וֹר שִׁנָּֽי׃
verses.translit: b'vry vbbshry dbqh 'tsmy v'tmlth b'vr shny
verses.translation: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, And I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חׇנֻּ֬נִי חׇנֻּ֣נִי אַתֶּ֣ם רֵעָ֑י כִּ֥י יַד־אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ נָ֣גְעָה בִּֽי׃
verses.translit: chnny chnny 'tm r'y khy yd'lvh ng'h by
verses.translation: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; For the hand of God hath touched me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֭מָּה תִּרְדְּפֻ֣נִי כְמוֹ־אֵ֑ל וּ֝מִבְּשָׂרִ֗י לֹ֣א תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: lmh trdpny khmv'l vmbshry l' tshb'v
verses.translation: Why do ye persecute me as God, And are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִי־יִתֵּ֣ן אֵ֭פוֹ וְיִכָּתְב֣וּן מִלָּ֑י מִי־יִתֵּ֖ן בַּסֵּ֣פֶר וְיֻחָֽקוּ׃
verses.translit: myytn 'pv vykhtbvn mly myytn bspr vychqv
verses.translation: Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּעֵט־בַּרְזֶ֥ל וְעֹפָ֑רֶת לָ֝עַ֗ד בַּצּ֥וּר יֵחָצְבֽוּן׃
verses.translit: b'tbrzl v'prt l'd btsvr ychtsbvn
verses.translation: That with an iron pen and lead They were graven in the rock for ever!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י יָ֭דַעְתִּי גֹּ֣אֲלִי חָ֑י וְ֝אַחֲר֗וֹן עַל־עָפָ֥ר יָקֽוּם׃
verses.translit: v'ny yd'ty g'ly chy v'chrvn 'l'pr yqvm
verses.translation: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer liveth, And that He will witness at the last upon the dust;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחַ֣ר ע֭וֹרִי נִקְּפוּ־זֹ֑את וּ֝מִבְּשָׂרִ֗י אֶחֱזֶ֥ה אֱלֽוֹהַּ׃
verses.translit: v'chr 'vry nqpvz't vmbshry 'chzh 'lvh
verses.translation: And when after my skin this is destroyed, Then without my flesh shall I see God;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִ֨י  אֶחֱזֶה־לִּ֗י וְעֵינַ֣י רָא֣וּ וְלֹא־זָ֑ר כָּל֖וּ כִלְיֹתַ֣י בְּחֵקִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'shr 'ny  'chzhly v'yny r'v vl'zr khlv khlyty bchqy
verses.translation: Whom I, even I, shall see for myself, And mine eyes shall behold, and not another’s. My reins are consumed within me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י תֹ֭אמְרוּ מַה־נִּרְדׇּף־ל֑וֹ וְשֹׁ֥רֶשׁ דָּ֝בָ֗ר נִמְצָא־בִֽי׃
verses.translit: khy t'mrv mhnrdflv vshrsh dbr nmts'by
verses.translation: If ye say: ‘How we will persecute him! ’ Seeing that the root of the matter is found in me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גּ֤וּרוּ לָכֶ֨ם  מִפְּנֵי־חֶ֗רֶב כִּֽי־חֵ֭מָה עֲוֺנ֣וֹת חָ֑רֶב לְמַ֖עַן תֵּדְע֣וּן (שדין) [שַׁדּֽוּן]׃ {פ}
verses.translit: gvrv lkhm  mpnychrb khychmh 'vnvt chrb lm'n td'vn (shdyn) [shdvn] {p}
verses.translation: Be ye afraid of the sword; For wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, That ye may know there is a judgment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יַּעַן צֹפַ֥ר הַֽנַּעֲמָתִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n tspr hn'mty vy'mr
verses.translation: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֭כֵן שְׂעִפַּ֣י יְשִׁיב֑וּנִי וּ֝בַעֲב֗וּר ח֣וּשִׁי בִֽי׃
verses.translit: lkhn sh'py yshybvny vb'bvr chvshy by
verses.translation: Therefore do my thoughts give answer to me, Even by reason of mine agitation that is in me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מוּסַ֣ר כְּלִמָּתִ֣י אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וְ֝ר֗וּחַ מִֽבִּינָתִ֥י יַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: mvsr khlmty 'shm' vrvch mbynty y'nny
verses.translation: I have heard the reproof which putteth me to shame, But out of my understanding my spirit answereth me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲזֹ֣את יָ֭דַעְתָּ מִנִּי־עַ֑ד מִנִּ֤י שִׂ֖ים אָדָ֣ם עֲלֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: hz't yd't mny'd mny shym 'dm 'ly'rts
verses.translation: Knowest thou not this of old time, Since man was placed upon earth,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י רִנְנַ֣ת רְ֭שָׁעִים מִקָּר֑וֹב וְשִׂמְחַ֖ת חָנֵ֣ף עֲדֵי־רָֽגַע׃
verses.translit: khy rnnt rsh'ym mqrvb vshmcht chnf 'dyrg'
verses.translation: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, And the joy of the godless but for a moment?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יַעֲלֶ֣ה לַשָּׁמַ֣יִם שִׂיא֑וֹ וְ֝רֹאשׁ֗וֹ לָעָ֥ב יַגִּֽיעַ׃
verses.translit: 'my'lh lshmym shy'v vr'shv l'b ygy'
verses.translation: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, And his head reach unto the clouds;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּֽ֭גֶלְלוֹ לָנֶ֣צַח יֹאבֵ֑ד רֹ֝אָ֗יו יֹאמְר֥וּ אַיּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khgllv lntsch y'bd r'yv y'mrv 'yv
verses.translation: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung; They that have seen him shall say: ‘Where is he?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּחֲל֣וֹם יָ֭עוּף וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָא֑וּהוּ וְ֝יֻדַּ֗ד כְּחֶזְי֥וֹן לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.translit: khchlvm y'vf vl' ymts'vhv vydd khchzyvn lylh
verses.translation: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found; Yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֣יִן שְׁ֭זָפַתּוּ וְלֹ֣א תוֹסִ֑יף וְלֹֽא־ע֝֗וֹד תְּשׁוּרֶ֥נּוּ מְקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'yn shzptv vl' tvsyf vl''vd tshvrnv mqvmv
verses.translation: The eye which saw him shall see him no more; Neither shall his place any more behold him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּ֭נָיו יְרַצּ֣וּ דַלִּ֑ים וְ֝יָדָ֗יו תָּשֵׁ֥בְנָה אוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: bnyv yrtsv dlym vydyv tshbnh 'vnv
verses.translation: His children shall appease the poor, And his hands shall restore his wealth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֭צְמוֹתָיו מָלְא֣וּ עֲלוּמָ֑ו וְ֝עִמּ֗וֹ עַל־עָפָ֥ר תִּשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.translit: 'tsmvtyv ml'v 'lvmv v'mv 'l'pr tshkhb
verses.translation: His bones are full of his youth, But it shall lie down with him in the dust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־תַּמְתִּ֣יק בְּפִ֣יו רָעָ֑ה יַ֝כְחִידֶ֗נָּה תַּ֣חַת לְשֹׁנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'mtmtyq bpyv r'h ykhchydnh tcht lshnv
verses.translation: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, Though he hide it under his tongue;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַחְמֹ֣ל עָ֭לֶיהָ וְלֹ֣א יַעַזְבֶ֑נָּה וְ֝יִמְנָעֶ֗נָּה בְּת֣וֹךְ חִכּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: ychml 'lyh vl' y'zbnh vymn'nh btvkh chkhv
verses.translation: Though he spare it, and will not let it go, But keep it still within his mouth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַ֭חְמוֹ בְּמֵעָ֣יו נֶהְפָּ֑ךְ מְרוֹרַ֖ת פְּתָנִ֣ים בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: lchmv bm'yv nhpkh mrvrt ptnym bqrbv
verses.translation: Yet his food in his bowels is turned, It is the gall of asps within him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַ֣יִל בָּ֭לַע וַיְקִאֶ֑נּוּ מִ֝בִּטְנ֗וֹ יֹרִשֶׁ֥נּוּ אֵֽל׃
verses.translit: chyl bl' vyq'nv mbtnv yrshnv 'l
verses.translation: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again; God shall cast them out of his belly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֹאשׁ־פְּתָנִ֥ים יִינָ֑ק תַּ֝הַרְגֵ֗הוּ לְשׁ֣וֹן אֶפְעֶֽה׃
verses.translit: r'shptnym yynq thrghv lshvn 'p'h
verses.translation: He shall suck the poison of asps; The viper’s tongue shall slay him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־יֵ֥רֶא בִפְלַגּ֑וֹת נַהֲרֵ֥י נַ֝חֲלֵ֗י דְּבַ֣שׁ וְחֶמְאָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lyr' bplgvt nhry nchly dbsh vchm'h
verses.translation: He shall not look upon the rivers, The flowing streams of honey and curd.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵשִׁ֣יב יָ֭גָע וְלֹ֣א יִבְלָ֑ע כְּחֵ֥יל תְּ֝מוּרָת֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲלֹֽס׃
verses.translit: mshyb yg' vl' ybl' khchyl tmvrtv vl' y'ls
verses.translation: That which he laboured for shall he give back, and shall not swallow it down; According to the substance that he hath gotten, he shall not rejoice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־רִ֭צַּץ עָזַ֣ב דַּלִּ֑ים בַּ֥יִת גָּ֝זַ֗ל וְלֹ֣א יִבְנֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: khyrtsts 'zb dlym byt gzl vl' ybnhv
verses.translation: For he hath oppressed and forsaken the poor; He hath violently taken away a house, and he shall not build it up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י  לֹא־יָדַ֣ע שָׁלֵ֣ו בְּבִטְנ֑וֹ בַּ֝חֲמוּד֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט׃
verses.translit: khy  l'yd' shlv bbtnv bchmvdv l' ymlt
verses.translation: Because he knew no quietness within him, In his greed he suffered nought to escape,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵין־שָׂרִ֥יד לְאׇכְל֑וֹ עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן לֹא־יָחִ֥יל טוּבֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'ynshryd l'khlv 'lkhn l'ychyl tvbv
verses.translation: There was nothing left that he devoured not— Therefore his prosperity shall not endure. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּמְלֹ֣אות שִׂ֭פְקוֹ יֵ֣צֶר ל֑וֹ כׇּל־יַ֖ד עָמֵ֣ל תְּבֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: bml'vt shpqv ytsr lv khlyd 'ml tb'nv
verses.translation: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits; The hand of every one that is in misery shall come upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהִ֤י  לְמַלֵּ֬א בִטְנ֗וֹ יְֽשַׁלַּח־בּ֭וֹ חֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑וֹ וְיַמְטֵ֥ר עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ בִּלְחוּמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: yhy  lml' btnv yshlchbv chrvn 'pv vymtr 'lymv blchvmv
verses.translation: It shall be for the filling of his belly; He shall cast the fierceness of His wrath upon him, And shall cause it to rain upon him into his flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
