verses.original: יִ֭בְרַח מִנֵּ֣שֶׁק בַּרְזֶ֑ל תַּ֝חְלְפֵ֗הוּ קֶ֣שֶׁת נְחוּשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: ybrch mnshq brzl tchlphv qsht nchvshh
verses.translation: If he flee from the iron weapon, The bow of brass shall strike him through.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁלַף֮ וַיֵּצֵ֢א מִגֵּ֫וָ֥ה וּ֭בָרָק מִֽמְּרֹרָת֥וֹ יַהֲלֹ֗ךְ עָלָ֥יו אֵמִֽים׃
verses.translit: shlf vyts' mgvh vbrq mmrrtv yhlkh 'lyv 'mym
verses.translation: He draweth it forth, and it cometh out of his body; Yea, the glittering point cometh out of his gall; Terrors are upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־חֹשֶׁךְ֮ טָמ֢וּן לִצְפּ֫וּנָ֥יו תְּ֭אׇכְלֵהוּ אֵ֣שׁ לֹא־נֻפָּ֑ח יֵ֖רַע שָׂרִ֣יד בְּאׇהֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khlchshkh tmvn ltspvnyv t'khlhv 'sh l'npch yr' shryd b'hlv
verses.translation: All darkness is laid up for his treasures; A fire not blown by man shall consume him; It shall go ill with him that is left in his tent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְגַלּ֣וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם עֲוֺנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֶ֗רֶץ מִתְקוֹמָ֘מָ֥ה לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: yglv shmym 'vnv v'rts mtqvmmh lv
verses.translation: The heavens shall reveal his iniquity, And the earth shall rise up against him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֭גֶל יְב֣וּל בֵּית֑וֹ נִ֝גָּר֗וֹת בְּי֣וֹם אַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: ygl ybvl bytv ngrvt byvm 'pv
verses.translation: The increase of his house shall depart, His goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֤ה  חֵלֶק־אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְנַחֲלַ֖ת אִמְר֣וֹ מֵאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: zh  chlq'dm rsh' m'lhym vnchlt 'mrv m'l {p}
verses.translation: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, And the heritage appointed unto him by God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Job answered and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑י וּתְהִי־זֹ֝֗את תַּנְח֥וּמֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: shm'v shmv' mlty vthyz't tnchvmtykhm
verses.translation: Hear diligently my speech; And let this be your consolations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂ֭אוּנִי וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְאַחַ֖ר דַּבְּרִ֣י תַלְעִֽיג׃
verses.translit: sh'vny v'nkhy 'dbr v'chr dbry tl'yg
verses.translation: Suffer me, that I may speak; And after that I have spoken, mock on.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶ֭אָנֹכִי לְאָדָ֣ם שִׂיחִ֑י וְאִם־מַ֝דּ֗וּעַ לֹֽא־תִקְצַ֥ר רוּחִֽי׃
verses.translit: h'nkhy l'dm shychy v'mmdv' l'tqtsr rvchy
verses.translation: As for me, is my complaint to man? Or why should I not be impatient?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּנוּ־אֵלַ֥י וְהָשַׁ֑מּוּ וְשִׂ֖ימוּ יָ֣ד עַל־פֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: pnv'ly vhshmv vshymv yd 'lph
verses.translation: Turn unto me, and be astonished, And lay your hand upon your mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־זָכַ֥רְתִּי וְנִבְהָ֑לְתִּי וְאָחַ֥ז בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י פַּלָּצֽוּת׃
verses.translit: v'mzkhrty vnbhlty v'chz bshry pltsvt
verses.translation: Even when I remember I am affrighted, And horror hath taketh hold on my flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַ֭דּוּעַ רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִֽחְי֑וּ עָ֝תְק֗וּ גַּם־גָּ֥בְרוּ חָֽיִל׃
verses.translit: mdv' rsh'ym ychyv 'tqv gmgbrv chyl
verses.translation: Wherefore do the wicked live, Become old, yea, wax mighty in power?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זַרְעָ֤ם נָכ֣וֹן לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם עִמָּ֑ם וְ֝צֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ֗ם לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: zr'm nkhvn lpnyhm 'mm vts'ts'yhm l'ynyhm
verses.translation: Their seed is established in their sight with them, And their offspring before their eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּתֵּיהֶ֣ם שָׁל֣וֹם מִפָּ֑חַד וְלֹ֤א שֵׁ֖בֶט אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: btyhm shlvm mpchd vl' shbt 'lvh 'lyhm
verses.translation: Their houses are safe, without fear, Neither is the rod of God upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁוֹר֣וֹ עִ֭בַּר וְלֹ֣א יַגְעִ֑ל תְּפַלֵּ֥ט פָּ֝רָת֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א תְשַׁכֵּֽל׃
verses.translit: shvrv 'br vl' yg'l tplt prtv vl' tshkhl
verses.translation: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; Their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְשַׁלְּח֣וּ כַ֭צֹּאן עֲוִילֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝יַלְדֵיהֶ֗ם יְרַקֵּדֽוּן׃
verses.translit: yshlchv khts'n 'vylyhm vyldyhm yrqdvn
verses.translation: They send forth their little ones like a flock, And their children dance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֭שְׂאוּ כְּתֹ֣ף וְכִנּ֑וֹר וְ֝יִשְׂמְח֗וּ לְק֣וֹל עוּגָֽב׃
verses.translit: ysh'v khtf vkhnvr vyshmchv lqvl 'vgb
verses.translation: They sing to the timbrel and harp, And rejoice at the sound of the pipe.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (יבלו) [יְכַלּ֣וּ] בַטּ֣וֹב יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וּ֝בְרֶ֗גַע שְׁא֣וֹל יֵחָֽתּוּ׃
verses.translit: (yblv) [ykhlv] btvb ymyhm vbrg' sh'vl ychtv
verses.translation: They spend their days in prosperity, And peacefully they go down to the grave.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לָ֭אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְדַ֥עַת דְּ֝רָכֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א חָפָֽצְנוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv l'l svr mmnv vd't drkhykh l' chptsnv
verses.translation: Yet they said unto God: ‘Depart from us; For we desire not the knowledge of Thy ways.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־שַּׁדַּ֥י כִּֽי־נַעַבְדֶ֑נּוּ וּמַה־נּ֝וֹעִ֗יל כִּ֣י נִפְגַּע־בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mhshdy khyn'bdnv vmhnv'yl khy npg'bv
verses.translation: What is the Almighty, that we should serve Him? And what profit should we have, if we pray unto Him?’—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֤ן לֹ֣א בְיָדָ֣ם טוּבָ֑ם עֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: hn l' bydm tvbm 'tst rsh'ym rchqh mny
verses.translation: Lo, their prosperity is not in their hand; The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּמָּ֤ה  נֵר־רְשָׁ֘עִ֤ים יִדְעָ֗ךְ וְיָבֹ֣א עָלֵ֣ימוֹ אֵידָ֑ם חֲ֝בָלִ֗ים יְחַלֵּ֥ק בְּאַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khmh  nrrsh'ym yd'kh vyb' 'lymv 'ydm chblym ychlq b'pv
verses.translation: How oft is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out? That their calamity cometh upon them? That He distributeth pains in His anger?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִֽהְי֗וּ כְּתֶ֥בֶן לִפְנֵי־ר֑וּחַ וּ֝כְמֹ֗ץ גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ סוּפָֽה׃
verses.translit: yhyv khtbn lpnyrvch vkhmts gnbtv svph
verses.translation: That they are as stubble before the wind, And as chaff that the storm stealeth away?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱל֗וֹהַּ יִצְפֹּן־לְבָנָ֥יו אוֹנ֑וֹ יְשַׁלֵּ֖ם אֵלָ֣יו וְיֵדָֽע׃
verses.translit: 'lvh ytspnlbnyv 'vnv yshlm 'lyv vyd'
verses.translation: ’God layeth up his iniquity for his children! ’— Let Him recompense it unto himself, that he may know it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְא֣וּ עֵינָ֣ו כִּיד֑וֹ וּמֵחֲמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י יִשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: yr'v 'ynv khydv vmchmt shdy yshth
verses.translation: Let his own eyes see his destruction, And let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י מַה־חֶפְצ֣וֹ בְּבֵית֣וֹ אַחֲרָ֑יו וּמִסְפַּ֖ר חֳדָשָׁ֣יו חֻצָּֽצוּ׃
verses.translit: khy mhchptsv bbytv 'chryv vmspr chdshyv chtstsv
verses.translation: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him? Seeing the number of his months is determined.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַלְאֵ֥ל יְלַמֶּד־דָּ֑עַת וְ֝ה֗וּא רָמִ֥ים יִשְׁפּֽוֹט׃
verses.translit: hl'l ylmdd't vhv' rmym yshpvt
verses.translation: Shall any teach God knowledge? Seeing it is He that judgeth those that are high.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּעֶ֣צֶם תֻּמּ֑וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗וֹ שַׁלְאֲנַ֥ן וְשָׁלֵֽיו׃
verses.translit: zh ymvt b'tsm tmv khlv shl'nn vshlyv
verses.translation: One dieth in his full strength, Being wholly at ease and quiet;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲ֭טִינָיו מָלְא֣וּ חָלָ֑ב וּמֹ֖חַ עַצְמוֹתָ֣יו יְשֻׁקֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'tynyv ml'v chlb vmch 'tsmvtyv yshqh
verses.translation: His pails are full of milk, And the marrow of his bones is moistened.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ מָרָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־אָ֝כַ֗ל בַּטּוֹבָֽה׃
verses.translit: vzh ymvt bnpsh mrh vl''khl btvbh
verses.translation: And another dieth in bitterness of soul, And hath never tasted of good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֭חַד עַל־עָפָ֣ר יִשְׁכָּ֑בוּ וְ֝רִמָּ֗ה תְּכַסֶּ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: ychd 'l'pr yshkhbv vrmh tkhsh 'lyhm
verses.translation: They lie down alike in the dust, And the worm covereth them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֣ן יָ֭דַעְתִּי מַחְשְׁבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וּ֝מְזִמּ֗וֹת עָלַ֥י תַּחְמֹֽסוּ׃
verses.translit: hn yd'ty mchshbvtykhm vmzmvt 'ly tchmsv
verses.translation: Behold, I know your thoughts, And the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י תֹאמְר֗וּ אַיֵּ֥ה בֵית־נָדִ֑יב וְ֝אַיֵּ֗ה אֹ֤הֶל  מִשְׁכְּנ֬וֹת רְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy t'mrv 'yh bytndyb v'yh 'hl  mshkhnvt rsh'ym
verses.translation: For ye say: ‘Where is the house of the prince? And where is the tent wherein the wicked dwelt?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֣א שְׁ֭אֶלְתֶּם ע֣וֹבְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ וְ֝אֹתֹתָ֗ם לֹ֣א תְנַכֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: hl' sh'ltm 'vbry drkh v'ttm l' tnkhrv
verses.translation: Have ye not asked them that go by the way; And will ye misdeem their tokens,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לְי֣וֹם אֵ֭יד יֵחָ֣שֶׂךְ רָ֑ע לְי֖וֹם עֲבָר֣וֹת יוּבָֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: khy lyvm 'yd ychshkh r' lyvm 'brvt yvblv
verses.translation: That the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led forth to the day of wrath?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־יַגִּ֣יד עַל־פָּנָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְהוּא־עָ֝שָׂ֗ה מִ֣י יְשַׁלֶּם־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: myygyd 'lpnyv drkhv vhv''shh my yshlmlv
verses.translation: But who shall declare his way to his face? And who shall repay him what he hath done?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭הוּא לִקְבָר֣וֹת יוּבָ֑ל וְֽעַל־גָּדִ֥ישׁ יִשְׁקֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: vhv' lqbrvt yvbl v'lgdysh yshqvd
verses.translation: For he is borne to the grave, And watch is kept over his tomb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָֽתְקוּ־ל֗וֹ רִגְבֵ֫י־נָ֥חַל וְ֭אַחֲרָיו כׇּל־אָדָ֣ם יִמְשׁ֑וֹךְ וּ֝לְפָנָ֗יו אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.translit: mtqvlv rgbynchl v'chryv khl'dm ymshvkh vlpnyv 'yn mspr
verses.translation: The clods of the valley are sweet unto him, And all men draw after him, As there were innumerable before him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭אֵיךְ תְּנַחֲמ֣וּנִי הָ֑בֶל וּ֝תְשׁ֥וּבֹתֵיכֶ֗ם נִשְׁאַר־מָֽעַל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'ykh tnchmvny hbl vtshvbtykhm nsh'rm'l {p}
verses.translation: How then comfort ye me in vain? And as for your answers, there remaineth only faithlessness?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּמָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'lypz htmny vy'mr
verses.translation: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַלְאֵ֥ל יִסְכׇּן־גָּ֑בֶר כִּֽי־יִסְכֹּ֖ן עָלֵ֣ימוֹ מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: hl'l yskhngbr khyyskhn 'lymv mshkhyl
verses.translation: Can a man be profitable unto God? Or can he that is wise be profitable unto Him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַחֵ֣פֶץ לְ֭שַׁדַּי כִּ֣י תִצְדָּ֑ק וְאִם־בֶּ֝֗צַע כִּֽי־תַתֵּ֥ם דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: hchpts lshdy khy ttsdq v'mbts' khyttm drkhykh
verses.translation: Is it any advantage to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? Or is it gain to Him, that thou makest thy ways blameless?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲֽ֭מִיִּרְאָ֣תְךָ יֹכִיחֶ֑ךָ יָב֥וֹא עִ֝מְּךָ֗ בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: hmyr'tkh ykhychkh ybv' 'mkh bmshpt
verses.translation: Is it for thy fear of Him that He reproveth thee, That He entereth with thee into judgment?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֣א רָעָתְךָ֣ רַבָּ֑ה וְאֵֽין־קֵ֝֗ץ לַעֲוֺנֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: hl' r'tkh rbh v'ynqts l'vntykh
verses.translation: Is not thy wickedness great? And are not thine iniquities without end?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תַחְבֹּ֣ל אַחֶ֣יךָ חִנָּ֑ם וּבִגְדֵ֖י עֲרוּמִּ֣ים תַּפְשִֽׁיט׃
verses.translit: khytchbl 'chykh chnm vbgdy 'rvmym tpshyt
verses.translation: For thou hast taken pledges of thy brother for nought, And stripped the naked of their clothing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־מַ֭יִם עָיֵ֣ף תַּשְׁקֶ֑ה וּ֝מֵרָעֵ֗ב תִּֽמְנַֽע־לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translit: l'mym 'yf tshqh vmr'b tmn'lchm
verses.translation: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, And thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֣ישׁ זְ֭רוֹעַ ל֣וֹ הָאָ֑רֶץ וּנְשׂ֥וּא פָ֝נִ֗ים יֵ֣שֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'ysh zrv' lv h'rts vnshv' pnym yshb bh
verses.translation: And as a mighty man, who hath the earth, And as a man of rank, who dwelleth in it,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭לְמָנוֹת שִׁלַּ֣חְתָּ רֵיקָ֑ם וּזְרֹע֖וֹת יְתֹמִ֣ים יְדֻכָּֽא׃
verses.translit: 'lmnvt shlcht ryqm vzr'vt ytmym ydkh'
verses.translation: Thou hast sent widows away empty, And the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֭ן סְבִיבוֹתֶ֣יךָ פַחִ֑ים וִ֝יבַהֶלְךָ֗ פַּ֣חַד פִּתְאֹֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn sbybvtykh pchym vybhlkh pchd pt'm
verses.translation: Therefore snares are round about thee, And sudden dread affrighted thee,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹ־חֹ֥שֶׁךְ לֹֽא־תִרְאֶ֑ה וְֽשִׁפְעַת־מַ֥יִם תְּכַסֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: 'vchshkh l'tr'h vshp'tmym tkhskh
verses.translation: Or darkness, that thou canst not see, And abundance of waters cover thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲֽלֹא־אֱ֭לוֹהַּ גֹּ֣בַהּ שָׁמָ֑יִם וּרְאֵ֤ה רֹ֖אשׁ כּוֹכָבִ֣ים כִּי־רָֽמּוּ׃
verses.translit: hl''lvh gbh shmym vr'h r'sh khvkhbym khyrmv
verses.translation: Is not God in the height of heaven? And behold the topmost of the stars, how high they are!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽ֭אָמַרְתָּ מַה־יָּ֣דַֽע אֵ֑ל הַבְעַ֖ד עֲרָפֶ֣ל יִשְׁפּֽוֹט׃
verses.translit: v'mrt mhyd' 'l hb'd 'rpl yshpvt
verses.translation: And thou sayest: ‘What doth God know? Can He judge through the dark cloud?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָבִ֣ים סֵֽתֶר־ל֭וֹ וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֶ֑ה וְח֥וּג שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יִתְהַלָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'bym strlv vl' yr'h vchvg shmym ythlkh
verses.translation: Thick clouds are a covering to Him, that He seeth not; And He walketh in the circuit of heaven.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַאֹ֣רַח עוֹלָ֣ם תִּשְׁמ֑וֹר אֲשֶׁ֖ר דָּרְכ֣וּ מְתֵי־אָֽוֶן׃
verses.translit: h'rch 'vlm tshmvr 'shr drkhv mty'vn
verses.translation: Wilt thou keep the old way Which wicked men have trodden?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶֽׁר־קֻמְּט֥וּ וְלֹא־עֵ֑ת נָ֝הָ֗ר יוּצַ֥ק יְסוֹדָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'shrqmtv vl''t nhr yvtsq ysvdm
verses.translation: Who were snatched away before their time, Whose foundation was poured out as a stream;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֹמְרִ֣ים לָ֭אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וּמַה־יִּפְעַ֖ל שַׁדַּ֣י לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: h'mrym l'l svr mmnv vmhyp'l shdy lmv
verses.translation: Who said unto God: ‘Depart from us’; And what could the Almighty do unto them?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְה֤וּא מִלֵּ֣א בָתֵּיהֶ֣ם ט֑וֹב וַעֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: vhv' ml' btyhm tvb v'tst rsh'ym rchqh mny
verses.translation: Yet He filled their houses with good things— But the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְא֣וּ צַדִּיקִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְ֝נָקִ֗י יִלְעַג־לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: yr'v tsdyqym vyshmchv vnqy yl'glmv
verses.translation: The righteous saw it, and were glad, And the innocent laugh them to scorn:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־לֹ֣א נִכְחַ֣ד קִימָ֑נוּ וְ֝יִתְרָ֗ם אָ֣כְלָה אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'ml' nkhchd qymnv vytrm 'khlh 'sh
verses.translation: ’Surely their substance is cut off, And their abundance the fire hath consumed.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַסְכֶּן־נָ֣א עִמּ֣וֹ וּשְׁלָ֑ם בָּ֝הֶ֗ם תְּֽבוֹאַתְךָ֥ טוֹבָֽה׃
verses.translit: hskhnn' 'mv vshlm bhm tbv'tkh tvbh
verses.translation: Acquaint now thyself with Him, and be at peace; Thereby shall thine increase be good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קַח־נָ֣א מִפִּ֣יו תּוֹרָ֑ה וְשִׂ֥ים אֲ֝מָרָ֗יו בִּלְבָבֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: qchn' mpyv tvrh vshym 'mryv blbbkh
verses.translation: Receive, I pray thee, instruction from His mouth, And lay up His words in thy heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־תָּשׁ֣וּב עַד־שַׁ֭דַּי תִּבָּנֶ֑ה תַּֽרְחִ֥יק עַ֝וְלָ֗ה מֵאׇהֳלֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'mtshvb 'dshdy tbnh trchyq 'vlh m'hlkh
verses.translation: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up— If thou put away unrighteousness far from thy tents,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁית־עַל־עָפָ֥ר בָּ֑צֶר וּכְצ֖וּר נְחָלִ֣ים אוֹפִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vshyt'l'pr btsr vkhtsvr nchlym 'vpyr
verses.translation: And lay thy treasure in the dust, And the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה שַׁדַּ֣י בְּצָרֶ֑יךָ וְכֶ֖סֶף תּוֹעָפ֣וֹת לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vhyh shdy btsrykh vkhsf tv'pvt lkh
verses.translation: And the Almighty be thy treasure, And precious silver unto thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־אָ֭ז עַל־שַׁדַּ֣י תִּתְעַנָּ֑ג וְתִשָּׂ֖א אֶל־אֱל֣וֹהַּ פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: khy'z 'lshdy tt'ng vtsh' 'l'lvh pnykh
verses.translation: Then surely shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, And shalt lift up thy face unto God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּעְתִּ֣יר אֵ֭לָיו וְיִשְׁמָעֶ֑ךָּ וּנְדָרֶ֥יךָ תְשַׁלֵּֽם׃
verses.translit: t'tyr 'lyv vyshm'kh vndrykh tshlm
verses.translation: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto Him, and He will hear thee, And thou shalt pay thy vows;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽתִגְזַר־אֹ֭מֶר וְיָ֣קׇם־לָ֑ךְ וְעַל־דְּ֝רָכֶ֗יךָ נָ֣גַהּ אֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vtgzr'mr vyqmlkh v'ldrkhykh ngh 'vr
verses.translation: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, And light shall shine upon thy ways.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִ֭שְׁפִּילוּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר גֵּוָ֑ה וְשַׁ֖ח עֵינַ֣יִם יוֹשִֽׁעַ׃
verses.translit: khyhshpylv vt'mr gvh vshch 'ynym yvsh'
verses.translation: When they cast thee down, thou shalt say: ‘There is lifting up’; For the humble person He saveth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְמַלֵּ֥ט אִֽי־נָקִ֑י וְ֝נִמְלַ֗ט בְּבֹ֣ר כַּפֶּֽיךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: ymlt 'ynqy vnmlt bbr khpykh {p}
verses.translation: He delivereth him that is innocent, Yea, thou shalt be delivered through the cleanness of thy hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Job answered and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־הַ֭יּוֹם מְרִ֣י שִׂחִ֑י יָ֝דִ֗י כָּבְדָ֥ה עַל־אַנְחָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: gmhyvm mry shchy ydy khbdh 'l'nchty
verses.translation: Even to-day is my complaint bitter; My hand is become heavy because of my groaning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־יִתֵּ֣ן יָ֭דַעְתִּי וְאֶמְצָאֵ֑הוּ אָ֝ב֗וֹא עַד־תְּכוּנָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: myytn yd'ty v'mts'hv 'bv' 'dtkhvntv
verses.translation: Oh that I knew where I might find Him, That I might come even to His seat!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶעֶרְכָ֣ה לְפָנָ֣יו מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝פִ֗י אֲמַלֵּ֥א תוֹכָחֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: ''rkhh lpnyv mshpt vpy 'ml' tvkhchvt
verses.translation: I would order my cause before Him, And fill my mouth with arguments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֭דְעָה מִלִּ֣ים יַעֲנֵ֑נִי וְ֝אָבִ֗ינָה מַה־יֹּ֥אמַר לִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'd'h mlym y'nny v'bynh mhy'mr ly
verses.translation: I would know the words which He would answer me, And understand what He would say unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַבְּרׇב־כֹּ֭חַ יָרִ֣יב עִמָּדִ֑י לֹ֥א אַךְ־ה֝֗וּא יָשִׂ֥ם בִּֽי׃
verses.translit: hbrbkhch yryb 'mdy l' 'khhv' yshm by
verses.translation: Would He contend with me in His great power? Nay; but He would give heed unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֗ם יָ֭שָׁר נוֹכָ֣ח עִמּ֑וֹ וַאֲפַלְּטָ֥ה לָ֝נֶ֗צַח מִשֹּׁפְטִֽי׃
verses.translit: shm yshr nvkhch 'mv v'plth lntsch mshpty
verses.translation: There the upright might reason with Him; So should I be delivered for ever from my Judge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֤ן קֶ֣דֶם אֶהֱלֹ֣ךְ וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וְ֝אָח֗וֹר וְֽלֹא־אָבִ֥ין לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hn qdm 'hlkh v'ynnv v'chvr vl''byn lv
verses.translation: Behold, I go forward, but He is not there, And backward, but I cannot perceive Him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂמֹ֣אול בַּעֲשֹׂת֣וֹ וְלֹא־אָ֑חַז יַעְטֹ֥ף יָ֝מִ֗ין וְלֹ֣א אֶרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: shm'vl b'shtv vl''chz y'tf ymyn vl' 'r'h
verses.translation: On the left hand, when He doth work, but I cannot behold Him, He turneth Himself to the right hand, but I cannot see Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יָ֭דַע דֶּ֣רֶךְ עִמָּדִ֑י בְּ֝חָנַ֗נִי כַּזָּהָ֥ב אֵצֵֽא׃
verses.translit: khyyd' drkh 'mdy bchnny khzhb 'ts'
verses.translation: For He knoweth the way that I take; When He hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּ֭אֲשֻׁרוֹ אָחֲזָ֣ה רַגְלִ֑י דַּרְכּ֖וֹ שָׁמַ֣רְתִּי וְלֹא־אָֽט׃
verses.translit: b'shrv 'chzh rgly drkhv shmrty vl''t
verses.translation: My foot hath held fast to His steps, His way have I kept, and turned not aside.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִצְוַ֣ת שְׂ֭פָתָיו וְלֹ֣א אָמִ֑ישׁ מֵ֝חֻקִּ֗י צָפַ֥נְתִּי אִמְרֵי־פִֽיו׃
verses.translit: mtsvt shptyv vl' 'mysh mchqy tspnty 'mrypyv
verses.translation: I have not gone back from the commandment of His lips; I have treasured up the words of His mouth more than my necessary food.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְה֣וּא בְ֭אֶחָד וּמִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹ אִוְּתָ֣ה וַיָּֽעַשׂ׃
verses.translit: vhv' b'chd vmy yshybnv vnpshv 'vth vy'sh
verses.translation: But He is at one with Himself, and who can turn Him? And what His soul desireth, even that He doeth. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֭י יַשְׁלִ֣ים חֻקִּ֑י וְכָהֵ֖נָּה רַבּ֣וֹת עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy yshlym chqy vkhhnh rbvt 'mv
verses.translation: For He will perform that which is appointed for me; And many such things are with Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֭ן מִפָּנָ֣יו אֶבָּהֵ֑ל אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן וְאֶפְחַ֥ד מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn mpnyv 'bhl 'tbvnn v'pchd mmnv
verses.translation: Therefore am I affrighted at His presence; When I consider, I am afraid of Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭אֵל הֵרַ֣ךְ לִבִּ֑י וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י הִבְהִילָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: v'l hrkh lby vshdy hbhylny
verses.translation: Yea, God hath made my heart faint, And the Almighty hath affrighted me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־לֹ֣א נִ֭צְמַתִּי מִפְּנֵי־חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וּ֝מִפָּנַ֗י כִּסָּה־אֹֽפֶל׃
verses.translit: khyl' ntsmty mpnychshkh vmpny khsh'pl
verses.translation: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, Neither did He cover the thick darkness from my face.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַדּ֗וּעַ מִ֭שַּׁדַּי לֹא־נִצְפְּנ֣וּ עִתִּ֑ים וְ֝יֹדְעָ֗ו לֹא־חָ֥זוּ יָמָֽיו׃
verses.translit: mdv' mshdy l'ntspnv 'tym vyd'v l'chzv ymyv
verses.translation: Why are times not laid up by the Almighty? And why do not they that know Him see His days?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גְּבֻל֥וֹת יַשִּׂ֑יגוּ עֵ֥דֶר גָּ֝זְל֗וּ וַיִּרְעֽוּ׃
verses.translit: gblvt yshygv 'dr gzlv vyr'v
verses.translation: There are that remove the landmarks; They violently take away flocks, and feed them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲמ֣וֹר יְתוֹמִ֣ים יִנְהָ֑גוּ יַ֝חְבְּל֗וּ שׁ֣וֹר אַלְמָנָֽה׃
verses.translit: chmvr ytvmym ynhgv ychblv shvr 'lmnh
verses.translation: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, They take the widow’s ox for a pledge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַטּ֣וּ אֶבְיֹנִ֣ים מִדָּ֑רֶךְ יַ֥חַד חֻ֝בְּא֗וּ עֲנִיֵּי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: ytv 'bynym mdrkh ychd chb'v 'nyy'rts
verses.translation: They turn the needy out of the way; The poor of the earth hide themselves together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֤ן פְּרָאִ֨ים  בַּ֥מִּדְבָּ֗ר יָצְא֣וּ בְּ֭פׇעֳלָם מְשַׁחֲרֵ֣י לַטָּ֑רֶף עֲרָבָ֥ה ל֥וֹ לֶ֝֗חֶם לַנְּעָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: hn pr'ym  bmdbr yts'v bp'lm mshchry ltrf 'rbh lv lchm ln'rym
verses.translation: Behold, as wild asses in the wilderness They go forth to their work, seeking diligently for food; The desert yieldeth them bread for their children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּ֭שָּׂדֶה בְּלִיל֣וֹ (יקצירו) [יִקְצ֑וֹרוּ] וְכֶ֖רֶם רָשָׁ֣ע יְלַקֵּֽשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: bshdh blylv (yqtsyrv) [yqtsvrv] vkhrm rsh' ylqshv
verses.translation: They cut his provender in the field; And they despoil the vineyard of the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָר֣וֹם יָ֭לִינוּ מִבְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת בַּקָּרָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'rvm ylynv mbly lbvsh v'yn khsvt bqrh
verses.translation: They lie all night naked without clothing, And have no covering in the cold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזֶּ֣רֶם הָרִ֣ים יִרְטָ֑בוּ וּֽמִבְּלִ֥י מַ֝חְסֶ֗ה חִבְּקוּ־צֽוּר׃
verses.translit: mzrm hrym yrtbv vmbly mchsh chbqvtsvr
verses.translation: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, And embrace the rock for want of a shelter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֭גְזְלוּ מִשֹּׁ֣ד יָת֑וֹם וְֽעַל־עָנִ֥י יַחְבֹּֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: ygzlv mshd ytvm v'l'ny ychblv
verses.translation: There are that pluck the fatherless from the breast, And take a pledge of the poor;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָר֣וֹם הִ֭לְּכוּ בְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וּ֝רְעֵבִ֗ים נָ֣שְׂאוּ עֹֽמֶר׃
verses.translit: 'rvm hlkhv bly lbvsh vr'bym nsh'v 'mr
verses.translation: So that they go about naked without clothing, And being hungry they carry the sheaves;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּין־שׁוּרֹתָ֥ם יַצְהִ֑ירוּ יְקָבִ֥ים דָּ֝רְכ֗וּ וַיִּצְמָֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: bynshvrtm ytshyrv yqbym drkhv vytsm'v
verses.translation: They make oil within the rows of these men; They tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵ֘עִ֤יר מְתִ֨ים  יִנְאָ֗קוּ וְנֶֽפֶשׁ־חֲלָלִ֥ים תְּשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וֶ֝אֱל֗וֹהַּ לֹֽא־יָשִׂ֥ים תִּפְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: m'yr mtym  yn'qv vnpshchllym tshv' v'lvh l'yshym tplh
verses.translation: From out of the populous city men groan, And the soul of the wounded crieth out; Yet God imputeth it not for unseemliness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֤מָּה  הָיוּ֮ בְּֽמֹרְדֵ֫י־א֥וֹר לֹא־הִכִּ֥ירוּ דְרָכָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יָ֝שְׁב֗וּ בִּנְתִיבֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hmh  hyv bmrdy'vr l'hkhyrv drkhyv vl' yshbv bntybtyv
verses.translation: These are of them that rebel against the light; They know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָא֡וֹר יָ֘ק֤וּם רוֹצֵ֗חַ יִֽקְטׇל־עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן וּ֝בַלַּ֗יְלָה יְהִ֣י כַגַּנָּֽב׃
verses.translit: l'vr yqvm rvtsch yqtl'ny v'byvn vblylh yhy khgnb
verses.translation: The murderer riseth with the light, to kill the poor and needy; And in the night he is as a thief.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֵ֤ין נֹאֵ֨ף  שָׁ֤מְרָֽה־נֶ֣שֶׁף לֵ֭אמֹר לֹא־תְשׁוּרֵ֣נִי עָ֑יִן וְסֵ֖תֶר פָּנִ֣ים יָשִֽׂים׃
verses.translit: v'yn n'f  shmrhnshf l'mr l'tshvrny 'yn vstr pnym yshym
verses.translation: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, Saying: ‘No eye shall see me’; And he putteth a covering on his face. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָתַ֥ר בַּחֹ֗שֶׁךְ בָּ֫תִּ֥ים יוֹמָ֥ם חִתְּמוּ־לָ֗מוֹ לֹא־יָ֥דְעוּ אֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: chtr bchshkh btym yvmm chtmvlmv l'yd'v 'vr
verses.translation: In the dark they dig through houses; They shut themselves up in the day-time; They know not the light.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י יַחְדָּ֨ו  בֹּ֣קֶר לָ֣מוֹ צַלְמָ֑וֶת כִּֽי־יַ֝כִּ֗יר בַּלְה֥וֹת צַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: khy ychdv  bqr lmv tslmvt khyykhyr blhvt tslmvt
verses.translation: For the shadow of death is to all of them as the morning; For they know the terrors of the shadow of death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קַל־ה֤וּא  עַל־פְּנֵי־מַ֗יִם תְּקֻלַּ֣ל חֶלְקָתָ֣ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ לֹא־יִ֝פְנֶ֗ה דֶּ֣רֶךְ כְּרָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: qlhv'  'lpnymym tqll chlqtm b'rts l'ypnh drkh khrmym
verses.translation: He is swift upon the face of the waters; Their portion is cursed in the earth; He turneth not by the way of the vineyards.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צִיָּ֤ה גַם־חֹ֗ם יִגְזְל֥וּ מֵֽימֵי־שֶׁ֗לֶג שְׁא֣וֹל חָטָֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: tsyh gmchm ygzlv mymyshlg sh'vl cht'v
verses.translation: Drought and heat consume the snow waters; So doth the nether-world those that have sinned.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׁכָּ֘חֵ֤הוּ רֶ֨חֶם  מְתָ֘ק֤וֹ רִמָּ֗ה ע֥וֹד לֹֽא־יִזָּכֵ֑ר וַתִּשָּׁבֵ֖ר כָּעֵ֣ץ עַוְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: yshkhchhv rchm  mtqv rmh 'vd l'yzkhr vtshbr kh'ts 'vlh
verses.translation: The womb forgetteth him; the worm feedeth sweetly on him; He shall be no more remembered; And unrighteousness is broken as a tree.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֹעֶ֣ה עֲ֭קָרָה לֹ֣א תֵלֵ֑ד וְ֝אַלְמָנָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְיֵטִֽיב׃
verses.translit: r'h 'qrh l' tld v'lmnh l' yytyb
verses.translation: He devoureth the barren that beareth not; And doeth not good to the widow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָשַׁ֣ךְ אַבִּירִ֣ים בְּכֹח֑וֹ יָ֝ק֗וּם וְֽלֹא־יַאֲמִ֥ין בַּחַיִּֽין׃
verses.translit: vmshkh 'byrym bkhchv yqvm vl'y'myn bchyyn
verses.translation: He draweth away the mighty also by his power; He riseth up, and he trusteth not his own life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִתֶּן־ל֣וֹ לָ֭בֶטַח וְיִשָּׁעֵ֑ן וְ֝עֵינֵ֗יהוּ עַל־דַּרְכֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: ytnlv lbtch vysh'n v'ynyhv 'ldrkhyhm
verses.translation: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth, Yet His eyes are upon their ways.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ר֤וֹמּוּ מְּעַ֨ט  וְֽאֵינֶ֗נּוּ וְֽהֻמְּכ֗וּ כַּכֹּ֥ל יִקָּפְצ֑וּן וּכְרֹ֖אשׁ שִׁבֹּ֣לֶת יִמָּֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: rvmv m't  v'ynnv vhmkhv khkhl yqptsvn vkhr'sh shblt ymlv
verses.translation: They are exalted for a little while, and they are gone; Yea, they are brought low, they are gathered in as all others, And wither as the tops of the ears of corn.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־לֹ֣א אֵ֭פוֹ מִ֣י יַכְזִיבֵ֑נִי וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְ֝אַ֗ל מִלָּתִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'ml' 'pv my ykhzybny vyshm l'l mlty {p}
verses.translation: And if it be not so now, who will prove me a liar, And make my speech nothing worth?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַשֻּׁחִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n bldd hshchy vy'mr
verses.translation: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמְשֵׁ֣ל וָפַ֣חַד עִמּ֑וֹ עֹשֶׂ֥ה שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם בִּמְרוֹמָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hmshl vpchd 'mv 'shh shlvm bmrvmyv
verses.translation: Dominion and fear are with Him; He maketh peace in His high places.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיֵ֣שׁ מִ֭סְפָּר לִגְדוּדָ֑יו וְעַל־מִ֝֗י לֹא־יָק֥וּם אוֹרֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: hysh mspr lgdvdyv v'lmy l'yqvm 'vrhv
verses.translation: Is there any number of His armies? And upon whom doth not His light arise?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַה־יִּצְדַּ֣ק אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עִם־אֵ֑ל וּמַה־יִּ֝זְכֶּ֗ה יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vmhytsdq 'nvsh 'm'l vmhyzkhh ylvd 'shh
verses.translation: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֣ן עַד־יָ֭רֵחַ וְלֹ֣א יַאֲהִ֑יל וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים לֹא־זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hn 'dyrch vl' y'hyl vkhvkhbym l'zkhv b'ynyv
verses.translation: Behold, even the moon hath no brightness, And the stars are not pure in His sight;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭ף כִּֽי־אֱנ֣וֹשׁ רִמָּ֑ה וּבֶן־אָ֝דָ֗ם תּוֹלֵעָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'f khy'nvsh rmh vbn'dm tvl'h {p}
verses.translation: How much less man, that is a worm! And the son of man, that is a maggot!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Job answered and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶה־עָזַ֥רְתָּ לְלֹא־כֹ֑חַ ה֝וֹשַׁ֗עְתָּ זְר֣וֹעַ לֹא־עֹֽז׃
verses.translit: mh'zrt ll'khch hvsh't zrv' l''z
verses.translation: How hast thou helped him that is without power! How hast thou saved the arm that hath no strength!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־יָּ֭עַצְתָּ לְלֹ֣א חׇכְמָ֑ה וְ֝תֻשִׁיָּ֗ה לָרֹ֥ב הוֹדָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.translit: mhy'tst ll' chkhmh vtshyh lrb hvd't
verses.translation: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom, And plentifully declared sound knowledge!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־מִ֭י הִגַּ֣דְתָּ מִלִּ֑ין וְנִשְׁמַת־מִ֝֗י יָצְאָ֥ה מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: 'tmy hgdt mlyn vnshmtmy yts'h mmkh
verses.translation: With whose help hast thou uttered words? And whose spirit came forth from thee?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָרְפָאִ֥ים יְחוֹלָ֑לוּ מִתַּ֥חַת מַ֝֗יִם וְשֹׁכְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: hrp'ym ychvllv mtcht mym vshkhnyhm
verses.translation: The shades tremble Beneath the waters and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָר֣וֹם שְׁא֣וֹל נֶגְדּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָאֲבַדּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: 'rvm sh'vl ngdv v'yn khsvt l'bdvn
verses.translation: The nether-world is naked before Him, And Destruction hath no covering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֹטֶ֣ה צָפ֣וֹן עַל־תֹּ֑הוּ תֹּ֥לֶה אֶ֝֗רֶץ עַל־בְּלִי־מָֽה׃
verses.translit: nth tspvn 'lthv tlh 'rts 'lblymh
verses.translation: He stretcheth out the north over the empty space, And hangeth the earth over nothing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צֹרֵֽר־מַ֥יִם בְּעָבָ֑יו וְלֹֽא־נִבְקַ֖ע עָנָ֣ן תַּחְתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: tsrrmym b'byv vl'nbq' 'nn tchtm
verses.translation: He bindeth up the waters in His thick clouds; And the cloud is not rent under them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְאַחֵ֥ז פְּנֵֽי־כִסֵּ֑ה פַּרְשֵׁ֖ז עָלָ֣יו עֲנָנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: m'chz pnykhsh prshz 'lyv 'nnv
verses.translation: He closeth in the face of His throne, And spreadeth His cloud upon it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֹֽק־חָ֭ג עַל־פְּנֵי־מָ֑יִם עַד־תַּכְלִ֖ית א֣וֹר עִם־חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.translit: chqchg 'lpnymym 'dtkhlyt 'vr 'mchshkh
verses.translation: He hath described a boundary upon the face of the waters, Unto the confines of light and darkness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַמּוּדֵ֣י שָׁמַ֣יִם יְרוֹפָ֑פוּ וְ֝יִתְמְה֗וּ מִגַּעֲרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'mvdy shmym yrvppv vytmhv mg'rtv
verses.translation: The pillars of heaven tremble And are astonished at His rebuke.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭כֹחוֹ רָגַ֣ע הַיָּ֑ם (ובתובנתו) [וּ֝בִתְבוּנָת֗וֹ] מָ֣חַץ רָֽהַב׃
verses.translit: bkhchv rg' hym (vbtvbntv) [vbtbvntv] mchts rhb
verses.translation: He stirreth up the sea with His power, And by His understanding He smiteth through Rahab.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭רוּחוֹ שָׁמַ֣יִם שִׁפְרָ֑ה חֹלְלָ֥ה יָ֝ד֗וֹ נָחָ֥שׁ בָּרִֽחַ׃
verses.translit: brvchv shmym shprh chllh ydv nchsh brch
verses.translation: By His breath the heavens are serene; His hand hath pierced the slant serpent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶן־אֵ֤לֶּה  קְצ֬וֹת דְּרָכָ֗ו וּמַה־שֵּׁ֣מֶץ דָּ֭בָר נִשְׁמַע־בּ֑וֹ וְרַ֥עַם גְּ֝בוּרֹתָ֗ו מִ֣י יִתְבּוֹנָֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hn'lh  qtsvt drkhv vmhshmts dbr nshm'bv vr'm gbvrtv my ytbvnn {p}
verses.translation: Lo, these are but the outskirts of His ways; And how small a whisper is heard of Him! But the thunder of His mighty deeds who can understand?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣סֶף אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת מְשָׁל֗וֹ וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vysf 'yvb sh't mshlv vy'mr
verses.translation: And Job again took up his parable, and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַי־אֵ֭ל הֵסִ֣יר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י הֵמַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: chy'l hsyr mshpty vshdy hmr npshy
verses.translation: As God liveth, who hath taken away my right; And the Almighty, who hath dealt bitterly with me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כׇל־ע֣וֹד נִשְׁמָתִ֣י בִ֑י וְר֖וּחַ אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּאַפִּֽי׃
verses.translit: khykhl'vd nshmty by vrvch 'lvh b'py
verses.translation: All the while my breath is in me And the spirit of God is in my nostrils,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־תְּדַבֵּ֣רְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣י עַוְלָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנִ֗י אִם־יֶהְגֶּ֥ה רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'mtdbrnh shpty 'vlh vlshvny 'myhgh rmyh
verses.translation: Surely my lips shall not speak unrighteousness, Neither shall my tongue utter deceit;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָלִ֣ילָה לִּי֮ אִם־אַצְדִּ֢יק אֶ֫תְכֶ֥ם עַד־אֶגְוָ֑ע לֹֽא־אָסִ֖יר תֻּמָּתִ֣י מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: chlylh ly 'm'tsdyq 'tkhm 'd'gv' l''syr tmty mmny
verses.translation: Far be it from me that I should justify you; Till I die I will not put away mine integrity from me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּצִדְקָתִ֣י הֶ֭חֱזַקְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אַרְפֶּ֑הָ לֹא־יֶחֱרַ֥ף לְ֝בָבִ֗י מִיָּמָֽי׃
verses.translit: btsdqty hchzqty vl' 'rph l'ychrf lbby mymy
verses.translation: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go; My heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהִ֣י כְ֭רָשָׁע אֹ֣יְבִ֑י וּמִתְקוֹמְמִ֥י כְעַוָּֽל׃
verses.translit: yhy khrsh' 'yby vmtqvmmy kh'vl
verses.translation: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, And let him that riseth up against me be as the unrighteous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י מַה־תִּקְוַ֣ת חָ֭נֵף כִּ֣י יִבְצָ֑ע כִּ֤י יֵ֖שֶׁל אֱל֣וֹהַּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy mhtqvt chnf khy ybts' khy yshl 'lvh npshv
verses.translation: For what is the hope of the godless, though he get him gain, When God taketh away his soul?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲֽ֭צַעֲקָתוֹ יִשְׁמַ֥ע ׀ אֵ֑ל כִּֽי־תָב֖וֹא עָלָ֣יו צָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: hts'qtv yshm'  'l khytbv' 'lyv tsrh
verses.translation: Will God hear his cry, When trouble cometh upon him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־עַל־שַׁדַּ֥י יִתְעַנָּ֑ג יִקְרָ֖א אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּכׇל־עֵֽת׃
verses.translit: 'm'lshdy yt'ng yqr' 'lvh bkhl't
verses.translation: Will he have his delight in the Almighty, And call upon God at all times?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹרֶ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֣ם בְּיַד־אֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם־שַׁ֝דַּ֗י לֹ֣א אֲכַחֵֽד׃
verses.translit: 'vrh 'tkhm byd'l 'shr 'mshdy l' 'khchd
verses.translation: I will teach you concerning the hand of God; That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵן־אַתֶּ֣ם כֻּלְּכֶ֣ם חֲזִיתֶ֑ם וְלָמָּה־זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל תֶּהְבָּֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: hn'tm khlkhm chzytm vlmhzh hbl thblv
verses.translation: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; Why then are ye become altogether vain?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֤ה  חֵלֶק־אָדָ֖ם רָשָׁ֥ע ׀ עִם־אֵ֑ל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת עָ֝רִיצִ֗ים מִשַּׁדַּ֥י יִקָּֽחוּ׃
verses.translit: zh  chlq'dm rsh'  'm'l vnchlt 'rytsym mshdy yqchv
verses.translation: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, And the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יִרְבּ֣וּ בָנָ֣יו לְמוֹ־חָ֑רֶב וְ֝צֶאֱצָאָ֗יו לֹ֣א יִשְׂבְּעוּ־לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translit: 'myrbv bnyv lmvchrb vts'ts'yv l' yshb'vlchm
verses.translation: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword; And his offspring shall not have bread enough.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂ֭רִידָו בַּמָּ֣וֶת יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ וְ֝אַלְמְנֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה׃
verses.translit: shrydv bmvt yqbrv v'lmntyv l' tbkhynh
verses.translation: Those that remain of him shall be buried by pestilence, And his widows shall make no lamentation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יִצְבֹּ֣ר כֶּעָפָ֣ר כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝כַחֹ֗מֶר יָכִ֥ין מַלְבּֽוּשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'mytsbr kh'pr khsf vkhchmr ykhyn mlbvsh
verses.translation: Though he heap up silver as the dust, And prepare raiment as the clay;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֭כִין וְצַדִּ֣יק יִלְבָּ֑שׁ וְ֝כֶ֗סֶף נָקִ֥י יַחֲלֹֽק׃
verses.translit: ykhyn vtsdyq ylbsh vkhsf nqy ychlq
verses.translation: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, And the innocent shall divide the silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּנָ֣ה כָעָ֣שׁ בֵּית֑וֹ וּ֝כְסֻכָּ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה נֹצֵֽר׃
verses.translit: bnh kh'sh bytv vkhskhh 'shh ntsr
verses.translation: He buildeth his house as a moth, And as a booth which the keeper maketh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָשִׁ֣יר יִ֭שְׁכַּב וְלֹ֣א יֵאָסֵ֑ף עֵינָ֖יו פָּקַ֣ח וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: 'shyr yshkhb vl' y'sf 'ynyv pqch v'ynnv
verses.translation: He lieth down rich, but there shall be nought to gather; He openeth his eyes, and his wealth is not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּשִּׂיגֵ֣הוּ כַ֭מַּיִם בַּלָּה֑וֹת לַ֝֗יְלָה גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ סוּפָֽה׃
verses.translit: tshyghv khmym blhvt lylh gnbtv svph
verses.translation: Terrors overtake him like waters; A tempest stealeth him away in the night.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשָּׂאֵ֣הוּ קָדִ֣ים וְיֵלַ֑ךְ וִ֝ישָׂעֲרֵ֗הוּ מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: ysh'hv qdym vylkh vysh'rhv mmqmv
verses.translation: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth; And it sweepeth him out of his place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיַשְׁלֵ֣ךְ עָ֭לָיו וְלֹ֣א יַחְמֹ֑ל מִ֝יָּד֗וֹ בָּר֥וֹחַ יִבְרָֽח׃
verses.translit: vyshlkh 'lyv vl' ychml mydv brvch ybrch
verses.translation: Yea, it hurleth at him, and spareth not; He would fain flee from its power.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׂפֹּ֣ק עָלֵ֣ימוֹ כַפֵּ֑ימוֹ וְיִשְׁרֹ֥ק עָ֝לָ֗יו מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: yshpq 'lymv khpymv vyshrq 'lyv mmqmv
verses.translation: Men shall clap their hands at him, And shall hiss him out of his place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י יֵ֣שׁ לַכֶּ֣סֶף מוֹצָ֑א וּ֝מָק֗וֹם לַזָּהָ֥ב יָזֹֽקּוּ׃
verses.translit: khy ysh lkhsf mvts' vmqvm lzhb yzqv
verses.translation: For there is a mine for silver, And a place for gold which they refine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּ֭רְזֶל מֵעָפָ֣ר יֻקָּ֑ח וְ֝אֶ֗בֶן יָצ֥וּק נְחוּשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: brzl m'pr yqch v'bn ytsvq nchvshh
verses.translation: Iron is taken out of the dust, And brass is molten out of the stone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֵ֤ץ  שָׂ֤ם לַחֹ֗שֶׁךְ וּֽלְכׇל־תַּ֭כְלִית ה֣וּא חוֹקֵ֑ר אֶ֖בֶן אֹ֣פֶל וְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: qts  shm lchshkh vlkhltkhlyt hv' chvqr 'bn 'pl vtslmvt
verses.translation: Man setteth an end to darkness, And searcheth out to the furthest bound The stones of thick darkness and of the shadow of death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּ֤רַץ נַ֨חַל  מֵֽעִם־גָּ֗ר הַֽנִּשְׁכָּחִ֥ים מִנִּי־רָ֑גֶל דַּ֖לּוּ מֵאֱנ֣וֹשׁ נָֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: prts nchl  m'mgr hnshkhchym mnyrgl dlv m'nvsh n'v
verses.translation: He breaketh open a shaft away from where men sojourn; They are forgotten of the foot that passeth by; They hang afar from men, they swing to and fro.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֗רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נָּה יֵֽצֵא־לָ֑חֶם וְ֝תַחְתֶּ֗יהָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ כְּמוֹ־אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'rts mmnh yts'lchm vtchtyh nhpkh khmv'sh
verses.translation: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread, And underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְקוֹם־סַפִּ֥יר אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְעַפְרֹ֖ת זָהָ֣ב לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mqvmspyr 'bnyh v'prt zhb lv
verses.translation: The stones thereof are the place of sapphires, And it hath dust of gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָ֭תִיב לֹא־יְדָ֣עוֹ עָ֑יִט וְלֹ֥א שְׁ֝זָפַ֗תּוּ עֵ֣ין אַיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: ntyb l'yd'v 'yt vl' shzptv 'yn 'yh
verses.translation: That path no bird of prey knoweth, Neither hath the falcon’s eye seen it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־הִדְרִיכ֥וּהוּ בְנֵי־שָׁ֑חַץ לֹֽא־עָדָ֖ה עָלָ֣יו שָֽׁחַל׃
verses.translit: l'hdrykhvhv bnyshchts l''dh 'lyv shchl
verses.translation: The proud beasts have not trodden it, Nor hath the lion passed thereby.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּ֭חַלָּמִישׁ שָׁלַ֣ח יָד֑וֹ הָפַ֖ךְ מִשֹּׁ֣רֶשׁ הָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: bchlmysh shlch ydv hpkh mshrsh hrym
verses.translation: He putteth forth his hand upon the flinty rock; He overturneth the mountains by the roots.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּ֭צּוּרוֹת יְאֹרִ֣ים בִּקֵּ֑עַ וְכׇל־יְ֝קָ֗ר רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: btsvrvt y'rym bq' vkhlyqr r'th 'ynv
verses.translation: He cutteth out channels among the rocks; And his eye seeth every precious thing. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭בְּכִי נְהָר֣וֹת חִבֵּ֑שׁ וְ֝תַעֲלֻמָ֗הּ יֹ֣צִא אֽוֹר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: mbkhy nhrvt chbsh vt'lmh yts' 'vr {p}
verses.translation: He bindeth the streams that they trickle not; And the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽ֭הַחׇכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תִּמָּצֵ֑א וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝֗ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhchkhmh m'yn tmts' v'y zh mqvm bynh
verses.translation: But wisdom, where shall it be found? And where is the place of understanding?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יָדַ֣ע אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עֶרְכָּ֑הּ וְלֹ֥א תִ֝מָּצֵ֗א בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַחַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: l'yd' 'nvsh 'rkhh vl' tmts' b'rts hchyym
verses.translation: Man knoweth not the price thereof; Neither is it found in the land of the living.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּה֣וֹם אָ֭מַר לֹ֣א בִי־הִ֑יא וְיָ֥ם אָ֝מַ֗ר אֵ֣ין עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.translit: thvm 'mr l' byhy' vym 'mr 'yn 'mdy
verses.translation: The deep saith: ‘It is not in me’; And the sea saith: ‘It is not with me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יֻתַּ֣ן סְג֣וֹר תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְלֹ֥א יִ֝שָּׁקֵ֗ל כֶּ֣סֶף מְחִירָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: l'ytn sgvr tchtyh vl' yshql khsf mchyrh
verses.translation: It cannot be gotten for gold, Neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־תְ֭סֻלֶּה בְּכֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִ֑יר בְּשֹׁ֖הַם יָקָ֣ר וְסַפִּֽיר׃
verses.translit: l'tslh bkhtm 'vpyr bshhm yqr vspyr
verses.translation: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, With the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יַעַרְכֶ֣נָּה זָ֭הָב וּזְכוֹכִ֑ית וּתְמ֖וּרָתָ֣הּ כְּלִי־פָֽז׃
verses.translit: l'y'rkhnh zhb vzkhvkhyt vtmvrth khlypz
verses.translation: Gold and glass cannot equal it; Neither shall the exchange thereof be vessels of fine gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאמ֣וֹת וְ֭גָבִישׁ לֹ֣א יִזָּכֵ֑ר וּמֶ֥שֶׁךְ חׇ֝כְמָ֗ה מִפְּנִינִֽים׃
verses.translit: r'mvt vgbysh l' yzkhr vmshkh chkhmh mpnynym
verses.translation: No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal; Yea, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־יַ֭עַרְכֶנָּה פִּטְדַת־כּ֑וּשׁ בְּכֶ֥תֶם טָ֝ה֗וֹר לֹ֣א תְסֻלֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: l'y'rkhnh ptdtkhvsh bkhtm thvr l' tslh
verses.translation: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, Neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽ֭הַחׇכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תָּב֑וֹא וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝֗ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhchkhmh m'yn tbv' v'y zh mqvm bynh
verses.translation: Whence then cometh wisdom? And where is the place of understanding?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽ֭נֶעֶלְמָה מֵעֵינֵ֣י כׇל־חָ֑י וּמֵע֖וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם נִסְתָּֽרָה׃
verses.translit: vn'lmh m'yny khlchy vm'vf hshmym nstrh
verses.translation: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, And kept close from the fowls of the air.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲבַדּ֣וֹן וָ֭מָוֶת אָ֣מְר֑וּ בְּ֝אׇזְנֵ֗ינוּ שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ שִׁמְעָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: 'bdvn vmvt 'mrv b'znynv shm'nv shm'h
verses.translation: Destruction and Death say: ‘We have heard a rumor thereof with our ears.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים הֵבִ֣ין דַּרְכָּ֑הּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יָדַ֥ע אֶת־מְקוֹמָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: 'lhym hbyn drkhh vhv' yd' 'tmqvmh
verses.translation: God understandeth the way thereof, And He knoweth the place thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־ה֭וּא לִקְצוֹת־הָאָ֣רֶץ יַבִּ֑יט תַּ֖חַת כׇּל־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: khyhv' lqtsvth'rts ybyt tcht khlhshmym yr'h
verses.translation: For He looketh to the ends of the earth, And seeth under the whole heaven;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָר֣וּחַ מִשְׁקָ֑ל וּ֝מַ֗יִם תִּכֵּ֥ן בְּמִדָּֽה׃
verses.translit: l'shvt lrvch mshql vmym tkhn bmdh
verses.translation: When He maketh a weight for the wind, And meteth out the waters by measure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּעֲשֹׂת֣וֹ לַמָּטָ֣ר חֹ֑ק וְ֝דֶ֗רֶךְ לַחֲזִ֥יז קֹלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: b'shtv lmtr chq vdrkh lchzyz qlvt
verses.translation: When He made a decree for the rain, And a way for the storm of thunders;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֣ז רָ֭אָהּ וַֽיְסַפְּרָ֑הּ הֱ֝כִינָ֗הּ וְגַם־חֲקָרָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: 'z r'h vysprh hkhynh vgmchqrh
verses.translation: Then did He see it, and declare it; He established it, yea, and searched it out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר  לָאָדָ֗ם הֵ֤ן יִרְאַ֣ת אֲ֭דֹנָי הִ֣יא חׇכְמָ֑ה וְס֖וּר מֵרָ֣ע בִּינָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr  l'dm hn yr't 'dny hy' chkhmh vsvr mr' bynh {p}
verses.translation: And unto man He said: ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; And to depart from evil is understanding.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣סֶף אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת מְשָׁל֗וֹ וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vysf 'yvb sh't mshlv vy'mr
verses.translation: And Job again took up his parable, and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־יִתְּנֵ֥נִי כְיַרְחֵי־קֶ֑דֶם כִּ֝ימֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יִשְׁמְרֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: myytnny khyrchyqdm khymy 'lvh yshmrny
verses.translation: Oh that I were as in the months of old, As in the days when God watched over me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּהִלּ֣וֹ נֵ֭רוֹ עֲלֵ֣י רֹאשִׁ֑י לְ֝אוֹר֗וֹ אֵ֣לֶךְ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.translit: bhlv nrv 'ly r'shy l'vrv 'lkh chshkh
verses.translation: When His lamp shined above my head, And by His light I walked through darkness;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר הָ֭יִיתִי בִּימֵ֣י חׇרְפִּ֑י בְּס֥וֹד אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ עֲלֵ֣י אׇהֳלִֽי׃
verses.translit: kh'shr hyyty bymy chrpy bsvd 'lvh 'ly 'hly
verses.translation: As I was in the days of my youth, When the converse of God was upon my tent;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּע֣וֹד שַׁ֭דַּי עִמָּדִ֑י סְבִ֖יבוֹתַ֣י נְעָרָֽי׃
verses.translit: b'vd shdy 'mdy sbybvty n'ry
verses.translation: When the Almighty was yet with me, And my children were about me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּרְחֹ֣ץ הֲלִיכַ֣י בְּחֵמָ֑ה וְצ֥וּר יָצ֥וּק עִ֝מָּדִ֗י פַּלְגֵי־שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.translit: brchts hlykhy bchmh vtsvr ytsvq 'mdy plgyshmn
verses.translation: When my steps were washed with butter, And the rock poured me out rivers of oil!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּצֵ֣אתִי שַׁ֣עַר עֲלֵי־קָ֑רֶת בָּ֝רְח֗וֹב אָכִ֥ין מוֹשָׁבִֽי׃
verses.translit: bts'ty sh'r 'lyqrt brchvb 'khyn mvshby
verses.translation: When I went forth to the gate unto the city, When I prepared my seat in the broad place,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָא֣וּנִי נְעָרִ֣ים וְנֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וִ֝ישִׁישִׁ֗ים קָ֣מוּ עָמָֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: r'vny n'rym vnchb'v vyshyshym qmv 'mdv
verses.translation: The young men saw me and hid themselves, And the aged rose up and stood;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂ֭רִים עָצְר֣וּ בְמִלִּ֑ים וְ֝כַ֗ף יָשִׂ֥ימוּ לְפִיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: shrym 'tsrv bmlym vkhf yshymv lpyhm
verses.translation: The princes refrained talking, And laid their hand on their mouth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קוֹל־נְגִידִ֥ים נֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם לְחִכָּ֥ם דָּבֵֽקָה׃
verses.translit: qvlngydym nchb'v vlshvnm lchkhm dbqh
verses.translation: The voice of the nobles was hushed, And their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֹ֣זֶן שָׁ֭מְעָה וַֽתְּאַשְּׁרֵ֑נִי וְעַ֥יִן רָ֝אֲתָ֗ה וַתְּעִידֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: khy 'zn shm'h vt'shrny v'yn r'th vt'ydny
verses.translation: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, And when the eye saw me, it gave witness unto me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אֲ֭מַלֵּט עָנִ֣י מְשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וְ֝יָת֗וֹם וְֽלֹא־עֹזֵ֥ר לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy'mlt 'ny mshv' vytvm vl''zr lv
verses.translation: Because I delivered the poor that cried, The fatherless also, that had none to help him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּרְכַּ֣ת אֹ֭בֵד עָלַ֣י תָּבֹ֑א וְלֵ֖ב אַלְמָנָ֣ה אַרְנִֽן׃
verses.translit: brkht 'bd 'ly tb' vlb 'lmnh 'rnn
verses.translation: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me; and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צֶ֣דֶק לָ֭בַשְׁתִּי וַיִּלְבָּשֵׁ֑נִי כִּֽמְעִ֥יל וְ֝צָנִ֗יף מִשְׁפָּטִֽי׃
verses.translit: tsdq lbshty vylbshny khm'yl vtsnyf mshpty
verses.translation: I put on righteousness, and it clothed itself with me; My justice was as a robe and a diadem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵינַ֣יִם הָ֭יִיתִי לַעִוֵּ֑ר וְרַגְלַ֖יִם לַפִּסֵּ֣חַ אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: 'ynym hyyty l'vr vrglym lpsch 'ny
verses.translation: I was eyes to the blind, And feet was I to the lame.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֣ב אָ֭נֹכִֽי לָאֶבְיוֹנִ֑ים וְרִ֖ב לֹא־יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶחְקְרֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: 'b 'nkhy l'byvnym vrb l'yd'ty 'chqrhv
verses.translation: I was a father to the needy; And the cause of him that I knew not I searched out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָ֭אֲשַׁבְּרָה מְתַלְּע֣וֹת עַוָּ֑ל וּ֝מִשִּׁנָּ֗יו אַשְׁלִ֥יךְ טָֽרֶף׃
verses.translit: v'shbrh mtl'vt 'vl vmshnyv 'shlykh trf
verses.translation: And I broke the jaws of the unrighteous, And plucked the prey out of his teeth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָ֭אֹמַר עִם־קִנִּ֣י אֶגְוָ֑ע וְ֝כַח֗וֹל אַרְבֶּ֥ה יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'mqny 'gv' vkhchvl 'rbh ymym
verses.translation: Then I said: ‘I shall die with my nest, And I shall multiply my days as the phoenix;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׇׁרְשִׁ֣י פָת֣וּחַ אֱלֵי־מָ֑יִם וְ֝טַ֗ל יָלִ֥ין בִּקְצִירִֽי׃
verses.translit: shrshy ptvch 'lymym vtl ylyn bqtsyry
verses.translation: My root shall be spread out to the waters, And the dew shall lie all night upon my branch;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּ֭בוֹדִי חָדָ֣שׁ עִמָּדִ֑י וְ֝קַשְׁתִּ֗י בְּיָדִ֥י תַחֲלִֽיף׃
verses.translit: khbvdy chdsh 'mdy vqshty bydy tchlyf
verses.translation: My glory shall be fresh in me, And my bow shall be renewed in my hand.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִֽי־שָׁמְע֥וּ וְיִחֵ֑לּוּ וְ֝יִדְּמ֗וּ לְמ֣וֹ עֲצָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: lyshm'v vychlv vydmv lmv 'tsty
verses.translation: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, And kept silence for my counsel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֣י דְ֭בָרִי לֹ֣א יִשְׁנ֑וּ וְ֝עָלֵ֗ימוֹ תִּטֹּ֥ף מִלָּתִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'chry dbry l' yshnv v'lymv ttf mlty
verses.translation: After my words they spoke not again; And my speech dropped upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִחֲל֣וּ כַמָּטָ֣ר לִ֑י וּ֝פִיהֶ֗ם פָּעֲר֥וּ לְמַלְקֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: vychlv khmtr ly vpyhm p'rv lmlqvsh
verses.translation: And they waited for me as for the rain; And they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶשְׂחַ֣ק אֲ֭לֵהֶם לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ינוּ וְא֥וֹר פָּ֝נַ֗י לֹ֣א יַפִּילֽוּן׃
verses.translit: 'shchq 'lhm l' y'mynv v'vr pny l' ypylvn
verses.translation: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; And the light of my countenance they cast not down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֥בְחַ֣ר דַּרְכָּם֮ וְאֵשֵׁ֢ב רֹ֥֫אשׁ וְ֭אֶשְׁכּוֹן כְּמֶ֣לֶךְ בַּגְּד֑וּד כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲבֵלִ֣ים יְנַחֵֽם׃
verses.translit: 'bchr drkhm v'shb r'sh v'shkhvn khmlkh bgdvd kh'shr 'blym ynchm
verses.translation: I chose out their way, and sat as chief, And dwelt as a king in the army, As one that comforteth the mourners.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֤ה  שָׂ֥חֲק֣וּ עָלַי֮ צְעִירִ֥ים מִמֶּ֗נִּי לְיָ֫מִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־מָאַ֥סְתִּי אֲבוֹתָ֑ם לָ֝שִׁ֗ית עִם־כַּלְבֵ֥י צֹאנִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'th  shchqv 'ly ts'yrym mmny lymym 'shrm'sty 'bvtm lshyt 'mkhlby ts'ny
verses.translation: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, Whose fathers I disdained to set with the dogs of my flock.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־כֹּ֣חַ יְ֭דֵיהֶם לָ֣מָּה לִּ֑י עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ אָ֣בַד כָּֽלַח׃
verses.translit: gmkhch ydyhm lmh ly 'lymv 'bd khlch
verses.translation: Yea, the strength of their hands, whereto should it profit me? Men in whom ripe age is perished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּחֶ֥סֶר וּבְכָפָ֗ן גַּ֫לְמ֥וּד הַעֹרְקִ֥ים צִיָּ֑ה אֶ֝֗מֶשׁ שׁוֹאָ֥ה וּמְשֹׁאָֽה׃
verses.translit: bchsr vbkhpn glmvd h'rqym tsyh 'msh shv'h vmsh'h
verses.translation: They are gaunt with want and famine; They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of wasteness and desolation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַקֹּטְפִ֣ים מַלּ֣וּחַ עֲלֵי־שִׂ֑יחַ וְשֹׁ֖רֶשׁ רְתָמִ֣ים לַחְמָֽם׃
verses.translit: hqtpym mlvch 'lyshych vshrsh rtmym lchmm
verses.translation: They pluck salt-wort with wormwood; And the roots of the broom are their food.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־גֵּ֥ו יְגֹרָ֑שׁוּ יָרִ֥יעוּ עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ כַּגַּנָּֽב׃
verses.translit: mngv ygrshv yry'v 'lymv khgnb
verses.translation: They are driven forth from the midst of men; They cry after them as after a thief.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּעֲר֣וּץ נְחָלִ֣ים לִשְׁכֹּ֑ן חֹרֵ֖י עָפָ֣ר וְכֵפִֽים׃
verses.translit: b'rvts nchlym lshkhn chry 'pr vkhpym
verses.translation: In the clefts of the valleys must they dwell, In holes of the earth and of the rocks.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּין־שִׂיחִ֥ים יִנְהָ֑קוּ תַּ֖חַת חָר֣וּל יְסֻפָּֽחוּ׃
verses.translit: bynshychym ynhqv tcht chrvl yspchv
verses.translation: Among the bushes they bray; Under the nettles they are gathered together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּֽנֵי־נָ֭בָל גַּם־בְּנֵ֣י בְלִי־שֵׁ֑ם נִ֝כְּא֗וּ מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: bnynbl gmbny blyshm nkh'v mnh'rts
verses.translation: They are children of churls, yea, children of ignoble men; They were scourged out of the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭עַתָּה נְגִינָתָ֣ם הָיִ֑יתִי וָאֱהִ֖י לָהֶ֣ם לְמִלָּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'th ngyntm hyyty v'hy lhm lmlh
verses.translation: And now I am become their song, Yea, I am a byword unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּ֭עֲבוּנִי רָ֣חֲקוּ מֶ֑נִּי וּ֝מִפָּנַ֗י לֹא־חָ֥שְׂכוּ רֹֽק׃
verses.translit: t'bvny rchqv mny vmpny l'chshkhv rq
verses.translation: They abhor me, they flee far from me, And spare not to spit in my face.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־[יִתְרִ֣י] (יתרו) פִ֭תַּח וַיְעַנֵּ֑נִי וְ֝רֶ֗סֶן מִפָּנַ֥י שִׁלֵּֽחוּ׃
verses.translit: khy[ytry] (ytrv) ptch vy'nny vrsn mpny shlchv
verses.translation: For He hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, And they have cast off the bridle before me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־יָמִין֮ פִּרְחַ֢ח יָ֫ק֥וּמוּ רַגְלַ֥י שִׁלֵּ֑חוּ וַיָּסֹ֥לּוּ עָ֝לַ֗י אׇרְח֥וֹת אֵידָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lymyn prchch yqvmv rgly shlchv vyslv 'ly 'rchvt 'ydm
verses.translation: Upon my right hand rise the brood; They entangle my feet, And they cast up against me their ways of destruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָֽתְס֗וּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י לְהַוָּתִ֥י יֹעִ֑ילוּ לֹ֖א עֹזֵ֣ר לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: ntsv ntybty lhvty y'ylv l' 'zr lmv
verses.translation: They break up my path, They further my calamity, Even men that have no helper.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּפֶ֣רֶץ רָחָ֣ב יֶאֱתָ֑יוּ תַּ֥חַת שֹׁ֝אָ֗ה הִתְגַּלְגָּֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: khprts rchb y'tyv tcht sh'h htglglv
verses.translation: As through a wide breach they come; In the midst of the ruin they roll themselves upon me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הׇהְפַּ֥ךְ עָלַ֗י בַּלָּ֫ה֥וֹת תִּרְדֹּ֣ף כָּ֭רוּחַ נְדִבָתִ֑י וּ֝כְעָ֗ב עָבְרָ֥ה יְשֻׁעָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: hhpkh 'ly blhvt trdf khrvch ndbty vkh'b 'brh ysh'ty
verses.translation: Terrors are turned upon me, They chase mine honour as the wind; And my welfare is passed away as a cloud.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה עָ֭לַי תִּשְׁתַּפֵּ֣ךְ נַפְשִׁ֑י יֹ֖אחֲז֣וּנִי יְמֵי־עֹֽנִי׃
verses.translit: v'th 'ly tshtpkh npshy y'chzvny ymy'ny
verses.translation: And now my soul is poured out within me; Days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַ֗יְלָה עֲ֭צָמַי נִקַּ֣ר מֵעָלָ֑י וְ֝עֹרְקַ֗י לֹ֣א יִשְׁכָּבֽוּן׃
verses.translit: lylh 'tsmy nqr m'ly v'rqy l' yshkhbvn
verses.translation: In the night my bones are pierced, and fall from me, And my sinews take no rest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרׇב־כֹּ֭חַ יִתְחַפֵּ֣שׂ לְבוּשִׁ֑י כְּפִ֖י כֻתׇּנְתִּ֣י יַאַזְרֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: brbkhch ytchpsh lbvshy khpy khtnty y'zrny
verses.translation: By the great force [of my disease] is my garment disfigured; It bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֹרָ֥נִי לַחֹ֑מֶר וָ֝אֶתְמַשֵּׁ֗ל כֶּעָפָ֥ר וָאֵֽפֶר׃
verses.translit: hrny lchmr v'tmshl kh'pr v'pr
verses.translation: He hath cast me into the mire, And I am become like dust and ashes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשַׁוַּ֣ע אֵ֭לֶיךָ וְלֹ֣א תַעֲנֵ֑נִי עָ֝מַ֗דְתִּי וַתִּתְבֹּ֥נֶן בִּֽי׃
verses.translit: 'shv' 'lykh vl' t'nny 'mdty vttbnn by
verses.translation: I cry unto Thee, and Thou dost not answer me; I stand up, and Thou lookest at me. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תֵּהָפֵ֣ךְ לְאַכְזָ֣ר לִ֑י בְּעֹ֖צֶם יָדְךָ֣ תִשְׂטְמֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: thpkh l'khzr ly b'tsm ydkh tshtmny
verses.translation: Thou art turned to be cruel to me; With the might of Thy hand Thou hatest me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי אֶל־ר֭וּחַ תַּרְכִּיבֵ֑נִי וּ֝תְמֹגְגֵ֗נִי (תשוה) [תּוּשִׁיָּֽה]׃
verses.translit: tsh'ny 'lrvch trkhybny vtmggny (tshvh) [tvshyh]
verses.translation: Thou liftest me up to the wind, Thou causest me to ride upon it; And Thou dissolvest my substance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יָ֭דַעְתִּי מָ֣וֶת תְּשִׁיבֵ֑נִי וּבֵ֖ית מוֹעֵ֣ד לְכׇל־חָֽי׃
verses.translit: khyyd'ty mvt tshybny vbyt mv'd lkhlchy
verses.translation: For I know that Thou wilt bring me to death, And to the house appointed for all living.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ לֹֽא־בְ֭עִי יִשְׁלַח־יָ֑ד אִם־בְּ֝פִיד֗וֹ לָהֶ֥ן שֽׁוּעַ׃
verses.translit: 'kh l'b'y yshlchyd 'mbpydv lhn shv'
verses.translation: Surely none shall put forth his hand to a ruinous heap, Neither because of these things shall help come in one’s calamity,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־לֹ֣א בָ֭כִיתִי לִקְשֵׁה־י֑וֹם עָֽגְמָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י לָאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: 'ml' bkhyty lqshhyvm 'gmh npshy l'byvn
verses.translation: If I have not wept for him that was in trouble, And if my soul grieved not for the needy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב קִ֭וִּיתִי וַיָּ֣בֹא רָ֑ע וַאֲיַחֲלָ֥ה לְ֝א֗וֹר וַיָּ֥בֹא אֹֽפֶל׃
verses.translit: khy tvb qvyty vyb' r' v'ychlh l'vr vyb' 'pl
verses.translation: Yet, when I looked for good, there came evil; And when I waited for light, there came darkness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵעַ֖י רֻתְּח֥וּ וְלֹא־דָ֗מּוּ קִדְּמֻ֥נִי יְמֵי־עֹֽנִי׃
verses.translit: m'y rtchv vl'dmv qdmny ymy'ny
verses.translation: Mine inwards boil, and rest not; Days of affliction are come upon me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֹדֵ֣ר הִ֭לַּכְתִּי בְּלֹ֣א חַמָּ֑ה קַ֖מְתִּי בַקָּהָ֣ל אֲשַׁוֵּֽעַ׃
verses.translit: qdr hlkhty bl' chmh qmty bqhl 'shv'
verses.translation: I go mourning without the sun; I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֭ח הָיִ֣יתִי לְתַנִּ֑ים וְ֝רֵ֗עַ לִבְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'ch hyyty ltnym vr' lbnvt y'nh
verses.translation: I am become a brother to jackals, And a companion to ostriches.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ע֭וֹרִי שָׁחַ֣ר מֵעָלָ֑י וְעַצְמִי־חָ֝֗רָה מִנִּי־חֹֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: 'vry shchr m'ly v'tsmychrh mnychrb
verses.translation: My skin is black, and falleth from me, And my bones are burned with heat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י לְ֭אֵבֶל כִּנֹּרִ֑י וְ֝עֻגָבִ֗י לְק֣וֹל בֹּכִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhy l'bl khnry v'gby lqvl bkhym
verses.translation: Therefore is my harp turned to mourning, And my pipe into the voice of them that weep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭רִית כָּרַ֣תִּי לְעֵינָ֑י וּמָ֥ה אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן עַל־בְּתוּלָֽה׃
verses.translit: bryt khrty l'yny vmh 'tbvnn 'lbtvlh
verses.translation: I made a covenant with mine eyes; How then should I look upon a maid?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֶ֤ה חֵ֣לֶק אֱל֣וֹהַּ מִמָּ֑עַל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת שַׁ֝דַּ֗י מִמְּרֹמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vmh chlq 'lvh mm'l vnchlt shdy mmrmym
verses.translation: For what would be the portion of God from above, And the heritage of the Almighty from on high?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹא־אֵ֥יד לְעַוָּ֑ל וְ֝נֵ֗כֶר לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.translit: hl''yd l'vl vnkhr lp'ly 'vn
verses.translation: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, And disaster to the workers of iniquity?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹא־ה֭וּא יִרְאֶ֣ה דְרָכָ֑י וְֽכׇל־צְעָדַ֥י יִסְפּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: hl'hv' yr'h drkhy vkhlts'dy yspvr
verses.translation: Doth not He see my ways, And count all my steps?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־הָלַ֥כְתִּי עִם־שָׁ֑וְא וַתַּ֖חַשׁ עַל־מִרְמָ֣ה רַגְלִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'mhlkhty 'mshv' vtchsh 'lmrmh rgly
verses.translation: If I have walked with vanity, And my foot hath hasted to deceit—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׁקְלֵ֥נִי בְמֹֽאזְנֵי־צֶ֑דֶק וְיֵדַ֥ע אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ תֻּמָּתִֽי׃
verses.translit: yshqlny bm'znytsdq vyd' 'lvh tmty
verses.translation: Let me be weighed in a just balance, That God may know mine integrity—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֥ם־תִּטֶּ֣ה אַשֻּׁרִי֮ מִנִּ֢י הַ֫דָּ֥רֶךְ וְאַחַ֣ר עֵ֭ינַי הָלַ֣ךְ לִבִּ֑י וּ֝בְכַפַּ֗י דָּ֣בַק מֽאוּם׃
verses.translit: 'mtth 'shry mny hdrkh v'chr 'yny hlkh lby vbkhpy dbq m'vm
verses.translation: If my step hath turned out of the way, And my heart walked after mine eyes, And if any spot hath cleaved to my hands;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֭זְרְעָה וְאַחֵ֣ר יֹאכֵ֑ל וְֽצֶאֱצָאַ֥י יְשֹׁרָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: 'zr'h v'chr y'khl vts'ts'y yshrshv
verses.translation: Then let me sow, and let another eat; Yea, let the produce of my field be rooted out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־נִפְתָּ֣ה לִ֭בִּי עַל־אִשָּׁ֑ה וְעַל־פֶּ֖תַח רֵעִ֣י אָרָֽבְתִּי׃
verses.translit: 'mnpth lby 'l'shh v'lptch r'y 'rbty
verses.translation: If my heart have been enticed unto a woman, And I have lain in wait at my neighbour’s door;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּטְחַ֣ן לְאַחֵ֣ר אִשְׁתִּ֑י וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ יִכְרְע֥וּן אֲחֵרִֽין׃
verses.translit: ttchn l'chr 'shty v'lyh ykhr'vn 'chryn
verses.translation: Then let my wife grind unto another, And let others bow down upon her. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־[הִ֥יא] (הוא) זִמָּ֑ה (והיא) [וְ֝ה֗וּא] עָוֺ֥ן פְּלִילִֽים׃
