verses.translit: khy[hy'] (hv') zmh (vhy') [vhv'] 'vn plylym
verses.translation: For that were a heinous crime; Yea, it were an iniquity to be punished by the judges.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣שׁ הִ֭יא עַד־אֲבַדּ֣וֹן תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּֽבְכׇל־תְּב֖וּאָתִ֣י תְשָׁרֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: khy 'sh hy' 'd'bdvn t'khl vbkhltbv'ty tshrsh
verses.translation: For it is a fire that consumeth unto destruction, And would root out all mine increase.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אֶמְאַ֗ס מִשְׁפַּ֣ט עַ֭בְדִּי וַאֲמָתִ֑י בְּ֝רִבָ֗ם עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'm'm's mshpt 'bdy v'mty brbm 'mdy
verses.translation: If I did despise the cause of my man-servant, Or of my maid-servant, when they contended with me—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָ֣ה אֶ֭עֱשֶׂה כִּֽי־יָק֣וּם אֵ֑ל וְכִי־יִ֝פְקֹ֗ד מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: vmh ''shh khyyqvm 'l vkhyypqd mh 'shybnv
verses.translation: What then shall I do when God riseth up? And when He remembereth, what shall I answer Him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲֽלֹא־בַ֭בֶּטֶן עֹשֵׂ֣נִי עָשָׂ֑הוּ וַ֝יְכֻנֶ֗נּוּ בָּרֶ֥חֶם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: hl'bbtn 'shny 'shhv vykhnnv brchm 'chd
verses.translation: Did not He that made me in the womb make him? And did not One fashion us in the womb?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אֶ֭מְנַע מֵחֵ֣פֶץ דַּלִּ֑ים וְעֵינֵ֖י אַלְמָנָ֣ה אֲכַלֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'm'mn' mchpts dlym v'yny 'lmnh 'khlh
verses.translation: If I have withheld aught that the poor desired, Or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֹכַ֣ל פִּתִּ֣י לְבַדִּ֑י וְלֹֽא־אָכַ֖ל יָת֣וֹם מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: v'khl pty lbdy vl''khl ytvm mmnh
verses.translation: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, And the fatherless hath not eaten thereof—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִ֭נְּעוּרַי גְּדֵלַ֣נִי כְאָ֑ב וּמִבֶּ֖טֶן אִמִּ֣י אַנְחֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: khy mn'vry gdlny kh'b vmbtn 'my 'nchnh
verses.translation: Nay, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, And I have been her guide from my mother’s womb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֭וֹבֵד מִבְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: 'm'r'h 'vbd mbly lbvsh v'yn khsvt l'byvn
verses.translation: If I have seen any wanderer in want of clothing, Or that the needy had no covering;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־לֹ֣א בֵרְכ֣וּנִי חֲלָצָ֑ו וּמִגֵּ֥ז כְּ֝בָשַׂ֗י יִתְחַמָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'ml' brkhvny chltsv vmgz khbshy ytchmm
verses.translation: If his loins have not blessed me, And if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־הֲנִיפ֣וֹתִי עַל־יָת֣וֹם יָדִ֑י כִּֽי־אֶרְאֶ֥ה בַ֝שַּׁ֗עַר עֶזְרָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'mhnypvty 'lytvm ydy khy'r'h bsh'r 'zrty
verses.translation: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, Because I saw my help in the gate;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּ֭תֵפִי מִשִּׁכְמָ֣הֿ תִפּ֑וֹל וְ֝אֶזְרֹעִ֗י מִקָּנָ֥הֿ תִשָּׁבֵֽר׃
verses.translit: khtpy mshkhmh tpvl v'zr'y mqnh tshbr
verses.translation: Then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder-blade, And mine arm be broken from the bone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י פַ֣חַד אֵ֭לַי אֵ֣יד אֵ֑ל וּ֝מִשְּׂאֵת֗וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל׃
verses.translit: khy pchd 'ly 'yd 'l vmsh'tv l' 'vkhl
verses.translation: For calamity from God was a terror to me, And by reason of His majesty I could do nothing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־שַׂ֣מְתִּי זָהָ֣ב כִּסְלִ֑י וְ֝לַכֶּ֗תֶם אָמַ֥רְתִּי מִבְטַחִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'mshmty zhb khsly vlkhtm 'mrty mbtchy
verses.translation: If I have made gold my hope, And have said to the fine gold: ‘Thou art my confidence’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אֶ֭שְׂמַח כִּֽי־רַ֣ב חֵילִ֑י וְכִֽי־כַ֝בִּ֗יר מָצְאָ֥ה יָדִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'm'shmch khyrb chyly vkhykhbyr mts'h ydy
verses.translation: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, And because my hand had gotten much;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֭וֹר כִּ֣י יָהֵ֑ל וְ֝יָרֵ֗חַ יָקָ֥ר הֹלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'm'r'h 'vr khy yhl vyrch yqr hlkh
verses.translation: If I beheld the sun when it shined, Or the moon walking in brightness;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֣פְתְּ בַּסֵּ֣תֶר לִבִּ֑י וַתִּשַּׁ֖ק יָדִ֣י לְפִֽי׃
verses.translit: vypt bstr lby vtshq ydy lpy
verses.translation: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, And my mouth hath kissed my hand;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־ה֭וּא עָוֺ֣ן פְּלִילִ֑י כִּֽי־כִחַ֖שְׁתִּי לָאֵ֣ל מִמָּֽעַל׃
verses.translit: gmhv' 'vn plyly khykhchshty l'l mm'l
verses.translation: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judges; For I should have lied to God that is above.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אֶ֭שְׂמַח בְּפִ֣יד מְשַׂנְאִ֑י וְ֝הִתְעֹרַ֗רְתִּי כִּֽי־מְצָ֥אוֹ רָֽע׃
verses.translit: 'm'shmch bpyd mshn'y vht'rrty khymts'v r'
verses.translation: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, Or exulted when evil found him—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־נָתַ֣תִּי לַחֲטֹ֣א חִכִּ֑י לִשְׁאֹ֖ל בְּאָלָ֣ה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: vl'ntty lcht' chkhy lsh'l b'lh npshv
verses.translation: Yea, I suffered not my mouth to sin By asking his life with a curse.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־לֹ֣א אָ֭מְרוּ מְתֵ֣י אׇהֳלִ֑י מִי־יִתֵּ֥ן מִ֝בְּשָׂר֗וֹ לֹ֣א נִשְׂבָּֽע׃
verses.translit: 'ml' 'mrv mty 'hly myytn mbshrv l' nshb'
verses.translation: If the men of my tent said not: ‘Who can find one that hath not been satisfied with his meat?’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּ֭חוּץ לֹא־יָלִ֣ין גֵּ֑ר דְּ֝לָתַ֗י לָאֹ֥רַח אֶפְתָּֽח׃
verses.translit: bchvts l'ylyn gr dlty l'rch 'ptch
verses.translation: The stranger did not lodge in the street; My doors I opened to the roadside.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־כִּסִּ֣יתִי כְאָדָ֣ם פְּשָׁעָ֑י לִטְמ֖וֹן בְּחֻבִּ֣י עֲוֺנִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'mkhsyty kh'dm psh'y ltmvn bchby 'vny
verses.translation: If after the manner of men I covered my transgressions, By hiding mine iniquity in my bosom—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶעֱר֨וֹץ  הָ֘מ֤וֹן רַבָּ֗ה וּבוּז־מִשְׁפָּח֥וֹת יְחִתֵּ֑נִי וָ֝אֶדֹּ֗ם לֹא־אֵ֥צֵא פָֽתַח׃
verses.translit: khy ''rvts  hmvn rbh vbvzmshpchvt ychtny v'dm l''ts' ptch
verses.translation: Because I feared the great multitude, And the most contemptible among families terrified me, So that I kept silence, and went not out of the door.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֤י יִתֶּן־לִ֨י  שֹׁ֘מֵ֤עַֽ לִ֗י הֶן־תָּ֭וִי שַׁדַּ֣י יַעֲנֵ֑נִי וְסֵ֥פֶר כָּ֝תַ֗ב אִ֣ישׁ רִיבִֽי׃
verses.translit: my ytnly  shm' ly hntvy shdy y'nny vspr khtb 'ysh ryby
verses.translation: Oh that I had one to hear me!— Lo, here is my signature, let the Almighty answer me— And that I had the indictment which mine adversary hath written!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־לֹ֣א עַל־שִׁ֭כְמִי אֶשָּׂאֶ֑נּוּ אֶעֶנְדֶ֖נּוּ עֲטָר֣וֹת לִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'ml' 'lshkhmy 'sh'nv ''ndnv 'trvt ly
verses.translation: Surely I would carry it upon my shoulder; I would bind it unto me as a crown.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִסְפַּ֣ר צְ֭עָדַי אַגִּידֶ֑נּוּ כְּמוֹ־נָ֝גִ֗יד אֲקָֽרְבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: mspr ts'dy 'gydnv khmvngyd 'qrbnv
verses.translation: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; As a prince would I go near unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־עָ֭לַי אַדְמָתִ֣י תִזְעָ֑ק וְ֝יַ֗חַד תְּלָמֶ֥יהָ יִבְכָּיֽוּן׃
verses.translit: 'm'ly 'dmty tz'q vychd tlmyh ybkhyvn
verses.translation: If my land cry out against me, And the furrows thereof weep together;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־כֹּ֭חָהּ אָכַ֣לְתִּי בְלִי־כָ֑סֶף וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ בְּעָלֶ֣יהָ הִפָּֽחְתִּי׃
verses.translit: 'mkhchh 'khlty blykhsf vnpsh b'lyh hpchty
verses.translation: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, Or have caused the tillers thereof to be disappointed—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֤חַת חִטָּ֨ה  יֵ֥צֵא ח֗וֹחַ וְתַֽחַת־שְׂעֹרָ֥ה בׇאְשָׁ֑ה תַּ֝֗מּוּ דִּבְרֵ֥י אִיּֽוֹב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: tcht chth  yts' chvch vtchtsh'rh b'shh tmv dbry 'yvb {p}
verses.translation: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, And noisome weeds instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁבְּת֡וּ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָ֭אֵלֶּה מֵעֲנ֣וֹת אֶת־אִיּ֑וֹב כִּ֤י ה֖וּא צַדִּ֣יק בְּעֵינָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshbtv shlsht h'nshym h'lh m'nvt 't'yvb khy hv' tsdyq b'ynyv {p}
verses.translation: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֤חַר אַ֨ף  אֱלִיה֣וּא בֶן־בַּרַכְאֵ֣ל הַבּוּזִי֮ מִמִּשְׁפַּ֢חַ֫ת רָ֥ם בְּ֭אִיּוֹב חָרָ֣ה אַפּ֑וֹ עַֽל־צַדְּק֥וֹ נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ מֵאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vychr 'f  'lyhv' bnbrkh'l hbvzy mmshpcht rm b'yvb chrh 'pv 'ltsdqv npshv m'lhym
verses.translation: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram; against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת רֵעָיו֮ חָרָ֢ה אַ֫פּ֥וֹ עַ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־מָצְא֣וּ מַעֲנֶ֑ה וַ֝יַּרְשִׁ֗יעוּ אֶת־אִיּֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: vbshlsht r'yv chrh 'pv 'l 'shr l'mts'v m'nh vyrshy'v 't'yvb
verses.translation: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וֶאֱלִיה֗וּ חִכָּ֣ה אֶת־אִ֭יּוֹב בִּדְבָרִ֑ים כִּ֤י זְֽקֵנִים־הֵ֖מָּה מִמֶּ֣נּוּ לְיָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'lyhv chkhh 't'yvb bdbrym khy zqnymhmh mmnv lymym
verses.translation: Now Elihu had waited to speak unto Job, because they were older than he.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤רְא אֱלִיה֗וּא כִּ֘י־אֵ֤ין מַעֲנֶ֗ה בְּ֭פִי שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיִּ֥חַר אַפּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyr' 'lyhv' khy'yn m'nh bpy shlsht h'nshym vychr 'pv {p}
verses.translation: And when Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַן  אֱלִיה֖וּא בֶן־בַּרַכְאֵ֥ל הַבּוּזִ֗י וַיֹּ֫אמַ֥ר צָ֘עִ֤יר אֲנִ֣י לְ֭יָמִים וְאַתֶּ֣ם יְשִׁישִׁ֑ים עַל־כֵּ֖ן זָחַ֥לְתִּי וָאִירָ֓א  מֵחַוֺּ֖ת דֵּעִ֣י אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'n  'lyhv' bnbrkh'l hbvzy vy'mr ts'yr 'ny lymym v'tm yshyshym 'lkhn zchlty v'yr'  mchvt d'y 'tkhm
verses.translation: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said: I am young, and ye are very old; Wherefore I held back, and durst not declare you mine opinion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֭מַרְתִּי יָמִ֣ים יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ וְרֹ֥ב שָׁ֝נִ֗ים יֹדִ֥יעוּ חׇכְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'mrty ymym ydbrv vrb shnym ydy'v chkhmh
verses.translation: I said: ‘Days should speak, And multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֭כֵן רוּחַ־הִ֣יא בֶאֱנ֑וֹשׁ וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּבִינֵֽם׃
verses.translit: 'khn rvchhy' b'nvsh vnshmt shdy tbynm
verses.translation: But it is a spirit in man, And the breath of the Almighty, that giveth them understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־רַבִּ֥ים יֶחְכָּ֑מוּ וּ֝זְקֵנִ֗ים יָבִ֥ינוּ מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: l'rbym ychkhmv vzqnym ybynv mshpt
verses.translation: It is not the great that are wise, Nor the aged that discern judgment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן אָ֭מַרְתִּי שִׁמְעָה־לִּ֑י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵעִ֣י אַף־אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: lkhn 'mrty shm'hly 'chvh d'y 'f'ny
verses.translation: Therefore I say: ‘Hearken to me; I also will declare mine opinion.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֤ן הוֹחַ֨לְתִּי  לְֽדִבְרֵיכֶ֗ם אָ֭זִין עַד־תְּב֥וּנֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם עַֽד־תַּחְקְר֥וּן מִלִּֽין׃
verses.translit: hn hvchlty  ldbrykhm 'zyn 'dtbvntykhm 'dtchqrvn mlyn
verses.translation: Behold, I waited for your words, I listened for your reasons, Whilst ye searched out what to say.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָ֥דֵיכֶ֗ם אֶתְבּ֫וֹנָ֥ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵ֣ין לְאִיּ֣וֹב מוֹכִ֑יחַ עוֹנֶ֖ה אֲמָרָ֣יו מִכֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'dykhm 'tbvnn vhnh 'yn l'yvb mvkhych 'vnh 'mryv mkhm
verses.translation: Yea, I attended unto you, And, behold, there was none that convinced Job, Or that answered his words, among you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּן־תֹּ֣֭אמְרוּ מָצָ֣אנוּ חׇכְמָ֑ה אֵ֖ל יִדְּפֶ֣נּוּ לֹא־אִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: pnt'mrv mts'nv chkhmh 'l ydpnv l''ysh
verses.translation: Beware lest ye say: ‘We have found wisdom; God may vanquish him, not man! ’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־עָרַ֣ךְ אֵלַ֣י מִלִּ֑ין וּ֝בְאִמְרֵיכֶ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: vl''rkh 'ly mlyn vb'mrykhm l' 'shybnv
verses.translation: For he hath not directed his words against me; Neither will I answer him with your speeches.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַ֭תּוּ לֹא־עָ֣נוּ ע֑וֹד הֶעְתִּ֖יקוּ מֵהֶ֣ם מִלִּֽים׃
verses.translit: chtv l''nv 'vd h'tyqv mhm mlym
verses.translation: They are amazed, they answer no more; Words are departed from them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭הוֹחַלְתִּי כִּי־לֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ כִּ֥י עָ֝מְד֗וּ לֹא־עָ֥נוּ עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: vhvchlty khyl' ydbrv khy 'mdv l''nv 'vd
verses.translation: And shall I wait, because they speak not, Because they stand still, and answer no more?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַעֲנֶ֣ה אַף־אֲנִ֣י חֶלְקִ֑י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵעִ֣י אַף־אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: ''nh 'f'ny chlqy 'chvh d'y 'f'ny
verses.translation: I also will answer my part, I also will declare mine opinion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֭י מָלֵ֣תִי מִלִּ֑ים הֱ֝צִיקַ֗תְנִי ר֣וּחַ בִּטְנִֽי׃
verses.translit: khy mlty mlym htsyqtny rvch btny
verses.translation: For I am full of words; The spirit within me constraineth me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּֽה־בִטְנִ֗י כְּיַ֥יִן לֹֽא־יִפָּתֵ֑חַ כְּאֹב֥וֹת חֲ֝דָשִׁ֗ים יִבָּקֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: hnhbtny khyyn l'yptch kh'bvt chdshym ybq'
verses.translation: Behold, mine inwards are as wine which hath no vent; Like new wine-skins which are ready to burst.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲדַבְּרָ֥ה וְיִֽרְוַֽח־לִ֑י אֶפְתַּ֖ח שְׂפָתַ֣י וְאֶעֱנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: 'dbrh vyrvchly 'ptch shpty v''nh
verses.translation: I will speak, that I may find relief; I will open my lips and answer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־נָ֭א אֶשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי־אִ֑ישׁ וְאֶל־אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲכַנֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'ln' 'sh' pny'ysh v'l'dm l' 'khnh
verses.translation: Let me not, I pray you, respect any man’s person; Neither will I give flattering titles unto any man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֲכַנֶּ֑ה כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט יִשָּׂאֵ֥נִי עֹשֵֽׂנִי׃
verses.translit: khy l' yd'ty 'khnh khm't ysh'ny 'shny
verses.translation: For I know not to give flattering titles; Else would my Maker soon take me away
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם שְׁמַֽע־נָ֣א אִיּ֣וֹב מִלָּ֑י וְֽכׇל־דְּבָרַ֥י הַאֲזִֽינָה׃
verses.translit: v'vlm shm'n' 'yvb mly vkhldbry h'zynh
verses.translation: Howbeit, Job, I pray thee, hear my speech, And hearken to all my words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה־נָ֭א פָּתַ֣חְתִּי פִ֑י דִּבְּרָ֖ה לְשׁוֹנִ֣י בְחִכִּֽי׃
verses.translit: hnhn' ptchty py dbrh lshvny bchkhy
verses.translation: Behold now, I have opened my mouth, My tongue hath spoken in my mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֹשֶׁר־לִבִּ֥י אֲמָרָ֑י וְדַ֥עַת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י בָּר֥וּר מִלֵּֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: yshrlby 'mry vd't shpty brvr mllv
verses.translation: My words shall utter the uprightness of my heart; And that which my lips know they shall speak sincerely.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֽוּחַ־אֵ֥ל עָשָׂ֑תְנִי וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּחַיֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: rvch'l 'shtny vnshmt shdy tchyny
verses.translation: The spirit of God hath made me, And the breath of the Almighty given me life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־תּוּכַ֥ל הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי עֶרְכָ֥הֿ לְ֝פָנַ֗י הִתְיַצָּֽבָה׃
verses.translit: 'mtvkhl hshybny 'rkhh lpny htytsbh
verses.translation: If thou canst, answer thou me, Set thy words in order before me, stand forth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵן־אֲנִ֣י כְפִ֣יךָ לָאֵ֑ל מֵ֝חֹ֗מֶר קֹרַ֥צְתִּי גַם־אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: hn'ny khpykh l'l mchmr qrtsty gm'ny
verses.translation: Behold, I am toward God even as thou art; I also am formed out of the clay.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה אֵ֭מָתִי לֹ֣א תְבַעֲתֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝אַכְפִּ֗י עָלֶ֥יךָ לֹֽא־יִכְבָּֽד׃
verses.translit: hnh 'mty l' tb'tkh v'khpy 'lykh l'ykhbd
verses.translation: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, Neither shall my pressure be heavy upon thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭ךְ אָמַ֣רְתָּ בְאׇזְנָ֑י וְק֖וֹל מִלִּ֣ין אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.translit: 'kh 'mrt b'zny vqvl mlyn 'shm'
verses.translation: Surely thou hast spoken in my hearing, And I have heard the voice of thy words;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זַ֥ךְ אֲנִ֗י בְּֽלִ֫י־פָ֥שַׁע חַ֥ף אָנֹכִ֑י וְלֹ֖א עָוֺ֣ן לִֽי׃
verses.translit: zkh 'ny blypsh' chf 'nkhy vl' 'vn ly
verses.translation: ’I am clean, without transgression, I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֣ן תְּ֭נוּאוֹת עָלַ֣י יִמְצָ֑א יַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאוֹיֵ֣ב לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hn tnv'vt 'ly ymts' ychshbny l'vyb lv
verses.translation: Behold, He findeth occasions against me, He counteth me for His enemy;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָשֵׂ֣ם בַּסַּ֣ד רַגְלָ֑י יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כׇּל־אׇרְחֹתָֽי׃
verses.translit: yshm bsd rgly yshmr khl'rchty
verses.translation: He putteth my feet in the stocks, He marketh all my paths.’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶן־זֹ֣את לֹא־צָדַ֣קְתָּ אֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ כִּי־יִרְבֶּ֥ה אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ מֵאֱנֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: hnz't l'tsdqt ''nkh khyyrbh 'lvh m'nvsh
verses.translation: Behold, I answer thee: In this thou art not right, That God is too great for man;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַ֭דּוּעַ אֵלָ֣יו רִיב֑וֹתָ כִּ֥י כׇל־דְּ֝בָרָ֗יו לֹ֣א יַעֲנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: mdv' 'lyv rybvt khy khldbryv l' y'nh
verses.translation: Why hast thou striven against Him? Seeing that He will not answer any of his words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־בְאַחַ֥ת יְדַבֶּר־אֵ֑ל וּ֝בִשְׁתַּ֗יִם לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: khyb'cht ydbr'l vbshtym l' yshvrnh
verses.translation: For God speaketh in one way, Yea in two, though man perceiveth it not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּחֲל֤וֹם  חֶזְי֬וֹן לַ֗יְלָה בִּנְפֹ֣ל תַּ֭רְדֵּמָה עַל־אֲנָשִׁ֑ים בִּ֝תְנוּמ֗וֹת עֲלֵ֣י מִשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.translit: bchlvm  chzyvn lylh bnpl trdmh 'l'nshym btnvmvt 'ly mshkhb
verses.translation: In a dream, in a vision of the night, When deep sleep falleth upon men, In slumberings upon the bed;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֣ז יִ֭גְלֶה אֹ֣זֶן אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וּבְמֹ֖סָרָ֣ם יַחְתֹּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'z yglh 'zn 'nshym vbmsrm ychtm
verses.translation: Then He openeth the ears of men, And by their chastisement sealeth the decree,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭הָסִיר אָדָ֣ם מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְגֵוָ֖ה מִגֶּ֣בֶר יְכַסֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: lhsyr 'dm m'shh vgvh mgbr ykhsh
verses.translation: That men may put away their purpose, And that He may hide pride from man;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַחְשֹׂ֣ךְ נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־שָׁ֑חַת וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ מֵעֲבֹ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁלַח׃
verses.translit: ychshkh npshv mnyshcht vchytv m'br bshlch
verses.translation: That He may keep back his soul from the pit, And his life from perishing by the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוּכַ֣ח בְּ֭מַכְאוֹב עַל־מִשְׁכָּב֑וֹ (וריב) [וְר֖וֹב] עֲצָמָ֣יו אֵתָֽן׃
verses.translit: vhvkhch bmkh'vb 'lmshkhbv (vryb) [vrvb] 'tsmyv 'tn
verses.translation: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, And all his bones grow stiff;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזִהֲמַ֣תּוּ חַיָּת֣וֹ לָ֑חֶם וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ מַאֲכַ֥ל תַּאֲוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vzhmtv chytv lchm vnpshv m'khl t'vh
verses.translation: So that his life maketh him to abhor bread, And his soul dainty food.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֣כֶל בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מֵרֹ֑אִי (ושפי) [וְשֻׁפּ֥וּ] עַ֝צְמֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א רֻאּֽוּ׃
verses.translit: ykhl bshrv mr'y (vshpy) [vshpv] 'tsmtyv l' r'v
verses.translation: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; And his bones corrode to unsightliness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקְרַ֣ב לַשַּׁ֣חַת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ לַֽמְמִתִֽים׃
verses.translit: vtqrb lshcht npshv vchytv lmmtym
verses.translation: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the pit, And his life to the destroyers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יֵ֤שׁ עָלָ֨יו  מַלְאָ֗ךְ מֵלִ֗יץ אֶחָ֥ד מִנִּי־אָ֑לֶף לְהַגִּ֖יד לְאָדָ֣ם יׇשְׁרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'mysh 'lyv  ml'kh mlyts 'chd mny'lf lhgyd l'dm yshrv
verses.translation: If there be for him an angel, An intercessor, one among a thousand, To vouch for a man’s uprightness;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחֻנֶּ֗נּוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר פְּ֭דָעֵהוּ מֵרֶ֥דֶת שָׁ֗חַת מָצָ֥אתִי כֹֽפֶר׃
verses.translit: vychnnv vy'mr pd'hv mrdt shcht mts'ty khpr
verses.translation: Then He is gracious unto him, and saith: ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֻֽטְפַ֣שׁ בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מִנֹּ֑עַר יָ֝שׁ֗וּב לִימֵ֥י עֲלוּמָֽיו׃
verses.translit: rtpsh bshrv mn'r yshvb lymy 'lvmyv
verses.translation: His flesh is tenderer than a child’s; He returneth to the days of his youth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֶעְתַּ֤ר אֶל־אֱל֨וֹהַּ  וַיִּרְצֵ֗הוּ וַיַּ֣רְא פָּ֭נָיו בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה וַיָּ֥שֶׁב לֶ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ צִדְקָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: y'tr 'l'lvh  vyrtshv vyr' pnyv btrv'h vyshb l'nvsh tsdqtv
verses.translation: He prayeth unto God, and He is favourable unto him; So that he seeth His face with joy; And He restoreth unto man his righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָשֹׁ֤ר  עַל־אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיֹּ֗אמֶר חָ֭טָאתִי וְיָשָׁ֥ר הֶעֱוֵ֗יתִי וְלֹא־שָׁ֥וָה לִֽי׃
verses.translit: yshr  'l'nshym vy'mr cht'ty vyshr h'vyty vl'shvh ly
verses.translation: He cometh before men, and saith: ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, And it profited me not.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּדָ֣ה (נפשי) [נַ֭פְשׁוֹ] מֵעֲבֹ֣ר בַּשָּׁ֑חַת (וחיתי) [וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ] בָּא֥וֹר תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: pdh (npshy) [npshv] m'br bshcht (vchyty) [vchytv] b'vr tr'h
verses.translation: So He redeemeth his soul from going into the pit, And his life beholdeth the light.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶן־כׇּל־אֵ֭לֶּה יִפְעַל־אֵ֑ל פַּעֲמַ֖יִם שָׁל֣וֹשׁ עִם־גָּֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: hnkhl'lh yp'l'l p'mym shlvsh 'mgbr
verses.translation: Lo, all these things doth God work, Twice, yea thrice, with a man,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהָשִׁ֣יב נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־שָׁ֑חַת לֵ֝א֗וֹר בְּא֣וֹר הַחַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: lhshyb npshv mnyshcht l'vr b'vr hchyym
verses.translation: To bring back his soul from the pit, That he may be enlightened with the light of the living.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַקְשֵׁ֖ב אִיּ֥וֹב שְֽׁמַֽע־לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וְאָנֹכִ֥י אֲדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: hqshb 'yvb shm'ly hchrsh v'nkhy 'dbr
verses.translation: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me; Hold thy peace, and I will speak.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יֵשׁ־מִלִּ֥ין הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי דַּ֝בֵּ֗ר כִּֽי־חָפַ֥צְתִּי צַדְּקֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: 'myshmlyn hshybny dbr khychptsty tsdqkh
verses.translation: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me; Speak, for I desire to justify thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אַ֭יִן אַתָּ֥ה שְֽׁמַֽע־לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וַאֲאַלֶּפְךָ֥ חׇכְמָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'm'yn 'th shm'ly hchrsh v''lpkh chkhmh {p}
verses.translation: If not, hearken thou unto me; Hold thy peace, and I will teach thee wisdom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'lyhv' vy'mr
verses.translation: Moreover Elihu answered and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ חֲכָמִ֣ים מִלָּ֑י וְ֝יֹדְעִ֗ים הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ לִֽי׃
verses.translit: shm'v chkhmym mly vyd'ym h'zynv ly
verses.translation: Hear my words, ye wise men; And give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־אֹ֭זֶן מִלִּ֣ין תִּבְחָ֑ן וְ֝חֵ֗ךְ יִטְעַ֥ם לֶאֱכֹֽל׃
verses.translit: khy'zn mlyn tbchn vchkh yt'm l'khl
verses.translation: For the ear trieth words, As the palate tasteth food.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִשְׁפָּ֥ט נִבְחֲרָה־לָּ֑נוּ נֵדְעָ֖ה בֵינֵ֣ינוּ מַה־טּֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: mshpt nbchrhlnv nd'h bynynv mhtvb
verses.translation: Let us choose for us that which is right; Let us know among ourselves what is good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אָמַ֣ר אִיּ֣וֹב צָדַ֑קְתִּי וְ֝אֵ֗ל הֵסִ֥יר מִשְׁפָּטִֽי׃
verses.translit: khy'mr 'yvb tsdqty v'l hsyr mshpty
verses.translation: For Job hath said: ‘I am righteous, And God hath taken away my right;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־מִשְׁפָּטִ֥י אֲכַזֵּ֑ב אָנ֖וּשׁ חִצִּ֣י בְלִי־פָֽשַׁע׃
verses.translit: 'lmshpty 'khzb 'nvsh chtsy blypsh'
verses.translation: Notwithstanding my right I am accounted a liar; My wound is incurable, though I am without transgression.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִי־גֶ֥בֶר כְּאִיּ֑וֹב יִֽשְׁתֶּה־לַּ֥עַג כַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: mygbr kh'yvb yshthl'g khmym
verses.translation: What man is like Job, Who drinketh up scorning like water?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָרַ֣ח לְ֭חֶבְרָה עִם־פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וְ֝לָלֶ֗כֶת עִם־אַנְשֵׁי־רֶֽשַׁע׃
verses.translit: v'rch lchbrh 'mp'ly 'vn vllkht 'm'nshyrsh'
verses.translation: Who goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, And walketh with wicked men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אָ֭מַר לֹ֣א יִסְכׇּן־גָּ֑בֶר בִּ֝רְצֹת֗וֹ עִם־אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy'mr l' yskhngbr brtstv 'm'lhym
verses.translation: For he hath said: ‘It profiteth a man nothing That he should be in accord with God.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֤ן  אַ֥נְשֵׁ֥י לֵבָ֗ב שִׁמְע֫וּ־לִ֥י חָלִ֖לָה לָאֵ֥ל מֵרֶ֗שַׁע וְשַׁדַּ֥י מֵעָֽוֶל׃
verses.translit: lkhn  'nshy lbb shm'vly chllh l'l mrsh' vshdy m'vl
verses.translation: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: Far be it from God, that He should do wickedness; And from the Almighty, that He should commit iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י פֹ֣עַל אָ֭דָם יְשַׁלֶּם־ל֑וֹ וּֽכְאֹ֥רַח אִ֝֗ישׁ יַמְצִאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: khy p'l 'dm yshlmlv vkh'rch 'ysh ymts'nv
verses.translation: For the work of a man will He requite unto him, And cause every man to find according to his ways.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַף־אׇמְנָ֗ם אֵ֥ל לֹֽא־יַרְשִׁ֑יעַ וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י לֹא־יְעַוֵּ֥ת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: 'f'mnm 'l l'yrshy' vshdy l'y'vt mshpt
verses.translation: Yea, of a surety, God will not do wickedly, Neither will the Almighty pervert justice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו אָ֑רְצָה וּמִ֥י שָׂ֝֗ם תֵּבֵ֥ל כֻּלָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: mypqd 'lyv 'rtsh vmy shm tbl khlh
verses.translation: Who gave Him a charge over the earth? Or who hath disposed the whole world?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יָשִׂ֣ים אֵלָ֣יו לִבּ֑וֹ רוּח֥וֹ וְ֝נִשְׁמָת֗וֹ אֵלָ֥יו יֶאֱסֹֽף׃
verses.translit: 'myshym 'lyv lbv rvchv vnshmtv 'lyv y'sf
verses.translation: If He set His heart upon man, If He gather unto Himself his spirit and his breath;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִגְוַ֣ע כׇּל־בָּשָׂ֣ר יָ֑חַד וְ֝אָדָ֗ם עַל־עָפָ֥ר יָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.translit: ygv' khlbshr ychd v'dm 'l'pr yshvb
verses.translation: All flesh shall perish together, And man shall return unto dust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־בִּ֥ינָה שִׁמְעָה־זֹּ֑את הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינָה לְק֣וֹל מִלָּֽי׃
verses.translit: v'mbynh shm'hz't h'zynh lqvl mly
verses.translation: If now thou hast understanding, hear this; Hearken to the voice of my words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַאַ֬ף שׂוֹנֵ֣א מִשְׁפָּ֣ט יַחֲב֑וֹשׁ וְאִם־צַדִּ֖יק כַּבִּ֣יר תַּרְשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.translit: h'f shvn' mshpt ychbvsh v'mtsdyq khbyr trshy'
verses.translation: Shall even one that hateth right govern? And wilt thou condemn Him that is just and mighty—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַאֲמֹ֣ר לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בְּלִיָּ֑עַל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע אֶל־נְדִיבִֽים׃
verses.translit: h'mr lmlkh bly'l rsh' 'lndybym
verses.translation: Is it fit to say to a king: ‘Thou art base’? Or to nobles: ‘Ye are wicked’?—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־נָשָׂ֨א  פְּנֵ֥י שָׂרִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א נִכַּר־שׁ֭וֹעַ לִפְנֵי־דָ֑ל כִּֽי־מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדָ֣יו כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'shr l'nsh'  pny shrym vl' nkhrshv' lpnydl khym'shh ydyv khlm
verses.translation: That respecteth not the persons of princes, Nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? For they all are the work of His hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֶ֤גַע  יָמֻתוּ֮ וַחֲצ֢וֹת לָ֥֫יְלָה יְגֹעֲשׁ֣וּ עָ֣ם וְיַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְיָסִ֥ירוּ אַ֝בִּ֗יר לֹ֣א בְיָֽד׃
verses.translit: rg'  ymtv vchtsvt lylh yg'shv 'm vy'brv vysyrv 'byr l' byd
verses.translation: In a moment they die, even at midnight; The people are shaken and pass away, And the mighty are taken away without hand. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עֵ֭ינָיו עַל־דַּרְכֵי־אִ֑ישׁ וְֽכׇל־צְעָדָ֥יו יִרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: khy'ynyv 'ldrkhy'ysh vkhlts'dyv yr'h
verses.translation: For His eyes are upon the ways of a man, And He seeth all his goings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵֽין־חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וְאֵ֣ין צַלְמָ֑וֶת לְהִסָּ֥תֶר שָׁ֝֗ם פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.translit: 'ynchshkh v'yn tslmvt lhstr shm p'ly 'vn
verses.translation: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, Where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א עַל־אִ֭ישׁ יָשִׂ֣ים ע֑וֹד לַהֲלֹ֥ךְ אֶל־אֵ֝֗ל בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: khy l' 'l'ysh yshym 'vd lhlkh 'l'l bmshpt
verses.translation: For He doth not appoint a time unto any man, When he should go before God in judgment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָרֹ֣עַ כַּבִּירִ֣ים לֹא־חֵ֑קֶר וַיַּעֲמֵ֖ד אֲחֵרִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: yr' khbyrym l'chqr vy'md 'chrym tchtm
verses.translation: He breaketh in pieces mighty men without inquisition, And setteth others in their stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן יַ֭כִּיר מַעְבָּדֵיהֶ֑ם וְהָ֥פַךְ לַ֝֗יְלָה וְיִדַּכָּֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: lkhn ykhyr m'bdyhm vhpkh lylh vydkh'v
verses.translation: Therefore He taketh knowledge of their works; And He overturneth them in the night, so that they are crushed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּֽחַת־רְשָׁעִ֥ים סְפָקָ֗ם בִּמְק֥וֹם רֹאִֽים׃
verses.translit: tchtrsh'ym spqm bmqvm r'ym
verses.translation: He striketh them as wicked men In the open sight of others;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־כֵּ֭ן סָ֣רוּ מֵאַחֲרָ֑יו וְכׇל־דְּ֝רָכָ֗יו לֹ֣א הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃
verses.translit: 'shr 'lkhn srv m'chryv vkhldrkhyv l' hshkhylv
verses.translation: Because they turned aside from following Him, And would not have regard to any of His ways;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהָבִ֣יא עָ֭לָיו צַעֲקַת־דָּ֑ל וְצַעֲקַ֖ת עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.translit: lhby' 'lyv ts'qtdl vts'qt 'nyym yshm'
verses.translation: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto Him, And He heareth the cry of the afflicted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְה֤וּא יַשְׁקִ֨ט  וּמִ֥י יַרְשִׁ֗עַ וְיַסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נִים וּמִ֣י יְשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ וְעַל־גּ֖וֹי וְעַל־אָדָ֣ם יָֽחַד׃
verses.translit: vhv' yshqt  vmy yrsh' vystr pnym vmy yshvrnv v'lgvy v'l'dm ychd
verses.translation: When He giveth quietness, who then can condemn? And when He hideth His face, who then can behold Him? Whether it be done unto a nation, or unto a man, alike;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭מְּלֹךְ אָדָ֥ם חָנֵ֗ף מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי עָֽם׃
verses.translit: mmlkh 'dm chnf mmqshy 'm
verses.translation: That the godless man reign not, That there be none to ensnare the people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אֶל־אֵ֭ל הֶאָמַ֥ר נָשָׂ֗אתִי לֹ֣א אֶחְבֹּֽל׃
verses.translit: khy'l'l h'mr nsh'ty l' 'chbl
verses.translation: For hath any said unto God: ‘I have borne chastisement, though I offend not;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּלְעֲדֵ֣י אֶ֭חֱזֶה אַתָּ֣ה הֹרֵ֑נִי אִֽם־עָ֥וֶל פָּ֝עַ֗לְתִּי לֹ֣א אֹסִֽיף׃
verses.translit: bl'dy 'chzh 'th hrny 'm'vl p'lty l' 'syf
verses.translation: That which I see not teach Thou me; If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲֽמֵעִמְּךָ֬ יְשַׁלְּמֶ֨נָּה  כִּֽי־מָאַ֗סְתָּ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה תִבְחַ֣ר וְלֹא־אָ֑נִי וּֽמַה־יָּדַ֥עְתָּ דַבֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: hm'mkh yshlmnh  khym'st khy'th tbchr vl''ny vmhyd't dbr
verses.translation: Shall His recompense be as thou wilt? For thou loathest it, So that thou must choose, and not I; Therefore speak what thou knowest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י לֵ֭בָב יֹ֣אמְרוּ לִ֑י וְגֶ֥בֶר חָ֝כָ֗ם שֹׁמֵ֥עַֽ לִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'nshy lbb y'mrv ly vgbr chkhm shm' ly
verses.translation: Men of understanding will say unto me, Yea, every wise man that heareth me:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֭יּוֹב לֹא־בְדַ֣עַת יְדַבֵּ֑ר וּ֝דְבָרָ֗יו לֹ֣א בְהַשְׂכֵּֽיל׃
verses.translit: 'yvb l'bd't ydbr vdbryv l' bhshkhyl
verses.translation: ’Job speaketh without knowledge, And his words are without discernment.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָבִ֗י יִבָּחֵ֣ן אִיּ֣וֹב עַד־נֶ֑צַח עַל־תְּ֝שֻׁבֹ֗ת בְּאַנְשֵׁי־אָֽוֶן׃
verses.translit: 'by ybchn 'yvb 'dntsch 'ltshbt b'nshy'vn
verses.translation: Would that Job were tried unto the end, Because of his answering like wicked men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י־יֹ֘סִ֤יף עַֽל־חַטָּאת֣וֹ פֶ֭שַׁע בֵּינֵ֣ינוּ יִשְׂפּ֑וֹק וְיֶ֖רֶב אֲמָרָ֣יו לָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khyysyf 'lcht'tv psh' bynynv yshpvq vyrb 'mryv l'l {p}
verses.translation: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, He clappeth his hands among us, And multiplieth his words against God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אֱלִיה֗וּ וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'lyhv vy'mr
verses.translation: Moreover Elihu answered and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲ֭זֹאת חָשַׁ֣בְתָּ לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט אָ֝מַ֗רְתָּ צִדְקִ֥י מֵאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: hz't chshbt lmshpt 'mrt tsdqy m'l
verses.translation: Thinkest thou this to be thy right, Or sayest thou: ‘I am righteousness before God’,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תֹ֭אמַר מַה־יִּסְכׇּן־לָ֑ךְ מָה־אֹ֝עִ֗יל מֵחַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.translit: khyt'mr mhyskhnlkh mh''yl mcht'ty
verses.translation: That thou inquirest: ‘What advantage will it be unto Thee?’ And: ‘What profit shall I have, more than if I had sinned?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲ֭נִי אֲשִֽׁיבְךָ֣ מִלִּ֑ין וְֽאֶת־רֵעֶ֥יךָ עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'ny 'shybkh mlyn v'tr'ykh 'mkh
verses.translation: I will give thee answer, And thy companions with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַבֵּ֣ט שָׁמַ֣יִם וּרְאֵ֑ה וְשׁ֥וּר שְׁ֝חָקִ֗ים גָּבְה֥וּ מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: hbt shmym vr'h vshvr shchqym gbhv mmkh
verses.translation: Look unto the heavens, and see; And behold the skies, which are higher than thou.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־חָ֭טָאתָ מַה־תִּפְעׇל־בּ֑וֹ וְרַבּ֥וּ פְ֝שָׁעֶ֗יךָ מַה־תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־לּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'mcht't mhtp'lbv vrbv psh'ykh mht'shhlv
verses.translation: If thou hast sinned, what doest thou against Him? And if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto Him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־צָ֭דַקְתָּ מַה־תִּתֶּן־ל֑וֹ א֥וֹ מַה־מִּיָּדְךָ֥ יִקָּֽח׃
verses.translit: 'mtsdqt mhttnlv 'v mhmydkh yqch
verses.translation: If thou be righteous, what givest thou Him? Or what receiveth He of thy hand?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְאִישׁ־כָּמ֥וֹךָ רִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ וּלְבֶן־אָ֝דָ֗ם צִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: l'yshkhmvkh rsh'kh vlbn'dm tsdqtkh
verses.translation: Thy wickedness concerneth a man as thou art; And thy righteousness a son of man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵ֭רֹב עֲשׁוּקִ֣ים יַזְעִ֑יקוּ יְשַׁוְּע֖וּ מִזְּר֣וֹעַ רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: mrb 'shvqym yz'yqv yshv'v mzrv' rbym
verses.translation: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out; They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽלֹא־אָמַ֗ר אַ֭יֵּה אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֹשָׂ֑י נֹתֵ֖ן זְמִר֣וֹת בַּלָּֽיְלָה׃
verses.translit: vl''mr 'yh 'lvh 'shy ntn zmrvt blylh
verses.translation: But none saith: ‘Where is God my Maker, Who giveth songs in the night;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַ֭לְּפֵנוּ מִבַּהֲמ֣וֹת אָ֑רֶץ וּמֵע֖וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יְחַכְּמֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: mlpnv mbhmvt 'rts vm'vf hshmym ychkhmnv
verses.translation: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, And maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֣ם יִ֭צְעֲקוּ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י גְּא֣וֹן רָעִֽים׃
verses.translit: shm yts'qv vl' y'nh mpny g'vn r'ym
verses.translation: There they cry, but none giveth answer, Because of the pride of evil men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־שָׁ֭וְא לֹא־יִשְׁמַ֥ע ׀ אֵ֑ל וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: 'khshv' l'yshm'  'l vshdy l' yshvrnh
verses.translation: Surely God will not hear vanity, Neither will the Almighty regard it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ף כִּֽי־תֹ֭אמַר לֹ֣א תְשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ דִּ֥ין לְ֝פָנָ֗יו וּתְח֥וֹלֵֽל לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'f khyt'mr l' tshvrnv dyn lpnyv vtchvll lv
verses.translation: Yea, when thou sayest thou canst not see Him— The cause is before Him; therefore wait thou for Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה כִּי־אַ֭יִן פָּקַ֣ד אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־יָדַ֖ע בַּפַּ֣שׁ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: v'th khy'yn pqd 'pv vl'yd' bpsh m'd
verses.translation: And now, is it for nought that He punished in His anger? And hath He not full knowledge of arrogance?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭אִיּוֹב הֶ֣בֶל יִפְצֶה־פִּ֑יהוּ בִּבְלִי־דַ֝֗עַת מִלִּ֥ין יַכְבִּֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'yvb hbl yptshpyhv bblyd't mlyn ykhbr {p}
verses.translation: But Job doth open his mouth in vanity; He multiplieth words without knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥סֶף אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vysf 'lyhv' vy'mr
verses.translation: Elihu also proceeded, and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּתַּר־לִ֣י זְ֭עֵיר וַאֲחַוֶּ֑ךָּ כִּ֤י ע֖וֹד לֶאֱל֣וֹהַּ מִלִּֽים׃
verses.translit: khtrly z'yr v'chvkh khy 'vd l'lvh mlym
verses.translation: Suffer me a little, and I will tell thee; For there are yet words on God’s behalf.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶשָּׂ֣א דֵ֭עִי לְמֵרָח֑וֹק וּ֝לְפֹעֲלִ֗י אֶֽתֵּֽן־צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.translit: 'sh' d'y lmrchvq vlp'ly 'tntsdq
verses.translation: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, And will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אׇ֭מְנָם לֹא־שֶׁ֣קֶר מִלָּ֑י תְּמִ֖ים דֵּע֣וֹת עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khy'mnm l'shqr mly tmym d'vt 'mkh
verses.translation: For truly my words are not false; One that is upright in mind is with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶן־אֵ֣ל כַּ֭בִּיר וְלֹ֣א יִמְאָ֑ס כַּ֝בִּ֗יר כֹּ֣חַֽ לֵֽב׃
verses.translit: hn'l khbyr vl' ym's khbyr khch lb
verses.translation: Behold, God is mighty, yet He despiseth not any; He is mighty in strength of understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יְחַיֶּ֥ה רָשָׁ֑ע וּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: l'ychyh rsh' vmshpt 'nyym ytn
verses.translation: He preserveth not the life of the wicked; But giveth to the poor their right.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־יִגְרַ֥ע מִצַּדִּ֗יק עֵ֫ינָ֥יו וְאֶת־מְלָכִ֥ים לַכִּסֵּ֑א וַיֹּשִׁיבֵ֥ם לָ֝נֶ֗צַח וַיִּגְבָּֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: l'ygr' mtsdyq 'ynyv v'tmlkhym lkhs' vyshybm lntsch vygbhv
verses.translation: He withdraweth not His eyes from the righteous; But with kings upon the throne He setteth them for ever, and they are exalted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־אֲסוּרִ֥ים בַּזִּקִּ֑ים יִ֝לָּכְד֗וּן בְּחַבְלֵי־עֹֽנִי׃
verses.translit: v'm'svrym bzqym ylkhdvn bchbly'ny
verses.translation: And if they be bound in fetters, And be holden in cords of affliction;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּגֵּ֣ד לָהֶ֣ם פׇּעֳלָ֑ם וּ֝פִשְׁעֵיהֶ֗ם כִּ֣י יִתְגַּבָּֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: vygd lhm p'lm vpsh'yhm khy ytgbrv
verses.translation: Then He declareth unto them their work, And their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֣גֶל אׇ֭זְנָם לַמּוּסָ֑ר וַ֝יֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי־יְשׁוּב֥וּן מֵאָֽוֶן׃
verses.translit: vygl 'znm lmvsr vy'mr khyyshvbvn m'vn
verses.translation: He openeth also their ear to discipline, And commandeth that they return from iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִֽם־יִשְׁמְע֗וּ וְֽיַ֫עֲבֹ֥דוּ יְכַלּ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֣ם בַּטּ֑וֹב וּ֝שְׁנֵיהֶ֗ם בַּנְּעִימִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'myshm'v vy'bdv ykhlv ymyhm btvb vshnyhm bn'ymym
verses.translation: If they hearken and serve Him, They shall spend their days in prosperity, And their years in pleasures.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־לֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁמְעוּ בְּשֶׁ֣לַח יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְ֝יִגְוְע֗וּ בִּבְלִי־דָֽעַת׃
verses.translit: v'ml' yshm'v bshlch y'brv vygv'v bblyd't
verses.translation: But if they hearken not, they shall perish by the sword, And they shall die without knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽחַנְפֵי־לֵ֭ב יָשִׂ֣ימוּ אָ֑ף לֹ֥א יְ֝שַׁוְּע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲסָרָֽם׃
verses.translit: vchnpylb yshymv 'f l' yshv'v khy 'srm
verses.translation: But they that are godless in heart lay up anger; They cry not for help when He bindeth them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּמֹ֣ת בַּנֹּ֣עַר נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם בַּקְּדֵשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: tmt bn'r npshm vchytm bqdshym
verses.translation: Their soul perisheth in youth, And their life as that of the depraved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְחַלֵּ֣ץ עָנִ֣י בְעׇנְי֑וֹ וְיִ֖גֶל בַּלַּ֣חַץ אׇזְנָֽם׃
verses.translit: ychlts 'ny b'nyv vygl blchts 'znm
verses.translation: He delivereth the afflicted by His affliction, And openeth their ear by tribulation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַ֤ף הֲסִֽיתְךָ֨  מִפִּי־צָ֗ר רַ֭חַב לֹא־מוּצָ֣ק תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְנַ֥חַת שֻׁ֝לְחָנְךָ֗ מָ֣לֵא דָֽשֶׁן׃
verses.translit: v'f hsytkh  mpytsr rchb l'mvtsq tchtyh vncht shlchnkh ml' dshn
verses.translation: Yea, He hath allured thee out of distress Into a broad place, where there is no straitness; And that which is set on thy table is full of fatness;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדִין־רָשָׁ֥ע מָלֵ֑אתָ דִּ֖ין וּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט יִתְמֹֽכוּ׃
verses.translit: vdynrsh' ml't dyn vmshpt ytmkhv
verses.translation: And thou art full of the judgment of the wicked; Judgment and justice take hold on them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־חֵ֭מָה פֶּן־יְסִֽיתְךָ֣ בְסָ֑פֶק וְרׇב־כֹּ֝֗פֶר אַל־יַטֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: khychmh pnysytkh bspq vrbkhpr 'lytkh
verses.translation: For beware of wrath, lest thou be led away by thy sufficiency; Neither let the greatness of the ransom turn thee aside.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיַעֲרֹ֣ךְ שׁ֭וּעֲךָ לֹ֣א בְצָ֑ר וְ֝כֹ֗ל מַאֲמַצֵּי־כֹֽחַ׃
verses.translit: hy'rkh shv'kh l' btsr vkhl m'mtsykhch
verses.translation: Will thy riches avail, that are without stint, Or all the forces of thy strength?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּשְׁאַ֥ף הַלָּ֑יְלָה לַעֲל֖וֹת עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'ltsh'f hlylh l'lvt 'mym tchtm
verses.translation: Desire not the night, When peoples are cut off in their place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֭שָּׁמֶר אַל־תֵּ֣פֶן אֶל־אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי־עַל־זֶ֝֗ה בָּחַ֥רְתָּ מֵעֹֽנִי׃
verses.translit: hshmr 'ltpn 'l'vn khy'lzh bchrt m'ny
verses.translation: Take heed, regard not iniquity; For this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶן־אֵ֭ל יַשְׂגִּ֣יב בְּכֹח֑וֹ מִ֖י כָמֹ֣הוּ מוֹרֶֽה׃
verses.translit: hn'l yshgyb bkhchv my khmhv mvrh
verses.translation: Behold, God doeth loftily in His power; Who is a teacher like Him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּמִי־אָ֝מַ֗ר פָּעַ֥לְתָּ עַוְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: mypqd 'lyv drkhv vmy'mr p'lt 'vlh
verses.translation: Who hath enjoined Him His way? Or who hath said: ‘Thou hast wrought unrighteousness’?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְ֭כֹר כִּֽי־תַשְׂגִּ֣יא פׇעֳל֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר שֹׁרְר֣וּ אֲנָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: zkhr khytshgy' p'lv 'shr shrrv 'nshym
verses.translation: Remember that thou magnify His work, Whereof men have sung.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־אָדָ֥ם חָזוּ־ב֑וֹ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ יַבִּ֥יט מֵרָחֽוֹק׃
verses.translit: khl'dm chzvbv 'nvsh ybyt mrchvq
verses.translation: All men have looked thereon; Man beholdeth it afar off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶן־אֵ֣ל שַׂ֭גִּיא וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע מִסְפַּ֖ר שָׁנָ֣יו וְלֹא־חֵֽקֶר׃
verses.translit: hn'l shgy' vl' nd' mspr shnyv vl'chqr
verses.translation: Behold, God is great, beyond our knowledge; The number of His years is unsearchable.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֭י יְגָרַ֣ע נִטְפֵי־מָ֑יִם יָזֹ֖קּוּ מָטָ֣ר לְאֵדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy ygr' ntpymym yzqv mtr l'dv
verses.translation: For He draweth away the drops of water, Which distil rain from His vapour;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶֽׁר־יִזְּל֥וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים יִ֝רְעֲפ֗וּ עֲלֵ֤י  אָדָ֬ם רָֽב׃
verses.translit: 'shryzlv shchqym yr'pv 'ly  'dm rb
verses.translation: Which the skies pour down And drop upon the multitudes of men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ף אִם־יָ֭בִין מִפְרְשֵׂי־עָ֑ב תְּ֝שֻׁא֗וֹת סֻכָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'f 'mybyn mprshy'b tsh'vt skhtv
verses.translation: Yea, can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, The crashings of His pavilion?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵן־פָּרַ֣שׂ עָלָ֣יו אוֹר֑וֹ וְשׇׁרְשֵׁ֖י הַיָּ֣ם כִּסָּֽה׃
verses.translit: hnprsh 'lyv 'vrv vshrshy hym khsh
verses.translation: Behold, He spreadeth His light upon it; And He covereth the depths of the sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־בָ֭ם יָדִ֣ין עַמִּ֑ים יִֽתֶּן־אֹ֥כֶל לְמַכְבִּֽיר׃
verses.translit: khybm ydyn 'mym ytn'khl lmkhbyr
verses.translation: For by these He judgeth the peoples; He giveth food in abundance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כַּפַּ֥יִם כִּסָּה־א֑וֹר וַיְצַ֖ו עָלֶ֣יהָ בְמַפְגִּֽיעַ׃
verses.translit: 'lkhpym khsh'vr vytsv 'lyh bmpgy'
verses.translation: He covereth His hands with the lightning, And giveth it a charge that it strike the mark.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַגִּ֣יד עָלָ֣יו רֵע֑וֹ מִ֝קְנֶ֗ה אַ֣ף עַל־עוֹלֶֽה׃
verses.translit: ygyd 'lyv r'v mqnh 'f 'l'vlh
verses.translation: The noise thereof telleth concerning it, The cattle also concerning the storm that cometh up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַף־לְ֭זֹאת יֶחֱרַ֣ד לִבִּ֑י וְ֝יִתַּ֗ר מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'flz't ychrd lby vytr mmqvmv
verses.translation: At this also my heart trembleth, And is moved out of its place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ שָׁמ֣וֹעַ בְּרֹ֣גֶז קֹל֑וֹ וְ֝הֶ֗גֶה מִפִּ֥יו יֵצֵֽא׃
verses.translit: shm'v shmv' brgz qlv vhgh mpyv yts'
verses.translation: Hear attentively the noise of His voice, And the sound that goeth out of His mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּֽחַת־כׇּל־הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם יִשְׁרֵ֑הוּ וְ֝אוֹר֗וֹ עַל־כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: tchtkhlhshmym yshrhv v'vrv 'lkhnpvt h'rts
verses.translation: He sendeth it forth under the whole heaven, And His lightning unto the ends of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֤יו  יִשְׁאַג־ק֗וֹל יַ֭רְעֵם בְּק֣וֹל גְּאוֹנ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יְ֝עַקְּבֵ֗ם כִּֽי־יִשָּׁמַ֥ע קוֹלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'chryv  ysh'gqvl yr'm bqvl g'vnv vl' y'qbm khyyshm' qvlv
verses.translation: After it a voice roareth; He thundereth with the voice of His majesty; And He stayeth them not when His voice is heard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַרְעֵ֤ם אֵ֣ל בְּ֭קוֹלוֹ נִפְלָא֑וֹת עֹשֶׂ֥ה גְ֝דֹל֗וֹת וְלֹ֣א נֵדָֽע׃
verses.translit: yr'm 'l bqvlv npl'vt 'shh gdlvt vl' nd'
verses.translation: God thundereth marvellously with His voice; Great things doeth He, which we cannot comprehend.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לַשֶּׁ֨לֶג  יֹאמַ֗ר הֱוֵ֫א־אָ֥רֶץ וְגֶ֥שֶׁם מָטָ֑ר וְ֝גֶ֗שֶׁם מִטְר֥וֹת עֻזּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy lshlg  y'mr hv''rts vgshm mtr vgshm mtrvt 'zv
verses.translation: For He saith to the snow: ‘Fall thou on the earth’; Likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of His mighty rain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּיַד־כׇּל־אָדָ֥ם יַחְתּ֑וֹם לָ֝דַ֗עַת כׇּל־אַנְשֵׁ֥י מַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃
verses.translit: bydkhl'dm ychtvm ld't khl'nshy m'shhv
verses.translation: He sealeth up the hand of every man, That all men whom He hath made may know it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּב֣וֹא חַיָּ֣ה בְמוֹ־אָ֑רֶב וּבִמְע֖וֹנֹתֶ֣יהָ תִשְׁכֹּֽן׃
verses.translit: vtbv' chyh bmv'rb vbm'vntyh tshkhn
verses.translation: Then the beasts go into coverts, And remain in their dens.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־הַ֭חֶדֶר תָּב֣וֹא סוּפָ֑ה וּֽמִמְּזָרִ֥ים קָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: mnhchdr tbv' svph vmmzrym qrh
verses.translation: Out of the Chamber cometh the storm; And cold out of the north.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִנִּשְׁמַת־אֵ֥ל יִתֶּן־קָ֑רַח וְרֹ֖חַב מַ֣יִם בְּמוּצָֽק׃
verses.translit: mnshmt'l ytnqrch vrchb mym bmvtsq
verses.translation: By the breath of God ice is given, And the breadth of the waters is straitened.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַף־בְּ֭רִי יַטְרִ֣יחַ עָ֑ב יָ֝פִ֗יץ עֲנַ֣ן אוֹרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'fbry ytrych 'b ypyts 'nn 'vrv
verses.translation: Yea, He ladeth the thick cloud with moister, He spreadeth abroad the cloud of His lightning;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְה֤וּא מְסִבּ֨וֹת  מִתְהַפֵּ֣ךְ בְּתַחְבּוּלֹתָ֣ו לְפׇעֳלָ֑ם כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצַוֵּ֓ם  עַל־פְּנֵ֖י תֵבֵ֣ל אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.translit: vhv' msbvt  mthpkh btchbvltv lp'lm khl 'shr ytsvm  'lpny tbl 'rtsh
verses.translation: And they are turned round about by His guidance, That they may do whatsoever He commandeth them Upon the face of the habitable world:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־לְשֵׁ֥בֶט אִם־לְאַרְצ֑וֹ אִם־לְ֝חֶ֗סֶד יַמְצִאֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: 'mlshbt 'ml'rtsv 'mlchsd ymts'hv
verses.translation: Whether it be for correction, or for His earth, Or for mercy, that He cause it to come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה זֹּ֣את אִיּ֑וֹב עֲ֝מֹ֗ד וְהִתְבּוֹנֵ֤ן  נִפְלְא֬וֹת אֵֽל׃
verses.translit: h'zynh z't 'yvb 'md vhtbvnn  npl'vt 'l
verses.translation: Hearken unto this, O Job; Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲ֭תֵדַע בְּשׂוּם־אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝הֹפִ֗יעַ א֣וֹר עֲנָנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: htd' bshvm'lvh 'lyhm vhpy' 'vr 'nnv
verses.translation: Dost thou know how God enjoineth them, And causeth the lightning of His cloud to shine?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲ֭תֵדַע עַל־מִפְלְשֵׂי־עָ֑ב מִ֝פְלְא֗וֹת תְּמִ֣ים דֵּעִֽים׃
verses.translit: htd' 'lmplshy'b mpl'vt tmym d'ym
verses.translation: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, The wondrous works of Him who is perfect in knowledge?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־בְּגָדֶ֥יךָ חַמִּ֑ים בְּהַשְׁקִ֥ט אֶ֝֗רֶץ מִדָּרֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: 'shrbgdykh chmym bhshqt 'rts mdrvm
verses.translation: Thou whose garments are warm, When the earth is still by reason of the south wind;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּרְקִ֣יעַ עִ֭מּוֹ לִשְׁחָקִ֑ים חֲ֝זָקִ֗ים כִּרְאִ֥י מוּצָֽק׃
verses.translit: trqy' 'mv lshchqym chzqym khr'y mvtsq
verses.translation: Canst thou with Him spread out the sky, Which is strong as a molten mirror?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֭וֹדִיעֵנוּ מַה־נֹּ֣אמַר ל֑וֹ לֹֽא־נַ֝עֲרֹ֗ךְ מִפְּנֵי־חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.translit: hvdy'nv mhn'mr lv l'n'rkh mpnychshkh
verses.translation: Teach us what we shall say unto Him; For we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽיְסֻפַּר־ל֭וֹ כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אִֽם־אָ֥מַר אִ֝֗ישׁ כִּ֣י יְבֻלָּֽע׃
verses.translit: hysprlv khy 'dbr 'm'mr 'ysh khy ybl'
verses.translation: Shall it be told Him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֤ה  לֹ֘א־רָ֤אוּ א֗וֹר בָּהִ֣יר ה֭וּא בַּשְּׁחָקִ֑ים וְר֥וּחַ עָ֝בְרָ֗ה וַֽתְּטַהֲרֵֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th  l'r'v 'vr bhyr hv' bshchqym vrvch 'brh vtthrm
verses.translation: And now men see not the light which is bright in the skies; But the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭צָּפוֹן זָהָ֣ב יֶאֱתֶ֑ה עַל־אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ נ֣וֹרָא הֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: mtspvn zhb y'th 'l'lvh nvr' hvd
verses.translation: Out of the north cometh golden splendour, About God is terrible majesty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁדַּ֣י לֹא־מְ֭צָאנֻהוּ שַׂגִּיא־כֹ֑חַ וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט וְרֹב־צְ֝דָקָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: shdy l'mts'nhv shgy'khch vmshpt vrbtsdqh l' y'nh
verses.translation: The Almighty, whom we cannot find out, is excellent in power, Yet to judgment and plenteous justice He doeth no violence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֭כֵן יְרֵא֣וּהוּ אֲנָשִׁ֑ים לֹֽא־יִ֝רְאֶ֗ה כׇּל־חַכְמֵי־לֵֽב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lkhn yr'vhv 'nshym l'yr'h khlchkhmylb {p}
verses.translation: Men do therefore fear Him; He regardeth not any that are wise of heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעַן־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֶת־אִ֭יּוֹב (מנהסערה) [מִ֥ן ׀ הַסְּעָרָ֗ה] וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'nyhvh 't'yvb (mnhs'rh) [mn  hs'rh] vy'mr
verses.translation: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֤י זֶ֨ה  מַחְשִׁ֖יךְ עֵצָ֥ה בְמִלִּ֗ין בְּֽלִי־דָֽעַת׃
verses.translit: my zh  mchshykh 'tsh bmlyn blyd't
verses.translation: Who is this that darkeneth counsel By words without knowledge?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱזׇר־נָ֣א כְגֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑יךָ וְ֝אֶשְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: 'zrn' khgbr chltsykh v'sh'lkh vhvdy'ny
verses.translation: Gird up now thy loins like a man; For I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵיפֹ֣ה הָ֭יִיתָ בְּיׇסְדִי־אָ֑רֶץ הַ֝גֵּ֗ד אִם־יָדַ֥עְתָּ בִינָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'yph hyyt bysdy'rts hgd 'myd't bynh
verses.translation: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if thou hast the understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִי־שָׂ֣ם מְ֭מַדֶּיהָ כִּ֣י תֵדָ֑ע א֤וֹ מִֽי־נָטָ֖ה עָלֶ֣יהָ קָּֽו׃
verses.translit: myshm mmdyh khy td' 'v mynth 'lyh qv
verses.translation: Who determined the measures thereof, if thou knowest? Or who stretched the line upon it?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־מָ֭ה אֲדָנֶ֣יהָ הׇטְבָּ֑עוּ א֥וֹ מִי־יָ֝רָ֗ה אֶ֣בֶן פִּנָּתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: 'lmh 'dnyh htb'v 'v myyrh 'bn pnth
verses.translation: Whereupon were the foundations thereof fastened? Or who laid the corner-stone thereof,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרׇן־יַ֭חַד כּ֣וֹכְבֵי בֹ֑קֶר וַ֝יָּרִ֗יעוּ כׇּל־בְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: brnychd khvkhby bqr vyry'v khlbny 'lhym
verses.translation: When the morning stars sang together, And all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣סֶךְ בִּדְלָתַ֣יִם יָ֑ם בְּ֝גִיח֗וֹ מֵרֶ֥חֶם יֵצֵֽא׃
verses.translit: vyskh bdltym ym bgychv mrchm yts'
verses.translation: Or who shut up the sea with doors, When it broke forth, and issued out of the womb;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּשׂוּמִ֣י עָנָ֣ן לְבֻשׁ֑וֹ וַ֝עֲרָפֶ֗ל חֲתֻלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: bshvmy 'nn lbshv v'rpl chtltv
verses.translation: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, And thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁבֹּ֣ר עָלָ֣יו חֻקִּ֑י וָ֝אָשִׂ֗ים בְּרִ֣יחַ וּדְלָתָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: v'shbr 'lyv chqy v'shym brych vdltym
verses.translation: And prescribed for it My decree, And set bars and doors,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר עַד־פֹּ֣ה תָ֭בוֹא וְלֹ֣א תֹסִ֑יף וּפֹא־יָ֝שִׁ֗ית בִּגְא֥וֹן גַּלֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'dph tbv' vl' tsyf vp'yshyt bg'vn glykh
verses.translation: And said: ‘Thus far shalt thou come, but no further; And here shall thy proud waves be stayed’?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲֽ֭מִיָּמֶיךָ צִוִּ֣יתָ בֹּ֑קֶר (ידעתה שחר) [יִדַּ֖עְתָּ הַשַּׁ֣חַר] מְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hmymykh tsvyt bqr (yd'th shchr) [yd't hshchr] mqmv
verses.translation: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days began, And caused the dayspring to know its place;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֶ֭אֱחֹז בְּכַנְפ֣וֹת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְיִנָּעֲר֖וּ רְשָׁים מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: l'chz bkhnpvt h'rts vyn'rv rshym mmnh
verses.translation: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, And the wicked be shaken out of it?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּ֭תְהַפֵּךְ כְּחֹ֣מֶר חוֹתָ֑ם וְ֝יִֽתְיַצְּב֗וּ כְּמ֣וֹ לְבֽוּשׁ׃
verses.translit: tthpkh khchmr chvtm vytytsbv khmv lbvsh
verses.translation: It is changed as clay under the seal; And they stand as a garment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִמָּנַ֣ע מֵרְשָׁים אוֹרָ֑ם וּזְר֥וֹעַ רָ֝מָ֗ה תִּשָּׁבֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vymn' mrshym 'vrm vzrv' rmh tshbr
verses.translation: But from the wicked their light is withholden, And the high arm is broken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲ֭בָאתָ עַד־נִבְכֵי־יָ֑ם וּבְחֵ֥קֶר תְּ֝ה֗וֹם הִתְהַלָּֽכְתָּ׃
verses.translit: hb't 'dnbkhyym vbchqr thvm hthlkht
verses.translation: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? Or hast thou walked in the recesses of the deep? .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲנִגְל֣וּ לְ֭ךָ שַׁעֲרֵי־מָ֑וֶת וְשַׁעֲרֵ֖י צַלְמָ֣וֶת תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: hnglv lkh sh'rymvt vsh'ry tslmvt tr'h
verses.translation: Have the gates of death been revealed unto thee? Or hast thou seen the gates of the shadow of death?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֭תְבֹּנַנְתָּ עַד־רַחֲבֵי־אָ֑רֶץ הַ֝גֵּ֗ד אִם־יָדַ֥עְתָּ כֻלָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: htbnnt 'drchby'rts hgd 'myd't khlh
verses.translation: Hast thou surveyed unto the breadths of the earth? Declare, if thou knowest it all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵי־זֶ֣ה הַ֭דֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁכׇּן־א֑וֹר וְ֝חֹ֗שֶׁךְ אֵי־זֶ֥ה מְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'yzh hdrkh yshkhn'vr vchshkh 'yzh mqmv
verses.translation: Where is the way to the dwelling of light, And as for darkness, where is the place thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִ֭קָּחֶנּוּ אֶל־גְּבוּל֑וֹ וְכִי־תָ֝בִ֗ין נְתִיב֥וֹת בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy tqchnv 'lgbvlv vkhytbyn ntybvt bytv
verses.translation: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, And that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֭דַעְתָּ כִּי־אָ֣ז תִּוָּלֵ֑ד וּמִסְפַּ֖ר יָמֶ֣יךָ רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: yd't khy'z tvld vmspr ymykh rbym
verses.translation: Thou knowest it, for thou wast then born, And the number of thy days is great!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲ֭בָאתָ אֶל־אֹצְר֣וֹת שָׁ֑לֶג וְאוֹצְר֖וֹת בָּרָ֣ד תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: hb't 'l'tsrvt shlg v'vtsrvt brd tr'h
verses.translation: Hast thou entered the treasuries of the snow, Or hast thou seen the treasuries of the hail,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־חָשַׂ֥כְתִּי לְעֶת־צָ֑ר לְי֥וֹם קְ֝רָ֗ב וּמִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'shrchshkhty l'ttsr lyvm qrb vmlchmh
verses.translation: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, Against the day of battle and war?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵי־זֶ֣ה הַ֭דֶּרֶךְ יֵחָ֣לֶק א֑וֹר יָפֵ֖ץ קָדִ֣ים עֲלֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: 'yzh hdrkh ychlq 'vr ypts qdym 'ly'rts
verses.translation: By what way is the light parted, Or the east wind scattered upon the earth?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־פִלַּ֣ג לַשֶּׁ֣טֶף תְּעָלָ֑ה וְ֝דֶ֗רֶךְ לַחֲזִ֥יז קֹלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: myplg lshtf t'lh vdrkh lchzyz qlvt
verses.translation: Who hath cleft a channel for the waterflood, Or a way for the lightning of the thunder;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭הַמְטִיר עַל־אֶ֣רֶץ לֹא־אִ֑ישׁ מִ֝דְבָּ֗ר לֹא־אָדָ֥ם בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: lhmtyr 'l'rts l''ysh mdbr l''dm bv
verses.translation: To cause it to rain on a land where no man is, On the wilderness, wherein there is no man;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהַשְׂבִּ֣יעַ שֹׁ֭אָה וּמְשֹׁאָ֑ה וּ֝לְהַצְמִ֗יחַ מֹ֣צָא דֶֽשֶׁא׃
verses.translit: lhshby' sh'h vmsh'h vlhtsmych mts' dsh'
verses.translation: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground, And to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיֵשׁ־לַמָּטָ֥ר אָ֑ב א֥וֹ מִי־ה֝וֹלִ֗יד אֶגְלֵי־טָֽל׃
verses.translit: hyshlmtr 'b 'v myhvlyd 'glytl
verses.translation: Hath the rain a father? Or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבֶּ֣טֶן מִ֭י יָצָ֣א הַקָּ֑רַח וּכְפֹ֥ר שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם מִ֣י יְלָדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mbtn my yts' hqrch vkhpr shmym my yldv
verses.translation: Out of whose womb came the ice? And the hoar-frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּ֭אֶבֶן מַ֣יִם יִתְחַבָּ֑אוּ וּפְנֵ֥י תְ֝ה֗וֹם יִתְלַכָּֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: kh'bn mym ytchb'v vpny thvm ytlkhdv
verses.translation: The waters are congealed like stone, And the face of the deep is frozen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽ֭תְקַשֵּׁר מַעֲדַנּ֣וֹת כִּימָ֑ה אֽוֹ־מֹשְׁכ֖וֹת כְּסִ֣יל תְּפַתֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: htqshr m'dnvt khymh 'vmshkhvt khsyl tptch
verses.translation: Canst thou bind the chains of the Pleiades, Or loose the bands of Orion?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲתֹצִ֣יא מַזָּר֣וֹת בְּעִתּ֑וֹ וְ֝עַ֗יִשׁ עַל־בָּנֶ֥יהָ תַנְחֵֽם׃
verses.translit: httsy' mzrvt b'tv v'ysh 'lbnyh tnchm
verses.translation: Canst thou lead forth the Mazzaroth in their season? Or canst thou guide the Bear with her sons?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲ֭יָדַעְתָּ חֻקּ֣וֹת שָׁמָ֑יִם אִם־תָּשִׂ֖ים מִשְׁטָר֣וֹ בָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: hyd't chqvt shmym 'mtshym mshtrv b'rts
verses.translation: Knowest thou the ordinances of the heavens? Canst thou establish the dominion thereof in the earth?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲתָרִ֣ים לָעָ֣ב קוֹלֶ֑ךָ וְֽשִׁפְעַת־מַ֥יִם תְּכַסֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: htrym l'b qvlkh vshp'tmym tkhskh
verses.translation: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, That abundance of waters may cover thee?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽתְשַׁלַּ֣ח בְּרָקִ֣ים וְיֵלֵ֑כוּ וְיֹאמְר֖וּ לְךָ֣ הִנֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: htshlch brqym vylkhv vy'mrv lkh hnnv
verses.translation: Canst thou send forth lightnings, that they may go, And say unto thee: ‘Here we are’?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִי־שָׁ֭ת בַּטֻּח֣וֹת חׇכְמָ֑ה א֤וֹ מִֽי־נָתַ֖ן לַשֶּׂ֣כְוִי בִינָֽה׃
verses.translit: mysht btchvt chkhmh 'v myntn lshkhvy bynh
verses.translation: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who hath given understanding to the mind?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־יְסַפֵּ֣ר שְׁחָקִ֣ים בְּחׇכְמָ֑ה וְנִבְלֵ֥י שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם מִ֣י יַשְׁכִּֽיב׃
verses.translit: myyspr shchqym bchkhmh vnbly shmym my yshkhyb
verses.translation: Who can number the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the bottles of heaven,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּצֶ֣קֶת עָ֭פָר לַמּוּצָ֑ק וּרְגָבִ֥ים יְדֻבָּֽקוּ׃
verses.translit: btsqt 'pr lmvtsq vrgbym ydbqv
verses.translation: When the dust runneth into a mass, And the clods cleave fast together?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲתָצ֣וּד לְלָבִ֣יא טָ֑רֶף וְחַיַּ֖ת כְּפִירִ֣ים תְּמַלֵּֽא׃
verses.translit: httsvd llby' trf vchyt khpyrym tml'
verses.translation: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lioness? Or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יָשֹׁ֥חוּ בַמְּעוֹנ֑וֹת יֵשְׁב֖וּ בַסֻּכָּ֣ה לְמוֹ־אָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: khyyshchv bm'vnvt yshbv bskhh lmv'rb
verses.translation: When they couch in their dens, And abide in the covert to lie in wait?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֤י יָכִ֥ין לָעֹרֵ֗ב צֵ֫יד֥וֹ כִּֽי־יְ֭לָדָו אֶל־אֵ֣ל יְשַׁוֵּ֑עוּ יִ֝תְע֗וּ לִבְלִי־אֹֽכֶל׃
verses.translit: my ykhyn l'rb tsydv khyyldv 'l'l yshv'v yt'v lbly'khl
verses.translation: Who provideth for the raven his prey, When his young ones cry unto God, and wander for lack of food?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיָדַ֗עְתָּ עֵ֭ת לֶ֣דֶת יַעֲלֵי־סָ֑לַע חֹלֵ֖ל אַיָּל֣וֹת תִּשְׁמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: hyd't 't ldt y'lysl' chll 'ylvt tshmr
verses.translation: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? Or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּסְפֹּ֣ר יְרָחִ֣ים תְּמַלֶּ֑אנָה וְ֝יָדַעְתָּ֗ עֵ֣ת לִדְתָּֽנָה׃
verses.translit: tspr yrchym tml'nh vyd't 't ldtnh
verses.translation: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? Or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּ֭כְרַעְנָה יַלְדֵיהֶ֣ן תְּפַלַּ֑חְנָה חֶבְלֵיהֶ֥ם תְּשַׁלַּֽחְנָה׃
verses.translit: tkhr'nh yldyhn tplchnh chblyhm tshlchnh
verses.translation: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young, They cast out their fruit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַחְלְמ֣וּ בְ֭נֵיהֶם יִרְבּ֣וּ בַבָּ֑ר יָ֝צְא֗וּ וְלֹא־שָׁ֥בוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: ychlmv bnyhm yrbv bbr yts'v vl'shbv lmv
verses.translation: Their young ones wax strong, they grow up in the open field; They go forth, and return not again.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִי־שִׁלַּ֣ח פֶּ֣רֶא חׇפְשִׁ֑י וּמֹסְר֥וֹת עָ֝ר֗וֹד מִ֣י פִתֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: myshlch pr' chpshy vmsrvt 'rvd my ptch
verses.translation: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? Or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־שַׂ֣מְתִּי עֲרָבָ֣ה בֵית֑וֹ וּֽמִשְׁכְּנוֹתָ֥יו מְלֵחָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'shrshmty 'rbh bytv vmshkhnvtyv mlchh
verses.translation: Whose house I have made the wilderness, And the salt land his dwelling-place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֭שְׂחַק לַהֲמ֣וֹן קִרְיָ֑ה תְּשֻׁא֥וֹת נֹ֝גֵ֗שׂ לֹ֣א יִשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.translit: yshchq lhmvn qryh tsh'vt ngsh l' yshm'
verses.translation: He scorneth the tumult of the city, Neither heareth he the shoutings of the driver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְת֣וּר הָרִ֣ים מִרְעֵ֑הוּ וְאַחַ֖ר כׇּל־יָר֣וֹק יִדְרֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: ytvr hrym mr'hv v'chr khlyrvq ydrvsh
verses.translation: The range of the mountains is his pasture, And he searcheth after every green thing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיֹ֣אבֶה רֵּ֣ים עׇבְדֶ֑ךָ אִם־יָ֝לִ֗ין עַל־אֲבוּסֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: hy'bh rym 'bdkh 'mylyn 'l'bvskh
verses.translation: Will the wild-ox be willing to serve thee? Or will he abide by thy crib?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲֽתִקְשׇׁר־רֵ֭ים בְּתֶ֣לֶם עֲבֹת֑וֹ אִם־יְשַׂדֵּ֖ד עֲמָקִ֣ים אַחֲרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: htqshrrym btlm 'btv 'myshdd 'mqym 'chrykh
verses.translation: Canst thou bind the wild-ox with his band in the furrow? Or will he harrow the valleys after thee?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲֽתִבְטַח־בּ֭וֹ כִּֽי־רַ֣ב כֹּח֑וֹ וְתַעֲזֹ֖ב אֵלָ֣יו יְגִיעֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: htbtchbv khyrb khchv vt'zb 'lyv ygy'kh
verses.translation: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? Or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?
