verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲתַאֲמִ֣ין בּ֭וֹ כִּֽי־[יָשִׁ֣יב] (ישוב) זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וְֽגׇרְנְךָ֥ יֶאֱסֹֽף׃
verses.translit: ht'myn bv khy[yshyb] (yshvb) zr'kh vgrnkh y'sf
verses.translation: Wilt thou rely on him, that he will bring home thy seed, And gather the corn of thy threshing-floor?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּנַף־רְנָנִ֥ים נֶעֱלָ֑סָה אִם־אֶ֝בְרָ֗ה חֲסִידָ֥ה וְנֹצָֽה׃
verses.translit: khnfrnnym n'lsh 'm'brh chsydh vntsh
verses.translation: The wing of the ostrich beateth joyously; But are her pinions and feathers the kindly stork’s?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־תַעֲזֹ֣ב לָאָ֣רֶץ בֵּצֶ֑יהָ וְֽעַל־עָפָ֥ר תְּחַמֵּֽם׃
verses.translit: khyt'zb l'rts btsyh v'l'pr tchmm
verses.translation: For she leaveth her eggs on the earth, And warmeth them in dust,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭תִּשְׁכַּח כִּי־רֶ֣גֶל תְּזוּרֶ֑הָ וְחַיַּ֖ת הַשָּׂדֶ֣ה תְדוּשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.translit: vtshkhch khyrgl tzvrh vchyt hshdh tdvshh
verses.translation: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, Or that the wild beast may trample them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִקְשִׁ֣יחַ בָּנֶ֣יהָ לְּלֹא־לָ֑הּ לְרִ֖יק יְגִיעָ֣הּ בְּלִי־פָֽחַד׃
verses.translit: hqshych bnyh ll'lh lryq ygy'h blypchd
verses.translation: She is hardened against her young ones, as if they were not hers; Though her labour be in vain, she is without fear; .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־הִשָּׁ֣הּ אֱל֣וֹהַּ חׇכְמָ֑ה וְלֹא־חָ֥לַק לָ֝֗הּ בַּבִּינָֽה׃
verses.translit: khyhshh 'lvh chkhmh vl'chlq lh bbynh
verses.translation: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, Neither hath He imparted to her understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּ֭עֵת בַּמָּר֣וֹם תַּמְרִ֑יא תִּֽשְׂחַ֥ק לַ֝סּ֗וּס וּלְרֹכְבֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: kh't bmrvm tmry' tshchq lsvs vlrkhbv {p}
verses.translation: When the time cometh, she raiseth her wings on high, And scorneth the horse and his rider.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲתִתֵּ֣ן לַסּ֣וּס גְּבוּרָ֑ה הֲתַלְבִּ֖ישׁ צַוָּאר֣וֹ רַעְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: httn lsvs gbvrh htlbysh tsv'rv r'mh
verses.translation: Hast thou given the horse his strength? Hast thou clothed his neck with fierceness?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲֽ֭תַרְעִישֶׁנּוּ כָּאַרְבֶּ֑ה ה֖וֹד נַחְר֣וֹ אֵימָֽה׃
verses.translit: htr'yshnv kh'rbh hvd nchrv 'ymh
verses.translation: Hast thou made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is terrible.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַחְפְּר֣וּ בָ֭עֵמֶק וְיָשִׂ֣ישׂ בְּכֹ֑חַ יֵ֝צֵ֗א לִקְרַאת־נָֽשֶׁק׃
verses.translit: ychprv b'mq vyshysh bkhch yts' lqr'tnshq
verses.translation: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength; He goeth out to meet the clash of arms.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׂחַ֣ק לְ֭פַחַד וְלֹ֣א יֵחָ֑ת וְלֹא־יָ֝שׁ֗וּב מִפְּנֵי־חָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: yshchq lpchd vl' ycht vl'yshvb mpnychrb
verses.translation: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; Neither turneth he back from the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָ֭לָיו תִּרְנֶ֣ה אַשְׁפָּ֑ה לַ֖הַב חֲנִ֣ית וְכִידֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: 'lyv trnh 'shph lhb chnyt vkhydvn
verses.translation: The quiver rattleth upon him, The glittering spear and the javelin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרַ֣עַשׁ וְ֭רֹגֶז יְגַמֶּא־אָ֑רֶץ וְלֹא־יַ֝אֲמִ֗ין כִּי־ק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃
verses.translit: br'sh vrgz ygm''rts vl'y'myn khyqvl shvpr
verses.translation: He swalloweth the ground with storm and rage; Neither believeth he that it is the voice of the horn.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּדֵ֤י שֹׁפָ֨ר  יֹ֘אמַ֤ר הֶאָ֗ח וּֽ֭מֵרָחוֹק יָרִ֣יחַ מִלְחָמָ֑ה רַ֥עַם שָׂ֝רִ֗ים וּתְרוּעָֽה׃
verses.translit: bdy shpr  y'mr h'ch vmrchvq yrych mlchmh r'm shrym vtrv'h
verses.translation: As oft as he heareth the horn he saith: ‘Ha, ha! ’ And he smelleth the battle afar off, The thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲֽ֭מִבִּינָ֣תְךָ יַאֲבֶר־נֵ֑ץ יִפְרֹ֖שׂ כְּנָפָ֣ו לְתֵימָֽן׃
verses.translit: hmbyntkh y'brnts yprsh khnpv ltymn
verses.translation: Doth the hawk soar by thy wisdom, And stretch her wings toward the south?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־עַל־פִּ֭יךָ יַגְבִּ֣יהַּ נָ֑שֶׁר וְ֝כִ֗י יָרִ֥ים קִנּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'm'lpykh ygbyh nshr vkhy yrym qnv
verses.translation: Doth the vulture mount up at thy command, And make her nest on high?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סֶ֣לַע יִ֭שְׁכֹּן וְיִתְלֹנָ֑ן עַ֥ל שֶׁן־סֶ֝֗לַע וּמְצוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: sl' yshkhn vytlnn 'l shnsl' vmtsvdh
verses.translation: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, Upon the crag of the rock, and the stronghold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִשָּׁ֥ם חָֽפַר־אֹ֑כֶל לְ֝מֵרָח֗וֹק עֵינָ֥יו יַבִּֽיטוּ׃
verses.translit: mshm chpr'khl lmrchvq 'ynyv ybytv
verses.translation: From thence she spieth out the prey; Her eyes behold it afar off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶפְרֹחָ֥ו יְעַלְעוּ־דָ֑ם וּבַאֲשֶׁ֥ר חֲ֝לָלִ֗ים שָׁ֣ם הֽוּא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'prchv y'l'vdm vb'shr chllym shm hv' {p}
verses.translation: Her young ones also suck up blood; And where the slain are, there is she.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַן יְהֹוָ֥ה אֶת־אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n yhvh 't'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲ֭רֹב עִם־שַׁדַּ֣י יִסּ֑וֹר מוֹכִ֖יחַ אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲנֶֽנָּה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hrb 'mshdy ysvr mvkhych 'lvh y'nnh {p}
verses.translation: Shall he that reproveth contend with the Almighty? He that argueth with God, let him answer it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַן אִיּ֥וֹב אֶת־יְהֹוָ֗ה וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb 'tyhvh vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Job answered the LORD, and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֣ן קַ֭לֹּתִי מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶ֑ךָּ יָ֝דִ֗י שַׂ֣מְתִּי לְמוֹ־פִֽי׃
verses.translit: hn qlty mh 'shybkh ydy shmty lmvpy
verses.translation: Behold, I am of small account; what shall I answer Thee? I lay my hand upon my mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחַ֣ת דִּ֭בַּרְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אֶעֱנֶ֑ה וּ֝שְׁתַּ֗יִם וְלֹ֣א אוֹסִֽיף׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'cht dbrty vl' ''nh vshtym vl' 'vsyf {p}
verses.translation: Once have I spoken, but I will not answer again; Yea, twice, but I will proceed no further.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעַן־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֶת־אִ֭יּוֹב (מנסערה) [מִ֥ן ׀ סְעָרָ֗ה] וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'nyhvh 't'yvb (mns'rh) [mn  s'rh] vy'mr
verses.translation: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱזׇר־נָ֣א כְגֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑יךָ אֶ֝שְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: 'zrn' khgbr chltsykh 'sh'lkh vhvdy'ny
verses.translation: Gird up thy loins now like a man; I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto Me. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭אַף תָּפֵ֣ר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י תַּ֝רְשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן תִּצְדָּֽק׃
verses.translit: h'f tpr mshpty trshy'ny lm'n ttsdq
verses.translation: Wilt thou even make void My judgment? Wilt thou condemn Me, that thou mayest be justified?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־זְר֖וֹעַ כָּאֵ֥ל ׀ לָ֑ךְ וּ֝בְק֗וֹל כָּמֹ֥הוּ תַרְעֵֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mzrv' kh'l  lkh vbqvl khmhv tr'm
verses.translation: Or hast thou an arm like God? And canst thou thunder with a voice like Him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲדֵ֥ה נָ֣א גָא֣וֹן וָגֹ֑בַהּ וְה֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תִּלְבָּֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'dh n' g'vn vgbh vhvd vhdr tlbsh
verses.translation: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency, And array thyself with glory and beauty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָ֭פֵץ עֶבְר֣וֹת אַפֶּ֑ךָ וּרְאֵ֥ה כׇל־גֵּ֝אֶ֗ה וְהַשְׁפִּילֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: hpts 'brvt 'pkh vr'h khlg'h vhshpylhv
verses.translation: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath; And look upon every one that is proud, and abase him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְאֵ֣ה כׇל־גֵּ֭אֶה הַכְנִיעֵ֑הוּ וַהֲדֹ֖ךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: r'h khlg'h hkhny'hv vhdkh rsh'ym tchtm
verses.translation: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; And tread down the wicked in their place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טׇמְנֵ֣ם בֶּעָפָ֣ר יָ֑חַד פְּ֝נֵיהֶ֗ם חֲבֹ֣שׁ בַּטָּמֽוּן׃
verses.translit: tmnm b'pr ychd pnyhm chbsh btmvn
verses.translation: Hide them in the dust together; Bind their faces in the hidden place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־אֲנִ֥י אוֹדֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי־תוֹשִׁ֖עַ לְךָ֣ יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vgm'ny 'vdkh khytvsh' lkh ymynkh
verses.translation: Then will I also confess unto thee That thine own right hand can save thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה־נָ֣א בְ֭הֵמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֣יתִי עִמָּ֑ךְ חָ֝צִ֗יר כַּבָּקָ֥ר יֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: hnhn' bhmvt 'shr'shyty 'mkh chtsyr khbqr y'khl
verses.translation: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; He eateth grass as an ox.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה־נָ֣א כֹח֣וֹ בְמׇתְנָ֑יו וְ֝אוֹנ֗וֹ בִּשְׁרִירֵ֥י בִטְנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hnhn' khchv bmtnyv v'vnv bshryry btnv
verses.translation: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, And his force is in the stays of his body.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַחְפֹּ֣ץ זְנָב֣וֹ כְמוֹ־אָ֑רֶז גִּידֵ֖י פַחֲדָ֣ו יְשֹׂרָֽגוּ׃
verses.translit: ychpts znbv khmv'rz gydy pchdv yshrgv
verses.translation: He straineth his tail like a cedar; The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲ֭צָמָיו אֲפִיקֵ֣י נְחֻשָׁ֑ה גְּ֝רָמָ֗יו כִּמְטִ֥יל בַּרְזֶֽל׃
verses.translit: 'tsmyv 'pyqy nchshh grmyv khmtyl brzl
verses.translation: His bones are as pipes of brass; His gristles are like bars of iron.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֭וּא רֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכֵי־אֵ֑ל הָ֝עֹשׂ֗וֹ יַגֵּ֥שׁ חַרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hv' r'shyt drkhy'l h'shv ygsh chrbv
verses.translation: He is the beginning of the ways of God; He only that made him can make His sword to approach unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־ב֭וּל הָרִ֣ים יִשְׂאוּ־ל֑וֹ וְֽכׇל־חַיַּ֥ת הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה יְשַׂחֲקוּ־שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: khybvl hrym ysh'vlv vkhlchyt hshdh yshchqvshm
verses.translation: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, And all the beasts of the field play there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּֽחַת־צֶאֱלִ֥ים יִשְׁכָּ֑ב בְּסֵ֖תֶר קָנֶ֣ה וּבִצָּֽה׃
verses.translit: tchtts'lym yshkhb bstr qnh vbtsh
verses.translation: He lieth under the lotus-trees, In the covert of the reed, and fens.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְסֻכֻּ֣הוּ צֶאֱלִ֣ים צִֽלְל֑וֹ יְ֝סֻבּ֗וּהוּ עַרְבֵי־נָֽחַל׃
verses.translit: yskhhv ts'lym tsllv ysbvhv 'rbynchl
verses.translation: The lotus-trees cover him with their shadow; The willows of the brook compass him about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֤ן יַעֲשֹׁ֣ק נָ֭הָר לֹ֣א יַחְפּ֑וֹז יִבְטַ֓ח  כִּֽי־יָגִ֖יחַ יַרְדֵּ֣ן אֶל־פִּֽיהוּ׃
verses.translit: hn y'shq nhr l' ychpvz ybtch  khyygych yrdn 'lpyhv
verses.translation: Behold, if a river overflow, he trembleth not; He is confident, though the Jordan rush forth to his mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּעֵינָ֥יו יִקָּחֶ֑נּוּ בְּ֝מוֹקְשִׁ֗ים יִנְקׇב־אָֽף׃
verses.translit: b'ynyv yqchnv bmvqshym ynqb'f
verses.translation: Shall any take him by his eyes, Or pierce through his nose with a snare?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּמְשֹׁ֣ךְ לִוְיָתָ֣ן בְּחַכָּ֑ה וּ֝בְחֶ֗בֶל תַּשְׁקִ֥יעַ לְשֹׁנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: tmshkh lvytn bchkhh vbchbl tshqy' lshnv
verses.translation: Canst thou draw out leviathan with a fish-hook? Or press down his tongue with a cord?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲתָשִׂ֣ים אַגְמֹ֣ן בְּאַפּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְח֗וֹחַ תִּקֹּ֥ב לֶחֱיֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: htshym 'gmn b'pv vbchvch tqb lchyv
verses.translation: Canst thou put a ring into his nose? Or bore his jaw through with a hook?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיַרְבֶּ֣ה אֵ֭לֶיךָ תַּחֲנוּנִ֑ים אִם־יְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלֶ֣יךָ רַכּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: hyrbh 'lykh tchnvnym 'mydbr 'lykh rkhvt
verses.translation: Will he make many supplications unto thee? Or will he speak soft words unto thee?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיִכְרֹ֣ת בְּרִ֣ית עִמָּ֑ךְ תִּ֝קָּחֶ֗נּוּ לְעֶ֣בֶד עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: hykhrt bryt 'mkh tqchnv l'bd 'vlm
verses.translation: Will he make a covenant with thee, That thou shouldest take him for a servant for ever?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽתְשַׂחֶק־בּ֭וֹ כַּצִּפּ֑וֹר וְ֝תִקְשְׁרֶ֗נּוּ לְנַעֲרוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: htshchqbv khtspvr vtqshrnv ln'rvtykh
verses.translation: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? Or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens? .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִכְר֣וּ עָ֭לָיו חַבָּרִ֑ים יֶ֝חֱצ֗וּהוּ בֵּ֣ין כְּֽנַעֲנִֽים׃
verses.translit: ykhrv 'lyv chbrym ychtsvhv byn khn'nym
verses.translation: Will the bands of fishermen make a banquet of him? Will they part him among the merchants?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽתְמַלֵּ֣א בְשֻׂכּ֣וֹת עוֹר֑וֹ וּבְצִלְצַ֖ל דָּגִ֣ים רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: html' bshkhvt 'vrv vbtsltsl dgym r'shv
verses.translation: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? Or his head with fish-spears?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂים־עָלָ֥יו כַּפֶּ֑ךָ זְכֹ֥ר מִ֝לְחָמָ֗ה אַל־תּוֹסַֽף׃
verses.translit: shym'lyv khpkh zkhr mlchmh 'ltvsf
verses.translation: Lay thy hand upon him; Think upon the battle, thou wilt do so no more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵן־תֹּחַלְתּ֥וֹ נִכְזָ֑בָה הֲגַ֖ם אֶל־מַרְאָ֣יו יֻטָֽל׃
verses.translit: hntchltv nkhzbh hgm 'lmr'yv ytl
verses.translation: Behold, the hope of him is in vain; Shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־אַ֭כְזָר כִּ֣י יְעוּרֶ֑נּוּ וּמִ֥י ה֝֗וּא לְפָנַ֥י יִתְיַצָּֽב׃
verses.translit: l''khzr khy y'vrnv vmy hv' lpny ytytsb
verses.translation: None is so fierce that dare stir him up; Who then is able to stand before Me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֣י הִ֭קְדִּימַנִי וַאֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם תַּ֖חַת כׇּל־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם לִי־הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: my hqdymny v'shlm tcht khlhshmym lyhv'
verses.translation: Who hath given Me anything beforehand, that I should repay him? Whatsoever is under the whole heaven is Mine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (לא) [לוֹ־]אַחֲרִ֥ישׁ בַּדָּ֑יו וּדְבַר־גְּ֝בוּר֗וֹת וְחִ֣ין עֶרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: (l') [lv]'chrysh bdyv vdbrgbvrvt vchyn 'rkhv
verses.translation: Would I keep silence concerning his boastings, or his proud talk, or his fair array of words?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־גִ֭לָּה פְּנֵ֣י לְבוּשׁ֑וֹ בְּכֶ֥פֶל רִ֝סְנ֗וֹ מִ֣י יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.translit: myglh pny lbvshv bkhpl rsnv my ybv'
verses.translation: Who can uncover the face of his garment? Who shall come within his double bridle?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּלְתֵ֣י פָ֭נָיו מִ֣י פִתֵּ֑חַ סְבִיב֖וֹת שִׁנָּ֣יו אֵימָֽה׃
verses.translit: dlty pnyv my ptch sbybvt shnyv 'ymh
verses.translation: Who can open the doors of his face? Round about his teeth is terror.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֭אֲוָה אֲפִיקֵ֣י מָגִנִּ֑ים סָ֝ג֗וּר חוֹתָ֥ם צָֽר׃
verses.translit: g'vh 'pyqy mgnym sgvr chvtm tsr
verses.translation: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶחָ֣ד בְּאֶחָ֣ד יִגַּ֑שׁוּ וְ֝ר֗וּחַ לֹא־יָבֹ֥א בֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'chd b'chd ygshv vrvch l'yb' bynyhm
verses.translation: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִישׁ־בְּאָחִ֥יהוּ יְדֻבָּ֑קוּ יִ֝תְלַכְּד֗וּ וְלֹ֣א יִתְפָּרָֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: 'yshb'chyhv ydbqv ytlkhdv vl' ytprdv
verses.translation: They are joined one to another; They stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲֽ֭טִישֹׁתָיו תָּ֣הֶל א֑וֹר וְ֝עֵינָ֗יו כְּעַפְעַפֵּי־שָֽׁחַר׃
verses.translit: 'tyshtyv thl 'vr v'ynyv kh'p'pyshchr
verses.translation: His sneezings flash forth light, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭פִּיו לַפִּידִ֣ים יַהֲלֹ֑כוּ כִּיד֥וֹדֵי אֵ֝֗שׁ יִתְמַלָּֽטוּ׃
verses.translit: mpyv lpydym yhlkhv khydvdy 'sh ytmltv
verses.translation: Out of his mouth go burning torches, and sparks of fire leap forth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭נְּחִירָיו יֵצֵ֣א עָשָׁ֑ן כְּד֖וּד נָפ֣וּחַ וְאַגְמֹֽן׃
verses.translit: mnchyryv yts' 'shn khdvd npvch v'gmn
verses.translation: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot and burning rushes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַ֭פְשׁוֹ גֶּחָלִ֣ים תְּלַהֵ֑ט וְ֝לַ֗הַב מִפִּ֥יו יֵצֵֽא׃
verses.translit: npshv gchlym tlht vlhb mpyv yts'
verses.translation: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּֽ֭צַוָּארוֹ יָלִ֣ין עֹ֑ז וּ֝לְפָנָ֗יו תָּד֥וּץ דְּאָבָֽה׃
verses.translit: btsv'rv ylyn 'z vlpnyv tdvts d'bh
verses.translation: In his neck abideth strength, and dismay danceth before him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַפְּלֵ֣י בְשָׂר֣וֹ דָבֵ֑קוּ יָצ֥וּק עָ֝לָ֗יו בַּל־יִמּֽוֹט׃
verses.translit: mply bshrv dbqv ytsvq 'lyv blymvt
verses.translation: The flakes of his flesh are joined together; they are firm upon him; they cannot be moved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִ֭בּוֹ יָצ֣וּק כְּמוֹ־אָ֑בֶן וְ֝יָצ֗וּק כְּפֶ֣לַח תַּחְתִּֽית׃
verses.translit: lbv ytsvq khmv'bn vytsvq khplch tchtyt
verses.translation: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, firm as the nether millstone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭שֵּׂתוֹ יָג֣וּרוּ אֵלִ֑ים מִ֝שְּׁבָרִ֗ים יִתְחַטָּֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: mshtv ygvrv 'lym mshbrym ytcht'v
verses.translation: When he raiseth himself up, the mighty are afraid; by reason of despair they are beside themselves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשִּׂיגֵ֣הוּ חֶ֭רֶב בְּלִ֣י תָק֑וּם חֲנִ֖ית מַסָּ֣ע וְשִׁרְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: mshyghv chrb bly tqvm chnyt ms' vshryh
verses.translation: If one lay at him with the sword, it will not hold; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַחְשֹׁ֣ב לְתֶ֣בֶן בַּרְזֶ֑ל לְעֵ֖ץ רִקָּב֣וֹן נְחוּשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: ychshb ltbn brzl l'ts rqbvn nchvshh
verses.translation: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יַבְרִיחֶ֥נּוּ בֶן־קָ֑שֶׁת לְ֝קַ֗שׁ נֶהְפְּכוּ־ל֥וֹ אַבְנֵי־קָֽלַע׃
verses.translit: l'ybrychnv bnqsht lqsh nhpkhvlv 'bnyql'
verses.translation: The arrow cannot make him flee; slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּ֭קַשׁ נֶחְשְׁב֣וּ תוֹתָ֑ח וְ֝יִשְׂחַ֗ק לְרַ֣עַשׁ כִּידֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: khqsh nchshbv tvtch vyshchq lr'sh khydvn
verses.translation: Clubs are accounted as stubble; He laugheth at the rattling of the javelin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֭חְתָּיו חַדּ֣וּדֵי חָ֑רֶשׂ יִרְפַּ֖ד חָר֣וּץ עֲלֵי־טִֽיט׃
verses.translit: tchtyv chdvdy chrsh yrpd chrvts 'lytyt
verses.translation: Sharpest potsherds are under him; He spreadeth a threshing-sledge upon the mire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַרְתִּ֣יחַ כַּסִּ֣יר מְצוּלָ֑ה יָ֝֗ם יָשִׂ֥ים כַּמֶּרְקָחָֽה׃
verses.translit: yrtych khsyr mtsvlh ym yshym khmrqchh
verses.translation: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot; He maketh the sea like a seething mixture.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭חֲרָיו יָאִ֣יר נָתִ֑יב יַחְשֹׁ֖ב תְּה֣וֹם לְשֵׂיבָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'chryv y'yr ntyb ychshb thvm lshybh
verses.translation: He maketh a path to shine after him; One would think the deep to be hoary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵֽין־עַל־עָפָ֥ר מׇשְׁל֑וֹ הֶ֝עָשׂ֗וּ לִבְלִי־חָֽת׃
verses.translit: 'yn'l'pr mshlv h'shv lblycht
verses.translation: Upon earth there is not his like who is made to be fearless.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵֽת־כׇּל־גָּבֹ֥הַּ יִרְאֶ֑ה ה֝֗וּא מֶ֣לֶךְ עַל־כׇּל־בְּנֵי־שָֽׁחַץ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'tkhlgbh yr'h hv' mlkh 'lkhlbnyshchts {p}
verses.translation: He looketh at all high things; He is king over all the proud beasts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַן אִיּ֥וֹב אֶת־יְהֹוָ֗ה וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb 'tyhvh vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Job answered the LORD, and said:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ידעת) [יָ֭דַעְתִּי] כִּי־כֹ֣ל תּוּכָ֑ל וְלֹֽא־יִבָּצֵ֖ר מִמְּךָ֣ מְזִמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: (yd't) [yd'ty] khykhl tvkhl vl'ybtsr mmkh mzmh
verses.translation: I know that Thou canst do every thing, And that no purpose can be withholden from Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֤י זֶ֨ה  מַעְלִ֥ים עֵצָ֗ה בְּֽלִ֫י־דָ֥עַת לָכֵ֣ן הִ֭גַּדְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אָבִ֑ין נִפְלָא֥וֹת מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי וְלֹ֣א אֵדָֽע׃
verses.translit: my zh  m'lym 'tsh blyd't lkhn hgdty vl' 'byn npl'vt mmny vl' 'd'
verses.translation: Who is this that hideth counsel without knowledge? Therefore have I uttered that which I understood not, Things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְֽׁמַֽע־נָ֭א וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֶ֝שְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: shm'n' v'nkhy 'dbr 'sh'lkh vhvdy'ny
verses.translation: Hear, I beseech Thee, and I will speak; I will demand of Thee, and declare Thou unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְשֵֽׁמַע־אֹ֥זֶן שְׁמַעְתִּ֑יךָ וְ֝עַתָּ֗ה עֵינִ֥י רָאָֽתְךָ׃
verses.translit: lshm''zn shm'tykh v'th 'yny r'tkh
verses.translation: I had heard of Thee by the hearing of the ear; But now mine eye seeth Thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֭ן אֶמְאַ֣ס וְנִחַ֑מְתִּי עַל־עָפָ֥ר וָאֵֽפֶר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lkhn 'm's vnchmty 'l'pr v'pr {p}
verses.translation: Wherefore I abhor my words, and repent, Seeing I am dust and ashes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחַ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אֶל־אִיּ֑וֹב וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶל־אֱלִיפַ֣ז הַתֵּימָנִ֗י חָרָ֨ה אַפִּ֤י בְךָ֙ וּבִשְׁנֵ֣י רֵעֶ֔יךָ כִּ֠י לֹ֣א דִבַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֵלַ֛י נְכוֹנָ֖ה כְּעַבְדִּ֥י אִיּֽוֹב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhy 'chr dbr yhvh 'thdbrym h'lh 'l'yvb vy'mr yhvh 'l'lypz htymny chrh 'py bkh vbshny r'ykh khy l' dbrtm 'ly nkhvnh kh'bdy 'yvb {s}
verses.translation: And it was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words unto Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite: ‘My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends; for ye have not spoken of Me the thing that is right, as My servant Job hath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה קְחוּ־לָכֶ֣ם שִׁבְעָֽה־פָרִים֩ וְשִׁבְעָ֨ה אֵילִ֜ים וּלְכ֣וּ  אֶל־עַבְדִּ֣י אִיּ֗וֹב וְהַעֲלִיתֶ֤ם עוֹלָה֙ בַּעַדְכֶ֔ם וְאִיּ֣וֹב עַבְדִּ֔י יִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֧י אִם־פָּנָ֣יו אֶשָּׂ֗א לְבִלְתִּ֞י עֲשׂ֤וֹת עִמָּכֶם֙ נְבָלָ֔ה כִּ֠י לֹ֣א דִבַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֵלַ֛י נְכוֹנָ֖ה כְּעַבְדִּ֥י אִיּֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: v'th qchvlkhm shb'hprym vshb'h 'ylym vlkhv  'l'bdy 'yvb vh'lytm 'vlh b'dkhm v'yvb 'bdy ytpll 'lykhm khy 'mpnyv 'sh' lblty 'shvt 'mkhm nblh khy l' dbrtm 'ly nkhvnh kh'bdy 'yvb
verses.translation: Now therefore, take unto you seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to My servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt-offering; and My servant Job shall pray for you; for him will I accept, that I do not unto you aught unseemly; for ye have not spoken of Me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכוּ֩ אֱלִיפַ֨ז הַתֵּימָנִ֜י וּבִלְדַּ֣ד הַשּׁוּחִ֗י צֹפַר֙ הַנַּ֣עֲמָתִ֔י וַיַּעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיִּשָּׂ֥א יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־פְּנֵ֥י אִיּֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: vylkhv 'lypz htymny vbldd hshvchy tspr hn'mty vy'shv kh'shr dbr 'lyhm yhvh vysh' yhvh 'tpny 'yvb
verses.translation: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the LORD commanded them; and the LORD accepted Job.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיהֹוָ֗ה שָׁ֚ב אֶת־[שְׁב֣וּת] (שבית) אִיּ֔וֹב בְּהִֽתְפַּֽלְל֖וֹ בְּעַ֣ד רֵעֵ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֧סֶף יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְאִיּ֖וֹב לְמִשְׁנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhvh shb 't[shbvt] (shbyt) 'yvb bhtpllv b'd r'hv vysf yhvh 'tkhl'shr l'yvb lmshnh
verses.translation: And the LORD changed the fortune of Job, when he prayed for his friends; and the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ אֵ֠לָ֠יו כׇּל־אֶחָ֨יו וְכׇל־אַחְיֹתָ֜יו וְכׇל־יֹדְעָ֣יו לְפָנִ֗ים וַיֹּאכְל֨וּ עִמּ֣וֹ לֶ֘חֶם֮ בְּבֵיתוֹ֒ וַיָּנֻ֤דוּ לוֹ֙ וַיְנַחֲמ֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ עַ֚ל כׇּל־הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִ֥יא יְהֹוָ֖ה עָלָ֑יו וַיִּתְּנוּ־ל֗וֹ אִ֚ישׁ קְשִׂיטָ֣ה אֶחָ֔ת וְאִ֕ישׁ נֶ֥זֶם זָהָ֖ב אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vyb'v 'lyv khl'chyv vkhl'chytyv vkhlyd'yv lpnym vy'khlv 'mv lchm bbytv vyndv lv vynchmv 'tv 'l khlhr'h 'shrhby' yhvh 'lyv vytnvlv 'ysh qshyth 'cht v'ysh nzm zhb 'chd
verses.translation: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house; and they bemoaned him, and comforted him concerning all the evil that the LORD had brought upon him; every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one a ring of gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיהֹוָ֗ה בֵּרַ֛ךְ אֶת־אַחֲרִ֥ית אִיּ֖וֹב מֵרֵֽאשִׁת֑וֹ וַֽיְהִי־ל֡וֹ אַרְבָּעָה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר אֶ֜לֶף צֹ֗אן וְשֵׁ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ גְּמַלִּ֔ים וְאֶלֶף־צֶ֥מֶד בָּקָ֖ר וְאֶ֥לֶף אֲתוֹנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyhvh brkh 't'chryt 'yvb mr'shtv vyhylv 'rb'h 'shr 'lf ts'n vshsht 'lpym gmlym v'lftsmd bqr v'lf 'tvnvt
verses.translation: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning; and he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she-asses. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ל֛וֹ שִׁבְעָ֥נָה בָנִ֖ים וְשָׁל֥וֹשׁ בָּנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyhylv shb'nh bnym vshlvsh bnvt
verses.translation: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֤א שֵׁם־הָאַחַת֙ יְמִימָ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית קְצִיעָ֑ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֖ית קֶ֥רֶן הַפּֽוּךְ׃
verses.translit: vyqr' shmh'cht ymymh vshm hshnyt qtsy'h vshm hshlyshyt qrn hpvkh
verses.translation: And he called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֨א נִמְצָ֜א נָשִׁ֥ים יָפ֛וֹת כִּבְנ֥וֹת אִיּ֖וֹב בְּכׇל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֧ם אֲבִיהֶ֛ם נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּת֥וֹךְ אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vl' nmts' nshym ypvt khbnvt 'yvb bkhlh'rts vytn lhm 'byhm nchlh btvkh 'chyhm
verses.translation: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job; and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֤י אִיּוֹב֙ אַחֲרֵי־זֹ֔את מֵאָ֥ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה (וירא) [וַיִּרְאֶ֗ה] אֶת־בָּנָיו֙ וְאֶת־בְּנֵ֣י בָנָ֔יו אַרְבָּעָ֖ה דֹּרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vychy 'yvb 'chryz't m'h v'rb'ym shnh (vyr') [vyr'h] 'tbnyv v'tbny bnyv 'rb'h drvt
verses.translation: And after this Job lived a hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’sons, even four generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מׇת אִיּ֔וֹב זָקֵ֖ן וּשְׂבַ֥ע יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vymt 'yvb zqn vshb' ymym
verses.translation: So Job died, being old and full of days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַשִּׁירִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִשְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.translit: shyr hshyrym 'shr lshlmh
verses.translation: THE song of songs, which is Solomon’s.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשָּׁקֵ֙נִי֙ מִנְּשִׁיק֣וֹת פִּ֔יהוּ כִּֽי־טוֹבִ֥ים דֹּדֶ֖יךָ מִיָּֽיִן׃
verses.translit: yshqny mnshyqvt pyhv khytvbym ddykh myyn
verses.translation: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth— For thy love is better than wine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְרֵ֙יחַ֙ שְׁמָנֶ֣יךָ טוֹבִ֔ים שֶׁ֖מֶן תּוּרַ֣ק שְׁמֶ֑ךָ עַל־כֵּ֖ן עֲלָמ֥וֹת אֲהֵבֽוּךָ׃
verses.translit: lrych shmnykh tvbym shmn tvrq shmkh 'lkhn 'lmvt 'hbvkh
verses.translation: Thine ointments have a goodly fragrance; Thy name is as ointment poured forth; Therefore do the maidens love thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מׇשְׁכֵ֖נִי אַחֲרֶ֣יךָ נָּר֑וּצָה הֱבִיאַ֨נִי הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ חֲדָרָ֗יו נָגִ֤ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה֙ בָּ֔ךְ נַזְכִּ֤ירָה דֹדֶ֙יךָ֙ מִיַּ֔יִן מֵישָׁרִ֖ים אֲהֵבֽוּךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: mshkhny 'chrykh nrvtsh hby'ny hmlkh chdryv ngylh vnshmchh bkh nzkhyrh ddykh myyn myshrym 'hbvkh {p}
verses.translation: Draw me, we will run after thee; The king hath brought me into his chambers; We will be glad and rejoice in thee, We will find thy love more fragrant than wine! Sincerely do they love thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁחוֹרָ֤ה אֲנִי֙ וְֽנָאוָ֔ה בְּנ֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם כְּאׇהֳלֵ֣י קֵדָ֔ר כִּירִיע֖וֹת שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.translit: shchvrh 'ny vn'vh bnvt yrvshl͏m kh'hly qdr khyry'vt shlmh
verses.translation: ’I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, As the tents of Kedar, As the curtains of Solomon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּרְא֙וּנִי֙ שֶׁאֲנִ֣י שְׁחַרְחֹ֔רֶת שֶׁשְּׁזָפַ֖תְנִי הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ בְּנֵ֧י אִמִּ֣י נִֽחֲרוּ־בִ֗י שָׂמֻ֙נִי֙ נֹטֵרָ֣ה אֶת־הַכְּרָמִ֔ים כַּרְמִ֥י שֶׁלִּ֖י לֹ֥א נָטָֽרְתִּי׃
verses.translit: 'ltr'vny sh'ny shchrchrt shshzptny hshmsh bny 'my nchrvby shmny ntrh 'thkhrmym khrmy shly l' ntrty
verses.translation: Look not upon me, that I am swarthy, That the sun hath tanned me; My mother’s sons were incensed against me, They made me keeper of the vineyards; But mine own vineyard have I not kept.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַגִּ֣ידָה לִּ֗י שֶׁ֤אָֽהֲבָה֙ נַפְשִׁ֔י אֵיכָ֣ה תִרְעֶ֔ה אֵיכָ֖ה תַּרְבִּ֣יץ בַּֽצׇּהֳרָ֑יִם שַׁלָּמָ֤ה אֶֽהְיֶה֙ כְּעֹ֣טְיָ֔ה עַ֖ל עֶדְרֵ֥י חֲבֵרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: hgydh ly sh'hbh npshy 'ykhh tr'h 'ykhh trbyts btshrym shlmh 'hyh kh'tyh 'l 'dry chbrykh
verses.translation: Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, Where thou feedest, where thou makest thy flock to rest at noon; For why should I be as one that veileth herself Beside the flocks of thy companions?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־לֹ֤א תֵֽדְעִי֙ לָ֔ךְ הַיָּפָ֖ה בַּנָּשִׁ֑ים צְֽאִי־לָ֞ךְ בְּעִקְבֵ֣י הַצֹּ֗אן וּרְעִי֙ אֶת־גְּדִיֹּתַ֔יִךְ עַ֖ל מִשְׁכְּנ֥וֹת הָרֹעִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'ml' td'y lkh hyph bnshym ts'ylkh b'qby hts'n vr'y 'tgdytykh 'l mshkhnvt hr'ym {p}
verses.translation: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, Go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock And feed thy kids, beside the shepherds’tents.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְסֻֽסָתִי֙ בְּרִכְבֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה דִּמִּיתִ֖יךְ רַעְיָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: lssty brkhby pr'h dmytykh r'yty
verses.translation: I have compared thee, O my love, To a steed in Pharaoh’s chariots.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָאו֤וּ לְחָיַ֙יִךְ֙ בַּתֹּרִ֔ים צַוָּארֵ֖ךְ בַּחֲרוּזִֽים׃
verses.translit: n'vv lchyykh btrym tsv'rkh bchrvzym
verses.translation: Thy cheeks are comely with circlets, Thy neck with beads.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּוֹרֵ֤י זָהָב֙ נַֽעֲשֶׂה־לָּ֔ךְ עִ֖ם נְקֻדּ֥וֹת הַכָּֽסֶף׃
verses.translit: tvry zhb n'shhlkh 'm nqdvt hkhsf
verses.translation: We will make thee circlets of gold With studs of silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־שֶׁ֤הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ בִּמְסִבּ֔וֹ נִרְדִּ֖י נָתַ֥ן רֵיחֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'dshhmlkh bmsbv nrdy ntn rychv
verses.translation: While the king sat at his table, My spikenard sent forth its fragrance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צְר֨וֹר הַמֹּ֤ר ׀ דּוֹדִי֙ לִ֔י בֵּ֥ין שָׁדַ֖י יָלִֽין׃
verses.translit: tsrvr hmr  dvdy ly byn shdy ylyn
verses.translation: My beloved is unto me as a bag of myrrh, That lieth betwixt my breasts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶשְׁכֹּ֨ל הַכֹּ֤פֶר ׀ דּוֹדִי֙ לִ֔י בְּכַרְמֵ֖י עֵ֥ין גֶּֽדִי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'shkhl hkhpr  dvdy ly bkhrmy 'yn gdy {s}
verses.translation: My beloved is unto me as a cluster of henna In the vineyards of En-gedi.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנָּ֤ךְ יָפָה֙ רַעְיָתִ֔י הִנָּ֥ךְ יָפָ֖ה עֵינַ֥יִךְ יוֹנִֽים׃
verses.translit: hnkh yph r'yty hnkh yph 'ynykh yvnym
verses.translation: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; Thine eyes are as doves. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְּךָ֨ יָפֶ֤ה דוֹדִי֙ אַ֣ף נָעִ֔ים אַף־עַרְשֵׂ֖נוּ רַעֲנָנָֽה׃
verses.translit: hnkh yph dvdy 'f n'ym 'f'rshnv r'nnh
verses.translation: Behold, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant; Also our couch is leafy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֹר֤וֹת בָּתֵּ֙ינוּ֙ אֲרָזִ֔ים (רחיטנו) [רַהִיטֵ֖נוּ] בְּרוֹתִֽים׃
verses.translit: qrvt btynv 'rzym (rchytnv) [rhytnv] brvtym
verses.translation: The beams of our houses are cedars, And our panels are cypresses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ חֲבַצֶּ֣לֶת הַשָּׁר֔וֹן שׁוֹשַׁנַּ֖ת הָעֲמָקִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'ny chbtslt hshrvn shvshnt h'mqym
verses.translation: I am a rose of Sharon, A lily of the valleys.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּשֽׁוֹשַׁנָּה֙ בֵּ֣ין הַחוֹחִ֔ים כֵּ֥ן רַעְיָתִ֖י בֵּ֥ין הַבָּנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: khshvshnh byn hchvchym khn r'yty byn hbnvt
verses.translation: As a lily among thorns, So is my love among the daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּתַפּ֙וּחַ֙ בַּעֲצֵ֣י הַיַּ֔עַר כֵּ֥ן דּוֹדִ֖י בֵּ֣ין הַבָּנִ֑ים בְּצִלּוֹ֙ חִמַּ֣דְתִּי וְיָשַׁ֔בְתִּי וּפִרְי֖וֹ מָת֥וֹק לְחִכִּֽי׃
verses.translit: khtpvch b'tsy hy'r khn dvdy byn hbnym btslv chmdty vyshbty vpryv mtvq lchkhy
verses.translation: As an apple-tree among the trees of the wood, So is my beloved among the sons. Under its shadow I delighted to sit, And its fruit was sweet to my taste.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֱבִיאַ֙נִי֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית הַיָּ֔יִן וְדִגְל֥וֹ עָלַ֖י אַהֲבָֽה׃
verses.translit: hby'ny 'lbyt hyyn vdglv 'ly 'hbh
verses.translation: He hath brought me to the banqueting-house, And his banner over me is love.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סַמְּכ֙וּנִי֙ בָּאֲשִׁישׁ֔וֹת רַפְּד֖וּנִי בַּתַּפּוּחִ֑ים כִּי־חוֹלַ֥ת אַהֲבָ֖ה אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: smkhvny b'shyshvt rpdvny btpvchym khychvlt 'hbh 'ny
verses.translation: ’Stay ye me with dainties, refresh me with apples; For I am love-sick.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂמֹאלוֹ֙ תַּ֣חַת לְרֹאשִׁ֔י וִימִינ֖וֹ תְּחַבְּקֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: shm'lv tcht lr'shy vymynv tchbqny
verses.translation: Let his left hand be under my head, And his right hand embrace me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֜ם בְּנ֤וֹת יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ בִּצְבָא֔וֹת א֖וֹ בְּאַיְל֣וֹת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה אִם־תָּעִ֧ירוּ ׀ וְֽאִם־תְּע֥וֹרְר֛וּ אֶת־הָאַהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּֽץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hshb'ty 'tkhm bnvt yrvshl͏m btsb'vt 'v b'ylvt hshdh 'mt'yrv  v'mt'vrrv 'th'hbh 'd shtchpts {s}
verses.translation: ’I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem, By the gazelles, and by the hinds of the field, That ye awaken not, nor stir up love, until it please.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֣וֹל דּוֹדִ֔י הִנֵּה־זֶ֖ה בָּ֑א מְדַלֵּג֙ עַל־הֶ֣הָרִ֔ים מְקַפֵּ֖ץ עַל־הַגְּבָעֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: qvl dvdy hnhzh b' mdlg 'lhhrym mqpts 'lhgb'vt
verses.translation: Hark! my beloved! behold, he cometh, Leaping upon the mountains, skipping upon the hills.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דּוֹמֶ֤ה דוֹדִי֙ לִצְבִ֔י א֖וֹ לְעֹ֣פֶר הָאַיָּלִ֑ים הִנֵּה־זֶ֤ה עוֹמֵד֙ אַחַ֣ר כׇּתְלֵ֔נוּ מַשְׁגִּ֙יחַ֙ מִן־הַֽחַלֹּנ֔וֹת מֵצִ֖יץ מִן־הַחֲרַכִּֽים׃
verses.translit: dvmh dvdy ltsby 'v l'pr h'ylym hnhzh 'vmd 'chr khtlnv mshgych mnhchlnvt mtsyts mnhchrkhym
verses.translation: My beloved is like a gazelle or a young hart; Behold, he standeth behind our wall, He looketh in through the windows, He peereth through the lattice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָנָ֥ה דוֹדִ֖י וְאָ֣מַר לִ֑י ק֥וּמִי לָ֛ךְ רַעְיָתִ֥י יָפָתִ֖י וּלְכִי־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'nh dvdy v'mr ly qvmy lkh r'yty ypty vlkhylkh
verses.translation: My beloved spoke, and said unto me: ‘Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֥ה הַסְּתָ֖ו עָבָ֑ר הַגֶּ֕שֶׁם חָלַ֖ף הָלַ֥ךְ לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khyhnh hstv 'br hgshm chlf hlkh lv
verses.translation: For, lo, the winter is past, The rain is over and gone;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַנִּצָּנִים֙ נִרְא֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ עֵ֥ת הַזָּמִ֖יר הִגִּ֑יעַ וְק֥וֹל הַתּ֖וֹר נִשְׁמַ֥ע בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: hntsnym nr'v b'rts 't hzmyr hgy' vqvl htvr nshm' b'rtsnv
verses.translation: The flowers appear on the earth; The time of singing is come, And the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַתְּאֵנָה֙ חָנְטָ֣ה פַגֶּ֔יהָ וְהַגְּפָנִ֥ים ׀ סְמָדַ֖ר נָ֣תְנוּ רֵ֑יחַ ק֥וּמִי (לכי) [לָ֛ךְ] רַעְיָתִ֥י יָפָתִ֖י וּלְכִי־לָֽךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ht'nh chnth pgyh vhgpnym  smdr ntnv rych qvmy (lkhy) [lkh] r'yty ypty vlkhylkh {s}
verses.translation: The fig-tree putteth forth her green figs, And the vines in blossom give forth their fragrance. Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹנָתִ֞י בְּחַגְוֵ֣י הַסֶּ֗לַע בְּסֵ֙תֶר֙ הַמַּדְרֵגָ֔ה הַרְאִ֙ינִי֙ אֶת־מַרְאַ֔יִךְ הַשְׁמִיעִ֖נִי אֶת־קוֹלֵ֑ךְ כִּֽי־קוֹלֵ֥ךְ עָרֵ֖ב וּמַרְאֵ֥יךְ נָאוֶֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: yvnty bchgvy hsl' bstr hmdrgh hr'yny 'tmr'ykh hshmy'ny 'tqvlkh khyqvlkh 'rb vmr'ykh n'vh {s}
verses.translation: O my dove, that art in the clefts of the rock, in the covert of the cliff, Let me see thy countenance, let me hear thy voice; For sweet is thy voice, and thy countenance is comely.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶֽחֱזוּ־לָ֙נוּ֙ שֻֽׁעָלִ֔ים שֻׁעָלִ֥ים קְטַנִּ֖ים מְחַבְּלִ֣ים כְּרָמִ֑ים וּכְרָמֵ֖ינוּ סְמָדַֽר׃
verses.translit: 'chzvlnv sh'lym sh'lym qtnym mchblym khrmym vkhrmynv smdr
verses.translation: ’Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vineyards; For our vineyards are in blossom.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דּוֹדִ֥י לִי֙ וַאֲנִ֣י ל֔וֹ הָרֹעֶ֖ה בַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים׃
verses.translit: dvdy ly v'ny lv hr'h bshvshnym
verses.translation: My beloved is mine, and I am his, That feedeth among the lilies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֤ד שֶׁיָּפ֙וּחַ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם וְנָ֖סוּ הַצְּלָלִ֑ים סֹב֩ דְּמֵה־לְךָ֨ דוֹדִ֜י לִצְבִ֗י א֛וֹ לְעֹ֥פֶר הָאַיָּלִ֖ים עַל־הָ֥רֵי בָֽתֶר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'd shypvch hyvm vnsv htsllym sb dmhlkh dvdy ltsby 'v l'pr h'ylym 'lhry btr {s}
verses.translation: Until the day breathe, and the shadows flee away, Turn, my beloved, and be thou like a gazelle or a young hart Upon the mountains of spices.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־מִשְׁכָּבִי֙ בַּלֵּיל֔וֹת בִּקַּ֕שְׁתִּי אֵ֥ת שֶֽׁאָהֲבָ֖ה נַפְשִׁ֑י בִּקַּשְׁתִּ֖יו וְלֹ֥א מְצָאתִֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'lmshkhby blylvt bqshty 't sh'hbh npshy bqshtyv vl' mts'tyv
verses.translation: By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loveth; I sought him, but I found him not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָק֨וּמָה נָּ֜א וַאֲסוֹבְבָ֣ה בָעִ֗יר בַּשְּׁוָקִים֙ וּבָ֣רְחֹב֔וֹת אֲבַקְשָׁ֕ה אֵ֥ת שֶֽׁאָהֲבָ֖ה נַפְשִׁ֑י בִּקַּשְׁתִּ֖יו וְלֹ֥א מְצָאתִֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'qvmh n' v'svbbh b'yr bshvqym vbrchbvt 'bqshh 't sh'hbh npshy bqshtyv vl' mts'tyv
verses.translation: ’I will rise now, and go about the city, In the streets and in the broad ways, I will seek him whom my soul loveth.’ I sought him, but I found him not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְצָא֙וּנִי֙ הַשֹּׁ֣מְרִ֔ים הַסֹּבְבִ֖ים בָּעִ֑יר אֵ֛ת שֶֽׁאָהֲבָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י רְאִיתֶֽם׃
verses.translit: mts'vny hshmrym hsbbym b'yr 't sh'hbh npshy r'ytm
verses.translation: The watchmen that go about the city found me: ‘Saw ye him whom my soul loveth?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּמְעַט֙ שֶׁעָבַ֣רְתִּי מֵהֶ֔ם עַ֣ד שֶׁמָּצָ֔אתִי אֵ֥ת שֶֽׁאָהֲבָ֖ה נַפְשִׁ֑י אֲחַזְתִּיו֙ וְלֹ֣א אַרְפֶּ֔נּוּ עַד־שֶׁ֤הֲבֵיאתִיו֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית אִמִּ֔י וְאֶל־חֶ֖דֶר הוֹרָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: khm't sh'brty mhm 'd shmts'ty 't sh'hbh npshy 'chztyv vl' 'rpnv 'dshhby'tyv 'lbyt 'my v'lchdr hvrty
verses.translation: Scarce had I passed from them, When I found him whom my soul loveth: I held him, and would not let him go, Until I had brought him into my mother’s house, And into the chamber of her that conceived me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֜ם בְּנ֤וֹת יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ בִּצְבָא֔וֹת א֖וֹ בְּאַיְל֣וֹת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה אִם־תָּעִ֧ירוּ ׀ וְֽאִם־תְּע֥וֹרְר֛וּ אֶת־הָאַהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּֽץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hshb'ty 'tkhm bnvt yrvshl͏m btsb'vt 'v b'ylvt hshdh 'mt'yrv  v'mt'vrrv 'th'hbh 'd shtchpts {s}
verses.translation: ’I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem, By the gazelles, and by the hinds of the field, That ye awaken not, nor stir up love, Until it please.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֣י זֹ֗את עֹלָה֙ מִן־הַמִּדְבָּ֔ר כְּתִֽימְר֖וֹת עָשָׁ֑ן מְקֻטֶּ֤רֶת מֹר֙ וּלְבוֹנָ֔ה מִכֹּ֖ל אַבְקַ֥ת רוֹכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: my z't 'lh mnhmdbr khtymrvt 'shn mqtrt mr vlbvnh mkhl 'bqt rvkhl
verses.translation: Who is this that cometh up out of the wilderness Like pillars of smoke, Perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, With all powders of the merchant?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֗ה מִטָּתוֹ֙ שֶׁלִּשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה שִׁשִּׁ֥ים גִּבֹּרִ֖ים סָבִ֣יב לָ֑הּ מִגִּבֹּרֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: hnh mttv shlshlmh shshym gbrym sbyb lh mgbry yshr'l
verses.translation: Behold, it is the litter of Solomon; Threescore mighty men are about it, Of the mighty men of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֻּלָּם֙ אֲחֻ֣זֵי חֶ֔רֶב מְלֻמְּדֵ֖י מִלְחָמָ֑ה אִ֤ישׁ חַרְבּוֹ֙ עַל־יְרֵכ֔וֹ מִפַּ֖חַד בַּלֵּילֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khlm 'chzy chrb mlmdy mlchmh 'ysh chrbv 'lyrkhv mpchd blylvt {s}
verses.translation: They all handle the sword, And are expert in war; Every man hath his sword upon his thigh, Because of dread in the night.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַפִּרְי֗וֹן עָ֤שָׂה לוֹ֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה מֵעֲצֵ֖י הַלְּבָנֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: 'pryvn 'shh lv hmlkh shlmh m'tsy hlbnvn
verses.translation: King Solomon made himself a palanquin Of the wood of Lebanon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַמּוּדָיו֙ עָ֣שָׂה כֶ֔סֶף רְפִידָת֣וֹ זָהָ֔ב מֶרְכָּב֖וֹ אַרְגָּמָ֑ן תּוֹכוֹ֙ רָצ֣וּף אַהֲבָ֔ה מִבְּנ֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: 'mvdyv 'shh khsf rpydtv zhb mrkhbv 'rgmn tvkhv rtsvf 'hbh mbnvt yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: He made the pillars thereof of silver, The top thereof of gold, The seat of it of purple, The inside thereof being inlaid with love, From the daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צְאֶ֧נָה ׀ וּֽרְאֶ֛ינָה בְּנ֥וֹת צִיּ֖וֹן בַּמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בָּעֲטָרָ֗ה שֶׁעִטְּרָה־לּ֤וֹ אִמּוֹ֙ בְּי֣וֹם חֲתֻנָּת֔וֹ וּבְי֖וֹם שִׂמְחַ֥ת לִבּֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ts'nh  vr'ynh bnvt tsyvn bmlkh shlmh b'trh sh'trhlv 'mv byvm chtntv vbyvm shmcht lbv {s}
verses.translation: Go forth, O ye daughters of Zion, And gaze upon king Solomon, Even upon the crown wherewith his mother hath crowned him in the day of his espousals, And in the day of the gladness of his heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנָּ֨ךְ יָפָ֤ה רַעְיָתִי֙ הִנָּ֣ךְ יָפָ֔ה עֵינַ֣יִךְ יוֹנִ֔ים מִבַּ֖עַד לְצַמָּתֵ֑ךְ שַׂעְרֵךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הָֽעִזִּ֔ים שֶׁגָּלְשׁ֖וּ מֵהַ֥ר גִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: hnkh yph r'yty hnkh yph 'ynykh yvnym mb'd ltsmtkh sh'rkh kh'dr h'zym shglshv mhr gl'd
verses.translation: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; Thine eyes are as doves behind thy veil; Thy hair is as a flock of goats, that trail down from mount Gilead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁנַּ֙יִךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הַקְּצוּב֔וֹת שֶׁעָל֖וּ מִן־הָרַחְצָ֑ה שֶׁכֻּלָּם֙ מַתְאִימ֔וֹת וְשַׁכֻּלָ֖ה אֵ֥ין בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: shnykh kh'dr hqtsvbvt sh'lv mnhrchtsh shkhlm mt'ymvt vshkhlh 'yn bhm
verses.translation: Thy teeth are like a flock of ewes all shaped alike, Which are come up from the washing; Whereof all are paired, and none faileth among them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּח֤וּט הַשָּׁנִי֙ שִׂפְתוֹתַ֔יִךְ וּמִדְבָּרֵ֖ךְ נָאוֶ֑ה כְּפֶ֤לַח הָֽרִמּוֹן֙ רַקָּתֵ֔ךְ מִבַּ֖עַד לְצַמָּתֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khchvt hshny shptvtykh vmdbrkh n'vh khplch hrmvn rqtkh mb'd ltsmtkh
verses.translation: Thy lips are like a thread of scarlet, And thy mouth is comely; Thy temples are like a pomegranate split open Behind thy veil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּמִגְדַּ֤ל דָּוִיד֙ צַוָּארֵ֔ךְ בָּנ֖וּי לְתַלְפִּיּ֑וֹת אֶ֤לֶף הַמָּגֵן֙ תָּל֣וּי עָלָ֔יו כֹּ֖ל שִׁלְטֵ֥י הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃
verses.translit: khmgdl dvyd tsv'rkh bnvy ltlpyvt 'lf hmgn tlvy 'lyv khl shlty hgbrym
verses.translation: Thy neck is like the tower of David Builded with turrets, Whereon there hang a thousand shields, All the armour of the mighty men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁנֵ֥י שָׁדַ֛יִךְ כִּשְׁנֵ֥י עֳפָרִ֖ים תְּאוֹמֵ֣י צְבִיָּ֑ה הָרוֹעִ֖ים בַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים׃
verses.translit: shny shdykh khshny 'prym t'vmy tsbyh hrv'ym bshvshnym
verses.translation: Thy two breasts are like two fawns That are twins of a gazelle, Which feed among the lilies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֤ד שֶׁיָּפ֙וּחַ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם וְנָ֖סוּ הַצְּלָלִ֑ים אֵ֤לֶךְ לִי֙ אֶל־הַ֣ר הַמּ֔וֹר וְאֶל־גִּבְעַ֖ת הַלְּבוֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'd shypvch hyvm vnsv htsllym 'lkh ly 'lhr hmvr v'lgb't hlbvnh
verses.translation: Until the day breathe, And the shadows flee away, I will get me to the mountain of myrrh, And to the hill of frankincense.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֤ךְ יָפָה֙ רַעְיָתִ֔י וּמ֖וּם אֵ֥ין בָּֽךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khlkh yph r'yty vmvm 'yn bkh {s}
verses.translation: Thou art all fair, my love; And there is no spot in thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִתִּ֤י מִלְּבָנוֹן֙ כַּלָּ֔ה אִתִּ֖י מִלְּבָנ֣וֹן תָּב֑וֹאִי תָּשׁ֣וּרִי  מֵרֹ֣אשׁ אֲמָנָ֗ה מֵרֹ֤אשׁ שְׂנִיר֙ וְחֶרְמ֔וֹן מִמְּעֹנ֣וֹת אֲרָי֔וֹת מֵֽהַרְרֵ֖י נְמֵרִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'ty mlbnvn khlh 'ty mlbnvn tbv'y tshvry  mr'sh 'mnh mr'sh shnyr vchrmvn mm'nvt 'ryvt mhrry nmrym
verses.translation: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, With me from Lebanon; Look from the top of Amana, From the top of Senir and Hermon, From the lions’dens, From the mountains of the leopards.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבַּבְתִּ֖נִי אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּ֑ה לִבַּבְתִּ֙נִי֙ (באחד) [בְּאַחַ֣ת] מֵעֵינַ֔יִךְ בְּאַחַ֥ד עֲנָ֖ק מִצַּוְּרֹנָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: lbbtny 'chty khlh lbbtny (b'chd) [b'cht] m'ynykh b'chd 'nq mtsvrnykh
verses.translation: Thou hast ravished my heart, my sister, my bride; Thou hast ravished my heart with one of thine eyes, With one bead of thy necklace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־יָּפ֥וּ דֹדַ֖יִךְ אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּ֑ה מַה־טֹּ֤בוּ דֹדַ֙יִךְ֙ מִיַּ֔יִן וְרֵ֥יחַ שְׁמָנַ֖יִךְ מִכׇּל־בְּשָׂמִֽים׃
verses.translit: mhypv ddykh 'chty khlh mhtbv ddykh myyn vrych shmnykh mkhlbshmym
verses.translation: How fair is thy love, my sister, my bride! How much better is thy love than wine! And the smell of thine ointments than all manner of spices!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֹ֛פֶת תִּטֹּ֥פְנָה שִׂפְתוֹתַ֖יִךְ כַּלָּ֑ה דְּבַ֤שׁ וְחָלָב֙ תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנֵ֔ךְ וְרֵ֥יחַ שַׂלְמֹתַ֖יִךְ כְּרֵ֥יחַ לְבָנֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: npt ttpnh shptvtykh khlh dbsh vchlb tcht lshvnkh vrych shlmtykh khrych lbnvn
verses.translation: Thy lips, O my bride, drop honey— Honey and milk are under thy tongue; And the smell of thy garments is like the smell of Lebanon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֥ן ׀ נָע֖וּל אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּ֑ה גַּ֥ל נָע֖וּל מַעְיָ֥ן חָתֽוּם׃
verses.translit: gn  n'vl 'chty khlh gl n'vl m'yn chtvm
verses.translation: A garden shut up is my sister, my bride; A spring shut up, a fountain sealed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁלָחַ֙יִךְ֙ פַּרְדֵּ֣ס רִמּוֹנִ֔ים עִ֖ם פְּרִ֣י מְגָדִ֑ים כְּפָרִ֖ים עִם־נְרָדִֽים׃
verses.translit: shlchykh prds rmvnym 'm pry mgdym khprym 'mnrdym
verses.translation: Thy shoots are a park of pomegranates, With precious fruits; Henna with spikenard plants,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֵ֣רְדְּ  וְכַרְכֹּ֗ם קָנֶה֙ וְקִנָּמ֔וֹן עִ֖ם כׇּל־עֲצֵ֣י לְבוֹנָ֑ה מֹ֚ר וַאֲהָל֔וֹת עִ֖ם כׇּל־רָאשֵׁ֥י בְשָׂמִֽים׃
verses.translit: nrd  vkhrkhm qnh vqnmvn 'm khl'tsy lbvnh mr v'hlvt 'm khlr'shy bshmym
verses.translation: Spikenard and saffron, calamus and cinnamon, With all trees of frankincense; Myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַעְיַ֣ן גַּנִּ֔ים בְּאֵ֖ר מַ֣יִם חַיִּ֑ים וְנֹזְלִ֖ים מִן־לְבָנֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: m'yn gnym b'r mym chyym vnzlym mnlbnvn
verses.translation: Thou art a fountain of gardens, A well of living waters, And flowing streams from Lebanon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ע֤וּרִי צָפוֹן֙ וּב֣וֹאִי תֵימָ֔ן הָפִ֥יחִי גַנִּ֖י יִזְּל֣וּ בְשָׂמָ֑יו יָבֹ֤א דוֹדִי֙ לְגַנּ֔וֹ וְיֹאכַ֖ל פְּרִ֥י מְגָדָֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'vry tspvn vbv'y tymn hpychy gny yzlv bshmyv yb' dvdy lgnv vy'khl pry mgdyv
verses.translation: Awake, O north wind; And come, thou south; Blow upon my garden, That the spices thereof may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, And eat his precious fruits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּ֣אתִי לְגַנִּי֮ אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּה֒ אָרִ֤יתִי מוֹרִי֙ עִם־בְּשָׂמִ֔י אָכַ֤לְתִּי יַעְרִי֙ עִם־דִּבְשִׁ֔י שָׁתִ֥יתִי יֵינִ֖י עִם־חֲלָבִ֑י אִכְל֣וּ רֵעִ֔ים שְׁת֥וּ וְשִׁכְר֖וּ דּוֹדִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: b'ty lgny 'chty khlh 'ryty mvry 'mbshmy 'khlty y'ry 'mdbshy shtyty yyny 'mchlby 'khlv r'ym shtv vshkhrv dvdym {s}
verses.translation: I am come into my garden, my sister, my bride; I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk. Eat, O friends; Drink, yea, drink abundantly, O beloved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י יְשֵׁנָ֖ה וְלִבִּ֣י עֵ֑ר ק֣וֹל  דּוֹדִ֣י דוֹפֵ֗ק פִּתְחִי־לִ֞י אֲחֹתִ֤י רַעְיָתִי֙ יוֹנָתִ֣י תַמָּתִ֔י שֶׁרֹּאשִׁי֙ נִמְלָא־טָ֔ל קְוֻצּוֹתַ֖י רְסִ֥יסֵי לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.translit: 'ny yshnh vlby 'r qvl  dvdy dvpq ptchyly 'chty r'yty yvnty tmty shr'shy nml'tl qvtsvty rsysy lylh
verses.translation: I sleep, but my heart waketh; Hark! my beloved knocketh: ‘Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled; For my head is filled with dew, My locks with the drops of the night.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּשַׁ֙טְתִּי֙ אֶת־כֻּתׇּנְתִּ֔י אֵיכָ֖כָה אֶלְבָּשֶׁ֑נָּה רָחַ֥צְתִּי אֶת־רַגְלַ֖י אֵיכָ֥כָה אֲטַנְּפֵֽם׃
verses.translit: pshtty 'tkhtnty 'ykhkhh 'lbshnh rchtsty 'trgly 'ykhkhh 'tnpm
verses.translation: I have put off my coat; How shall I put it on? I have washed my feet; How shall I defile them?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דּוֹדִ֗י שָׁלַ֤ח יָדוֹ֙ מִן־הַחֹ֔ר וּמֵעַ֖י הָמ֥וּ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: dvdy shlch ydv mnhchr vm'y hmv 'lyv
verses.translation: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door, And my heart was moved for him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קַ֥מְתִּֽי אֲנִ֖י לִפְתֹּ֣חַ לְדוֹדִ֑י וְיָדַ֣י נָֽטְפוּ־מ֗וֹר וְאֶצְבְּעֹתַי֙ מ֣וֹר עֹבֵ֔ר עַ֖ל כַּפּ֥וֹת הַמַּנְעֽוּל׃
verses.translit: qmty 'ny lptch ldvdy vydy ntpvmvr v'tsb'ty mvr 'br 'l khpvt hmn'vl
verses.translation: I rose up to open to my beloved; And my hands dropped with myrrh, And my fingers with flowing myrrh, Upon the handles of the bar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּתַ֤חְתִּֽי אֲנִי֙ לְדוֹדִ֔י וְדוֹדִ֖י חָמַ֣ק עָבָ֑ר נַפְשִׁי֙ יָֽצְאָ֣ה בְדַבְּר֔וֹ בִּקַּשְׁתִּ֙יהוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א מְצָאתִ֔יהוּ קְרָאתִ֖יו וְלֹ֥א עָנָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: ptchty 'ny ldvdy vdvdy chmq 'br npshy yts'h bdbrv bqshtyhv vl' mts'tyhv qr'tyv vl' 'nny
verses.translation: I opened to my beloved; But my beloved had turned away, and was gone. My soul failed me when he spoke. I sought him, but I could not find him; I called him, but he gave me no answer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְצָאֻ֧נִי הַשֹּׁמְרִ֛ים הַסֹּבְבִ֥ים בָּעִ֖יר הִכּ֣וּנִי פְצָע֑וּנִי נָשְׂא֤וּ אֶת־רְדִידִי֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י שֹׁמְרֵ֖י הַחֹמֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: mts'ny hshmrym hsbbym b'yr hkhvny pts'vny nsh'v 'trdydy m'ly shmry hchmvt
verses.translation: The watchmen that go about the city found me, They smote me, they wounded me; The keepers of the walls took away my mantle from me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּנ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם אִֽם־תִּמְצְאוּ֙ אֶת־דּוֹדִ֔י מַה־תַּגִּ֣ידוּ ל֔וֹ שֶׁחוֹלַ֥ת אַהֲבָ֖ה אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: hshb'ty 'tkhm bnvt yrvshl͏m 'mtmts'v 'tdvdy mhtgydv lv shchvlt 'hbh 'ny
verses.translation: ’I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem, If ye find my beloved, what will ye tell him? That I am love-sick.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־דּוֹדֵ֣ךְ מִדּ֔וֹד הַיָּפָ֖ה בַּנָּשִׁ֑ים מַה־דּוֹדֵ֣ךְ מִדּ֔וֹד שֶׁכָּ֖כָה הִשְׁבַּעְתָּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: mhdvdkh mdvd hyph bnshym mhdvdkh mdvd shkhkhh hshb'tnv
verses.translation: ’What is thy beloved more than another beloved, O thou fairest among women? What is thy beloved more than another beloved, That thou dost so adjure us?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דּוֹדִ֥י צַח֙ וְאָד֔וֹם דָּג֖וּל מֵרְבָבָֽה׃
verses.translit: dvdy tsch v'dvm dgvl mrbbh
verses.translation: ’My beloved is white and ruddy, Pre-eminent above ten thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֹאשׁ֖וֹ כֶּ֣תֶם פָּ֑ז קְוֻצּוֹתָיו֙ תַּלְתַּלִּ֔ים שְׁחֹר֖וֹת כָּעוֹרֵֽב׃
verses.translit: r'shv khtm pz qvtsvtyv tltlym shchrvt kh'vrb
verses.translation: His head is as the most fine gold, His locks are curled, And black as a raven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵינָ֕יו כְּיוֹנִ֖ים עַל־אֲפִ֣יקֵי מָ֑יִם רֹֽחֲצוֹת֙ בֶּֽחָלָ֔ב יֹשְׁב֖וֹת עַל־מִלֵּֽאת׃
verses.translit: 'ynyv khyvnym 'l'pyqy mym rchtsvt bchlb yshbvt 'lml't
verses.translation: His eyes are like doves Beside the water-brooks; Washed with milk, And fitly set.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְחָיָו֙ כַּעֲרוּגַ֣ת הַבֹּ֔שֶׂם מִגְדְּל֖וֹת מֶרְקָחִ֑ים שִׂפְתוֹתָיו֙ שֽׁוֹשַׁנִּ֔ים נֹטְפ֖וֹת מ֥וֹר עֹבֵֽר׃
verses.translit: lchyv kh'rvgt hbshm mgdlvt mrqchym shptvtyv shvshnym ntpvt mvr 'br
verses.translation: His cheeks are as a bed of spices, As banks of sweet herbs; His lips are as lilies, Dropping with flowing myrrh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָדָיו֙ גְּלִילֵ֣י זָהָ֔ב מְמֻלָּאִ֖ים בַּתַּרְשִׁ֑ישׁ מֵעָיו֙ עֶ֣שֶׁת שֵׁ֔ן מְעֻלֶּ֖פֶת סַפִּירִֽים׃
verses.translit: ydyv glyly zhb mml'ym btrshysh m'yv 'sht shn m'lpt spyrym
verses.translation: His hands are as rods of gold Set with beryl; His body is as polished ivory Overlaid with sapphires.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁוֹקָיו֙ עַמּ֣וּדֵי שֵׁ֔שׁ מְיֻסָּדִ֖ים עַל־אַדְנֵי־פָ֑ז מַרְאֵ֙הוּ֙ כַּלְּבָנ֔וֹן בָּח֖וּר כָּאֲרָזִֽים׃
verses.translit: shvqyv 'mvdy shsh mysdym 'l'dnypz mr'hv khlbnvn bchvr kh'rzym
verses.translation: His legs are as pillars of marble, Set upon sockets of fine gold; His aspect is like Lebanon, Excellent as the cedars.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חִכּוֹ֙ מַֽמְתַקִּ֔ים וְכֻלּ֖וֹ מַחֲמַדִּ֑ים זֶ֤ה דוֹדִי֙ וְזֶ֣ה רֵעִ֔י בְּנ֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: chkhv mmtqym vkhlv mchmdym zh dvdy vzh r'y bnvt yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: His mouth is most sweet; Yea, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֚נָה הָלַ֣ךְ דּוֹדֵ֔ךְ הַיָּפָ֖ה בַּנָּשִׁ֑ים אָ֚נָה פָּנָ֣ה דוֹדֵ֔ךְ וּנְבַקְשֶׁ֖נּוּ עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'nh hlkh dvdkh hyph bnshym 'nh pnh dvdkh vnbqshnv 'mkh
verses.translation: ’Whither is thy beloved gone, O thou fairest among women? Whither hath thy beloved turned him, That we may seek him with thee?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דּוֹדִי֙ יָרַ֣ד לְגַנּ֔וֹ לַעֲרֻג֖וֹת הַבֹּ֑שֶׂם לִרְעוֹת֙ בַּגַּנִּ֔ים וְלִלְקֹ֖ט שֽׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים׃
verses.translit: dvdy yrd lgnv l'rgvt hbshm lr'vt bgnym vllqt shvshnym
verses.translation: ’My beloved is gone down into his garden, To the beds of spices, To feed in the gardens, And to gather lilies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֤י לְדוֹדִי֙ וְדוֹדִ֣י לִ֔י הָרֹעֶ֖ה בַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'ny ldvdy vdvdy ly hr'h bshvshnym {s}
verses.translation: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine, That feedeth among the lilies.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָפָ֨ה אַ֤תְּ רַעְיָתִי֙ כְּתִרְצָ֔ה נָאוָ֖ה כִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם אֲיֻמָּ֖ה כַּנִּדְגָּלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: yph 't r'yty khtrtsh n'vh khyrvshl͏m 'ymh khndglvt
verses.translation: Thou art beautiful, O my love, as Tirzah, Comely as Jerusalem, Terrible as an army with banners.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָסֵ֤בִּי עֵינַ֙יִךְ֙ מִנֶּגְדִּ֔י שֶׁ֥הֵ֖ם הִרְהִיבֻ֑נִי שַׂעְרֵךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הָֽעִזִּ֔ים שֶׁגָּלְשׁ֖וּ מִן־הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: hsby 'ynykh mngdy shhm hrhybny sh'rkh kh'dr h'zym shglshv mnhgl'd
verses.translation: Turn away thine eyes from me, For they have overcome me. Thy hair is as a flock of goats, That trail down from Gilead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁנַּ֙יִךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הָֽרְחֵלִ֔ים שֶׁעָל֖וּ מִן־הָרַחְצָ֑ה שֶׁכֻּלָּם֙ מַתְאִימ֔וֹת וְשַׁכֻּלָ֖ה אֵ֥ין בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: shnykh kh'dr hrchlym sh'lv mnhrchtsh shkhlm mt'ymvt vshkhlh 'yn bhm
verses.translation: Thy teeth are like a flock of ewes, Which are come up from the washing; Whereof all are paired, And none faileth among them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּפֶ֤לַח הָרִמּוֹן֙ רַקָּתֵ֔ךְ מִבַּ֖עַד לְצַמָּתֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khplch hrmvn rqtkh mb'd ltsmtkh
verses.translation: Thy temples are like a pomegranate split open Behind thy veil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁשִּׁ֥ים הֵ֙מָּה֙ מְלָכ֔וֹת וּשְׁמֹנִ֖ים פִּֽילַגְשִׁ֑ים וַעֲלָמ֖וֹת אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.translit: shshym hmh mlkhvt vshmnym pylgshym v'lmvt 'yn mspr
verses.translation: There are threescore queens, And fourscore concubines, And maidens without number.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחַ֥ת הִיא֙ יוֹנָתִ֣י תַמָּתִ֔י אַחַ֥ת הִיא֙ לְאִמָּ֔הּ בָּרָ֥ה הִ֖יא לְיֽוֹלַדְתָּ֑הּ רָא֤וּהָ בָנוֹת֙ וַֽיְאַשְּׁר֔וּהָ מְלָכ֥וֹת וּפִֽילַגְשִׁ֖ים וַֽיְהַלְלֽוּהָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'cht hy' yvnty tmty 'cht hy' l'mh brh hy' lyvldth r'vh bnvt vy'shrvh mlkhvt vpylgshym vyhllvh {s}
verses.translation: My dove, my undefiled, is but one; She is the only one of her mother; She is the choice one of her that bore her. The daughters saw her, and called her happy; Yea, the queens and the concubines, and they praised her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִי־זֹ֥את הַנִּשְׁקָפָ֖ה כְּמוֹ־שָׁ֑חַר יָפָ֣ה כַלְּבָנָ֗ה בָּרָה֙ כַּֽחַמָּ֔ה אֲיֻמָּ֖ה כַּנִּדְגָּלֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: myz't hnshqph khmvshchr yph khlbnh brh khchmh 'ymh khndglvt {s}
verses.translation: Who is she that looketh forth as the dawn, Fair as the moon, Clear as the sun, Terrible as an army with banners?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶל־גִּנַּ֤ת אֱגוֹז֙ יָרַ֔דְתִּי לִרְא֖וֹת בְּאִבֵּ֣י הַנָּ֑חַל לִרְאוֹת֙ הֲפָֽרְחָ֣ה הַגֶּ֔פֶן הֵנֵ֖צוּ הָרִמֹּנִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'lgnt 'gvz yrdty lr'vt b'by hnchl lr'vt hprchh hgpn hntsv hrmnym
verses.translation: I went down into the garden of nuts, To look at the green plants of the valley, To see whether the vine budded, And the pomegranates were in flower.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי נַפְשִׁ֣י שָׂמַ֔תְנִי מַרְכְּב֖וֹת עַמִּ֥י נָדִֽיב׃
verses.translit: l' yd'ty npshy shmtny mrkhbvt 'my ndyb
verses.translation: Before I was aware, my soul set me Upon the chariots of my princely people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁ֤וּבִי שׁ֙וּבִי֙ הַשּׁ֣וּלַמִּ֔ית שׁ֥וּבִי שׁ֖וּבִי וְנֶחֱזֶה־בָּ֑ךְ מַֽה־תֶּחֱזוּ֙ בַּשּׁ֣וּלַמִּ֔ית כִּמְחֹלַ֖ת הַֽמַּחֲנָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: shvby shvby hshvlmyt shvby shvby vnchzhbkh mhtchzv bshvlmyt khmchlt hmchnym
verses.translation: Return, return, O Shulammite; Return, return, that we may look upon thee. What will ye see in the Shulammite? As it were a dance of two companies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־יָּפ֧וּ פְעָמַ֛יִךְ בַּנְּעָלִ֖ים בַּת־נָדִ֑יב חַמּוּקֵ֣י יְרֵכַ֔יִךְ כְּמ֣וֹ חֲלָאִ֔ים מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְדֵ֥י אׇמָּֽן׃
verses.translit: mhypv p'mykh bn'lym btndyb chmvqy yrkhykh khmv chl'ym m'shh ydy 'mn
verses.translation: How beautiful are thy steps in sandals, O prince’s daughter! The roundings of thy thighs are like the links of a chain, The work of the hands of a skilled workman.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׇׁרְרֵךְ֙ אַגַּ֣ן הַסַּ֔הַר אַל־יֶחְסַ֖ר הַמָּ֑זֶג בִּטְנֵךְ֙ עֲרֵמַ֣ת חִטִּ֔ים סוּגָ֖ה בַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים׃
verses.translit: shrrkh 'gn hshr 'lychsr hmzg btnkh 'rmt chtym svgh bshvshnym
verses.translation: Thy navel is like a round goblet, wherein no mingled wine is wanting; Thy belly is like a heap of wheat Set about with lilies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁנֵ֥י שָׁדַ֛יִךְ כִּשְׁנֵ֥י עֳפָרִ֖ים תׇּאֳמֵ֥י צְבִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: shny shdykh khshny 'prym t'my tsbyh
verses.translation: Thy two breasts are like two fawns that are twins of a gazelle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַוָּארֵ֖ךְ כְּמִגְדַּ֣ל הַשֵּׁ֑ן עֵינַ֜יִךְ בְּרֵכ֣וֹת בְּחֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן עַל־שַׁ֙עַר֙ בַּת־רַבִּ֔ים אַפֵּךְ֙ כְּמִגְדַּ֣ל הַלְּבָנ֔וֹן צוֹפֶ֖ה פְּנֵ֥י דַמָּֽשֶׂק׃
verses.translit: tsv'rkh khmgdl hshn 'ynykh brkhvt bchshbvn 'lsh'r btrbym 'pkh khmgdl hlbnvn tsvph pny dmshq
verses.translation: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory; Thine eyes as the pools in Heshbon, By the gate of Bath-rabbim; Thy nose is like the tower of Lebanon Which looketh toward Damascus.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֹאשֵׁ֤ךְ עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ כַּכַּרְמֶ֔ל וְדַלַּ֥ת רֹאשֵׁ֖ךְ כָּאַרְגָּמָ֑ן מֶ֖לֶךְ אָס֥וּר בָּרְהָטִֽים׃
verses.translit: r'shkh 'lykh khkhrml vdlt r'shkh kh'rgmn mlkh 'svr brhtym
verses.translation: Thy head upon thee is like Carmel, and the hair of thy head like purple; The king is held captive in the tresses thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־יָּפִית֙ וּמַה־נָּעַ֔מְתְּ אַהֲבָ֖ה בַּתַּֽעֲנוּגִֽים׃
verses.translit: mhypyt vmhn'mt 'hbh bt'nvgym
verses.translation: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights! .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֤את קֽוֹמָתֵךְ֙ דָּֽמְתָ֣ה לְתָמָ֔ר וְשָׁדַ֖יִךְ לְאַשְׁכֹּלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: z't qvmtkh dmth ltmr vshdykh l'shkhlvt
verses.translation: This thy stature is like to a palm-tree, and thy breasts to clusters of grapes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ אֶעֱלֶ֣ה בְתָמָ֔ר אֹֽחֲזָ֖ה בְּסַנְסִנָּ֑יו וְיִֽהְיוּ־נָ֤א שָׁדַ֙יִךְ֙ כְּאֶשְׁכְּל֣וֹת הַגֶּ֔פֶן וְרֵ֥יחַ אַפֵּ֖ךְ כַּתַּפּוּחִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'mrty ''lh btmr 'chzh bsnsnyv vyhyvn' shdykh kh'shkhlvt hgpn vrych 'pkh khtpvchym
verses.translation: I said: ‘I will climb up into the palm-tree, I will take hold of the branches thereof; and let thy breasts be as clusters of the vine, And the smell of thy countenance like apples;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחִכֵּ֕ךְ כְּיֵ֥ין הַטּ֛וֹב הוֹלֵ֥ךְ לְדוֹדִ֖י לְמֵישָׁרִ֑ים דּוֹבֵ֖ב שִׂפְתֵ֥י יְשֵׁנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vchkhkh khyyn htvb hvlkh ldvdy lmyshrym dvbb shpty yshnym
verses.translation: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine, That glideth down smoothly for my beloved, moving gently the lips of those that are asleep.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י לְדוֹדִ֔י וְעָלַ֖י תְּשׁוּקָתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'ny ldvdy v'ly tshvqtv {s}
verses.translation: I am my beloved’s, and his desire is toward me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְכָ֤ה דוֹדִי֙ נֵצֵ֣א הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה נָלִ֖ינָה בַּכְּפָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: lkhh dvdy nts' hshdh nlynh bkhprym
verses.translation: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in the villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַשְׁכִּ֙ימָה֙ לַכְּרָמִ֔ים נִרְאֶ֞ה אִם־פָּֽרְחָ֤ה הַגֶּ֙פֶן֙ פִּתַּ֣ח הַסְּמָדַ֔ר הֵנֵ֖צוּ הָרִמּוֹנִ֑ים שָׁ֛ם אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת־דֹּדַ֖י לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: nshkhymh lkhrmym nr'h 'mprchh hgpn ptch hsmdr hntsv hrmvnym shm 'tn 'tddy lkh
verses.translation: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see whether the vine hath budded, whether the vine-blossom be opened, and the pomegranates be in flower; there will I give thee my love.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽדּוּדָאִ֣ים נָֽתְנוּ־רֵ֗יחַ וְעַל־פְּתָחֵ֙ינוּ֙ כׇּל־מְגָדִ֔ים חֲדָשִׁ֖ים גַּם־יְשָׁנִ֑ים דּוֹדִ֖י צָפַ֥נְתִּי לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: hdvd'ym ntnvrych v'lptchynv khlmgdym chdshym gmyshnym dvdy tspnty lkh
verses.translation: The mandrakes give forth fragrance, and at our doors are all manner of precious fruits, new and old, which I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֤י יִתֶּנְךָ֙ כְּאָ֣ח לִ֔י יוֹנֵ֖ק שְׁדֵ֣י אִמִּ֑י אֶֽמְצָאֲךָ֤ בַחוּץ֙ אֶשָּׁ֣קְךָ֔ גַּ֖ם לֹא־יָבֻ֥זוּ לִֽי׃
verses.translit: my ytnkh kh'ch ly yvnq shdy 'my 'mts'kh bchvts 'shqkh gm l'ybzv ly
verses.translation: Oh that thou wert as my brother, That sucked the breasts of my mother! When I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; Yea, and none would despise me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶנְהָֽגְךָ֗ אֲבִֽיאֲךָ֛ אֶל־בֵּ֥ית אִמִּ֖י תְּלַמְּדֵ֑נִי אַשְׁקְךָ֙ מִיַּ֣יִן הָרֶ֔קַח מֵעֲסִ֖יס רִמֹּנִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'nhgkh 'by'kh 'lbyt 'my tlmdny 'shqkh myyn hrqch m'sys rmny
verses.translation: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother’s house, That thou mightest instruct me; I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine, Of the juice of my pomegranate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂמֹאלוֹ֙ תַּ֣חַת רֹאשִׁ֔י וִֽימִינ֖וֹ תְּחַבְּקֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: shm'lv tcht r'shy vymynv tchbqny
verses.translation: His left hand should be under my head, And his right hand should embrace me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּנ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם מַה־תָּעִ֧ירוּ ׀ וּֽמַה־תְּעֹ֥רְר֛וּ אֶת־הָאַהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּֽץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hshb'ty 'tkhm bnvt yrvshl͏m mht'yrv  vmht'rrv 'th'hbh 'd shtchpts {s}
verses.translation: ’I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem: Why should ye awaken, or stir up love, Until it please?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֣י זֹ֗את עֹלָה֙ מִן־הַמִּדְבָּ֔ר מִתְרַפֶּ֖קֶת עַל־דּוֹדָ֑הּ תַּ֤חַת הַתַּפּ֙וּחַ֙ עֽוֹרַרְתִּ֔יךָ שָׁ֚מָּה חִבְּלַ֣תְךָ אִמֶּ֔ךָ שָׁ֖מָּה חִבְּלָ֥ה יְלָדַֽתְךָ׃
verses.translit: my z't 'lh mnhmdbr mtrpqt 'ldvdh tcht htpvch 'vrrtykh shmh chbltkh 'mkh shmh chblh yldtkh
verses.translation: Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness, Leaning upon her beloved? Under the apple-tree I awakened thee; There thy mother was in travail with thee; There was she in travail and brought thee forth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂימֵ֨נִי כַֽחוֹתָ֜ם עַל־לִבֶּ֗ךָ כַּֽחוֹתָם֙ עַל־זְרוֹעֶ֔ךָ כִּֽי־עַזָּ֤ה כַמָּ֙וֶת֙ אַהֲבָ֔ה קָשָׁ֥ה כִשְׁא֖וֹל קִנְאָ֑ה רְשָׁפֶ֕יהָ רִשְׁפֵּ֕י אֵ֖שׁ שַׁלְהֶ֥בֶתְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: shymny khchvtm 'llbkh khchvtm 'lzrv'kh khy'zh khmvt 'hbh qshh khsh'vl qn'h rshpyh rshpy 'sh shlhbtyh
verses.translation: Set me as a seal upon thy heart, As a seal upon thine arm; For love is strong as death, Jealousy is cruel as the grave; The flashes thereof are flashes of fire, A very flame of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֗ים לֹ֤א יֽוּכְלוּ֙ לְכַבּ֣וֹת אֶת־הָֽאַהֲבָ֔ה וּנְהָר֖וֹת לֹ֣א יִשְׁטְפ֑וּהָ אִם־יִתֵּ֨ן אִ֜ישׁ אֶת־כׇּל־ה֤וֹן בֵּיתוֹ֙ בָּאַהֲבָ֔ה בּ֖וֹז יָב֥וּזוּ לֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mym rbym l' yvkhlv lkhbvt 'th'hbh vnhrvt l' yshtpvh 'mytn 'ysh 'tkhlhvn bytv b'hbh bvz ybvzv lv {s}
verses.translation: Many waters cannot quench love, Neither can the floods drown it; If a man would give all the substance of his house for love, He would utterly be contemned.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָח֥וֹת לָ֙נוּ֙ קְטַנָּ֔ה וְשָׁדַ֖יִם אֵ֣ין לָ֑הּ מַֽה־נַּעֲשֶׂה֙ לַאֲחֹתֵ֔נוּ בַּיּ֖וֹם שֶׁיְּדֻבַּר־בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: 'chvt lnv qtnh vshdym 'yn lh mhn'shh l'chtnv byvm shydbrbh
verses.translation: We have a little sister, And she hath no breasts; What shall we do for our sister In the day when she shall be spoken for?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־חוֹמָ֣ה הִ֔יא נִבְנֶ֥ה עָלֶ֖יהָ טִ֣ירַת כָּ֑סֶף וְאִם־דֶּ֣לֶת הִ֔יא נָצ֥וּר עָלֶ֖יהָ ל֥וּחַ אָֽרֶז׃
verses.translit: 'mchvmh hy' nbnh 'lyh tyrt khsf v'mdlt hy' ntsvr 'lyh lvch 'rz
verses.translation: If she be a wall, We will build upon her a turret of silver; And if she be a door, We will enclose her with boards of cedar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י חוֹמָ֔ה וְשָׁדַ֖י כַּמִּגְדָּל֑וֹת אָ֛ז הָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינָ֖יו כְּמוֹצְאֵ֥ת שָׁלֽוֹם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'ny chvmh vshdy khmgdlvt 'z hyyty b'ynyv khmvts't shlvm {p}
verses.translation: I am a wall, And my breasts like the towers thereof; Then was I in his eyes As one that found peace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֶּ֣רֶם הָיָ֤ה לִשְׁלֹמֹה֙ בְּבַ֣עַל הָמ֔וֹן נָתַ֥ן אֶת־הַכֶּ֖רֶם לַנֹּטְרִ֑ים אִ֛ישׁ יָבִ֥א בְּפִרְי֖וֹ אֶ֥לֶף כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.translit: khrm hyh lshlmh bb'l hmvn ntn 'thkhrm lntrym 'ysh yb' bpryv 'lf khsf
verses.translation: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon; He gave over the vineyard unto keepers; Every one for the fruit thereof Brought in a thousand pieces of silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּרְמִ֥י שֶׁלִּ֖י לְפָנָ֑י הָאֶ֤לֶף לְךָ֙ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וּמָאתַ֖יִם לְנֹטְרִ֥ים אֶת־פִּרְיֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khrmy shly lpny h'lf lkh shlmh vm'tym lntrym 'tpryv
verses.translation: My vineyard, which is mine, is before me; Thou, O Solomon, shalt have the thousand, And those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַיּוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת בַּגַּנִּ֗ים חֲבֵרִ֛ים מַקְשִׁיבִ֥ים לְקוֹלֵ֖ךְ הַשְׁמִיעִֽנִי׃
verses.translit: hyvshbt bgnym chbrym mqshybym lqvlkh hshmy'ny
verses.translation: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, The companions hearken for thy voice: ‘Cause me to hear it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
