verses.original: בְּרַ֣ח  דּוֹדִ֗י וּֽדְמֵה־לְךָ֤ לִצְבִי֙ א֚וֹ לְעֹ֣פֶר הָֽאַיָּלִ֔ים עַ֖ל הָרֵ֥י בְשָׂמִֽים׃
verses.translit: brch  dvdy vdmhlkh ltsby 'v l'pr h'ylym 'l hry bshmym
verses.translation: Make haste, my beloved, And be thou like to a gazelle or to a young hart Upon the mountains of spices.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּימֵי֙ שְׁפֹ֣ט הַשֹּׁפְטִ֔ים וַיְהִ֥י רָעָ֖ב בָּאָ֑רֶץ וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ אִ֜ישׁ מִבֵּ֧ית לֶ֣חֶם יְהוּדָ֗ה לָגוּר֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב ה֥וּא וְאִשְׁתּ֖וֹ וּשְׁנֵ֥י בָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyhy bymy shpt hshptym vyhy r'b b'rts vylkh 'ysh mbyt lchm yhvdh lgvr bshdy mv'b hv' v'shtv vshny bnyv
verses.translation: AND IT came to pass in the days when the judges judged, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Beth-lehem in Judah went to sojourn in the field of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֵׁ֣ם הָאִ֣ישׁ אֱֽלִימֶ֡לֶךְ וְשֵׁם֩ אִשְׁתּ֨וֹ נׇעֳמִ֜י וְשֵׁ֥ם שְׁנֵֽי־בָנָ֣יו  מַחְל֤וֹן וְכִלְיוֹן֙ אֶפְרָתִ֔ים מִבֵּ֥ית לֶ֖חֶם יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ שְׂדֵֽי־מוֹאָ֖ב וַיִּֽהְיוּ־שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vshm h'ysh 'lymlkh vshm 'shtv n'my vshm shnybnyv  mchlvn vkhlyvn 'prtym mbyt lchm yhvdh vyb'v shdymv'b vyhyvshm
verses.translation: And the name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Beth-lehem in Judah. And they came into the field of Moab, and continued there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֥מׇת אֱלִימֶ֖לֶךְ אִ֣ישׁ נׇעֳמִ֑י וַתִּשָּׁאֵ֥ר הִ֖יא וּשְׁנֵ֥י בָנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vymt 'lymlkh 'ysh n'my vtsh'r hy' vshny bnyh
verses.translation: And Elimelech Naomi’s husband died; and she was left, and her two sons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂא֣וּ לָהֶ֗ם נָשִׁים֙ מֹֽאֲבִיּ֔וֹת שֵׁ֤ם הָאַחַת֙ עׇרְפָּ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית ר֑וּת וַיֵּ֥שְׁבוּ שָׁ֖ם כְּעֶ֥שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vysh'v lhm nshym m'byvt shm h'cht 'rph vshm hshnyt rvt vyshbv shm kh'shr shnym
verses.translation: And they took them wives of the women of Moab: the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth; and they dwelt there about ten years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּמֻ֥תוּ גַם־שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם מַחְל֣וֹן וְכִלְי֑וֹן וַתִּשָּׁאֵר֙ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה מִשְּׁנֵ֥י יְלָדֶ֖יהָ וּמֵאִישָֽׁהּ׃
verses.translit: vymtv gmshnyhm mchlvn vkhlyvn vtsh'r h'shh mshny yldyh vm'yshh
verses.translation: And Mahlon and Chilion died both of them; and the woman was left of her two children and of her husband.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּ֤קׇם הִיא֙ וְכַלֹּתֶ֔יהָ וַתָּ֖שׇׁב מִשְּׂדֵ֣י מוֹאָ֑ב כִּ֤י שָֽׁמְעָה֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב כִּֽי־פָקַ֤ד יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־עַמּ֔וֹ לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶ֖ם לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translit: vtqm hy' vkhltyh vtshb mshdy mv'b khy shm'h bshdh mv'b khypqd yhvh 't'mv ltt lhm lchm
verses.translation: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law, that she might return from the field of Moab; for she had heard in the field of Moab how that the LORD had remembered His people in giving them bread.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּצֵ֗א מִן־הַמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָֽיְתָה־שָּׁ֔מָּה וּשְׁתֵּ֥י כַלּוֹתֶ֖יהָ עִמָּ֑הּ וַתֵּלַ֣כְנָה בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ לָשׁ֖וּב אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vtts' mnhmqvm 'shr hythshmh vshty khlvtyh 'mh vtlkhnh bdrkh lshvb 'l'rts yhvdh
verses.translation: And she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר נׇעֳמִי֙ לִשְׁתֵּ֣י כַלֹּתֶ֔יהָ לֵ֣כְנָה שֹּׁ֔בְנָה אִשָּׁ֖ה לְבֵ֣ית אִמָּ֑הּ (יעשה) [יַ֣עַשׂ] יְהֹוָ֤ה עִמָּכֶם֙ חֶ֔סֶד כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֛ם עִם־הַמֵּתִ֖ים וְעִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.translit: vt'mr n'my lshty khltyh lkhnh shbnh 'shh lbyt 'mh (y'shh) [y'sh] yhvh 'mkhm chsd kh'shr 'shytm 'mhmtym v'mdy
verses.translation: And Naomi said unto her two daughters-in-law: ‘Go, return each of you to her mother’s house; the LORD deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִתֵּ֤ן יְהֹוָה֙ לָכֶ֔ם וּמְצֶ֣אןָ מְנוּחָ֔ה אִשָּׁ֖ה בֵּ֣ית אִישָׁ֑הּ וַתִּשַּׁ֣ק לָהֶ֔ן וַתִּשֶּׂ֥אנָה קוֹלָ֖ן וַתִּבְכֶּֽינָה׃
verses.translit: ytn yhvh lkhm vmts'n mnvchh 'shh byt 'yshh vtshq lhn vtsh'nh qvln vtbkhynh
verses.translation: TheLORD grant you that ye may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband.’ Then she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice, and wept.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּאמַ֖רְנָה־לָּ֑הּ כִּֽי־אִתָּ֥ךְ נָשׁ֖וּב לְעַמֵּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vt'mrnhlh khy'tkh nshvb l'mkh
verses.translation: And they said unto her: ‘Nay, but we will return with thee unto thy people.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר נׇעֳמִי֙ שֹׁ֣בְנָה בְנֹתַ֔י לָ֥מָּה תֵלַ֖כְנָה עִמִּ֑י הַעֽוֹד־לִ֤י בָנִים֙ בְּֽמֵעַ֔י וְהָי֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם לַאֲנָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vt'mr n'my shbnh bnty lmh tlkhnh 'my h'vdly bnym bm'y vhyv lkhm l'nshym
verses.translation: And Naomi said: ‘Turn back, my daughters; why will ye go with me? have I yet sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֹׁ֤בְנָה בְנֹתַי֙ לֵ֔כְןָ כִּ֥י זָקַ֖נְתִּי מִהְי֣וֹת לְאִ֑ישׁ כִּ֤י אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ יֶשׁ־לִ֣י תִקְוָ֔ה גַּ֣ם הָיִ֤יתִי הַלַּ֙יְלָה֙ לְאִ֔ישׁ וְגַ֖ם יָלַ֥דְתִּי בָנִֽים׃
verses.translit: shbnh bnty lkhn khy zqnty mhyvt l'ysh khy 'mrty yshly tqvh gm hyyty hlylh l'ysh vgm yldty bnym
verses.translation: Turn back, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have a husband. If I should say: I have hope, should I even have an husband to-night, and also bear sons;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלָהֵ֣ן  תְּשַׂבֵּ֗רְנָה עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִגְדָּ֔לוּ הֲלָהֵן֙ תֵּעָגֵ֔נָה לְבִלְתִּ֖י הֱי֣וֹת לְאִ֑ישׁ אַ֣ל בְּנֹתַ֗י כִּֽי־מַר־לִ֤י מְאֹד֙ מִכֶּ֔ם כִּֽי־יָצְאָ֥ה בִ֖י יַד־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hlhn  tshbrnh 'd 'shr ygdlv hlhn t'gnh lblty hyvt l'ysh 'l bnty khymrly m'd mkhm khyyts'h by ydyhvh
verses.translation: would ye tarry for them till they were grown? would ye shut yourselves off for them and have no husbands? nay, my daughters; for it grieveth me much for your sakes, for the hand of the LORD is gone forth against me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּשֶּׂ֣נָה קוֹלָ֔ן וַתִּבְכֶּ֖ינָה ע֑וֹד וַתִּשַּׁ֤ק עׇרְפָּה֙ לַחֲמוֹתָ֔הּ וְר֖וּת דָּ֥בְקָה בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vtshnh qvln vtbkhynh 'vd vtshq 'rph lchmvth vrvt dbqh bh
verses.translation: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again; and Orpah kissed her mother-in-law; but Ruth cleaved unto her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּה֙ שָׁ֣בָה יְבִמְתֵּ֔ךְ אֶל־עַמָּ֖הּ וְאֶל־אֱלֹהֶ֑יהָ שׁ֖וּבִי אַחֲרֵ֥י יְבִמְתֵּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vt'mr hnh shbh ybmtkh 'l'mh v'l'lhyh shvby 'chry ybmtkh
verses.translation: And she said: ‘Behold, thy sister-in-law is gone back unto her people, and unto her god; return thou after thy sister-in-law.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר רוּת֙ אַל־תִּפְגְּעִי־בִ֔י לְעׇזְבֵ֖ךְ לָשׁ֣וּב מֵאַחֲרָ֑יִךְ כִּ֠י אֶל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֵּלְכִ֜י אֵלֵ֗ךְ וּבַאֲשֶׁ֤ר תָּלִ֙ינִי֙ אָלִ֔ין עַמֵּ֣ךְ עַמִּ֔י וֵאלֹהַ֖יִךְ אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translit: vt'mr rvt 'ltpg'yby l'zbkh lshvb m'chrykh khy 'l'shr tlkhy 'lkh vb'shr tlyny 'lyn 'mkh 'my v'lhykh 'lhy
verses.translation: And Ruth said: ‘Entreat me not to leave thee, and to return from following after thee; for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge; thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר תָּמ֙וּתִי֙ אָמ֔וּת וְשָׁ֖ם אֶקָּבֵ֑ר כֹּה֩ יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה יְהֹוָ֥ה לִי֙ וְכֹ֣ה יוֹסִ֔יף כִּ֣י הַמָּ֔וֶת יַפְרִ֖יד בֵּינִ֥י וּבֵינֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: b'shr tmvty 'mvt vshm 'qbr khh y'shh yhvh ly vkhh yvsyf khy hmvt ypryd byny vbynkh
verses.translation: where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried; the LORD do so to me,and more also, if aught but death part thee and me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֕רֶא כִּֽי־מִתְאַמֶּ֥צֶת הִ֖יא לָלֶ֣כֶת אִתָּ֑הּ וַתֶּחְדַּ֖ל לְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vtr' khymt'mtst hy' llkht 'th vtchdl ldbr 'lyh
verses.translation: And when she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her, she left off speaking unto her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּלַ֣כְנָה שְׁתֵּיהֶ֔ם עַד־בּוֹאָ֖נָה בֵּ֣ית לָ֑חֶם וַיְהִ֗י כְּבוֹאָ֙נָה֙ בֵּ֣ית לֶ֔חֶם וַתֵּהֹ֤ם כׇּל־הָעִיר֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ן וַתֹּאמַ֖רְנָה הֲזֹ֥את נׇעֳמִֽי׃
verses.translit: vtlkhnh shtyhm 'dbv'nh byt lchm vyhy khbv'nh byt lchm vthm khlh'yr 'lyhn vt'mrnh hz't n'my
verses.translation: So they two went until they came to Beth-lehem. And it came to pass, when they were come to Beth-lehem, that all the city was astir concerning them, and the women said: ‘Is this Naomi?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ן אַל־תִּקְרֶ֥אנָה לִ֖י נׇעֳמִ֑י קְרֶ֤אןָ לִי֙ מָרָ֔א כִּֽי־הֵמַ֥ר שַׁדַּ֛י לִ֖י מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lyhn 'ltqr'nh ly n'my qr'n ly mr' khyhmr shdy ly m'd
verses.translation: And she said unto them: ‘Call me not Naomi, call me Marah; for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ מְלֵאָ֣ה הָלַ֔כְתִּי וְרֵיקָ֖ם הֱשִׁיבַ֣נִי יְהֹוָ֑ה לָ֣מָּה תִקְרֶ֤אנָה לִי֙ נׇעֳמִ֔י וַֽיהֹוָה֙ עָ֣נָה בִ֔י וְשַׁדַּ֖י הֵ֥רַֽע לִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'ny ml'h hlkhty vryqm hshybny yhvh lmh tqr'nh ly n'my vyhvh 'nh by vshdy hr' ly
verses.translation: I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me back home empty; why call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּ֣שׇׁב נׇעֳמִ֗י וְר֨וּת הַמּוֹאֲבִיָּ֤ה כַלָּתָהּ֙ עִמָּ֔הּ הַשָּׁ֖בָה מִשְּׂדֵ֣י מוֹאָ֑ב וְהֵ֗מָּה בָּ֚אוּ בֵּ֣ית לֶ֔חֶם בִּתְחִלַּ֖ת קְצִ֥יר שְׂעֹרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vtshb n'my vrvt hmv'byh khlth 'mh hshbh mshdy mv'b vhmh b'v byt lchm btchlt qtsyr sh'rym
verses.translation: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, with her, who returned out of the field of Moab—and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽלְנׇעֳמִ֞י (מידע) [מוֹדָ֣ע] לְאִישָׁ֗הּ אִ֚ישׁ גִּבּ֣וֹר חַ֔יִל מִמִּשְׁפַּ֖חַת אֱלִימֶ֑לֶךְ וּשְׁמ֖וֹ בֹּֽעַז׃
verses.translit: vln'my (myd') [mvd'] l'yshh 'ysh gbvr chyl mmshpcht 'lymlkh vshmv b'z
verses.translation: And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband’s, a mighty man of valour, of the family of Elimelech, and his name was Boaz.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֩אמֶר֩ ר֨וּת הַמּוֹאֲבִיָּ֜ה אֶֽל־נׇעֳמִ֗י אֵלְכָה־נָּ֤א הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וַאֲלַקֳּטָ֣ה בַֽשִּׁבֳּלִ֔ים אַחַ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶמְצָא־חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינָ֑יו וַתֹּ֥אמֶר לָ֖הּ לְכִ֥י בִתִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vt'mr rvt hmv'byh 'ln'my 'lkhhn' hshdh v'lqth bshblym 'chr 'shr 'mts'chn b'ynyv vt'mr lh lkhy bty
verses.translation: And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi: ‘Let me now go to the field, and glean among the ears of corn after him in whose sight I shall find favour.’ And she said unto her: ‘Go, my daughter.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֤לֶךְ וַתָּבוֹא֙ וַתְּלַקֵּ֣ט בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה אַחֲרֵ֖י הַקֹּצְרִ֑ים וַיִּ֣קֶר מִקְרֶ֔הָ חֶלְקַ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ לְבֹ֔עַז אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִמִּשְׁפַּ֥חַת אֱלִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vtlkh vtbv' vtlqt bshdh 'chry hqtsrym vyqr mqrh chlqt hshdh lb'z 'shr mmshpcht 'lymlkh
verses.translation: And she went, and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers; and her hap was to light on the portion of the field belonging unto Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה־בֹ֗עַז בָּ֚א מִבֵּ֣ית לֶ֔חֶם וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לַקּוֹצְרִ֖ים יְהֹוָ֣ה עִמָּכֶ֑ם וַיֹּ֥אמְרוּ ל֖וֹ יְבָרֶכְךָ֥ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhnhb'z b' mbyt lchm vy'mr lqvtsrym yhvh 'mkhm vy'mrv lv ybrkhkh yhvh
verses.translation: And, behold, Boaz came from Beth-lehem, and said unto the reapers: ‘The LORD be with you.’ And they answered him: ‘The LORD bless thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בֹּ֙עַז֙ לְנַֽעֲר֔וֹ הַנִּצָּ֖ב עַל־הַקּוֹצְרִ֑ים לְמִ֖י הַנַּעֲרָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vy'mr b'z ln'rv hntsb 'lhqvtsrym lmy hn'rh hz't
verses.translation: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers: ‘Whose damsel is this?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֗עַן הַנַּ֛עַר הַנִּצָּ֥ב עַל־הַקּוֹצְרִ֖ים וַיֹּאמַ֑ר נַעֲרָ֤ה מֽוֹאֲבִיָּה֙ הִ֔יא הַשָּׁ֥בָה עִֽם־נׇעֳמִ֖י מִשְּׂדֵ֥י מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.translit: vy'n hn'r hntsb 'lhqvtsrym vy'mr n'rh mv'byh hy' hshbh 'mn'my mshdy mv'b
verses.translation: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said: ‘It is a Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the field of Moab;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֗אמֶר אֲלַקֳּטָה־נָּא֙ וְאָסַפְתִּ֣י בָעֳמָרִ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֖י הַקּוֹצְרִ֑ים וַתָּב֣וֹא וַֽתַּעֲמ֗וֹד מֵאָ֤ז הַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ וְעַד־עַ֔תָּה זֶ֛ה שִׁבְתָּ֥הּ הַבַּ֖יִת מְעָֽט׃
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lqthn' v'spty b'mrym 'chry hqvtsrym vtbv' vt'mvd m'z hbqr v'd'th zh shbth hbyt m't
verses.translation: and she said: Let me glean, I pray you, and gather after the reapers among the sheaves; so she came, and hath continued even from the morning until now, save that she tarried a little in the house.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ בֹּ֨עַז אֶל־ר֜וּת הֲל֧וֹא שָׁמַ֣עַתְּ בִּתִּ֗י אַל־תֵּֽלְכִי֙ לִלְקֹט֙ בְּשָׂדֶ֣ה אַחֵ֔ר וְגַ֛ם לֹ֥א תַעֲבוּרִ֖י מִזֶּ֑ה וְכֹ֥ה תִדְבָּקִ֖ין עִם־נַעֲרֹתָֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr b'z 'lrvt hlv' shm't bty 'ltlkhy llqt bshdh 'chr vgm l' t'bvry mzh vkhh tdbqyn 'mn'rty
verses.translation: Then said Boaz unto Ruth: ‘Hearest thou not, my daughter? Go not to glean in another field, neither pass from hence, but abide here fast by my maidens.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵינַ֜יִךְ בַּשָּׂדֶ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־יִקְצֹרוּן֙ וְהָלַ֣כְתְּ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ן הֲל֥וֹא צִוִּ֛יתִי אֶת־הַנְּעָרִ֖ים לְבִלְתִּ֣י נׇגְעֵ֑ךְ וְצָמִ֗ת וְהָלַכְתְּ֙ אֶל־הַכֵּלִ֔ים וְשָׁתִ֕ית מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׁאֲב֖וּן הַנְּעָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'ynykh bshdh 'shryqtsrvn vhlkht 'chryhn hlv' tsvyty 'thn'rym lblty ng'kh vtsmt vhlkht 'lhkhlym vshtyt m'shr ysh'bvn hn'rym
verses.translation: Let thine eyes be on the field that they do reap, and go thou after them; have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee? and when thou art athirst, go unto the vessels, and drink of that which the young men have drawn.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּפֹּל֙ עַל־פָּנֶ֔יהָ וַתִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ אָ֑רְצָה וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו מַדּ֩וּעַ֩ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּעֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ לְהַכִּירֵ֔נִי וְאָנֹכִ֖י נׇכְרִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vtpl 'lpnyh vtshtchv 'rtsh vt'mr 'lyv mdv' mts'ty chn b'ynykh lhkhyrny v'nkhy nkhryh
verses.translation: Then she fell on her face, and bowed down to the ground, and said unto him: ‘Why have I found favour in thy sight, that thou shouldest take cognizance of me, seeing I am a foreigner?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַן בֹּ֙עַז֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָ֔הּ הֻגֵּ֨ד הֻגַּ֜ד לִ֗י כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂית֙ אֶת־חֲמוֹתֵ֔ךְ אַחֲרֵ֖י מ֣וֹת אִישֵׁ֑ךְ וַתַּעַזְבִ֞י אָבִ֣יךְ וְאִמֵּ֗ךְ וְאֶ֙רֶץ֙ מֽוֹלַדְתֵּ֔ךְ וַתֵּ֣לְכִ֔י אֶל־עַ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יָדַ֖עַתְּ תְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃
verses.translit: vy'n b'z vy'mr lh hgd hgd ly khl 'shr'shyt 'tchmvtkh 'chry mvt 'yshkh vt'zby 'bykh v'mkh v'rts mvldtkh vtlkhy 'l'm 'shr l'yd't tmvl shlshvm
verses.translation: And Boaz answered and said unto her: ‘It hath fully been told me, all that thou hast done unto thy mother-in-law since the death of thy husband; and how thou hast left thy father and thy mother, and the land of thy nativity, and art come unto a people that thou knewest not heretofore.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְשַׁלֵּ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה פׇּעֳלֵ֑ךְ וּתְהִ֨י מַשְׂכֻּרְתֵּ֜ךְ שְׁלֵמָ֗ה מֵעִ֤ם יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֖את לַחֲס֥וֹת תַּחַת־כְּנָפָֽיו׃
verses.translit: yshlm yhvh p'lkh vthy mshkhrtkh shlmh m'm yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'shrb't lchsvt tchtkhnpyv
verses.translation: The LORD recompense thy work, and be thy reward complete from the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings thou art come to take refuge.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠תֹּ֠אמֶר אֶמְצָא־חֵ֨ן בְּעֵינֶ֤יךָ אֲדֹנִי֙ כִּ֣י נִֽחַמְתָּ֔נִי וְכִ֥י דִבַּ֖רְתָּ עַל־לֵ֣ב שִׁפְחָתֶ֑ךָ וְאָֽנֹכִי֙ לֹ֣א אֶהְיֶ֔ה כְּאַחַ֖ת שִׁפְחֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vt'mr 'mts'chn b'ynykh 'dny khy nchmtny vkhy dbrt 'llb shpchtkh v'nkhy l' 'hyh kh'cht shpchtykh
verses.translation: Then she said: ‘Let me find favour in thy sight, my LORD; for that thou hast comforted me, and for that thou hast spoken to the heart of thy handmaid, though I be not as one of thy handmaidens.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ לָ֨הֿ בֹ֜עַז לְעֵ֣ת הָאֹ֗כֶל גֹּ֤שִֽׁי הֲלֹם֙ וְאָכַ֣לְתְּ מִן־הַלֶּ֔חֶם וְטָבַ֥לְתְּ פִּתֵּ֖ךְ בַּחֹ֑מֶץ וַתֵּ֙שֶׁב֙ מִצַּ֣ד הַקֹּצְרִ֔ים וַיִּצְבׇּט־לָ֣הּ קָלִ֔י וַתֹּ֥אכַל וַתִּשְׂבַּ֖ע וַתֹּתַֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lh b'z l't h'khl gshy hlm v'khlt mnhlchm vtblt ptkh bchmts vtshb mtsd hqtsrym vytsbtlh qly vt'khl vtshb' vttr
verses.translation: And Boaz said unto her at meal-time: ‘Come hither, and eat of the bread, and dip thy morsel in the vinegar.’ And she sat beside the reapers; and they reached her parched corn, and she did eat and was satisfied, and left thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּ֖קׇם לְלַקֵּ֑ט וַיְצַו֩ בֹּ֨עַז אֶת־נְעָרָ֜יו לֵאמֹ֗ר גַּ֣ם בֵּ֧ין הָעֳמָרִ֛ים תְּלַקֵּ֖ט וְלֹ֥א תַכְלִימֽוּהָ׃
verses.translit: vtqm llqt vytsv b'z 'tn'ryv l'mr gm byn h'mrym tlqt vl' tkhlymvh
verses.translation: And when she was risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying: ‘Let her glean even among the sheaves, and put her not to shame.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֛ם שֹׁל־תָּשֹׁ֥לּוּ לָ֖הּ מִן־הַצְּבָתִ֑ים וַעֲזַבְתֶּ֥ם וְלִקְּטָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תִגְעֲרוּ־בָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vgm shltshlv lh mnhtsbtym v'zbtm vlqth vl' tg'rvbh
verses.translation: And also pull out some for her of purpose from the bundles, and leave it, and let her glean, and rebuke her not.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּלַקֵּ֥ט בַּשָּׂדֶ֖ה עַד־הָעָ֑רֶב וַתַּחְבֹּט֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־לִקֵּ֔טָה וַיְהִ֖י כְּאֵיפָ֥ה שְׂעֹרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vtlqt bshdh 'dh'rb vtchbt 't 'shrlqth vyhy kh'yph sh'rym
verses.translation: So she gleaned in the field until even; and she beat out that which she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּשָּׂא֙ וַתָּב֣וֹא הָעִ֔יר וַתֵּ֥רֶא חֲמוֹתָ֖הּ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־לִקֵּ֑טָה וַתּוֹצֵא֙ וַתִּתֶּן־לָ֔הּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־הוֹתִ֖רָה מִשׇּׂבְעָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vtsh' vtbv' h'yr vtr' chmvth 't 'shrlqth vtvts' vttnlh 't 'shrhvtrh mshb'h
verses.translation: And she took it up, and went into the city; and her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned; and she brought forth and gave to her that which she had left after she was satisfied.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֩אמֶר֩ לָ֨הּ חֲמוֹתָ֜הּ אֵיפֹ֨ה לִקַּ֤טְתְּ הַיּוֹם֙ וְאָ֣נָה עָשִׂ֔ית יְהִ֥י מַכִּירֵ֖ךְ בָּר֑וּךְ וַתַּגֵּ֣ד לַחֲמוֹתָ֗הּ אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר־עָֽשְׂתָה֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר שֵׁ֤ם הָאִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשִׂ֧יתִי עִמּ֛וֹ הַיּ֖וֹם בֹּֽעַז׃
verses.translit: vt'mr lh chmvth 'yph lqtt hyvm v'nh 'shyt yhy mkhyrkh brvkh vtgd lchmvth 't 'shr'shth 'mv vt'mr shm h'ysh 'shr 'shyty 'mv hyvm b'z
verses.translation: And her mother-in-law said unto her: ‘Where hast thou gleaned to-day? and where wroughtest thou? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee.’ And she told her mother-in-law with whom she had wrought, and said: ‘The man’s name with whom I wrought to-day is Boaz.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר נׇעֳמִ֜י לְכַלָּתָ֗הּ בָּר֥וּךְ הוּא֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹא־עָזַ֣ב חַסְדּ֔וֹ אֶת־הַחַיִּ֖ים וְאֶת־הַמֵּתִ֑ים וַתֹּ֧אמֶר לָ֣הּ נׇעֳמִ֗י קָר֥וֹב לָ֙נוּ֙ הָאִ֔ישׁ מִֽגֹּאֲלֵ֖נוּ הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vt'mr n'my lkhlth brvkh hv' lyhvh 'shr l''zb chsdv 'thchyym v'thmtym vt'mr lh n'my qrvb lnv h'ysh mg'lnv hv'
verses.translation: And Naomi said unto her daughter-in-law: ‘Blessed be he of the LORD, who hath not left off His kindness to the living and to the dead.’ And Naomi said unto her: ‘The man is nigh of kin unto us, one of our near kinsmen.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֖אמֶר ר֣וּת הַמּוֹאֲבִיָּ֑ה גַּ֣ם  כִּי־אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֗י עִם־הַנְּעָרִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר־לִי֙ תִּדְבָּקִ֔ין עַ֣ד אִם־כִּלּ֔וּ אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַקָּצִ֖יר אֲשֶׁר־לִֽי׃
verses.translit: vt'mr rvt hmv'byh gm  khy'mr 'ly 'mhn'rym 'shrly tdbqyn 'd 'mkhlv 't khlhqtsyr 'shrly
verses.translation: And Ruth the Moabitess said: ‘Yea, he said unto me: Thou shalt keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֥אמֶר נׇעֳמִ֖י אֶל־ר֣וּת כַּלָּתָ֑הּ ט֣וֹב בִּתִּ֗י כִּ֤י תֵצְאִי֙ עִם־נַ֣עֲרוֹתָ֔יו וְלֹ֥א יִפְגְּעוּ־בָ֖ךְ בְּשָׂדֶ֥ה אַחֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vt'mr n'my 'lrvt khlth tvb bty khy tts'y 'mn'rvtyv vl' ypg'vbkh bshdh 'chr
verses.translation: And Naomi said unto Ruth her daughter-in-law: ‘It is good, my daughter, that thou go out with his maidens, and that thou be not met in any other field.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּדְבַּ֞ק בְּנַעֲר֥וֹת בֹּ֙עַז֙ לְלַקֵּ֔ט עַד־כְּל֥וֹת קְצִֽיר־הַשְּׂעֹרִ֖ים וּקְצִ֣יר הַחִטִּ֑ים וַתֵּ֖שֶׁב אֶת־חֲמוֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vtdbq bn'rvt b'z llqt 'dkhlvt qtsyrhsh'rym vqtsyr hchtym vtshb 'tchmvth
verses.translation: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and she dwelt with her mother-in-law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֥אמֶר לָ֖הּ נׇעֳמִ֣י חֲמוֹתָ֑הּ בִּתִּ֕י הֲלֹ֧א אֲבַקֶּשׁ־לָ֛ךְ מָנ֖וֹחַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִֽיטַב־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vt'mr lh n'my chmvth bty hl' 'bqshlkh mnvch 'shr yytblkh
verses.translation: And Naomi her mother-in-law said unto her: ‘My daughter, shall I not seek rest for thee, that it may be well with thee?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הֲלֹ֥א בֹ֙עַז֙ מֹֽדַעְתָּ֔נוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיִ֖ית אֶת־נַעֲרוֹתָ֑יו הִנֵּה־ה֗וּא זֹרֶ֛ה אֶת־גֹּ֥רֶן הַשְּׂעֹרִ֖ים הַלָּֽיְלָה׃
verses.translit: v'th hl' b'z md'tnv 'shr hyyt 'tn'rvtyv hnhhv' zrh 'tgrn hsh'rym hlylh
verses.translation: And now is there not Boaz our kinsman, with whose maidens thou wast? Behold, he winnoweth barley to-night in the threshing-floor.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָחַ֣צְתְּ  וָסַ֗כְתְּ וְשַׂ֧מְתְּ (שמלתך) [שִׂמְלֹתַ֛יִךְ] עָלַ֖יִךְ (וירדתי) [וְיָרַ֣דְתְּ] הַגֹּ֑רֶן אַל־תִּוָּדְעִ֣י לָאִ֔ישׁ עַ֥ד כַּלֹּת֖וֹ לֶאֱכֹ֥ל וְלִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vrchtst  vskht vshmt (shmltkh) [shmltykh] 'lykh (vyrdty) [vyrdt] hgrn 'ltvd'y l'ysh 'd khltv l'khl vlshtvt
verses.translation: Wash thyself therefore, and anoint thee, and put thy raiment upon thee, and get thee down to the threshing-floor; but make not thyself known unto the man, until he shall have done eating and drinking.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיהִ֣י בְשׇׁכְב֗וֹ וְיָדַ֙עַתְּ֙ אֶת־הַמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁכַּב־שָׁ֔ם וּבָ֛את וְגִלִּ֥ית מַרְגְּלֹתָ֖יו (ושכבתי) [וְשָׁכָ֑בְתְּ] וְהוּא֙ יַגִּ֣יד לָ֔ךְ אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשִֽׂין׃
verses.translit: vyhy bshkhbv vyd't 'thmqvm 'shr yshkhbshm vb't vglyt mrgltyv (vshkhbty) [vshkhbt] vhv' ygyd lkh 't 'shr t'shyn
verses.translation: And it shall be, when he lieth down, that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie, and thou shalt go in, and uncover his feet, and lay thee down; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלֶ֑יהָ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאמְרִ֥י [אֵלַ֖י] אֶעֱשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lyh khl 'shrt'mry ['ly] ''shh
verses.translation: And she said unto her: ‘All that thou sayest unto me I will do.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֖רֶד הַגֹּ֑רֶן וַתַּ֕עַשׂ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוַּ֖תָּה חֲמוֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vtrd hgrn vt'sh khkhl 'shrtsvth chmvth
verses.translation: And she went down unto the threshing-floor, and did according to all that her mother-in-law bade her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אכַל בֹּ֤עַז וַיֵּשְׁתְּ֙ וַיִּיטַ֣ב לִבּ֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֕א לִשְׁכַּ֖ב בִּקְצֵ֣ה הָעֲרֵמָ֑ה וַתָּבֹ֣א בַלָּ֔ט וַתְּגַ֥ל מַרְגְּלֹתָ֖יו וַתִּשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.translit: vy'khl b'z vysht vyytb lbv vyb' lshkhb bqtsh h'rmh vtb' blt vtgl mrgltyv vtshkhb
verses.translation: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn; and she came softly, and uncovered his feet, and laid her down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בַּחֲצִ֣י הַלַּ֔יְלָה וַיֶּחֱרַ֥ד הָאִ֖ישׁ וַיִּלָּפֵ֑ת וְהִנֵּ֣ה אִשָּׁ֔ה שֹׁכֶ֖בֶת מַרְגְּלֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyhy bchtsy hlylh vychrd h'ysh vylpt vhnh 'shh shkhbt mrgltyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass at midnight, that the man was startled, and turned himself; and, behold, a woman lay at his feet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מִי־אָ֑תְּ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר אָֽנֹכִי֙ ר֣וּת אֲמָתֶ֔ךָ וּפָרַשְׂתָּ֤ כְנָפֶ֙ךָ֙ עַל־אֲמָ֣תְךָ֔ כִּ֥י גֹאֵ֖ל אָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr my't vt'mr 'nkhy rvt 'mtkh vprsht khnpkh 'l'mtkh khy g'l 'th
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Who art thou?’ And she answered: ‘I am Ruth thine handmaid; spread therefore thy skirt over thy handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר בְּרוּכָ֨ה אַ֤תְּ לַֽיהֹוָה֙ בִּתִּ֔י הֵיטַ֛בְתְּ חַסְדֵּ֥ךְ הָאַחֲר֖וֹן מִן־הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן לְבִלְתִּי־לֶ֗כֶת אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הַבַּ֣חוּרִ֔ים אִם־דַּ֖ל וְאִם־עָשִֽׁיר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr brvkhh 't lyhvh bty hytbt chsdkh h'chrvn mnhr'shvn lbltylkht 'chry hbchvrym 'mdl v'm'shyr
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Blessed be thou of the LORD, my daughter; thou hast shown more kindness in the end than at the beginning, inasmuch as thou didst not follow the young men, whether poor or rich.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה בִּתִּי֙ אַל־תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאמְרִ֖י אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּ֑ךְ כִּ֤י יוֹדֵ֙עַ֙ כׇּל־שַׁ֣עַר עַמִּ֔י כִּ֛י אֵ֥שֶׁת חַ֖יִל אָֽתְּ׃
verses.translit: v'th bty 'ltyr'y khl 'shrt'mry ''shhlkh khy yvd' khlsh'r 'my khy 'sht chyl 't
verses.translation: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou sayest; for all the men in the gate of my people do know that thou art a virtuous woman.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ כִּ֣י אׇמְנָ֔ם כִּ֥י (אם) גֹאֵ֖ל אָנֹ֑כִי וְגַ֛ם יֵ֥שׁ גֹּאֵ֖ל קָר֥וֹב מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: v'th khy 'mnm khy ('m) g'l 'nkhy vgm ysh g'l qrvb mmny
verses.translation: And now it is true that I am a near kinsman; howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִ֣י הַלַּ֗יְלָה וְהָיָ֤ה בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ אִם־יִגְאָלֵ֥ךְ טוֹב֙ יִגְאָ֔ל וְאִם־לֹ֨א יַחְפֹּ֧ץ לְגׇאֳלֵ֛ךְ וּגְאַלְתִּ֥יךְ אָנֹ֖כִי חַי־יְהֹוָ֑ה שִׁכְבִ֖י עַד־הַבֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.translit: ly hlylh vhyh bbqr 'myg'lkh tvb yg'l v'ml' ychpts lg'lkh vg'ltykh 'nkhy chyyhvh shkhby 'dhbqr
verses.translation: Tarry this night, and it shall be in the morning, that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman, well; let him do the kinsman’s part; but if he be not willing to do the part of a kinsman to thee, then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee, as the LORD liveth; lie down until the morning.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּשְׁכַּ֤ב מַרְגְּלוֹתָו֙ עַד־הַבֹּ֔קֶר וַתָּ֕קׇם (בטרום) [בְּטֶ֛רֶם] יַכִּ֥יר אִ֖ישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אַל־יִוָּדַ֔ע כִּי־בָ֥אָה הָאִשָּׁ֖ה הַגֹּֽרֶן׃
verses.translit: vtshkhb mrglvtv 'dhbqr vtqm (btrvm) [btrm] ykhyr 'ysh 'tr'hv vy'mr 'lyvd' khyb'h h'shh hgrn
verses.translation: And she lay at his feet until the morning; and she rose up before one could discern another. For he said: ‘Let it not be known that the woman came to the threshing-floor.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הָ֠בִ֠י הַמִּטְפַּ֧חַת אֲשֶׁר־עָלַ֛יִךְ וְאֶחֳזִי־בָ֖הּ וַתֹּ֣אחֶז בָּ֑הּ וַיָּ֤מׇד שֵׁשׁ־שְׂעֹרִים֙ וַיָּ֣שֶׁת עָלֶ֔יהָ וַיָּבֹ֖א הָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr hby hmtpcht 'shr'lykh v'chzybh vt'chz bh vymd shshsh'rym vysht 'lyh vyb' h'yr
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Bring the mantle that is upon thee, and hold it’; and she held it; and he measured six measures of barley, and laid it on her; and he went into the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּבוֹא֙ אֶל־חֲמוֹתָ֔הּ וַתֹּ֖אמֶר מִי־אַ֣תְּ בִּתִּ֑י וַתַּ֨גֶּד־לָ֔הּ אֵ֛ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂה־לָ֖הּ הָאִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: vtbv' 'lchmvth vt'mr my't bty vtgdlh 't khl'shr 'shhlh h'ysh
verses.translation: And when she came to her mother-in-law, she said: ‘Who art thou, my daughter?’ And she told her all that the man had done to her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֕אמֶר שֵׁשׁ־הַשְּׂעֹרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה נָ֣תַן לִ֑י כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר [אֵלַ֔י] אַל־תָּב֥וֹאִי רֵיקָ֖ם אֶל־חֲמוֹתֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vt'mr shshhsh'rym h'lh ntn ly khy 'mr ['ly] 'ltbv'y ryqm 'lchmvtkh
verses.translation: And she said: ‘These six measures of barley gave he me; for he said to me: Go not empty unto thy mother-in-law.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ שְׁבִ֣י בִתִּ֔י עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽדְעִ֔ין אֵ֖יךְ יִפֹּ֣ל דָּבָ֑ר כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יִשְׁקֹט֙ הָאִ֔ישׁ כִּֽי־אִם־כִּלָּ֥ה הַדָּבָ֖ר הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vt'mr shby bty 'd 'shr td'yn 'ykh ypl dbr khy l' yshqt h'ysh khy'mkhlh hdbr hyvm
verses.translation: Then said she: ‘Sit still, my daughter, until thou know how the matter will fall; for the man will not rest, until he have finished the thing this day.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֹ֨עַז עָלָ֣ה הַשַּׁ֘עַר֮ וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב שָׁם֒ וְהִנֵּ֨ה הַגֹּאֵ֤ל עֹבֵר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר־בֹּ֔עַז וַיֹּ֛אמֶר ס֥וּרָה שְׁבָה־פֹּ֖ה פְּלֹנִ֣י אַלְמֹנִ֑י וַיָּ֖סַר וַיֵּשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: vb'z 'lh hsh'r vyshb shm vhnh hg'l 'br 'shr dbrb'z vy'mr svrh shbhph plny 'lmny vysr vyshb
verses.translation: Now Boaz went up to the gate, and sat him down there; and, behold, the near kinsman of whom Boaz spoke came by; unto whom he said: ‘Ho, such a one! turn aside, sit down here.’ And he turned aside, and sat down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח עֲשָׂרָ֧ה אֲנָשִׁ֛ים מִזִּקְנֵ֥י הָעִ֖יר וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁבוּ־פֹ֑ה וַיֵּשֵֽׁבוּ׃
verses.translit: vyqch 'shrh 'nshym mzqny h'yr vy'mr shbvph vyshbv
verses.translation: And he took ten men of the elders of the city, and said: ‘Sit ye down here.’ And they sat down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לַגֹּאֵ֔ל חֶלְקַת֙ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְאָחִ֖ינוּ לֶאֱלִימֶ֑לֶךְ מָכְרָ֣ה נׇעֳמִ֔י הַשָּׁ֖בָה מִשְּׂדֵ֥ה מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lg'l chlqt hshdh 'shr l'chynv l'lymlkh mkhrh n'my hshbh mshdh mv'b
verses.translation: And he said unto the near kinsman: ‘Naomi, that is come back out of the field of Moab, selleth the parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech’s;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֨י אָמַ֜רְתִּי אֶגְלֶ֧ה אׇזְנְךָ֣ לֵאמֹ֗ר קְ֠נֵ֠ה נֶ֥גֶד הַיֹּשְׁבִים֮ וְנֶ֣גֶד זִקְנֵ֣י עַמִּי֒ אִם־תִּגְאַל֙ גְּאָ֔ל וְאִם־לֹ֨א יִגְאַ֜ל הַגִּ֣ידָה לִּ֗י (ואדע) [וְאֵֽדְעָה֙] כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין זוּלָֽתְךָ֙ לִגְא֔וֹל וְאָנֹכִ֖י אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אָנֹכִ֥י אֶגְאָֽל׃
verses.translit: v'ny 'mrty 'glh 'znkh l'mr qnh ngd hyshbym vngd zqny 'my 'mtg'l g'l v'ml' yg'l hgydh ly (v'd') [v'd'h] khy 'yn zvltkh lg'vl v'nkhy 'chrykh vy'mr 'nkhy 'g'l
verses.translation: and I thought to disclose it unto thee, saying: Buy it before them that sit here, and before the elders of my people. If thou wilt redeem it, redeem it; but if it will not be redeemed, then tell me, that I may know; for there is none to redeem it beside thee; and I am after thee.’ And he said: ‘I will redeem it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר בֹּ֔עַז בְּיוֹם־קְנוֹתְךָ֥ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה מִיַּ֣ד נׇעֳמִ֑י וּ֠מֵאֵ֠ת ר֣וּת הַמּוֹאֲבִיָּ֤ה אֵֽשֶׁת־הַמֵּת֙ (קניתי) [קָנִ֔יתָ] לְהָקִ֥ים שֵׁם־הַמֵּ֖ת עַל־נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr b'z byvmqnvtkh hshdh myd n'my vm't rvt hmv'byh 'shthmt (qnyty) [qnyt] lhqym shmhmt 'lnchltv
verses.translation: Then said Boaz: ‘What day thou buyest the field of the hand of Naomi—hast thou also bought of Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַגֹּאֵ֗ל לֹ֤א אוּכַל֙ (לגאול) [לִגְאׇל־]לִ֔י פֶּן־אַשְׁחִ֖ית אֶת־נַחֲלָתִ֑י גְּאַל־לְךָ֤ אַתָּה֙ אֶת־גְּאֻלָּתִ֔י כִּ֥י לֹא־אוּכַ֖ל לִגְאֹֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mr hg'l l' 'vkhl (lg'vl) [lg'l]ly pn'shchyt 'tnchlty g'llkh 'th 'tg'lty khy l''vkhl lg'l
verses.translation: And the near kinsman said: ‘I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I mar mine own inheritance; take thou my right of redemption on thee; for I cannot redeem it.’—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֹאת֩ לְפָנִ֨ים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל עַל־הַגְּאֻלָּ֤ה וְעַל־הַתְּמוּרָה֙ לְקַיֵּ֣ם כׇּל־דָּבָ֔ר שָׁלַ֥ף אִ֛ישׁ נַעֲל֖וֹ וְנָתַ֣ן לְרֵעֵ֑הוּ וְזֹ֥את הַתְּעוּדָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vz't lpnym byshr'l 'lhg'lh v'lhtmvrh lqym khldbr shlf 'ysh n'lv vntn lr'hv vz't ht'vdh byshr'l
verses.translation: Now this was the custom in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning exchanging, to confirm all things: a man drew off his shoe, and gave it to his neighbour; and this was the attestation in Israel.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר הַגֹּאֵ֛ל לְבֹ֖עַז קְנֵה־לָ֑ךְ וַיִּשְׁלֹ֖ף נַעֲלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr hg'l lb'z qnhlkh vyshlf n'lv
verses.translation: So the near kinsman said unto Boaz: ‘Buy it for thyself.’ And he drew off his shoe.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ בֹּ֨עַז לַזְּקֵנִ֜ים וְכׇל־הָעָ֗ם עֵדִ֤ים אַתֶּם֙ הַיּ֔וֹם כִּ֤י קָנִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֶאֱלִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְאֵ֛ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְכִלְי֖וֹן וּמַחְל֑וֹן מִיַּ֖ד נׇעֳמִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr b'z lzqnym vkhlh'm 'dym 'tm hyvm khy qnyty 'tkhl'shr l'lymlkh v't khl'shr lkhlyvn vmchlvn myd n'my
verses.translation: And Boaz said unto the elders, and unto all the people: ‘Ye are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that was Elimelech’s, and all that was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, of the hand of Naomi.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם אֶת־ר֣וּת הַמֹּאֲבִיָּה֩ אֵ֨שֶׁת מַחְל֜וֹן קָנִ֧יתִי לִ֣י לְאִשָּׁ֗ה לְהָקִ֤ים שֵׁם־הַמֵּת֙ עַל־נַ֣חֲלָת֔וֹ וְלֹֽא־יִכָּרֵ֧ת שֵׁם־הַמֵּ֛ת מֵעִ֥ם אֶחָ֖יו וּמִשַּׁ֣עַר מְקוֹמ֑וֹ עֵדִ֥ים אַתֶּ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vgm 'trvt hm'byh 'sht mchlvn qnyty ly l'shh lhqym shmhmt 'lnchltv vl'ykhrt shmhmt m'm 'chyv vmsh'r mqvmv 'dym 'tm hyvm
verses.translation: Moreover Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I acquired to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, that the name of the dead be not cut off from among his brethren, and from the gate of his place; ye are witnesses this day.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ כׇּל־הָעָ֧ם אֲשֶׁר־בַּשַּׁ֛עַר וְהַזְּקֵנִ֖ים עֵדִ֑ים יִתֵּן֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֶֽת־הָאִשָּׁ֜ה הַבָּאָ֣ה אֶל־בֵּיתֶ֗ךָ כְּרָחֵ֤ל ׀ וּכְלֵאָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנ֤וּ שְׁתֵּיהֶם֙ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַעֲשֵׂה־חַ֣יִל בְּאֶפְרָ֔תָה וּקְרָא־שֵׁ֖ם בְּבֵ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv khlh'm 'shrbsh'r vhzqnym 'dym ytn yhvh 'th'shh hb'h 'lbytkh khrchl  vkhl'h 'shr bnv shtyhm 'tbyt yshr'l v'shhchyl b'prth vqr'shm bbyt lchm
verses.translation: And all the people that were in the gate, and the elders, said: ‘We are witnesses. The LORD make the woman that is come into thy house like Rachel and like Leah, which two did build the house of Israel; and do thou worthily in Ephrath, and be famous in Beth-lehem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיהִ֤י בֵֽיתְךָ֙ כְּבֵ֣ית פֶּ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יָלְדָ֥ה תָמָ֖ר לִיהוּדָ֑ה מִן־הַזֶּ֗רַע אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֤ן יְהֹוָה֙ לְךָ֔ מִן־הַֽנַּעֲרָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vyhy bytkh khbyt prts 'shryldh tmr lyhvdh mnhzr' 'shr ytn yhvh lkh mnhn'rh hz't
verses.translation: and let thy house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore unto Judah, of the seed which the LORD shall give thee of this young woman.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח בֹּ֤עַז אֶת־רוּת֙ וַתְּהִי־ל֣וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֖א אֵלֶ֑יהָ וַיִּתֵּ֨ן יְהֹוָ֥ה לָ֛הּ הֵרָי֖וֹן וַתֵּ֥לֶד בֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vyqch b'z 'trvt vthylv l'shh vyb' 'lyh vytn yhvh lh hryvn vtld bn
verses.translation: So Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife; and he went in unto her, and the LORD gave her conception, and she bore a son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּאמַ֤רְנָה הַנָּשִׁים֙ אֶֽל־נׇעֳמִ֔י בָּר֣וּךְ יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲ֠שֶׁ֠ר לֹ֣א הִשְׁבִּ֥ית לָ֛ךְ גֹּאֵ֖ל הַיּ֑וֹם וְיִקָּרֵ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vt'mrnh hnshym 'ln'my brvkh yhvh 'shr l' hshbyt lkh g'l hyvm vyqr' shmv byshr'l
verses.translation: And the women said unto Naomi: ‘Blessed be the LORD, who hath not left thee this day without a near kinsman, and let his name be famous in Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָ֤יָה לָךְ֙ לְמֵשִׁ֣יב נֶ֔פֶשׁ וּלְכַלְכֵּ֖ל אֶת־שֵׂיבָתֵ֑ךְ כִּ֣י כַלָּתֵ֤ךְ אֲֽשֶׁר־אֲהֵבַ֙תֶךְ֙ יְלָדַ֔תּוּ אֲשֶׁר־הִיא֙ ט֣וֹבָה לָ֔ךְ מִשִּׁבְעָ֖ה בָּנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhyh lkh lmshyb npsh vlkhlkhl 'tshybtkh khy khltkh 'shr'hbtkh yldtv 'shrhy' tvbh lkh mshb'h bnym
verses.translation: And he shall be unto thee a restorer of life, and a nourisher of thine old age; for thy daughter-in-law, who loveth thee, who is better to thee than seven sons, hath borne him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקַּ֨ח נׇעֳמִ֤י אֶת־הַיֶּ֙לֶד֙ וַתְּשִׁתֵ֣הוּ בְחֵיקָ֔הּ וַתְּהִי־ל֖וֹ לְאֹמֶֽנֶת׃
verses.translit: vtqch n'my 'thyld vtshthv bchyqh vthylv l'mnt
verses.translation: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקְרֶ֩אנָה֩ ל֨וֹ הַשְּׁכֵנ֥וֹת שֵׁם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יֻלַּד־בֵּ֖ן לְנׇעֳמִ֑י וַתִּקְרֶ֤אנָֽה שְׁמוֹ֙ עוֹבֵ֔ד ה֥וּא אֲבִֽי־יִשַׁ֖י אֲבִ֥י דָוִֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vtqr'nh lv hshkhnvt shm l'mr yldbn ln'my vtqr'nh shmv 'vbd hv' 'byyshy 'by dvd {p}
verses.translation: And the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying: ‘There is a son born to Naomi’; and they called his name Obed; he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ תּוֹלְד֣וֹת פָּ֔רֶץ פֶּ֖רֶץ הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־חֶצְרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: v'lh tvldvt prts prts hvlyd 'tchtsrvn
verses.translation: Now these are the generations of Perez: Perez begot Hezron;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחֶצְרוֹן֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־רָ֔ם וְרָ֖ם הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־עַמִּינָדָֽב׃
verses.translit: vchtsrvn hvlyd 'trm vrm hvlyd 't'myndb
verses.translation: and Hezron begot Ram, and Ram begot Amminadab;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַמִּֽינָדָב֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־נַחְשׁ֔וֹן וְנַחְשׁ֖וֹן הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־שַׂלְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'myndb hvlyd 'tnchshvn vnchshvn hvlyd 'tshlmh
verses.translation: and Amminadab begot Nahshon, and Nahshon begot Salmon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂלְמוֹן֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־בֹּ֔עַז וּבֹ֖עַז הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־עוֹבֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vshlmvn hvlyd 'tb'z vb'z hvlyd 't'vbd
verses.translation: and Salmon begot Boaz, and Boaz begot Obed;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֹבֵד֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יִשָׁ֔י וְיִשַׁ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־דָּוִֽד׃
verses.translit: v'bd hvlyd 'tyshy vyshy hvlyd 'tdvd
verses.translation: and Obed begot Jesse, and Jesse begot David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵיכָ֣ה  יָשְׁבָ֣ה בָדָ֗ד הָעִיר֙ רַבָּ֣תִי עָ֔ם הָיְתָ֖ה כְּאַלְמָנָ֑ה רַבָּ֣תִי בַגּוֹיִ֗ם שָׂרָ֙תִי֙ בַּמְּדִינ֔וֹת הָיְתָ֖ה לָמַֽס׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'ykhh  yshbh bdd h'yr rbty 'm hyth kh'lmnh rbty bgvym shrty bmdynvt hyth lms {s}
verses.translation: How doth the city sit solitary, That was full of people! How is she become as a widow! She that was great among the nations, And princess among the provinces, How is she become tributary!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּכ֨וֹ תִבְכֶּ֜ה בַּלַּ֗יְלָה וְדִמְעָתָהּ֙ עַ֣ל לֶֽחֱיָ֔הּ אֵֽין־לָ֥הּ מְנַחֵ֖ם מִכׇּל־אֹהֲבֶ֑יהָ כׇּל־רֵעֶ֙יהָ֙ בָּ֣גְדוּ בָ֔הּ הָ֥יוּ לָ֖הּ לְאֹיְבִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bkhv tbkhh blylh vdm'th 'l lchyh 'ynlh mnchm mkhl'hbyh khlr'yh bgdv bh hyv lh l'ybym {s}
verses.translation: She weepeth sore in the night, And her tears are on her cheeks; She hath none to comfort her Among all her lovers; All her friends have dealt treacherously with her, They are become her enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גָּֽלְתָ֨ה יְהוּדָ֤ה מֵעֹ֙נִי֙ וּמֵרֹ֣ב עֲבֹדָ֔ה הִ֚יא יָשְׁבָ֣ה בַגּוֹיִ֔ם לֹ֥א מָצְאָ֖ה מָנ֑וֹחַ כׇּל־רֹדְפֶ֥יהָ הִשִּׂיג֖וּהָ בֵּ֥ין הַמְּצָרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: glth yhvdh m'ny vmrb 'bdh hy' yshbh bgvym l' mts'h mnvch khlrdpyh hshygvh byn hmtsrym {s}
verses.translation: Judah is gone into exile because of affliction, And because of great servitude; She dwelleth among the nations, She findeth no rest; All her pursuers overtook her within the straits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּרְכֵ֨י צִיּ֜וֹן אֲבֵל֗וֹת מִבְּלִי֙ בָּאֵ֣י מוֹעֵ֔ד כׇּל־שְׁעָרֶ֙יהָ֙ שֽׁוֹמֵמִ֔ין כֹּהֲנֶ֖יהָ נֶאֱנָחִ֑ים בְּתוּלֹתֶ֥יהָ נּוּג֖וֹת וְהִ֥יא מַר־לָֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: drkhy tsyvn 'blvt mbly b'y mv'd khlsh'ryh shvmmyn khhnyh n'nchym btvltyh nvgvt vhy' mrlh {s}
verses.translation: The ways of Zion do mourn, Because none come to the solemn assembly; All her gates are desolate, Her priests sigh; Her virgins are afflicted, And she herself is in bitterness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָי֨וּ צָרֶ֤יהָ לְרֹאשׁ֙ אֹיְבֶ֣יהָ שָׁל֔וּ כִּֽי־יְהֹוָ֥ה הוֹגָ֖הּ עַ֣ל רֹב־פְּשָׁעֶ֑יהָ עוֹלָלֶ֛יהָ הָלְכ֥וּ שְׁבִ֖י לִפְנֵי־צָֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hyv tsryh lr'sh 'ybyh shlv khyyhvh hvgh 'l rbpsh'yh 'vllyh hlkhv shby lpnytsr {s}
verses.translation: Her adversaries are become the head, Her enemies are at ease; For the LORD hath afflicted her For the multitude of her transgressions; Her young children are gone into captivity Before the adversary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א (מן בת) [מִבַּת־]צִיּ֖וֹן כׇּל־הֲדָרָ֑הּ הָי֣וּ שָׂרֶ֗יהָ כְּאַיָּלִים֙ לֹא־מָצְא֣וּ מִרְעֶ֔ה וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ בְלֹא־כֹ֖חַ לִפְנֵ֥י רוֹדֵֽף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyts' (mn bt) [mbt]tsyvn khlhdrh hyv shryh kh'ylym l'mts'v mr'h vylkhv bl'khch lpny rvdf {s}
verses.translation: And gone is from the daughter of Zion All her splendour; Her princes are become like harts That find no pasture, And they are gone without strength Before the pursuer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָֽכְרָ֣ה יְרוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם יְמֵ֤י עׇנְיָהּ֙ וּמְרוּדֶ֔יהָ כֹּ֚ל מַחֲמֻדֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ מִ֣ימֵי קֶ֑דֶם בִּנְפֹ֧ל עַמָּ֣הּ בְּיַד־צָ֗ר וְאֵ֤ין עוֹזֵר֙ לָ֔הּ רָא֣וּהָ צָרִ֔ים שָׂחֲק֖וּ עַ֥ל מִשְׁבַּתֶּֽהָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: zkhrh yrvshl͏m ymy 'nyh vmrvdyh khl mchmdyh 'shr hyv mymy qdm bnpl 'mh bydtsr v'yn 'vzr lh r'vh tsrym shchqv 'l mshbth {s}
verses.translation: Jerusalem remembereth In the days of her affliction and of her anguish All her treasures that she had From the days of old; Now that her people fall by the hand of the adversary, And none doth help her, The adversaries have seen her, They have mocked at her desolations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֵ֤טְא חָֽטְאָה֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם עַל־כֵּ֖ן לְנִידָ֣ה הָיָ֑תָה כׇּֽל־מְכַבְּדֶ֤יהָ הִזִּיל֙וּהָ֙ כִּי־רָא֣וּ עֶרְוָתָ֔הּ גַּם־הִ֥יא נֶאֶנְחָ֖ה וַתָּ֥שׇׁב אָחֽוֹר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: cht' cht'h yrvshl͏m 'lkhn lnydh hyth khlmkhbdyh hzylvh khyr'v 'rvth gmhy' n'nchh vtshb 'chvr {s}
verses.translation: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned, Therefore she is become as one unclean; All that honoured her despise her, Because they have seen her nakedness; She herself also sigheth, And turneth backward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טֻמְאָתָ֣הּ בְּשׁוּלֶ֗יהָ לֹ֤א זָֽכְרָה֙ אַחֲרִיתָ֔הּ וַתֵּ֣רֶד פְּלָאִ֔ים אֵ֥ין מְנַחֵ֖ם לָ֑הּ רְאֵ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־עׇנְיִ֔י כִּ֥י הִגְדִּ֖יל אוֹיֵֽב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tm'th bshvlyh l' zkhrh 'chryth vtrd pl'ym 'yn mnchm lh r'h yhvh 't'nyy khy hgdyl 'vyb {s}
verses.translation: Her filthiness was in her skirts, She was not mindful of her end; Therefore is she come down wonderfully, She hath no comforter. ‘Behold, O LORD, My affliction, For the enemy hath magnified himself.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָדוֹ֙ פָּ֣רַשׂ צָ֔ר עַ֖ל כׇּל־מַחֲמַדֶּ֑יהָ כִּֽי־רָאֲתָ֤ה גוֹיִם֙ בָּ֣אוּ מִקְדָּשָׁ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּ֔יתָה לֹא־יָבֹ֥אוּ בַקָּהָ֖ל לָֽךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ydv prsh tsr 'l khlmchmdyh khyr'th gvym b'v mqdshh 'shr tsvyth l'yb'v bqhl lkh {s}
verses.translation: The adversary hath spread out his hand Upon all her treasures; For she hath seen that the heathen Are entered into her sanctuary, Concerning whom Thou didst command That they should not enter into Thy congregation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־עַמָּ֤הּ נֶאֱנָחִים֙ מְבַקְשִׁ֣ים לֶ֔חֶם נָתְנ֧וּ (מחמודיהם) [מַחֲמַדֵּיהֶ֛ם] בְּאֹ֖כֶל לְהָשִׁ֣יב נָ֑פֶשׁ רְאֵ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ וְֽהַבִּ֔יטָה כִּ֥י הָיִ֖יתִי זוֹלֵלָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khl'mh n'nchym mbqshym lchm ntnv (mchmvdyhm) [mchmdyhm] b'khl lhshyb npsh r'h yhvh vhbyth khy hyyty zvllh {s}
verses.translation: All her people sigh, They seek bread; They have given their pleasant things for food To refresh the soul. ‘See, O LORD, And behold, How abject I am become.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ל֣וֹא אֲלֵיכֶם֮ כׇּל־עֹ֣בְרֵי דֶ֒רֶךְ֒ הַבִּ֣יטוּ וּרְא֔וּ אִם־יֵ֤שׁ מַכְאוֹב֙ כְּמַכְאֹבִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר עוֹלַ֖ל לִ֑י אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹגָ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּי֖וֹם חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lv' 'lykhm khl'bry drkh hbytv vr'v 'mysh mkh'vb khmkh'by 'shr 'vll ly 'shr hvgh yhvh byvm chrvn 'pv {s}
verses.translation: Let it not come unto you, All ye that pass by! Behold, And see If there be any pain like unto my pain, Which is done unto me, Wherewith the LORD hath afflicted me In the day of His fierce anger.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִמָּר֛וֹם שָֽׁלַח־אֵ֥שׁ בְּעַצְמֹתַ֖י וַיִּרְדֶּ֑נָּה פָּרַ֨שׂ רֶ֤שֶׁת לְרַגְלַי֙ הֱשִׁיבַ֣נִי אָח֔וֹר נְתָנַ֙נִי֙ שֹֽׁמֵמָ֔ה כׇּל־הַיּ֖וֹם דָּוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mmrvm shlch'sh b'tsmty vyrdnh prsh rsht lrgly hshybny 'chvr ntnny shmmh khlhyvm dvh {s}
verses.translation: From on high hath He sent fire into my bones, And it prevaileth against them; He hath spread a net for my feet, He hath turned me back; He hath made me desolate And faint all the day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׂקַד֩ עֹ֨ל פְּשָׁעַ֜י בְּיָד֗וֹ יִשְׂתָּ֥רְג֛וּ עָל֥וּ עַל־צַוָּארִ֖י הִכְשִׁ֣יל כֹּחִ֑י נְתָנַ֣נִי אֲדֹנָ֔י בִּידֵ֖י לֹא־אוּכַ֥ל קֽוּם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: nshqd 'l psh'y bydv yshtrgv 'lv 'ltsv'ry hkhshyl khchy ntnny 'dny bydy l''vkhl qvm {s}
verses.translation: The yoke of my transgressions is impressed by His hand; They are knit together, They are come up upon my neck; He hath made my strength to fail; The Lord hath delivered me into their hands, Against whom I am not able to stand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סִלָּ֨ה כׇל־אַבִּירַ֤י ׀ אֲדֹנָי֙ בְּקִרְבִּ֔י קָרָ֥א עָלַ֛י מוֹעֵ֖ד לִשְׁבֹּ֣ר בַּחוּרָ֑י גַּ֚ת דָּרַ֣ךְ אֲדֹנָ֔י לִבְתוּלַ֖ת בַּת־יְהוּדָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: slh khl'byry  'dny bqrby qr' 'ly mv'd lshbr bchvry gt drkh 'dny lbtvlt btyhvdh {s}
verses.translation: The Lord hath set at nought All my mighty men in the midst of me; He hath called a solemn assembly against me To crush my young men; The Lord hath trodden as in a winepress The virgin the daughter of Judah.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־אֵ֣לֶּה  אֲנִ֣י בוֹכִיָּ֗ה עֵינִ֤י ׀ עֵינִי֙ יֹ֣רְדָה מַּ֔יִם כִּֽי־רָחַ֥ק מִמֶּ֛נִּי מְנַחֵ֖ם מֵשִׁ֣יב נַפְשִׁ֑י הָי֤וּ בָנַי֙ שֽׁוֹמֵמִ֔ים כִּ֥י גָבַ֖ר אוֹיֵֽב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'l'lh  'ny bvkhyh 'yny  'yny yrdh mym khyrchq mmny mnchm mshyb npshy hyv bny shvmmym khy gbr 'vyb {s}
verses.translation: For these things I weep; Mine eye, Mine eye runneth down with water; Because the comforter is far from me, Even he that should refresh my soul; My children are desolate, Because the enemy hath prevailed.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֵּֽרְשָׂ֨ה צִיּ֜וֹן בְּיָדֶ֗יהָ אֵ֤ין מְנַחֵם֙ לָ֔הּ צִוָּ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה לְיַעֲקֹ֖ב סְבִיבָ֣יו צָרָ֑יו הָיְתָ֧ה יְרוּשָׁלַ֛͏ִם לְנִדָּ֖ה בֵּינֵיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: prshh tsyvn bydyh 'yn mnchm lh tsvh yhvh ly'qb sbybyv tsryv hyth yrvshl͏m lndh bynyhm {s}
verses.translation: Zion spreadeth forth her hands; There is none to comfort her; The LORD hath commanded concerning Jacob, That they that are round about him should be his adversaries; Jerusalem is among them As one unclean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַדִּ֥יק ה֛וּא יְהֹוָ֖ה כִּ֣י פִ֣יהוּ מָרִ֑יתִי שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֣א כׇל־[הָֽעַמִּ֗ים] (עמים) וּרְאוּ֙ מַכְאֹבִ֔י בְּתוּלֹתַ֥י וּבַחוּרַ֖י הָלְכ֥וּ בַשֶּֽׁבִי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tsdyq hv' yhvh khy pyhv mryty shm'vn' khl[h'mym] ('mym) vr'v mkh'by btvlty vbchvry hlkhv bshby {s}
verses.translation: The LORD is righteous; For I have rebelled against His word; Hear, I pray you, All ye peoples, And behold my pain: My virgins and my young men Are gone into captivity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָרָ֤אתִי לַֽמְאַהֲבַי֙ הֵ֣מָּה רִמּ֔וּנִי כֹּהֲנַ֥י וּזְקֵנַ֖י בָּעִ֣יר גָּוָ֑עוּ כִּֽי־בִקְשׁ֥וּ אֹ֙כֶל֙ לָ֔מוֹ וְיָשִׁ֖יבוּ אֶת־נַפְשָֽׁם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: qr'ty lm'hby hmh rmvny khhny vzqny b'yr gv'v khybqshv 'khl lmv vyshybv 'tnpshm {s}
verses.translation: I called for my lovers, But they deceived me; My priests and mine elders Perished in the city, While they sought them food To refresh their souls.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְאֵ֨ה יְהֹוָ֤ה כִּֽי־צַר־לִי֙ מֵעַ֣י חֳמַרְמָ֔רוּ נֶהְפַּ֤ךְ לִבִּי֙ בְּקִרְבִּ֔י כִּ֥י מָר֖וֹ מָרִ֑יתִי מִח֥וּץ שִׁכְּלָה־חֶ֖רֶב בַּבַּ֥יִת כַּמָּֽוֶת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: r'h yhvh khytsrly m'y chmrmrv nhpkh lby bqrby khy mrv mryty mchvts shkhlhchrb bbyt khmvt {s}
verses.translation: Behold, O LORD, For I am in distress, Mine inwards burn; My heart is turned within me, For I have grievously rebelled. Abroad the sword bereaveth, At home there is the like of death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמְע֞וּ כִּ֧י נֶאֱנָחָ֣ה אָ֗נִי אֵ֤ין מְנַחֵם֙ לִ֔י כׇּל־אֹ֨יְבַ֜י שָׁמְע֤וּ רָֽעָתִי֙ שָׂ֔שׂוּ כִּ֥י אַתָּ֖ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ הֵבֵ֥אתָ יוֹם־קָרָ֖אתָ וְיִֽהְי֥וּ כָמֹֽנִי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: shm'v khy n'nchh 'ny 'yn mnchm ly khl'yby shm'v r'ty shshv khy 'th 'shyt hb't yvmqr't vyhyv khmny {s}
verses.translation: They have heard that I sigh, There is none to comfort me; All mine enemies have heard of my trouble, And are glad, For Thou hast done it; Thou wilt bring the day that Thou hast proclaimed, And they shall be like unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּבֹ֨א כׇל־רָעָתָ֤ם לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ וְעוֹלֵ֣ל לָ֔מוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עוֹלַ֛לְתָּ לִ֖י עַ֣ל כׇּל־פְּשָׁעָ֑י כִּֽי־רַבּ֥וֹת אַנְחֹתַ֖י וְלִבִּ֥י דַוָּֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: tb' khlr'tm lpnykh v'vll lmv kh'shr 'vllt ly 'l khlpsh'y khyrbvt 'nchty vlby dvy {p}
verses.translation: Let all their wickedness come before Thee; And do unto them, As Thou hast done unto me For all my transgressions; For my sighs are many And my heart is faint.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵיכָה֩ יָעִ֨יב בְּאַפּ֤וֹ ׀ אֲדֹנָי֙ אֶת־בַּת־צִיּ֔וֹן הִשְׁלִ֤יךְ מִשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ אֶ֔רֶץ תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹא־זָכַ֥ר הֲדֹם־רַגְלָ֖יו בְּי֥וֹם אַפּֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'ykhh y'yb b'pv  'dny 'tbttsyvn hshlykh mshmym 'rts tp'rt yshr'l vl'zkhr hdmrglyv byvm 'pv {s}
verses.translation: How hath the Lord covered with a cloud The daughter of Zion in His anger! He hath cast down from heaven unto the earth The beauty of Israel, And hath not remembered His footstool In the day of His anger.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּלַּ֨ע אֲדֹנָ֜י (לא) [וְלֹ֣א] חָמַ֗ל אֵ֚ת כׇּל־נְא֣וֹת יַעֲקֹ֔ב הָרַ֧ס בְּעֶבְרָת֛וֹ מִבְצְרֵ֥י בַת־יְהוּדָ֖ה הִגִּ֣יעַ לָאָ֑רֶץ חִלֵּ֥ל מַמְלָכָ֖ה וְשָׂרֶֽיהָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bl' 'dny (l') [vl'] chml 't khln'vt y'qb hrs b'brtv mbtsry btyhvdh hgy' l'rts chll mmlkhh vshryh {s}
verses.translation: The Lord hath swallowed up unsparingly All the habitations of Jacob; He hath thrown down in His wrath The strongholds of the daughter of Judah; He hath brought them down to the ground; He hath profaned the kingdom and the princes thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גָּדַ֣ע בׇּֽחֳרִי־אַ֗ף כֹּ֚ל קֶ֣רֶן יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֵשִׁ֥יב אָח֛וֹר יְמִינ֖וֹ מִפְּנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֑ב וַיִּבְעַ֤ר בְּיַעֲקֹב֙ כְּאֵ֣שׁ לֶֽהָבָ֔ה אָכְלָ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: gd' bchry'f khl qrn yshr'l hshyb 'chvr ymynv mpny 'vyb vyb'r by'qb kh'sh lhbh 'khlh sbyb {s}
verses.translation: He hath cut off in fierce anger All the horn of Israel; He hath drawn back His right hand From before the enemy; And He hath burned in Jacob like a flaming fire, Which devoureth round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דָּרַ֨ךְ קַשְׁתּ֜וֹ כְּאוֹיֵ֗ב נִצָּ֤ב יְמִינוֹ֙ כְּצָ֔ר וַֽיַּהֲרֹ֔ג כֹּ֖ל מַחֲמַדֵּי־עָ֑יִן בְּאֹ֙הֶל֙ בַּת־צִיּ֔וֹן שָׁפַ֥ךְ כָּאֵ֖שׁ חֲמָתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: drkh qshtv kh'vyb ntsb ymynv khtsr vyhrg khl mchmdy'yn b'hl bttsyvn shpkh kh'sh chmtv {s}
verses.translation: He hath bent His bow like an enemy, Standing with His right hand as an adversary, And hath slain all that were pleasant to the eye; In the tent of the daughter of Zion He hath poured out His fury like fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָיָ֨ה אֲדֹנָ֤י ׀ כְּאוֹיֵב֙ בִּלַּ֣ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּלַּע֙ כׇּל־אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ שִׁחֵ֖ת מִבְצָרָ֑יו וַיֶּ֙רֶב֙ בְּבַת־יְהוּדָ֔ה תַּאֲנִיָּ֖ה וַאֲנִיָּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hyh 'dny  kh'vyb bl' yshr'l bl' khl'rmnvtyh shcht mbtsryv vyrb bbtyhvdh t'nyh v'nyh {s}
verses.translation: The Lord is become as an enemy, He hath swallowed up Israel; He hath swallowed up all her palaces, He hath destroyed his strongholds; And He hath multiplied in the daughter of Judah Mourning and moaning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּחְמֹ֤ס כַּגַּן֙ שֻׂכּ֔וֹ שִׁחֵ֖ת מֹעֲד֑וֹ שִׁכַּ֨ח יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ בְּצִיּוֹן֙ מוֹעֵ֣ד וְשַׁבָּ֔ת וַיִּנְאַ֥ץ בְּזַֽעַם־אַפּ֖וֹ מֶ֥לֶךְ וְכֹהֵֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vychms khgn shkhv shcht m'dv shkhch yhvh  btsyvn mv'd vshbt vyn'ts bz'm'pv mlkh vkhhn {s}
verses.translation: And He hath stripped His tabernacle, as if it were a garden, He hath destroyed His place of assembly; The LORD hath caused to be forgotten in Zion Appointed season and sabbath, And hath rejected in the indignation of His anger The king and the priest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָנַ֨ח אֲדֹנָ֤י ׀ מִזְבְּחוֹ֙ נִאֵ֣ר מִקְדָּשׁ֔וֹ הִסְגִּיר֙ בְּיַד־אוֹיֵ֔ב חוֹמֹ֖ת אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ ק֛וֹל נָתְנ֥וּ בְּבֵית־יְהֹוָ֖ה כְּי֥וֹם מוֹעֵֽד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: znch 'dny  mzbchv n'r mqdshv hsgyr byd'vyb chvmt 'rmnvtyh qvl ntnv bbytyhvh khyvm mv'd {s}
verses.translation: The Lord hath cast off His altar, He hath abhorred His sanctuary, He hath given up into the hand of the enemy The walls of her palaces; They have made a noise in the house of the LORD, As in the day of a solemn assembly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָשַׁ֨ב יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ לְהַשְׁחִית֙ חוֹמַ֣ת בַּת־צִיּ֔וֹן נָ֣טָה קָ֔ו לֹא־הֵשִׁ֥יב יָד֖וֹ מִבַּלֵּ֑עַ וַיַּֽאֲבֶל־חֵ֥ל וְחוֹמָ֖ה יַחְדָּ֥ו אֻמְלָֽלוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: chshb yhvh  lhshchyt chvmt bttsyvn nth qv l'hshyb ydv mbl' vy'blchl vchvmh ychdv 'mllv {s}
verses.translation: The LORD hath purposed to destroy The wall of the daughter of Zion; He hath stretched out the line, He hath not withdrawn His hand from destroying; But He hath made the rampart and wall to mourn, They languish together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טָבְע֤וּ בָאָ֙רֶץ֙ שְׁעָרֶ֔יהָ אִבַּ֥ד וְשִׁבַּ֖ר בְּרִיחֶ֑יהָ מַלְכָּ֨הּ וְשָׂרֶ֤יהָ בַגּוֹיִם֙ אֵ֣ין תּוֹרָ֔ה גַּם־נְבִיאֶ֕יהָ לֹא־מָצְא֥וּ חָז֖וֹן מֵיְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tb'v b'rts sh'ryh 'bd vshbr brychyh mlkhh vshryh bgvym 'yn tvrh gmnby'yh l'mts'v chzvn myhvh {s}
verses.translation: Her gates are sunk into the ground; He hath destroyed and broken her bars; Her king and her princes are among the nations, Instruction is no more; Yea, her prophets find No vision from the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵשְׁב֨וּ לָאָ֤רֶץ יִדְּמוּ֙ זִקְנֵ֣י בַת־צִיּ֔וֹן הֶֽעֱל֤וּ עָפָר֙ עַל־רֹאשָׁ֔ם חָגְר֖וּ שַׂקִּ֑ים הוֹרִ֤ידוּ לָאָ֙רֶץ֙ רֹאשָׁ֔ן בְּתוּלֹ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: yshbv l'rts ydmv zqny bttsyvn h'lv 'pr 'lr'shm chgrv shqym hvrydv l'rts r'shn btvlt yrvshl͏m {s}
verses.translation: They sit upon the ground, and keep silence, The elders of the daughter of Zion; They have cast up dust upon their heads, They have girded themselves with sackcloth; The virgins of Jerusalem hang down Their heads to the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּל֨וּ בַדְּמָע֤וֹת עֵינַי֙ חֳמַרְמְר֣וּ מֵעַ֔י נִשְׁפַּ֤ךְ לָאָ֙רֶץ֙ כְּבֵדִ֔י עַל־שֶׁ֖בֶר בַּת־עַמִּ֑י בֵּֽעָטֵ֤ף עוֹלֵל֙ וְיוֹנֵ֔ק בִּרְחֹב֖וֹת קִרְיָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khlv bdm'vt 'yny chmrmrv m'y nshpkh l'rts khbdy 'lshbr bt'my b'tf 'vll vyvnq brchbvt qryh {s}
verses.translation: Mine eyes do fail with tears, Mine inwards burn, My liver is poured upon the earth, For the breach of the daughter of my people; Because the young children and the sucklings swoon In the broad places of the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְאִמֹּתָם֙ יֹֽאמְר֔וּ אַיֵּ֖ה דָּגָ֣ן וָיָ֑יִן בְּהִֽתְעַטְּפָ֤ם כֶּֽחָלָל֙ בִּרְחֹב֣וֹת עִ֔יר בְּהִשְׁתַּפֵּ֣ךְ נַפְשָׁ֔ם אֶל־חֵ֖יק אִמֹּתָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: l'mtm y'mrv 'yh dgn vyyn bht'tpm khchll brchbvt 'yr bhshtpkh npshm 'lchyq 'mtm {s}
verses.translation: They say to their mothers: ‘Where is corn and wine?’ When they swoon as the wounded In the broad places of the city, When their soul is poured out Into their mothers’bosom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָֽה־אֲעִידֵ֞ךְ מָ֣ה אֲדַמֶּה־לָּ֗ךְ הַבַּת֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם מָ֤ה אַשְׁוֶה־לָּךְ֙ וַאֲנַֽחֲמֵ֔ךְ בְּתוּלַ֖ת בַּת־צִיּ֑וֹן כִּֽי־גָד֥וֹל כַּיָּ֛ם שִׁבְרֵ֖ךְ מִ֥י יִרְפָּא־לָֽךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mh''ydkh mh 'dmhlkh hbt yrvshl͏m mh 'shvhlkh v'nchmkh btvlt bttsyvn khygdvl khym shbrkh my yrp'lkh {s}
verses.translation: What shall I take to witness for thee? What shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? For thy breach is great like the sea; Who can heal thee?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְבִיאַ֗יִךְ חָ֤זוּ לָךְ֙ שָׁ֣וְא וְתָפֵ֔ל וְלֹֽא־גִלּ֥וּ עַל־עֲוֺנֵ֖ךְ לְהָשִׁ֣יב (שביתך) [שְׁבוּתֵ֑ךְ] וַיֶּ֣חֱזוּ לָ֔ךְ מַשְׂא֥וֹת שָׁ֖וְא וּמַדּוּחִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: nby'ykh chzv lkh shv' vtpl vl'glv 'l'vnkh lhshyb (shbytkh) [shbvtkh] vychzv lkh msh'vt shv' vmdvchym {s}
verses.translation: Thy prophets have seen visions for thee Of vanity and delusion; And they have not uncovered thine iniquity, To bring back thy captivity; But have prophesied for thee burdens Of vanity and seduction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סָֽפְק֨וּ עָלַ֤יִךְ כַּפַּ֙יִם֙ כׇּל־עֹ֣בְרֵי דֶ֔רֶךְ שָֽׁרְקוּ֙ וַיָּנִ֣עוּ רֹאשָׁ֔ם עַל־בַּ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם הֲזֹ֣את הָעִ֗יר שֶׁיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ כְּלִ֣ילַת יֹ֔פִי מָשׂ֖וֹשׂ לְכׇל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: spqv 'lykh khpym khl'bry drkh shrqv vyn'v r'shm 'lbt yrvshl͏m hz't h'yr shy'mrv khlylt ypy mshvsh lkhlh'rts {s}
verses.translation: All that pass by clap Their hands at thee; They hiss and wag their head At the daughter of Jerusalem: ‘Is this the city that men called The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּצ֨וּ עָלַ֤יִךְ פִּיהֶם֙ כׇּל־אֹ֣יְבַ֔יִךְ שָֽׁרְקוּ֙ וַיַּֽחַרְקוּ־שֵׁ֔ן אָמְר֖וּ בִּלָּ֑עְנוּ אַ֣ךְ זֶ֥ה הַיּ֛וֹם שֶׁקִּוִּינֻ֖הוּ מָצָ֥אנוּ רָאִֽינוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ptsv 'lykh pyhm khl'ybykh shrqv vychrqvshn 'mrv bl'nv 'kh zh hyvm shqvynhv mts'nv r'ynv {s}
verses.translation: All thine enemies have opened Their mouth wide against thee; They hiss and gnash the teeth; They say: ‘We have swallowed her up; Certainly this is the day that we looked for; We have found, we have seen it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָשָׂ֨ה יְהֹוָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר זָמָ֗ם בִּצַּ֤ע אֶמְרָתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה מִֽימֵי־קֶ֔דֶם הָרַ֖ס וְלֹ֣א חָמָ֑ל וַיְשַׂמַּ֤ח עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ אוֹיֵ֔ב הֵרִ֖ים קֶ֥רֶן צָרָֽיִךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'shh yhvh 'shr zmm bts' 'mrtv 'shr tsvh mymyqdm hrs vl' chml vyshmch 'lykh 'vyb hrym qrn tsrykh {s}
verses.translation: The LORD hath done that which He devised; He hath performed His word That He commanded in the days of old; He hath thrown down unsparingly; And He hath caused the enemy to rejoice over thee, He hath exalted the horn of thine adversaries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צָעַ֥ק לִבָּ֖ם אֶל־אֲדֹנָ֑י חוֹמַ֣ת בַּת־צִ֠יּ֠וֹן הוֹרִ֨ידִי כַנַּ֤חַל דִּמְעָה֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה אַֽל־תִּתְּנִ֤י פוּגַת֙ לָ֔ךְ אַל־תִּדֹּ֖ם בַּת־עֵינֵֽךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ts'q lbm 'l'dny chvmt bttsyvn hvrydy khnchl dm'h yvmm vlylh 'lttny pvgt lkh 'ltdm bt'ynkh {s}
verses.translation: Their heart cried unto the Lord: ‘O wall of the daughter of Zion, Let tears run down like a river Day and night; Give thyself no respite; Let not the apple of thine eye cease.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֣וּמִי  רֹ֣נִּי (בליל) [בַלַּ֗יְלָה] לְרֹאשׁ֙ אַשְׁמֻר֔וֹת שִׁפְכִ֤י כַמַּ֙יִם֙ לִבֵּ֔ךְ נֹ֖כַח פְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנָ֑י שְׂאִ֧י אֵלָ֣יו כַּפַּ֗יִךְ עַל־נֶ֙פֶשׁ֙ עֽוֹלָלַ֔יִךְ הָעֲטוּפִ֥ים בְּרָעָ֖ב בְּרֹ֥אשׁ כׇּל־חוּצֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: qvmy  rny (blyl) [blylh] lr'sh 'shmrvt shpkhy khmym lbkh nkhch pny 'dny sh'y 'lyv khpykh 'lnpsh 'vllykh h'tvpym br'b br'sh khlchvtsvt {s}
verses.translation: Arise, cry out in the night, At the beginning of the watches; Pour out thy heart like water Before the face of the Lord; Lift up thy hands toward Him For the life of thy young children, That faint for hunger At the head of every street.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְאֵ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ וְֽהַבִּ֔יטָה לְמִ֖י עוֹלַ֣לְתָּ כֹּ֑ה אִם־תֹּאכַ֨לְנָה נָשִׁ֤ים פִּרְיָם֙ עֹלְלֵ֣י טִפֻּחִ֔ים אִם־יֵהָרֵ֛ג בְּמִקְדַּ֥שׁ אֲדֹנָ֖י כֹּהֵ֥ן וְנָבִֽיא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: r'h yhvh vhbyth lmy 'vllt khh 'mt'khlnh nshym prym 'lly tpchym 'myhrg bmqdsh 'dny khhn vnby' {s}
verses.translation: ’See, O LORD, and consider, To whom Thou hast done thus! Shall the women eat their fruit, The children that are dandled in the hands? Shall the priest and the prophet be slain In the sanctuary of the Lord?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁכְב֨וּ לָאָ֤רֶץ חוּצוֹת֙ נַ֣עַר וְזָקֵ֔ן בְּתוּלֹתַ֥י וּבַחוּרַ֖י נָפְל֣וּ בֶחָ֑רֶב הָרַ֙גְתָּ֙ בְּי֣וֹם אַפֶּ֔ךָ טָבַ֖חְתָּ לֹ֥א חָמָֽלְתָּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: shkhbv l'rts chvtsvt n'r vzqn btvlty vbchvry nplv bchrb hrgt byvm 'pkh tbcht l' chmlt {s}
verses.translation: The youth and the old man lie On the ground in the streets; My virgins and my young men Are fallen by the sword; Thou hast slain them in the day of Thine anger; Thou hast slaughtered unsparingly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּקְרָא֩ כְי֨וֹם מוֹעֵ֤ד מְגוּרַי֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב וְלֹ֥א הָיָ֛ה בְּי֥וֹם אַף־יְהֹוָ֖ה פָּלִ֣יט וְשָׂרִ֑יד אֲשֶׁר־טִפַּ֥חְתִּי וְרִבִּ֖יתִי אֹיְבִ֥י כִלָּֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: tqr' khyvm mv'd mgvry msbyb vl' hyh byvm 'fyhvh plyt vshryd 'shrtpchty vrbyty 'yby khlm {p}
verses.translation: Thou hast called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, My terrors on every side, And there was none in the day of the LORD’S anger That escaped or remained; Those that I have dandled and brought up Hath mine enemy consumed.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֤י הַגֶּ֙בֶר֙ רָאָ֣ה עֳנִ֔י בְּשֵׁ֖בֶט עֶבְרָתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'ny hgbr r'h 'ny bshbt 'brtv {s}
verses.translation: I am the man that hath seen affliction By the rod of His wrath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹתִ֥י נָהַ֛ג וַיֹּלַ֖ךְ חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וְלֹא־אֽוֹר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'vty nhg vylkh chshkh vl''vr {s}
verses.translation: He hath led me and caused me to walk in darkness and not in light.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ בִּ֥י יָשֻׁ֛ב יַהֲפֹ֥ךְ יָד֖וֹ כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'kh by yshb yhpkh ydv khlhyvm {s}
verses.translation: Surely against me He turneth His hand again and again all the day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּלָּ֤ה בְשָׂרִי֙ וְעוֹרִ֔י שִׁבַּ֖ר עַצְמוֹתָֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: blh bshry v'vry shbr 'tsmvty {s}
verses.translation: My flesh and my skin hath He worn out; He hath broken my bones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּנָ֥ה עָלַ֛י וַיַּקַּ֖ף רֹ֥אשׁ וּתְלָאָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnh 'ly vyqf r'sh vtl'h {s}
verses.translation: He hath builded against me, and compassed me With gall and travail.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּמַחֲשַׁכִּ֥ים הוֹשִׁיבַ֖נִי כְּמֵתֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bmchshkhym hvshybny khmty 'vlm {s}
verses.translation: He hath made me to dwell in dark places, As those that have been long dead. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גָּדַ֧ר בַּעֲדִ֛י וְלֹ֥א אֵצֵ֖א הִכְבִּ֥יד נְחׇשְׁתִּֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: gdr b'dy vl' 'ts' hkhbyd nchshty {s}
verses.translation: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot go forth; He hath made my chain heavy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֣ם כִּ֤י אֶזְעַק֙ וַאֲשַׁוֵּ֔עַ שָׂתַ֖ם תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: gm khy 'z'q v'shv' shtm tplty {s}
verses.translation: Yea, when I cry and call for help, He shutteth out my prayer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גָּדַ֤ר דְּרָכַי֙ בְּגָזִ֔ית נְתִיבֹתַ֖י עִוָּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: gdr drkhy bgzyt ntybty 'vh {s}
verses.translation: He hath enclosed my ways with hewn stone, He hath made my paths crooked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דֹּ֣ב אֹרֵ֥ב הוּא֙ לִ֔י (אריה) [אֲרִ֖י] בְּמִסְתָּרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: db 'rb hv' ly ('ryh) ['ry] bmstrym {s}
verses.translation: He is unto me as a bear lying in wait, As a lion in secret places.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּרָכַ֥י סוֹרֵ֛ר וַֽיְפַשְּׁחֵ֖נִי שָׂמַ֥נִי שֹׁמֵֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: drkhy svrr vypshchny shmny shmm {s}
verses.translation: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces; He hath made me desolate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דָּרַ֤ךְ קַשְׁתּוֹ֙ וַיַּצִּיבֵ֔נִי כַּמַּטָּרָ֖א לַחֵֽץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: drkh qshtv vytsybny khmtr' lchts {s}
verses.translation: He hath bent His bow, and set me As a mark for the arrow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵבִיא֙ בְּכִלְיֹתָ֔י בְּנֵ֖י אַשְׁפָּתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hby' bkhlyty bny 'shptv {s}
verses.translation: He hath caused the arrows of His quiver To enter into my reins.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָיִ֤יתִי שְּׂחֹק֙ לְכׇל־עַמִּ֔י נְגִינָתָ֖ם כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hyyty shchq lkhl'my ngyntm khlhyvm {s}
verses.translation: I am become a derision to all my people, And their song all the day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִשְׂבִּיעַ֥נִי בַמְּרוֹרִ֖ים הִרְוַ֥נִי לַעֲנָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hshby'ny bmrvrym hrvny l'nh {s}
verses.translation: He hath filled me with bitterness, He hath sated me with wormwood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּגְרֵ֤ס בֶּֽחָצָץ֙ שִׁנָּ֔י הִכְפִּישַׁ֖נִי בָּאֵֽפֶר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vygrs bchtsts shny hkhpyshny b'pr {s}
verses.translation: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, He hath made me to wallow in ashes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּזְנַ֧ח מִשָּׁל֛וֹם נַפְשִׁ֖י נָשִׁ֥יתִי טוֹבָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vtznch mshlvm npshy nshyty tvbh {s}
verses.translation: And my soul is removed far off from peace, I forgot prosperity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַר֙ אָבַ֣ד נִצְחִ֔י וְתוֹחַלְתִּ֖י מֵיְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'mr 'bd ntschy vtvchlty myhvh {s}
verses.translation: And I said: ‘My strength is perished, And mine expectation from the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכׇר־עׇנְיִ֥י וּמְרוּדִ֖י לַעֲנָ֥ה וָרֹֽאשׁ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: zkhr'nyy vmrvdy l'nh vr'sh {s}
verses.translation: Remember mine affliction and mine anguish, The wormwood and the gall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָכ֣וֹר תִּזְכּ֔וֹר (ותשיח) [וְתָשׁ֥וֹחַ] עָלַ֖י נַפְשִֽׁי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: zkhvr tzkhvr (vtshych) [vtshvch] 'ly npshy {s}
verses.translation: My soul hath them still in remembrance, And is bowed down within me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֛את אָשִׁ֥יב אֶל־לִבִּ֖י עַל־כֵּ֥ן אוֹחִֽיל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: z't 'shyb 'llby 'lkhn 'vchyl {s}
verses.translation: This I recall to my mind, Therefore have I hope.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַֽסְדֵ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ כִּ֣י לֹא־תָ֔מְנוּ כִּ֥י לֹא־כָל֖וּ רַחֲמָֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: chsdy yhvh khy l'tmnv khy l'khlv rchmyv {s}
verses.translation: Surely the LORD’S mercies are not consumed, Surely His compassions fail not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲדָשִׁים֙ לַבְּקָרִ֔ים רַבָּ֖ה אֱמוּנָתֶֽךָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: chdshym lbqrym rbh 'mvntkh {s}
verses.translation: They are new every morning; Great is Thy faithfulness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶלְקִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ אָמְרָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֔י עַל־כֵּ֖ן אוֹחִ֥יל לֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: chlqy yhvh 'mrh npshy 'lkhn 'vchyl lv {s}
verses.translation: ’The LORD is my portion’, saith my soul; ‘Therefore will I hope in Him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֤וֹב יְהֹוָה֙ לְקֹוָ֔ו לְנֶ֖פֶשׁ תִּדְרְשֶֽׁנּוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tvb yhvh lqvv lnpsh tdrshnv {s}
verses.translation: The LORD is good unto them that wait for Him, To the soul that seeketh Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֤וֹב וְיָחִיל֙ וְדוּמָ֔ם לִתְשׁוּעַ֖ת יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tvb vychyl vdvmm ltshv't yhvh {s}
verses.translation: It is good that a man should quietly wait For the salvation of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֣וֹב לַגֶּ֔בֶר כִּֽי־יִשָּׂ֥א עֹ֖ל בִּנְעוּרָֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tvb lgbr khyysh' 'l bn'vryv {s}
verses.translation: It is good for a man that he bear The yoke in his youth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵשֵׁ֤ב בָּדָד֙ וְיִדֹּ֔ם כִּ֥י נָטַ֖ל עָלָֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: yshb bdd vydm khy ntl 'lyv {s}
verses.translation: Let him sit alone and keep silence, Because He hath laid it upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִתֵּ֤ן בֶּֽעָפָר֙ פִּ֔יהוּ אוּלַ֖י יֵ֥שׁ תִּקְוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ytn b'pr pyhv 'vly ysh tqvh {s}
verses.translation: Let him put his mouth in the dust, If so be there may be hope.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִתֵּ֧ן לְמַכֵּ֛הוּ לֶ֖חִי יִשְׂבַּ֥ע בְּחֶרְפָּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ytn lmkhhv lchy yshb' bchrph {s}
verses.translation: Let him give his cheek to him that smiteth him Let him be filled full with reproach.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֥א יִזְנַ֛ח לְעוֹלָ֖ם אֲדֹנָֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy l' yznch l'vlm 'dny {s}
verses.translation: For the Lord will not cast off For ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־הוֹגָ֔ה וְרִחַ֖ם כְּרֹ֥ב חֲסָדָֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy 'mhvgh vrchm khrb chsdyv {s}
verses.translation: For though He cause grief, yet will He have compassion According to the multitude of His mercies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א עִנָּה֙ מִלִּבּ֔וֹ וַיַּגֶּ֖ה בְּנֵי־אִֽישׁ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy l' 'nh mlbv vygh bny'ysh {s}
verses.translation: For He doth not afflict willingly, Nor grieve the children of men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדַכֵּא֙ תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָ֔יו כֹּ֖ל אֲסִ֥ירֵי אָֽרֶץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ldkh' tcht rglyv khl 'syry 'rts {s}
verses.translation: To crush under foot All the prisoners of the earth,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהַטּוֹת֙ מִשְׁפַּט־גָּ֔בֶר נֶ֖גֶד פְּנֵ֥י עֶלְיֽוֹן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lhtvt mshptgbr ngd pny 'lyvn {s}
verses.translation: To turn aside the right of a man Before the face of the Most High,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְעַוֵּ֤ת אָדָם֙ בְּרִיב֔וֹ אֲדֹנָ֖י לֹ֥א רָאָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: l'vt 'dm brybv 'dny l' r'h {s}
verses.translation: To subvert a man in his cause, The Lord approveth not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֣י זֶ֤ה אָמַר֙ וַתֶּ֔הִי אֲדֹנָ֖י לֹ֥א צִוָּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: my zh 'mr vthy 'dny l' tsvh {s}
verses.translation: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, When the Lord commandeth it not?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִפִּ֤י עֶלְיוֹן֙ לֹ֣א תֵצֵ֔א הָרָע֖וֹת וְהַטּֽוֹב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mpy 'lyvn l' tts' hr'vt vhtvb {s}
verses.translation: Out of the mouth of the Most High proceedeth not Evil and good?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
