verses.original: מַה־יִּתְאוֹנֵן֙ אָדָ֣ם חָ֔י גֶּ֖בֶר עַל־חֲטָאָֽו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mhyt'vnn 'dm chy gbr 'lcht'v {s}
verses.translation: Wherefore doth a living man complain, A strong man because of his sins?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַחְפְּשָׂ֤ה דְרָכֵ֙ינוּ֙ וְֽנַחְקֹ֔רָה וְנָשׁ֖וּבָה עַד־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: nchpshh drkhynv vnchqrh vnshvbh 'dyhvh {s}
verses.translation: Let us search and try our ways, And return to the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשָּׂ֤א לְבָבֵ֙נוּ֙ אֶל־כַּפָּ֔יִם אֶל־אֵ֖ל בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: nsh' lbbnv 'lkhpym 'l'l bshmym {s}
verses.translation: Let us lift up our heart with our hands Unto God in the heavens.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַ֤חְנוּ פָשַׁ֙עְנוּ֙ וּמָרִ֔ינוּ אַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א סָלָֽחְתָּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: nchnv psh'nv vmrynv 'th l' slcht {s}
verses.translation: We have transgressed and have rebelled; Thou hast not pardoned.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סַכּ֤וֹתָה בָאַף֙ וַֽתִּרְדְּפֵ֔נוּ הָרַ֖גְתָּ לֹ֥א חָמָֽלְתָּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: skhvth b'f vtrdpnv hrgt l' chmlt {s}
verses.translation: Thou hast covered with anger and pursued us; Thou hast slain unsparingly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סַכּ֤וֹתָה בֶֽעָנָן֙ לָ֔ךְ מֵעֲב֖וֹר תְּפִלָּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: skhvth b'nn lkh m'bvr tplh {s}
verses.translation: Thou hast covered Thyself with a cloud, So that no prayer can pass through.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סְחִ֧י וּמָא֛וֹס תְּשִׂימֵ֖נוּ בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָעַמִּֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: schy vm'vs tshymnv bqrb h'mym {s}
verses.translation: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse In the midst of the peoples.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּצ֥וּ עָלֵ֛ינוּ פִּיהֶ֖ם כׇּל־אֹיְבֵֽינוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ptsv 'lynv pyhm khl'ybynv {s}
verses.translation: All our enemies have opened their mouth Wide against us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּ֧חַד וָפַ֛חַת הָ֥יָה לָ֖נוּ הַשֵּׁ֥את וְהַשָּֽׁבֶר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: pchd vpcht hyh lnv hsh't vhshbr {s}
verses.translation: Terror and the pit are come upon us, Desolation and destruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּלְגֵי־מַ֙יִם֙ תֵּרַ֣ד עֵינִ֔י עַל־שֶׁ֖בֶר בַּת־עַמִּֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: plgymym trd 'yny 'lshbr bt'my {s}
verses.translation: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water, For the breach of the daughter of my people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵינִ֧י נִגְּרָ֛ה וְלֹ֥א תִדְמֶ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ין הֲפֻגֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'yny ngrh vl' tdmh m'yn hpgvt {s}
verses.translation: Mine eye is poured out, and ceaseth not, Without any intermission,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־יַשְׁקִ֣יף וְיֵ֔רֶא יְהֹוָ֖ה מִשָּׁמָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'dyshqyf vyr' yhvh mshmym {s}
verses.translation: Till the LORD look forth, And behold from heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵינִי֙ עֽוֹלְלָ֣ה לְנַפְשִׁ֔י מִכֹּ֖ל בְּנ֥וֹת עִירִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'yny 'vllh lnpshy mkhl bnvt 'yry {s}
verses.translation: Mine eye affected my soul, Because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צ֥וֹד צָד֛וּנִי כַּצִּפּ֖וֹר אֹיְבַ֥י חִנָּֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tsvd tsdvny khtspvr 'yby chnm {s}
verses.translation: They have chased me sore like a bird, That are mine enemies without cause.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צָֽמְת֤וּ בַבּוֹר֙ חַיָּ֔י וַיַּדּוּ־אֶ֖בֶן בִּֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tsmtv bbvr chyy vydv'bn by {s}
verses.translation: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, And have cast stones upon me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צָֽפוּ־מַ֥יִם עַל־רֹאשִׁ֖י אָמַ֥רְתִּי נִגְזָֽרְתִּי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tspvmym 'lr'shy 'mrty ngzrty {s}
verses.translation: Waters flowed over my head; I said: ‘I am cut off.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָרָ֤אתִי שִׁמְךָ֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה מִבּ֖וֹר תַּחְתִּיּֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: qr'ty shmkh yhvh mbvr tchtyvt {s}
verses.translation: I called upon Thy name, O LORD, Out of the lowest dungeon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קוֹלִ֖י שָׁמָ֑עְתָּ אַל־תַּעְלֵ֧ם אׇזְנְךָ֛ לְרַוְחָתִ֖י לְשַׁוְעָתִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: qvly shm't 'lt'lm 'znkh lrvchty lshv'ty {s}
verses.translation: Thou heardest my voice; hide not Thine ear at my sighing, at my cry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָרַ֙בְתָּ֙ בְּי֣וֹם אֶקְרָאֶ֔ךָּ אָמַ֖רְתָּ אַל־תִּירָֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: qrbt byvm 'qr'kh 'mrt 'ltyr' {s}
verses.translation: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon Thee; Thou saidst: ‘Fear not.’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֧בְתָּ אֲדֹנָ֛י רִיבֵ֥י נַפְשִׁ֖י גָּאַ֥לְתָּ חַיָּֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: rbt 'dny ryby npshy g'lt chyy {s}
verses.translation: O Lord, Thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; Thou hast redeemed my life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאִ֤יתָה יְהֹוָה֙ עַוָּ֣תָתִ֔י שׇׁפְטָ֖ה מִשְׁפָּטִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: r'yth yhvh 'vtty shpth mshpty {s}
verses.translation: O LORD, Thou hast seen my wrong; Judge Thou my cause.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאִ֙יתָה֙ כׇּל־נִקְמָתָ֔ם כׇּל־מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֖ם לִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: r'yth khlnqmtm khlmchshbtm ly {s}
verses.translation: Thou hast seen all their vengeance And all their devices against me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמַ֤עְתָּ חֶרְפָּתָם֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה כׇּל־מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֖ם עָלָֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: shm't chrptm yhvh khlmchshbtm 'ly {s}
verses.translation: Thou hast heard their taunt, O LORD, And all their devices against me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂפְתֵ֤י קָמַי֙ וְהֶגְיוֹנָ֔ם עָלַ֖י כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: shpty qmy vhgyvnm 'ly khlhyvm {s}
verses.translation: The lips of those that rose up against me, And their muttering against me all the day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁבְתָּ֤ם וְקִֽימָתָם֙ הַבִּ֔יטָה אֲנִ֖י מַנְגִּינָתָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: shbtm vqymtm hbyth 'ny mngyntm {s}
verses.translation: Behold Thou their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their song.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּשִׁ֨יב לָהֶ֥ם גְּמ֛וּל יְהֹוָ֖ה כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tshyb lhm gmvl yhvh khm'shh ydyhm {s}
verses.translation: Thou wilt render unto them a recompense, O LORD, According to the work of their hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּתֵּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ מְגִנַּת־לֵ֔ב תַּאֲלָֽתְךָ֖ לָהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ttn lhm mgntlb t'ltkh lhm {s}
verses.translation: Thou wilt give them hardness of heart, Thy curse unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּרְדֹּ֤ף בְּאַף֙ וְתַשְׁמִידֵ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת שְׁמֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: trdf b'f vtshmydm mtcht shmy yhvh {p}
verses.translation: Thou wilt pursue them in anger, and destroy them From under the heavens of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵיכָה֙ יוּעַ֣ם זָהָ֔ב יִשְׁנֶ֖א הַכֶּ֣תֶם הַטּ֑וֹב תִּשְׁתַּפֵּ֙כְנָה֙ אַבְנֵי־קֹ֔דֶשׁ בְּרֹ֖אשׁ כׇּל־חוּצֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'ykhh yv'm zhb yshn' hkhtm htvb tshtpkhnh 'bnyqdsh br'sh khlchvtsvt {s}
verses.translation: How is the gold become dim! How is the most fine gold changed! The hallowed stones are poured out At the head of every street.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י צִיּוֹן֙ הַיְקָרִ֔ים הַמְסֻלָּאִ֖ים בַּפָּ֑ז אֵיכָ֤ה נֶחְשְׁבוּ֙ לְנִבְלֵי־חֶ֔רֶשׂ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְדֵ֥י יוֹצֵֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny tsyvn hyqrym hmsl'ym bpz 'ykhh nchshbv lnblychrsh m'shh ydy yvtsr {s}
verses.translation: The precious sons of Zion, Comparable to fine gold, How are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, The work of the hands of the potter!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־[תַּנִּים֙] (תנין) חָ֣לְצוּ שַׁ֔ד הֵינִ֖יקוּ גּוּרֵיהֶ֑ן בַּת־עַמִּ֣י לְאַכְזָ֔ר (כי ענים) [כַּיְעֵינִ֖ים] בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: gm[tnym] (tnyn) chltsv shd hynyqv gvryhn bt'my l'khzr (khy 'nym) [khy'ynym] bmdbr {s}
verses.translation: Even the jackals draw out the breast, They give suck to their young ones; The daughter of my people is become cruel, Like the ostriches in the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דָּבַ֨ק לְשׁ֥וֹן יוֹנֵ֛ק אֶל־חִכּ֖וֹ בַּצָּמָ֑א עֽוֹלָלִים֙ שָׁ֣אֲלוּ לֶ֔חֶם פֹּרֵ֖שׂ אֵ֥ין לָהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: dbq lshvn yvnq 'lchkhv btsm' 'vllym sh'lv lchm prsh 'yn lhm {s}
verses.translation: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth To the roof of his mouth for thirst; The young children ask bread, And none breaketh it unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֹֽכְלִים֙ לְמַ֣עֲדַנִּ֔ים נָשַׁ֖מּוּ בַּחוּצ֑וֹת הָאֱמֻנִים֙ עֲלֵ֣י תוֹלָ֔ע חִבְּק֖וּ אַשְׁפַּתּֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: h'khlym lm'dnym nshmv bchvtsvt h'mnym 'ly tvl' chbqv 'shptvt {s}
verses.translation: They that did feed on dainties Are desolate in the streets; They that were brought up in scarlet Embrace dunghills.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְדַּל֙ עֲוֺ֣ן בַּת־עַמִּ֔י מֵֽחַטַּ֖את סְדֹ֑ם הַֽהֲפוּכָ֣ה כְמוֹ־רָ֔גַע וְלֹא־חָ֥לוּ בָ֖הּ יָדָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vygdl 'vn bt'my mcht't sdm hhpvkhh khmvrg' vl'chlv bh ydym {s}
verses.translation: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater Than the sin of Sodom, That was overthrown as in a moment, And no hands fell upon her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זַכּ֤וּ נְזִירֶ֙יהָ֙ מִשֶּׁ֔לֶג צַח֖וּ מֵחָלָ֑ב אָ֤דְמוּ עֶ֙צֶם֙ מִפְּנִינִ֔ים סַפִּ֖יר גִּזְרָתָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: zkhv nzyryh mshlg tschv mchlb 'dmv 'tsm mpnynym spyr gzrtm {s}
verses.translation: Her princes were purer than snow, They were whiter than milk, They were more ruddy in body than rubies, Their polishing was as of sapphire;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָשַׁ֤ךְ מִשְּׁחוֹר֙ תׇּֽאֳרָ֔ם לֹ֥א נִכְּר֖וּ בַּחוּצ֑וֹת צָפַ֤ד עוֹרָם֙ עַל־עַצְמָ֔ם יָבֵ֖שׁ הָיָ֥ה כָעֵֽץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: chshkh mshchvr t'rm l' nkhrv bchvtsvt tspd 'vrm 'l'tsmm ybsh hyh kh'ts {s}
verses.translation: Their visage is blacker than a coal; They are not known in the streets; Their skin is shrivelled upon their bones; It is withered, it is become like a stick.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טוֹבִ֤ים הָיוּ֙ חַלְלֵי־חֶ֔רֶב מֵֽחַלְלֵ֖י רָעָ֑ב שֶׁ֣הֵ֤ם יָזֻ֙בוּ֙ מְדֻקָּרִ֔ים מִתְּנוּבֹ֖ת שָׂדָֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tvbym hyv chllychrb mchlly r'b shhm yzbv mdqrym mtnvbt shdy {s}
verses.translation: They that are slain with the sword are better Than they that are slain with hunger; For these pine away, stricken through, For want of the fruits of the field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְדֵ֗י נָשִׁים֙ רַחֲמָ֣נִיּ֔וֹת בִּשְּׁל֖וּ יַלְדֵיהֶ֑ן הָי֤וּ לְבָרוֹת֙ לָ֔מוֹ בְּשֶׁ֖בֶר בַּת־עַמִּֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ydy nshym rchmnyvt bshlv yldyhn hyv lbrvt lmv bshbr bt'my {s}
verses.translation: The hands of women full of compassion Have sodden their own children; They were their food In the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּלָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־חֲמָת֔וֹ שָׁפַ֖ךְ חֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑וֹ וַיַּצֶּת־אֵ֣שׁ בְּצִיּ֔וֹן וַתֹּ֖אכַל יְסֹדֹתֶֽיהָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khlh yhvh 'tchmtv shpkh chrvn 'pv vytst'sh btsyvn vt'khl ysdtyh {s}
verses.translation: The LORD hath accomplished His fury, He hath poured out His fierce anger; And He hath kindled a fire in Zion, Which hath devoured the foundations thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א הֶאֱמִ֙ינוּ֙ מַלְכֵי־אֶ֔רֶץ (וכל) [כֹּ֖ל] יֹשְׁבֵ֣י תֵבֵ֑ל כִּ֤י יָבֹא֙ צַ֣ר וְאוֹיֵ֔ב בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: l' h'mynv mlkhy'rts (vkhl) [khl] yshby tbl khy yb' tsr v'vyb bsh'ry yrvshl͏m {s}
verses.translation: The kings of the earth believed not, Neither all the inhabitants of the world, That the adversary and the enemy would enter Into the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵֽחַטֹּ֣אות נְבִיאֶ֔יהָ עֲוֺנֹ֖ת כֹּהֲנֶ֑יהָ הַשֹּׁפְכִ֥ים בְּקִרְבָּ֖הּ דַּ֥ם צַדִּיקִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mcht'vt nby'yh 'vnt khhnyh hshpkhym bqrbh dm tsdyqym {s}
verses.translation: It is because of the sins of her prophets, And the iniquities of her priests, That have shed the blood of the just In the midst of her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָע֤וּ עִוְרִים֙ בַּֽחוּצ֔וֹת נְגֹֽאֲל֖וּ בַּדָּ֑ם בְּלֹ֣א יֽוּכְל֔וּ יִגְּע֖וּ בִּלְבֻשֵׁיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: n'v 'vrym bchvtsvt ng'lv bdm bl' yvkhlv yg'v blbshyhm {s}
verses.translation: They wander as blind men in the streets, They are polluted with blood, So that men cannot Touch their garments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ס֣וּרוּ טָמֵ֞א קָ֣רְאוּ לָ֗מוֹ ס֤וּרוּ ס֙וּרוּ֙ אַל־תִּגָּ֔עוּ כִּ֥י נָצ֖וּ גַּם־נָ֑עוּ אָֽמְרוּ֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם לֹ֥א יוֹסִ֖פוּ לָגֽוּר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: svrv tm' qr'v lmv svrv svrv 'ltg'v khy ntsv gmn'v 'mrv bgvym l' yvspv lgvr {s}
verses.translation: ’Depart ye! unclean! ’ men cried unto them, ‘Depart, depart, touch not’; Yea, they fled away and wandered; Men said among the nations: ‘They shall no more sojourn here.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּנֵ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ חִלְּקָ֔ם לֹ֥א יוֹסִ֖יף לְהַבִּיטָ֑ם פְּנֵ֤י כֹהֲנִים֙ לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֔אוּ (זקנים) [וּזְקֵנִ֖ים] לֹ֥א חָנָֽנוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: pny yhvh chlqm l' yvsyf lhbytm pny khhnym l' nsh'v (zqnym) [vzqnym] l' chnnv {s}
verses.translation: The anger of the LORD hath divided them; He will no more regard them; They respected not the persons of the priests, They were not gracious unto the elders.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (עודינה) [עוֹדֵ֙ינוּ֙] תִּכְלֶ֣ינָה עֵינֵ֔ינוּ אֶל־עֶזְרָתֵ֖נוּ הָ֑בֶל בְּצִפִּיָּתֵ֣נוּ צִפִּ֔ינוּ אֶל־גּ֖וֹי לֹ֥א יוֹשִֽׁעַ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ('vdynh) ['vdynv] tkhlynh 'ynynv 'l'zrtnv hbl btspytnv tspynv 'lgvy l' yvsh' {s}
verses.translation: As for us, our eyes do yet fail For our vain help; In our watching we have watched For a nation that could not save.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צָד֣וּ צְעָדֵ֔ינוּ מִלֶּ֖כֶת בִּרְחֹבֹתֵ֑ינוּ קָרַ֥ב קִצֵּ֛נוּ מָלְא֥וּ יָמֵ֖ינוּ כִּי־בָ֥א קִצֵּֽנוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tsdv ts'dynv mlkht brchbtynv qrb qtsnv ml'v ymynv khyb' qtsnv {s}
verses.translation: They hunt our steps, That we cannot go in our broad places; Our end is near, our days are fulfilled; For our end is come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קַלִּ֤ים הָיוּ֙ רֹדְפֵ֔ינוּ מִנִּשְׁרֵ֖י שָׁמָ֑יִם עַל־הֶהָרִ֣ים דְּלָקֻ֔נוּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר אָ֥רְבוּ לָֽנוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: qlym hyv rdpynv mnshry shmym 'lhhrym dlqnv bmdbr 'rbv lnv {s}
verses.translation: Our pursuers were swifter Than the eagles of the heaven; They chased us upon the mountains, They lay in wait for us in the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ר֤וּחַ אַפֵּ֙ינוּ֙ מְשִׁ֣יחַ יְהֹוָ֔ה נִלְכַּ֖ד בִּשְׁחִיתוֹתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְנוּ בְּצִלּ֖וֹ נִֽחְיֶ֥ה בַגּוֹיִֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: rvch 'pynv mshych yhvh nlkhd bshchytvtm 'shr 'mrnv btslv nchyh bgvym {s}
verses.translation: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, Was taken in their pits; Of whom we said: ‘Under his shadow We shall live among the nations.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂ֤ישִׂי וְשִׂמְחִי֙ בַּת־אֱד֔וֹם (יושבתי) [יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת] בְּאֶ֣רֶץ ע֑וּץ גַּם־עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ תַּעֲבׇר־כּ֔וֹס תִּשְׁכְּרִ֖י וְתִתְעָרִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: shyshy vshmchy bt'dvm (yvshbty) [yvshbt] b'rts 'vts gm'lykh t'brkhvs tshkhry vtt'ry {s}
verses.translation: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, That dwellest in the land of Uz: The cup shall pass over unto thee also; Thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּם־עֲוֺנֵךְ֙ בַּת־צִיּ֔וֹן לֹ֥א יוֹסִ֖יף לְהַגְלוֹתֵ֑ךְ פָּקַ֤ד עֲוֺנֵךְ֙ בַּת־אֱד֔וֹם גִּלָּ֖ה עַל־חַטֹּאתָֽיִךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: tm'vnkh bttsyvn l' yvsyf lhglvtkh pqd 'vnkh bt'dvm glh 'lcht'tykh {p}
verses.translation: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion, He will no more carry thee away into captivity; He will punish thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom, He will uncover thy sins.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכֹ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ מֶֽה־הָ֣יָה לָ֔נוּ (הביט) [הַבִּ֖יטָה] וּרְאֵ֥ה אֶת־חֶרְפָּתֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: zkhr yhvh mhhyh lnv (hbyt) [hbyth] vr'h 'tchrptnv
verses.translation: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us; Behold, and see our reproach.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַחֲלָתֵ֙נוּ֙ נֶֽהֶפְכָ֣ה לְזָרִ֔ים בָּתֵּ֖ינוּ לְנׇכְרִֽים׃
verses.translit: nchltnv nhpkhh lzrym btynv lnkhrym
verses.translation: Our inheritance is turned unto strangers, Our houses unto aliens.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְתוֹמִ֤ים הָיִ֙ינוּ֙ (אין) [וְאֵ֣ין] אָ֔ב אִמֹּתֵ֖ינוּ כְּאַלְמָנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: ytvmym hyynv ('yn) [v'yn] 'b 'mtynv kh'lmnvt
verses.translation: We are become orphans and fatherless, Our mothers are as widows.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵימֵ֙ינוּ֙ בְּכֶ֣סֶף שָׁתִ֔ינוּ עֵצֵ֖ינוּ בִּמְחִ֥יר יָבֹֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: mymynv bkhsf shtynv 'tsynv bmchyr yb'v
verses.translation: We have drunk our water for money; Our wood cometh to us for price.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֤ל צַוָּארֵ֙נוּ֙ נִרְדָּ֔פְנוּ יָגַ֖עְנוּ (לא) [וְלֹ֥א] הֽוּנַֽח־לָֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: 'l tsv'rnv nrdpnv yg'nv (l') [vl'] hvnchlnv
verses.translation: To our very necks we are pursued; We labour, and have no rest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ נָתַ֣נּוּ יָ֔ד אַשּׁ֖וּר לִשְׂבֹּ֥עַֽ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translit: mtsrym ntnv yd 'shvr lshb' lchm
verses.translation: We have given the hand to Egypt, And to Assyria, to have bread enough;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲבֹתֵ֤ינוּ חָֽטְאוּ֙ (אינם) [וְאֵינָ֔ם] (אנחנו) [וַאֲנַ֖חְנוּ] עֲוֺנֹתֵיהֶ֥ם סָבָֽלְנוּ׃
verses.translit: 'btynv cht'v ('ynm) [v'ynm] ('nchnv) [v'nchnv] 'vntyhm sblnv
verses.translation: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; And we have borne their iniquities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲבָדִים֙ מָ֣שְׁלוּ בָ֔נוּ פֹּרֵ֖ק אֵ֥ין מִיָּדָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'bdym mshlv bnv prq 'yn mydm
verses.translation: Servants rule over us; There is none to deliver us out of their hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנַפְשֵׁ֙נוּ֙ נָבִ֣יא לַחְמֵ֔נוּ מִפְּנֵ֖י חֶ֥רֶב הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: bnpshnv nby' lchmnv mpny chrb hmdbr
verses.translation: We get our bread with the peril of our lives Because of the sword of the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עוֹרֵ֙נוּ֙ כְּתַנּ֣וּר נִכְמָ֔רוּ מִפְּנֵ֖י זַלְעֲפ֥וֹת רָעָֽב׃
verses.translit: 'vrnv khtnvr nkhmrv mpny zl'pvt r'b
verses.translation: Our skin is hot like an oven Because of the burning heat of famine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָשִׁים֙ בְּצִיּ֣וֹן עִנּ֔וּ בְּתֻלֹ֖ת בְּעָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: nshym btsyvn 'nv btlt b'ry yhvdh
verses.translation: They have ravished the women in Zion, The maidens in the cities of Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂרִים֙ בְּיָדָ֣ם נִתְל֔וּ פְּנֵ֥י זְקֵנִ֖ים לֹ֥א נֶהְדָּֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: shrym bydm ntlv pny zqnym l' nhdrv
verses.translation: Princes are hanged up by their hand; The faces of elders are not honoured.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּחוּרִים֙ טְח֣וֹן נָשָׂ֔אוּ וּנְעָרִ֖ים בָּעֵ֥ץ כָּשָֽׁלוּ׃
verses.translit: bchvrym tchvn nsh'v vn'rym b'ts khshlv
verses.translation: The young men have borne the mill, And the children have stumbled under the wood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְקֵנִים֙ מִשַּׁ֣עַר שָׁבָ֔תוּ בַּחוּרִ֖ים מִנְּגִינָתָֽם׃
verses.translit: zqnym msh'r shbtv bchvrym mngyntm
verses.translation: The elders have ceased from the gate, The young men from their music.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁבַת֙ מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ לִבֵּ֔נוּ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְאֵ֖בֶל מְחֹלֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: shbt mshvsh lbnv nhpkh l'bl mchlnv
verses.translation: The joy of our heart is ceased; Our dance is turned into mourning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָֽפְלָה֙ עֲטֶ֣רֶת רֹאשֵׁ֔נוּ אֽוֹי־נָ֥א לָ֖נוּ כִּ֥י חָטָֽאנוּ׃
verses.translit: nplh 'trt r'shnv 'vyn' lnv khy cht'nv
verses.translation: The crown is fallen from our head; Woe unto us! for we have sinned.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־זֶ֗ה הָיָ֤ה דָוֶה֙ לִבֵּ֔נוּ עַל־אֵ֖לֶּה חָשְׁכ֥וּ עֵינֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: 'lzh hyh dvh lbnv 'l'lh chshkhv 'ynynv
verses.translation: For this our heart is faint, For these things our eyes are dim;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֤ל הַר־צִיּוֹן֙ שֶׁשָּׁמֵ֔ם שׁוּעָלִ֖ים הִלְּכוּ־בֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'l hrtsyvn shshmm shv'lym hlkhvbv {p}
verses.translation: For the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, The foxes walk upon it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ לְעוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֔ב כִּסְאֲךָ֖ לְד֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: 'th yhvh l'vlm tshb khs'kh ldvr vdvr
verses.translation: Thou, O LORD, art enthroned for ever, Thy throne is from generation to generation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה לָנֶ֙צַח֙ תִּשְׁכָּחֵ֔נוּ תַּֽעַזְבֵ֖נוּ לְאֹ֥רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: lmh lntsch tshkhchnv t'zbnv l'rkh ymym
verses.translation: Wherefore dost Thou forget us for ever, And forsake us so long time?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲשִׁיבֵ֨נוּ יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ (ונשוב) [וְֽנָשׁ֔וּבָה] חַדֵּ֥שׁ יָמֵ֖ינוּ כְּקֶֽדֶם׃
verses.translit: hshybnv yhvh  'lykh (vnshvb) [vnshvbh] chdsh ymynv khqdm
verses.translation: Turn Thou us unto Thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; Renew our days as of old.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י אִם־מָאֹ֣ס מְאַסְתָּ֔נוּ קָצַ֥פְתָּ עָלֵ֖ינוּ עַד־מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: khy 'mm's m'stnv qtspt 'lynv 'dm'd
verses.translation: Thou canst not have utterly rejected us, And be exceeding wroth against us! [Turn us unto Thee, O Lord, and we shall be turned; Renew our days as of old.]
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּבְרֵי֙ קֹהֶ֣לֶת בֶּן־דָּוִ֔ד מֶ֖לֶךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: dbry qhlt bndvd mlkh byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: THE WORDs OF the Koheleth, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲבֵ֤ל הֲבָלִים֙ אָמַ֣ר קֹהֶ֔לֶת הֲבֵ֥ל הֲבָלִ֖ים הַכֹּ֥ל הָֽבֶל׃
verses.translit: hbl hblym 'mr qhlt hbl hblym hkhl hbl
verses.translation: Vanity of vanities, saith Koheleth; Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־יִּתְר֖וֹן לָֽאָדָ֑ם בְּכׇ֨ל־עֲמָל֔וֹ שֶֽׁיַּעֲמֹ֖ל תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: mhytrvn l'dm bkhl'mlv shy'ml tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: What profit hath man of all his labour Wherein he laboureth under the sun?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דּ֤וֹר הֹלֵךְ֙ וְד֣וֹר בָּ֔א וְהָאָ֖רֶץ לְעוֹלָ֥ם עֹמָֽדֶת׃
verses.translit: dvr hlkh vdvr b' vh'rts l'vlm 'mdt
verses.translation: One generation passeth away, and another generation cometh; And the earth abideth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזָרַ֥ח הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ וּבָ֣א הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְאֶ֨ל־מְקוֹמ֔וֹ שׁוֹאֵ֛ף זוֹרֵ֥חַֽ ה֖וּא שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vzrch hshmsh vb' hshmsh v'lmqvmv shv'f zvrch hv' shm
verses.translation: The sun also ariseth, And the sun goeth down, And hasteth to his place where he ariseth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹלֵךְ֙ אֶל־דָּר֔וֹם וְסוֹבֵ֖ב אֶל־צָפ֑וֹן סוֹבֵ֤ב ׀ סֹבֵב֙ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ הָר֔וּחַ וְעַל־סְבִיבֹתָ֖יו שָׁ֥ב הָרֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: hvlkh 'ldrvm vsvbb 'ltspvn svbb  sbb hvlkh hrvch v'lsbybtyv shb hrvch
verses.translation: The wind goeth toward the south, And turneth about unto the north; It turneth about continually in its circuit, And the wind returneth again to its circuits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַנְּחָלִים֙ הֹלְכִ֣ים אֶל־הַיָּ֔ם וְהַיָּ֖ם אֵינֶ֣נּוּ מָלֵ֑א אֶל־מְק֗וֹם שֶׁ֤הַנְּחָלִים֙ הֹֽלְכִ֔ים שָׁ֛ם הֵ֥ם שָׁבִ֖ים לָלָֽכֶת׃
verses.translit: khlhnchlym hlkhym 'lhym vhym 'ynnv ml' 'lmqvm shhnchlym hlkhym shm hm shbym llkht
verses.translation: All the rivers run into the sea, Yet the sea is not full; Unto the place whither the rivers go, Thither they go again.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים יְגֵעִ֔ים לֹא־יוּכַ֥ל אִ֖ישׁ לְדַבֵּ֑ר לֹא־תִשְׂבַּ֥ע עַ֙יִן֙ לִרְא֔וֹת וְלֹא־תִמָּלֵ֥א אֹ֖זֶן מִשְּׁמֹֽעַ׃
verses.translit: khlhdbrym yg'ym l'yvkhl 'ysh ldbr l'tshb' 'yn lr'vt vl'tml' 'zn mshm'
verses.translation: All things toil to weariness; Man cannot utter it, The eye is not satisfied with seeing, Nor the ear filled with hearing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־שֶּֽׁהָיָה֙ ה֣וּא שֶׁיִּהְיֶ֔ה וּמַה־שֶּׁנַּֽעֲשָׂ֔ה ה֖וּא שֶׁיֵּעָשֶׂ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין כׇּל־חָדָ֖שׁ תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: mhshhyh hv' shyhyh vmhshn'shh hv' shy'shh v'yn khlchdsh tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: That which hath been is that which shall be, And that which hath been done is that which shall be done; And there is nothing new under the sun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֥שׁ דָּבָ֛ר שֶׁיֹּאמַ֥ר רְאֵה־זֶ֖ה חָדָ֣שׁ ה֑וּא כְּבָר֙ הָיָ֣ה לְעֹֽלָמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה מִלְּפָנֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: ysh dbr shy'mr r'hzh chdsh hv' khbr hyh l'lmym 'shr hyh mlpnnv
verses.translation: Is there a thing whereof it is said: ‘See, this is new’?—it hath been already, in the ages which were before us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֥ין זִכְר֖וֹן לָרִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וְגַ֨ם לָאַחֲרֹנִ֜ים שֶׁיִּהְי֗וּ לֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֤ה לָהֶם֙ זִכָּר֔וֹן עִ֥ם שֶׁיִּהְי֖וּ לָאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'yn zkhrvn lr'shnym vgm l'chrnym shyhyv l'yhyh lhm zkhrvn 'm shyhyv l'chrnh {p}
verses.translation: There is no remembrance of them of former times; neither shall there be any remembrance of them of latter times that are to come, among those that shall come after.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י קֹהֶ֗לֶת הָיִ֥יתִי מֶ֛לֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: 'ny qhlt hyyty mlkh 'lyshr'l byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: I Koheleth have been king over Israel in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַ֣תִּי אֶת־לִבִּ֗י לִדְר֤וֹשׁ וְלָתוּר֙ בַּֽחׇכְמָ֔ה עַ֛ל כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשָׂ֖ה תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם ה֣וּא  עִנְיַ֣ן רָ֗ע נָתַ֧ן אֱלֹהִ֛ים לִבְנֵ֥י הָאָדָ֖ם לַעֲנ֥וֹת בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vntty 'tlby ldrvsh vltvr bchkhmh 'l khl'shr n'shh tcht hshmym hv'  'nyn r' ntn 'lhym lbny h'dm l'nvt bv
verses.translation: And I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven; it is a sore task that God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised therewith.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הַֽמַּעֲשִׂ֔ים שֶֽׁנַּעֲשׂ֖וּ תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְהִנֵּ֥ה הַכֹּ֛ל הֶ֖בֶל וּרְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: r'yty 'tkhlhm'shym shn'shv tcht hshmsh vhnh hkhl hbl vr'vt rvch
verses.translation: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and a striving after wind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְעֻוָּ֖ת לֹא־יוּכַ֣ל לִתְקֹ֑ן וְחֶסְר֖וֹן לֹא־יוּכַ֥ל לְהִמָּנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: m'vt l'yvkhl ltqn vchsrvn l'yvkhl lhmnvt
verses.translation: That which is crooked cannot be made straight; And that which is wanting cannot be numbered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּבַּ֨רְתִּי אֲנִ֤י עִם־לִבִּי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אֲנִ֗י הִנֵּ֨ה הִגְדַּ֤לְתִּי וְהוֹסַ֙פְתִּי֙ חׇכְמָ֔ה עַ֛ל כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־הָיָ֥ה לְפָנַ֖י עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְלִבִּ֛י רָאָ֥ה הַרְבֵּ֖ה חׇכְמָ֥ה וָדָֽעַת׃
verses.translit: dbrty 'ny 'mlby l'mr 'ny hnh hgdlty vhvspty chkhmh 'l khl'shrhyh lpny 'lyrvshl͏m vlby r'h hrbh chkhmh vd't
verses.translation: I spoke with my own heart, saying: ‘Lo, I have gotten great wisdom, more also than all that were before me over Jerusalem’; yea, my heart hath had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶתְּנָ֤ה לִבִּי֙ לָדַ֣עַת חׇכְמָ֔ה וְדַ֥עַת הוֹלֵלֹ֖ת וְשִׂכְל֑וּת יָדַ֕עְתִּי שֶׁגַּם־זֶ֥ה ה֖וּא רַעְי֥וֹן רֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: v'tnh lby ld't chkhmh vd't hvllt vshkhlvt yd'ty shgmzh hv' r'yvn rvch
verses.translation: And I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly—I perceived that this also was a striving after wind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י בְּרֹ֥ב חׇכְמָ֖ה רׇב־כָּ֑עַס וְיוֹסִ֥יף דַּ֖עַת יוֹסִ֥יף מַכְאֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: khy brb chkhmh rbkh's vyvsyf d't yvsyf mkh'vb
verses.translation: For in much wisdom is much vexation; And he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֤רְתִּֽי אֲנִי֙ בְּלִבִּ֔י לְכָה־נָּ֛א אֲנַסְּכָ֥ה בְשִׂמְחָ֖ה וּרְאֵ֣ה בְט֑וֹב וְהִנֵּ֥ה גַם־ה֖וּא הָֽבֶל׃
verses.translit: 'mrty 'ny blby lkhhn' 'nskhh bshmchh vr'h btvb vhnh gmhv' hbl
verses.translation: I said in my heart: ‘Come now, I will try thee with mirth, and enjoy pleasure’; and, behold, this also was vanity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִשְׂח֖וֹק אָמַ֣רְתִּי מְהוֹלָ֑ל וּלְשִׂמְחָ֖ה מַה־זֹּ֥ה עֹשָֽׂה׃
verses.translit: lshchvq 'mrty mhvll vlshmchh mhzh 'shh
verses.translation: I said of laughter: ‘It is mad’; and of mirth: ‘What doth it accomplish?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֣רְתִּי בְלִבִּ֔י לִמְשׁ֥וֹךְ בַּיַּ֖יִן אֶת־בְּשָׂרִ֑י וְלִבִּ֞י נֹהֵ֤ג בַּֽחׇכְמָה֙ וְלֶאֱחֹ֣ז בְּסִכְל֔וּת עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁר־אֶרְאֶ֗ה אֵי־זֶ֨ה ט֜וֹב לִבְנֵ֤י הָאָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַעֲשׂוּ֙ תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם מִסְפַּ֖ר יְמֵ֥י חַיֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: trty blby lmshvkh byyn 'tbshry vlby nhg bchkhmh vl'chz bskhlvt 'd 'shr'r'h 'yzh tvb lbny h'dm 'shr y'shv tcht hshmym mspr ymy chyyhm
verses.translation: I searched in my heart how to pamper my flesh with wine, and, my heart conducting itself with wisdom, how yet to lay hold on folly, till I might see which it was best for the sons of men that they should do under the heaven the few days of their life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִגְדַּ֖לְתִּי מַעֲשָׂ֑י בָּנִ֤יתִי לִי֙ בָּתִּ֔ים נָטַ֥עְתִּי לִ֖י כְּרָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: hgdlty m'shy bnyty ly btym nt'ty ly khrmym
verses.translation: I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָשִׂ֣יתִי לִ֔י גַּנּ֖וֹת וּפַרְדֵּסִ֑ים וְנָטַ֥עְתִּי בָהֶ֖ם עֵ֥ץ כׇּל־פֶּֽרִי׃
verses.translit: 'shyty ly gnvt vprdsym vnt'ty bhm 'ts khlpry
verses.translation: I made me gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָשִׂ֥יתִי לִ֖י בְּרֵכ֣וֹת מָ֑יִם לְהַשְׁק֣וֹת מֵהֶ֔ם יַ֖עַר צוֹמֵ֥חַ עֵצִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'shyty ly brkhvt mym lhshqvt mhm y'r tsvmch 'tsym
verses.translation: I made me pools of water, to water therefrom the wood springing up with trees;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָנִ֙יתִי֙ עֲבָדִ֣ים וּשְׁפָח֔וֹת וּבְנֵי־בַ֖יִת הָ֣יָה לִ֑י גַּ֣ם מִקְנֶה֩ בָקָ֨ר וָצֹ֤אן הַרְבֵּה֙ הָ֣יָה לִ֔י מִכֹּ֛ל שֶֽׁהָי֥וּ לְפָנַ֖י בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: qnyty 'bdym vshpchvt vbnybyt hyh ly gm mqnh bqr vts'n hrbh hyh ly mkhl shhyv lpny byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: I acquired men-servants and maid-servants, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of herds and flocks, above all that were before me in Jerusalem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּנַ֤סְתִּי לִי֙ גַּם־כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֔ב וּסְגֻלַּ֥ת מְלָכִ֖ים וְהַמְּדִינ֑וֹת עָשִׂ֨יתִי לִ֜י שָׁרִ֣ים וְשָׁר֗וֹת וְתַעֲנֻג֛וֹת בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָ֖ם שִׁדָּ֥ה וְשִׁדּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: khnsty ly gmkhsf vzhb vsglt mlkhym vhmdynvt 'shyty ly shrym vshrvt vt'ngvt bny h'dm shdh vshdvt
verses.translation: I gathered me also silver and gold, and treasure such as kings and the provinces have as their own; I got me men-singers and women-singers, and the delights of the sons of men, women very many.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגָדַ֣לְתִּי וְהוֹסַ֔פְתִּי מִכֹּ֛ל שֶׁהָיָ֥ה לְפָנַ֖י בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם אַ֥ף חׇכְמָתִ֖י עָ֥מְדָה לִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vgdlty vhvspty mkhl shhyh lpny byrvshl͏m 'f chkhmty 'mdh ly
verses.translation: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem; also my wisdom stood me in stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָֽׁאֲל֣וּ עֵינַ֔י לֹ֥א אָצַ֖לְתִּי מֵהֶ֑ם לֹֽא־מָנַ֨עְתִּי אֶת־לִבִּ֜י מִכׇּל־שִׂמְחָ֗ה כִּֽי־לִבִּ֤י שָׂמֵ֙חַ֙ מִכׇּל־עֲמָלִ֔י וְזֶֽה־הָיָ֥ה חֶלְקִ֖י מִכׇּל־עֲמָלִֽי׃
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr sh'lv 'yny l' 'tslty mhm l'mn'ty 'tlby mkhlshmchh khylby shmch mkhl'mly vzhhyh chlqy mkhl'mly
verses.translation: And whatsoever mine eyes desired I kept not from them; I withheld not my heart from any joy, for my heart had joy of all my labour; and this was my portion from all my labour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָנִ֣יתִֽי אֲנִ֗י בְּכׇל־מַעֲשַׂי֙ שֶֽׁעָשׂ֣וּ יָדַ֔י וּבֶֽעָמָ֖ל שֶׁעָמַ֣לְתִּי לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת וְהִנֵּ֨ה הַכֹּ֥ל הֶ֙בֶל֙ וּרְע֣וּת ר֔וּחַ וְאֵ֥ין יִתְר֖וֹן תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vpnyty 'ny bkhlm'shy sh'shv ydy vb'ml sh'mlty l'shvt vhnh hkhl hbl vr'vt rvch v'yn ytrvn tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought, and on the labour that I had laboured to do; and, behold, all was vanity and a striving after wind, and there was no profit under the sun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָנִ֤יתִֽי אֲנִי֙ לִרְא֣וֹת חׇכְמָ֔ה וְהוֹלֵל֖וֹת וְסִכְל֑וּת כִּ֣י  מֶ֣ה הָאָדָ֗ם שֶׁיָּבוֹא֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־כְּבָ֖ר עָשֽׂוּהוּ׃
verses.translit: vpnyty 'ny lr'vt chkhmh vhvllvt vskhlvt khy  mh h'dm shybv' 'chry hmlkh 't 'shrkhbr 'shvhv
verses.translation: And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness and folly; for what can the man do that cometh after the king? even that which hath been already done.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאִ֣יתִי אָ֔נִי שֶׁיֵּ֥שׁ יִתְר֛וֹן לַֽחׇכְמָ֖ה מִן־הַסִּכְל֑וּת כִּֽיתְר֥וֹן הָא֖וֹר מִן־הַחֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.translit: vr'yty 'ny shysh ytrvn lchkhmh mnhskhlvt khytrvn h'vr mnhchshkh
verses.translation: Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶֽחָכָם֙ עֵינָ֣יו בְּרֹאשׁ֔וֹ וְהַכְּסִ֖יל בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ הוֹלֵ֑ךְ וְיָדַ֣עְתִּי גַם־אָ֔נִי שֶׁמִּקְרֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד יִקְרֶ֥ה אֶת־כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.translit: hchkhm 'ynyv br'shv vhkhsyl bchshkh hvlkh vyd'ty gm'ny shmqrh 'chd yqrh 'tkhlm
verses.translation: The wise man, his eyes are in his head; But the fool walketh in darkness. And I also perceived that one event happeneth to them all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַ֨רְתִּֽי אֲנִ֜י בְּלִבִּ֗י כְּמִקְרֵ֤ה הַכְּסִיל֙ גַּם־אֲנִ֣י יִקְרֵ֔נִי וְלָ֧מָּה חָכַ֛מְתִּי אֲנִ֖י אָ֣ז יֹתֵ֑ר וְדִבַּ֣רְתִּי בְלִבִּ֔י שֶׁגַּם־זֶ֖ה הָֽבֶל׃
verses.translit: v'mrty 'ny blby khmqrh hkhsyl gm'ny yqrny vlmh chkhmty 'ny 'z ytr vdbrty blby shgmzh hbl
verses.translation: Then said I in my heart: ‘As it happeneth to the fool, so will it happen even to me; and why was I then more wise?’ Then I said in my heart, that this also is vanity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ אֵ֨ין זִכְר֧וֹן לֶחָכָ֛ם עִֽם־הַכְּסִ֖יל לְעוֹלָ֑ם בְּשֶׁכְּבָ֞ר הַיָּמִ֤ים הַבָּאִים֙ הַכֹּ֣ל נִשְׁכָּ֔ח וְאֵ֛יךְ יָמ֥וּת הֶחָכָ֖ם עִֽם־הַכְּסִֽיל׃
verses.translit: khy 'yn zkhrvn lchkhm 'mhkhsyl l'vlm bshkhbr hymym hb'ym hkhl nshkhch v'ykh ymvt hchkhm 'mhkhsyl
verses.translation: For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no remembrance for ever; seeing that in the days to come all will long ago have been forgotten. And how must the wise man die even as the fool!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׂנֵ֙אתִי֙ אֶת־הַ֣חַיִּ֔ים כִּ֣י רַ֤ע עָלַי֙ הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂ֖ה תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ כִּֽי־הַכֹּ֥ל הֶ֖בֶל וּרְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: vshn'ty 'thchyym khy r' 'ly hm'shh shn'shh tcht hshmsh khyhkhl hbl vr'vt rvch
verses.translation: So I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun was grievous unto me; for all is vanity and a striving after wind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׂנֵ֤אתִֽי אֲנִי֙ אֶת־כׇּל־עֲמָלִ֔י שֶׁאֲנִ֥י עָמֵ֖ל תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ שֶׁ֣אַנִּיחֶ֔נּוּ לָאָדָ֖ם שֶׁיִּהְיֶ֥ה אַחֲרָֽי׃
verses.translit: vshn'ty 'ny 'tkhl'mly sh'ny 'ml tcht hshmsh sh'nychnv l'dm shyhyh 'chry
verses.translation: And I hated all my labour wherein I laboured under the sun, seeing that I must leave it unto the man that shall be after me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִ֣י יוֹדֵ֗עַ הֶֽחָכָ֤ם יִהְיֶה֙ א֣וֹ סָכָ֔ל וְיִשְׁלַט֙ בְּכׇל־עֲמָלִ֔י שֶֽׁעָמַ֥לְתִּי וְשֶׁחָכַ֖מְתִּי תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ גַּם־זֶ֖ה הָֽבֶל׃
verses.translit: vmy yvd' hchkhm yhyh 'v skhl vyshlt bkhl'mly sh'mlty vshchkhmty tcht hshmsh gmzh hbl
verses.translation: And who knoweth whether he will be a wise man or a fool? yet will he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, and wherein I have shown myself wise under the sun. This also is vanity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסַבּ֥וֹתִֽי אֲנִ֖י לְיַאֵ֣שׁ אֶת־לִבִּ֑י עַ֚ל כׇּל־הֶ֣עָמָ֔ל שֶׁעָמַ֖לְתִּי תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vsbvty 'ny ly'sh 'tlby 'l khlh'ml sh'mlty tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: Therefore I turned about to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labour wherein I had laboured under the sun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־יֵ֣שׁ אָדָ֗ם שֶׁעֲמָל֛וֹ בְּחׇכְמָ֥ה וּבְדַ֖עַת וּבְכִשְׁר֑וֹן וּלְאָדָ֞ם שֶׁלֹּ֤א עָֽמַל־בּוֹ֙ יִתְּנֶ֣נּוּ חֶלְק֔וֹ גַּם־זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וְרָעָ֥ה רַבָּֽה׃
verses.translit: khyysh 'dm sh'mlv bchkhmh vbd't vbkhshrvn vl'dm shl' 'mlbv ytnnv chlqv gmzh hbl vr'h rbh
verses.translation: For there is a man whose labour is with wisdom, and with knowledge, and with skill; yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it for his portion. This also is vanity and a great evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֠י מֶֽה־הֹוֶ֤ה לָֽאָדָם֙ בְּכׇל־עֲמָל֔וֹ וּבְרַעְי֖וֹן לִבּ֑וֹ שְׁה֥וּא עָמֵ֖ל תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: khy mhhvh l'dm bkhl'mlv vbr'yvn lbv shhv' 'ml tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: For what hath a man of all his labour, and of the striving of his heart, wherein he laboureth under the sun?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֧י כׇל־יָמָ֣יו מַכְאֹבִ֗ים וָכַ֙עַס֙ עִנְיָנ֔וֹ גַּם־בַּלַּ֖יְלָה לֹא־שָׁכַ֣ב לִבּ֑וֹ גַּם־זֶ֖ה הֶ֥בֶל הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: khy khlymyv mkh'bym vkh's 'nynv gmblylh l'shkhb lbv gmzh hbl hv'
verses.translation: For all his days are pains, and his occupation vexation; yea, even in the night his heart taketh not rest. This also is vanity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵֽין־ט֤וֹב בָּאָדָם֙ שֶׁיֹּאכַ֣ל וְשָׁתָ֔ה וְהֶרְאָ֧ה אֶת־נַפְשׁ֛וֹ ט֖וֹב בַּעֲמָל֑וֹ גַּם־זֹה֙ רָאִ֣יתִי אָ֔נִי כִּ֛י מִיַּ֥ד הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים הִֽיא׃
verses.translit: 'yntvb b'dm shy'khl vshth vhr'h 'tnpshv tvb b'mlv gmzh r'yty 'ny khy myd h'lhym hy'
verses.translation: There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy pleasure for his labour. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִ֥י יֹאכַ֛ל וּמִ֥י יָח֖וּשׁ ח֥וּץ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: khy my y'khl vmy ychvsh chvts mmny
verses.translation: For who will eat, or who will enjoy, if not I?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לְאָדָם֙ שֶׁטּ֣וֹב לְפָנָ֔יו נָתַ֛ן חׇכְמָ֥ה וְדַ֖עַת וְשִׂמְחָ֑ה וְלַחוֹטֶא֩ נָתַ֨ן עִנְיָ֜ן לֶאֱסֹ֣ף וְלִכְנ֗וֹס לָתֵת֙ לְטוֹב֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים גַּם־זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וּרְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: khy l'dm shtvb lpnyv ntn chkhmh vd't vshmchh vlchvt' ntn 'nyn l'sf vlkhnvs ltt ltvb lpny h'lhym gmzh hbl vr'vt rvch
verses.translation: For to the man that is good in His sight He giveth wisdom, and knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner He giveth the task, to gather and to heap up, that he may leave to him that is good in the sight of God. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַכֹּ֖ל זְמָ֑ן וְעֵ֥ת לְכׇל־חֵ֖פֶץ תַּ֥חַת הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lkhl zmn v't lkhlchpts tcht hshmym {s}
verses.translation: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֥ת לָלֶ֖דֶת וְעֵ֣ת לָמ֑וּת עֵ֣ת לָטַ֔עַת וְעֵ֖ת לַעֲק֥וֹר נָטֽוּעַ׃
verses.translit: 't lldt v't lmvt 't lt't v't l'qvr ntv'
verses.translation: A time to be born, and a time to die; A time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֤ת לַהֲרוֹג֙ וְעֵ֣ת לִרְפּ֔וֹא עֵ֥ת לִפְר֖וֹץ וְעֵ֥ת לִבְנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 't lhrvg v't lrpv' 't lprvts v't lbnvt
verses.translation: A time to kill, and a time to heal; A time to break down, and a time to build up;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֤ת לִבְכּוֹת֙ וְעֵ֣ת לִשְׂח֔וֹק עֵ֥ת סְפ֖וֹד וְעֵ֥ת רְקֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: 't lbkhvt v't lshchvq 't spvd v't rqvd
verses.translation: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; A time to mourn, and a time to dance;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֚ת לְהַשְׁלִ֣יךְ אֲבָנִ֔ים וְעֵ֖ת כְּנ֣וֹס אֲבָנִ֑ים עֵ֣ת לַחֲב֔וֹק וְעֵ֖ת לִרְחֹ֥ק מֵחַבֵּֽק׃
verses.translit: 't lhshlykh 'bnym v't khnvs 'bnym 't lchbvq v't lrchq mchbq
verses.translation: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; A time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֤ת לְבַקֵּשׁ֙ וְעֵ֣ת לְאַבֵּ֔ד עֵ֥ת לִשְׁמ֖וֹר וְעֵ֥ת לְהַשְׁלִֽיךְ׃
verses.translit: 't lbqsh v't l'bd 't lshmvr v't lhshlykh
verses.translation: A time to seek, and a time to lose; A time to keep, and a time to cast away;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֤ת לִקְר֙וֹעַ֙ וְעֵ֣ת לִתְפּ֔וֹר עֵ֥ת לַחֲשׁ֖וֹת וְעֵ֥ת לְדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: 't lqrv' v't ltpvr 't lchshvt v't ldbr
verses.translation: A time to rend, and a time to sew; A time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֤ת לֶֽאֱהֹב֙ וְעֵ֣ת לִשְׂנֹ֔א עֵ֥ת מִלְחָמָ֖ה וְעֵ֥ת שָׁלֽוֹם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 't l'hb v't lshn' 't mlchmh v't shlvm {s}
verses.translation: A time to love, and a time to hate; A time for war, and a time for peace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־יִּתְרוֹן֙ הָֽעוֹשֶׂ֔ה בַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר ה֥וּא עָמֵֽל׃
verses.translit: mhytrvn h'vshh b'shr hv' 'ml
verses.translation: What profit hath he that worketh in that he laboureth?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאִ֣יתִי אֶת־הָֽעִנְיָ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧ן אֱלֹהִ֛ים לִבְנֵ֥י הָאָדָ֖ם לַעֲנ֥וֹת בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: r'yty 'th'nyn 'shr ntn 'lhym lbny h'dm l'nvt bv
verses.translation: I have seen the task which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised therewith.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־הַכֹּ֥ל עָשָׂ֖ה יָפֶ֣ה בְעִתּ֑וֹ גַּ֤ם אֶת־הָעֹלָם֙ נָתַ֣ן בְּלִבָּ֔ם מִבְּלִ֞י אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־יִמְצָ֣א הָאָדָ֗ם אֶת־הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֥ה הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים מֵרֹ֥אשׁ וְעַד־סֽוֹף׃
verses.translit: 'thkhl 'shh yph b'tv gm 'th'lm ntn blbm mbly 'shr l'ymts' h'dm 'thm'shh 'shr'shh h'lhym mr'sh v'dsvf
verses.translation: He hath made every thing beautiful in its time; also He hath set the world in their heart, yet so that man cannot find out the work that God hath done from the beginning even to the end.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין ט֖וֹב בָּ֑ם כִּ֣י אִם־לִשְׂמ֔וֹחַ וְלַעֲשׂ֥וֹת ט֖וֹב בְּחַיָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: yd'ty khy 'yn tvb bm khy 'mlshmvch vl'shvt tvb bchyyv
verses.translation: I know that there is nothing better for them, than to rejoice, and to get pleasure so long as they live.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֤ם כׇּל־הָאָדָם֙ שֶׁיֹּאכַ֣ל וְשָׁתָ֔ה וְרָאָ֥ה ט֖וֹב בְּכׇל־עֲמָל֑וֹ מַתַּ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֖ים הִֽיא׃
verses.translit: vgm khlh'dm shy'khl vshth vr'h tvb bkhl'mlv mtt 'lhym hy'
verses.translation: But also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy pleasure for all his labour, is the gift of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֠י כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה הָאֱלֹהִים֙ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה לְעוֹלָ֔ם עָלָיו֙ אֵ֣ין לְהוֹסִ֔יף וּמִמֶּ֖נּוּ אֵ֣ין לִגְרֹ֑עַ וְהָאֱלֹהִ֣ים עָשָׂ֔ה שֶׁיִּֽרְא֖וּ מִלְּפָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: yd'ty khy khl'shr y'shh h'lhym hv' yhyh l'vlm 'lyv 'yn lhvsyf vmmnv 'yn lgr' vh'lhym 'shh shyr'v mlpnyv
verses.translation: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever; nothing can be added to it, nor any thing taken from it; and God hath so made it, that men should fear before Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־שֶּֽׁהָיָה֙ כְּבָ֣ר ה֔וּא וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לִהְי֖וֹת כְּבָ֣ר הָיָ֑ה וְהָאֱלֹהִ֖ים יְבַקֵּ֥שׁ אֶת־נִרְדָּֽף׃
verses.translit: mhshhyh khbr hv' v'shr lhyvt khbr hyh vh'lhym ybqsh 'tnrdf
verses.translation: That which is hath been long ago, and that which is to be hath already been; and God seeketh that which is pursued.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְע֥וֹד רָאִ֖יתִי תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ מְק֤וֹם הַמִּשְׁפָּט֙ שָׁ֣מָּה הָרֶ֔שַׁע וּמְק֥וֹם הַצֶּ֖דֶק שָׁ֥מָּה הָרָֽשַׁע׃
verses.translit: v'vd r'yty tcht hshmsh mqvm hmshpt shmh hrsh' vmqvm htsdq shmh hrsh'
verses.translation: And moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֤רְתִּֽי אֲנִי֙ בְּלִבִּ֔י אֶת־הַצַּדִּיק֙ וְאֶת־הָ֣רָשָׁ֔ע יִשְׁפֹּ֖ט הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּי־עֵ֣ת לְכׇל־חֵ֔פֶץ וְעַ֥ל כׇּל־הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: 'mrty 'ny blby 'thtsdyq v'thrsh' yshpt h'lhym khy't lkhlchpts v'l khlhm'shh shm
verses.translation: I said in my heart: ‘The righteous and the wicked God will judge; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֤רְתִּֽי אֲנִי֙ בְּלִבִּ֔י עַל־דִּבְרַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י הָאָדָ֔ם לְבָרָ֖ם הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְלִרְא֕וֹת שְׁהֶם־בְּהֵמָ֥ה הֵ֖מָּה לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mrty 'ny blby 'ldbrt bny h'dm lbrm h'lhym vlr'vt shhmbhmh hmh lhm
verses.translation: I said in my heart: ‘It is because of the sons of men, that God may sift them, and that they may see that they themselves are but as beasts.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ מִקְרֶ֨ה בְֽנֵי־הָאָדָ֜ם וּמִקְרֶ֣ה הַבְּהֵמָ֗ה וּמִקְרֶ֤ה אֶחָד֙ לָהֶ֔ם כְּמ֥וֹת זֶה֙ כֵּ֣ן מ֣וֹת זֶ֔ה וְר֥וּחַ אֶחָ֖ד לַכֹּ֑ל וּמוֹתַ֨ר הָאָדָ֤ם מִן־הַבְּהֵמָה֙ אָ֔יִן כִּ֥י הַכֹּ֖ל הָֽבֶל׃
verses.translit: khy mqrh bnyh'dm vmqrh hbhmh vmqrh 'chd lhm khmvt zh khn mvt zh vrvch 'chd lkhl vmvtr h'dm mnhbhmh 'yn khy hkhl hbl
verses.translation: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them; as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that man hath no pre-eminence above a beast; for all is vanity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַכֹּ֥ל הוֹלֵ֖ךְ אֶל־מָק֣וֹם אֶחָ֑ד הַכֹּל֙ הָיָ֣ה מִן־הֶֽעָפָ֔ר וְהַכֹּ֖ל שָׁ֥ב אֶל־הֶעָפָֽר׃
verses.translit: hkhl hvlkh 'lmqvm 'chd hkhl hyh mnh'pr vhkhl shb 'lh'pr
verses.translation: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all return to dust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֣י יוֹדֵ֗עַ ר֚וּחַ בְּנֵ֣י הָאָדָ֔ם הָעֹלָ֥ה הִ֖יא לְמָ֑עְלָה וְר֙וּחַ֙ הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה הַיֹּרֶ֥דֶת הִ֖יא לְמַ֥טָּה לָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: my yvd' rvch bny h'dm h'lh hy' lm'lh vrvch hbhmh hyrdt hy' lmth l'rts
verses.translation: Who knoweth the spirit of man whether it goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast whether it goeth downward to the earth?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאִ֗יתִי כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין טוֹב֙ מֵאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׂמַ֤ח הָאָדָם֙ בְּֽמַעֲשָׂ֔יו כִּי־ה֖וּא חֶלְק֑וֹ כִּ֣י מִ֤י יְבִיאֶ֙נּוּ֙ לִרְא֔וֹת בְּמֶ֖ה שֶׁיִּהְיֶ֥ה אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vr'yty khy 'yn tvb m'shr yshmch h'dm bm'shyv khyhv' chlqv khy my yby'nv lr'vt bmh shyhyh 'chryv
verses.translation: Wherefore I perceived that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his works; for that is his portion; for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁ֣בְתִּֽי אֲנִ֗י וָאֶרְאֶה֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הָ֣עֲשֻׁקִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשִׂ֖ים תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְהִנֵּ֣ה  דִּמְעַ֣ת הָעֲשֻׁקִ֗ים וְאֵ֤ין לָהֶם֙ מְנַחֵ֔ם וּמִיַּ֤ד עֹֽשְׁקֵיהֶם֙ כֹּ֔חַ וְאֵ֥ין לָהֶ֖ם מְנַחֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vshbty 'ny v'r'h 'tkhlh'shqym 'shr n'shym tcht hshmsh vhnh  dm't h'shqym v'yn lhm mnchm vmyd 'shqyhm khch v'yn lhm mnchm
verses.translation: But I returned and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun; and behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power, but they had no comforter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁבֵּ֧חַ אֲנִ֛י אֶת־הַמֵּתִ֖ים שֶׁכְּבָ֣ר מֵ֑תוּ מִן־הַ֣חַיִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥מָּה חַיִּ֖ים עֲדֶֽנָה׃
verses.translit: vshbch 'ny 'thmtym shkhbr mtv mnhchyym 'shr hmh chyym 'dnh
verses.translation: Wherefore I praised the dead that are already dead more than the living that are yet alive;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְטוֹב֙ מִשְּׁנֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־עֲדֶ֖ן לֹ֣א הָיָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־רָאָה֙ אֶת־הַמַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה הָרָ֔ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשָׂ֖ה תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vtvb mshnyhm 't 'shr'dn l' hyh 'shr l'r'h 'thm'shh hr' 'shr n'shh tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: but better than they both is he that hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאִ֨יתִֽי אֲנִ֜י אֶת־כׇּל־עָמָ֗ל וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־כִּשְׁר֣וֹן הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה כִּ֛י הִ֥יא קִנְאַת־אִ֖ישׁ מֵרֵעֵ֑הוּ גַּם־זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וּרְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: vr'yty 'ny 'tkhl'ml v't khlkhshrvn hm'shh khy hy' qn't'ysh mr'hv gmzh hbl vr'vt rvch
verses.translation: Again, I considered all labour and all excelling in work, that it is a man’s rivalry with his neighbour. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַכְּסִיל֙ חֹבֵ֣ק אֶת־יָדָ֔יו וְאֹכֵ֖ל אֶת־בְּשָׂרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hkhsyl chbq 'tydyv v'khl 'tbshrv
verses.translation: The fool foldeth his hands together, And eateth his own flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֕וֹב מְלֹ֥א כַ֖ף נָ֑חַת מִמְּלֹ֥א חׇפְנַ֛יִם עָמָ֖ל וּרְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: tvb ml' khf ncht mml' chpnym 'ml vr'vt rvch
verses.translation: Better is a handful of quietness, Than both the hands full of labour and striving after wind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁ֧בְתִּי אֲנִ֛י וָאֶרְאֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vshbty 'ny v'r'h hbl tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ אֶחָד֩ וְאֵ֨ין שֵׁנִ֜י גַּ֣ם בֵּ֧ן וָאָ֣ח אֵֽין־ל֗וֹ וְאֵ֥ין קֵץ֙ לְכׇל־עֲמָל֔וֹ גַּם־[עֵינ֖וֹ] (עיניו) לֹא־תִשְׂבַּ֣ע עֹ֑שֶׁר וּלְמִ֣י  אֲנִ֣י עָמֵ֗ל וּמְחַסֵּ֤ר אֶת־נַפְשִׁי֙ מִטּוֹבָ֔ה גַּם־זֶ֥ה הֶ֛בֶל וְעִנְיַ֥ן רָ֖ע הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: ysh 'chd v'yn shny gm bn v'ch 'ynlv v'yn qts lkhl'mlv gm['ynv] ('ynyv) l'tshb' 'shr vlmy  'ny 'ml vmchsr 'tnpshy mtvbh gmzh hbl v'nyn r' hv'
verses.translation: There is one that is alone, and he hath not a second; yea, he hath neither son nor brother; yet is there no end of all his labour, neither is his eye satisfied with riches: ‘for whom then do I labour, and bereave my soul of pleasure?’ This also is vanity, yea, it is a grievous business.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טוֹבִ֥ים הַשְּׁנַ֖יִם מִן־הָאֶחָ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵשׁ־לָהֶ֛ם שָׂכָ֥ר ט֖וֹב בַּעֲמָלָֽם׃
verses.translit: tvbym hshnym mnh'chd 'shr yshlhm shkhr tvb b'mlm
verses.translation: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־יִפֹּ֔לוּ הָאֶחָ֖ד יָקִ֣ים אֶת־חֲבֵר֑וֹ וְאִ֣יל֗וֹ הָֽאֶחָד֙ שֶׁיִּפּ֔וֹל וְאֵ֥ין שֵׁנִ֖י לַהֲקִימֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy 'myplv h'chd yqym 'tchbrv v'ylv h'chd shypvl v'yn shny lhqymv
verses.translation: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him that is alone when he falleth, and hath not another to lift him up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֛ם אִם־יִשְׁכְּב֥וּ שְׁנַ֖יִם וְחַ֣ם לָהֶ֑ם וּלְאֶחָ֖ד אֵ֥יךְ יֵחָֽם׃
verses.translit: gm 'myshkhbv shnym vchm lhm vl'chd 'ykh ychm
verses.translation: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one be warm alone?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִֽם־יִתְקְפוֹ֙ הָאֶחָ֔ד הַשְּׁנַ֖יִם יַעַמְד֣וּ נֶגְדּ֑וֹ וְהַחוּט֙ הַֽמְשֻׁלָּ֔שׁ לֹ֥א בִמְהֵרָ֖ה יִנָּתֵֽק׃
verses.translit: v'mytqpv h'chd hshnym y'mdv ngdv vhchvt hmshlsh l' bmhrh yntq
verses.translation: And if a man prevail against him that is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֛וֹב יֶ֥לֶד מִסְכֵּ֖ן וְחָכָ֑ם מִמֶּ֤לֶךְ זָקֵן֙ וּכְסִ֔יל אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־יָדַ֥ע לְהִזָּהֵ֖ר עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: tvb yld mskhn vchkhm mmlkh zqn vkhsyl 'shr l'yd' lhzhr 'vd
verses.translation: Better is a poor and wise child than an old and foolish king, who knoweth not how to receive admonition any more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־מִבֵּ֥ית הָסוּרִ֖ים יָצָ֣א לִמְלֹ֑ךְ כִּ֛י גַּ֥ם בְּמַלְכוּת֖וֹ נוֹלַ֥ד רָֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: khymbyt hsvrym yts' lmlkh khy gm bmlkhvtv nvld rsh
verses.translation: For out of prison he came forth to be king; although in his kingdom he was born poor.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הַ֣חַיִּ֔ים הַֽמְהַלְּכִ֖ים תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ עִ֚ם הַיֶּ֣לֶד הַשֵּׁנִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲמֹ֖ד תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: r'yty 'tkhlhchyym hmhlkhym tcht hshmsh 'm hyld hshny 'shr y'md tchtyv
verses.translation: I saw all the living that walk under the sun, that they were with the child, the second, that was to stand up in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵֽין־קֵ֣ץ לְכׇל־הָעָ֗ם לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־הָיָה֙ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם גַּ֥ם הָאַחֲרוֹנִ֖ים לֹ֣א יִשְׂמְחוּ־ב֑וֹ כִּֽי־גַם־זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וְרַעְי֥וֹן רֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: 'ynqts lkhlh'm lkhl 'shrhyh lpnyhm gm h'chrvnym l' yshmchvbv khygmzh hbl vr'yvn rvch
verses.translation: There was no end of all the people, even of all them whom he did lead; yet they that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a striving after wind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמֹ֣ר (רגליך) [רַגְלְךָ֗] כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר תֵּלֵךְ֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְקָר֣וֹב לִשְׁמֹ֔עַ מִתֵּ֥ת הַכְּסִילִ֖ים זָ֑בַח כִּֽי־אֵינָ֥ם יוֹדְעִ֖ים לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת רָֽע׃
verses.translit: shmr (rglykh) [rglkh] kh'shr tlkh 'lbyt h'lhym vqrvb lshm' mtt hkhsylym zbch khy'ynm yvd'ym l'shvt r'
verses.translation: Guard thy foot when thou goest to the house of God, and be ready to hearken: it is better than when fools give sacrifices; for they know not that they do evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תְּבַהֵ֨ל עַל־פִּ֜יךָ וְלִבְּךָ֧ אַל־יְמַהֵ֛ר לְהוֹצִ֥יא דָבָ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֤ים בַּשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְאַתָּ֣ה עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ עַל־כֵּ֛ן יִהְי֥וּ דְבָרֶ֖יךָ מְעַטִּֽים׃
verses.translit: 'ltbhl 'lpykh vlbkh 'lymhr lhvtsy' dbr lpny h'lhym khy h'lhym bshmym v'th 'lh'rts 'lkhn yhyv dbrykh m'tym
verses.translation: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thy heart be hasty to utter a word before God; for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth; therefore let thy words be few.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י בָּ֥א הַחֲל֖וֹם בְּרֹ֣ב עִנְיָ֑ן וְק֥וֹל כְּסִ֖יל בְּרֹ֥ב דְּבָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy b' hchlvm brb 'nyn vqvl khsyl brb dbrym
verses.translation: For a dream cometh through a multitude of business; And a fool’s voice through a multitude of words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ תִּדֹּ֨ר נֶ֜דֶר לֵֽאלֹהִ֗ים אַל־תְּאַחֵר֙ לְשַׁלְּמ֔וֹ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין חֵ֖פֶץ בַּכְּסִילִ֑ים אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־תִּדֹּ֖ר שַׁלֵּֽם׃
verses.translit: kh'shr tdr ndr l'lhym 'lt'chr lshlmv khy 'yn chpts bkhsylym 't 'shrtdr shlm
verses.translation: When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for He hath no pleasure in fools; pay that which thou vowest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֖וֹב אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־תִדֹּ֑ר מִשֶּׁתִּדּ֖וֹר וְלֹ֥א תְשַׁלֵּֽם׃
verses.translit: tvb 'shr l'tdr mshtdvr vl' tshlm
verses.translation: Better is it that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת־פִּ֙יךָ֙ לַחֲטִ֣יא אֶת־בְּשָׂרֶ֔ךָ וְאַל־תֹּאמַר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַמַּלְאָ֔ךְ כִּ֥י שְׁגָגָ֖ה הִ֑יא לָ֣מָּה יִקְצֹ֤ף הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ עַל־קוֹלֶ֔ךָ וְחִבֵּ֖ל אֶת־מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'lttn 'tpykh lchty' 'tbshrkh v'lt'mr lpny hml'kh khy shggh hy' lmh yqtsf h'lhym 'lqvlkh vchbl 'tm'shh ydykh
verses.translation: Suffer not thy mouth to bring thy flesh into guilt, neither say thou before the messenger, that it was an error; wherefore should God be angry at thy voice, and destroy the work of thy hands?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְרֹ֤ב חֲלֹמוֹת֙ וַהֲבָלִ֔ים וּדְבָרִ֖ים הַרְבֵּ֑ה כִּ֥י אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים יְרָֽא׃
verses.translit: khy brb chlmvt vhblym vdbrym hrbh khy 'th'lhym yr'
verses.translation: For through the multitude of dreams and vanities there are also many words; but fear thou God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־עֹ֣שֶׁק רָ֠שׁ וְגֵ֨זֶל מִשְׁפָּ֤ט וָצֶ֙דֶק֙ תִּרְאֶ֣ה בַמְּדִינָ֔ה אַל־תִּתְמַ֖הּ עַל־הַחֵ֑פֶץ כִּ֣י גָבֹ֜הַּ מֵעַ֤ל גָּבֹ֙הַּ֙ שֹׁמֵ֔ר וּגְבֹהִ֖ים עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'm'shq rsh vgzl mshpt vtsdq tr'h bmdynh 'lttmh 'lhchpts khy gbh m'l gbh shmr vgbhym 'lyhm
verses.translation: If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and the violent perverting of justice and righteousness in the state, marvel not at the matter; for one higher than the high watcheth, and there are higher than they.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִתְר֥וֹן אֶ֖רֶץ בַּכֹּ֣ל (היא) [ה֑וּא] מֶ֥לֶךְ לְשָׂדֶ֖ה נֶעֱבָֽד׃
verses.translit: vytrvn 'rts bkhl (hy') [hv'] mlkh lshdh n'bd
verses.translation: But the profit of a land every way is a king that maketh himself servant to the field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹהֵ֥ב כֶּ֙סֶף֙ לֹא־יִשְׂבַּ֣ע כֶּ֔סֶף וּמִֽי־אֹהֵ֥ב בֶּהָמ֖וֹן לֹ֣א תְבוּאָ֑ה גַּם־זֶ֖ה הָֽבֶל׃
verses.translit: 'hb khsf l'yshb' khsf vmy'hb bhmvn l' tbv'h gmzh hbl
verses.translation: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance, with increase; this also is vanity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּרְבוֹת֙ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה רַבּ֖וּ אוֹכְלֶ֑יהָ וּמַה־כִּשְׁרוֹן֙ לִבְעָלֶ֔יהָ כִּ֖י אִם־[רְא֥וּת] (ראית) עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.translit: brbvt htvbh rbv 'vkhlyh vmhkhshrvn lb'lyh khy 'm[r'vt] (r'yt) 'ynyv
verses.translation: When goods increase, they are increased that eat them; and what advantage is there to the owner thereof, saving the beholding of them with his eyes?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְתוּקָה֙ שְׁנַ֣ת הָעֹבֵ֔ד אִם־מְעַ֥ט וְאִם־הַרְבֵּ֖ה יֹאכֵ֑ל וְהַשָּׂבָע֙ לֶֽעָשִׁ֔יר אֵינֶ֛נּוּ מַנִּ֥יחַֽ ל֖וֹ לִישֽׁוֹן׃
verses.translit: mtvqh shnt h'bd 'mm't v'mhrbh y'khl vhshb' l'shyr 'ynnv mnych lv lyshvn
verses.translation: Sweet is the sleep of a labouring man, whether he eat little or much; but the satiety of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֚שׁ רָעָ֣ה חוֹלָ֔ה רָאִ֖יתִי תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ עֹ֛שֶׁר שָׁמ֥וּר לִבְעָלָ֖יו לְרָעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: ysh r'h chvlh r'yty tcht hshmsh 'shr shmvr lb'lyv lr'tv
verses.translation: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun, namely, riches kept by the owner thereof to his hurt;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָבַ֛ד הָעֹ֥שֶׁר הַה֖וּא בְּעִנְיַ֣ן רָ֑ע וְהוֹלִ֣יד בֵּ֔ן וְאֵ֥ין בְּיָד֖וֹ מְאֽוּמָה׃
verses.translit: v'bd h'shr hhv' b'nyn r' vhvlyd bn v'yn bydv m'vmh
verses.translation: and those riches perish by evil adventure; and if he hath begotten a son, there is nothing in his hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר יָצָא֙ מִבֶּ֣טֶן אִמּ֔וֹ עָר֛וֹם יָשׁ֥וּב לָלֶ֖כֶת כְּשֶׁבָּ֑א וּמְא֙וּמָה֙ לֹא־יִשָּׂ֣א בַעֲמָל֔וֹ שֶׁיֹּלֵ֖ךְ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: kh'shr yts' mbtn 'mv 'rvm yshvb llkht khshb' vm'vmh l'ysh' b'mlv shylkh bydv
verses.translation: As he came forth of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go back as he came, and shall take nothing for his labour, which he may carry away in his hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־זֹה֙ רָעָ֣ה חוֹלָ֔ה כׇּל־עֻמַּ֥ת שֶׁבָּ֖א כֵּ֣ן יֵלֵ֑ךְ וּמַה־יִּתְר֣וֹן ל֔וֹ שֶֽׁיַּעֲמֹ֖ל לָרֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: vgmzh r'h chvlh khl'mt shb' khn ylkh vmhytrvn lv shy'ml lrvch
verses.translation: And this also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go; and what profit hath he that he laboureth for the wind?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֥ם כׇּל־יָמָ֖יו בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ יֹאכֵ֑ל וְכָעַ֥ס הַרְבֵּ֖ה וְחׇלְי֥וֹ וָקָֽצֶף׃
verses.translit: gm khlymyv bchshkh y'khl vkh's hrbh vchlyv vqtsf
verses.translation: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he hath much vexation and sickness and wrath. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־רָאִ֣יתִי אָ֗נִי ט֣וֹב אֲשֶׁר־יָפֶ֣ה לֶֽאֱכוֹל־וְ֠לִשְׁתּ֠וֹת וְלִרְא֨וֹת טוֹבָ֜ה בְּכׇל־עֲמָל֣וֹ  שֶׁיַּעֲמֹ֣ל תַּֽחַת־הַשֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ מִסְפַּ֧ר יְמֵי־חַיָּ֛ו אֲשֶׁר־נָֽתַן־ל֥וֹ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־ה֥וּא חֶלְקֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hnh 'shrr'yty 'ny tvb 'shryph l'khvlvlshtvt vlr'vt tvbh bkhl'mlv  shy'ml tchthshmsh mspr ymychyv 'shrntnlv h'lhym khyhv' chlqv
verses.translation: Behold that which I have seen: it is good, yea, it is comely for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy pleasure for all his labour, wherein he laboureth under the sun, all the days of his life which God hath given him; for this is his portion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֣ם כׇּֽל־הָאָדָ֡ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָֽתַן־ל֣וֹ הָאֱלֹהִים֩ עֹ֨שֶׁר וּנְכָסִ֜ים וְהִשְׁלִיט֨וֹ לֶאֱכֹ֤ל מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ וְלָשֵׂ֣את אֶת־חֶלְק֔וֹ וְלִשְׂמֹ֖חַ בַּעֲמָל֑וֹ זֹ֕ה מַתַּ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֖ים הִֽיא׃
verses.translit: gm khlh'dm 'shr ntnlv h'lhym 'shr vnkhsym vhshlytv l'khl mmnv vlsh't 'tchlqv vlshmch b'mlv zh mtt 'lhym hy'
verses.translation: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth, and hath given him power to eat thereof, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labour—this is the gift of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י לֹ֣א הַרְבֵּ֔ה יִזְכֹּ֖ר אֶת־יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֑יו כִּ֧י הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים מַעֲנֶ֖ה בְּשִׂמְחַ֥ת לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy l' hrbh yzkhr 'tymy chyyv khy h'lhym m'nh bshmcht lbv
verses.translation: For let him remember the days of his life that they are not many; for God answereth him in the joy of his heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֖יתִי תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְרַבָּ֥ה הִ֖יא עַל־הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: ysh r'h 'shr r'yty tcht hshmsh vrbh hy' 'lh'dm
verses.translation: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is heavy upon men:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִתֶּן־ל֣וֹ הָאֱלֹהִ֡ים עֹ֩שֶׁר֩ וּנְכָסִ֨ים וְכָב֜וֹד וְֽאֵינֶ֨נּוּ חָסֵ֥ר לְנַפְשׁ֣וֹ  מִכֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־יִתְאַוֶּ֗ה וְלֹֽא־יַשְׁלִיטֶ֤נּוּ הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ לֶאֱכֹ֣ל מִמֶּ֔נּוּ כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ נׇכְרִ֖י יֹֽאכְלֶ֑נּוּ זֶ֥ה הֶ֛בֶל וׇחֳלִ֥י רָ֖ע הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: 'ysh 'shr ytnlv h'lhym 'shr vnkhsym vkhbvd v'ynnv chsr lnpshv  mkhl 'shryt'vh vl'yshlytnv h'lhym l'khl mmnv khy 'ysh nkhry y'khlnv zh hbl vchly r' hv'
verses.translation: a man to whom God giveth riches, wealth, and honour, so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth, yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof, but a stranger eateth it; this is vanity, and it is an evil disease.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יוֹלִ֣יד אִ֣ישׁ מֵאָ֡ה וְשָׁנִים֩ רַבּ֨וֹת יִֽחְיֶ֜ה וְרַ֣ב  שֶׁיִּהְי֣וּ יְמֵֽי־שָׁנָ֗יו וְנַפְשׁוֹ֙ לֹא־תִשְׂבַּ֣ע מִן־הַטּוֹבָ֔ה וְגַם־קְבוּרָ֖ה לֹא־הָ֣יְתָה לּ֑וֹ אָמַ֕רְתִּי ט֥וֹב מִמֶּ֖נּוּ הַנָּֽפֶל׃
verses.translit: 'myvlyd 'ysh m'h vshnym rbvt ychyh vrb  shyhyv ymyshnyv vnpshv l'tshb' mnhtvbh vgmqbvrh l'hyth lv 'mrty tvb mmnv hnpl
verses.translation: If a man beget a hundred children, and live many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul have not enough of good, and moreover he have no burial; I say, that an untimely birth is better than he;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־בַהֶ֥בֶל בָּ֖א וּבַחֹ֣שֶׁךְ יֵלֵ֑ךְ וּבַחֹ֖שֶׁךְ שְׁמ֥וֹ יְכֻסֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: khybhbl b' vbchshkh ylkh vbchshkh shmv ykhsh
verses.translation: for it cometh in vanity, and departeth in darkness, and the name thereof is covered with darkness;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ לֹא־רָאָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א יָדָ֑ע נַ֥חַת לָזֶ֖ה מִזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: gmshmsh l'r'h vl' yd' ncht lzh mzh
verses.translation: moreover it hath not seen the sun nor known it; this hath gratification rather than the other;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִלּ֣וּ חָיָ֗ה אֶ֤לֶף שָׁנִים֙ פַּעֲמַ֔יִם וְטוֹבָ֖ה לֹ֣א רָאָ֑ה הֲלֹ֛א אֶל־מָק֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד הַכֹּ֥ל הוֹלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: v'lv chyh 'lf shnym p'mym vtvbh l' r'h hl' 'lmqvm 'chd hkhl hvlkh
verses.translation: yea, though he live a thousand years twice told, and enjoy no good; do not all go to one place?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־עֲמַ֥ל הָאָדָ֖ם לְפִ֑יהוּ וְגַם־הַנֶּ֖פֶשׁ לֹ֥א תִמָּלֵֽא׃
verses.translit: khl'ml h'dm lpyhv vgmhnpsh l' tml'
verses.translation: All the labour of man is for his mouth, And yet the appetite is not filled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י מַה־יּוֹתֵ֥ר לֶחָכָ֖ם מִֽן־הַכְּסִ֑יל מַה־לֶּעָנִ֣י יוֹדֵ֔עַ לַהֲלֹ֖ךְ נֶ֥גֶד הַחַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: khy mhyvtr lchkhm mnhkhsyl mhl'ny yvd' lhlkh ngd hchyym
verses.translation: For what advantage hath the wise more than the fool? or the poor man that hath understanding, in walking before the living?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֛וֹב מַרְאֵ֥ה עֵינַ֖יִם מֵֽהֲלׇךְ־נָ֑פֶשׁ גַּם־זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וּרְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: tvb mr'h 'ynym mhlkhnpsh gmzh hbl vr'vt rvch
verses.translation: Better is the seeing of the eyes than the wandering of the desire; this also is vanity and a striving after wind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־שֶּֽׁהָיָ֗ה כְּבָר֙ נִקְרָ֣א שְׁמ֔וֹ וְנוֹדָ֖ע אֲשֶׁר־ה֣וּא אָדָ֑ם וְלֹא־יוּכַ֣ל לָדִ֔ין עִ֥ם (שהתקיף) [שֶׁתַּקִּ֖יף] מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: mhshhyh khbr nqr' shmv vnvd' 'shrhv' 'dm vl'yvkhl ldyn 'm (shhtqyf) [shtqyf] mmnv
verses.translation: Whatsoever cometh into being, the name thereof was given long ago, and it is foreknown what man is; neither can he contend with Him that is mightier than he.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י יֵשׁ־דְּבָרִ֥ים הַרְבֵּ֖ה מַרְבִּ֣ים הָ֑בֶל מַה־יֹּתֵ֖ר לָאָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy yshdbrym hrbh mrbym hbl mhytr l'dm
verses.translation: Seeing there are many words that increase vanity, what is man the better?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִֽי־יוֹדֵ֩עַ֩ מַה־טּ֨וֹב לָֽאָדָ֜ם בַּֽחַיִּ֗ים מִסְפַּ֛ר יְמֵי־חַיֵּ֥י הֶבְל֖וֹ וְיַעֲשֵׂ֣ם כַּצֵּ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ מִֽי־יַגִּ֣יד לָֽאָדָ֔ם מַה־יִּהְיֶ֥ה אַחֲרָ֖יו תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: khy myyvd' mhtvb l'dm bchyym mspr ymychyy hblv vy'shm khtsl 'shr myygyd l'dm mhyhyh 'chryv tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: For who knoweth what is good for man in his life, all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֥וֹב שֵׁ֖ם מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן ט֑וֹב וְי֣וֹם הַמָּ֔וֶת מִיּ֖וֹם הִוָּלְדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: tvb shm mshmn tvb vyvm hmvt myvm hvldv
verses.translation: A good name is better than precious oil; And the day of death than the day of one’s birth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֞וֹב לָלֶ֣כֶת אֶל־בֵּֽית־אֵ֗בֶל מִלֶּ֙כֶת֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה בַּאֲשֶׁ֕ר ה֖וּא ס֣וֹף כׇּל־הָאָדָ֑ם וְהַחַ֖י יִתֵּ֥ן אֶל־לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: tvb llkht 'lbyt'bl mlkht 'lbyt mshth b'shr hv' svf khlh'dm vhchy ytn 'llbv
verses.translation: It is better to go to the house of mourning, Than to go to the house of feasting; For that is the end of all men, And the living will lay it to his heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֥וֹב כַּ֖עַס מִשְּׂח֑וֹק כִּֽי־בְרֹ֥עַ פָּנִ֖ים יִ֥יטַב לֵֽב׃
verses.translit: tvb kh's mshchvq khybr' pnym yytb lb
verses.translation: Vexation is better than laughter; For by the sadness of the countenance the heart may be gladdened.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֤ב חֲכָמִים֙ בְּבֵ֣ית אֵ֔בֶל וְלֵ֥ב כְּסִילִ֖ים בְּבֵ֥ית שִׂמְחָֽה׃
verses.translit: lb chkhmym bbyt 'bl vlb khsylym bbyt shmchh
verses.translation: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; But the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֕וֹב לִשְׁמֹ֖עַ גַּעֲרַ֣ת חָכָ֑ם מֵאִ֕ישׁ שֹׁמֵ֖עַ שִׁ֥יר כְּסִילִֽים׃
verses.translit: tvb lshm' g'rt chkhm m'ysh shm' shyr khsylym
verses.translation: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise, Than for a man to hear the song of fools.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כְק֤וֹל הַסִּירִים֙ תַּ֣חַת הַסִּ֔יר כֵּ֖ן שְׂחֹ֣ק הַכְּסִ֑יל וְגַם־זֶ֖ה הָֽבֶל׃
verses.translit: khy khqvl hsyrym tcht hsyr khn shchq hkhsyl vgmzh hbl
verses.translation: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool; this also is vanity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י הָעֹ֖שֶׁק יְהוֹלֵ֣ל חָכָ֑ם וִֽיאַבֵּ֥ד אֶת־לֵ֖ב מַתָּנָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy h'shq yhvll chkhm vy'bd 'tlb mtnh
verses.translation: Surely oppression turneth a wise man into a fool; And a gift destroyeth the understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֛וֹב אַחֲרִ֥ית דָּבָ֖ר מֵֽרֵאשִׁית֑וֹ ט֥וֹב אֶֽרֶךְ־ר֖וּחַ מִגְּבַהּ־רֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: tvb 'chryt dbr mr'shytv tvb 'rkhrvch mgbhrvch
verses.translation: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof; And the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תְּבַהֵ֥ל בְּרֽוּחֲךָ֖ לִכְע֑וֹס כִּ֣י כַ֔עַס בְּחֵ֥יק כְּסִילִ֖ים יָנֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: 'ltbhl brvchkh lkh'vs khy kh's bchyq khsylym ynvch
verses.translation: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry; For anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תֹּאמַר֙ מֶ֣ה הָיָ֔ה שֶׁ֤הַיָּמִים֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים הָי֥וּ טוֹבִ֖ים מֵאֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֛י לֹ֥א מֵחׇכְמָ֖ה שָׁאַ֥לְתָּ עַל־זֶֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lt'mr mh hyh shhymym hr'shnym hyv tvbym m'lh khy l' mchkhmh sh'lt 'lzh
verses.translation: Say not thou: ‘How was it that the former days were better than these?’ for it is not out of wisdom that thou inquirest concerning this.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טוֹבָ֥ה חׇכְמָ֖ה עִֽם־נַחֲלָ֑ה וְיֹתֵ֖ר לְרֹאֵ֥י הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: tvbh chkhmh 'mnchlh vytr lr'y hshmsh
verses.translation: Wisdom is good with an inheritance, Yea, a profit to them that see the sun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י בְּצֵ֥ל הַֽחׇכְמָ֖ה בְּצֵ֣ל הַכָּ֑סֶף וְיִתְר֣וֹן דַּ֔עַת הַֽחׇכְמָ֖ה תְּחַיֶּ֥ה בְעָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: khy btsl hchkhmh btsl hkhsf vytrvn d't hchkhmh tchyh b'lyh
verses.translation: For wisdom is a defence, even as money is a defence; but the excellency of knowledge is, that wisdom preserveth the life of him that hath it.
