verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְאֵ֖ה אֶת־מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֣י מִ֤י יוּכַל֙ לְתַקֵּ֔ן אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִוְּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: r'h 'tm'shh h'lhym khy my yvkhl ltqn 't 'shr 'vtv
verses.translation: Consider the work of God; for who can make that straight, which He hath made crooked?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּי֤וֹם טוֹבָה֙ הֱיֵ֣ה בְט֔וֹב וּבְי֥וֹם רָעָ֖ה רְאֵ֑ה גַּ֣ם אֶת־זֶ֤ה לְעֻמַּת־זֶה֙ עָשָׂ֣ה הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים עַל־דִּבְרַ֗ת שֶׁלֹּ֨א יִמְצָ֧א הָֽאָדָ֛ם אַחֲרָ֖יו מְאֽוּמָה׃
verses.translit: byvm tvbh hyh btvb vbyvm r'h r'h gm 'tzh l'mtzh 'shh h'lhym 'ldbrt shl' ymts' h'dm 'chryv m'vmh
verses.translation: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; God hath made even the one as well as the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־הַכֹּ֥ל רָאִ֖יתִי בִּימֵ֣י הֶבְלִ֑י יֵ֤שׁ צַדִּיק֙ אֹבֵ֣ד בְּצִדְק֔וֹ וְיֵ֣שׁ רָשָׁ֔ע מַאֲרִ֖יךְ בְּרָעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'thkhl r'yty bymy hbly ysh tsdyq 'bd btsdqv vysh rsh' m'rykh br'tv
verses.translation: All things have I seen in the days of my vanity; there is a righteous man that perisheth in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his evil-doing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תְּהִ֤י צַדִּיק֙ הַרְבֵּ֔ה וְאַל־תִּתְחַכַּ֖ם יוֹתֵ֑ר לָ֖מָּה תִּשּׁוֹמֵֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lthy tsdyq hrbh v'lttchkhm yvtr lmh tshvmm
verses.translation: Be not righteous overmuch; neither make thyself overwise; why shouldest thou destroy thyself?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּרְשַׁ֥ע הַרְבֵּ֖ה וְאַל־תְּהִ֣י סָכָ֑ל לָ֥מָּה תָמ֖וּת בְּלֹ֥א עִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'ltrsh' hrbh v'lthy skhl lmh tmvt bl' 'tkh
verses.translation: Be not overmuch wicked, neither be thou foolish; why shouldest thou die before thy time?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֚וֹב אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֶּאֱחֹ֣ז בָּזֶ֔ה וְגַם־מִזֶּ֖ה אַל־תַּנַּ֣ח אֶת־יָדֶ֑ךָ כִּֽי־יְרֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים יֵצֵ֥א אֶת־כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.translit: tvb 'shr t'chz bzh vgmmzh 'ltnch 'tydkh khyyr' 'lhym yts' 'tkhlm
verses.translation: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of the one; yea, also from the other withdraw not thy hand; for he that feareth God shall discharge himself of them all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽחׇכְמָ֖ה תָּעֹ֣ז לֶחָכָ֑ם מֵֽעֲשָׂרָה֙ שַׁלִּיטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ בָּעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: hchkhmh t'z lchkhm m'shrh shlytym 'shr hyv b'yr
verses.translation: Wisdom is a stronghold to the wise man more than ten rulers that are in a city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אָדָ֔ם אֵ֥ין צַדִּ֖יק בָּאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲשֶׂה־טּ֖וֹב וְלֹ֥א יֶחֱטָֽא׃
verses.translit: khy 'dm 'yn tsdyq b'rts 'shr y'shhtvb vl' ycht'
verses.translation: For there is not a righteous man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֤ם לְכׇל־הַדְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ אַל־תִּתֵּ֖ן לִבֶּ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־תִשְׁמַ֥ע אֶֽת־עַבְדְּךָ֖ מְקַלְלֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: gm lkhlhdbrym 'shr ydbrv 'lttn lbkh 'shr l'tshm' 't'bdkh mqllkh
verses.translation: Also take not heed unto all words that are spoken, lest thou hear thy servant curse thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י גַּם־פְּעָמִ֥ים רַבּ֖וֹת יָדַ֣ע לִבֶּ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר גַּם־[אַתָּ֖ה] (את) קִלַּ֥לְתָּ אֲחֵרִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy gmp'mym rbvt yd' lbkh 'shr gm['th] ('t) qllt 'chrym
verses.translation: for oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־זֹ֖ה נִסִּ֣יתִי בַֽחׇכְמָ֑ה אָמַ֣רְתִּי אֶחְכָּ֔מָה וְהִ֖יא רְחוֹקָ֥ה מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: khlzh nsyty bchkhmh 'mrty 'chkhmh vhy' rchvqh mmny
verses.translation: All this have I tried by wisdom; I said: ‘I will get wisdom’; but it was far from me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָח֖וֹק מַה־שֶּׁהָיָ֑ה וְעָמֹ֥ק ׀ עָמֹ֖ק מִ֥י יִמְצָאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: rchvq mhshhyh v'mq  'mq my ymts'nv
verses.translation: That which is far off, and exceeding deep; who can find it out?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סַבּ֨וֹתִֽי אֲנִ֤י וְלִבִּי֙ לָדַ֣עַת וְלָת֔וּר וּבַקֵּ֥שׁ חׇכְמָ֖ה וְחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן וְלָדַ֙עַת֙ רֶ֣שַׁע כֶּ֔סֶל וְהַסִּכְל֖וּת הוֹלֵלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: sbvty 'ny vlby ld't vltvr vbqsh chkhmh vchshbvn vld't rsh' khsl vhskhlvt hvllvt
verses.translation: I turned about, and applied my heart to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the reason of things, and to know wickedness to be folly, and foolishness to be madness;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמוֹצֶ֨א אֲנִ֜י מַ֣ר מִמָּ֗וֶת אֶת־הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ אֲשֶׁר־הִ֨יא מְצוֹדִ֧ים וַחֲרָמִ֛ים לִבָּ֖הּ אֲסוּרִ֣ים יָדֶ֑יהָ ט֞וֹב לִפְנֵ֤י הָאֱלֹהִים֙ יִמָּלֵ֣ט מִמֶּ֔נָּה וְחוֹטֵ֖א יִלָּ֥כֶד בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vmvts' 'ny mr mmvt 'th'shh 'shrhy' mtsvdym vchrmym lbh 'svrym ydyh tvb lpny h'lhym ymlt mmnh vchvt' ylkhd bh
verses.translation: and I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands; whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְאֵה֙ זֶ֣ה מָצָ֔אתִי אָמְרָ֖ה קֹהֶ֑לֶת אַחַ֥ת לְאַחַ֖ת לִמְצֹ֥א חֶשְׁבּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: r'h zh mts'ty 'mrh qhlt 'cht l'cht lmts' chshbvn
verses.translation: Behold, this have I found, saith Koheleth, adding one thing to another, to find out the account;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֛ר עוֹד־בִּקְשָׁ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י וְלֹ֣א מָצָ֑אתִי אָדָ֞ם אֶחָ֤ד מֵאֶ֙לֶף֙ מָצָ֔אתִי וְאִשָּׁ֥ה בְכׇל־אֵ֖לֶּה לֹ֥א מָצָֽאתִי׃
verses.translit: 'shr 'vdbqshh npshy vl' mts'ty 'dm 'chd m'lf mts'ty v'shh bkhl'lh l' mts'ty
verses.translation: which yet my soul sought, but I found not; one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְבַד֙ רְאֵה־זֶ֣ה מָצָ֔אתִי אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֧ה הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־הָאָדָ֖ם יָשָׁ֑ר וְהֵ֥מָּה בִקְשׁ֖וּ חִשְּׁבֹנ֥וֹת רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: lbd r'hzh mts'ty 'shr 'shh h'lhym 'th'dm yshr vhmh bqshv chshbnvt rbym
verses.translation: Behold, this only have I found, that God made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֚י כְּהֶ֣חָכָ֔ם וּמִ֥י יוֹדֵ֖עַ פֵּ֣שֶׁר דָּבָ֑ר חׇכְמַ֤ת אָדָם֙ תָּאִ֣יר פָּנָ֔יו וְעֹ֥ז פָּנָ֖יו יְשֻׁנֶּֽא׃
verses.translit: my khhchkhm vmy yvd' pshr dbr chkhmt 'dm t'yr pnyv v'z pnyv yshn'
verses.translation: Who is as the wise man? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? A man’s wisdom maketh his face to shine, And the boldness of his face is changed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ פִּי־מֶ֣לֶךְ שְׁמֹ֔ר וְעַ֕ל דִּבְרַ֖ת שְׁבוּעַ֥ת אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'ny pymlkh shmr v'l dbrt shbv't 'lhym
verses.translation: I [counsel thee]: keep the king’s command, and that in regard of the oath of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּבָּהֵ֤ל מִפָּנָיו֙ תֵּלֵ֔ךְ אַֽל־תַּעֲמֹ֖ד בְּדָבָ֣ר רָ֑ע כִּ֛י כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַחְפֹּ֖ץ יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: 'ltbhl mpnyv tlkh 'lt'md bdbr r' khy khl'shr ychpts y'shh
verses.translation: Be not hasty to go out of his presence; stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דְּבַר־מֶ֖לֶךְ שִׁלְט֑וֹן וּמִ֥י יֹֽאמַר־ל֖וֹ מַֽה־תַּעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: b'shr dbrmlkh shltvn vmy y'mrlv mht'shh
verses.translation: Forasmuch as the king’s word hath power; and who may say unto him: ‘What doest thou?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁוֹמֵ֣ר מִצְוָ֔ה לֹ֥א יֵדַ֖ע דָּבָ֣ר רָ֑ע וְעֵ֣ת וּמִשְׁפָּ֔ט יֵדַ֖ע לֵ֥ב חָכָֽם׃
verses.translit: shvmr mtsvh l' yd' dbr r' v't vmshpt yd' lb chkhm
verses.translation: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall know no evil thing; And a wise man’s heart discerneth time and judgment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לְכׇל־חֵ֔פֶץ יֵ֖שׁ עֵ֣ת וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּֽי־רָעַ֥ת הָאָדָ֖ם רַבָּ֥ה עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: khy lkhlchpts ysh 't vmshpt khyr't h'dm rbh 'lyv
verses.translation: For to every matter there is a time and judgment; for the evil of man is great upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אֵינֶ֥נּוּ יֹדֵ֖עַ מַה־שֶּׁיִּֽהְיֶ֑ה כִּ֚י כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יִֽהְיֶ֔ה מִ֖י יַגִּ֥יד לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy'ynnv yd' mhshyhyh khy kh'shr yhyh my ygyd lv
verses.translation: For he knoweth not that which shall be; for even when it cometh to pass, who shall declare it unto him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣ין אָדָ֞ם שַׁלִּ֤יט בָּר֙וּחַ֙ לִכְל֣וֹא אֶת־הָר֔וּחַ וְאֵ֤ין שִׁלְטוֹן֙ בְּי֣וֹם הַמָּ֔וֶת וְאֵ֥ין מִשְׁלַ֖חַת בַּמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־יְמַלֵּ֥ט רֶ֖שַׁע אֶת־בְּעָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'yn 'dm shlyt brvch lkhlv' 'thrvch v'yn shltvn byvm hmvt v'yn mshlcht bmlchmh vl'ymlt rsh' 'tb'lyv
verses.translation: There is no man that hath power over the wind to retain the wind; neither hath he power over the day of death; and there is no discharge in war; neither shall wickedness deliver him that is given to it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־כׇּל־זֶ֤ה רָאִ֙יתִי֙ וְנָת֣וֹן אֶת־לִבִּ֔י לְכׇֽל־מַעֲשֶׂ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשָׂ֖ה תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ עֵ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁלַ֧ט הָאָדָ֛ם בְּאָדָ֖ם לְרַ֥ע לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'tkhlzh r'yty vntvn 'tlby lkhlm'shh 'shr n'shh tcht hshmsh 't 'shr shlt h'dm b'dm lr' lv
verses.translation: All this have I seen, even applied my heart thereto, whatever the work that is done under the sun; what time one man had power over another to his hurt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְכֵ֡ן רָאִ֩יתִי֩ רְשָׁעִ֨ים קְבֻרִ֜ים וָבָ֗אוּ וּמִמְּק֤וֹם קָדוֹשׁ֙ יְהַלֵּ֔כוּ וְיִֽשְׁתַּכְּח֥וּ בָעִ֖יר אֲשֶׁ֣ר כֵּן־עָשׂ֑וּ גַּם־זֶ֖ה הָֽבֶל׃
verses.translit: vbkhn r'yty rsh'ym qbrym vb'v vmmqvm qdvsh yhlkhv vyshtkhchv b'yr 'shr khn'shv gmzh hbl
verses.translation: And so I saw the wicked buried, and they entered into their rest; but they that had done right went away from the holy place, and were forgotten in the city; this also is vanity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר֙ אֵין־נַעֲשָׂ֣ה פִתְגָ֔ם מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הָרָעָ֖ה מְהֵרָ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֡ן מָלֵ֞א לֵ֧ב בְּֽנֵי־הָאָדָ֛ם בָּהֶ֖ם לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת רָֽע׃
verses.translit: 'shr 'ynn'shh ptgm m'shh hr'h mhrh 'lkhn ml' lb bnyh'dm bhm l'shvt r'
verses.translation: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֹטֶ֗א עֹשֶׂ֥ה רָ֛ע מְאַ֖ת וּמַאֲרִ֣יךְ ל֑וֹ כִּ֚י גַּם־יוֹדֵ֣עַ אָ֔נִי אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִהְיֶה־טּוֹב֙ לְיִרְאֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִֽירְא֖וּ מִלְּפָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'shr cht' 'shh r' m't vm'rykh lv khy gmyvd' 'ny 'shr yhyhtvb lyr'y h'lhym 'shr yyr'v mlpnyv
verses.translation: because a sinner doeth evil a hundred times, and prolongeth his days—though yet I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, that fear before Him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְטוֹב֙ לֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֣ה לָֽרָשָׁ֔ע וְלֹֽא־יַאֲרִ֥יךְ יָמִ֖ים כַּצֵּ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֵינֶ֥נּוּ יָרֵ֖א מִלִּפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vtvb l'yhyh lrsh' vl'y'rykh ymym khtsl 'shr 'ynnv yr' mlpny 'lhym
verses.translation: but it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow, because he feareth not before God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֶשׁ־הֶ֘בֶל֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲשָׂ֣ה עַל־הָאָ֒רֶץ֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר  יֵ֣שׁ צַדִּיקִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר מַגִּ֤יעַ אֲלֵהֶם֙ כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה הָרְשָׁעִ֔ים וְיֵ֣שׁ רְשָׁעִ֔ים שֶׁמַּגִּ֥יעַ אֲלֵהֶ֖ם כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה הַצַּדִּיקִ֑ים אָמַ֕רְתִּי שֶׁגַּם־זֶ֖ה הָֽבֶל׃
verses.translit: yshhbl 'shr n'shh 'lh'rts 'shr  ysh tsdyqym 'shr mgy' 'lhm khm'shh hrsh'ym vysh rsh'ym shmgy' 'lhm khm'shh htsdyqym 'mrty shgmzh hbl
verses.translation: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth: that there are righteous men, unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there are wicked men, to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous—I said that this also is vanity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁבַּ֤חְתִּֽי אֲנִי֙ אֶת־הַשִּׂמְחָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֵֽין־ט֤וֹב לָֽאָדָם֙ תַּ֣חַת הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ כִּ֛י אִם־לֶאֱכֹ֥ל וְלִשְׁתּ֖וֹת וְלִשְׂמ֑וֹחַ וְה֞וּא יִלְוֶ֣נּוּ בַעֲמָל֗וֹ יְמֵ֥י חַיָּ֛יו אֲשֶׁר־נָֽתַן־ל֥וֹ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vshbchty 'ny 'thshmchh 'shr 'yntvb l'dm tcht hshmsh khy 'ml'khl vlshtvt vlshmvch vhv' ylvnv b'mlv ymy chyyv 'shrntnlv h'lhym tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: So I commended mirth, that a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry, and that this should accompany him in his labour all the days of his life which God hath given him under the sun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤תִּי אֶת־לִבִּי֙ לָדַ֣עַת חׇכְמָ֔ה וְלִרְאוֹת֙ אֶת־הָ֣עִנְיָ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשָׂ֖ה עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֣י גַ֤ם בַּיּוֹם֙ וּבַלַּ֔יְלָה שֵׁנָ֕ה בְּעֵינָ֖יו אֵינֶ֥נּוּ רֹאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: kh'shr ntty 'tlby ld't chkhmh vlr'vt 'th'nyn 'shr n'shh 'lh'rts khy gm byvm vblylh shnh b'ynyv 'ynnv r'h
verses.translation: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth—for neither day nor night do men see sleep with their eyes—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאִ֘יתִי֮ אֶת־כׇּל־מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה הָאֱלֹהִים֒ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יוּכַ֜ל הָאָדָ֗ם לִמְצוֹא֙ אֶת־הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲשָׂ֣ה תַֽחַת־הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ בְּ֠שֶׁ֠ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲמֹ֧ל הָאָדָ֛ם לְבַקֵּ֖שׁ וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָ֑א וְגַ֨ם אִם־יֹאמַ֤ר הֶֽחָכָם֙ לָדַ֔עַת לֹ֥א יוּכַ֖ל לִמְצֹֽא׃
verses.translit: vr'yty 'tkhlm'shh h'lhym khy l' yvkhl h'dm lmtsv' 'thm'shh 'shr n'shh tchthshmsh bshl 'shr y'ml h'dm lbqsh vl' ymts' vgm 'my'mr hchkhm ld't l' yvkhl lmts'
verses.translation: then I beheld all the work of God, that man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun; because though a man labour to seek it out, yet he shall not find it; yea further, though a wise man think to know it, yet shall he not be able to find it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֶת־כׇּל־זֶ֞ה נָתַ֤תִּי אֶל־לִבִּי֙ וְלָב֣וּר אֶת־כׇּל־זֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַצַּדִּיקִ֧ים וְהַחֲכָמִ֛ים וַעֲבָדֵיהֶ֖ם בְּיַ֣ד הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים גַּֽם־אַהֲבָ֣ה גַם־שִׂנְאָ֗ה אֵ֤ין יוֹדֵ֙עַ֙ הָֽאָדָ֔ם הַכֹּ֖ל לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy 'tkhlzh ntty 'llby vlbvr 'tkhlzh 'shr htsdyqym vhchkhmym v'bdyhm byd h'lhym gm'hbh gmshn'h 'yn yvd' h'dm hkhl lpnyhm
verses.translation: For all this I laid to my heart, even to make clear all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it be love or hatred, man knoweth it not; all is before them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַכֹּ֞ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר לַכֹּ֗ל מִקְרֶ֨ה אֶחָ֜ד לַצַּדִּ֤יק וְלָרָשָׁע֙ לַטּוֹב֙ וְלַטָּה֣וֹר וְלַטָּמֵ֔א וְלַ֨זֹּבֵ֔חַ וְלַאֲשֶׁ֖ר אֵינֶ֣נּוּ זֹבֵ֑חַ כַּטּוֹב֙ כַּֽחֹטֶ֔א הַנִּשְׁבָּ֕ע כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר שְׁבוּעָ֥ה יָרֵֽא׃
verses.translit: hkhl kh'shr lkhl mqrh 'chd ltsdyq vlrsh' ltvb vlthvr vltm' vlzbch vl'shr 'ynnv zbch khtvb khcht' hnshb' kh'shr shbv'h yr'
verses.translation: All things come alike to all; there is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good and to the clean and to the unclean; to him that sacrificeth and to him that sacrificeth not; as is the good, so is the sinner, and he that sweareth, as he that feareth an oath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֣ה  רָ֗ע בְּכֹ֤ל אֲשֶֽׁר־נַעֲשָׂה֙ תַּ֣חַת הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ כִּֽי־מִקְרֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד לַכֹּ֑ל וְגַ֣ם לֵ֣ב בְּֽנֵי־הָ֠אָדָ֠ם מָלֵא־רָ֨ע וְהוֹלֵל֤וֹת בִּלְבָבָם֙ בְּחַיֵּיהֶ֔ם וְאַחֲרָ֖יו אֶל־הַמֵּתִֽים׃
verses.translit: zh  r' bkhl 'shrn'shh tcht hshmsh khymqrh 'chd lkhl vgm lb bnyh'dm ml'r' vhvllvt blbbm bchyyhm v'chryv 'lhmtym
verses.translation: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event unto all; yea also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־מִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר (יבחר) [יְחֻבַּ֔ר] אֶ֥ל כׇּל־הַחַיִּ֖ים יֵ֣שׁ בִּטָּח֑וֹן כִּֽי־לְכֶ֤לֶב חַי֙ ה֣וּא ט֔וֹב מִן־הָאַרְיֵ֖ה הַמֵּֽת׃
verses.translit: khymy 'shr (ybchr) [ychbr] 'l khlhchyym ysh btchvn khylkhlb chy hv' tvb mnh'ryh hmt
verses.translation: For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֧י הַֽחַיִּ֛ים יוֹדְעִ֖ים שֶׁיָּמֻ֑תוּ וְהַמֵּתִ֞ים אֵינָ֧ם יוֹדְעִ֣ים מְא֗וּמָה וְאֵֽין־ע֤וֹד לָהֶם֙ שָׂכָ֔ר כִּ֥י נִשְׁכַּ֖ח זִכְרָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy hchyym yvd'ym shymtv vhmtym 'ynm yvd'ym m'vmh v'yn'vd lhm shkhr khy nshkhch zkhrm
verses.translation: For the living know that they shall die; but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֣ם אַהֲבָתָ֧ם גַּם־שִׂנְאָתָ֛ם גַּם־קִנְאָתָ֖ם כְּבָ֣ר אָבָ֑דָה וְחֵ֨לֶק אֵין־לָהֶ֥ם עוֹד֙ לְעוֹלָ֔ם בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר־נַעֲשָׂ֖ה תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: gm 'hbtm gmshn'tm gmqn'tm khbr 'bdh vchlq 'ynlhm 'vd l'vlm bkhl 'shrn'shh tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: As well their love, as their hatred and their envy, is long ago perished; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֣ךְ אֱכֹ֤ל בְּשִׂמְחָה֙ לַחְמֶ֔ךָ וּֽשְׁתֵ֥ה בְלֶב־ט֖וֹב יֵינֶ֑ךָ כִּ֣י כְבָ֔ר רָצָ֥ה הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶֽת־מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ׃
verses.translit: lkh 'khl bshmchh lchmkh vshth blbtvb yynkh khy khbr rtsh h'lhym 'tm'shykh
verses.translation: Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, And drink thy wine with a merry heart; For God hath already accepted thy works.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּכׇל־עֵ֕ת יִהְי֥וּ בְגָדֶ֖יךָ לְבָנִ֑ים וְשֶׁ֖מֶן עַל־רֹאשְׁךָ֥ אַל־יֶחְסָֽר׃
verses.translit: bkhl't yhyv bgdykh lbnym vshmn 'lr'shkh 'lychsr
verses.translation: Let thy garments be always white; And let thy head lack no oil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְאֵ֨ה חַיִּ֜ים עִם־אִשָּׁ֣ה אֲשֶׁר־אָהַ֗בְתָּ כׇּל־יְמֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י הֶבְלֶ֔ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽתַן־לְךָ֙ תַּ֣חַת הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י הֶבְלֶ֑ךָ כִּ֣י ה֤וּא חֶלְקְךָ֙ בַּֽחַיִּ֔ים וּבַעֲמָ֣לְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה עָמֵ֖ל תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: r'h chyym 'm'shh 'shr'hbt khlymy chyy hblkh 'shr ntnlkh tcht hshmsh khl ymy hblkh khy hv' chlqkh bchyym vb'mlkh 'shr'th 'ml tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: Enjoy life with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which He hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity; for that is thy portion in life, and in thy labour wherein thou labourest under the sun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֠ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּמְצָ֧א יָֽדְךָ֛ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת בְּכֹחֲךָ֖ עֲשֵׂ֑ה כִּי֩ אֵ֨ין מַעֲשֶׂ֤ה וְחֶשְׁבּוֹן֙ וְדַ֣עַת וְחׇכְמָ֔ה בִּשְׁא֕וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה הֹלֵ֥ךְ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: khl 'shr tmts' ydkh l'shvt bkhchkh 'shh khy 'yn m'shh vchshbvn vd't vchkhmh bsh'vl 'shr 'th hlkh shmh
verses.translation: Whatsoever thy hand attaineth to do by thy strength, that do; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁ֜בְתִּי וְרָאֹ֣ה תַֽחַת־הַשֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ כִּ֣י לֹא֩ לַקַּלִּ֨ים הַמֵּר֜וֹץ וְלֹ֧א לַגִּבּוֹרִ֣ים הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה וְ֠גַ֠ם לֹ֣א לַחֲכָמִ֥ים לֶ֙חֶם֙ וְגַ֨ם לֹ֤א לַנְּבֹנִים֙ עֹ֔שֶׁר וְגַ֛ם לֹ֥א לַיֹּדְעִ֖ים חֵ֑ן כִּי־עֵ֥ת וָפֶ֖גַע יִקְרֶ֥ה אֶת־כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.translit: shbty vr'h tchthshmsh khy l' lqlym hmrvts vl' lgbvrym hmlchmh vgm l' lchkhmym lchm vgm l' lnbnym 'shr vgm l' lyd'ym chn khy't vpg' yqrh 'tkhlm
verses.translation: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֡י גַּם֩ לֹֽא־יֵדַ֨ע הָאָדָ֜ם אֶת־עִתּ֗וֹ כַּדָּגִים֙ שֶׁנֶּֽאֱחָזִים֙ בִּמְצוֹדָ֣ה רָעָ֔ה וְכַ֨צִּפֳּרִ֔ים הָאֲחֻז֖וֹת בַּפָּ֑ח כָּהֵ֗ם יֽוּקָשִׁים֙ בְּנֵ֣י הָֽאָדָ֔ם לְעֵ֣ת רָעָ֔ה כְּשֶׁתִּפּ֥וֹל עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם פִּתְאֹֽם׃
verses.translit: khy gm l'yd' h'dm 't'tv khdgym shn'chzym bmtsvdh r'h vkhtsprym h'chzvt bpch khhm yvqshym bny h'dm l't r'h khshtpvl 'lyhm pt'm
verses.translation: For man also knoweth not his time; as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falleth suddenly upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־זֹ֛ה רָאִ֥יתִי חׇכְמָ֖ה תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וּגְדוֹלָ֥ה הִ֖יא אֵלָֽי׃
verses.translit: gmzh r'yty chkhmh tcht hshmsh vgdvlh hy' 'ly
verses.translation: This also have I seen as wisdom under the sun, and it seemed great unto me:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִ֣יר קְטַנָּ֔ה וַאֲנָשִׁ֥ים בָּ֖הּ מְעָ֑ט וּבָֽא־אֵלֶ֜יהָ מֶ֤לֶךְ גָּדוֹל֙ וְסָבַ֣ב אֹתָ֔הּ וּבָנָ֥ה עָלֶ֖יהָ מְצוֹדִ֥ים גְּדֹלִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'yr qtnh v'nshym bh m't vb''lyh mlkh gdvl vsbb 'th vbnh 'lyh mtsvdym gdlym
verses.translation: there was a little city, and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָ֣צָא בָ֗הּ אִ֤ישׁ מִסְכֵּן֙ חָכָ֔ם וּמִלַּט־ה֥וּא אֶת־הָעִ֖יר בְּחׇכְמָת֑וֹ וְאָדָם֙ לֹ֣א זָכַ֔ר אֶת־הָאִ֥ישׁ הַמִּסְכֵּ֖ן הַהֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vmts' bh 'ysh mskhn chkhm vmlthv' 'th'yr bchkhmtv v'dm l' zkhr 'th'ysh hmskhn hhv'
verses.translation: now there was found in it a man poor and wise, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַ֣רְתִּי אָ֔נִי טוֹבָ֥ה חׇכְמָ֖ה מִגְּבוּרָ֑ה וְחׇכְמַ֤ת הַמִּסְכֵּן֙ בְּזוּיָ֔ה וּדְבָרָ֖יו אֵינָ֥ם נִשְׁמָעִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'mrty 'ny tvbh chkhmh mgbvrh vchkhmt hmskhn bzvyh vdbryv 'ynm nshm'ym
verses.translation: Then said I: ‘Wisdom is better than strength; nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י חֲכָמִ֔ים בְּנַ֖חַת נִשְׁמָעִ֑ים מִזַּעֲקַ֥ת מוֹשֵׁ֖ל בַּכְּסִילִֽים׃
verses.translit: dbry chkhmym bncht nshm'ym mz'qt mvshl bkhsylym
verses.translation: The words of the wise spoken in quiet Are more acceptable than the cry of a ruler among fools.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טוֹבָ֥ה חׇכְמָ֖ה מִכְּלֵ֣י קְרָ֑ב וְחוֹטֶ֣א אֶחָ֔ד יְאַבֵּ֖ד טוֹבָ֥ה הַרְבֵּֽה׃
verses.translit: tvbh chkhmh mkhly qrb vchvt' 'chd y'bd tvbh hrbh
verses.translation: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; But one sinner destroyeth much good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְב֣וּבֵי מָ֔וֶת יַבְאִ֥ישׁ יַבִּ֖יעַ שֶׁ֣מֶן רוֹקֵ֑חַ יָקָ֛ר מֵחׇכְמָ֥ה מִכָּב֖וֹד סִכְל֥וּת מְעָֽט׃
verses.translit: zbvby mvt yb'ysh yby' shmn rvqch yqr mchkhmh mkhbvd skhlvt m't
verses.translation: Dead flies make the ointment of the perfumer fetid and putrid; So doth a little folly outweigh wisdom and honour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֤ב חָכָם֙ לִֽימִינ֔וֹ וְלֵ֥ב כְּסִ֖יל לִשְׂמֹאלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: lb chkhm lymynv vlb khsyl lshm'lv
verses.translation: A wise man’s understanding is at his right hand; but a fool’s understanding at his left.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־בַּדֶּ֛רֶךְ (כשהסכל) [כְּשֶׁסָּכָ֥ל] הֹלֵ֖ךְ לִבּ֣וֹ חָסֵ֑ר וְאָמַ֥ר לַכֹּ֖ל סָכָ֥ל הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vgmbdrkh (khshhskhl) [khshskhl] hlkh lbv chsr v'mr lkhl skhl hv'
verses.translation: Yea also, when a fool walketh by the way, his understanding faileth him, and he saith to every one that he is a fool.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־ר֤וּחַ הַמּוֹשֵׁל֙ תַּעֲלֶ֣ה עָלֶ֔יךָ מְקוֹמְךָ֖ אַל־תַּנַּ֑ח כִּ֣י מַרְפֵּ֔א יַנִּ֖יחַ חֲטָאִ֥ים גְּדוֹלִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'mrvch hmvshl t'lh 'lykh mqvmkh 'ltnch khy mrp' ynych cht'ym gdvlym
verses.translation: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for gentleness allayeth great offences.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ רָעָ֔ה רָאִ֖יתִי תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ כִּשְׁגָגָ֕ה שֶׁיֹּצָ֖א מִלִּפְנֵ֥י הַשַּׁלִּֽיט׃
verses.translit: ysh r'h r'yty tcht hshmsh khshggh shyts' mlpny hshlyt
verses.translation: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, like an error which proceedeth from a ruler:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִתַּ֣ן הַסֶּ֔כֶל בַּמְּרוֹמִ֖ים רַבִּ֑ים וַעֲשִׁירִ֖ים בַּשֵּׁ֥פֶל יֵשֵֽׁבוּ׃
verses.translit: ntn hskhl bmrvmym rbym v'shyrym bshpl yshbv
verses.translation: Folly is set on great heights, and the rich sit in low place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאִ֥יתִי עֲבָדִ֖ים עַל־סוּסִ֑ים וְשָׂרִ֛ים הֹלְכִ֥ים כַּעֲבָדִ֖ים עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: r'yty 'bdym 'lsvsym vshrym hlkhym kh'bdym 'lh'rts
verses.translation: I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֹפֵ֥ר גּוּמָּ֖ץ בּ֣וֹ יִפּ֑וֹל וּפֹרֵ֥ץ גָּדֵ֖ר יִשְּׁכֶ֥נּוּ נָחָֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: chpr gvmts bv ypvl vprts gdr yshkhnv nchsh
verses.translation: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; and whoso breaketh through a fence, a serpent shall bite him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַסִּ֣יעַ אֲבָנִ֔ים יֵעָצֵ֖ב בָּהֶ֑ם בּוֹקֵ֥עַ עֵצִ֖ים יִסָּ֥כֶן בָּֽם׃
verses.translit: msy' 'bnym y'tsb bhm bvq' 'tsym yskhn bm
verses.translation: Whoso quarrieth stones shall be hurt therewith; and he that cleaveth wood is endangered thereby.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־קֵהָ֣ה הַבַּרְזֶ֗ל וְהוּא֙ לֹא־פָנִ֣ים קִלְקַ֔ל וַחֲיָלִ֖ים יְגַבֵּ֑ר וְיִתְר֥וֹן הַכְשֵׁ֖יר חׇכְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'mqhh hbrzl vhv' l'pnym qlql vchylym ygbr vytrvn hkhshyr chkhmh
verses.translation: If the iron be blunt, and one do not whet the edge, then must he put to more strength; but wisdom is profitable to direct.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יִשֹּׁ֥ךְ הַנָּחָ֖שׁ בְּלוֹא־לָ֑חַשׁ וְאֵ֣ין יִתְר֔וֹן לְבַ֖עַל הַלָּשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.translit: 'myshkh hnchsh blv'lchsh v'yn ytrvn lb'l hlshvn
verses.translation: If the serpent bite before it is charmed, then the charmer hath no advantage.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֥י פִי־חָכָ֖ם חֵ֑ן וְשִׂפְת֥וֹת כְּסִ֖יל תְּבַלְּעֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: dbry pychkhm chn vshptvt khsyl tbl'nv
verses.translation: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious; but the lips of a fool will swallow up himself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּחִלַּ֥ת דִּבְרֵי־פִ֖יהוּ סִכְל֑וּת וְאַחֲרִ֣ית פִּ֔יהוּ הוֹלֵל֖וּת רָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: tchlt dbrypyhv skhlvt v'chryt pyhv hvllvt r'h
verses.translation: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness; and the end of his talk is grievous madness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַסָּכָ֖ל יַרְבֶּ֣ה דְבָרִ֑ים לֹא־יֵדַ֤ע הָאָדָם֙ מַה־שֶּׁיִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר יִֽהְיֶה֙ מֵֽאַחֲרָ֔יו מִ֖י יַגִּ֥יד לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhskhl yrbh dbrym l'yd' h'dm mhshyhyh v'shr yhyh m'chryv my ygyd lv
verses.translation: A fool also multiplieth words; yet man knoweth not what shall be; And that which shall be after him, Who can tell him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲמַ֥ל הַכְּסִילִ֖ים תְּיַגְּעֶ֑נּוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יָדַ֖ע לָלֶ֥כֶת אֶל־עִֽיר׃
verses.translit: 'ml hkhsylym tyg'nv 'shr l'yd' llkht 'l'yr
verses.translation: The labour of fools wearieth every one of them, for he knoweth not how to go to the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִֽי־לָ֣ךְ אֶ֔רֶץ שֶׁמַּלְכֵּ֖ךְ נָ֑עַר וְשָׂרַ֖יִךְ בַּבֹּ֥קֶר יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: 'ylkh 'rts shmlkhkh n'r vshrykh bbqr y'khlv
verses.translation: Woe to thee, O land, when thy king is a boy, And thy princes feast in the morning! .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣יךְ אֶ֔רֶץ שֶׁמַּלְכֵּ֖ךְ בֶּן־חוֹרִ֑ים וְשָׂרַ֙יִךְ֙ בָּעֵ֣ת יֹאכֵ֔לוּ בִּגְבוּרָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א בַשְּׁתִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'shrykh 'rts shmlkhkh bnchvrym vshrykh b't y'khlv bgbvrh vl' bshty
verses.translation: Happy art thou, O land, when thy king is a free man, And thy princes eat in due season, In strength, and not in drunkenness!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּעֲצַלְתַּ֖יִם יִמַּ֣ךְ הַמְּקָרֶ֑ה וּבְשִׁפְל֥וּת יָדַ֖יִם יִדְלֹ֥ף הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: b'tsltym ymkh hmqrh vbshplvt ydym ydlf hbyt
verses.translation: By slothfulness the rafters sink in; And through idleness of the hands the house leaketh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִשְׂחוֹק֙ עֹשִׂ֣ים לֶ֔חֶם וְיַ֖יִן יְשַׂמַּ֣ח חַיִּ֑ים וְהַכֶּ֖סֶף יַעֲנֶ֥ה אֶת־הַכֹּֽל׃
verses.translit: lshchvq 'shym lchm vyyn yshmch chyym vhkhsf y'nh 'thkhl
verses.translation: A feast is made for laughter, And wine maketh glad the life; And money answereth all things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֣ם בְּמַדָּֽעֲךָ֗ מֶ֚לֶךְ אַל־תְּקַלֵּ֔ל וּבְחַדְרֵי֙ מִשְׁכָּ֣בְךָ֔ אַל־תְּקַלֵּ֖ל עָשִׁ֑יר כִּ֣י ע֤וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ יוֹלִ֣יךְ אֶת־הַקּ֔וֹל וּבַ֥עַל (הכנפים) [כְּנָפַ֖יִם] יַגֵּ֥יד דָּבָֽר׃
verses.translit: gm bmd'kh mlkh 'ltqll vbchdry mshkhbkh 'ltqll 'shyr khy 'vf hshmym yvlykh 'thqvl vb'l (hkhnpym) [khnpym] ygyd dbr
verses.translation: Curse not the king, no, not in thy thought, And curse not the rich in thy bedchamber; For a bird of the air shall carry the voice, And that which hath wings shall tell the matter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁלַּ֥ח לַחְמְךָ֖ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַמָּ֑יִם כִּֽי־בְרֹ֥ב הַיָּמִ֖ים תִּמְצָאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: shlch lchmkh 'lpny hmym khybrb hymym tmts'nv
verses.translation: Cast thy bread upon the waters, For thou shalt find it after many days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תֶּן־חֵ֥לֶק לְשִׁבְעָ֖ה וְגַ֣ם לִשְׁמוֹנָ֑ה כִּ֚י לֹ֣א תֵדַ֔ע מַה־יִּהְיֶ֥ה רָעָ֖ה עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: tnchlq lshb'h vgm lshmvnh khy l' td' mhyhyh r'h 'lh'rts
verses.translation: Divide a portion into seven, yea, even into eight; For thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יִמָּלְא֨וּ הֶעָבִ֥ים גֶּ֙שֶׁם֙ עַל־הָאָ֣רֶץ יָרִ֔יקוּ וְאִם־יִפּ֥וֹל עֵ֛ץ בַּדָּר֖וֹם וְאִ֣ם בַּצָּפ֑וֹן מְק֛וֹם שֶׁיִּפּ֥וֹל הָעֵ֖ץ שָׁ֥ם יְהֽוּא׃
verses.translit: 'myml'v h'bym gshm 'lh'rts yryqv v'mypvl 'ts bdrvm v'm btspvn mqvm shypvl h'ts shm yhv'
verses.translation: If the clouds be full of rain, They empty themselves upon the earth; And if a tree fall in the south, or in the north, In the place where the tree falleth, there shall it be.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֥ר ר֖וּחַ לֹ֣א יִזְרָ֑ע וְרֹאֶ֥ה בֶעָבִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִקְצֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: shmr rvch l' yzr' vr'h b'bym l' yqtsvr
verses.translation: He that observeth the wind shall not sow; And he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר אֵֽינְךָ֤ יוֹדֵ֙עַ֙ מַה־דֶּ֣רֶךְ הָר֔וּחַ כַּעֲצָמִ֖ים בְּבֶ֣טֶן הַמְּלֵאָ֑ה כָּ֗כָה לֹ֤א תֵדַע֙ אֶת־מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֶת־הַכֹּֽל׃
verses.translit: kh'shr 'ynkh yvd' mhdrkh hrvch kh'tsmym bbtn hml'h khkhh l' td' 'tm'shh h'lhym 'shr y'shh 'thkhl
verses.translation: As thou knowest not what is the way of the wind, Nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child; Even so thou knowest not the work of God Who doeth all things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּבֹּ֙קֶר֙ זְרַ֣ע אֶת־זַרְעֶ֔ךָ וְלָעֶ֖רֶב אַל־תַּנַּ֣ח יָדֶ֑ךָ כִּי֩ אֵֽינְךָ֨ יוֹדֵ֜עַ אֵ֣י זֶ֤ה יִכְשָׁר֙ הֲזֶ֣ה אוֹ־זֶ֔ה וְאִם־שְׁנֵיהֶ֥ם כְּאֶחָ֖ד טוֹבִֽים׃
verses.translit: bbqr zr' 'tzr'kh vl'rb 'ltnch ydkh khy 'ynkh yvd' 'y zh ykhshr hzh 'vzh v'mshnyhm kh'chd tvbym
verses.translation: In the morning sow thy seed, And in the evening withhold not thy hand; For thou knowest not which shall prosper, whether this or that, Or whether they both shall be alike good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָת֖וֹק הָא֑וֹר וְט֥וֹב לַֽעֵינַ֖יִם לִרְא֥וֹת אֶת־הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vmtvq h'vr vtvb l'ynym lr'vt 'thshmsh
verses.translation: And the light is sweet, And a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־שָׁנִ֥ים הַרְבֵּ֛ה יִחְיֶ֥ה הָאָדָ֖ם בְּכֻלָּ֣ם יִשְׂמָ֑ח וְיִזְכֹּר֙ אֶת־יְמֵ֣י הַחֹ֔שֶׁךְ כִּֽי־הַרְבֵּ֥ה יִהְי֖וּ כׇּל־שֶׁבָּ֥א הָֽבֶל׃
verses.translit: khy 'mshnym hrbh ychyh h'dm bkhlm yshmch vyzkhr 'tymy hchshkh khyhrbh yhyv khlshb' hbl
verses.translation: For if a man live many years, Let him rejoice in them all, And remember the days of darkness, For they shall be many. All that cometh is vanity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂמַ֧ח בָּח֣וּר בְּיַלְדוּתֶ֗יךָ וִֽיטִֽיבְךָ֤ לִבְּךָ֙ בִּימֵ֣י בְחוּרוֹתֶ֔יךָ וְהַלֵּךְ֙ בְּדַרְכֵ֣י לִבְּךָ֔ וּבְמַרְאֵ֖י עֵינֶ֑יךָ וְדָ֕ע כִּ֧י עַל־כׇּל־אֵ֛לֶּה יְבִֽיאֲךָ֥ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: shmch bchvr byldvtykh vytybkh lbkh bymy bchvrvtykh vhlkh bdrkhy lbkh vbmr'y 'ynykh vd' khy 'lkhl'lh yby'kh h'lhym bmshpt
verses.translation: Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; And let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth, And walk in the ways of thy heart, And in the sight of thine eyes; But know thou, that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָסֵ֥ר כַּ֙עַס֙ מִלִּבֶּ֔ךָ וְהַעֲבֵ֥ר רָעָ֖ה מִבְּשָׂרֶ֑ךָ כִּֽי־הַיַּלְד֥וּת וְהַֽשַּׁחֲר֖וּת הָֽבֶל׃
verses.translit: vhsr kh's mlbkh vh'br r'h mbshrkh khyhyldvt vhshchrvt hbl
verses.translation: Therefore remove vexation from thy heart, And put away evil from thy flesh; For childhood and youth are vanity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּזְכֹר֙ אֶת־בּ֣וֹרְאֶ֔יךָ בִּימֵ֖י בְּחוּרֹתֶ֑יךָ עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא־יָבֹ֙אוּ֙ יְמֵ֣י הָֽרָעָ֔ה וְהִגִּ֣יעוּ שָׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאמַ֔ר אֵֽין־לִ֥י בָהֶ֖ם חֵֽפֶץ׃
verses.translit: vzkhr 'tbvr'ykh bymy bchvrtykh 'd 'shr l'yb'v ymy hr'h vhgy'v shnym 'shr t'mr 'ynly bhm chpts
verses.translation: Remember then thy Creator in the days of thy youth, and the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say: 'I have no pleasure in them';
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֠ד אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־תֶחְשַׁ֤ךְ הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ וְהָא֔וֹר וְהַיָּרֵ֖חַ וְהַכּוֹכָבִ֑ים וְשָׁ֥בוּ הֶעָבִ֖ים אַחַ֥ר הַגָּֽשֶׁם׃
verses.translit: 'd 'shr l'tchshkh hshmsh vh'vr vhyrch vhkhvkhbym vshbv h'bym 'chr hgshm
verses.translation: Before the sun, and the light, and the moon, and the stars, are darkened, and the clouds return after the rain;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֗וֹם שֶׁיָּזֻ֙עוּ֙ שֹׁמְרֵ֣י הַבַּ֔יִת וְהִֽתְעַוְּת֖וּ אַנְשֵׁ֣י הֶחָ֑יִל וּבָטְל֤וּ הַטֹּֽחֲנוֹת֙ כִּ֣י מִעֵ֔טוּ וְחָשְׁכ֥וּ הָרֹא֖וֹת בָּאֲרֻבּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: byvm shyz'v shmry hbyt vht'vtv 'nshy hchyl vbtlv htchnvt khy m'tv vchshkhv hr'vt b'rbvt
verses.translation: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out shall be darkened in the windows,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסֻגְּר֤וּ דְלָתַ֙יִם֙ בַּשּׁ֔וּק בִּשְׁפַ֖ל ק֣וֹל הַֽטַּחֲנָ֑ה וְיָקוּם֙ לְק֣וֹל הַצִּפּ֔וֹר וְיִשַּׁ֖חוּ כׇּל־בְּנ֥וֹת הַשִּֽׁיר׃
verses.translit: vsgrv dltym bshvq bshpl qvl htchnh vyqvm lqvl htspvr vyshchv khlbnvt hshyr
verses.translation: And the doors shall be shut in the street, when the sound of the grinding is low; and one shall start up at the voice of a bird, and all the daughters of music shall be brought low;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֣ם מִגָּבֹ֤הַּ יִרָ֙אוּ֙ וְחַתְחַתִּ֣ים בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ וְיָנֵ֤אץ הַשָּׁקֵד֙ וְיִסְתַּבֵּ֣ל הֶֽחָגָ֔ב וְתָפֵ֖ר הָֽאֲבִיּוֹנָ֑ה כִּֽי־הֹלֵ֤ךְ הָאָדָם֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית עוֹלָמ֔וֹ וְסָבְב֥וּ בַשּׁ֖וּק הַסּוֹפְדִֽים׃
verses.translit: gm mgbh yr'v vchtchtym bdrkh vyn'ts hshqd vystbl hchgb vtpr h'byvnh khyhlkh h'dm 'lbyt 'vlmv vsbbv bshvq hsvpdym
verses.translation: Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high, and terrors shall be in the way; and the almond-tree shall blossom, and the grasshopper shall drag itself along, and the caperberry shall fail; Because man goeth to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־[יֵרָתֵק֙] (ירחק) חֶ֣בֶל הַכֶּ֔סֶף וְתָר֖וּץ גֻּלַּ֣ת הַזָּהָ֑ב וְתִשָּׁ֤בֶר כַּד֙ עַל־הַמַּבּ֔וּעַ וְנָרֹ֥ץ הַגַּלְגַּ֖ל אֶל־הַבּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: 'd 'shr l'[yrtq] (yrchq) chbl hkhsf vtrvts glt hzhb vtshbr khd 'lhmbv' vnrts hglgl 'lhbvr
verses.translation: Before the silver cord is snapped asunder, and the golden bowl is shattered, And the pitcher is broken at the fountain, and the wheel falleth shattered, into the pit;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָשֹׁ֧ב הֶעָפָ֛ר עַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּשֶׁהָיָ֑ה וְהָר֣וּחַ תָּשׁ֔וּב אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְתָנָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vyshb h'pr 'lh'rts khshhyh vhrvch tshvb 'lh'lhym 'shr ntnh
verses.translation: And the dust returneth to the earth as it was, and the spirit returneth unto God who gave it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲבֵ֧ל הֲבָלִ֛ים אָמַ֥ר הַקּוֹהֶ֖לֶת הַכֹּ֥ל הָֽבֶל׃
verses.translit: hbl hblym 'mr hqvhlt hkhl hbl
verses.translation: Vanity of vanities, saith Koheleth; all is vanity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֹתֵ֕ר שֶׁהָיָ֥ה קֹהֶ֖לֶת חָכָ֑ם ע֗וֹד לִמַּד־דַּ֙עַת֙ אֶת־הָעָ֔ם וְאִזֵּ֣ן וְחִקֵּ֔ר תִּקֵּ֖ן מְשָׁלִ֥ים הַרְבֵּֽה׃
verses.translit: vytr shhyh qhlt chkhm 'vd lmdd't 'th'm v'zn vchqr tqn mshlym hrbh
verses.translation: And besides that Koheleth was wise, he also taught the people knowledge; yea, he pondered, and sought out, and set in order many proverbs.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּקֵּ֣שׁ קֹהֶ֔לֶת לִמְצֹ֖א דִּבְרֵי־חֵ֑פֶץ וְכָת֥וּב יֹ֖שֶׁר דִּבְרֵ֥י אֱמֶֽת׃
verses.translit: bqsh qhlt lmts' dbrychpts vkhtvb yshr dbry 'mt
verses.translation: Koheleth sought to find out words of delight, and that which was written uprightly, even words of truth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֤י חֲכָמִים֙ כַּדָּ֣רְבֹנ֔וֹת וּֽכְמַשְׂמְר֥וֹת נְטוּעִ֖ים בַּעֲלֵ֣י אֲסֻפּ֑וֹת נִתְּנ֖וּ מֵרֹעֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: dbry chkhmym khdrbnvt vkhmshmrvt ntv'ym b'ly 'spvt ntnv mr'h 'chd
verses.translation: The words of the wise are as goads, and as nails well fastened are those that are composed in collections; they are given from one shepherd.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֹתֵ֥ר מֵהֵ֖מָּה בְּנִ֣י הִזָּהֵ֑ר עֲשׂ֨וֹת סְפָרִ֤ים הַרְבֵּה֙ אֵ֣ין קֵ֔ץ וְלַ֥הַג הַרְבֵּ֖ה יְגִעַ֥ת בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.translit: vytr mhmh bny hzhr 'shvt sprym hrbh 'yn qts vlhg hrbh yg't bshr
verses.translation: And furthermore, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ס֥וֹף דָּבָ֖ר הַכֹּ֣ל נִשְׁמָ֑ע אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִ֤ים יְרָא֙ וְאֶת־מִצְוֺתָ֣יו שְׁמ֔וֹר כִּי־זֶ֖ה כׇּל־הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: svf dbr hkhl nshm' 'th'lhym yr' v'tmtsvtyv shmvr khyzh khlh'dm
verses.translation: The end of the matter, all having been heard: fear God, and keep His commandments; for this is the whole man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י אֶת־כׇּל־מַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים יָבִ֥א בְמִשְׁפָּ֖ט עַ֣ל כׇּל־נֶעְלָ֑ם אִם־ט֖וֹב וְאִם־רָֽע׃
verses.translit: khy 'tkhlm'shh h'lhym yb' bmshpt 'l khln'lm 'mtvb v'mr'
verses.translation: For God shall bring every work into the judgment concerning every hidden thing, whether it be good or whether it be evil. [The end of the matter, all having been heard: fear God, and keep His Commandments; for this is the whole man.]
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י בִּימֵ֣י אֲחַשְׁוֵר֑וֹשׁ ה֣וּא אֲחַשְׁוֵר֗וֹשׁ הַמֹּלֵךְ֙ מֵהֹ֣דּוּ וְעַד־כּ֔וּשׁ שֶׁ֛בַע וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּמֵאָ֖ה מְדִינָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy bymy 'chshvrvsh hv' 'chshvrvsh hmlkh mhdv v'dkhvsh shb' v'shrym vm'h mdynh
verses.translation: NOW IT came to pass in the days of Ahasuerus—this is Ahasuerus who reigned, from India to Ethiopia, over a hundred and seven and twenty provinces—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֖ים הָהֵ֑ם כְּשֶׁ֣בֶת  הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֗וֹשׁ עַ֚ל כִּסֵּ֣א מַלְכוּת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּשׁוּשַׁ֥ן הַבִּירָֽה׃
verses.translit: bymym hhm khshbt  hmlkh 'chshvrvsh 'l khs' mlkhvtv 'shr bshvshn hbyrh
verses.translation: that in those days, when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Shushan the castle,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֤ת שָׁלוֹשׁ֙ לְמׇלְכ֔וֹ עָשָׂ֣ה מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה לְכׇל־שָׂרָ֖יו וַעֲבָדָ֑יו חֵ֣יל  פָּרַ֣ס וּמָדַ֗י הַֽפַּרְתְּמִ֛ים וְשָׂרֵ֥י הַמְּדִינ֖וֹת לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: bshnt shlvsh lmlkhv 'shh mshth lkhlshryv v'bdyv chyl  prs vmdy hprtmym vshry hmdynvt lpnyv
verses.translation: in the third year of his reign, he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants; the army of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces, being before him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּהַרְאֹת֗וֹ אֶת־עֹ֙שֶׁר֙ כְּב֣וֹד מַלְכוּת֔וֹ וְאֶ֨ת־יְקָ֔ר תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת גְּדוּלָּת֑וֹ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים שְׁמוֹנִ֥ים וּמְאַ֖ת יֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: bhr'tv 't'shr khbvd mlkhvtv v'tyqr tp'rt gdvltv ymym rbym shmvnym vm't yvm
verses.translation: when he showed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty, many days, even a hundred and fourscore days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִמְל֣וֹאת  הַיָּמִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה עָשָׂ֣ה הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ לְכׇל־הָעָ֣ם הַנִּמְצְאִים֩ בְּשׁוּשַׁ֨ן הַבִּירָ֜ה לְמִגָּד֧וֹל וְעַד־קָטָ֛ן מִשְׁתֶּ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים בַּחֲצַ֕ר גִּנַּ֥ת בִּיתַ֖ן הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vbmlv't  hymym h'lh 'shh hmlkh lkhlh'm hnmts'ym bshvshn hbyrh lmgdvl v'dqtn mshth shb't ymym bchtsr gnt bytn hmlkh
verses.translation: And when these days were fulfilled, the king made a feast unto all the people that were present in Shushan the castle, both great and small, seven days, in the court of the garden of the king’s palace;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּרְפַּ֣ס וּתְכֵ֗לֶת אָחוּז֙ בְּחַבְלֵי־ב֣וּץ וְאַרְגָּמָ֔ן עַל־גְּלִ֥ילֵי כֶ֖סֶף וְעַמּ֣וּדֵי שֵׁ֑שׁ מִטּ֣וֹת  זָהָ֣ב וָכֶ֗סֶף עַ֛ל רִֽצְפַ֥ת בַּהַט־וָשֵׁ֖שׁ וְדַ֥ר וְסֹחָֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: khrps vtkhlt 'chvz bchblybvts v'rgmn 'lglyly khsf v'mvdy shsh mtvt  zhb vkhsf 'l rtspt bhtvshsh vdr vschrt
verses.translation: there were hangings of white, fine cotton, and blue, bordered with cords of fine linen and purple, upon silver rods and pillars of marble; the couches were of gold and silver, upon a pavement of green, and white, and shell, and onyx marble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַשְׁקוֹת֙ בִּכְלֵ֣י זָהָ֔ב וְכֵלִ֖ים מִכֵּלִ֣ים שׁוֹנִ֑ים וְיֵ֥ין מַלְכ֛וּת רָ֖ב כְּיַ֥ד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vhshqvt bkhly zhb vkhlym mkhlym shvnym vyyn mlkhvt rb khyd hmlkh
verses.translation: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold—the vessels being diverse one from another—and royal wine in abundance, according to the bounty of the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַשְּׁתִיָּ֥ה כַדָּ֖ת אֵ֣ין אֹנֵ֑ס כִּי־כֵ֣ן  יִסַּ֣ד הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ עַ֚ל כׇּל־רַ֣ב בֵּית֔וֹ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת כִּרְצ֥וֹן אִישׁ־וָאִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: vhshtyh khdt 'yn 'ns khykhn  ysd hmlkh 'l khlrb bytv l'shvt khrtsvn 'yshv'ysh
verses.translation: And the drinking was according to the law; none did compel; for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house, that they should do according to every man’s pleasure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֚ם וַשְׁתִּ֣י הַמַּלְכָּ֔ה עָשְׂתָ֖ה מִשְׁתֵּ֣ה נָשִׁ֑ים בֵּ֚ית הַמַּלְכ֔וּת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֽוֹשׁ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: gm vshty hmlkhh 'shth mshth nshym byt hmlkhvt 'shr lmlkh 'chshvrvsh {s}
verses.translation: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to king Ahasuerus.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י כְּט֥וֹב לֵב־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בַּיָּ֑יִן אָמַ֡ר לִ֠מְהוּמָ֠ן בִּזְּתָ֨א חַרְבוֹנָ֜א בִּגְתָ֤א וַאֲבַגְתָא֙ זֵתַ֣ר וְכַרְכַּ֔ס שִׁבְעַת֙ הַסָּ֣רִיסִ֔ים הַמְשָׁ֣רְתִ֔ים אֶת־פְּנֵ֖י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: byvm hshby'y khtvb lbhmlkh byyn 'mr lmhvmn bzt' chrbvn' bgt' v'bgt' ztr vkhrkhs shb't hsrysym hmshrtym 'tpny hmlkh 'chshvrvsh
verses.translation: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Bizzetha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven chamberlains that ministered in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֠הָבִ֠יא אֶת־וַשְׁתִּ֧י הַמַּלְכָּ֛ה לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּכֶ֣תֶר מַלְכ֑וּת לְהַרְא֨וֹת הָֽעַמִּ֤ים וְהַשָּׂרִים֙ אֶת־יׇפְיָ֔הּ כִּֽי־טוֹבַ֥ת מַרְאֶ֖ה הִֽיא׃
verses.translit: lhby' 'tvshty hmlkhh lpny hmlkh bkhtr mlkhvt lhr'vt h'mym vhshrym 'typyh khytvbt mr'h hy'
verses.translation: to bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal, to show the peoples and the princes her beauty; for she was fair to look on.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּמָאֵ֞ן הַמַּלְכָּ֣ה וַשְׁתִּ֗י לָבוֹא֙ בִּדְבַ֣ר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּיַ֣ד הַסָּרִיסִ֑ים וַיִּקְצֹ֤ף הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַחֲמָת֖וֹ בָּעֲרָ֥ה בֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vtm'n hmlkhh vshty lbv' bdbr hmlkh 'shr byd hsrysym vyqtsf hmlkh m'd vchmtv b'rh bv
verses.translation: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king’s commandment by the chamberlains; therefore was the king very wroth, and his anger burned in him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לַחֲכָמִ֖ים יֹדְעֵ֣י הָֽעִתִּ֑ים כִּי־כֵן֙ דְּבַ֣ר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לִפְנֵ֕י כׇּל־יֹדְעֵ֖י דָּ֥ת וָדִֽין׃
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh lchkhmym yd'y h'tym khykhn dbr hmlkh lpny khlyd'y dt vdyn
verses.translation: Then the king said to the wise men, who knew the times—for so was the king’s manner toward all that knew law and judgment;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַקָּרֹ֣ב אֵלָ֗יו כַּרְשְׁנָ֤א שֵׁתָר֙ אַדְמָ֣תָא תַרְשִׁ֔ישׁ מֶ֥רֶס מַרְסְנָ֖א מְמוּכָ֑ן שִׁבְעַ֞ת שָׂרֵ֣י  פָּרַ֣ס וּמָדַ֗י רֹאֵי֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ הַיֹּשְׁבִ֥ים רִאשֹׁנָ֖ה בַּמַּלְכֽוּת׃
verses.translit: vhqrb 'lyv khrshn' shtr 'dmt' trshysh mrs mrsn' mmvkhn shb't shry  prs vmdy r'y pny hmlkh hyshbym r'shnh bmlkhvt
verses.translation: and the next unto him was Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, who saw the king’s face, and sat the first in the kingdom:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּדָת֙ מַֽה־לַּעֲשׂ֔וֹת בַּמַּלְכָּ֖ה וַשְׁתִּ֑י עַ֣ל  אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־עָשְׂתָ֗ה אֶֽת־מַאֲמַר֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ בְּיַ֖ד הַסָּרִיסִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khdt mhl'shvt bmlkhh vshty 'l  'shr l''shth 'tm'mr hmlkh 'chshvrvsh byd hsrysym {p}
verses.translation: ’What shall we do unto the queen Vashti according to law, forasmuch as she hath not done the bidding of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר (מומכן) [מְמוּכָ֗ן] לִפְנֵ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְהַשָּׂרִ֔ים לֹ֤א עַל־הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ לְבַדּ֔וֹ עָוְתָ֖ה וַשְׁתִּ֣י הַמַּלְכָּ֑ה כִּ֤י עַל־כׇּל־הַשָּׂרִים֙ וְעַל־כׇּל־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֕ר בְּכׇל־מְדִינ֖וֹת הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr (mvmkhn) [mmvkhn] lpny hmlkh vhshrym l' 'lhmlkh lbdv 'vth vshty hmlkhh khy 'lkhlhshrym v'lkhlh'mym 'shr bkhlmdynvt hmlkh 'chshvrvsh
verses.translation: And Memucan answered before the king and the princes: ‘Vashti the queen hath not done wrong to the king only, but also to all the princes, and to all the peoples, that are in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יֵצֵ֤א דְבַר־הַמַּלְכָּה֙ עַל־כׇּל־הַנָּשִׁ֔ים לְהַבְז֥וֹת בַּעְלֵיהֶ֖ן בְּעֵינֵיהֶ֑ן בְּאׇמְרָ֗ם הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֡וֹשׁ אָמַ֞ר לְהָבִ֨יא אֶת־וַשְׁתִּ֧י הַמַּלְכָּ֛ה לְפָנָ֖יו וְלֹא־בָֽאָה׃
verses.translit: khyyts' dbrhmlkhh 'lkhlhnshym lhbzvt b'lyhn b'ynyhn b'mrm hmlkh 'chshvrvsh 'mr lhby' 'tvshty hmlkhh lpnyv vl'b'h
verses.translation: For this deed of the queen will come abroad unto all women, to make their husbands contemptible in their eyes, when it will be said: The king Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she came not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽהַיּ֨וֹם הַזֶּ֜ה תֹּאמַ֣רְנָה  שָׂר֣וֹת פָּֽרַס־וּמָדַ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת־דְּבַ֣ר הַמַּלְכָּ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל שָׂרֵ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וּכְדַ֖י בִּזָּי֥וֹן וָקָֽצֶף׃
verses.translit: vhyvm hzh t'mrnh  shrvt prsvmdy 'shr shm'v 'tdbr hmlkhh lkhl shry hmlkh vkhdy bzyvn vqtsf
verses.translation: And this day will the princesses of Persia and Media who have heard of the deed of the queen say the like unto all the king’s princes. So will there arise enough contempt and wrath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־עַל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ ט֗וֹב יֵצֵ֤א דְבַר־מַלְכוּת֙ מִלְּפָנָ֔יו וְיִכָּתֵ֛ב בְּדָתֵ֥י פָֽרַס־וּמָדַ֖י וְלֹ֣א יַעֲב֑וֹר אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־תָב֜וֹא וַשְׁתִּ֗י לִפְנֵי֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ וּמַלְכוּתָהּ֙ יִתֵּ֣ן הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לִרְעוּתָ֖הּ הַטּוֹבָ֥ה מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: 'm'lhmlkh tvb yts' dbrmlkhvt mlpnyv vykhtb bdty prsvmdy vl' y'bvr 'shr l'tbv' vshty lpny hmlkh 'chshvrvsh vmlkhvth ytn hmlkh lr'vth htvbh mmnh
verses.translation: If it please the king, let there go forth a royal commandment from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, that it be not altered, that Vashti come no more before king Ahasuerus, and that the king give her royal estate unto another that is better than she.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִשְׁמַע֩ פִּתְגָ֨ם הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ אֲשֶֽׁר־יַעֲשֶׂה֙ בְּכׇל־מַלְכוּת֔וֹ כִּ֥י רַבָּ֖ה הִ֑יא וְכׇל־הַנָּשִׁ֗ים יִתְּנ֤וּ יְקָר֙ לְבַעְלֵיהֶ֔ן לְמִגָּד֖וֹל וְעַד־קָטָֽן׃
verses.translit: vnshm' ptgm hmlkh 'shry'shh bkhlmlkhvtv khy rbh hy' vkhlhnshym ytnv yqr lb'lyhn lmgdvl v'dqtn
verses.translation: And when the king’s decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his kingdom, great though it be, all the wives will give to their husbands honour, both to great and small.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּיטַב֙ הַדָּבָ֔ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִ֑ים וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ כִּדְבַ֥ר מְמוּכָֽן׃
verses.translit: vyytb hdbr b'yny hmlkh vhshrym vy'sh hmlkh khdbr mmvkhn
verses.translation: And the word pleased the king and the princes; and the king did according to the word of Memucan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח סְפָרִים֙ אֶל־כׇּל־מְדִינ֣וֹת הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֶל־מְדִינָ֤ה וּמְדִינָה֙ כִּכְתָבָ֔הּ וְאֶל־עַ֥ם וָעָ֖ם כִּלְשׁוֹנ֑וֹ לִהְי֤וֹת כׇּל־אִישׁ֙ שֹׂרֵ֣ר בְּבֵית֔וֹ וּמְדַבֵּ֖ר כִּלְשׁ֥וֹן עַמּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshlch sprym 'lkhlmdynvt hmlkh 'lmdynh vmdynh khkhtbh v'l'm v'm khlshvnv lhyvt khl'ysh shrr bbytv vmdbr khlshvn 'mv {p}
verses.translation: for he sent letters into all the king’s provinces, into every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language, that every man should bear rule in his own house, and speak according to the language of his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה כְּשֹׁ֕ךְ חֲמַ֖ת הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֑וֹשׁ זָכַ֤ר אֶת־וַשְׁתִּי֙ וְאֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֔תָה וְאֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־נִגְזַ֖ר עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: 'chr hdbrym h'lh khshkh chmt hmlkh 'chshvrvsh zkhr 'tvshty v't 'shr'shth v't 'shrngzr 'lyh
verses.translation: After these things, when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was assuaged, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ נַעֲרֵֽי־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מְשָׁרְתָ֑יו יְבַקְשׁ֥וּ לַמֶּ֛לֶךְ נְעָר֥וֹת בְּתוּל֖וֹת טוֹב֥וֹת מַרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv n'ryhmlkh mshrtyv ybqshv lmlkh n'rvt btvlvt tvbvt mr'h
verses.translation: Then said the king’s servants that ministered unto him: ‘Let there be sought for the king young virgins fair to look on;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיַפְקֵ֨ד הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ פְּקִידִים֮ בְּכׇל־מְדִינ֣וֹת מַלְכוּתוֹ֒ וְיִקְבְּצ֣וּ אֶת־כׇּל־נַעֲרָֽה־בְ֠תוּלָ֠ה טוֹבַ֨ת מַרְאֶ֜ה אֶל־שׁוּשַׁ֤ן הַבִּירָה֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית הַנָּשִׁ֔ים אֶל־יַ֥ד הֵגֶ֛א סְרִ֥יס הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ שֹׁמֵ֣ר הַנָּשִׁ֑ים וְנָת֖וֹן תַּמְרֻקֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: vypqd hmlkh pqydym bkhlmdynvt mlkhvtv vyqbtsv 'tkhln'rhbtvlh tvbt mr'h 'lshvshn hbyrh 'lbyt hnshym 'lyd hg' srys hmlkh shmr hnshym vntvn tmrqyhn
verses.translation: and let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the fair young virgins unto Shushan the castle, to the house of the women, unto the custody of Hegai the king’s chamberlain, keeper of the women; and let their ointments be given them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַֽנַּעֲרָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּיטַב֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ תִּמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּ֣חַת וַשְׁתִּ֑י וַיִּיטַ֧ב הַדָּבָ֛ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וַיַּ֥עַשׂ כֵּֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhn'rh 'shr tytb b'yny hmlkh tmlkh tcht vshty vyytb hdbr b'yny hmlkh vy'sh khn {p}
verses.translation: and let the maiden that pleaseth the king be queen instead of Vashti.’ And the thing pleased the king; and he did so.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדִ֔י הָיָ֖ה בְּשׁוּשַׁ֣ן הַבִּירָ֑ה וּשְׁמ֣וֹ מׇרְדֳּכַ֗י בֶּ֣ן יָאִ֧יר בֶּן־שִׁמְעִ֛י בֶּן־קִ֖ישׁ אִ֥ישׁ יְמִינִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'ysh yhvdy hyh bshvshn hbyrh vshmv mrdkhy bn y'yr bnshm'y bnqysh 'ysh ymyny
verses.translation: There was a certain Jew in Shushan the castle, whose name was Mordecai the son of Jair the son of Shimei the son of Kish, a Benjamite,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר הׇגְלָה֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔יִם עִם־הַגֹּלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הׇגְלְתָ֔ה עִ֖ם יְכׇנְיָ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶגְלָ֔ה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֖ר מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: 'shr hglh myrvshlym 'mhglh 'shr hglth 'm ykhnyh mlkhyhvdh 'shr hglh nbvkhdntsr mlkh bbl
verses.translation: who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captives that had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י אֹמֵ֜ן אֶת־הֲדַסָּ֗ה הִ֤יא אֶסְתֵּר֙ בַּת־דֹּד֔וֹ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין לָ֖הּ אָ֣ב וָאֵ֑ם וְהַנַּעֲרָ֤ה יְפַת־תֹּ֙אַר֙ וְטוֹבַ֣ת מַרְאֶ֔ה וּבְמ֤וֹת אָבִ֙יהָ֙ וְאִמָּ֔הּ לְקָחָ֧הּ מׇרְדֳּכַ֛י ל֖וֹ לְבַֽת׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'mn 'thdsh hy' 'str btddv khy 'yn lh 'b v'm vhn'rh yptt'r vtvbt mr'h vbmvt 'byh v'mh lqchh mrdkhy lv lbt
verses.translation: And he brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle’s daughter; for she had neither father nor mother, and the maiden was of beautiful form and fair to look on; and when her father and mother were dead, Mordecai took her for his own daughter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּהִשָּׁמַ֤ע דְּבַר־הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְדָת֔וֹ וּֽבְהִקָּבֵ֞ץ נְעָר֥וֹת רַבּ֛וֹת אֶל־שׁוּשַׁ֥ן הַבִּירָ֖ה אֶל־יַ֣ד הֵגָ֑י וַתִּלָּקַ֤ח אֶסְתֵּר֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֶל־יַ֥ד הֵגַ֖י שֹׁמֵ֥ר הַנָּשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vyhy bhshm' dbrhmlkh vdtv vbhqbts n'rvt rbvt 'lshvshn hbyrh 'lyd hgy vtlqch 'str 'lbyt hmlkh 'lyd hgy shmr hnshym
verses.translation: So it came to pass, when the king’s commandment and his decree was published, and when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the castle, to the custody of Hegai, that Esther was taken into the king’s house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּיטַ֨ב הַנַּעֲרָ֣ה בְעֵינָיו֮ וַתִּשָּׂ֣א חֶ֣סֶד לְפָנָיו֒ וַ֠יְבַהֵ֠ל אֶת־תַּמְרוּקֶ֤יהָ וְאֶת־מָנוֹתֶ֙הָ֙ לָתֵ֣ת לָ֔הּ וְאֵת֙ שֶׁ֣בַע הַנְּעָר֔וֹת הָרְאֻי֥וֹת לָֽתֶת־לָ֖הּ מִבֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיְשַׁנֶּ֧הָ וְאֶת־נַעֲרוֹתֶ֛יהָ לְט֖וֹב בֵּ֥ית הַנָּשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vtytb hn'rh b'ynyv vtsh' chsd lpnyv vybhl 'ttmrvqyh v'tmnvth ltt lh v't shb' hn'rvt hr'yvt lttlh mbyt hmlkh vyshnh v'tn'rvtyh ltvb byt hnshym
verses.translation: And the maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness of him; and he speedily gave her her ointments, with her portions, and the seven maidens, who were meet to be given her out of the king’s house; and he advanced her and her maidens to the best place in the house of the women.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־הִגִּ֣ידָה אֶסְתֵּ֔ר אֶת־עַמָּ֖הּ וְאֶת־מֽוֹלַדְתָּ֑הּ כִּ֧י מׇרְדֳּכַ֛י צִוָּ֥ה עָלֶ֖יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תַגִּֽיד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: l'hgydh 'str 't'mh v'tmvldth khy mrdkhy tsvh 'lyh 'shr l'tgyd {s}
verses.translation: Esther had not made known her people nor her kindred; for Mordecai had charged her that she should not tell it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְכׇל־י֣וֹם וָי֔וֹם מׇרְדֳּכַי֙ מִתְהַלֵּ֔ךְ לִפְנֵ֖י חֲצַ֣ר בֵּית־הַנָּשִׁ֑ים לָדַ֙עַת֙ אֶת־שְׁל֣וֹם אֶסְתֵּ֔ר וּמַה־יֵּעָשֶׂ֖ה בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vbkhlyvm vyvm mrdkhy mthlkh lpny chtsr bythnshym ld't 'tshlvm 'str vmhy'shh bh
verses.translation: And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women’s house, to know how Esther did, and what would become of her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְהַגִּ֡יעַ תֹּר֩ נַעֲרָ֨ה וְנַעֲרָ֜ה לָב֣וֹא  אֶל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֗וֹשׁ מִקֵּץ֩ הֱי֨וֹת לָ֜הּ כְּדָ֤ת הַנָּשִׁים֙ שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֣ר חֹ֔דֶשׁ כִּ֛י כֵּ֥ן יִמְלְא֖וּ יְמֵ֣י מְרוּקֵיהֶ֑ן שִׁשָּׁ֤ה חֳדָשִׁים֙ בְּשֶׁ֣מֶן הַמֹּ֔ר וְשִׁשָּׁ֤ה חֳדָשִׁים֙ בַּבְּשָׂמִ֔ים וּבְתַמְרוּקֵ֖י הַנָּשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vbhgy' tr n'rh vn'rh lbv'  'lhmlkh 'chshvrvsh mqts hyvt lh khdt hnshym shnym 'shr chdsh khy khn yml'v ymy mrvqyhn shshh chdshym bshmn hmr vshshh chdshym bbshmym vbtmrvqy hnshym
verses.translation: Now when the turn of every maiden was come to go in to king Ahasuerus, after that it had been done to her according to the law for the women, twelve months—for so were the days of their anointing accomplished, to wit, six months with oil of myrrh, and six month with sweet odours, and with other ointments of the women —
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָזֶ֕ה הַֽנַּעֲרָ֖ה בָּאָ֣ה אֶל־הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ אֵת֩ כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֹּאמַ֜ר יִנָּ֤תֵֽן לָהּ֙ לָב֣וֹא עִמָּ֔הּ מִבֵּ֥ית הַנָּשִׁ֖ים עַד־בֵּ֥ית הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vbzh hn'rh b'h 'lhmlkh 't khl'shr t'mr yntn lh lbv' 'mh mbyt hnshym 'dbyt hmlkh
verses.translation: when then the maiden came unto the king, whatsoever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women unto the king’s house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּעֶ֣רֶב  הִ֣יא בָאָ֗ה וּ֠בַבֹּ֠קֶר הִ֣יא שָׁבָ֞ה אֶל־בֵּ֤ית הַנָּשִׁים֙ שֵׁנִ֔י אֶל־יַ֧ד שַֽׁעַשְׁגַ֛ז סְרִ֥יס הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ שֹׁמֵ֣ר הַפִּֽילַגְשִׁ֑ים לֹא־תָב֥וֹא עוֹד֙ אֶל־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ כִּ֣י אִם־חָפֵ֥ץ בָּ֛הּ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וְנִקְרְאָ֥ה בְשֵֽׁם׃
verses.translit: b'rb  hy' b'h vbbqr hy' shbh 'lbyt hnshym shny 'lyd sh'shgz srys hmlkh shmr hpylgshym l'tbv' 'vd 'lhmlkh khy 'mchpts bh hmlkh vnqr'h bshm
verses.translation: In the evening she went, and on the morrow she returned into the second house of the women, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king’s chamberlain, who kept the concubines; she came in unto the king no more, except the king delighted in her, and she were called by name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְהַגִּ֣יעַ תֹּר־אֶסְתֵּ֣ר בַּת־אֲבִיחַ֣יִל דֹּ֣ד מׇרְדֳּכַ֡י אֲשֶׁר֩ לָקַֽח־ל֨וֹ לְבַ֜ת לָב֣וֹא אֶל־הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ לֹ֤א בִקְשָׁה֙ דָּבָ֔ר כִּ֠י אִ֣ם אֶת־אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹאמַ֛ר הֵגַ֥י סְרִיס־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ שֹׁמֵ֣ר הַנָּשִׁ֑ים וַתְּהִ֤י אֶסְתֵּר֙ נֹשֵׂ֣את חֵ֔ן בְּעֵינֵ֖י כׇּל־רֹאֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vbhgy' tr'str bt'bychyl dd mrdkhy 'shr lqchlv lbt lbv' 'lhmlkh l' bqshh dbr khy 'm 't'shr y'mr hgy sryshmlkh shmr hnshym vthy 'str nsh't chn b'yny khlr'yh
verses.translation: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, was come to go in unto the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king’s chamberlain, the keeper of the women, appointed. And Esther obtained favour in the sight of all them that looked upon her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּלָּקַ֨ח אֶסְתֵּ֜ר אֶל־הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית מַלְכוּת֔וֹ בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִ֖י הוּא־חֹ֣דֶשׁ טֵבֵ֑ת בִּשְׁנַת־שֶׁ֖בַע לְמַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vtlqch 'str 'lhmlkh 'chshvrvsh 'lbyt mlkhvtv bchdsh h'shyry hv'chdsh tbt bshntshb' lmlkhvtv
verses.translation: So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֶּאֱהַ֨ב הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ אֶת־אֶסְתֵּר֙ מִכׇּל־הַנָּשִׁ֔ים וַתִּשָּׂא־חֵ֥ן וָחֶ֛סֶד לְפָנָ֖יו מִכׇּל־הַבְּתוּל֑וֹת וַיָּ֤שֶׂם כֶּֽתֶר־מַלְכוּת֙ בְּרֹאשָׁ֔הּ וַיַּמְלִיכֶ֖הָ תַּ֥חַת וַשְׁתִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'hb hmlkh 't'str mkhlhnshym vtsh'chn vchsd lpnyv mkhlhbtvlvt vyshm khtrmlkhvt br'shh vymlykhh tcht vshty
verses.translation: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ מִשְׁתֶּ֣ה גָד֗וֹל לְכׇל־שָׂרָיו֙ וַעֲבָדָ֔יו אֵ֖ת מִשְׁתֵּ֣ה אֶסְתֵּ֑ר וַהֲנָחָ֤ה לַמְּדִינוֹת֙ עָשָׂ֔ה וַיִּתֵּ֥ן מַשְׂאֵ֖ת כְּיַ֥ד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'sh hmlkh mshth gdvl lkhlshryv v'bdyv 't mshth 'str vhnchh lmdynvt 'shh vytn msh't khyd hmlkh
verses.translation: Then the king made a great feast unto all his princes and his servants, even Esther’s feast; and he made a release to the provinces, and gave gifts, according to the bounty of the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְהִקָּבֵ֥ץ בְּתוּל֖וֹת שֵׁנִ֑ית וּמׇרְדֳּכַ֖י יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּשַֽׁעַר־הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vbhqbts btvlvt shnyt vmrdkhy yshb bsh'rhmlkh
verses.translation: And when the virgins were gathered together the second time, and Mordecai sat in the king’s gate—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣ין אֶסְתֵּ֗ר מַגֶּ֤דֶת מֽוֹלַדְתָּהּ֙ וְאֶת־עַמָּ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה עָלֶ֖יהָ מׇרְדֳּכָ֑י וְאֶת־מַאֲמַ֤ר מׇרְדֳּכַי֙ אֶסְתֵּ֣ר עֹשָׂ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר הָיְתָ֥ה בְאׇמְנָ֖ה אִתּֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'yn 'str mgdt mvldth v't'mh kh'shr tsvh 'lyh mrdkhy v'tm'mr mrdkhy 'str 'shh kh'shr hyth b'mnh 'tv {s}
verses.translation: Esther had not yet made known her kindred nor her people; as Mordecai had charged her; for Esther did the commandment of Mordecai, like as when she was brought up with him—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם וּמׇרְדֳּכַ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּשַֽׁעַר־הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ קָצַף֩ בִּגְתָ֨ן וָתֶ֜רֶשׁ שְׁנֵֽי־סָרִיסֵ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ מִשֹּׁמְרֵ֣י הַסַּ֔ף וַיְבַקְשׁוּ֙ לִשְׁלֹ֣חַ יָ֔ד בַּמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֹֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: bymym hhm vmrdkhy yvshb bsh'rhmlkh qtsf bgtn vtrsh shnysrysy hmlkh mshmry hsf vybqshv lshlch yd bmlkh 'chshvrsh
verses.translation: in those days, while Mordecai sat in the king’s gate, two of the king’s chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, of those that kept the door, were wroth, and sought to lay hands on the king Ahasuerus.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּוָּדַ֤ע הַדָּבָר֙ לְמׇרְדֳּכַ֔י וַיַּגֵּ֖ד לְאֶסְתֵּ֣ר הַמַּלְכָּ֑ה וַתֹּ֧אמֶר אֶסְתֵּ֛ר לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּשֵׁ֥ם מׇרְדֳּכָֽי׃
verses.translit: vyvd' hdbr lmrdkhy vygd l'str hmlkhh vt'mr 'str lmlkh bshm mrdkhy
verses.translation: And the thing became known to Mordecai, who told it unto Esther the queen; and Esther told the king thereof in Mordecai’s name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבֻקַּ֤שׁ הַדָּבָר֙ וַיִּמָּצֵ֔א וַיִּתָּל֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־עֵ֑ץ וַיִּכָּתֵ֗ב בְּסֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vybqsh hdbr vymts' vytlv shnyhm 'l'ts vykhtb bspr dbry hymym lpny hmlkh {p}
verses.translation: And when inquisition was made of the matter, and it was found to be so, they were both hanged on a tree; and it was written in the book of the chronicles before the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחַ֣ר  הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה גִּדַּל֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֜וֹשׁ אֶת־הָמָ֧ן בֶּֽן־הַמְּדָ֛תָא הָאֲגָגִ֖י וַֽיְנַשְּׂאֵ֑הוּ וַיָּ֙שֶׂם֙ אֶת־כִּסְא֔וֹ מֵעַ֕ל כׇּל־הַשָּׂרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'chr  hdbrym h'lh gdl hmlkh 'chshvrvsh 'thmn bnhmdt' h'ggy vynsh'hv vyshm 'tkhs'v m'l khlhshrym 'shr 'tv
verses.translation: After these things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes that were with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־עַבְדֵ֨י הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־בְּשַׁ֣עַר הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ כֹּרְעִ֤ים וּמִֽשְׁתַּחֲוִים֙ לְהָמָ֔ן כִּי־כֵ֖ן צִוָּה־ל֣וֹ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וּמׇ֨רְדֳּכַ֔י לֹ֥א יִכְרַ֖ע וְלֹ֥א יִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vkhl'bdy hmlkh 'shrbsh'r hmlkh khr'ym vmshtchvym lhmn khykhn tsvhlv hmlkh vmrdkhy l' ykhr' vl' yshtchvh
verses.translation: And all the king’s servants, that were in the king’s gate, bowed down, and prostrated themselves before Haman; for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai bowed not down, nor prostrated himself before him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ עַבְדֵ֥י הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־בְּשַׁ֥עַר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לְמׇרְדֳּכָ֑י מַדּ֙וּעַ֙ אַתָּ֣ה עוֹבֵ֔ר אֵ֖ת מִצְוַ֥ת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'bdy hmlkh 'shrbsh'r hmlkh lmrdkhy mdv' 'th 'vbr 't mtsvt hmlkh
verses.translation: Then the king’s servants, that were in the king’s gate, said unto Mordecai: ‘Why transgressest thou the king’s commandment?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י (באמרם) [כְּאׇמְרָ֤ם] אֵלָיו֙ י֣וֹם וָי֔וֹם וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַיַּגִּ֣ידוּ לְהָמָ֗ן לִרְאוֹת֙ הֲיַֽעַמְדוּ֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י מׇרְדֳּכַ֔י כִּֽי־הִגִּ֥יד לָהֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ה֥וּא יְהוּדִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyhy (b'mrm) [kh'mrm] 'lyv yvm vyvm vl' shm' 'lyhm vygydv lhmn lr'vt hy'mdv dbry mrdkhy khyhgyd lhm 'shrhv' yhvdy
verses.translation: Now it came to pass, when they spoke daily unto him, and he hearkened not unto them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai’s words would stand; for he had told them that he was a Jew.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא הָמָ֔ן כִּי־אֵ֣ין מׇרְדֳּכַ֔י כֹּרֵ֥עַ וּמִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה ל֑וֹ וַיִּמָּלֵ֥א הָמָ֖ן חֵמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyr' hmn khy'yn mrdkhy khr' vmshtchvh lv vyml' hmn chmh
verses.translation: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not down, nor prostrated himself before him, then was Haman full of wrath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֣בֶז בְּעֵינָ֗יו לִשְׁלֹ֤חַ יָד֙ בְּמׇרְדֳּכַ֣י לְבַדּ֔וֹ כִּֽי־הִגִּ֥ידוּ ל֖וֹ אֶת־עַ֣ם מׇרְדֳּכָ֑י וַיְבַקֵּ֣שׁ הָמָ֗ן לְהַשְׁמִ֧יד אֶת־כׇּל־הַיְּהוּדִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּכׇל־מַלְכ֥וּת אֲחַשְׁוֵר֖וֹשׁ עַ֥ם מׇרְדֳּכָֽי׃
verses.translit: vybz b'ynyv lshlch yd bmrdkhy lbdv khyhgydv lv 't'm mrdkhy vybqsh hmn lhshmyd 'tkhlhyhvdym 'shr bkhlmlkhvt 'chshvrvsh 'm mrdkhy
verses.translation: But it seemed contemptible in his eyes to lay hands on Mordecai alone; for they had made known to him the people of Mordecai; wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even the people of Mordecai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּחֹ֤דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן֙ הוּא־חֹ֣דֶשׁ נִיסָ֔ן בִּשְׁנַת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֑וֹשׁ הִפִּ֣יל פּוּר֩ ה֨וּא הַגּוֹרָ֜ל לִפְנֵ֣י הָמָ֗ן מִיּ֧וֹם ׀ לְי֛וֹם וּמֵחֹ֛דֶשׁ לְחֹ֥דֶשׁ שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֖ר הוּא־חֹ֥דֶשׁ אֲדָֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bchdsh hr'shvn hv'chdsh nysn bshnt shtym 'shrh lmlkh 'chshvrvsh hpyl pvr hv' hgvrl lpny hmn myvm  lyvm vmchdsh lchdsh shnym'shr hv'chdsh 'dr {s}
verses.translation: In the first month, which is the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus, they cast pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, to the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הָמָן֙ לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ יֶשְׁנ֣וֹ עַם־אֶחָ֗ד מְפֻזָּ֤ר וּמְפֹרָד֙ בֵּ֣ין הָֽעַמִּ֔ים בְּכֹ֖ל מְדִינ֣וֹת מַלְכוּתֶ֑ךָ וְדָתֵיהֶ֞ם שֹׁנ֣וֹת מִכׇּל־עָ֗ם וְאֶת־דָּתֵ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֵינָ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים וְלַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אֵין־שֹׁוֶ֖ה לְהַנִּיחָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr hmn lmlkh 'chshvrvsh yshnv 'm'chd mpzr vmprd byn h'mym bkhl mdynvt mlkhvtkh vdtyhm shnvt mkhl'm v'tdty hmlkh 'ynm 'shym vlmlkh 'ynshvh lhnychm
verses.translation: And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus: ‘There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the peoples in all the provinces of thy kingdom; and their laws are diverse from those of every people; neither keep they the king’s laws; therefore it profiteth not the king to suffer them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־עַל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ ט֔וֹב יִכָּתֵ֖ב לְאַבְּדָ֑ם וַעֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֜ים כִּכַּר־כֶּ֗סֶף אֶשְׁקוֹל֙ עַל־יְדֵי֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה לְהָבִ֖יא אֶל־גִּנְזֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: 'm'lhmlkh tvb ykhtb l'bdm v'shrt 'lpym khkhrkhsf 'shqvl 'lydy 'shy hml'khh lhby' 'lgnzy hmlkh
verses.translation: If it please the king, let it be written that they be destroyed; and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver into the hands of those that have the charge of the king’s business, to bring it into the king’s treasuries.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֧סַר הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶת־טַבַּעְתּ֖וֹ מֵעַ֣ל יָד֑וֹ וַֽיִּתְּנָ֗הּ לְהָמָ֧ן בֶּֽן־הַמְּדָ֛תָא הָאֲגָגִ֖י צֹרֵ֥ר הַיְּהוּדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vysr hmlkh 'ttb'tv m'l ydv vytnh lhmn bnhmdt' h'ggy tsrr hyhvdym
verses.translation: And the king took his ring from his hand, and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews’enemy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ לְהָמָ֔ן הַכֶּ֖סֶף נָת֣וּן לָ֑ךְ וְהָעָ֕ם לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת בּ֖וֹ כַּטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh lhmn hkhsf ntvn lkh vh'm l'shvt bv khtvb b'ynykh
verses.translation: And the king said unto Haman: ‘The silver is given to thee, the people also, to do with them as it seemeth good to thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקָּרְאוּ֩ סֹפְרֵ֨י הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֣ר יוֹם֮ בּוֹ֒ וַיִּכָּתֵ֣ב כְּֽכׇל־אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֣ה הָמָ֡ן אֶ֣ל אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנֵֽי־הַ֠מֶּ֠לֶךְ וְֽאֶל־הַפַּח֞וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר  עַל־מְדִינָ֣ה וּמְדִינָ֗ה וְאֶל־שָׂ֤רֵי עַם֙ וָעָ֔ם מְדִינָ֤ה וּמְדִינָה֙ כִּכְתָבָ֔הּ וְעַ֥ם וָעָ֖ם כִּלְשׁוֹנ֑וֹ בְּשֵׁ֨ם הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֹשׁ֙ נִכְתָּ֔ב וְנֶחְתָּ֖ם בְּטַבַּ֥עַת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vyqr'v spry hmlkh bchdsh hr'shvn bshlvshh 'shr yvm bv vykhtb khkhl'shrtsvh hmn 'l 'chshdrpnyhmlkh v'lhpchvt 'shr  'lmdynh vmdynh v'lshry 'm v'm mdynh vmdynh khkhtbh v'm v'm khlshvnv bshm hmlkh 'chshvrsh nkhtb vnchtm btb't hmlkh
verses.translation: Then were the king’s scribes called in the first month, on the thirteenth day thereof, and there was written, according to all that Haman commanded, unto the king’s satraps, and to the governors that were over every province, and to the princes of every people; to every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language; in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written, and it was sealed with the king’s ring.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִשְׁל֨וֹחַ סְפָרִ֜ים בְּיַ֣ד הָרָצִים֮ אֶל־כׇּל־מְדִינ֣וֹת הַמֶּ֒לֶךְ֒ לְהַשְׁמִ֡יד לַהֲרֹ֣ג וּלְאַבֵּ֣ד אֶת־כׇּל־הַ֠יְּהוּדִ֠ים מִנַּ֨עַר וְעַד־זָקֵ֜ן טַ֤ף וְנָשִׁים֙ בְּי֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר לְחֹ֥דֶשׁ שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֖ר הוּא־חֹ֣דֶשׁ אֲדָ֑ר וּשְׁלָלָ֖ם לָבֽוֹז׃
verses.translit: vnshlvch sprym byd hrtsym 'lkhlmdynvt hmlkh lhshmyd lhrg vl'bd 'tkhlhyhvdym mn'r v'dzqn tf vnshym byvm 'chd bshlvshh 'shr lchdsh shnym'shr hv'chdsh 'dr vshllm lbvz
verses.translation: And letters were sent by posts into all the king’s provinces, to destroy, to slay, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, even upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to take the spoil of them for a prey.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּתְשֶׁ֣גֶן הַכְּתָ֗ב לְהִנָּ֤תֵֽן דָּת֙ בְּכׇל־מְדִינָ֣ה וּמְדִינָ֔ה גָּל֖וּי לְכׇל־הָֽעַמִּ֑ים לִהְי֥וֹת עֲתִדִ֖ים לַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: ptshgn hkhtb lhntn dt bkhlmdynh vmdynh glvy lkhlh'mym lhyvt 'tdym lyvm hzh
verses.translation: The copy of the writing, to be given out for a decree in every province, was to be published unto all peoples, that they should be ready against that day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָֽרָצִ֞ים יָצְא֤וּ דְחוּפִים֙ בִּדְבַ֣ר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְהַדָּ֥ת נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּשׁוּשַׁ֣ן הַבִּירָ֑ה וְהַמֶּ֤לֶךְ וְהָמָן֙ יָשְׁב֣וּ לִשְׁתּ֔וֹת וְהָעִ֥יר שׁוּשָׁ֖ן נָבֽוֹכָה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hrtsym yts'v dchvpym bdbr hmlkh vhdt ntnh bshvshn hbyrh vhmlkh vhmn yshbv lshtvt vh'yr shvshn nbvkhh {s}
verses.translation: The posts went forth in haste by the king’s commandment, and the decree was given out in Shushan the castle; and the king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city of Shushan was perplexed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמׇרְדֳּכַ֗י יָדַע֙ אֶת־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲשָׂ֔ה וַיִּקְרַ֤ע מׇרְדֳּכַי֙ אֶת־בְּגָדָ֔יו וַיִּלְבַּ֥שׁ שַׂ֖ק וָאֵ֑פֶר וַיֵּצֵא֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעִ֔יר וַיִּזְעַ֛ק זְעָקָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה וּמָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vmrdkhy yd' 'tkhl'shr n'shh vyqr' mrdkhy 'tbgdyv vylbsh shq v'pr vyts' btvkh h'yr vyz'q z'qh gdvlh vmrh
