verses.original: עָנֵ֣ה וְאָמַ֗ר לְאַרְיוֹךְ֙ שַׁלִּיטָ֣א דִֽי־מַלְכָּ֔א עַל־מָ֥ה דָתָ֛א מְהַחְצְפָ֖ה מִן־קֳדָ֣ם מַלְכָּ֑א אֱדַ֣יִן מִלְּתָ֔א הוֹדַ֥ע אַרְי֖וֹךְ לְדָנִיֵּֽאל׃
verses.translit: 'nh v'mr l'ryvkh shlyt' dymlkh' 'lmh dt' mhchtsph mnqdm mlkh' 'dyn mlt' hvd' 'ryvkh ldny'l
verses.translation: he answered and said to Arioch the king’s captain: ‘Wherefore is the decree so peremptory from the king?’ Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדָ֣נִיֵּ֔אל עַ֖ל וּבְעָ֣ה מִן־מַלְכָּ֑א דִּ֚י זְמָ֣ן יִנְתִּן־לֵ֔הּ וּפִשְׁרָ֖א לְהַֽחֲוָיָ֥ה לְמַלְכָּֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vdny'l 'l vb'h mnmlkh' dy zmn yntnlh vpshr' lhchvyh lmlkh' {s}
verses.translation: Then Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would give him time, that he might declare unto the king the interpretation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱדַ֥יִן דָּנִיֵּ֖אל לְבַיְתֵ֣הּ אֲזַ֑ל וְ֠לַחֲנַנְיָ֠ה מִֽישָׁאֵ֧ל וַעֲזַרְיָ֛ה חַבְר֖וֹהִי מִלְּתָ֥א הוֹדַֽע׃
verses.translit: 'dyn dny'l lbyth 'zl vlchnnyh mysh'l v'zryh chbrvhy mlt' hvd'
verses.translation: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרַחֲמִ֗ין לְמִבְעֵא֙ מִן־קֳדָם֙ אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֔א עַל־רָזָ֖א דְּנָ֑ה דִּ֣י לָ֤א יְהֽוֹבְדוּן֙ דָּנִיֵּ֣אל וְחַבְר֔וֹהִי עִם־שְׁאָ֖ר חַכִּימֵ֥י בָבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: vrchmyn lmb'' mnqdm 'lh shmy' 'lrz' dnh dy l' yhvbdvn dny'l vchbrvhy 'msh'r chkhymy bbl
verses.translation: that they might ask mercy of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his companions should not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱדַ֗יִן לְדָנִיֵּ֛אל בְּחֶזְוָ֥א דִֽי־לֵילְיָ֖א רָזָ֣א גְלִ֑י אֱדַ֙יִן֙ דָּֽנִיֵּ֔אל בָּרִ֖ךְ לֶאֱלָ֥הּ שְׁמַיָּֽא׃
verses.translit: 'dyn ldny'l bchzv' dylyly' rz' gly 'dyn dny'l brkh l'lh shmy'
verses.translation: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a vision of the night. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָנֵ֤ה דָֽנִיֵּאל֙ וְאָמַ֔ר לֶהֱוֵ֨א שְׁמֵ֤הּ דִּֽי־אֱלָהָא֙ מְבָרַ֔ךְ מִן־עָלְמָ֖א וְעַ֣ד עָלְמָ֑א דִּ֧י חׇכְמְתָ֛א וּגְבוּרְתָ֖א דִּ֥י לֵֽהּ־הִֽיא׃
verses.translit: 'nh dny'l v'mr lhv' shmh dy'lh' mbrkh mn'lm' v'd 'lm' dy chkhmt' vgbvrt' dy lhhy'
verses.translation: Daniel spoke and said: Blessed be the name of God From everlasting even unto everlasting; For wisdom and might are His;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠ה֠וּא מְהַשְׁנֵ֤א עִדָּנַיָּא֙ וְזִמְנַיָּ֔א מְהַעְדֵּ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין וּמְהָקֵ֣ים מַלְכִ֑ין יָהֵ֤ב חׇכְמְתָא֙ לְחַכִּימִ֔ין וּמַנְדְּעָ֖א לְיָדְעֵ֥י בִינָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhv' mhshn' 'dny' vzmny' mh'dh mlkhyn vmhqym mlkhyn yhb chkhmt' lchkhymyn vmnd'' lyd'y bynh
verses.translation: And He changeth the times and the seasons; He removeth kings, and setteth up kings; He giveth wisdom unto the wise, And knowledge to them that know understanding;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֛וּא גָּלֵ֥א עַמִּיקָתָ֖א וּמְסַתְּרָתָ֑א יָדַע֙ מָ֣ה בַחֲשׁוֹכָ֔א (ונהירא) [וּנְהוֹרָ֖א] עִמֵּ֥הּ שְׁרֵֽא׃
verses.translit: hv' gl' 'myqt' vmstrt' yd' mh bchshvkh' (vnhyr') [vnhvr'] 'mh shr'
verses.translation: He revealeth the deep and secret things; He knoweth what is in the darkness, And the light dwelleth with Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֣ךְ  אֱלָ֣הּ אֲבָהָתִ֗י מְהוֹדֵ֤א וּמְשַׁבַּח֙ אֲנָ֔ה דִּ֧י חׇכְמְתָ֛א וּגְבוּרְתָ֖א יְהַ֣בְתְּ לִ֑י וּכְעַ֤ן הֽוֹדַעְתַּ֙נִי֙ דִּֽי־בְעֵ֣ינָא מִנָּ֔ךְ דִּֽי־מִלַּ֥ת מַלְכָּ֖א הוֹדַעְתֶּֽנָא׃
verses.translit: lkh  'lh 'bhty mhvd' vmshbch 'nh dy chkhmt' vgbvrt' yhbt ly vkh'n hvd'tny dyb'yn' mnkh dymlt mlkh' hvd'tn'
verses.translation: I thank Thee, and praise Thee, O Thou God of my fathers, w Who hast given me wisdom and might, And hast now made known unto me what we desired of Thee; For Thou hast made known unto us the king’s matter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־קֳבֵ֣ל דְּנָ֗ה דָּֽנִיֵּאל֙ עַ֣ל עַל־אַרְי֔וֹךְ דִּ֚י מַנִּ֣י מַלְכָּ֔א לְהוֹבָדָ֖ה לְחַכִּימֵ֣י בָבֶ֑ל אֲזַ֣ל  וְכֵ֣ן אֲמַר־לֵ֗הּ לְחַכִּימֵ֤י בָבֶל֙ אַל־תְּהוֹבֵ֔ד הַעֵ֙לְנִי֙ קֳדָ֣ם מַלְכָּ֔א וּפִשְׁרָ֖א לְמַלְכָּ֥א אֲחַוֵּֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khlqbl dnh dny'l 'l 'l'ryvkh dy mny mlkh' lhvbdh lchkhymy bbl 'zl  vkhn 'mrlh lchkhymy bbl 'lthvbd h'lny qdm mlkh' vpshr' lmlkh' 'chv' {s}
verses.translation: Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch, whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon; he went and said thus unto him: ‘Destroy not the wise men of Babylon; bring me in before the king, and I will declare unto the king the interpretation.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱדַ֤יִן אַרְיוֹךְ֙ בְּהִתְבְּהָלָ֔ה הַנְעֵ֥ל לְדָנִיֵּ֖אל קֳדָ֣ם מַלְכָּ֑א וְכֵ֣ן אֲמַר־לֵ֗הּ דִּֽי־הַשְׁכַּ֤חַת גְּבַר֙ מִן־בְּנֵ֤י גָֽלוּתָא֙ דִּ֣י יְה֔וּד דִּ֥י פִשְׁרָ֖א לְמַלְכָּ֥א יְהוֹדַֽע׃
verses.translit: 'dyn 'ryvkh bhtbhlh hn'l ldny'l qdm mlkh' vkhn 'mrlh dyhshkhcht gbr mnbny glvt' dy yhvd dy pshr' lmlkh' yhvd'
verses.translation: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said thus unto him: ‘I have found a man of the children of the captivity of Judah, that will make known unto the king the interpretation.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָנֵ֤ה מַלְכָּא֙ וְאָמַ֣ר לְדָנִיֵּ֔אל דִּ֥י שְׁמֵ֖הּ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּ֑ר (האיתיך) [הַֽאִיתָ֣ךְ] כָּהֵ֗ל לְהוֹדָעֻתַ֛נִי חֶלְמָ֥א דִֽי־חֲזֵ֖ית וּפִשְׁרֵֽהּ׃
verses.translit: 'nh mlkh' v'mr ldny'l dy shmh bltsh'tsr (h'ytykh) [h'ytkh] khhl lhvd'tny chlm' dychzyt vpshrh
verses.translation: The king spoke and said to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar: ‘Art thou able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen, and the interpretation thereof?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָנֵ֧ה דָנִיֵּ֛אל קֳדָ֥ם מַלְכָּ֖א וְאָמַ֑ר רָזָא֙ דִּֽי־מַלְכָּ֣א שָׁאֵ֔ל לָ֧א חַכִּימִ֣ין אָֽשְׁפִ֗ין חַרְטֻמִּין֙ גָּזְרִ֔ין יָכְלִ֖ין לְהַֽחֲוָיָ֥ה לְמַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.translit: 'nh dny'l qdm mlkh' v'mr rz' dymlkh' sh'l l' chkhymyn 'shpyn chrtmyn gzryn ykhlyn lhchvyh lmlkh'
verses.translation: Daniel answered before the king, and said: ‘The secret which the king hath asked can neither wise men, enchanters, magicians, nor astrologers, declare unto the king;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרַ֡ם אִיתַ֞י אֱלָ֤הּ בִּשְׁמַיָּא֙ גָּלֵ֣א רָזִ֔ין וְהוֹדַ֗ע לְמַלְכָּא֙ נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּ֔ר מָ֛ה דִּ֥י לֶהֱוֵ֖א בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית יוֹמַיָּ֑א חֶלְמָ֨ךְ וְחֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשָׁ֛ךְ עַֽל־מִשְׁכְּבָ֖ךְ דְּנָ֥ה הֽוּא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: brm 'yty 'lh bshmy' gl' rzyn vhvd' lmlkh' nbvkhdntsr mh dy lhv' b'chryt yvmy' chlmkh vchzvy r'shkh 'lmshkhbkh dnh hv' {s}
verses.translation: but there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, and He hath made known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the end of days. Thy dream, and the visions of thy head upon thy bed, are these:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (אנתה) [אַ֣נְתְּ] מַלְכָּ֗א רַעְיוֹנָךְ֙ עַל־מִשְׁכְּבָ֣ךְ סְלִ֔קוּ מָ֛ה דִּ֥י לֶהֱוֵ֖א אַחֲרֵ֣י דְנָ֑ה וְגָלֵ֧א רָזַיָּ֛א הוֹדְעָ֖ךְ מָה־דִ֥י לֶהֱוֵֽא׃
verses.translit: ('nth) ['nt] mlkh' r'yvnkh 'lmshkhbkh slqv mh dy lhv' 'chry dnh vgl' rzy' hvd'kh mhdy lhv'
verses.translation: as for thee, O king, thy thoughts came [into thy mind] upon thy bed, what should come to pass hereafter; and He that revealeth secrets hath made known to thee what shall come to pass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנָ֗ה לָ֤א בְחׇכְמָה֙ דִּֽי־אִיתַ֥י בִּי֙ מִן־כׇּל־חַיַּיָּ֔א רָזָ֥א דְנָ֖ה גֱּלִ֣י לִ֑י לָהֵ֗ן עַל־דִּבְרַת֙ דִּ֤י פִשְׁרָא֙ לְמַלְכָּ֣א יְהוֹדְע֔וּן וְרַעְיוֹנֵ֥י לִבְבָ֖ךְ תִּנְדַּֽע׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'nh l' bchkhmh dy'yty by mnkhlchyy' rz' dnh gly ly lhn 'ldbrt dy pshr' lmlkh' yhvd'vn vr'yvny lbbkh tnd' {s}
verses.translation: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but to the intent that the interpretation may be made known to the king, and that thou mayest know the thoughts of thy heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (אנתה) [אַ֣נְתְּ] מַלְכָּ֗א חָזֵ֤ה הֲוַ֙יְתָ֙ וַאֲל֨וּ צְלֵ֥ם חַד֙ שַׂגִּ֔יא צַלְמָ֨א דִכֵּ֥ן רַ֛ב וְזִיוֵ֥הּ יַתִּ֖יר קָאֵ֣ם לְקׇבְלָ֑ךְ וְרֵוֵ֖הּ דְּחִֽיל׃
verses.translit: ('nth) ['nt] mlkh' chzh hvyt v'lv tslm chd shgy' tslm' dkhn rb vzyvh ytyr q'm lqblkh vrvh dchyl
verses.translation: Thou, O king, sawest, and behold a great image. This image, which was mighty, and whose brightness was surpassing, stood before thee; and the appearance thereof was terrible.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֣וּא צַלְמָ֗א רֵאשֵׁהּ֙ דִּֽי־דְהַ֣ב טָ֔ב חֲד֥וֹהִי וּדְרָע֖וֹהִי דִּ֣י כְסַ֑ף מְע֥וֹהִי וְיַרְכָתֵ֖הּ דִּ֥י נְחָֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: hv' tslm' r'shh dydhb tb chdvhy vdr'vhy dy khsf m'vhy vyrkhth dy nchsh
verses.translation: As for that image, its head was of fine gold, its breast and its arms of silver, its belly and its thighs of brass,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁק֖וֹהִי דִּ֣י פַרְזֶ֑ל רַגְל֕וֹהִי (מנהון) [מִנְּהֵין֙] דִּ֣י פַרְזֶ֔ל (ומנהון) [וּמִנְּהֵ֖ין] דִּ֥י חֲסַֽף׃
verses.translit: shqvhy dy przl rglvhy (mnhvn) [mnhyn] dy przl (vmnhvn) [vmnhyn] dy chsf
verses.translation: its legs of iron, its feet part of iron and part of clay.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוַ֗יְתָ עַ֠ד דִּ֣י הִתְגְּזֶ֤רֶת אֶ֙בֶן֙ דִּי־לָ֣א בִידַ֔יִן וּמְחָ֤ת לְצַלְמָא֙ עַל־רַגְל֔וֹהִי דִּ֥י פַרְזְלָ֖א וְחַסְפָּ֑א וְהַדֵּ֖קֶת הִמּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: chzh hvyt 'd dy htgzrt 'bn dyl' bydyn vmcht ltslm' 'lrglvhy dy przl' vchsp' vhdqt hmvn
verses.translation: Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon its feet that were of iron and clay, and broke them to pieces.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֣יִן דָּ֣קוּ כַחֲדָ֡ה פַּרְזְלָא֩ חַסְפָּ֨א נְחָשָׁ֜א כַּסְפָּ֣א וְדַהֲבָ֗א וַהֲווֹ֙ כְּע֣וּר מִן־אִדְּרֵי־קַ֔יִט וּנְשָׂ֤א הִמּוֹן֙ רוּחָ֔א וְכׇל־אֲתַ֖ר לָא־הִשְׁתְּכַ֣ח לְה֑וֹן וְאַבְנָ֣א  דִּֽי־מְחָ֣ת לְצַלְמָ֗א הֲוָ֛ת לְט֥וּר רַ֖ב וּמְלָ֥את כׇּל־אַרְעָֽא׃
verses.translit: b'dyn dqv khchdh przl' chsp' nchsh' khsp' vdhb' vhvv kh'vr mn'dryqyt vnsh' hmvn rvch' vkhl'tr l'hshtkhch lhvn v'bn'  dymcht ltslm' hvt ltvr rb vml't khl'r''
verses.translation: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken in pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshing-floors; and the wind carried them away, so that no place was found for them; and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּנָ֣ה חֶלְמָ֔א וּפִשְׁרֵ֖הּ נֵאמַ֥ר קֳדָם־מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.translit: dnh chlm' vpshrh n'mr qdmmlkh'
verses.translation: This is the dream; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (אנתה) [אַ֣נְתְּ] מַלְכָּ֔א מֶ֖לֶךְ מַלְכַיָּ֑א דִּ֚י אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֔א מַלְכוּתָ֥א חִסְנָ֛א וְתׇקְפָּ֥א וִֽיקָרָ֖א יְהַב־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: ('nth) ['nt] mlkh' mlkh mlkhy' dy 'lh shmy' mlkhvt' chsn' vtqp' vyqr' yhblkh
verses.translation: Thou, O king, king of kings, unto whom the God of heaven hath given the kingdom, the power, and the strength, and the glory;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְכׇל־דִּ֣י (דארין) [דָֽיְרִ֣ין] בְּֽנֵי־אֲ֠נָשָׁ֠א חֵיוַ֨ת בָּרָ֤א וְעוֹף־שְׁמַיָּא֙ יְהַ֣ב בִּידָ֔ךְ וְהַשְׁלְטָ֖ךְ בְּכׇלְּה֑וֹן (אנתה) [אַ֨נְתְּ־]ה֔וּא רֵאשָׁ֖ה דִּ֥י דַהֲבָֽא׃
verses.translit: vbkhldy (d'ryn) [dyryn] bny'nsh' chyvt br' v'vfshmy' yhb bydkh vhshltkh bkhlhvn ('nth) ['nt]hv' r'shh dy dhb'
verses.translation: and wheresoever the children of men, the beasts of the field, and the fowls of the heaven dwell, hath He given them into thy hand, and hath made thee to rule over them all; thou art the head of gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָתְרָ֗ךְ תְּק֛וּם מַלְכ֥וּ אׇחֳרִ֖י (ארעא) [אֲרַ֣ע] מִנָּ֑ךְ וּמַלְכ֨וּ (תליתיא) [תְלִיתָאָ֤ה] אׇחֳרִי֙ דִּ֣י נְחָשָׁ֔א דִּ֥י תִשְׁלַ֖ט בְּכׇל־אַרְעָֽא׃
verses.translit: vbtrkh tqvm mlkhv 'chry ('r'') ['r'] mnkh vmlkhv (tlyty') [tlyt'h] 'chry dy nchsh' dy tshlt bkhl'r''
verses.translation: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee; and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַלְכוּ֙ (רביעיה) [רְבִ֣יעָאָ֔ה] תֶּהֱוֵ֥א תַקִּיפָ֖ה כְּפַרְזְלָ֑א כׇּל־קֳבֵ֗ל דִּ֤י פַרְזְלָא֙ מְהַדֵּ֤ק וְחָשֵׁל֙ כֹּ֔לָּא וּֽכְפַרְזְלָ֛א דִּֽי־מְרָעַ֥ע כׇּל־אִלֵּ֖ן תַּדִּ֥ק וְתֵרֹֽעַ׃
verses.translit: vmlkhv (rby'yh) [rby''h] thv' tqyph khprzl' khlqbl dy przl' mhdq vchshl khl' vkhprzl' dymr'' khl'ln tdq vtr'
verses.translation: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron; forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and beateth down all things; and as iron that crusheth all these, shall it break in pieces and crush.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדִֽי־חֲזַ֜יְתָה רַגְלַיָּ֣א וְאֶצְבְּעָתָ֗א (מנהון) [מִנְּהֵ֞ן] חֲסַ֤ף דִּֽי־פֶחָר֙ (ומנהון) [וּמִנְּהֵ֣ין] פַּרְזֶ֔ל מַלְכ֤וּ פְלִיגָה֙ תֶּהֱוֵ֔ה וּמִן־נִצְבְּתָ֥א דִֽי־פַרְזְלָ֖א לֶֽהֱוֵא־בַ֑הּ כׇּל־קֳבֵל֙ דִּ֣י חֲזַ֔יְתָה פַּ֨רְזְלָ֔א מְעָרַ֖ב בַּחֲסַ֥ף טִינָֽא׃
verses.translit: vdychzyth rgly' v'tsb't' (mnhvn) [mnhn] chsf dypchr (vmnhvn) [vmnhyn] przl mlkhv plygh thvh vmnntsbt' dyprzl' lhv'bh khlqbl dy chzyth przl' m'rb bchsf tyn'
verses.translation: And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes, part of potters’clay, and part of iron, it shall be a divided kingdom; but there shall be in it of the firmness of the iron, forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶצְבְּעָת֙ רַגְלַיָּ֔א (מנהון) [מִנְּהֵ֥ין] פַּרְזֶ֖ל (ומנהון) [וּמִנְּהֵ֣ין] חֲסַ֑ף מִן־קְצָ֤ת מַלְכוּתָא֙ תֶּהֱוֵ֣ה תַקִּיפָ֔ה וּמִנַּ֖הּ תֶּהֱוֵ֥א תְבִירָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'tsb't rgly' (mnhvn) [mnhyn] przl (vmnhvn) [vmnhyn] chsf mnqtst mlkhvt' thvh tqyph vmnh thv' tbyrh
verses.translation: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so part of the kingdom shall be strong, and part thereof broken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (די) [וְדִ֣י] חֲזַ֗יְתָ פַּרְזְלָא֙ מְעָרַב֙ בַּחֲסַ֣ף טִינָ֔א מִתְעָרְבִ֤ין לֶהֱוֺן֙ בִּזְרַ֣ע אֲנָשָׁ֔א וְלָֽא־לֶהֱוֺ֥ן דָּבְקִ֖ין דְּנָ֣ה עִם־דְּנָ֑ה הֵֽא־כְדִ֣י פַרְזְלָ֔א לָ֥א מִתְעָרַ֖ב עִם־חַסְפָּֽא׃
verses.translit: (dy) [vdy] chzyt przl' m'rb bchsf tyn' mt'rbyn lhvn bzr' 'nsh' vl'lhvn dbqyn dnh 'mdnh h'khdy przl' l' mt'rb 'mchsp'
verses.translation: And whereas thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves by the seed of men; but they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron doth not mingle with clay.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽבְיוֹמֵיה֞וֹן דִּ֧י מַלְכַיָּ֣א אִנּ֗וּן יְקִים֩ אֱלָ֨הּ שְׁמַיָּ֤א מַלְכוּ֙ דִּ֤י לְעָלְמִין֙ לָ֣א תִתְחַבַּ֔ל וּמַ֨לְכוּתָ֔ה לְעַ֥ם אׇחֳרָ֖ן לָ֣א תִשְׁתְּבִ֑ק תַּדִּ֤ק וְתָסֵיף֙ כׇּל־אִלֵּ֣ין מַלְכְוָתָ֔א וְהִ֖יא תְּק֥וּם לְעָלְמַיָּֽא׃
verses.translit: vbyvmyhvn dy mlkhy' 'nvn yqym 'lh shmy' mlkhv dy l'lmyn l' ttchbl vmlkhvth l'm 'chrn l' tshtbq tdq vtsyf khl'lyn mlkhvt' vhy' tqvm l'lmy'
verses.translation: And in the days of those kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed; nor shall the kingdom be left to another people; it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, but it shall stand for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־קֳבֵ֣ל דִּֽי־חֲזַ֡יְתָ דִּ֣י מִטּוּרָא֩ אִתְגְּזֶ֨רֶת אֶ֜בֶן דִּי־לָ֣א בִידַ֗יִן וְ֠הַדֵּ֠קֶת פַּרְזְלָ֨א נְחָשָׁ֤א חַסְפָּא֙ כַּסְפָּ֣א וְדַהֲבָ֔א אֱלָ֥הּ רַב֙ הוֹדַ֣ע לְמַלְכָּ֔א מָ֛ה דִּ֥י לֶהֱוֵ֖א אַחֲרֵ֣י דְנָ֑ה וְיַצִּ֥יב חֶלְמָ֖א וּמְהֵימַ֥ן פִּשְׁרֵֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khlqbl dychzyt dy mtvr' 'tgzrt 'bn dyl' bydyn vhdqt przl' nchsh' chsp' khsp' vdhb' 'lh rb hvd' lmlkh' mh dy lhv' 'chry dnh vytsyb chlm' vmhymn pshrh {s}
verses.translation: Forasmuch as thou sawest that a stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it broke in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter; and the dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֠אדַ֠יִן מַלְכָּ֤א נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּר֙ נְפַ֣ל עַל־אַנְפּ֔וֹהִי וּלְדָנִיֵּ֖אל סְגִ֑ד וּמִנְחָה֙ וְנִ֣יחֹחִ֔ין אֲמַ֖ר לְנַסָּ֥כָה לֵֽהּ׃
verses.translit: b'dyn mlkh' nbvkhdntsr npl 'l'npvhy vldny'l sgd vmnchh vnychchyn 'mr lnskhh lh
verses.translation: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an offering and sweet odours unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָנֵה֩ מַלְכָּ֨א לְדָנִיֵּ֜אל וְאָמַ֗ר מִן־קְשֹׁט֙ דִּ֣י אֱלָהֲכ֗וֹן ה֣וּא אֱלָ֧הּ אֱלָהִ֛ין וּמָרֵ֥א מַלְכִ֖ין וְגָלֵ֣ה רָזִ֑ין דִּ֣י יְכֵ֔לְתָּ לְמִגְלֵ֖א רָזָ֥א דְנָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'nh mlkh' ldny'l v'mr mnqsht dy 'lhkhvn hv' 'lh 'lhyn vmr' mlkhyn vglh rzyn dy ykhlt lmgl' rz' dnh
verses.translation: The king spoke unto Daniel, and said: ‘Of a truth it is, that your God is the God of gods, and the Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing thou hast been able to reveal this secret.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱדַ֨יִן מַלְכָּ֜א לְדָנִיֵּ֣אל רַבִּ֗י וּמַתְּנָ֨ן רַבְרְבָ֤ן שַׂגִּיאָן֙ יְהַב־לֵ֔הּ וְהַ֨שְׁלְטֵ֔הּ עַ֖ל כׇּל־מְדִינַ֣ת בָּבֶ֑ל וְרַ֨ב־סִגְנִ֔ין עַ֖ל כׇּל־חַכִּימֵ֥י בָבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: 'dyn mlkh' ldny'l rby vmtnn rbrbn shgy'n yhblh vhshlth 'l khlmdynt bbl vrbsgnyn 'l khlchkhymy bbl
verses.translation: Then the king made Daniel great, and gave him many great gifts, and made him to rule over the whole province of Babylon, and to be chief prefect over all the wise men of Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדָנִיֵּאל֙ בְּעָ֣א מִן־מַלְכָּ֔א וּמַנִּ֗י עַ֤ל עֲבִֽידְתָּא֙ דִּ֚י מְדִינַ֣ת בָּבֶ֔ל לְשַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ וְדָנִיֵּ֖אל בִּתְרַ֥ע מַלְכָּֽא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vdny'l b'' mnmlkh' vmny 'l 'bydt' dy mdynt bbl lshdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv vdny'l btr' mlkh' {p}
verses.translation: And Daniel requested of the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon; but Daniel was in the gate of the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֗א עֲבַד֙ צְלֵ֣ם דִּֽי־דְהַ֔ב רוּמֵהּ֙ אַמִּ֣ין שִׁתִּ֔ין פְּתָיֵ֖הּ אַמִּ֣ין שִׁ֑ת אֲקִימֵהּ֙ בְּבִקְעַ֣ת דּוּרָ֔א בִּמְדִינַ֖ת בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: nbvkhdntsr mlkh' 'bd tslm dydhb rvmh 'myn shtyn ptyh 'myn sht 'qymh bbq't dvr' bmdynt bbl
verses.translation: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits; he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֡א שְׁלַ֡ח לְמִכְנַ֣שׁ  לַֽאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֡א סִגְנַיָּ֣א וּֽפַחֲוָתָ֡א אֲדַרְגָּזְרַיָּא֩ גְדָ֨בְרַיָּ֤א דְּתָבְרַיָּא֙ תִּפְתָּיֵ֔א וְכֹ֖ל שִׁלְטֹנֵ֣י מְדִֽינָתָ֑א לְמֵתֵא֙ לַחֲנֻכַּ֣ת צַלְמָ֔א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ים נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.translit: vnbvkhdntsr mlkh' shlch lmkhnsh  l'chshdrpny' sgny' vpchvt' 'drgzry' gdbry' dtbry' tpty' vkhl shltny mdynt' lmt' lchnkht tslm' dy hqym nbvkhdntsr mlkh'
verses.translation: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the satraps, the prefects, and the governors, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֡יִן מִֽתְכַּנְּשִׁ֡ין אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֡א סִגְנַיָּ֣א וּֽפַחֲוָתָ֡א אֲדַרְגָּזְרַיָּ֣א גְדָבְרַיָּא֩ דְּתָ֨בְרַיָּ֜א תִּפְתָּיֵ֗א וְכֹל֙ שִׁלְטֹנֵ֣י מְדִֽינָתָ֔א לַחֲנֻכַּ֣ת צַלְמָ֔א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ים נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֑א (וקאמין) [וְקָֽיְמִין֙] לׇקֳבֵ֣ל צַלְמָ֔א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ים נְבֻכַדְנֶצַּֽר׃
verses.translit: b'dyn mtkhnshyn 'chshdrpny' sgny' vpchvt' 'drgzry' gdbry' dtbry' tpty' vkhl shltny mdynt' lchnkht tslm' dy hqym nbvkhdntsr mlkh' (vq'myn) [vqymyn] lqbl tslm' dy hqym nbkhdntsr
verses.translation: Then the satraps, the prefects, and the governors, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, were gathered together unto the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכָרוֹזָ֖א קָרֵ֣א בְחָ֑יִל לְכ֤וֹן אָֽמְרִין֙ עַֽמְמַיָּ֔א אֻמַּיָּ֖א וְלִשָּׁנַיָּֽא׃
verses.translit: vkhrvz' qr' bchyl lkhvn 'mryn 'mmy' 'my' vlshny'
verses.translation: And the herald cried aloud: ‘To you it is commanded, O peoples, nations, and languages,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּעִדָּנָ֡א דִּֽי־תִשְׁמְע֡וּן קָ֣ל קַרְנָ֣א מַ֠שְׁרוֹקִיתָ֠א (קיתרס) [קַתְר֨וֹס] שַׂבְּכָ֤א פְסַנְתֵּרִין֙ סוּמְפֹּ֣נְיָ֔א וְכֹ֖ל זְנֵ֣י זְמָרָ֑א תִּפְּל֤וּן וְתִסְגְּדוּן֙ לְצֶ֣לֶם דַּהֲבָ֔א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ים נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.translit: b'dn' dytshm'vn ql qrn' mshrvqyt' (qytrs) [qtrvs] shbkh' psntryn svmpny' vkhl zny zmr' tplvn vtsgdvn ltslm dhb' dy hqym nbvkhdntsr mlkh'
verses.translation: that at what time ye hear the sound of the horn, pipe, harp, trigon, psaltery, bagpipe, and all kinds of music, ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַן־דִּי־לָ֥א יִפֵּ֖ל וְיִסְגֻּ֑ד בַּהּ־שַׁעֲתָ֣א יִתְרְמֵ֔א לְגֽוֹא־אַתּ֥וּן נוּרָ֖א יָקִֽדְתָּֽא׃
verses.translit: vmndyl' ypl vysgd bhsh't' ytrm' lgv''tvn nvr' yqdt'
verses.translation: and whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־קֳבֵ֣ל דְּנָ֡ה בֵּהּ־זִמְנָ֡א כְּדִ֣י שָֽׁמְעִ֣ין כׇּֽל־עַמְמַיָּ֡א קָ֣ל קַרְנָא֩ מַשְׁר֨וֹקִיתָ֜א (קיתרס) [קַתְר֤וֹס] שַׂבְּכָא֙ פְּסַנְטֵרִ֔ין וְכֹ֖ל זְנֵ֣י זְמָרָ֑א נָֽפְלִ֨ין כׇּֽל־עַֽמְמַיָּ֜א אֻמַּיָּ֣א וְלִשָּׁנַיָּ֗א סָֽגְדִין֙ לְצֶ֣לֶם דַּהֲבָ֔א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ים נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.translit: khlqbl dnh bhzmn' khdy shm'yn khl'mmy' ql qrn' mshrvqyt' (qytrs) [qtrvs] shbkh' psntryn vkhl zny zmr' nplyn khl'mmy' 'my' vlshny' sgdyn ltslm dhb' dy hqym nbvkhdntsr mlkh'
verses.translation: Therefore at that time, when all the peoples heard the sound of the horn, pipe, harp, trigon, psaltery, and all kinds of music, all the peoples, the nations, and the languages, fell down and worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־קֳבֵ֤ל דְּנָה֙ בֵּהּ־זִמְנָ֔א קְרִ֖בוּ גֻּבְרִ֣ין כַּשְׂדָּאִ֑ין וַאֲכַ֥לוּ קַרְצֵיה֖וֹן דִּ֥י יְהוּדָיֵֽא׃
verses.translit: khlqbl dnh bhzmn' qrbv gbryn khshd'yn v'khlv qrtsyhvn dy yhvdy'
verses.translation: Wherefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, and brought accusation against the Jews.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲנוֹ֙ וְאָ֣מְרִ֔ין לִנְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֖ר מַלְכָּ֑א מַלְכָּ֖א לְעָלְמִ֥ין חֱיִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'nv v'mryn lnbvkhdntsr mlkh' mlkh' l'lmyn chyy
verses.translation: They spoke and said to Nebuchadnezzar the king: ‘O king, live for ever!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (אנתה) [אַ֣נְתְּ] מַלְכָּא֮ שָׂ֣מְתָּ טְּעֵם֒ דִּ֣י כׇל־אֱנָ֡שׁ דִּֽי־יִשְׁמַ֡ע קָ֣ל קַרְנָ֣א מַ֠שְׁרֹקִיתָ֠א (קיתרס) [קַתְר֨וֹס] שַׂבְּכָ֤א פְסַנְתֵּרִין֙ (וסיפניה) [וְסוּפֹּ֣נְיָ֔ה] וְכֹ֖ל זְנֵ֣י זְמָרָ֑א יִפֵּ֥ל וְיִסְגֻּ֖ד לְצֶ֥לֶם דַּהֲבָֽא׃
verses.translit: ('nth) ['nt] mlkh' shmt t'm dy khl'nsh dyyshm' ql qrn' mshrqyt' (qytrs) [qtrvs] shbkh' psntryn (vsypnyh) [vsvpnyh] vkhl zny zmr' ypl vysgd ltslm dhb'
verses.translation: Thou, O king, hast made a decree, that every man that shall hear the sound of the horn, pipe, harp, trigon, psaltery, and bagpipe, and all kinds of music, shall fall down and worship the golden image;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַן־דִּי־לָ֥א יִפֵּ֖ל וְיִסְגֻּ֑ד יִתְרְמֵ֕א לְגֽוֹא־אַתּ֥וּן נוּרָ֖א יָקִֽדְתָּֽא׃
verses.translit: vmndyl' ypl vysgd ytrm' lgv''tvn nvr' yqdt'
verses.translation: and whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִיתַ֞י גֻּבְרִ֣ין יְהוּדָאיִ֗ן דִּֽי־מַנִּ֤יתָ יָתְהוֹן֙ עַל־עֲבִידַת֙ מְדִינַ֣ת בָּבֶ֔ל שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ גֻּבְרַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֗ךְ לָא־שָׂ֨מֽוּ (עליך) [עֲלָ֤ךְ] מַלְכָּא֙ טְעֵ֔ם (לאלהיך) [לֵֽאלָהָךְ֙] לָ֣א פָלְחִ֔ין וּלְצֶ֧לֶם דַּהֲבָ֛א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ימְתָּ לָ֥א סָגְדִֽין׃
verses.translit: 'yty gbryn yhvd'yn dymnyt ythvn 'l'bydt mdynt bbl shdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv gbry' 'lkh l'shmv ('lykh) ['lkh] mlkh' t'm (l'lhykh) [l'lhkh] l' plchyn vltslm dhb' dy hqymt l' sgdyn
verses.translation: There are certain Jews whom thou hast appointed over the affairs of the province of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego; these men, O king, have not regarded thee: they serve not thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֤יִן נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר֙ בִּרְגַ֣ז וַחֲמָ֔א אֲמַר֙ לְהַיְתָיָ֔ה לְשַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ בֵּאדַ֙יִן֙ גֻּבְרַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֔ךְ הֵיתָ֖יוּ קֳדָ֥ם מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.translit: b'dyn nbvkhdntsr brgz vchm' 'mr lhytyh lshdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv b'dyn gbry' 'lkh hytyv qdm mlkh'
verses.translation: Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego. Then were these men brought before the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָנֵ֤ה נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּר֙ וְאָמַ֣ר לְה֔וֹן הַצְדָּ֕א שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ לֵֽאלָהַ֗י לָ֤א אִֽיתֵיכוֹן֙ פָּֽלְחִ֔ין וּלְצֶ֧לֶם דַּהֲבָ֛א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ימֶת לָ֥א סָֽגְדִֽין׃
verses.translit: 'nh nbvkhdntsr v'mr lhvn htsd' shdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv l'lhy l' 'ytykhvn plchyn vltslm dhb' dy hqymt l' sgdyn
verses.translation: Nebuchadnezzar spoke and said unto them: ‘Is it true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, that ye serve not my gods, nor worship the golden image which I have set up?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּעַ֞ן הֵ֧ן אִֽיתֵיכ֣וֹן עֲתִידִ֗ין דִּ֣י בְעִדָּנָ֡א דִּֽי־תִשְׁמְע֡וּן קָ֣ל קַרְנָ֣א מַשְׁרוֹקִיתָ֣א (קיתרס) [קַתְר֣וֹס] שַׂבְּכָ֡א פְּסַנְתֵּרִין֩ וְסוּמְפֹּ֨נְיָ֜ה וְכֹ֣ל  זְנֵ֣י זְמָרָ֗א תִּפְּל֣וּן וְתִסְגְּדוּן֮ לְצַלְמָ֣א דִֽי־עַבְדֵת֒ וְהֵן֙ לָ֣א תִסְגְּד֔וּן בַּהּ־שַׁעֲתָ֣א תִתְרְמ֔וֹן לְגֽוֹא־אַתּ֥וּן נוּרָ֖א יָקִֽדְתָּ֑א וּמַן־ה֣וּא אֱלָ֔הּ דִּ֥י יְשֵֽׁיזְבִנְכ֖וֹן מִן־יְדָֽי׃
verses.translit: kh'n hn 'ytykhvn 'tydyn dy b'dn' dytshm'vn ql qrn' mshrvqyt' (qytrs) [qtrvs] shbkh' psntryn vsvmpnyh vkhl  zny zmr' tplvn vtsgdvn ltslm' dy'bdt vhn l' tsgdvn bhsh't' ttrmvn lgv''tvn nvr' yqdt' vmnhv' 'lh dy yshyzbnkhvn mnydy
verses.translation: Now if ye be ready that at what time ye hear the sound of the horn, pipe, harp, trigon, psaltery, and bagpipe, and all kinds of music, ye fall down and worship the image which I have made , well; but if ye worship not, ye shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace; and who is the god that shall deliver you out of my hands?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲנ֗וֹ שַׁדְרַ֤ךְ מֵישַׁךְ֙ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֔וֹ וְאָמְרִ֖ין לְמַלְכָּ֑א נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּ֔ר לָֽא־חַשְׁחִ֨ין אֲנַ֧חְנָא עַל־דְּנָ֛ה פִּתְגָ֖ם לַהֲתָבוּתָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'nv shdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv v'mryn lmlkh' nbvkhdntsr l'chshchyn 'nchn' 'ldnh ptgm lhtbvtkh
verses.translation: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, answered and said to the king: ‘O Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer thee in this matter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֣ן אִיתַ֗י אֱלָהַ֙נָא֙ דִּֽי־אֲנַ֣חְנָא פָֽלְחִ֔ין יָכִ֖ל לְשֵׁיזָבוּתַ֑נָא מִן־אַתּ֨וּן נוּרָ֧א יָקִֽדְתָּ֛א וּמִן־יְדָ֥ךְ מַלְכָּ֖א יְשֵׁיזִֽב׃
verses.translit: hn 'yty 'lhn' dy'nchn' plchyn ykhl lshyzbvtn' mn'tvn nvr' yqdt' vmnydkh mlkh' yshyzb
verses.translation: If our God whom we serve is able to deliver us, He will deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and out of thy hand, O king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵ֣ן לָ֔א יְדִ֥יעַ לֶהֱוֵא־לָ֖ךְ מַלְכָּ֑א דִּ֤י (לאלהיך) [לֵֽאלָהָךְ֙] לָא־[אִיתַ֣נָא] (איתינא) פָֽלְחִ֔ין וּלְצֶ֧לֶם דַּהֲבָ֛א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ימְתָּ לָ֥א נִסְגֻּֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhn l' ydy' lhv'lkh mlkh' dy (l'lhykh) [l'lhkh] l'['ytn'] ('ytyn') plchyn vltslm dhb' dy hqymt l' nsgd {p}
verses.translation: But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֨יִן נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֜ר הִתְמְלִ֣י חֱמָ֗א וּצְלֵ֤ם אַנְפּ֙וֹהִי֙ (אשתנו) [אֶשְׁתַּנִּ֔י] עַל־שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ עָנֵ֤ה וְאָמַר֙ לְמֵזֵ֣א לְאַתּוּנָ֔א חַ֨ד־שִׁבְעָ֔ה עַ֛ל דִּ֥י חֲזֵ֖ה לְמֵזְיֵֽהּ׃
verses.translit: b'dyn nbvkhdntsr htmly chm' vtslm 'npvhy ('shtnv) ['shtny] 'lshdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv 'nh v'mr lmz' l'tvn' chdshb'h 'l dy chzh lmzyh
verses.translation: Then was Nebuchadnezzar filled with fury, and the form of his visage was changed, against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego; he spoke, and commanded that they should heat the furnace seven times more than it was wont to be heated.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְגֻבְרִ֤ין גִּבָּֽרֵי־חַ֙יִל֙ דִּ֣י בְחַיְלֵ֔הּ אֲמַר֙ לְכַפָּתָ֔ה לְשַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ לְמִרְמֵ֕א לְאַתּ֥וּן נוּרָ֖א יָקִֽדְתָּֽא׃
verses.translit: vlgbryn gbrychyl dy bchylh 'mr lkhpth lshdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv lmrm' l'tvn nvr' yqdt'
verses.translation: And he commanded certain mighty men that were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֜יִן גֻּבְרַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֗ךְ כְּפִ֙תוּ֙ בְּסַרְבָּלֵיהוֹן֙ (פטישיהון) [פַּטְּשֵׁיה֔וֹן] וְכַרְבְּלָתְה֖וֹן וּלְבֻשֵׁיה֑וֹן וּרְמִ֕יו לְגֽוֹא־אַתּ֥וּן נוּרָ֖א יָקִֽדְתָּֽא׃
verses.translit: b'dyn gbry' 'lkh khptv bsrblyhvn (ptyshyhvn) [ptshyhvn] vkhrblthvn vlbshyhvn vrmyv lgv''tvn nvr' yqdt'
verses.translation: Then these men were bound in their cloaks, their tunics, and their robes, and their other garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־קֳבֵ֣ל דְּנָ֗ה מִן־דִּ֞י מִלַּ֤ת מַלְכָּא֙ מַחְצְפָ֔ה וְאַתּוּנָ֖א אֵזֵ֣ה יַתִּ֑ירָה גֻּבְרַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֗ךְ דִּ֤י הַסִּ֙קוּ֙ לְשַׁדְרַ֤ךְ מֵישַׁךְ֙ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֔וֹ קַטִּ֣ל הִמּ֔וֹן שְׁבִיבָ֖א דִּ֥י נוּרָֽא׃
verses.translit: khlqbl dnh mndy mlt mlkh' mchtsph v'tvn' 'zh ytyrh gbry' 'lkh dy hsqv lshdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv qtl hmvn shbyb' dy nvr'
verses.translation: Therefore because the king’s commandment was peremptory, and the furnace exceeding hot, the flame of the fire slew those men that took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגֻבְרַיָּ֤א אִלֵּךְ֙ תְּלָ֣תֵּה֔וֹן שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ נְפַ֛לוּ לְגֽוֹא־אַתּוּן־נוּרָ֥א יָֽקִדְתָּ֖א מְכַפְּתִֽין׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vgbry' 'lkh tlthvn shdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv nplv lgv''tvnnvr' yqdt' mkhptyn {p}
verses.translation: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱדַ֙יִן֙ נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֔א תְּוַ֖הּ וְקָ֣ם בְּהִתְבְּהָלָ֑ה עָנֵ֨ה וְאָמַ֜ר לְהַדָּֽבְר֗וֹהִי הֲלָא֩ גֻבְרִ֨ין תְּלָתָ֜ה רְמֵ֤ינָא לְגוֹא־נוּרָא֙ מְכַפְּתִ֔ין עָנַ֤יִן וְאָמְרִין֙ לְמַלְכָּ֔א יַצִּיבָ֖א מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.translit: 'dyn nbvkhdntsr mlkh' tvh vqm bhtbhlh 'nh v'mr lhdbrvhy hl' gbryn tlth rmyn' lgv'nvr' mkhptyn 'nyn v'mryn lmlkh' ytsyb' mlkh'
verses.translation: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was alarmed, and rose up in haste; he spoke and said unto his ministers: ‘Did not we cast three men bound into the midst of the fire?’ They answered and said unto the king: ‘True, O king.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָנֵ֣ה וְאָמַ֗ר הָֽא־אֲנָ֨ה חָזֵ֜ה גֻּבְרִ֣ין אַרְבְּעָ֗ה שְׁרַ֙יִן֙ מַהְלְכִ֣ין בְּגֽוֹא־נוּרָ֔א וַחֲבָ֖ל לָא־אִיתַ֣י בְּה֑וֹן וְרֵוֵהּ֙ דִּ֣י (רביעיא) [רְֽבִיעָאָ֔ה] דָּמֵ֖ה לְבַר־אֱלָהִֽין׃
verses.translit: 'nh v'mr h''nh chzh gbryn 'rb'h shryn mhlkhyn bgv'nvr' vchbl l''yty bhvn vrvh dy (rby'y') [rby''h] dmh lbr'lhyn
verses.translation: He answered and said: ‘Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the appearance of the fourth is like a son of the gods.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֜יִן קְרֵ֣ב נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֗ר לִתְרַע֮ אַתּ֣וּן נוּרָ֣א יָקִֽדְתָּא֒ עָנֵ֣ה וְאָמַ֗ר שַׁדְרַ֨ךְ מֵישַׁ֧ךְ וַעֲבֵד־נְג֛וֹ עַבְד֛וֹהִי דִּֽי־אֱלָהָ֥א (עליא) [עִלָּאָ֖ה] פֻּ֣קוּ וֶאֱת֑וֹ בֵּאדַ֣יִן נָֽפְקִ֗ין שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֛ךְ וַעֲבֵ֥ד נְג֖וֹ מִן־גּ֥וֹא נוּרָֽא׃
verses.translit: b'dyn qrb nbvkhdntsr ltr' 'tvn nvr' yqdt' 'nh v'mr shdrkh myshkh v'bdngv 'bdvhy dy'lh' ('ly') ['l'h] pqv v'tv b'dyn npqyn shdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv mngv' nvr'
verses.translation: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace; he spoke and said: ‘Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, ye servants of God Most High, come forth, and come hither.’ Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, came forth out of the midst of the fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֠מִֽתְכַּנְּשִׁ֠ין אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֞א סִגְנַיָּ֣א וּפַחֲוָתָא֮ וְהַדָּבְרֵ֣י מַלְכָּא֒ חָזַ֣יִן לְגֻבְרַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֡ךְ דִּי֩ לָֽא־שְׁלֵ֨ט נוּרָ֜א בְּגֶשְׁמְה֗וֹן וּשְׂעַ֤ר רֵֽאשְׁהוֹן֙ לָ֣א הִתְחָרַ֔ךְ וְסַרְבָּלֵיה֖וֹן לָ֣א שְׁנ֑וֹ וְרֵ֣יחַ נ֔וּר לָ֥א עֲדָ֖ת בְּהֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vmtkhnshyn 'chshdrpny' sgny' vpchvt' vhdbry mlkh' chzyn lgbry' 'lkh dy l'shlt nvr' bgshmhvn vsh'r r'shhvn l' htchrkh vsrblyhvn l' shnv vrych nvr l' 'dt bhvn
verses.translation: And the satraps, the prefects, and the governors, and the king’s ministers, being gathered together, saw these men, that the fire had no power upon their bodies, nor was the hair of their head singed, neither were their cloaks changed, nor had the smell of fire passed on them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָנֵ֨ה נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּ֜ר וְאָמַ֗ר בְּרִ֤יךְ אֱלָהֲהוֹן֙ דִּֽי־שַׁדְרַ֤ךְ מֵישַׁךְ֙ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֔וֹ דִּֽי־שְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאֲכֵהּ֙ וְשֵׁיזִ֣ב לְעַבְד֔וֹהִי דִּ֥י הִתְרְחִ֖צוּ עֲל֑וֹהִי וּמִלַּ֤ת מַלְכָּא֙ שַׁנִּ֔יו וִיהַ֣בוּ (גשמיהון) [גֶשְׁמְה֗וֹן] דִּ֠י לָֽא־יִפְלְח֤וּן וְלָֽא־יִסְגְּדוּן֙ לְכׇל־אֱלָ֔הּ לָהֵ֖ן לֵאלָֽהֲהֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: 'nh nbvkhdntsr v'mr brykh 'lhhvn dyshdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv dyshlch ml'khh vshyzb l'bdvhy dy htrchtsv 'lvhy vmlt mlkh' shnyv vyhbv (gshmyhvn) [gshmhvn] dy l'yplchvn vl'ysgdvn lkhl'lh lhn l'lhhvn
verses.translation: Nebuchadnezzar spoke and said: ‘Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, who hath sent His angel, and delivered His servants that trusted in Him, and have changed the king’s word, and have yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִנִּי֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ דִּי֩ כׇל־עַ֨ם אֻמָּ֜ה וְלִשָּׁ֗ן דִּֽי־יֵאמַ֤ר (שלה) [שָׁלוּ֙] עַ֣ל אֱלָהֲה֗וֹן דִּֽי־שַׁדְרַ֤ךְ מֵישַׁךְ֙ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֔וֹא הַדָּמִ֣ין יִתְעֲבֵ֔ד וּבַיְתֵ֖הּ נְוָלִ֣י יִשְׁתַּוֵּ֑ה כׇּל־קֳבֵ֗ל דִּ֣י לָ֤א אִיתַי֙ אֱלָ֣הּ אׇחֳרָ֔ן דִּֽי־יִכֻּ֥ל לְהַצָּלָ֖ה כִּדְנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vmny shym t'm dy khl'm 'mh vlshn dyy'mr (shlh) [shlv] 'l 'lhhvn dyshdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv' hdmyn yt'bd vbyth nvly yshtvh khlqbl dy l' 'yty 'lh 'chrn dyykhl lhtslh khdnh
verses.translation: Therefore I make a decree, that every people, nation, and language, which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill; because there is no other god that is able to deliver after this sort.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֣יִן מַלְכָּ֗א הַצְלַ֛ח לְשַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֛ךְ וַעֲבֵ֥ד נְג֖וֹ בִּמְדִינַ֥ת בָּבֶֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: b'dyn mlkh' htslch lshdrkh myshkh v'bd ngv bmdynt bbl {p}
verses.translation: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, in the province of Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֗א לְֽכׇל־עַֽמְמַיָּ֞א אֻמַּיָּ֧א וְלִשָּׁנַיָּ֛א דִּֽי־[דָיְרִ֥ין] (דארין) בְּכׇל־אַרְעָ֖א שְׁלָמְכ֥וֹן יִשְׂגֵּֽא׃
verses.translit: nbvkhdntsr mlkh' lkhl'mmy' 'my' vlshny' dy[dyryn] (d'ryn) bkhl'r'' shlmkhvn yshg'
verses.translation: ‘Nebuchadnezzar the king, unto all peoples, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; peace be multiplied unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָֽתַיָּא֙ וְתִמְהַיָּ֔א דִּ֚י עֲבַ֣ד עִמִּ֔י אֱלָהָ֖א (עליא) [עִלָּאָ֑ה] שְׁפַ֥ר קׇֽדָמַ֖י לְהַחֲוָיָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'ty' vtmhy' dy 'bd 'my 'lh' ('ly') ['l'h] shpr qdmy lhchvyh
verses.translation: It hath seemed good unto me to declare the signs and wonders that God Most High hath wrought toward me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָת֙וֹהִי֙ כְּמָ֣ה רַבְרְבִ֔ין וְתִמְה֖וֹהִי כְּמָ֣ה תַקִּיפִ֑ין מַלְכוּתֵהּ֙ מַלְכ֣וּת עָלַ֔ם וְשׇׁלְטָנֵ֖הּ עִם־דָּ֥ר וְדָֽר׃
verses.translit: 'tvhy khmh rbrbyn vtmhvhy khmh tqypyn mlkhvth mlkhvt 'lm vshltnh 'mdr vdr
verses.translation: How great are His signs! And how mighty are His wonders! His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And His dominion is from generation to generation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנָ֣ה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֗ר שְׁלֵ֤ה הֲוֵית֙ בְּבֵיתִ֔י וְרַעְנַ֖ן בְּהֵיכְלִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'nh nbvkhdntsr shlh hvyt bbyty vr'nn bhykhly
verses.translation: I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in my house, and flourishing in my palace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֵ֥לֶם חֲזֵ֖ית וִֽידַחֲלִנַּ֑נִי וְהַרְהֹרִין֙ עַֽל־מִשְׁכְּבִ֔י וְחֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשִׁ֖י יְבַהֲלֻנַּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: chlm chzyt vydchlnny vhrhryn 'lmshkhby vchzvy r'shy ybhlnny
verses.translation: I saw a dream which made me afraid; and imaginings upon my bed and the visions of my head affrighted me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִנִּי֙ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵ֔ם לְהַנְעָלָ֣ה קׇֽדָמַ֔י לְכֹ֖ל חַכִּימֵ֣י בָבֶ֑ל דִּֽי־פְשַׁ֥ר חֶלְמָ֖א יְהֽוֹדְעֻנַּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vmny shym t'm lhn'lh qdmy lkhl chkhymy bbl dypshr chlm' yhvd'nny
verses.translation: Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me, that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֣יִן (עללין) [עׇלִּ֗ין] חַרְטֻמַּיָּא֙ אָֽשְׁפַיָּ֔א (כשדיא) [כַּשְׂדָּאֵ֖י] וְגָזְרַיָּ֑א וְחֶלְמָ֗א אָמַ֤ר אֲנָה֙ קֳדָ֣מֵיה֔וֹן וּפִשְׁרֵ֖הּ לָא־מְהוֹדְעִ֥ין לִֽי׃
verses.translit: b'dyn ('llyn) ['lyn] chrtmy' 'shpy' (khshdy') [khshd'y] vgzry' vchlm' 'mr 'nh qdmyhvn vpshrh l'mhvd'yn ly
verses.translation: Then came in the magicians, the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the astrologers; and I told the dream before them; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֣ד אׇחֳרֵ֡ין עַל֩ קׇֽדָמַ֨י דָּנִיֵּ֜אל דִּֽי־שְׁמֵ֤הּ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר֙ כְּשֻׁ֣ם אֱלָהִ֔י וְדִ֛י רֽוּחַ־אֱלָהִ֥ין קַדִּישִׁ֖ין בֵּ֑הּ וְחֶלְמָ֖א קׇֽדָמ֥וֹהִי אַמְרֵֽת׃
verses.translit: v'd 'chryn 'l qdmy dny'l dyshmh bltsh'tsr khshm 'lhy vdy rvch'lhyn qdyshyn bh vchlm' qdmvhy 'mrt
verses.translation: But at the last Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and I told the dream before him:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר֮ רַ֣ב חַרְטֻמַּיָּא֒ דִּ֣י  אֲנָ֣ה יִדְעֵ֗ת דִּ֠י ר֣וּחַ אֱלָהִ֤ין קַדִּישִׁין֙ בָּ֔ךְ וְכׇל־רָ֖ז לָא־אָנֵ֣ס לָ֑ךְ חֶזְוֵ֨י חֶלְמִ֧י דִֽי־חֲזֵ֛ית וּפִשְׁרֵ֖הּ אֱמַֽר׃
verses.translit: bltsh'tsr rb chrtmy' dy  'nh yd't dy rvch 'lhyn qdyshyn bkh vkhlrz l''ns lkh chzvy chlmy dychzyt vpshrh 'mr
verses.translation: O Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in thee, and no secret causeth thee trouble, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and the interpretation thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשִׁ֖י עַֽל־מִשְׁכְּבִ֑י חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֔ית וַאֲל֥וּ אִילָ֛ן בְּג֥וֹא אַרְעָ֖א וְרוּמֵ֥הּ שַׂגִּֽיא׃
verses.translit: vchzvy r'shy 'lmshkhby chzh hvyt v'lv 'yln bgv' 'r'' vrvmh shgy'
verses.translation: Thus were the visions of my head upon my bed: I saw, And behold a tree in the midst of the earth, And the height thereof was great.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְבָ֥ה אִֽילָנָ֖א וּתְקִ֑ף וְרוּמֵהּ֙ יִמְטֵ֣א לִשְׁמַיָּ֔א וַחֲזוֹתֵ֖הּ לְס֥וֹף כׇּל־אַרְעָֽא׃
verses.translit: rbh 'yln' vtqf vrvmh ymt' lshmy' vchzvth lsvf khl'r''
verses.translation: The tree grew, and was strong, And the height thereof reached unto heaven, And the sight thereof to the end of all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עׇפְיֵ֤הּ שַׁפִּיר֙ וְאִנְבֵּ֣הּ שַׂגִּ֔יא וּמָז֨וֹן לְכֹ֖לָּא־בֵ֑הּ תְּחֹת֜וֹהִי תַּטְלֵ֣ל  חֵיוַ֣ת בָּרָ֗א וּבְעַנְפ֙וֹהִי֙ (ידרון) [יְדוּרָן֙] צִפְּרֵ֣י שְׁמַיָּ֔א וּמִנֵּ֖הּ יִתְּזִ֥ין כׇּל־בִּשְׂרָֽא׃
verses.translit: 'pyh shpyr v'nbh shgy' vmzvn lkhl'bh tchtvhy ttll  chyvt br' vb'npvhy (ydrvn) [ydvrn] tspry shmy' vmnh ytzyn khlbshr'
verses.translation: The leaves thereof were fair, and the fruit thereof much, And in it was food for all; The beasts of the field had shadow under it, And the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the branches thereof, And all flesh was fed of it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָזֵ֥ה הֲוֵ֛ית בְּחֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשִׁ֖י עַֽל־מִשְׁכְּבִ֑י וַאֲלוּ֙ עִ֣יר וְקַדִּ֔ישׁ מִן־שְׁמַיָּ֖א נָחִֽת׃
verses.translit: chzh hvyt bchzvy r'shy 'lmshkhby v'lv 'yr vqdysh mnshmy' ncht
verses.translation: I saw in the visions of my head upon my bed, and, behold, a watcher and a holy one came down from heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָרֵ֨א בְחַ֜יִל וְכֵ֣ן אָמַ֗ר גֹּ֤דּוּ אִֽילָנָא֙ וְקַצִּ֣צוּ עַנְפ֔וֹהִי אַתַּ֥רוּ עׇפְיֵ֖הּ וּבַדַּ֣רוּ אִנְבֵּ֑הּ תְּנֻ֤ד חֵֽיוְתָא֙ מִן־תַּחְתּ֔וֹהִי וְצִפְּרַיָּ֖א מִן־עַנְפֽוֹהִי׃
verses.translit: qr' bchyl vkhn 'mr gdv 'yln' vqtstsv 'npvhy 'trv 'pyh vbdrv 'nbh tnd chyvt' mntchtvhy vtspry' mn'npvhy
verses.translation: He cried aloud, and said thus: Hew down the tree, and cut off its branches, Shake off its leaves, and scatter its fruit; Let the beasts get away from under it, And the fowls from its branches.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרַ֨ם עִקַּ֤ר שׇׁרְשׁ֙וֹהִי֙ בְּאַרְעָ֣א שְׁבֻ֔קוּ וּבֶֽאֱסוּר֙ דִּֽי־פַרְזֶ֣ל וּנְחָ֔שׁ בְּדִתְאָ֖א דִּ֣י בָרָ֑א וּבְטַ֤ל שְׁמַיָּא֙ יִצְטַבַּ֔ע וְעִם־חֵיוְתָ֥א חֲלָקֵ֖הּ בַּעֲשַׂ֥ב אַרְעָֽא׃
verses.translit: brm 'qr shrshvhy b'r'' shbqv vb'svr dyprzl vnchsh bdt'' dy br' vbtl shmy' ytstb' v'mchyvt' chlqh b'shb 'r''
verses.translation: Nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth, Even in a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; And let it be wet with the dew of heaven, And let his portion be with the beasts in the grass of the earth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְבֵהּ֙ מִן־[אֲנָשָׁ֣א] (אנושא) יְשַׁנּ֔וֹן וּלְבַ֥ב חֵיוָ֖ה יִתְיְהִ֣ב לֵ֑הּ וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה עִדָּנִ֖ין יַחְלְפ֥וּן עֲלֽוֹהִי׃
verses.translit: lbbh mn['nsh'] ('nvsh') yshnvn vlbb chyvh ytyhb lh vshb'h 'dnyn ychlpvn 'lvhy
verses.translation: Let his heart be changed from man’s, And let a beast’s heart be given unto him; And let seven times pass over him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּגְזֵרַ֤ת עִירִין֙ פִּתְגָמָ֔א וּמֵאמַ֥ר קַדִּישִׁ֖ין שְׁאֵֽלְתָ֑א עַד־דִּבְרַ֡ת דִּ֣י יִנְדְּע֣וּן חַ֠יַּיָּ֠א דִּֽי־שַׁלִּ֨יט (עליא) [עִלָּאָ֜ה] בְּמַלְכ֣וּת (אנושא) [אֲנָשָׁ֗א] וּלְמַן־דִּ֤י יִצְבֵּא֙ יִתְּנִנַּ֔הּ וּשְׁפַ֥ל אֲנָשִׁ֖ים יְקִ֥ים (עליה) [עֲלַֽהּ]׃
verses.translit: bgzrt 'yryn ptgm' vm'mr qdyshyn sh'lt' 'ddbrt dy ynd'vn chyy' dyshlyt ('ly') ['l'h] bmlkhvt ('nvsh') ['nsh'] vlmndy ytsb' ytnnh vshpl 'nshym yqym ('lyh) ['lh]
verses.translation: The matter is by the decree of the watchers, And the sentence by the word of the holy ones; To the intent that the living may know That the Most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, And giveth it to whomsoever He will, And setteth up over it the lowest of men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּנָה֙ חֶלְמָ֣א חֲזֵ֔ית אֲנָ֖ה מַלְכָּ֣א נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֑ר (ואנתה) [וְאַ֨נְתְּ] בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּ֜ר פִּשְׁרֵ֣א  אֱמַ֗ר כׇּל־קֳבֵל֙ דִּ֣י  כׇּל־חַכִּימֵ֣י מַלְכוּתִ֗י לָֽא־יָכְלִ֤ין פִּשְׁרָא֙ לְהוֹדָ֣עוּתַ֔נִי (ואנתה) [וְאַ֣נְתְּ] כָּהֵ֔ל דִּ֛י רֽוּחַ־אֱלָהִ֥ין קַדִּישִׁ֖ין בָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: dnh chlm' chzyt 'nh mlkh' nbvkhdntsr (v'nth) [v'nt] bltsh'tsr pshr'  'mr khlqbl dy  khlchkhymy mlkhvty l'ykhlyn pshr' lhvd'vtny (v'nth) [v'nt] khhl dy rvch'lhyn qdyshyn bkh
verses.translation: This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen; and thou, O Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation, forasmuch as all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation; but thou art able, for the spirit of the holy gods is in thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱדַ֨יִן דָּֽנִיֵּ֜אל דִּֽי־שְׁמֵ֣הּ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּ֗ר אֶשְׁתּוֹמַם֙ כְּשָׁעָ֣ה חֲדָ֔ה וְרַעְיֹנֹ֖הִי יְבַהֲלֻנֵּ֑הּ עָנֵ֨ה מַלְכָּ֜א וְאָמַ֗ר בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר֙ חֶלְמָ֤א וּפִשְׁרֵא֙ אַֽל־יְבַהֲלָ֔ךְ עָנֵ֤ה בֵלְטְשַׁאצַּר֙ וְאָמַ֔ר מָרִ֕אי חֶלְמָ֥א (לשנאיך) [לְשָֽׂנְאָ֖ךְ] וּפִשְׁרֵ֥הּ (לעריך) [לְעָרָֽךְ]׃
verses.translit: 'dyn dny'l dyshmh bltsh'tsr 'shtvmm khsh'h chdh vr'ynhy ybhlnh 'nh mlkh' v'mr bltsh'tsr chlm' vpshr' 'lybhlkh 'nh bltsh'tsr v'mr mr'y chlm' (lshn'ykh) [lshn'kh] vpshrh (l'rykh) [l'rkh]
verses.translation: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was appalled for a while, and his thoughts affrighted him. The king spoke and said: ‘Belteshazzar, let not the dream, or the interpretation, affright thee.’ Belteshazzar answered and said: ‘My lord, the dream be to them that hate thee, and the interpretation thereof to thine adversaries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִֽילָנָא֙ דִּ֣י חֲזַ֔יְתָ דִּ֥י רְבָ֖ה וּתְקִ֑ף וְרוּמֵהּ֙ יִמְטֵ֣א לִשְׁמַיָּ֔א וַחֲזוֹתֵ֖הּ לְכׇל־אַרְעָֽא׃
verses.translit: 'yln' dy chzyt dy rbh vtqf vrvmh ymt' lshmy' vchzvth lkhl'r''
verses.translation: The tree that thou sawest, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached unto the heaven, and the sight thereof to all the earth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעׇפְיֵ֤הּ שַׁפִּיר֙ וְאִנְבֵּ֣הּ שַׂגִּ֔יא וּמָז֨וֹן לְכֹ֖לָּא־בֵ֑הּ תְּחֹת֗וֹהִי תְּדוּר֙ חֵיוַ֣ת בָּרָ֔א וּבְעַנְפ֕וֹהִי יִשְׁכְּנָ֖ן צִפְּרֵ֥י שְׁמַיָּֽא׃
verses.translit: v'pyh shpyr v'nbh shgy' vmzvn lkhl'bh tchtvhy tdvr chyvt br' vb'npvhy yshkhnn tspry shmy'
verses.translation: whose leaves were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it was food for all; under which the beasts of the field dwelt, and upon whose branches the fowls of the heaven had their habitation;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (אנתה) [אַנְתְּ־]ה֣וּא מַלְכָּ֔א דִּ֥י (רבית) [רְבַ֖ת] וּתְקֵ֑פְתְּ וּרְבוּתָ֤ךְ רְבָת֙ וּמְטָ֣ת לִשְׁמַיָּ֔א וְשׇׁלְטָנָ֖ךְ לְס֥וֹף אַרְעָֽא׃
verses.translit: ('nth) ['nt]hv' mlkh' dy (rbyt) [rbt] vtqpt vrbvtkh rbt vmtt lshmy' vshltnkh lsvf 'r''
verses.translation: it is thou, O king, that art grown and become strong; for thy greatness is grown, and reacheth unto heaven, and thy dominion to the end of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדִ֣י חֲזָ֣ה מַלְכָּ֡א עִ֣יר וְקַדִּ֣ישׁ נָחִ֣ת ׀ מִן־שְׁמַיָּ֡א וְאָמַר֩ גֹּ֨דּוּ אִֽילָנָ֜א וְחַבְּל֗וּהִי בְּרַ֨ם עִקַּ֤ר שׇׁרְשׁ֙וֹהִי֙ בְּאַרְעָ֣א שְׁבֻ֔קוּ וּבֶאֱסוּר֙ דִּֽי־פַרְזֶ֣ל וּנְחָ֔שׁ בְּדִתְאָ֖א דִּ֣י בָרָ֑א וּבְטַ֧ל שְׁמַיָּ֣א יִצְטַבַּ֗ע וְעִם־חֵיוַ֤ת בָּרָא֙ חֲלָקֵ֔הּ עַ֛ד דִּֽי־שִׁבְעָ֥ה עִדָּנִ֖ין יַחְלְפ֥וּן עֲלֽוֹהִי׃
verses.translit: vdy chzh mlkh' 'yr vqdysh ncht  mnshmy' v'mr gdv 'yln' vchblvhy brm 'qr shrshvhy b'r'' shbqv vb'svr dyprzl vnchsh bdt'' dy br' vbtl shmy' ytstb' v'mchyvt br' chlqh 'd dyshb'h 'dnyn ychlpvn 'lvhy
verses.translation: And whereas the king saw a watcher and a holy one coming down from heaven, and saying: Hew down the tree, and destroy it; nevertheless leave the stump of the roots thereof in the earth, even in a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts of the field, till seven times pass over him—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּנָ֥ה פִשְׁרָ֖א מַלְכָּ֑א וּגְזֵרַ֤ת (עליא) [עִלָּאָה֙] הִ֔יא דִּ֥י מְטָ֖ת עַל־מָרִ֥אי מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.translit: dnh pshr' mlkh' vgzrt ('ly') ['l'h] hy' dy mtt 'lmr'y mlkh'
verses.translation: this is the interpretation, O king, and it is the decree of the Most High, which is come upon my lord the king,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָ֣ךְ טָֽרְדִ֣ין מִן־אֲנָשָׁ֡א וְעִם־חֵיוַ֣ת בָּרָא֩ לֶהֱוֵ֨ה מְדֹרָ֜ךְ וְעִשְׂבָּ֥א כְתוֹרִ֣ין  לָ֣ךְ יְטַֽעֲמ֗וּן וּמִטַּ֤ל שְׁמַיָּא֙ לָ֣ךְ מְצַבְּעִ֔ין וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה עִדָּנִ֖ין יַחְלְפ֣וּן (עליך) [עֲלָ֑ךְ] עַ֣ד דִּֽי־תִנְדַּ֗ע דִּֽי־שַׁלִּ֤יט (עליא) [עִלָּאָה֙] בְּמַלְכ֣וּת אֲנָשָׁ֔א וּלְמַן־דִּ֥י יִצְבֵּ֖א יִתְּנִנַּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vlkh trdyn mn'nsh' v'mchyvt br' lhvh mdrkh v'shb' khtvryn  lkh yt'mvn vmtl shmy' lkh mtsb'yn vshb'h 'dnyn ychlpvn ('lykh) ['lkh] 'd dytnd' dyshlyt ('ly') ['l'h] bmlkhvt 'nsh' vlmndy ytsb' ytnnh
verses.translation: that thou shalt be driven from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field, and thou shalt be made to eat grass as oxen, and shalt be wet with the dew of heaven, and seven times shall pass over thee; till thou know that the Most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever He will.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדִ֣י אֲמַ֗רוּ לְמִשְׁבַּ֞ק עִקַּ֤ר שׇׁרְשׁ֙וֹהִי֙ דִּ֣י אִֽילָנָ֔א מַלְכוּתָ֖ךְ לָ֣ךְ קַיָּמָ֑א מִן־דִּ֣י תִנְדַּ֔ע דִּ֥י שַׁלִּטִ֖ן שְׁמַיָּֽא׃
verses.translit: vdy 'mrv lmshbq 'qr shrshvhy dy 'yln' mlkhvtkh lkh qym' mndy tnd' dy shltn shmy'
verses.translation: And whereas it was commanded to leave the stump of the roots of the tree, thy kingdom shall be sure unto thee, after that thou shalt have known that the heavens do rule.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָהֵ֣ן מַלְכָּ֗א מִלְכִּי֙ יִשְׁפַּ֣ר (עליך) [עֲלָ֔ךְ] (וחטיך) [וַחֲטָאָךְ֙] בְּצִדְקָ֣ה פְרֻ֔ק וַעֲוָיָתָ֖ךְ בְּמִחַ֣ן עֲנָ֑יִן הֵ֛ן תֶּהֱוֵ֥ה אַרְכָ֖ה לִשְׁלֵוְתָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: lhn mlkh' mlkhy yshpr ('lykh) ['lkh] (vchtykh) [vcht'kh] btsdqh prq v'vytkh bmchn 'nyn hn thvh 'rkhh lshlvtkh
verses.translation: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee, and break off thy sins by almsgiving, and thine iniquities by showing mercy to the poor; if there may be a lengthening of thy prosperity.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣לָּא מְּטָ֔א עַל־נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֖ר מַלְכָּֽא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khl' mt' 'lnbvkhdntsr mlkh' {p}
verses.translation: All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִקְצָ֥ת יַרְחִ֖ין תְּרֵֽי־עֲשַׂ֑ר עַל־הֵיכַ֧ל מַלְכוּתָ֛א דִּ֥י בָבֶ֖ל מְהַלֵּ֥ךְ הֲוָֽה׃
verses.translit: lqtst yrchyn try'shr 'lhykhl mlkhvt' dy bbl mhlkh hvh
verses.translation: At the end of twelve months he was walking upon the royal palace of Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָנֵ֤ה מַלְכָּא֙ וְאָמַ֔ר הֲלָ֥א דָא־הִ֖יא בָּבֶ֣ל רַבְּתָ֑א דִּֽי־אֲנָ֤ה בֱנַיְתַהּ֙ לְבֵ֣ית מַלְכ֔וּ בִּתְקָ֥ף חִסְנִ֖י וְלִיקָ֥ר הַדְרִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'nh mlkh' v'mr hl' d'hy' bbl rbt' dy'nh bnyth lbyt mlkhv btqf chsny vlyqr hdry
verses.translation: The king spoke, and said: ‘Is not this great Babylon, which I have built for a royal dwelling-place, by the might of my power and for the glory of my majesty?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ע֗וֹד מִלְּתָא֙ בְּפֻ֣ם מַלְכָּ֔א קָ֖ל מִן־שְׁמַיָּ֣א נְפַ֑ל לָ֤ךְ אָֽמְרִין֙ נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֔א מַלְכוּתָ֖א עֲדָ֥ת מִנָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'vd mlt' bpm mlkh' ql mnshmy' npl lkh 'mryn nbvkhdntsr mlkh' mlkhvt' 'dt mnkh
verses.translation: While the word was in the king’s mouth, there fell a voice from heaven: ‘O king Nebuchadnezzar, to thee it is spoken: the kingdom is departed from thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־אֲנָשָׁא֩ לָ֨ךְ טָֽרְדִ֜ין וְֽעִם־חֵיוַ֧ת בָּרָ֣א מְדֹרָ֗ךְ עִשְׂבָּ֤א כְתוֹרִין֙ לָ֣ךְ יְטַעֲמ֔וּן וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה עִדָּנִ֖ין יַחְלְפ֣וּן (עליך) [עֲלָ֑ךְ] עַ֣ד דִּֽי־תִנְדַּ֗ע דִּֽי־שַׁלִּ֤יט (עליא) [עִלָּאָה֙] בְּמַלְכ֣וּת אֲנָשָׁ֔א וּלְמַן־דִּ֥י יִצְבֵּ֖א יִתְּנִנַּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vmn'nsh' lkh trdyn v'mchyvt br' mdrkh 'shb' khtvryn lkh yt'mvn vshb'h 'dnyn ychlpvn ('lykh) ['lkh] 'd dytnd' dyshlyt ('ly') ['l'h] bmlkhvt 'nsh' vlmndy ytsb' ytnnh
verses.translation: And thou shalt be driven from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field; thou shalt be made to eat grass as oxen, and seven times shall pass over thee; until thou know that the Most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever He will.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּהּ־שַׁעֲתָ֗א מִלְּתָא֮ סָ֣פַת עַל־נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר֒ וּמִן־אֲנָשָׁ֣א טְרִ֔יד וְעִשְׂבָּ֤א כְתוֹרִין֙ יֵאכֻ֔ל וּמִטַּ֥ל שְׁמַיָּ֖א גִּשְׁמֵ֣הּ יִצְטַבַּ֑ע עַ֣ד דִּ֥י שַׂעְרֵ֛הּ כְּנִשְׁרִ֥ין רְבָ֖ה וְטִפְר֥וֹהִי כְצִפְּרִֽין׃
verses.translit: bhsh't' mlt' spt 'lnbvkhdntsr vmn'nsh' tryd v'shb' khtvryn y'khl vmtl shmy' gshmh ytstb' 'd dy sh'rh khnshryn rbh vtprvhy khtspryn
verses.translation: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar; and he was driven from men, and did eat grass as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven, till his hair was grown like eagles’feathers, and his nails like birds’claws.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִקְצָ֣ת יֽוֹמַיָּא֩ אֲנָ֨ה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֜ר עַיְנַ֣י  לִשְׁמַיָּ֣א נִטְלֵ֗ת וּמַנְדְּעִי֙ עֲלַ֣י יְת֔וּב (ולעליא) [וּלְעִלָּאָה֙] בָּרְכֵ֔ת וּלְחַ֥י עָלְמָ֖א שַׁבְּחֵ֣ת וְהַדְּרֵ֑ת דִּ֤י שׇׁלְטָנֵהּ֙ שׇׁלְטָ֣ן עָלַ֔ם וּמַלְכוּתֵ֖הּ עִם־דָּ֥ר וְדָֽר׃
verses.translit: vlqtst yvmy' 'nh nbvkhdntsr 'yny  lshmy' ntlt vmnd'y 'ly ytvb (vl'ly') [vl'l'h] brkht vlchy 'lm' shbcht vhdrt dy shltnh shltn 'lm vmlkhvth 'mdr vdr
verses.translation: ‘And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine eyes unto heaven, and mine understanding returned unto me, and I blessed the Most High, and I praised and honoured Him that liveth for ever; For His dominion is an everlasting dominion, And His kingdom from generation to generation;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־[דָּיְרֵ֤י] (דארי) אַרְעָא֙ כְּלָ֣ה חֲשִׁיבִ֔ין וּֽכְמִצְבְּיֵ֗הּ עָבֵד֙ בְּחֵ֣יל שְׁמַיָּ֔א (ודארי) [וְדָיְרֵ֖י] אַרְעָ֑א וְלָ֤א אִיתַי֙ דִּֽי־יְמַחֵ֣א בִידֵ֔הּ וְיֵ֥אמַר לֵ֖הּ מָ֥ה עֲבַֽדְתְּ׃
verses.translit: vkhl[dyry] (d'ry) 'r'' khlh chshybyn vkhmtsbyh 'bd bchyl shmy' (vd'ry) [vdyry] 'r'' vl' 'yty dyymch' bydh vy'mr lh mh 'bdt
verses.translation: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; And He doeth according to His will in the host of heaven, And among the inhabitants of the earth; And none can stay His hand, Or say unto Him: What doest Thou?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּהּ־זִמְנָ֞א מַנְדְּעִ֣י  יְת֣וּב עֲלַ֗י וְלִיקַ֨ר מַלְכוּתִ֜י הַדְרִ֤י וְזִיוִי֙ יְת֣וּב עֲלַ֔י וְלִ֕י הַדָּֽבְרַ֥י וְרַבְרְבָנַ֖י יְבַע֑וֹן וְעַל־מַלְכוּתִ֣י הׇתְקְנַ֔ת וּרְב֥וּ יַתִּירָ֖ה ה֥וּסְפַת לִֽי׃
verses.translit: bhzmn' mnd'y  ytvb 'ly vlyqr mlkhvty hdry vzyvy ytvb 'ly vly hdbry vrbrbny yb'vn v'lmlkhvty htqnt vrbv ytyrh hvspt ly
verses.translation: At the same time mine understanding returned unto me; and for the glory of my kingdom, my majesty and my splendour returned unto me; and my ministers and my lords sought unto me; and I was established in my kingdom, and surpassing greatness was added unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּעַ֞ן אֲנָ֣ה נְבֻכַדְנֶצַּ֗ר מְשַׁבַּ֨ח וּמְרוֹמֵ֤ם וּמְהַדַּר֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ שְׁמַיָּ֔א דִּ֤י כׇל־מַעֲבָד֙וֹהִי֙ קְשֹׁ֔ט וְאֹרְחָתֵ֖הּ דִּ֑ין וְדִי֙ מַהְלְכִ֣ין בְּגֵוָ֔ה יָכִ֖ל לְהַשְׁפָּלָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: kh'n 'nh nbkhdntsr mshbch vmrvmm vmhdr lmlkh shmy' dy khlm'bdvhy qsht v'rchth dyn vdy mhlkhyn bgvh ykhl lhshplh {p}
verses.translation: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven; for all His works are truth, and His ways justice; and those that walk in pride He is able to abase.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּלְשַׁאצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֗א עֲבַד֙ לְחֶ֣ם רַ֔ב לְרַבְרְבָנ֖וֹהִי אֲלַ֑ף וְלׇקֳבֵ֥ל אַלְפָּ֖א חַמְרָ֥א שָׁתֵֽה׃
verses.translit: blsh'tsr mlkh' 'bd lchm rb lrbrbnvhy 'lf vlqbl 'lp' chmr' shth
verses.translation: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּלְשַׁאצַּ֞ר אֲמַ֣ר  בִּטְעֵ֣ם חַמְרָ֗א לְהַיְתָיָה֙ לְמָאנֵי֙ דַּהֲבָ֣א וְכַסְפָּ֔א דִּ֤י הַנְפֵּק֙ נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר אֲב֔וּהִי מִן־הֵיכְלָ֖א דִּ֣י בִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וְיִשְׁתּ֣וֹן בְּה֗וֹן מַלְכָּא֙ וְרַבְרְבָנ֔וֹהִי שֵׁגְלָתֵ֖הּ וּלְחֵנָתֵֽהּ׃
verses.translit: blsh'tsr 'mr  bt'm chmr' lhytyh lm'ny dhb' vkhsp' dy hnpq nbvkhdntsr 'bvhy mnhykhl' dy byrvshlm vyshtvn bhvn mlkh' vrbrbnvhy shglth vlchnth
verses.translation: Belshazzar, while he tasted the wine, commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which Nebuchadnezzar his father had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem; that the king and his lords, his consorts and his concubines, might drink therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֗יִן הַיְתִיו֙ מָאנֵ֣י דַהֲבָ֔א דִּ֣י הַנְפִּ֗קוּ מִן־הֵ֥יכְלָ֛א דִּֽי־בֵ֥ית אֱלָהָ֖א דִּ֣י בִירֽוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וְאִשְׁתִּ֣יו בְּה֗וֹן מַלְכָּא֙ וְרַבְרְבָנ֔וֹהִי שֵׁגְלָתֵ֖הּ וּלְחֵנָתֵֽהּ׃
verses.translit: b'dyn hytyv m'ny dhb' dy hnpqv mnhykhl' dybyt 'lh' dy byrvshlm v'shtyv bhvn mlkh' vrbrbnvhy shglth vlchnth
verses.translation: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of God which was at Jerusalem; and the king, and his lords, his consorts and his concubines, drank in them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִשְׁתִּ֖יו חַמְרָ֑א וְ֠שַׁבַּ֠חוּ לֵֽאלָהֵ֞י דַּהֲבָ֧א וְכַסְפָּ֛א נְחָשָׁ֥א פַרְזְלָ֖א אָעָ֥א וְאַבְנָֽא׃
verses.translit: 'shtyv chmr' vshbchv l'lhy dhb' vkhsp' nchsh' przl' ''' v'bn'
verses.translation: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of brass, of iron, of wood, and of stone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּהּ־שַׁעֲתָ֗ה (נפקו) [נְפַ֙קָה֙] אֶצְבְּעָן֙ דִּ֣י יַד־אֱנָ֔שׁ וְכָֽתְבָן֙ לׇקֳבֵ֣ל נֶבְרַשְׁתָּ֔א עַל־גִּירָ֕א דִּֽי־כְתַ֥ל הֵיכְלָ֖א דִּ֣י מַלְכָּ֑א וּמַלְכָּ֣א חָזֵ֔ה פַּ֥ס יְדָ֖א דִּ֥י כָתְבָֽה׃
verses.translit: bhsh'th (npqv) [npqh] 'tsb'n dy yd'nsh vkhtbn lqbl nbrsht' 'lgyr' dykhtl hykhl' dy mlkh' vmlkh' chzh ps yd' dy khtbh
verses.translation: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man’s hand, and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaster of the wall of the king’s palace; and the king saw the palm of the hand that wrote.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱדַ֤יִן מַלְכָּא֙ זִיוֺ֣הִי שְׁנ֔וֹהִי וְרַעְיֹנֹ֖הִי יְבַהֲלוּנֵּ֑הּ וְקִטְרֵ֤י חַרְצֵהּ֙ מִשְׁתָּרַ֔יִן וְאַ֨רְכֻבָּתֵ֔הּ דָּ֥א לְדָ֖א נָֽקְשָֽׁן׃
verses.translit: 'dyn mlkh' zyvhy shnvhy vr'ynhy ybhlvnh vqtry chrtsh mshtryn v'rkhbth d' ld' nqshn
verses.translation: Then the king’s countenance was changed in him, and his thoughts affrighted him; and the joints of his loins were loosed, and his knees smote one against another.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָרֵ֤א מַלְכָּא֙ בְּחַ֔יִל לְהֶֽעָלָה֙ לְאָ֣שְׁפַיָּ֔א (כשדיא) [כַּשְׂדָּאֵ֖י] וְגָזְרַיָּ֑א עָנֵ֨ה מַלְכָּ֜א וְאָמַ֣ר  לְחַכִּימֵ֣י בָבֶ֗ל דִּ֣י כׇל־אֱ֠נָ֠שׁ דִּֽי־יִקְרֵ֞ה כְּתָבָ֣ה דְנָ֗ה וּפִשְׁרֵהּ֙ יְחַוִּנַּ֔נִי אַרְגְּוָנָ֣א יִלְבַּ֗שׁ (והמנוכא) [וְהַֽמְנִיכָ֤א] דִֽי־דַהֲבָא֙ עַֽל־צַוְּארֵ֔הּ וְתַלְתִּ֥י בְמַלְכוּתָ֖א יִשְׁלַֽט׃ {ס}
verses.translit: qr' mlkh' bchyl lh'lh l'shpy' (khshdy') [khshd'y] vgzry' 'nh mlkh' v'mr  lchkhymy bbl dy khl'nsh dyyqrh khtbh dnh vpshrh ychvnny 'rgvn' ylbsh (vhmnvkh') [vhmnykh'] dydhb' 'ltsv'rh vtlty bmlkhvt' yshlt {s}
verses.translation: The king cried aloud to bring in the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the astrologers. The king spoke and said to the wise men of Babylon: ‘Whosoever shall read this writing, and declare unto me the interpretation thereof, shall be clothed with purple, and have a chain of gold about his neck, and shall rule as one of three in the kingdom.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱדַ֙יִן֙ (עללין) [עָֽלִּ֔ין] כֹּ֖ל חַכִּימֵ֣י מַלְכָּ֑א וְלָֽא־כָהֲלִ֤ין כְּתָבָא֙ לְמִקְרֵ֔א (ופשרא) [וּפִשְׁרֵ֖הּ] לְהוֹדָעָ֥ה לְמַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.translit: 'dyn ('llyn) ['lyn] khl chkhymy mlkh' vl'khhlyn khtb' lmqr' (vpshr') [vpshrh] lhvd'h lmlkh'
verses.translation: Then came in all the king’s wise men: but they could not read the writing, nor make known to the king the interpretation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֠דַ֠יִן מַלְכָּ֤א בֵלְשַׁאצַּר֙ שַׂגִּ֣יא מִתְבָּהַ֔ל וְזִיוֺ֖הִי שָׁנַ֣יִן עֲל֑וֹהִי וְרַבְרְבָנ֖וֹהִי מִֽשְׁתַּבְּשִֽׁין׃
verses.translit: 'dyn mlkh' blsh'tsr shgy' mtbhl vzyvhy shnyn 'lvhy vrbrbnvhy mshtbshyn
verses.translation: Then was king Belshazzar greatly affrighted, and his countenance was changed in him, and his lords were perplexed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַלְכְּתָ֕א לׇקֳבֵ֨ל מִלֵּ֤י מַלְכָּא֙ וְרַבְרְבָנ֔וֹהִי לְבֵ֥ית מִשְׁתְּיָ֖א (עללת) [עַלַּ֑ת] עֲנָ֨ת מַלְכְּתָ֜א וַאֲמֶ֗רֶת מַלְכָּא֙ לְעָלְמִ֣ין חֱיִ֔י אַֽל־יְבַהֲלוּךְ֙ רַעְיוֹנָ֔ךְ (וזיויך) [וְזִיוָ֖ךְ] אַל־יִשְׁתַּנּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mlkht' lqbl mly mlkh' vrbrbnvhy lbyt mshty' ('llt) ['lt] 'nt mlkht' v'mrt mlkh' l'lmyn chyy 'lybhlvkh r'yvnkh (vzyvykh) [vzyvkh] 'lyshtnv
verses.translation: Now the queen by reason of the words of the king and his lords came into the banquet house; the queen spoke and said: ‘O king, live for ever! let not thy thoughts affright thee, nor let thy countenance be changed;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִיתַ֨י גְּבַ֜ר בְּמַלְכוּתָ֗ךְ דִּ֠י ר֣וּחַ אֱלָהִ֣ין קַדִּישִׁין֮ בֵּהּ֒ וּבְיוֹמֵ֣י אֲב֗וּךְ נַהִיר֧וּ וְשׇׂכְלְתָנ֛וּ וְחׇכְמָ֥ה כְּחׇכְמַת־אֱלָהִ֖ין הִשְׁתְּכַ֣חַת בֵּ֑הּ וּמַלְכָּ֤א נְבֻֽכַדְנֶצַּר֙ אֲב֔וּךְ רַ֧ב חַרְטֻמִּ֣ין אָֽשְׁפִ֗ין כַּשְׂדָּאִין֙ גָּזְרִ֔ין הֲקִימֵ֖הּ אֲב֥וּךְ מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.translit: 'yty gbr bmlkhvtkh dy rvch 'lhyn qdyshyn bh vbyvmy 'bvkh nhyrv vshkhltnv vchkhmh khchkhmt'lhyn hshtkhcht bh vmlkh' nbkhdntsr 'bvkh rb chrtmyn 'shpyn khshd'yn gzryn hqymh 'bvkh mlkh'
verses.translation: there is a man in thy kingdom, in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of thy father light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, was found in him; and the king Nebuchadnezzar thy father, the king, I say, thy father, made him master of the magicians, enchanters, Chaldeans, and astrologers;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־קֳבֵ֡ל דִּ֣י ר֣וּחַ ׀ יַתִּירָ֡ה וּמַנְדַּ֡ע וְשׇׂכְלְתָנ֡וּ מְפַשַּׁ֣ר חֶלְמִין֩ וְֽאַֽחֲוָיַ֨ת אֲחִידָ֜ן וּמְשָׁרֵ֣א קִטְרִ֗ין הִשְׁתְּכַ֤חַת בֵּהּ֙ בְּדָ֣נִיֵּ֔אל דִּֽי־מַלְכָּ֥א שָׂם־שְׁמֵ֖הּ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּ֑ר כְּעַ֛ן דָּנִיֵּ֥אל יִתְקְרֵ֖י וּפִשְׁרָ֥ה יְהַֽחֲוֵֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khlqbl dy rvch  ytyrh vmnd' vshkhltnv mpshr chlmyn v'chvyt 'chydn vmshr' qtryn hshtkhcht bh bdny'l dymlkh' shmshmh bltsh'tsr kh'n dny'l ytqry vpshrh yhchvh {p}
verses.translation: forasmuch as a surpassing spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, interpreting of dreams, and declaring of riddles, and loosing of knots, were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar. Now let Daniel be called, and he will declare the interpretation.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֙יִן֙ דָּֽנִיֵּ֔אל הֻעַ֖ל קֳדָ֣ם מַלְכָּ֑א עָנֵ֨ה מַלְכָּ֜א וְאָמַ֣ר לְדָנִיֵּ֗אל (אנתה) [אַנְתְּ־]ה֤וּא דָנִיֵּאל֙ דִּֽי־מִן־בְּנֵ֤י גָלוּתָא֙ דִּ֣י יְה֔וּד דִּ֥י הַיְתִ֛י מַלְכָּ֥א אַ֖בִי מִן־יְהֽוּד׃
verses.translit: b'dyn dny'l h'l qdm mlkh' 'nh mlkh' v'mr ldny'l ('nth) ['nt]hv' dny'l dymnbny glvt' dy yhvd dy hyty mlkh' 'by mnyhvd
verses.translation: Then was Daniel brought in before the king. The king spoke and said unto Daniel: ‘Art thou Daniel, who is of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Judah?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁמְעֵ֣ת (עליך) [עֲלָ֔ךְ] דִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ אֱלָהִ֖ין בָּ֑ךְ וְנַהִיר֧וּ וְשׇׂכְלְתָנ֛וּ וְחׇכְמָ֥ה יַתִּירָ֖ה הִשְׁתְּכַ֥חַת בָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vshm't ('lykh) ['lkh] dy rvch 'lhyn bkh vnhyrv vshkhltnv vchkhmh ytyrh hshtkhcht bkh
verses.translation: I have heard of thee, that the spirit of the gods is in thee, and that light and understanding and surpassing wisdom is found in thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְעַ֞ן הֻעַ֣לּוּ קׇֽדָמַ֗י חַכִּֽימַיָּא֙ אָֽשְׁפַיָּ֔א דִּֽי־כְתָבָ֤ה דְנָה֙ יִקְר֔וֹן וּפִשְׁרֵ֖הּ לְהוֹדָעֻתַ֑נִי וְלָֽא־כָהֲלִ֥ין פְּשַֽׁר־מִלְּתָ֖א לְהַחֲוָיָֽה׃
verses.translit: vkh'n h'lv qdmy chkhymy' 'shpy' dykhtbh dnh yqrvn vpshrh lhvd'tny vl'khhlyn pshrmlt' lhchvyh
verses.translation: And now the wise men, the enchanters, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known unto me the interpretation thereof; but they could not declare the interpretation of the thing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנָה֙ שִׁמְעֵ֣ת (עליך) [עֲלָ֔ךְ] דִּֽי־[תִכּ֥וּל] (תוכל) פִּשְׁרִ֛ין לְמִפְשַׁ֖ר וְקִטְרִ֣ין לְמִשְׁרֵ֑א כְּעַ֡ן הֵן֩ (תוכל) [תִּכּ֨וּל] כְּתָבָ֜א לְמִקְרֵ֗א וּפִשְׁרֵהּ֙ לְהוֹדָ֣עוּתַ֔נִי אַרְגְּוָנָ֣א תִלְבַּ֗שׁ (והמונכא) [וְהַֽמְנִיכָ֤א] דִֽי־דַהֲבָא֙ עַֽל־צַוְּארָ֔ךְ וְתַלְתָּ֥א בְמַלְכוּתָ֖א תִּשְׁלַֽט׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'nh shm't ('lykh) ['lkh] dy[tkhvl] (tvkhl) pshryn lmpshr vqtryn lmshr' kh'n hn (tvkhl) [tkhvl] khtb' lmqr' vpshrh lhvd'vtny 'rgvn' tlbsh (vhmvnkh') [vhmnykh'] dydhb' 'ltsv'rkh vtlt' bmlkhvt' tshlt {p}
verses.translation: But I have heard of thee, that thou canst give interpretations, and loose knots; now if thou canst read the writing, and make known to me the interpretation thereof, thou shalt be clothed with purple, and have a chain of gold about thy neck, and shalt rule as one of three in the kingdom.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֜יִן עָנֵ֣ה דָנִיֵּ֗אל וְאָמַר֙ קֳדָ֣ם מַלְכָּ֔א מַתְּנָתָךְ֙ לָ֣ךְ לֶֽהֶוְיָ֔ן וּנְבָ֥זְבְּיָתָ֖ךְ לְאׇחֳרָ֣ן הַ֑ב בְּרַ֗ם כְּתָבָא֙ אֶקְרֵ֣א לְמַלְכָּ֔א וּפִשְׁרָ֖א אֲהוֹדְעִנֵּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: b'dyn 'nh dny'l v'mr qdm mlkh' mtntkh lkh lhvyn vnbzbytkh l'chrn hb brm khtb' 'qr' lmlkh' vpshr' 'hvd'nh
verses.translation: Then Daniel answered and said before the king: ‘Let thy gifts be to thyself, and give thy rewards to another; nevertheless I will read the writing unto the king, and make known to him the interpretation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (אנתה) [אַ֖נְתְּ] מַלְכָּ֑א אֱלָהָא֙ (עליא) [עִלָּאָ֔ה] מַלְכוּתָ֤א וּרְבוּתָא֙ וִיקָרָ֣א וְהַדְרָ֔א יְהַ֖ב לִנְבֻכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר אֲבֽוּךְ׃
verses.translit: ('nth) ['nt] mlkh' 'lh' ('ly') ['l'h] mlkhvt' vrbvt' vyqr' vhdr' yhb lnbkhdntsr 'bvkh
verses.translation: O thou king, God Most High gave Nebuchadnezzar thy father the kingdom, and greatness, and glory, and majesty;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־רְבוּתָא֙ דִּ֣י יְהַב־לֵ֔הּ כֹּ֣ל עַֽמְמַיָּ֗א אֻמַּיָּא֙ וְלִשָּׁ֣נַיָּ֔א הֲו֛וֹ (זאעין) [זָיְעִ֥ין] וְדָחֲלִ֖ין מִן־קֳדָמ֑וֹהִי דִּֽי־הֲוָ֨א צָבֵ֜א הֲוָ֣ה קָטֵ֗ל וְדִֽי־הֲוָ֤ה צָבֵא֙ הֲוָ֣ה מַחֵ֔א וְדִֽי־הֲוָ֤ה צָבֵא֙ הֲוָ֣ה מָרִ֔ים וְדִֽי־הֲוָ֥א צָבֵ֖א הֲוָ֥א מַשְׁפִּֽל׃
verses.translit: vmnrbvt' dy yhblh khl 'mmy' 'my' vlshny' hvv (z''yn) [zy'yn] vdchlyn mnqdmvhy dyhv' tsb' hvh qtl vdyhvh tsb' hvh mch' vdyhvh tsb' hvh mrym vdyhv' tsb' hv' mshpl
verses.translation: and because of the greatness that He gave him, all the peoples, nations, and languages trembled and feared before him: whom he would he slew, and whom he would he kept alive; and whom he would he raised up, and whom he would he put down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְדִי֙ רִ֣ם לִבְבֵ֔הּ וְרוּחֵ֖הּ תִּֽקְפַ֣ת לַהֲזָדָ֑ה הׇנְחַת֙ מִן־כׇּרְסֵ֣א מַלְכוּתֵ֔הּ וִֽיקָרָ֖ה הֶעְדִּ֥יו מִנֵּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vkhdy rm lbbh vrvchh tqpt lhzdh hncht mnkhrs' mlkhvth vyqrh h'dyv mnh
verses.translation: But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was hardened that he dealt proudly, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and his glory was taken from him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־בְּנֵי֩ אֲנָשָׁ֨א טְרִ֜יד וְלִבְבֵ֣הּ  עִם־חֵיוְתָ֣א (שוי) [שַׁוִּ֗יו] וְעִם־עֲרָֽדַיָּא֙ מְדֹרֵ֔הּ עִשְׂבָּ֤א כְתוֹרִין֙ יְטַ֣עֲמוּנֵּ֔הּ וּמִטַּ֥ל שְׁמַיָּ֖א גִּשְׁמֵ֣הּ יִצְטַבַּ֑ע עַ֣ד דִּֽי־יְדַ֗ע דִּֽי־שַׁלִּ֞יט אֱלָהָ֤א (עליא) [עִלָּאָה֙] בְּמַלְכ֣וּת אֲנָשָׁ֔א וּלְמַן־דִּ֥י יִצְבֵּ֖א יְהָקֵ֥ים (עליה) [עֲלַֽהּ]׃
verses.translit: vmnbny 'nsh' tryd vlbbh  'mchyvt' (shvy) [shvyv] v'm'rdy' mdrh 'shb' khtvryn yt'mvnh vmtl shmy' gshmh ytstb' 'd dyyd' dyshlyt 'lh' ('ly') ['l'h] bmlkhvt 'nsh' vlmndy ytsb' yhqym ('lyh) ['lh]
verses.translation: and he was driven from the sons of men, and his heart was made like the beasts, and his dwelling was with the wild asses; he was fed with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven; until he knew that God Most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and that He setteth up over it whomsoever He will.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ואנתה) [וְאַ֤נְתְּ] בְּרֵהּ֙ בֵּלְשַׁאצַּ֔ר לָ֥א הַשְׁפֵּ֖לְתְּ לִבְבָ֑ךְ כׇּל־קֳבֵ֕ל דִּ֥י כׇל־דְּנָ֖ה יְדַֽעְתָּ׃
verses.translit: (v'nth) [v'nt] brh blsh'tsr l' hshplt lbbkh khlqbl dy khldnh yd't
verses.translation: And thou his son, O Belshazzar, hast not humbled thy heart, though thou knewest all this;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֣ל מָרֵֽא־שְׁמַיָּ֣א ׀ הִתְרוֹמַ֡מְתָּ וּלְמָֽאנַיָּ֨א דִֽי־בַיְתֵ֜הּ הַיְתִ֣יו (קדמיך) [קׇֽדָמָ֗ךְ] (ואנתה) [וְאַ֨נְתְּ] (ורברבניך) [וְרַבְרְבָנָ֜ךְ] שֵֽׁגְלָתָ֣ךְ וּלְחֵנָתָךְ֮ חַמְרָא֮ שָׁתַ֣יִן בְּהוֹן֒ וְלֵֽאלָהֵ֣י כַסְפָּֽא־וְ֠דַהֲבָ֠א נְחָשָׁ֨א פַרְזְלָ֜א אָעָ֣א וְאַבְנָ֗א דִּ֠י לָֽא־חָזַ֧יִן וְלָא־שָׁמְעִ֛ין וְלָ֥א יָדְעִ֖ין שַׁבַּ֑חְתָּ וְלֵֽאלָהָ֞א דִּֽי־נִשְׁמְתָ֥ךְ בִּידֵ֛הּ וְכׇל־אֹרְחָתָ֥ךְ לֵ֖הּ לָ֥א הַדַּֽרְתָּ׃
verses.translit: v'l mr'shmy'  htrvmmt vlm'ny' dybyth hytyv (qdmykh) [qdmkh] (v'nth) [v'nt] (vrbrbnykh) [vrbrbnkh] shgltkh vlchntkh chmr' shtyn bhvn vl'lhy khsp'vdhb' nchsh' przl' ''' v'bn' dy l'chzyn vl'shm'yn vl' yd'yn shbcht vl'lh' dynshmtkh bydh vkhl'rchtkh lh l' hdrt
verses.translation: but hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of His house before thee, and thou and thy lords, thy consorts and thy concubines, have drunk wine in them; and thou hast praised the gods of silver, and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which see not, nor hear, nor know; and the God in whose hand thy breath is, and whose are all thy ways, hast thou not glorified;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֙יִן֙ מִן־קֳדָמ֔וֹהִי שְׁלִ֖יחַ פַּסָּ֣א דִֽי־יְדָ֑א וּכְתָבָ֥א דְנָ֖ה רְשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: b'dyn mnqdmvhy shlych ps' dyyd' vkhtb' dnh rshym
verses.translation: then was the palm of the hand sent from before Him, and this writing was inscribed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּדְנָ֥ה כְתָבָ֖א דִּ֣י רְשִׁ֑ים מְנֵ֥א מְנֵ֖א תְּקֵ֥ל וּפַרְסִֽין׃
verses.translit: vdnh khtb' dy rshym mn' mn' tql vprsyn
verses.translation: And this is the writing that was inscribed: MENE MENE, TEKEL UPHARSIN.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּנָ֖ה פְּשַֽׁר־מִלְּתָ֑א מְנֵ֕א מְנָֽה־אֱלָהָ֥א מַלְכוּתָ֖ךְ וְהַשְׁלְמַֽהּ׃
verses.translit: dnh pshrmlt' mn' mnh'lh' mlkhvtkh vhshlmh
verses.translation: This is the interpretation of the thing: MENE, God hath numbered thy kingdom, and brought it to an end.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּקֵ֑ל תְּקִ֥ילְתָּ בְמֹֽאזַנְיָ֖א וְהִשְׁתְּכַ֥חַתְּ חַסִּֽיר׃
verses.translit: tql tqylt bm'zny' vhshtkhcht chsyr
verses.translation: TEKEL, Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּרֵ֑ס פְּרִיסַת֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔ךְ וִיהִיבַ֖ת לְמָדַ֥י וּפָרָֽס׃
verses.translit: prs pryst mlkhvtkh vyhybt lmdy vprs
verses.translation: PERES, thy kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֣יִן  אֲמַ֣ר בֵּלְשַׁאצַּ֗ר וְהַלְבִּ֤שׁוּ לְדָֽנִיֵּאל֙ אַרְגְּוָנָ֔א (והמנוכא) [וְהַֽמְנִיכָ֥א] דִֽי־דַהֲבָ֖א עַֽל־צַוְּארֵ֑הּ וְהַכְרִ֣זֽוּ עֲל֔וֹהִי דִּֽי־לֶהֱוֵ֥א שַׁלִּ֛יט תַּלְתָּ֖א בְּמַלְכוּתָֽא׃
verses.translit: b'dyn  'mr blsh'tsr vhlbshv ldny'l 'rgvn' (vhmnvkh') [vhmnykh'] dydhb' 'ltsv'rh vhkhrzv 'lvhy dylhv' shlyt tlt' bmlkhvt'
verses.translation: Then commanded Belshazzar, and they clothed Daniel with purple, and put a chain of gold about his neck, and made proclamation concerning him, that he should rule as one of three in the kingdom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֚הּ בְּלֵ֣ילְיָ֔א קְטִ֕יל בֵּלְאשַׁצַּ֖ר מַלְכָּ֥א (כשדיא) [כַשְׂדָּאָֽה]׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bh blyly' qtyl bl'shtsr mlkh' (khshdy') [khshd'h] {p}
verses.translation: In that night Belshazzar the Chaldean king was slain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדָרְיָ֙וֶשׁ֙ (מדיא) [מָֽדָאָ֔ה] קַבֵּ֖ל מַלְכוּתָ֑א כְּבַ֥ר שְׁנִ֖ין שִׁתִּ֥ין וְתַרְתֵּֽין׃
verses.translit: vdryvsh (mdy') [md'h] qbl mlkhvt' khbr shnyn shtyn vtrtyn
verses.translation: And Darius the Mede received the kingdom, being about threescore and two years old.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁפַר֙ קֳדָ֣ם דָּרְיָ֔וֶשׁ וַהֲקִים֙ עַל־מַלְכוּתָ֔א לַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֖א מְאָ֣ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֑ין דִּ֥י לֶהֱוֺ֖ן בְּכׇל־מַלְכוּתָֽא׃
verses.translit: shpr qdm dryvsh vhqym 'lmlkhvt' l'chshdrpny' m'h v'shryn dy lhvn bkhlmlkhvt'
verses.translation: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom a hundred and twenty satraps, who should be throughout the whole kingdom;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֵ֤לָּא מִנְּהוֹן֙ סָרְכִ֣ין תְּלָתָ֔ה דִּ֥י דָנִיֵּ֖אל חַֽד־מִנְּה֑וֹן דִּֽי־לֶהֱוֺ֞ן אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֗ין יָהֲבִ֤ין לְהוֹן֙ טַעְמָ֔א וּמַלְכָּ֖א לָֽא־לֶהֱוֵ֥א נָזִֽק׃
verses.translit: v'l' mnhvn srkhyn tlth dy dny'l chdmnhvn dylhvn 'chshdrpny' 'lyn yhbyn lhvn t'm' vmlkh' l'lhv' nzq
verses.translation: and over them three presidents, of whom Daniel was one; that these satraps might give account unto them, and that the king should have no damage.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
