verses.original: אֱדַ֙יִן֙ דָּנִיֵּ֣אל דְּנָ֔ה הֲוָ֣א מִתְנַצַּ֔ח עַל־סָרְכַיָּ֖א וַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֑א כׇּל־קֳבֵ֗ל דִּ֣י ר֤וּחַ יַתִּירָא֙ בֵּ֔הּ וּמַלְכָּ֣א עֲשִׁ֔ית לַהֲקָמוּתֵ֖הּ עַל־כׇּל־מַלְכוּתָֽא׃
verses.translit: 'dyn dny'l dnh hv' mtntsch 'lsrkhy' v'chshdrpny' khlqbl dy rvch ytyr' bh vmlkh' 'shyt lhqmvth 'lkhlmlkhvt'
verses.translation: Then this Daniel distinguished himself above the presidents and the satraps, because a surpassing spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱדַ֨יִן סָֽרְכַיָּ֜א וַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֗א הֲו֨וֹ בָעַ֧יִן עִלָּ֛ה לְהַשְׁכָּחָ֥ה לְדָנִיֵּ֖אל מִצַּ֣ד מַלְכוּתָ֑א וְכׇל־עִלָּ֨ה וּשְׁחִיתָ֜ה לָא־יָכְלִ֣ין לְהַשְׁכָּחָ֗ה כׇּל־קֳבֵל֙ דִּֽי־מְהֵימַ֣ן ה֔וּא וְכׇל־שָׁלוּ֙ וּשְׁחִיתָ֔ה לָ֥א הִשְׁתְּכַ֖חַת עֲלֽוֹהִי׃
verses.translit: 'dyn srkhy' v'chshdrpny' hvv b'yn 'lh lhshkhchh ldny'l mtsd mlkhvt' vkhl'lh vshchyth l'ykhlyn lhshkhchh khlqbl dymhymn hv' vkhlshlv vshchyth l' hshtkhcht 'lvhy
verses.translation: Then the presidents and the satraps sought to find occasion against Daniel as touching the kingdom; but they could find no occasion nor fault; forasmuch as he was faithful, neither was there any error or fault found in him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֠דַ֠יִן גֻּבְרַיָּ֤א אִלֵּךְ֙ אָֽמְרִ֔ין דִּ֣י לָ֧א נְהַשְׁכַּ֛ח לְדָנִיֵּ֥אל דְּנָ֖ה כׇּל־עִלָּ֑ה לָהֵ֕ן הַשְׁכַּ֥חְנָֽא עֲל֖וֹהִי בְּדָ֥ת אֱלָהֵֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'dyn gbry' 'lkh 'mryn dy l' nhshkhch ldny'l dnh khl'lh lhn hshkhchn' 'lvhy bdt 'lhh {s}
verses.translation: Then said these men: ‘We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel, except we find it against him in the matter of the law of his God.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֠דַ֠יִן סָרְכַיָּ֤א וַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּא֙ אִלֵּ֔ן הַרְגִּ֖שׁוּ עַל־מַלְכָּ֑א וְכֵן֙ אָמְרִ֣ין לֵ֔הּ דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֖א לְעָלְמִ֥ין חֱיִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'dyn srkhy' v'chshdrpny' 'ln hrgshv 'lmlkh' vkhn 'mryn lh dryvsh mlkh' l'lmyn chyy
verses.translation: Then these presidents and satraps came tumultuously to the king, and said thus unto him: ‘King Darius, live for ever!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִתְיָעַ֜טוּ כֹּ֣ל  סָרְכֵ֣י מַלְכוּתָ֗א סִגְנַיָּ֤א וַֽאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּא֙ הַדָּֽבְרַיָּ֣א וּפַחֲוָתָ֔א לְקַיָּמָ֤ה קְיָם֙ מַלְכָּ֔א וּלְתַקָּפָ֖ה אֱסָ֑ר דִּ֣י כׇל־דִּֽי־יִבְעֵ֣א בָ֠ע֠וּ מִן־כׇּל־אֱלָ֨הּ וֶֽאֱנָ֜שׁ עַד־יוֹמִ֣ין תְּלָתִ֗ין לָהֵן֙ מִנָּ֣ךְ מַלְכָּ֔א יִתְרְמֵ֕א לְגֹ֖ב אַרְיָוָתָֽא׃
verses.translit: 'ty'tv khl  srkhy mlkhvt' sgny' v'chshdrpny' hdbry' vpchvt' lqymh qym mlkh' vltqph 'sr dy khldyyb'' b'v mnkhl'lh v'nsh 'dyvmyn tltyn lhn mnkh mlkh' ytrm' lgb 'ryvt'
verses.translation: All the presidents of the kingdom, the prefects and the satraps, the ministers and the governors, have consulted together that the king should establish a statute, and make a strong interdict, that whosoever shall ask a petition of any god or man for thirty days, save of thee, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּעַ֣ן מַלְכָּ֔א תְּקִ֥ים אֱסָרָ֖א וְתִרְשֻׁ֣ם כְּתָבָ֑א דִּ֣י לָ֧א לְהַשְׁנָיָ֛ה כְּדָת־מָדַ֥י וּפָרַ֖ס דִּי־לָ֥א תֶעְדֵּֽא׃
verses.translit: kh'n mlkh' tqym 'sr' vtrshm khtb' dy l' lhshnyh khdtmdy vprs dyl' t'd'
verses.translation: Now, O king, establish the interdict, and sign the writing, that it be not changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־קֳבֵ֖ל דְּנָ֑ה מַלְכָּא֙ דָּֽרְיָ֔וֶשׁ רְשַׁ֥ם כְּתָבָ֖א וֶאֱסָרָֽא׃
verses.translit: khlqbl dnh mlkh' dryvsh rshm khtb' v'sr'
verses.translation: Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the interdict.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠דָנִיֵּ֠אל כְּדִ֨י יְדַ֜ע דִּֽי־רְשִׁ֤ים כְּתָבָא֙ עַ֣ל לְבַיְתֵ֔הּ וְכַוִּ֨ין פְּתִיחָ֥ן לֵהּ֙ בְּעִלִּיתֵ֔הּ נֶ֖גֶד יְרוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וְזִמְנִין֩ תְּלָתָ֨ה בְיוֹמָ֜א ה֣וּא  בָּרֵ֣ךְ עַל־בִּרְכ֗וֹהִי וּמְצַלֵּ֤א וּמוֹדֵא֙ קֳדָ֣ם אֱלָהֵ֔הּ כׇּל־קֳבֵל֙ דִּֽי־הֲוָ֣א עָבֵ֔ד מִן־קַדְמַ֖ת דְּנָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vdny'l khdy yd' dyrshym khtb' 'l lbyth vkhvyn ptychn lh b'lyth ngd yrvshlm vzmnyn tlth byvm' hv'  brkh 'lbrkhvhy vmtsl' vmvd' qdm 'lhh khlqbl dyhv' 'bd mnqdmt dnh {s}
verses.translation: And when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house—now his windows were open in his upper chamber toward Jerusalem—and he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did aforetime.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֠דַ֠יִן גֻּבְרַיָּ֤א אִלֵּךְ֙ הַרְגִּ֔שׁוּ וְהַשְׁכַּ֖חוּ לְדָנִיֵּ֑אל בָּעֵ֥ה וּמִתְחַנַּ֖ן קֳדָ֥ם אֱלָהֵֽהּ׃
verses.translit: 'dyn gbry' 'lkh hrgshv vhshkhchv ldny'l b'h vmtchnn qdm 'lhh
verses.translation: Then these men came tumultuously, and found Daniel making petition and supplication before his God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֠אדַ֠יִן קְרִ֨בוּ וְאָמְרִ֥ין קֳדָם־מַלְכָּא֮ עַל־אֱסָ֣ר מַלְכָּא֒ הֲלָ֧א אֱסָ֣ר רְשַׁ֗מְתָּ דִּ֣י כׇל־אֱנָ֡שׁ דִּֽי־יִבְעֵא֩ מִן־כׇּל־אֱלָ֨הּ וֶֽאֱנָ֜שׁ עַד־יוֹמִ֣ין תְּלָתִ֗ין לָהֵן֙ מִנָּ֣ךְ מַלְכָּ֔א יִתְרְמֵ֕א לְג֖וֹב אַרְיָוָתָ֑א עָנֵ֨ה מַלְכָּ֜א וְאָמַ֗ר יַצִּיבָ֧א מִלְּתָ֛א כְּדָת־מָדַ֥י וּפָרַ֖ס דִּי־לָ֥א תֶעְדֵּֽא׃
verses.translit: b'dyn qrbv v'mryn qdmmlkh' 'l'sr mlkh' hl' 'sr rshmt dy khl'nsh dyyb'' mnkhl'lh v'nsh 'dyvmyn tltyn lhn mnkh mlkh' ytrm' lgvb 'ryvt' 'nh mlkh' v'mr ytsyb' mlt' khdtmdy vprs dyl' t'd'
verses.translation: Then they came near, and spoke before the king concerning the king’s interdict: ‘Hast thou not signed an interdict, that every man that shall make petition unto any god or man within thirty days, save of thee, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions?’ The king answered and said: ‘The thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֠אדַ֠יִן עֲנ֣וֹ וְאָמְרִין֮ קֳדָ֣ם מַלְכָּא֒ דִּ֣י דָנִיֵּ֡אל דִּי֩ מִן־בְּנֵ֨י גָלוּתָ֜א דִּ֣י יְה֗וּד לָא־שָׂ֨ם (עליך) [עֲלָ֤ךְ] מַלְכָּא֙ טְעֵ֔ם וְעַל־אֱסָרָ֖א דִּ֣י רְשַׁ֑מְתָּ וְזִמְנִ֤ין תְּלָתָה֙ בְּיוֹמָ֔א בָּעֵ֖א בָּעוּתֵֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: b'dyn 'nv v'mryn qdm mlkh' dy dny'l dy mnbny glvt' dy yhvd l'shm ('lykh) ['lkh] mlkh' t'm v'l'sr' dy rshmt vzmnyn tlth byvm' b'' b'vth {p}
verses.translation: Then answered they and said before the king: ‘That Daniel, who is of the children of the captivity of Judah, regardeth not thee, O king, nor the interdict that thou hast signed, but maketh his petition three times a day.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱדַ֨יִן מַלְכָּ֜א כְּדִ֧י מִלְּתָ֣א שְׁמַ֗ע שַׂגִּיא֙ בְּאֵ֣שׁ עֲל֔וֹהִי וְעַ֧ל דָּנִיֵּ֛אל שָׂ֥ם בָּ֖ל לְשֵׁיזָבוּתֵ֑הּ וְעַד֙ מֶֽעָלֵ֣י שִׁמְשָׁ֔א הֲוָ֥א מִשְׁתַּדַּ֖ר לְהַצָּלוּתֵֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'dyn mlkh' khdy mlt' shm' shgy' b'sh 'lvhy v'l dny'l shm bl lshyzbvth v'd m'ly shmsh' hv' mshtdr lhtslvth {s}
verses.translation: Then the king, when he heard these words, was sore displeased, and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him; and he laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֙יִן֙ גֻּבְרַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֔ךְ הַרְגִּ֖שׁוּ עַל־מַלְכָּ֑א וְאָמְרִ֣ין לְמַלְכָּ֗א דַּ֤ע מַלְכָּא֙ דִּֽי־דָת֙ לְמָדַ֣י וּפָרַ֔ס דִּֽי־כׇל־אֱסָ֥ר וּקְיָ֛ם דִּֽי־מַלְכָּ֥א יְהָקֵ֖ים לָ֥א לְהַשְׁנָיָֽה׃
verses.translit: b'dyn gbry' 'lkh hrgshv 'lmlkh' v'mryn lmlkh' d' mlkh' dydt lmdy vprs dykhl'sr vqym dymlkh' yhqym l' lhshnyh
verses.translation: Then these men came tumultuously unto the king, and said unto the king: ‘Know, O king, that it is a law of the Medes and Persians, that no interdict nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֜יִן מַלְכָּ֣א אֲמַ֗ר וְהַיְתִיו֙ לְדָ֣נִיֵּ֔אל וּרְמ֕וֹ לְגֻבָּ֖א דִּ֣י אַרְיָוָתָ֑א עָנֵ֤ה מַלְכָּא֙ וְאָמַ֣ר לְדָנִיֵּ֔אל אֱלָהָ֗ךְ דִּ֣י (אנתה) [אַ֤נְתְּ] פָּֽלַֽח־לֵהּ֙ בִּתְדִירָ֔א ה֖וּא יְשֵׁיזְבִנָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: b'dyn mlkh' 'mr vhytyv ldny'l vrmv lgb' dy 'ryvt' 'nh mlkh' v'mr ldny'l 'lhkh dy ('nth) ['nt] plchlh btdyr' hv' yshyzbnkh
verses.translation: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. Now the king spoke and said unto Daniel: ‘Thy God whom thou servest continually, He will deliver thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵיתָ֙יִת֙ אֶ֣בֶן חֲדָ֔ה וְשֻׂמַ֖ת עַל־פֻּ֣ם גֻּבָּ֑א וְחַתְמַ֨הּ מַלְכָּ֜א בְּעִזְקְתֵ֗הּ וּבְעִזְקָת֙ רַבְרְבָנ֔וֹהִי דִּ֛י לָא־תִשְׁנֵ֥א צְב֖וּ בְּדָנִיֵּֽאל׃
verses.translit: vhytyt 'bn chdh vshmt 'lpm gb' vchtmh mlkh' b'zqth vb'zqt rbrbnvhy dy l'tshn' tsbv bdny'l
verses.translation: And a stone was brought, and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that nothing might be changed concerning Daniel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֠דַ֠יִן אֲזַ֨ל מַלְכָּ֤א לְהֵֽיכְלֵהּ֙ וּבָ֣ת טְוָ֔ת וְדַחֲוָ֖ן לָא־הַנְעֵ֣ל קׇֽדָמ֑וֹהִי וְשִׁנְתֵּ֖הּ נַדַּ֥ת עֲלֽוֹהִי׃
verses.translit: 'dyn 'zl mlkh' lhykhlh vbt tvt vdchvn l'hn'l qdmvhy vshnth ndt 'lvhy
verses.translation: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting; neither were diversions brought before him; and his sleep fled from him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֣יִן מַלְכָּ֔א בִּשְׁפַּרְפָּרָ֖א יְק֣וּם בְּנׇגְהָ֑א וּ֨בְהִתְבְּהָלָ֔ה לְגֻבָּ֥א דִֽי־אַרְיָוָתָ֖א אֲזַֽל׃
verses.translit: b'dyn mlkh' bshprpr' yqvm bngh' vbhtbhlh lgb' dy'ryvt' 'zl
verses.translation: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste unto the den of lions.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְמִקְרְבֵ֣הּ לְגֻבָּ֔א לְדָ֣נִיֵּ֔אל בְּקָ֥ל עֲצִ֖יב זְעִ֑ק עָנֵ֨ה מַלְכָּ֜א וְאָמַ֣ר לְדָנִיֵּ֗אל דָּֽנִיֵּאל֙ עֲבֵד֙ אֱלָהָ֣א חַיָּ֔א אֱלָהָ֗ךְ דִּ֣י (אנתה) [אַ֤נְתְּ] פָּֽלַֽח־לֵהּ֙ בִּתְדִירָ֔א הַיְכִ֥ל לְשֵׁיזָבוּתָ֖ךְ מִן־אַרְיָוָתָֽא׃
verses.translit: vkhmqrbh lgb' ldny'l bql 'tsyb z'q 'nh mlkh' v'mr ldny'l dny'l 'bd 'lh' chy' 'lhkh dy ('nth) ['nt] plchlh btdyr' hykhl lshyzbvtkh mn'ryvt'
verses.translation: And when he came near unto the den to Daniel, he cried with a pained voice; the king spoke and said to Daniel: ‘O Daniel, servant of the living God, is thy God, whom thou servest continually, able to deliver thee from the lions?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱדַ֙יִן֙ דָּנִיֵּ֔אל עִם־מַלְכָּ֖א מַלִּ֑ל מַלְכָּ֖א לְעָלְמִ֥ין חֱיִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'dyn dny'l 'mmlkh' mll mlkh' l'lmyn chyy
verses.translation: Then said Daniel unto the king: ‘O king, live for ever!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלָהִ֞י שְׁלַ֣ח מַלְאֲכֵ֗הּ וּֽסְגַ֛ר פֻּ֥ם אַרְיָוָתָ֖א וְלָ֣א חַבְּל֑וּנִי כׇּל־קֳבֵ֗ל דִּ֤י קׇֽדָמ֙וֹהִי֙ זָכוּ֙ הִשְׁתְּכַ֣חַת לִ֔י וְאַ֤ף (קדמיך) [קׇֽדָמָךְ֙] מַלְכָּ֔א חֲבוּלָ֖ה לָ֥א עַבְדֵֽת׃
verses.translit: 'lhy shlch ml'khh vsgr pm 'ryvt' vl' chblvny khlqbl dy qdmvhy zkhv hshtkhcht ly v'f (qdmykh) [qdmkh] mlkh' chbvlh l' 'bdt
verses.translation: My God hath sent His angel, and hath shut the lions’mouths, and they have not hurt me; forasmuch as before Him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֣יִן מַלְכָּ֗א שַׂגִּיא֙ טְאֵ֣ב עֲל֔וֹהִי וּלְדָ֣נִיֵּ֔אל אֲמַ֖ר לְהַנְסָקָ֣ה מִן־גֻּבָּ֑א וְהֻסַּ֨ק דָּנִיֵּ֜אל מִן־גֻּבָּ֗א וְכׇל־חֲבָל֙ לָא־הִשְׁתְּכַ֣ח בֵּ֔הּ דִּ֖י הֵימִ֥ן בֵּאלָהֵֽהּ׃
verses.translit: b'dyn mlkh' shgy' t'b 'lvhy vldny'l 'mr lhnsqh mngb' vhsq dny'l mngb' vkhlchbl l'hshtkhch bh dy hymn b'lhh
verses.translation: Then was the king exceeding glad, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he had trusted in his God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲמַ֣ר מַלְכָּ֗א וְהַיְתִ֞יו גֻּבְרַיָּ֤א אִלֵּךְ֙ דִּֽי־אֲכַ֤לוּ קַרְצ֙וֹהִי֙ דִּ֣י דָֽנִיֵּ֔אל וּלְג֤וֹב אַרְיָוָתָא֙ רְמ֔וֹ אִנּ֖וּן בְּנֵיה֣וֹן וּנְשֵׁיה֑וֹן וְלָֽא־מְט֞וֹ לְאַרְעִ֣ית גֻּבָּ֗א עַ֠ד דִּֽי־שְׁלִ֤טֽוּ בְהוֹן֙ אַרְיָ֣וָתָ֔א וְכׇל־גַּרְמֵיה֖וֹן הַדִּֽקוּ׃
verses.translit: v'mr mlkh' vhytyv gbry' 'lkh dy'khlv qrtsvhy dy dny'l vlgvb 'ryvt' rmv 'nvn bnyhvn vnshyhvn vl'mtv l'r'yt gb' 'd dyshltv bhvn 'ryvt' vkhlgrmyhvn hdqv
verses.translation: And the king commanded, and they brought those men that had accused Daniel, and they cast them into the den of lions, them, their children, and their wives; and they had not come to the bottom of the den, when the lions had the mastery of them, and broke all their bones in pieces.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֜יִן דָּרְיָ֣וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֗א כְּ֠תַ֠ב לְֽכׇל־עַֽמְמַיָּ֞א אֻמַּיָּ֧א וְלִשָּׁנַיָּ֛א דִּֽי־[דָיְרִ֥ין] (דארין) בְּכׇל־אַרְעָ֖א שְׁלָמְכ֥וֹן יִשְׂגֵּֽא׃
verses.translit: b'dyn dryvsh mlkh' khtb lkhl'mmy' 'my' vlshny' dy[dyryn] (d'ryn) bkhl'r'' shlmkhvn yshg'
verses.translation: Then king Darius wrote unto all the peoples, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth: ‘Peace be multiplied unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־קֳדָמַי֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ דִּ֣י  בְּכׇל־שׇׁלְטָ֣ן מַלְכוּתִ֗י לֶהֱוֺ֤ן (זאעין) [זָיְעִין֙] וְדָ֣חֲלִ֔ין מִן־קֳדָ֖ם אֱלָהֵ֣הּ דִּי־דָֽנִיֵּ֑אל דִּי־ה֣וּא  אֱלָהָ֣א חַיָּ֗א וְקַיָּם֙ לְעָ֣לְמִ֔ין וּמַלְכוּתֵהּ֙ דִּֽי־לָ֣א תִתְחַבַּ֔ל וְשׇׁלְטָנֵ֖הּ עַד־סוֹפָֽא׃
verses.translit: mnqdmy shym t'm dy  bkhlshltn mlkhvty lhvn (z''yn) [zy'yn] vdchlyn mnqdm 'lhh dydny'l dyhv'  'lh' chy' vqym l'lmyn vmlkhvth dyl' ttchbl vshltnh 'dsvp'
verses.translation: I make a decree, that in all the dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel; For He is the living God, And stedfast for ever, And His kingdom that which shall not be destroyed, And His dominion shall be even unto the end;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְשֵׁיזִ֣ב וּמַצִּ֔ל וְעָבֵד֙ אָתִ֣ין וְתִמְהִ֔ין בִּשְׁמַיָּ֖א וּבְאַרְעָ֑א דִּ֚י שֵׁיזִ֣ב לְדָֽנִיֵּ֔אל מִן־יַ֖ד אַרְיָוָתָֽא׃
verses.translit: mshyzb vmtsl v'bd 'tyn vtmhyn bshmy' vb'r'' dy shyzb ldny'l mnyd 'ryvt'
verses.translation: He delivereth and rescueth, And He worketh signs and wonders In heaven and in earth; Who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדָנִיֵּ֣אל דְּנָ֔ה הַצְלַ֖ח בְּמַלְכ֣וּת דָּרְיָ֑וֶשׁ וּבְמַלְכ֖וּת כּ֥וֹרֶשׁ (פרסיא) [פָּרְסָאָֽה]׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vdny'l dnh htslch bmlkhvt dryvsh vbmlkhvt khvrsh (prsy') [prs'h] {p}
verses.translation: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת חֲדָ֗ה לְבֵלְאשַׁצַּר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל דָּנִיֵּאל֙ חֵ֣לֶם חֲזָ֔ה וְחֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשֵׁ֖הּ עַֽל־מִשְׁכְּבֵ֑הּ בֵּאדַ֙יִן֙ חֶלְמָ֣א כְתַ֔ב רֵ֥אשׁ מִלִּ֖ין אֲמַֽר׃
verses.translit: bshnt chdh lbl'shtsr mlkh bbl dny'l chlm chzh vchzvy r'shh 'lmshkhbh b'dyn chlm' khtb r'sh mlyn 'mr
verses.translation: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed; then he wrote the dream and told the sum of the matters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָנֵ֤ה דָנִיֵּאל֙ וְאָמַ֔ר חָזֵ֥ה הֲוֵ֛ית בְּחֶזְוִ֖י עִם־לֵֽילְיָ֑א וַאֲר֗וּ אַרְבַּע֙ רוּחֵ֣י שְׁמַיָּ֔א מְגִיחָ֖ן לְיַמָּ֥א רַבָּֽא׃
verses.translit: 'nh dny'l v'mr chzh hvyt bchzvy 'mlyly' v'rv 'rb' rvchy shmy' mgychn lym' rb'
verses.translation: Daniel spoke and said: I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the heaven broke forth upon the great sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַרְבַּ֤ע חֵיוָן֙ רַבְרְבָ֔ן סָלְקָ֖ן מִן־יַמָּ֑א שָׁנְיָ֖ן דָּ֥א מִן־דָּֽא׃
verses.translit: v'rb' chyvn rbrbn slqn mnym' shnyn d' mnd'
verses.translation: And four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קַדְמָיְתָ֣א כְאַרְיֵ֔ה וְגַפִּ֥ין דִּֽי־נְשַׁ֖ר לַ֑הּ חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֡ית עַד֩ דִּי־מְּרִ֨יטוּ (גפיה) [גַפַּ֜הּ] וּנְטִ֣ילַת מִן־אַרְעָ֗א וְעַל־רַגְלַ֙יִן֙ כֶּאֱנָ֣שׁ הֳקִימַ֔ת וּלְבַ֥ב אֱנָ֖שׁ יְהִ֥יב לַֽהּ׃
verses.translit: qdmyt' kh'ryh vgpyn dynshr lh chzh hvyt 'd dymrytv (gpyh) [gph] vntylt mn'r'' v'lrglyn kh'nsh hqymt vlbb 'nsh yhyb lh
verses.translation: The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings; I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked off, and it was lifted up from the earth, and made stand upon two feet as a man, and a man’s heart was given to it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲר֣וּ חֵיוָה֩ אׇחֳרִ֨י תִנְיָנָ֜ה דָּמְיָ֣ה לְדֹ֗ב וְלִשְׂטַר־חַד֙ הֳקִמַ֔ת וּתְלָ֥ת עִלְעִ֛ין בְּפֻמַּ֖הּ בֵּ֣ין (שניה) [שִׁנַּ֑הּ] וְכֵן֙ אָמְרִ֣ין לַ֔הּ ק֥וּמִֽי אֲכֻ֖לִי בְּשַׂ֥ר שַׂגִּֽיא׃
verses.translit: v'rv chyvh 'chry tnynh dmyh ldb vlshtrchd hqmt vtlt 'l'yn bpmh byn (shnyh) [shnh] vkhn 'mryn lh qvmy 'khly bshr shgy'
verses.translation: And behold another beast, a second, like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and it had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth; and it was said thus unto it: ‘Arise, devour much flesh.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּאתַ֨ר דְּנָ֜ה חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֗ית וַאֲר֤וּ אׇֽחֳרִי֙ כִּנְמַ֔ר וְלַ֨הּ גַּפִּ֥ין אַרְבַּ֛ע דִּי־ע֖וֹף עַל־[גַּבַּ֑הּ] (גביה) וְאַרְבְּעָ֤ה רֵאשִׁין֙ לְחֵ֣יוְתָ֔א וְשׇׁלְטָ֖ן יְהִ֥יב לַֽהּ׃
verses.translit: b'tr dnh chzh hvyt v'rv 'chry khnmr vlh gpyn 'rb' dy'vf 'l[gbh] (gbyh) v'rb'h r'shyn lchyvt' vshltn yhyb lh
verses.translation: After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the sides of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּאתַ֣ר דְּנָה֩ חָזֵ֨ה הֲוֵ֜ית בְּחֶזְוֵ֣י לֵֽילְיָ֗א וַאֲר֣וּ חֵיוָ֣ה (רביעיה) [רְֽבִיעָאָ֡ה] דְּחִילָה֩ וְאֵֽימְתָנִ֨י וְתַקִּיפָ֜א יַתִּ֗ירָה וְשִׁנַּ֨יִן דִּֽי־פַרְזֶ֥ל לַהּ֙ רַבְרְבָ֔ן אָֽכְלָ֣ה וּמַדֱּקָ֔ה וּשְׁאָרָ֖א (ברגליה) [בְּרַגְלַ֣הּ] רָפְסָ֑ה וְהִ֣יא מְשַׁנְּיָ֗ה מִן־כׇּל־חֵֽיוָתָא֙ דִּ֣י (קדמיה) [קׇֽדָמַ֔הּ] וְקַרְנַ֥יִן עֲשַׂ֖ר לַֽהּ׃
verses.translit: b'tr dnh chzh hvyt bchzvy lyly' v'rv chyvh (rby'yh) [rby''h] dchylh v'ymtny vtqyp' ytyrh vshnyn dyprzl lh rbrbn 'khlh vmdqh vsh'r' (brglyh) [brglh] rpsh vhy' mshnyh mnkhlchyvt' dy (qdmyh) [qdmh] vqrnyn 'shr lh
verses.translation: After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth; it devoured and broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet; and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִשְׂתַּכַּ֨ל הֲוֵ֜ית בְּקַרְנַיָּ֗א וַ֠אֲל֠וּ קֶ֣רֶן אׇחֳרִ֤י זְעֵירָה֙ סִלְקָ֣ת (ביניהון) [בֵּֽינֵיהֵ֔ן] וּתְלָ֗ת מִן־קַרְנַיָּא֙ קַדְמָ֣יָתָ֔א (אתעקרו) [אֶתְעֲקַ֖רָה] מִן־[קֳדָמַ֑הּ] (קדמיה) וַאֲל֨וּ עַיְנִ֜ין כְּעַיְנֵ֤י אֲנָשָׁא֙ בְּקַרְנָא־דָ֔א וּפֻ֖ם מְמַלִּ֥ל רַבְרְבָֽן׃
verses.translit: mshtkhl hvyt bqrny' v'lv qrn 'chry z'yrh slqt (bynyhvn) [bynyhn] vtlt mnqrny' qdmyt' ('t'qrv) ['t'qrh] mn[qdmh] (qdmyh) v'lv 'ynyn kh'yny 'nsh' bqrn'd' vpm mmll rbrbn
verses.translation: I considered the horns, and, behold, there came up among them another horn, a little one, before which three of the first horns were plucked up by the roots; and, behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of a man, and a mouth speaking great things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֗ית עַ֣ד דִּ֤י כׇרְסָוָן֙ רְמִ֔יו וְעַתִּ֥יק יוֹמִ֖ין יְתִ֑ב לְבוּשֵׁ֣הּ  כִּתְלַ֣ג חִוָּ֗ר וּשְׂעַ֤ר רֵאשֵׁהּ֙ כַּעֲמַ֣ר נְקֵ֔א כׇּרְסְיֵהּ֙ שְׁבִבִ֣ין דִּי־נ֔וּר גַּלְגִּלּ֖וֹהִי נ֥וּר דָּלִֽק׃
verses.translit: chzh hvyt 'd dy khrsvn rmyv v'tyq yvmyn ytb lbvshh  khtlg chvr vsh'r r'shh kh'mr nq' khrsyh shbbyn dynvr glglvhy nvr dlq
verses.translation: I beheld Till thrones were placed, And one that was ancient of days did sit: His raiment was as white snow, And the hair of his head like pure wool; His throne was fiery flames, and the wheels thereof burning fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְהַ֣ר דִּי־נ֗וּר נָגֵ֤ד וְנָפֵק֙ מִן־קֳדָמ֔וֹהִי אֶ֤לֶף (אלפים) [אַלְפִין֙] יְשַׁמְּשׁוּנֵּ֔הּ וְרִבּ֥וֹ (רבון) [רִבְבָ֖ן] קָֽדָמ֣וֹהִי יְקוּמ֑וּן דִּינָ֥א יְתִ֖ב וְסִפְרִ֥ין פְּתִֽיחוּ׃
verses.translit: nhr dynvr ngd vnpq mnqdmvhy 'lf ('lpym) ['lpyn] yshmshvnh vrbv (rbvn) [rbbn] qdmvhy yqvmvn dyn' ytb vspryn ptychv
verses.translation: A fiery stream issued And came forth from before him; thousand thousands ministered unto him, And ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him; The judgment was set, And the books were opened.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֔ית בֵּאדַ֗יִן מִן־קָל֙ מִלַּיָּ֣א רַבְרְבָתָ֔א דִּ֥י קַרְנָ֖א מְמַלֱּלָ֑ה חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֡ית עַד֩ דִּ֨י קְטִילַ֤ת חֵֽיוְתָא֙ וְהוּבַ֣ד גִּשְׁמַ֔הּ וִיהִיבַ֖ת לִיקֵדַ֥ת אֶשָּֽׁא׃
verses.translit: chzh hvyt b'dyn mnql mly' rbrbt' dy qrn' mmllh chzh hvyt 'd dy qtylt chyvt' vhvbd gshmh vyhybt lyqdt 'sh'
verses.translation: I beheld at that time because of the voice of the great words which the horn spoke, I beheld even till the beast was slain, and its body destroyed, and it was given to be burned with fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁאָר֙ חֵֽיוָתָ֔א הֶעְדִּ֖יו שׇׁלְטָנְה֑וֹן וְאַרְכָ֧ה בְחַיִּ֛ין יְהִ֥יבַת לְה֖וֹן עַד־זְמַ֥ן וְעִדָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vsh'r chyvt' h'dyv shltnhvn v'rkhh bchyyn yhybt lhvn 'dzmn v'dn
verses.translation: And as for the rest of the beasts, their dominion was taken away; yet their lives were prolonged for a season and a time.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָזֵ֤ה הֲוֵית֙ בְּחֶזְוֵ֣י לֵֽילְיָ֔א וַאֲרוּ֙ עִם־עֲנָנֵ֣י שְׁמַיָּ֔א כְּבַ֥ר אֱנָ֖שׁ אָתֵ֣ה הֲוָ֑א וְעַד־עַתִּ֤יק יֽוֹמַיָּא֙ מְטָ֔ה וּקְדָמ֖וֹהִי הַקְרְבֽוּהִי׃
verses.translit: chzh hvyt bchzvy lyly' v'rv 'm'nny shmy' khbr 'nsh 'th hv' v'd'tyq yvmy' mth vqdmvhy hqrbvhy
verses.translation: I saw in the night visions, And, behold, there came with the clouds of heaven One like unto a son of man, And he came even to the Ancient of days, And he was brought near before Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֵ֨הּ יְהִ֤ב שׇׁלְטָן֙ וִיקָ֣ר וּמַלְכ֔וּ וְכֹ֣ל עַֽמְמַיָּ֗א אֻמַּיָּ֛א וְלִשָּׁנַיָּ֖א לֵ֣הּ יִפְלְח֑וּן שׇׁלְטָנֵ֞הּ שׇׁלְטָ֤ן עָלַם֙ דִּֽי־לָ֣א יֶעְדֵּ֔ה וּמַלְכוּתֵ֖הּ דִּי־לָ֥א תִתְחַבַּֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vlh yhb shltn vyqr vmlkhv vkhl 'mmy' 'my' vlshny' lh yplchvn shltnh shltn 'lm dyl' y'dh vmlkhvth dyl' ttchbl {p}
verses.translation: And there was given him dominion, And glory, and a kingdom, That all the peoples, nations, and languages Should serve him; His dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, And his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶתְכְּרִיַּ֥ת רוּחִ֛י אֲנָ֥ה דָנִיֵּ֖אל בְּג֣וֹא נִדְנֶ֑ה וְחֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשִׁ֖י יְבַהֲלֻנַּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: 'tkhryt rvchy 'nh dny'l bgv' ndnh vchzvy r'shy ybhlnny
verses.translation: As for me Daniel, my spirit was pained in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head affrighted me. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קִרְבֵ֗ת עַל־חַד֙ מִן־קָ֣אֲמַיָּ֔א וְיַצִּיבָ֥א אֶבְעֵֽא־מִנֵּ֖הּ עַֽל־כׇּל־דְּנָ֑ה וַאֲמַר־לִ֕י וּפְשַׁ֥ר מִלַּיָּ֖א יְהוֹדְעִנַּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: qrbt 'lchd mnq'my' vytsyb' 'b''mnh 'lkhldnh v'mrly vpshr mly' yhvd'nny
verses.translation: I came near unto one of them that stood by, and asked him the truth concerning all this. So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִלֵּין֙ חֵיוָתָ֣א רַבְרְבָתָ֔א דִּ֥י אִנִּ֖ין אַרְבַּ֑ע אַרְבְּעָ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין יְקוּמ֥וּן מִן־אַרְעָֽא׃
verses.translit: 'lyn chyvt' rbrbt' dy 'nyn 'rb' 'rb'h mlkhyn yqvmvn mn'r''
verses.translation: ’These great beasts, which are four, are four kings, that shall arise out of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִֽיקַבְּלוּן֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔א קַדִּישֵׁ֖י עֶלְיוֹנִ֑ין וְיַחְסְנ֤וּן מַלְכוּתָא֙ עַד־עָ֣לְמָ֔א וְעַ֖ד עָלַ֥ם עָלְמַיָּֽא׃
verses.translit: vyqblvn mlkhvt' qdyshy 'lyvnyn vychsnvn mlkhvt' 'd'lm' v'd 'lm 'lmy'
verses.translation: But the saints of the Most High shall receive the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱדַ֗יִן צְבִית֙ לְיַצָּבָ֗א עַל־חֵֽיוְתָא֙ רְבִיעָ֣יְתָ֔א דִּֽי־הֲוָ֥ת שָֽׁנְיָ֖ה מִן־[כׇּלְּהֵ֑ין] (כלהון) דְּחִילָ֣ה יַתִּ֗ירָה (שניה) [שִׁנַּ֤הּ] דִּֽי־פַרְזֶל֙ (וטפריה) [וְטִפְרַ֣הּ] דִּֽי־נְחָ֔שׁ אָֽכְלָ֣ה מַדְּקָ֔ה וּשְׁאָרָ֖א (ברגליה) [בְּרַגְלַ֥הּ] רָֽפְסָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'dyn tsbyt lytsb' 'lchyvt' rby'yt' dyhvt shnyh mn[khlhyn] (khlhvn) dchylh ytyrh (shnyh) [shnh] dyprzl (vtpryh) [vtprh] dynchsh 'khlh mdqh vsh'r' (brglyh) [brglh] rpsh
verses.translation: Then I desired to know the truth concerning the fourth beast, which was diverse from all of them, exceeding terrible, whose teeth were of iron, and its nails of brass; which devoured, brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־קַרְנַיָּ֤א עֲשַׂר֙ דִּ֣י בְרֵאשַׁ֔הּ וְאׇחֳרִי֙ דִּ֣י סִלְקַ֔ת (ונפלו) [וּנְפַ֥לָה] מִן־[קֳדָמַ֖הּ] (קדמיה) תְּלָ֑ת וְקַרְנָ֨א דִכֵּ֜ן וְעַיְנִ֣ין לַ֗הּ וּפֻם֙ מְמַלִּ֣ל רַבְרְבָ֔ן וְחֶזְוַ֖הּ רַ֥ב מִן־חַבְרָתַֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'lqrny' 'shr dy br'shh v'chry dy slqt (vnplv) [vnplh] mn[qdmh] (qdmyh) tlt vqrn' dkhn v'ynyn lh vpm mmll rbrbn vchzvh rb mnchbrth
verses.translation: and concerning the ten horns that were on its head, and the other horn which came up, and before which three fell; even that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spoke great things, whose appearance was greater than that of its fellows.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֔ית וְקַרְנָ֣א דִכֵּ֔ן עָבְדָ֥ה קְרָ֖ב עִם־קַדִּישִׁ֑ין וְיָכְלָ֖ה לְהֹֽן׃
verses.translit: chzh hvyt vqrn' dkhn 'bdh qrb 'mqdyshyn vykhlh lhn
verses.translation: I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֣ד דִּֽי־אֲתָ֗ה עַתִּיק֙ יֽוֹמַיָּ֔א וְדִינָ֣א יְהִ֔ב לְקַדִּישֵׁ֖י עֶלְיוֹנִ֑ין וְזִמְנָ֣א מְטָ֔ה וּמַלְכוּתָ֖א הֶחֱסִ֥נוּ קַדִּישִֽׁין׃
verses.translit: 'd dy'th 'tyq yvmy' vdyn' yhb lqdyshy 'lyvnyn vzmn' mth vmlkhvt' hchsnv qdyshyn
verses.translation: until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given for the saints of the Most High; and the time came, and the saints possessed the kingdom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּן֮ אֲמַר֒ חֵֽיוְתָא֙ רְבִיעָ֣יְתָ֔א מַלְכ֤וּ (רביעיה) [רְבִיעָאָה֙] תֶּהֱוֵ֣א בְאַרְעָ֔א דִּ֥י תִשְׁנֵ֖א מִן־כׇּל־מַלְכְוָתָ֑א וְתֵאכֻל֙ כׇּל־אַרְעָ֔א וּתְדוּשִׁנַּ֖הּ וְתַדְּקִנַּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khn 'mr chyvt' rby'yt' mlkhv (rby'yh) [rby''h] thv' b'r'' dy tshn' mnkhlmlkhvt' vt'khl khl'r'' vtdvshnh vtdqnh
verses.translation: Thus he said: ‘The fourth beast shall be a fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all the kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקַרְנַיָּ֣א עֲשַׂ֔ר מִנַּהּ֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔א עַשְׂרָ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין יְקֻמ֑וּן וְאׇחֳרָ֞ן יְק֣וּם אַחֲרֵיהֹ֗ן וְה֤וּא יִשְׁנֵא֙ מִן־קַדְמָיֵ֔א וּתְלָתָ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין יְהַשְׁפִּֽל׃
verses.translit: vqrny' 'shr mnh mlkhvt' 'shrh mlkhyn yqmvn v'chrn yqvm 'chryhn vhv' yshn' mnqdmy' vtlth mlkhyn yhshpl
verses.translation: And as for the ten horns, out of this kingdom shall ten kings arise; and another shall arise after them; and he shall be diverse from the former, and he shall put down three kings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִלִּ֗ין לְצַ֤ד (עליא) [עִלָּאָה֙] יְמַלִּ֔ל וּלְקַדִּישֵׁ֥י עֶלְיוֹנִ֖ין יְבַלֵּ֑א וְיִסְבַּ֗ר לְהַשְׁנָיָה֙ זִמְנִ֣ין וְדָ֔ת וְיִתְיַהֲב֣וּן בִּידֵ֔הּ עַד־עִדָּ֥ן וְעִדָּנִ֖ין וּפְלַ֥ג עִדָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vmlyn ltsd ('ly') ['l'h] ymll vlqdyshy 'lyvnyn ybl' vysbr lhshnyh zmnyn vdt vytyhbvn bydh 'd'dn v'dnyn vplg 'dn
verses.translation: And he shall speak words against the Most High, and shall wear out the saints of the Most High; and he shall think to change the seasons and the law; and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and half a time.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדִינָ֖א יִתִּ֑ב וְשׇׁלְטָנֵ֣הּ יְהַעְדּ֔וֹן לְהַשְׁמָדָ֥ה וּלְהוֹבָדָ֖ה עַד־סוֹפָֽא׃
verses.translit: vdyn' ytb vshltnh yh'dvn lhshmdh vlhvbdh 'dsvp'
verses.translation: But the judgment shall sit, and his dominions shall be taken away, to be consumed and to be destroy unto the end.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַלְכוּתָ֨א וְשׇׁלְטָנָ֜א וּרְבוּתָ֗א דִּ֚י מַלְכְוָת֙ תְּח֣וֹת כׇּל־שְׁמַיָּ֔א יְהִיבַ֕ת לְעַ֖ם קַדִּישֵׁ֣י עֶלְיוֹנִ֑ין מַלְכוּתֵהּ֙ מַלְכ֣וּת עָלַ֔ם וְכֹל֙ שׇׁלְטָ֣נַיָּ֔א לֵ֥הּ יִפְלְח֖וּן וְיִֽשְׁתַּמְּעֽוּן׃
verses.translit: vmlkhvt' vshltn' vrbvt' dy mlkhvt tchvt khlshmy' yhybt l'm qdyshy 'lyvnyn mlkhvth mlkhvt 'lm vkhl shltny' lh yplchvn vyshtm'vn
verses.translation: And the kingdom and the dominion, and the greatness of the kingdoms under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the Most High; their kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־כָּ֖ה סוֹפָ֣א דִֽי־מִלְּתָ֑א אֲנָ֨ה דָֽנִיֵּ֜אל שַׂגִּ֣יא  רַעְיוֹנַ֣י יְבַהֲלֻנַּ֗נִי וְזִיוַי֙ יִשְׁתַּנּ֣וֹן עֲלַ֔י וּמִלְּתָ֖א בְּלִבִּ֥י נִטְרֵֽת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'dkhh svp' dymlt' 'nh dny'l shgy'  r'yvny ybhlnny vzyvy yshtnvn 'ly vmlt' blby ntrt {p}
verses.translation: Here is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my thoughts much affrighted me, and my countenance was changed in me; but I kept the matter in my heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁל֔וֹשׁ לְמַלְכ֖וּת בֵּלְאשַׁצַּ֣ר הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ חָז֞וֹן נִרְאָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ אֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֔אל אַחֲרֵ֛י הַנִּרְאָ֥ה אֵלַ֖י בַּתְּחִלָּֽה׃
verses.translit: bshnt shlvsh lmlkhvt bl'shtsr hmlkh chzvn nr'h 'ly 'ny dny'l 'chry hnr'h 'ly btchlh
verses.translation: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me, even unto me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָֽאֶרְאֶה֮ בֶּחָזוֹן֒ וַֽיְהִי֙ בִּרְאֹתִ֔י וַאֲנִי֙ בְּשׁוּשַׁ֣ן הַבִּירָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵילָ֣ם הַמְּדִינָ֑ה וָאֶרְאֶה֙ בֶּֽחָז֔וֹן וַאֲנִ֥י הָיִ֖יתִי עַל־אוּבַ֥ל אוּלָֽי׃
verses.translit: v'r'h bchzvn vyhy br'ty v'ny bshvshn hbyrh 'shr b'ylm hmdynh v'r'h bchzvn v'ny hyyty 'l'vbl 'vly
verses.translation: And I saw in the vision; now it was so, that when I saw, I was in Shushan the castle, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in the vision, and I was by the stream Ulai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשָּׂ֤א עֵינַי֙ וָאֶרְאֶ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֣ה  אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֗ד עֹמֵ֛ד לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֻבָ֖ל וְל֣וֹ קְרָנָ֑יִם וְהַקְּרָנַ֣יִם גְּבֹה֗וֹת וְהָאַחַת֙ גְּבֹהָ֣ה מִן־הַשֵּׁנִ֔ית וְהַ֨גְּבֹהָ֔ה עֹלָ֖ה בָּאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'sh' 'yny v'r'h vhnh  'yl 'chd 'md lpny h'bl vlv qrnym vhqrnym gbhvt vh'cht gbhh mnhshnyt vhgbhh 'lh b'chrnh
verses.translation: And I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the stream a ram which had two horns; and the two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאִ֣יתִי אֶת־הָאַ֡יִל מְנַגֵּ֩חַ֩ יָ֨מָּה וְצָפ֜וֹנָה וָנֶ֗גְבָּה וְכׇל־חַיּוֹת֙ לֹֽא־יַֽעַמְד֣וּ לְפָנָ֔יו וְאֵ֥ין מַצִּ֖יל מִיָּד֑וֹ וְעָשָׂ֥ה כִרְצֹנ֖וֹ וְהִגְדִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: r'yty 'th'yl mngch ymh vtspvnh vngbh vkhlchyvt l'y'mdv lpnyv v'yn mtsyl mydv v'shh khrtsnv vhgdyl
verses.translation: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; and no beasts could stand before him, neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and magnified himself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י  הָיִ֣יתִי מֵבִ֗ין וְהִנֵּ֤ה צְפִיר־הָֽעִזִּים֙ בָּ֤א מִן־הַֽמַּעֲרָב֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י כׇל־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֵ֥ין נוֹגֵ֖עַ בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְהַ֨צָּפִ֔יר קֶ֥רֶן חָז֖וּת בֵּ֥ין עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'ny  hyyty mbyn vhnh tspyrh'zym b' mnhm'rb 'lpny khlh'rts v'yn nvg' b'rts vhtspyr qrn chzvt byn 'ynyv
verses.translation: And as I was considering, behold, a he-goat came from the west over the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground; and the goat had a conspicuous horn between his eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֗א עַד־הָאַ֙יִל֙ בַּ֣עַל הַקְּרָנַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאִ֔יתִי עֹמֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י הָאֻבָ֑ל וַיָּ֥רׇץ אֵלָ֖יו בַּחֲמַ֥ת כֹּחֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'dh'yl b'l hqrnym 'shr r'yty 'md lpny h'bl vyrts 'lyv bchmt khchv
verses.translation: And he came to the ram that had the two horns, which I saw standing before the stream, and ran at him in the fury of his power.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּרְאִיתִ֞יו מַגִּ֣יעַ  אֵ֣צֶל הָאַ֗יִל וַיִּתְמַרְמַ֤ר אֵלָיו֙ וַיַּ֣ךְ אֶת־הָאַ֗יִל וַיְשַׁבֵּר֙ אֶת־שְׁתֵּ֣י קְרָנָ֔יו וְלֹא־הָ֥יָה כֹ֛חַ בָּאַ֖יִל לַעֲמֹ֣ד לְפָנָ֑יו וַיַּשְׁלִיכֵ֤הוּ אַ֙רְצָה֙ וַֽיִּרְמְסֵ֔הוּ וְלֹא־הָיָ֥ה מַצִּ֛יל לָאַ֖יִל מִיָּדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vr'ytyv mgy'  'tsl h'yl vytmrmr 'lyv vykh 'th'yl vyshbr 'tshty qrnyv vl'hyh khch b'yl l'md lpnyv vyshlykhhv 'rtsh vyrmshv vl'hyh mtsyl l'yl mydv
verses.translation: And I saw him come close unto the ram, and he was moved with choler against him, and smote the ram, and broke his two horns; and there was no power in the ram to stand before him; but he cast him down to the ground, and trampled upon him; and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּצְפִ֥יר הָעִזִּ֖ים הִגְדִּ֣יל עַד־מְאֹ֑ד וּכְעׇצְמ֗וֹ נִשְׁבְּרָה֙ הַקֶּ֣רֶן הַגְּדֹלָ֔ה וַֽתַּעֲלֶ֜נָה חָז֤וּת אַרְבַּע֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔יהָ לְאַרְבַּ֖ע רוּח֥וֹת הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vtspyr h'zym hgdyl 'dm'd vkh'tsmv nshbrh hqrn hgdlh vt'lnh chzvt 'rb' tchtyh l'rb' rvchvt hshmym
verses.translation: And the he-goat magnified himself exceedingly; and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and instead of it there came up the appearance of four horns toward the four winds of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־הָאַחַ֣ת מֵהֶ֔ם יָצָ֥א קֶֽרֶן־אַחַ֖ת מִצְּעִירָ֑ה וַתִּגְדַּל־יֶ֛תֶר אֶל־הַנֶּ֥גֶב וְאֶל־הַמִּזְרָ֖ח וְאֶל־הַצֶּֽבִי׃
verses.translit: vmnh'cht mhm yts' qrn'cht mts'yrh vtgdlytr 'lhngb v'lhmzrch v'lhtsby
verses.translation: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the beauteous land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּגְדַּ֖ל עַד־צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַתַּפֵּ֥ל אַ֛רְצָה מִן־הַצָּבָ֥א וּמִן־הַכּוֹכָבִ֖ים וַֽתִּרְמְסֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vtgdl 'dtsb' hshmym vtpl 'rtsh mnhtsb' vmnhkhvkhbym vtrmsm
verses.translation: And it waxed great, even to the host of heaven; and some of the host and of the stars it cast down to the ground, and trampled upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֥ד שַֽׂר־הַצָּבָ֖א הִגְדִּ֑יל וּמִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ (הרים) [הוּרַ֣ם] הַתָּמִ֔יד וְהֻשְׁלַ֖ךְ מְכ֥וֹן מִקְדָּשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'd shrhtsb' hgdyl vmmnv (hrym) [hvrm] htmyd vhshlkh mkhvn mqdshv
verses.translation: Yea, it magnified itself, even to the prince of the host; and from him the continual burnt-offering was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצָבָ֛א תִּנָּתֵ֥ן עַל־הַתָּמִ֖יד בְּפָ֑שַׁע וְתַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ אֱמֶת֙ אַ֔רְצָה וְעָשְׂתָ֖ה וְהִצְלִֽיחָה׃
verses.translit: vtsb' tntn 'lhtmyd bpsh' vtshlkh 'mt 'rtsh v'shth vhtslychh
verses.translation: And the host was given over to it together with the continual burnt-offering through transgression; and it cast down truth to the ground, and it wrought, and prospered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁמְעָ֥ה אֶֽחָד־קָד֖וֹשׁ מְדַבֵּ֑ר וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ אֶחָ֨ד קָד֜וֹשׁ לַפַּֽלְמוֹנִ֣י הַֽמְדַבֵּ֗ר עַד־מָתַ֞י הֶחָז֤וֹן הַתָּמִיד֙ וְהַפֶּ֣שַׁע שֹׁמֵ֔ם תֵּ֛ת וְקֹ֥דֶשׁ וְצָבָ֖א מִרְמָֽס׃
verses.translit: v'shm'h 'chdqdvsh mdbr vy'mr 'chd qdvsh lplmvny hmdbr 'dmty hchzvn htmyd vhpsh' shmm tt vqdsh vtsb' mrms
verses.translation: Then I heard a holy one speaking; and another holy one said unto that certain one who spoke: ‘How long shall be the vision concerning the continual burnt-offering, and the transgression that causes appalment, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trampled under foot?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י עַ֚ד עֶ֣רֶב בֹּ֔קֶר אַלְפַּ֖יִם וּשְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וְנִצְדַּ֖ק קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly 'd 'rb bqr 'lpym vshlsh m'vt vntsdq qdsh
verses.translation: And he said unto me: ‘Unto two thousand and three hundred evenings and mornings; then shall the sanctuary be victorious.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּרְאֹתִ֛י אֲנִ֥י דָנִיֵּ֖אל אֶת־הֶחָז֑וֹן וָאֲבַקְשָׁ֣ה בִינָ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה עֹמֵ֥ד לְנֶגְדִּ֖י כְּמַרְאֵה־גָֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: vyhy br'ty 'ny dny'l 'thchzvn v'bqshh bynh vhnh 'md lngdy khmr'hgbr
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, that I sought to understand it; and, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁמַ֥ע קוֹל־אָדָ֖ם בֵּ֣ין אוּלָ֑י וַיִּקְרָא֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר גַּבְרִיאֵ֕ל הָבֵ֥ן לְהַלָּ֖ז אֶת־הַמַּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: v'shm' qvl'dm byn 'vly vyqr' vy'mr gbry'l hbn lhlz 'thmr'h
verses.translation: And I heard the voice of a man between the banks of Ulai, who called, and said: ‘Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֵ֣צֶל עׇמְדִ֔י וּבְבֹא֣וֹ נִבְעַ֔תִּי וָאֶפְּלָ֖ה עַל־פָּנָ֑י וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַי֙ הָבֵ֣ן בֶּן־אָדָ֔ם כִּ֖י לְעֶת־קֵ֥ץ הֶחָזֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'tsl 'mdy vbb'v nb'ty v'plh 'lpny vy'mr 'ly hbn bn'dm khy l'tqts hchzvn
verses.translation: So he came near where I stood; and when he came, I was terrified, and fell upon my face; but he said unto me: ‘Understand, O son of man; for the vision belongeth to the time of the end.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְדַבְּר֣וֹ עִמִּ֔י נִרְדַּ֥מְתִּי עַל־פָּנַ֖י אָ֑רְצָה וַיִּ֨גַּע־בִּ֔י וַיַּֽעֲמִידֵ֖נִי עַל־עׇמְדִֽי׃
verses.translit: vbdbrv 'my nrdmty 'lpny 'rtsh vyg'by vy'mydny 'l'mdy
verses.translation: Now as he was speaking with me, I fell into a deep sleep with my face toward the ground; but he touched me, and set me upright.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הִנְנִ֣י מוֹדִֽיעֲךָ֔ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶ֖ה בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַזָּ֑עַם כִּ֖י לְמוֹעֵ֥ד קֵֽץ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr hnny mvdy'kh 't 'shryhyh b'chryt hz'm khy lmv'd qts
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the latter time of the indignation; for it belongeth to the appointed time of the end.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאַ֥יִל אֲשֶׁר־רָאִ֖יתָ בַּ֣עַל הַקְּרָנָ֑יִם מַלְכֵ֖י מָדַ֥י וּפָרָֽס׃
verses.translit: h'yl 'shrr'yt b'l hqrnym mlkhy mdy vprs
verses.translation: The ram which thou sawest having the two horns, they are the kings of Media and Persia.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַצָּפִ֥יר הַשָּׂעִ֖יר מֶ֣לֶךְ יָוָ֑ן וְהַקֶּ֤רֶן הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֵּין־עֵינָ֔יו ה֖וּא הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.translit: vhtspyr hsh'yr mlkh yvn vhqrn hgdvlh 'shr byn'ynyv hv' hmlkh hr'shvn
verses.translation: And the rough he-goat is the king of Greece; and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַ֨נִּשְׁבֶּ֔רֶת וַתַּֽעֲמֹ֥דְנָה אַרְבַּ֖ע תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ אַרְבַּ֧ע מַלְכֻי֛וֹת מִגּ֥וֹי יַעֲמֹ֖דְנָה וְלֹ֥א בְכֹחֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhnshbrt vt'mdnh 'rb' tchtyh 'rb' mlkhyvt mgvy y'mdnh vl' bkhchv
verses.translation: And as for that which was broken, in the place whereof four stood up, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not with his power.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽבְאַחֲרִית֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔ם כְּהָתֵ֖ם הַפֹּשְׁעִ֑ים יַעֲמֹ֛ד מֶ֥לֶךְ עַז־פָּנִ֖ים וּמֵבִ֥ין חִידֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vb'chryt mlkhvtm khhtm hpsh'ym y'md mlkh 'zpnym vmbyn chydvt
verses.translation: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors have completed their transgression, there shall stand up a king of fierce countenance, and understanding stratagems.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָצַ֤ם כֹּחוֹ֙ וְלֹ֣א בְכֹח֔וֹ וְנִפְלָא֥וֹת יַשְׁחִ֖ית וְהִצְלִ֣יחַ וְעָשָׂ֑ה וְהִשְׁחִ֥ית עֲצוּמִ֖ים וְעַם־קְדֹשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: v'tsm khchv vl' bkhchv vnpl'vt yshchyt vhtslych v'shh vhshchyt 'tsvmym v'mqdshym
verses.translation: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power; and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper and do; and he shall destroy them that are mighty and the people of the saints.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־שִׂכְל֗וֹ וְהִצְלִ֤יחַ מִרְמָה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ וּבִלְבָב֣וֹ יַגְדִּ֔יל וּבְשַׁלְוָ֖ה יַשְׁחִ֣ית רַבִּ֑ים וְעַ֤ל שַׂר־שָׂרִים֙ יַעֲמֹ֔ד וּבְאֶ֥פֶס יָ֖ד יִשָּׁבֵֽר׃
verses.translit: v'lshkhlv vhtslych mrmh bydv vblbbv ygdyl vbshlvh yshchyt rbym v'l shrshrym y'md vb'ps yd yshbr
verses.translation: And through his cunning he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and in time of security shall he destroy many; he shall also stand up against the prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַרְאֵ֨ה הָעֶ֧רֶב וְהַבֹּ֛קֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נֶאֱמַ֖ר אֱמֶ֣ת ה֑וּא וְאַתָּה֙ סְתֹ֣ם הֶֽחָז֔וֹן כִּ֖י לְיָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vmr'h h'rb vhbqr 'shr n'mr 'mt hv' v'th stm hchzvn khy lymym rbym
verses.translation: And the vision of the evenings and mornings which hath been told is true; but thou, shut thou up the vision; for it belongeth to many days to come.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֗אל נִהְיֵ֤יתִי וְנֶֽחֱלֵ֙יתִי֙ יָמִ֔ים וָאָק֕וּם וָאֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה אֶת־מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וָאֶשְׁתּוֹמֵ֥ם עַל־הַמַּרְאֶ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין מֵבִֽין׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'ny dny'l nhyyty vnchlyty ymym v'qvm v''shh 'tml'kht hmlkh v'shtvmm 'lhmr'h v'yn mbyn {p}
verses.translation: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick certain days; then I rose up, and did the king’s business; and I was appalled at the vision, but understood it not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת אַחַ֗ת לְדָרְיָ֛וֶשׁ בֶּן־אֲחַשְׁוֵר֖וֹשׁ מִזֶּ֣רַע מָדָ֑י אֲשֶׁ֣ר הׇמְלַ֔ךְ עַ֖ל מַלְכ֥וּת כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.translit: bshnt 'cht ldryvsh bn'chshvrvsh mzr' mdy 'shr hmlkh 'l mlkhvt khshdym
verses.translation: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, who was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֤ת אַחַת֙ לְמׇלְכ֔וֹ אֲנִי֙ דָּֽנִיֵּ֔אל בִּינֹ֖תִי בַּסְּפָרִ֑ים מִסְפַּ֣ר הַשָּׁנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־יִרְמְיָ֣ה הַנָּבִ֔יא לְמַלֹּ֛אות לְחׇרְב֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם שִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: bshnt 'cht lmlkhv 'ny dny'l bynty bsprym mspr hshnym 'shr hyh dbryhvh 'lyrmyh hnby' lml'vt lchrbvt yrvshl͏m shb'ym shnh
verses.translation: in the first year of his reign I Daniel meditated in the books, over the number of the years, whereof the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet, that He would accomplish for the desolations of Jerusalem seventy years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶתְּנָ֣ה אֶת־פָּנַ֗י אֶל־אֲדֹנָי֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְבַקֵּ֥שׁ תְּפִלָּ֖ה וְתַחֲנוּנִ֑ים בְּצ֖וֹם וְשַׂ֥ק וָאֵֽפֶר׃
verses.translit: v'tnh 'tpny 'l'dny h'lhym lbqsh tplh vtchnvnym btsvm vshq v'pr
verses.translation: And I set my face unto the Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָֽאֶתְפַּֽלְלָ֛ה לַיהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהַ֖י וָאֶתְוַדֶּ֑ה וָאֹֽמְרָ֗ה אָנָּ֤א אֲדֹנָי֙ הָאֵ֤ל הַגָּדוֹל֙ וְהַנּוֹרָ֔א שֹׁמֵ֤ר הַבְּרִית֙ וְֽהַחֶ֔סֶד לְאֹהֲבָ֖יו וּלְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י מִצְוֺתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'tpllh lyhvh 'lhy v'tvdh v'mrh 'n' 'dny h'l hgdvl vhnvr' shmr hbryt vhchsd l'hbyv vlshmry mtsvtyv
verses.translation: And I prayed unto the LORD my God, and made confession, and said: ‘O Lord, the great and awful God, who keepest covenant and mercy with them that love Thee and keep Thy commandments,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָטָ֥אנוּ וְעָוִ֖ינוּ (והרשענו) [הִרְשַׁ֣עְנוּ] וּמָרָ֑דְנוּ וְס֥וֹר מִמִּצְוֺתֶ֖ךָ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: cht'nv v'vynv (vhrsh'nv) [hrsh'nv] vmrdnv vsvr mmtsvtkh vmmshptykh
verses.translation: we have sinned, and have dealt iniquitously, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, and have turned aside from Thy commandments and from Thine ordinances;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א שָׁמַ֙עְנוּ֙ אֶל־עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבְּרוּ֙ בְּשִׁמְךָ֔ אֶל־מְלָכֵ֥ינוּ שָׂרֵ֖ינוּ וַאֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ וְאֶ֖ל כׇּל־עַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vl' shm'nv 'l'bdykh hnby'ym 'shr dbrv bshmkh 'lmlkhynv shrynv v'btynv v'l khl'm h'rts
verses.translation: neither have we hearkened unto Thy servants the prophets, that spoke in Thy name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְךָ֤ אֲדֹנָי֙ הַצְּדָקָ֔ה וְלָ֛נוּ בֹּ֥שֶׁת הַפָּנִ֖ים כַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה לְאִ֤ישׁ יְהוּדָה֙ וּלְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וּֽלְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֞ל הַקְּרֹבִ֣ים וְהָרְחֹקִ֗ים בְּכׇל־הָֽאֲרָצוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִדַּחְתָּ֣ם שָׁ֔ם בְּמַעֲלָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָֽעֲלוּ־בָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: lkh 'dny htsdqh vlnv bsht hpnym khyvm hzh l'ysh yhvdh vlyshby yrvshl͏m vlkhlyshr'l hqrbym vhrchqym bkhlh'rtsvt 'shr hdchtm shm bm'lm 'shr m'lvbkh
verses.translation: Unto Thee, O Lord, belongeth righteousness, but unto us confusion of face, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto all Israel, that are near, and that are far off, through all the countries whither Thou hast driven them, because they dealt treacherously with Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֗ה לָ֚נוּ בֹּ֣שֶׁת הַפָּנִ֔ים לִמְלָכֵ֥ינוּ לְשָׂרֵ֖ינוּ וְלַאֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖אנוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: yhvh lnv bsht hpnym lmlkhynv lshrynv vl'btynv 'shr cht'nv lkh
verses.translation: O LORD, to us belongeth confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַֽאדֹנָ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ הָרַחֲמִ֖ים וְהַסְּלִח֑וֹת כִּ֥י מָרַ֖דְנוּ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: l'dny 'lhynv hrchmym vhslchvt khy mrdnv bv
verses.translation: To the Lord our God belong compassions and forgivenesses; for we have rebelled against Him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְנוּ בְּק֖וֹל יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לָלֶ֤כֶת בְּתֽוֹרֹתָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣ן לְפָנֵ֔ינוּ בְּיַ֖ד עֲבָדָ֥יו הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃
verses.translit: vl' shm'nv bqvl yhvh 'lhynv llkht btvrtyv 'shr ntn lpnynv byd 'bdyv hnby'ym
verses.translation: neither have we hearkened to the voice of the LORD our God, to walk in His laws, which He set before us by His servants the prophets. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עָֽבְרוּ֙ אֶת־תּ֣וֹרָתֶ֔ךָ וְס֕וֹר לְבִלְתִּ֖י שְׁמ֣וֹעַ בְּקֹלֶ֑ךָ וַתִּתַּ֨ךְ עָלֵ֜ינוּ הָאָלָ֣ה וְהַשְּׁבֻעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר כְּתוּבָה֙ בְּתוֹרַת֙ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עֶֽבֶד־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים כִּ֥י חָטָ֖אנוּ לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vkhlyshr'l 'brv 'ttvrtkh vsvr lblty shmv' bqlkh vttkh 'lynv h'lh vhshb'h 'shr khtvbh btvrt mshh 'bdh'lhym khy cht'nv lv
verses.translation: Yea, all Israel have transgressed Thy law, and have turned aside, so as not to hearken to Thy voice; and so there hath been poured out upon us the curse and the oath that is written in the Law of Moses the servant of God; for we have sinned against Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֜קֶם אֶת־[דְּבָר֣וֹ ] (דבריו) אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֣ר עָלֵ֗ינוּ וְעַ֤ל שֹֽׁפְטֵ֙ינוּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁפָט֔וּנוּ לְהָבִ֥יא עָלֵ֖ינוּ רָעָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־נֶעֶשְׂתָ֗ה תַּ֚חַת כׇּל־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נֶעֶשְׂתָ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vyqm 't[dbrv ] (dbryv) 'shrdbr 'lynv v'l shptynv 'shr shptvnv lhby' 'lynv r'h gdlh 'shr l'n'shth tcht khlhshmym kh'shr n'shth byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And He hath confirmed His word, which He spoke against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil; so that under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּתוּב֙ בְּתוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֛ת כׇּל־הָרָעָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בָּ֣אָה עָלֵ֑ינוּ וְלֹֽא־חִלִּ֜ינוּ אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י  יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ לָשׁוּב֙ מֵֽעֲוֺנֵ֔נוּ וּלְהַשְׂכִּ֖יל בַּאֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: kh'shr khtvb btvrt mshh 't khlhr'h hz't b'h 'lynv vl'chlynv 'tpny  yhvh 'lhynv lshvb m'vnnv vlhshkhyl b'mtkh
verses.translation: As it is written in the Law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us; yet have we not entreated the favour of the LORD our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and have discernment in Thy truth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁקֹ֤ד יְהֹוָה֙ עַל־הָ֣רָעָ֔ה וַיְבִיאֶ֖הָ עָלֵ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־צַדִּ֞יק יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עַל־כׇּל־מַֽעֲשָׂיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ בְּקֹלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshqd yhvh 'lhr'h vyby'h 'lynv khytsdyq yhvh 'lhynv 'lkhlm'shyv 'shr 'shh vl' shm'nv bqlv
verses.translation: And so the LORD hath watched over the evil, and brought it upon us; for the LORD our God is righteous in all His works which He hath done, and we have not hearkened to His voice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה  אֲדֹנָ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אֲשֶׁר֩ הוֹצֵ֨אתָ אֶֽת־עַמְּךָ֜ מֵאֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בְּיָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֔ה וַתַּֽעַשׂ־לְךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם כַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה חָטָ֖אנוּ רָשָֽׁעְנוּ׃
verses.translit: v'th  'dny 'lhynv 'shr hvts't 't'mkh m'rts mtsrym byd chzqh vt'shlkh shm khyvm hzh cht'nv rsh'nv
verses.translation: And now, O Lord our God, that hast brought Thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and hast gotten Thee renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֗י כְּכׇל־צִדְקֹתֶ֙ךָ֙ יָֽשׇׁב־נָ֤א אַפְּךָ֙ וַחֲמָ֣תְךָ֔ מֵעִֽירְךָ֥ יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם הַר־קׇדְשֶׁ֑ךָ כִּ֤י בַחֲטָאֵ֙ינוּ֙ וּבַעֲוֺנ֣וֹת אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ יְרוּשָׁלַ֧͏ִם וְעַמְּךָ֛ לְחֶרְפָּ֖ה לְכׇל־סְבִיבֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: 'dny khkhltsdqtkh yshbn' 'pkh vchmtkh m'yrkh yrvshl͏m hrqdshkh khy bcht'ynv vb'vnvt 'btynv yrvshl͏m v'mkh lchrph lkhlsbybtynv
verses.translation: O Lord, according to all Thy righteousness, let Thine anger and Thy fury, I pray Thee, be turned away from Thy city Jerusalem, Thy holy mountain; because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and Thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה  שְׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֤ת עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְאֶל־תַּ֣חֲנוּנָ֔יו וְהָאֵ֣ר פָּנֶ֔יךָ עַל־מִקְדָּשְׁךָ֖ הַשָּׁמֵ֑ם לְמַ֖עַן אֲדֹנָֽי׃
verses.translit: v'th  shm' 'lhynv 'ltplt 'bdkh v'ltchnvnyv vh'r pnykh 'lmqdshkh hshmm lm'n 'dny
verses.translation: Now therefore, O our God, hearken unto the prayer of Thy servant, and to his supplications, and cause Thy face to shine upon Thy sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַטֵּ֨ה אֱלֹהַ֥י ׀ אׇזְנְךָ֮ וּֽשְׁמָע֒ (פקחה) [פְּקַ֣ח] עֵינֶ֗יךָ וּרְאֵה֙ שֹֽׁמְמֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְהָעִ֕יר אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֥א שִׁמְךָ֖ עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֣י  לֹ֣א עַל־צִדְקֹתֵ֗ינוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ מַפִּילִ֤ים תַּחֲנוּנֵ֙ינוּ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֖י עַל־רַחֲמֶ֥יךָ הָרַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: hth 'lhy  'znkh vshm' (pqchh) [pqch] 'ynykh vr'h shmmtynv vh'yr 'shrnqr' shmkh 'lyh khy  l' 'ltsdqtynv 'nchnv mpylym tchnvnynv lpnykh khy 'lrchmykh hrbym
verses.translation: O my God, incline Thine ear, and hear; open Thine eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city upon which Thy name is called; for we do not present our supplications before Thee because of our righteousness, but because of Thy great compassions.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֤י ׀ שְׁמָ֙עָה֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י ׀ סְלָ֔חָה אֲדֹנָ֛י הַֽקְשִׁ֥יבָה וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה אַל־תְּאַחַ֑ר לְמַֽעַנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּֽי־שִׁמְךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל־עִירְךָ֖ וְעַל־עַמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'dny  shm'h 'dny  slchh 'dny hqshybh v'shh 'lt'chr lm'nkh 'lhy khyshmkh nqr' 'l'yrkh v'l'mkh
verses.translation: O Lord, hear, O Lord, forgive, O Lord, attend and do, defer not; for Thine own sake, O my God, because Thy name is called upon Thy city and Thy people.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְע֨וֹד אֲנִ֤י מְדַבֵּר֙ וּמִתְפַּלֵּ֔ל וּמִתְוַדֶּה֙ חַטָּאתִ֔י וְחַטַּ֖את עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּמַפִּ֣יל תְּחִנָּתִ֗י לִפְנֵי֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֔י עַ֖ל הַר־קֹ֥דֶשׁ אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translit: v'vd 'ny mdbr vmtpll vmtvdh cht'ty vcht't 'my yshr'l vmpyl tchnty lpny yhvh 'lhy 'l hrqdsh 'lhy
verses.translation: And while I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the LORD my God for the holy mountain of my God;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְע֛וֹד אֲנִ֥י מְדַבֵּ֖ר בַּתְּפִלָּ֑ה וְהָאִ֣ישׁ גַּבְרִיאֵ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ רָאִ֨יתִי בֶחָז֤וֹן בַּתְּחִלָּה֙ מֻעָ֣ף בִּיעָ֔ף נֹגֵ֣עַ אֵלַ֔י כְּעֵ֖ת מִנְחַת־עָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: v'vd 'ny mdbr btplh vh'ysh gbry'l 'shr r'yty bchzvn btchlh m'f by'f ng' 'ly kh't mncht'rb
verses.translation: yea, while I was speaking in prayer, the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, approached close to me about the time of the evening offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֖בֶן וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר עִמִּ֑י וַיֹּאמַ֕ר דָּנִיֵּ֕אל עַתָּ֥ה יָצָ֖אתִי לְהַשְׂכִּילְךָ֥ בִינָֽה׃
verses.translit: vybn vydbr 'my vy'mr dny'l 'th yts'ty lhshkhylkh bynh
verses.translation: And he made me to understand, and talked with me, and said: ‘O Daniel, I am now come forth to make thee skilful of understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּתְחִלַּ֨ת תַּחֲנוּנֶ֜יךָ יָצָ֣א דָבָ֗ר וַאֲנִי֙ בָּ֣אתִי לְהַגִּ֔יד כִּ֥י חֲמוּד֖וֹת אָ֑תָּה וּבִין֙ בַּדָּבָ֔ר וְהָבֵ֖ן בַּמַּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: btchlt tchnvnykh yts' dbr v'ny b'ty lhgyd khy chmvdvt 'th vbyn bdbr vhbn bmr'h
verses.translation: At the beginning of thy supplications a word went forth, and I am come to declare it; for thou art greatly beloved; therefore look into the word, and understand the vision.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁבֻעִ֨ים שִׁבְעִ֜ים נֶחְתַּ֥ךְ עַֽל־עַמְּךָ֣  וְעַל־עִ֣יר קׇדְשֶׁ֗ךָ לְכַלֵּ֨א הַפֶּ֜שַׁע (ולחתם) [וּלְהָתֵ֤ם] (חטאות) [חַטָּאת֙] וּלְכַפֵּ֣ר עָוֺ֔ן וּלְהָבִ֖יא צֶ֣דֶק עֹֽלָמִ֑ים וְלַחְתֹּם֙ חָז֣וֹן וְנָבִ֔יא וְלִמְשֹׁ֖חַ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קׇֽדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: shb'ym shb'ym nchtkh 'l'mkh  v'l'yr qdshkh lkhl' hpsh' (vlchtm) [vlhtm] (cht'vt) [cht't] vlkhpr 'vn vlhby' tsdq 'lmym vlchtm chzvn vnby' vlmshch qdsh qdshym
verses.translation: Seventy weeks are decreed upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sin, and to forgive iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal vision and prophet, and to anoint the most holy place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתֵדַ֨ע וְתַשְׂכֵּ֜ל מִן־מֹצָ֣א דָבָ֗ר לְהָשִׁיב֙ וְלִבְנ֤וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ עַד־מָשִׁ֣יחַ נָגִ֔יד שָׁבֻעִ֖ים שִׁבְעָ֑ה וְשָׁבֻעִ֞ים שִׁשִּׁ֣ים וּשְׁנַ֗יִם תָּשׁוּב֙ וְנִבְנְתָה֙ רְח֣וֹב וְחָר֔וּץ וּבְצ֖וֹק הָעִתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vtd' vtshkhl mnmts' dbr lhshyb vlbnvt yrvshl͏m 'dmshych ngyd shb'ym shb'h vshb'ym shshym vshnym tshvb vnbnth rchvb vchrvts vbtsvq h'tym
verses.translation: Know therefore and discern, that from the going forth of the word to restore and to build Jerusalem unto one anointed, a prince, shall be seven weeks; and for threescore and two weeks, it shall be built again, with broad place and moat, but in troublous times.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵ֤י הַשָּׁבֻעִים֙ שִׁשִּׁ֣ים וּשְׁנַ֔יִם יִכָּרֵ֥ת מָשִׁ֖יחַ וְאֵ֣ין ל֑וֹ וְהָעִ֨יר וְהַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ יַ֠שְׁחִ֠ית עַ֣ם נָגִ֤יד הַבָּא֙ וְקִצּ֣וֹ בַשֶּׁ֔טֶף וְעַד֙ קֵ֣ץ מִלְחָמָ֔ה נֶחֱרֶ֖צֶת שֹׁמֵמֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'chry hshb'ym shshym vshnym ykhrt mshych v'yn lv vh'yr vhqdsh yshchyt 'm ngyd hb' vqtsv bshtf v'd qts mlchmh nchrtst shmmvt
verses.translation: And after the threescore and two weeks shall an anointed one be cut off, and be no more; and the people of a prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; but his end shall be with a flood; and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִגְבִּ֥יר בְּרִ֛ית לָרַבִּ֖ים שָׁב֣וּעַ אֶחָ֑ד וַחֲצִ֨י הַשָּׁב֜וּעַ יַשְׁבִּ֣ית  זֶ֣בַח וּמִנְחָ֗ה וְעַ֨ל כְּנַ֤ף שִׁקּוּצִים֙ מְשֹׁמֵ֔ם וְעַד־כָּלָה֙ וְנֶ֣חֱרָצָ֔ה תִּתַּ֖ךְ עַל־שֹׁמֵֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhgbyr bryt lrbym shbv' 'chd vchtsy hshbv' yshbyt  zbch vmnchh v'l khnf shqvtsym mshmm v'dkhlh vnchrtsh ttkh 'lshmm {s}
verses.translation: And he shall make a firm covenant with many for one week; and for half of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the offering to cease; and upon the wing of detestable things shall be that which causeth appalment; and that until the extermination wholly determined be poured out upon that which causeth appalment.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁל֗וֹשׁ לְכ֙וֹרֶשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס דָּבָר֙ נִגְלָ֣ה לְדָֽנִיֵּ֔אל אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ בֵּלְטְאשַׁצַּ֑ר וֶאֱמֶ֤ת הַדָּבָר֙ וְצָבָ֣א גָד֔וֹל וּבִין֙ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֔ר וּבִ֥ינָה ל֖וֹ בַּמַּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: bshnt shlvsh lkhvrsh mlkh prs dbr nglh ldny'l 'shrnqr' shmv blt'shtsr v'mt hdbr vtsb' gdvl vbyn 'thdbr vbynh lv bmr'h
verses.translation: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a word was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the word was true, even a great warfare; and he gave heed to the word, and had understanding of the vision.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֖ים הָהֵ֑ם אֲנִ֤י דָֽנִיֵּאל֙ הָיִ֣יתִי מִתְאַבֵּ֔ל שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה שָׁבֻעִ֖ים יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: bymym hhm 'ny dny'l hyyty mt'bl shlshh shb'ym ymym
verses.translation: In those days I Daniel was mourning three whole weeks.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֶ֣חֶם חֲמֻד֞וֹת לֹ֣א אָכַ֗לְתִּי וּבָשָׂ֥ר וָיַ֛יִן לֹא־בָ֥א אֶל־פִּ֖י וְס֣וֹךְ לֹא־סָ֑כְתִּי עַד־מְלֹ֕את שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת שָׁבֻעִ֖ים יָמִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lchm chmdvt l' 'khlty vbshr vyyn l'b' 'lpy vsvkh l'skhty 'dml't shlsht shb'ym ymym {p}
verses.translation: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְי֛וֹם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן וַאֲנִ֗י הָיִ֛יתִי עַ֣ל יַ֧ד הַנָּהָ֛ר הַגָּד֖וֹל ה֥וּא חִדָּֽקֶל׃
verses.translit: vbyvm 'shrym v'rb'h lchdsh hr'shvn v'ny hyyty 'l yd hnhr hgdvl hv' chdql
verses.translation: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Tigris,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשָּׂ֤א אֶת־עֵינַי֙ וָאֵ֔רֶא וְהִנֵּ֥ה אִישׁ־אֶחָ֖ד לָב֣וּשׁ בַּדִּ֑ים וּמׇתְנָ֥יו חֲגֻרִ֖ים בְּכֶ֥תֶם אוּפָֽז׃
verses.translit: v'sh' 't'yny v'r' vhnh 'ysh'chd lbvsh bdym vmtnyv chgrym bkhtm 'vpz
verses.translation: I lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּגְוִיָּת֣וֹ כְתַרְשִׁ֗ישׁ וּפָנָ֞יו כְּמַרְאֵ֤ה בָרָק֙ וְעֵינָיו֙ כְּלַפִּ֣ידֵי אֵ֔שׁ וּזְרֹֽעֹתָיו֙ וּמַרְגְּלֹתָ֔יו כְּעֵ֖ין נְחֹ֣שֶׁת קָלָ֑ל וְק֥וֹל דְּבָרָ֖יו כְּק֥וֹל הָמֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vgvytv khtrshysh vpnyv khmr'h brq v'ynyv khlpydy 'sh vzr'tyv vmrgltyv kh'yn nchsht qll vqvl dbryv khqvl hmvn
verses.translation: his body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as torches of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to burnished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאִ֩יתִי֩ אֲנִ֨י דָנִיֵּ֤אל לְבַדִּי֙ אֶת־הַמַּרְאָ֔ה וְהָאֲנָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ עִמִּ֔י לֹ֥א רָא֖וּ אֶת־הַמַּרְאָ֑ה אֲבָ֗ל חֲרָדָ֤ה גְדֹלָה֙ נָפְלָ֣ה עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וַֽיִּבְרְח֖וּ בְּהֵחָבֵֽא׃
verses.translit: vr'yty 'ny dny'l lbdy 'thmr'h vh'nshym 'shr hyv 'my l' r'v 'thmr'h 'bl chrdh gdlh nplh 'lyhm vybrchv bhchb'
verses.translation: And I Daniel alone saw the vision; for the men that were with me saw not the vision; howbeit a great trembling fell upon them, and they fled to hide themselves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִי֙ נִשְׁאַ֣רְתִּי לְבַדִּ֔י וָֽאֶרְאֶ֗ה אֶת־הַמַּרְאָ֤ה הַגְּדֹלָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את וְלֹ֥א נִשְׁאַר־בִּ֖י כֹּ֑חַ וְהוֹדִ֗י נֶהְפַּ֤ךְ עָלַי֙ לְמַשְׁחִ֔ית וְלֹ֥א עָצַ֖רְתִּי כֹּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: v'ny nsh'rty lbdy v'r'h 'thmr'h hgdlh hz't vl' nsh'rby khch vhvdy nhpkh 'ly lmshchyt vl' 'tsrty khch
verses.translation: So that I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me; for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁמַ֖ע אֶת־ק֣וֹל דְּבָרָ֑יו וּכְשׇׁמְעִי֙ אֶת־ק֣וֹל דְּבָרָ֔יו וַאֲנִ֗י הָיִ֛יתִי נִרְדָּ֥ם עַל־פָּנַ֖י וּפָנַ֥י אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.translit: v'shm' 'tqvl dbryv vkhshm'y 'tqvl dbryv v'ny hyyty nrdm 'lpny vpny 'rtsh
verses.translation: Yet heard I the voice of his words; and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I fallen into a deep sleep on my face, with my face toward the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה־יָ֖ד נָ֣גְעָה בִּ֑י וַתְּנִיעֵ֥נִי עַל־בִּרְכַּ֖י וְכַפּ֥וֹת יָדָֽי׃
verses.translit: vhnhyd ng'h by vtny'ny 'lbrkhy vkhpvt ydy
verses.translation: And, behold, a hand touched me, which set me tottering upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֡י דָּנִיֵּ֣אל אִישׁ־חֲ֠מֻד֠וֹת הָבֵ֨ן בַּדְּבָרִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר֩ אָנֹכִ֨י דֹבֵ֤ר אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ וַעֲמֹ֣ד עַל־עׇמְדֶ֔ךָ כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה שֻׁלַּ֣חְתִּי אֵלֶ֑יךָ וּבְדַבְּר֥וֹ עִמִּ֛י אֶת־הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה עָמַ֥דְתִּי מַרְעִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly dny'l 'yshchmdvt hbn bdbrym 'shr 'nkhy dbr 'lykh v'md 'l'mdkh khy 'th shlchty 'lykh vbdbrv 'my 'thdbr hzh 'mdty mr'yd
verses.translation: And he said unto me: ‘O Daniel, thou man greatly beloved, give heed unto the words that I speak unto thee, and stand upright; for now am I sent unto thee’; and when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַי֮ אַל־תִּירָ֣א דָנִיֵּאל֒ כִּ֣י  מִן־הַיּ֣וֹם הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧תָּ אֶֽת־לִבְּךָ֛ לְהָבִ֧ין וּלְהִתְעַנּ֛וֹת לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נִשְׁמְע֣וּ דְבָרֶ֑יךָ וַאֲנִי־בָ֖אתִי בִּדְבָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly 'ltyr' dny'l khy  mnhyvm hr'shvn 'shr ntt 'tlbkh lhbyn vlht'nvt lpny 'lhykh nshm'v dbrykh v'nyb'ty bdbrykh
verses.translation: Then said he unto me: ‘Fear not, Daniel; for from the first day that thou didst set thy heart to understand, and to humble thyself before thy God, thy words were heard; and I am come because of thy words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂ֣ר  מַלְכ֣וּת פָּרַ֗ס עֹמֵ֤ד לְנֶגְדִּי֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְאֶחָ֣ד י֔וֹם וְהִנֵּ֣ה מִֽיכָאֵ֗ל אַחַ֛ד הַשָּׂרִ֥ים הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים בָּ֣א לְעׇזְרֵ֑נִי וַאֲנִי֙ נוֹתַ֣רְתִּי שָׁ֔ם אֵ֖צֶל מַלְכֵ֥י פָרָֽס׃
verses.translit: vshr  mlkhvt prs 'md lngdy 'shrym v'chd yvm vhnh mykh'l 'chd hshrym hr'shnym b' l'zrny v'ny nvtrty shm 'tsl mlkhy prs
verses.translation: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days; but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I was left over there beside the kings of Persia.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֙אתִי֙ לַהֲבִ֣ינְךָ֔ אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָ֥ה לְעַמְּךָ֖ בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֑ים כִּי־ע֥וֹד חָז֖וֹן לַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vb'ty lhbynkh 't 'shryqrh l'mkh b'chryt hymym khy'vd chzvn lymym
verses.translation: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the end of days; for there is yet a vision for the days.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְדַבְּר֣וֹ עִמִּ֔י כַּדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה נָתַ֧תִּי פָנַ֛י אַ֖רְצָה וְנֶאֱלָֽמְתִּי׃
verses.translit: vbdbrv 'my khdbrym h'lh ntty pny 'rtsh vn'lmty
verses.translation: And when he had spoken unto me according to these words, I set my face toward the ground, and was dumb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֗ה כִּדְמוּת֙ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם נֹגֵ֖עַ עַל־שְׂפָתָ֑י וָאֶפְתַּח־פִּ֗י וָאֲדַבְּרָה֙ וָאֹֽמְרָה֙ אֶל־הָעֹמֵ֣ד לְנֶגְדִּ֔י אֲדֹנִ֗י בַּמַּרְאָה֙ נֶהֶפְכ֤וּ צִירַי֙ עָלַ֔י וְלֹ֥א עָצַ֖רְתִּי כֹּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vhnh khdmvt bny 'dm ng' 'lshpty v'ptchpy v'dbrh v'mrh 'lh'md lngdy 'dny bmr'h nhpkhv tsyry 'ly vl' 'tsrty khch
verses.translation: And, behold, one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips; then I opened my mouth, and spoke and said unto him that stood before me: ‘O my lord, by reason of the vision my pains are come upon me, and I retain no strength.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵ֣יךְ יוּכַ֗ל עֶ֤בֶד אֲדֹנִי֙ זֶ֔ה לְדַבֵּ֖ר עִם־אֲדֹ֣נִי זֶ֑ה וַאֲנִ֤י מֵעַ֙תָּה֙ לֹֽא־יַעֲמׇד־בִּ֣י כֹ֔חַ וּנְשָׁמָ֖ה לֹ֥א נִשְׁאֲרָה־בִֽי׃
verses.translit: vhykh yvkhl 'bd 'dny zh ldbr 'm'dny zh v'ny m'th l'y'mdby khch vnshmh l' nsh'rhby
verses.translation: For how can this servant of my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither was there breath left in me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧סֶף וַיִּגַּע־בִּ֛י כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה אָדָ֖ם וַֽיְחַזְּקֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vysf vyg'by khmr'h 'dm vychzqny
verses.translation: Then there touched me again one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר אַל־תִּירָ֧א אִישׁ־חֲמֻד֛וֹת שָׁל֥וֹם לָ֖ךְ חֲזַ֣ק וַחֲזָ֑ק וּֽכְדַבְּר֤וֹ עִמִּי֙ הִתְחַזַּ֔קְתִּי וָאֹ֥מְרָ֛ה יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י כִּ֥י חִזַּקְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ltyr' 'yshchmdvt shlvm lkh chzq vchzq vkhdbrv 'my htchzqty v'mrh ydbr 'dny khy chzqtny
verses.translation: And he said: ‘O man greatly beloved, fear not! peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong.’ And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said: ‘Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֲיָדַ֙עְתָּ֙ לָמָּה־בָּ֣אתִי אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְעַתָּ֣ה אָשׁ֔וּב לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם עִם־שַׂ֣ר פָּרָ֑ס וַאֲנִ֣י יוֹצֵ֔א וְהִנֵּ֥ה שַׂר־יָוָ֖ן בָּֽא׃
verses.translit: vy'mr hyd't lmhb'ty 'lykh v'th 'shvb lhlchm 'mshr prs v'ny yvts' vhnh shryvn b'
verses.translation: Then said he: Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia; and when I go forth, lo, the prince of Greece shall come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲבָל֙ אַגִּ֣יד לְךָ֔ אֶת־הָרָשׁ֥וּם בִּכְתָ֖ב אֱמֶ֑ת וְאֵ֨ין אֶחָ֜ד מִתְחַזֵּ֤ק עִמִּי֙ עַל־אֵ֔לֶּה כִּ֥י אִם־מִיכָאֵ֖ל שַׂרְכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'bl 'gyd lkh 'thrshvm bkhtb 'mt v'yn 'chd mtchzq 'my 'l'lh khy 'mmykh'l shrkhm {p}
verses.translation: Howbeit I will declare unto thee that which is inscribed in the writing of truth; and there is none that holdeth with me against these, except Michael your prince.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
